Singapore pan Zangkong ah, Zangkong pan Kawlpi ah ut hile hang Tedim a kitungsuak ding ahi hi. Zolai bawlpa Cope topa Zangkong pan Kawlpi a pai ciang ni 7 pan ni 10 sung gunkuang tawh na kihotto hi. Tu hun ciang Singapore ah zing niangtui, Zangkong ah sun ann, Kawlpi ah nitak ann kidelhta hi. Sangmang Cope hun pan tu hun kum 100 sungah khantohna, kikhelna tampi om cih hong lak, hong musak hi. Zomite zong Zolai a thei bek hilo in laibu a bawl ziahziahte hita hang cih hong lak lai hi. Kum lui pek in Zomi Christian Literature Society ah Secretary Rev. Lian Khen Pau in lai khat hong khak a, tua sungah tukum 2013 pen Zolai Simbu Kum 100 a cin kum a hih manin pawi khat kibawl nuam hi cih ahi hi. Pawi kibawl nuam bek hilo in thusinna leh thusunna zong kibawl nuam ah tua ah nang zong thusung dingin nong kihelzo diam ciin deihsakna laidal kilawm mahmah khat hong khak ahi hi. Kei pen Zolai a zang hi in a puah, a zuun zo pawl zong hituanlo in, ka minam pau leh lai Zolai takpi mite banga a siam gina zong hi kisa kei veng aw ciin ka dawnga, midang a kilawmzaw om ding hi ciin ka zasak hi. Ko zong limtak ka ngaihsut khit uh ciang kong zaksak uh hi a, nong san zawh ding zong a lamen hi ung hong ci hi. Tua ahih leh nakpi takin lungdam ing; ka hun omdan hong en ningin hong kikum nung, ciin ka dawngkik hi. Moses bangin kampau siamlo kisakna, Joshua bangin naupang kisakna leh David bangin kei sanga khanghamzaw om hilo hiam ka cih manin thakhat in a sang ngamlo, a kilawmzaw om lua ding ciin ka ngaihsutna leh ka upna ka gen ahi hi. Sia Pau in hong theisiam in, nang nong thusun ding leh gen ding thu pen Zolai leh Zokam bek hilo in tuhun science pilna lam tawh kisai limlim mipite theih ding a hoihte English hilo Zokam tawh hong pulak ding leh khangnote kiangah pilna a kisapna, pilna a zon huaizia hong uang gen dingin kong deih uh hi; a tua dingin nang hong deih hi ung hong cih ciangin kei leltak thugen ka mipihte in hamphatpih ding uh ahih leh ka hanciam kei ding maw ciin ka sang uh hi. Ka nupa un kikum in pai ding ka khentat uh hi. A hun hong tun taktak ciangin lawmnu Cingpi (Vung Deih Cing Valte) in a nasepna nusia theilo, amau sepna ah nurse khempeuh ama khutnuai ah om himawk ahih manin taisan theilo leuleu a, kei bek ka pai hong kulta hi. October 29, 2013 zingsang nai 5 in tho in zingsang niangtui lawmnu in hong awm sitset a, Polar Fruit Cake tawh hong mehsak in ka nek khit uh ciang thungetna nei in vanlengtual lam ka manawh uh hi. Singapore vanlengtual Changi International Airport ka tun uh ciangin Terminal 2 ah lut in ka van teng uh Singapore International Airlines (SIA) SQ 998 ah ap in nai 7 ah lengkhia ding a hun hong nai mahmahta ahih manin a sungah ka lutsuak pah hi. Singapore pen amau gam passport tawite a thupisak mahmah leh a kithupisak nuam gam ahih manin amau gammi leh a gammi banga a tuatte uh (permanent resident) te pen midang lutna ah lutsaklo in amau leh amau konghong tawma lut ziauziau nading kongvang tuambawlsak in tua ah pumpi tung deihtaka kivel cih om vetlo in a lut thei uh hi. Kigualh kullo, kivel kullo a lutsuak in a sungah ka vanleng omna Gate 34 zuanin ka paisuak thei pah hi. A mun ka tun ciang vanleng kongkhak kihong nailo a, vanleng sungah hong lutsak pah nailo uh ahih manin a tuang dingte kingakkhopna ah Free Internet computer te mek in ka facebook peuh ka en hi. Sawt tu manlo cih ciang vanleng kongkhak kihong a, a nunglam a tu dingte lut masa ding cih hi. A lai a tu ding te lut leuleu ding ci; a tawpna ah a mai guala tu dingte ci uh ahih manin a tawpna lam ah ka lut a, a maigual pan sima gual thumna ah ka tu hi. Ka gei ah nungak a kiva mahmah khat hong tu citciat ahih manin ka ihmut suak simsim zong ka ihmu ngam kei hi (hih bel kuamah kiang na gen kei un maw Ka veilam ah mikangte khat tu a, English pau zanglo mikangte ahi hi. Ka taklam nungak pen Kawlgam pan India ah Buddha pianna mun Bodh Gaya ah a hawh hi in Buddha tangthu kigelhna laibu India pan kibawl tampi a pua euau hi. Ei Christian te Israel gam hawh, Bethlehem leh Jerusalem hawh bangin amah zong akingaihsun hingel ding hi. Biakna thu mite in kin, thupibawl, hunpia, uangbawl uh hi. Upna maan tak neih ding, a nungta Pasian biak ding a thupizaw kan a hihna tel huai. Vanleng kongkhak kikhak in a sunga tuang a tamzaw mikang vive hi a, kawlgam ah a khatvei paina uh a tamzaw dingin ka um mawh hi. Banghang hiam cih leh Zangkong vanlengtual ka tun uh ciangin kongkhak ah mite in na dawn zihziah uh a, kawlgam ah sumbawlna leh kizopna ding lam saite leh khuadak dinga khualzin (tourist) te hi in a tunna ding uh hotel te in na dawnsak uh ahi hi. Zomi khat in, a nungcianga hong genna ah, Kawlgam ah mikang hizah nidangin hong zin ngeilo uh hi ciliang hi. Phulum bangin mikangte phul keei uh himai hi. Vanleng sunga tutna 285 om a, a vekpi in dim hi. A hawlte leh vanleng nungakte kihel nailo in. A tuang mihing 285 lak ah a tamzaw mikang ahih manin a sungah thupulakna khempeuh English kizang hi. Zomi a tamzaw hileh Zokam kizang ding hi cih ka ngaihsun kiukiau hi. Vanleng a lenkhiatna ding mun ah pai a, lengkhia dingin kigual diudeu a, ko a a 6na a hih manin tawmvei ka ngak uh hi. Kei hong kha lawmnu zong inn ciahta ding cih bang khawng ka ngaihsun giugiau hi. Vanleng sunga mei teng hong kisumit in, a gin hong kikhek a, a pei hong kiling in hong siip ging teta a, hat deuhdeuh hat deuhdeuh in a mailam hong nawk veva a, huih tungah kilamto in a pei in leizulkha nawnlo in khuapi leh inn te, Singapore khuagei a tuipi tunga Tembawpi te akpi ciacia in kimu a, a sawtna ciang Singapore gam kimu nawnlo in a kilengkhiata himawk hi. Malaysia tungah lengto in Thailand gam tungah lengto a, Andaman Sea tungah lengto in Zangkong a lut ding ka hi uh hi. Meipi te tungah a kilaptoh khit ciangin vanleng sunga meite hong vakkik a, vanleng nungakte a pheizum ngo sitset uh kidawk hialhial kawma kileh zatzatte hong tam semsem hi. Banghangin vakvak uh hiam i cih leh nek ding Apple Juice, Orange Juice cihte hong hawm uh a, Niangtui leh Coffee zong a duhte adingin hong pia uh hi. Tuisik dawn ding zong om a, vantungah tui sangin apple tui khawng kiduhzaw ciat tawh kibang hi. Singapore Airlines ah vanleng nungakte pen Singapore kumpi in The Singapore Girl ciin a ciamteh uh hi a, a melhoih, a thacing, a duangcing, a maitai, a kizen, a thanuam vive kitel hi. Zolia te zah in a hoih dekdek zong om leh kilawm! Nek ding hong hawm leuleu uh a ngasa leh singgah ne ding maw, aksa leh singgah leh alu em cih hi a, kei bang alu pen ka khua vuah zong ka ciin den uh hi cih khawng ngaihsun in ka nek tamloh zawk ngasa leh singgah ka tel hi Singgah leh moh keu, anteh holing leh mehgahte ban ah ngasa a guh omlo khutpek cia khat tawh buhsih leh benangnek sathau nello a kikang hi a, sa vitvit, khu veuveu in lim mahmah a, i nuten phalbi zingsang i thawh cianga nek ding a annhuan uh a thuk khu litlit uh hong phawksak hi. Lim tuak mahmah ahih manin a khu tam pusuaksak manlo in sikkeu, temta leh sikkeuka lakhia in sikkeuka tawh suncip in temta tawh ngasa at khia in ka kam sungah ka guang pah ziauziau hi. Sikkeu tawh suak mehha te suak in ka kamsung mah ka tun zel hi. Limtak haizan sitset leng an lim se ahih man in damdam in ka haizan a, a khum tiuteu ciangin ka valh zel hi. Ahi zongin inn ah i nute huan, i lawmnu te anhuan zah in a lim ding bel leitungah na tam tuanlo himawk ei ka ci veve hi. An kham khit ciang, annek khit ciang hizaw ei, singgahte ne in dawn ding tui tuamtuamte tawh khupsuk leuleu in ka mai a TV kisuaksak pen ka en hi. Ka ut leh football en, ka ut leh News en, ka ut leh movie en, ka ut leh games kimawl cih bangin ka hun hong bei hanhan a, Zangkong khuapi hong kilang dandan hi. Tua tak ciang a pua lam kikhuadak nuamzawata ahih manin music ngaihna ka bil ah thuah in a pua lam ka dak leh gunpi khat Zangkong khuapi laizang ah a luang ka mu hi. Leilak kinaih deuhdeuh in khuapi nai deuhdeuh a, vanlengpei in lei zuutkha in, vanleng kihuang deudeu a, Zangkong vanlengtual ah a tu ka hita mawk uh hauzacinhi. Ka zin masak laiin Zangkong vanlengtual ah pusuak dingin kigualh deudau kisam a, tu hun ciangin pusuahna ding kongvang tamzaw kihong ahih manin sawt ngaklo in ka vaiteng a mansiang pah hi. Ka van hong tunna ding lam manawh phei in duappi tungah hong kitaisak ka van ka muh ciang ka gei hong tun ding ngak in ka likkhia a, Singapore ah kikhen Zangkong ka kimu kik uh hi. Vanleng sungah i vante a nuai lam ah kitusak a, a mihingte a sungah kitusak hi :). A pua ka pusuah leh mi thupi vive Pu Kapno, President, Tedim Baptist Church Yangon; Rev. Cin Sian Pau, Pastor, TBCY; leh Pu Khup Mung, Zozum te in hong na dawn uh a, lungdam khut kilen in ka kinohset khit uh ciangin ka vante hong laksak lian in mawtaw sungah hong guansak uh a, kei mawtaw mai ah hong tusak in amau a nungah a tuang uh hi. Pu Kapno mawtaw tawh vanleng tual gei ah Annekna Phualpi khat ah hong lutpih uh a, aksa kan, moh leh niangtui lim mahmah hong nekpih uh a; tua mun ah Zozum ulian Pu Khup Mung in: Lengtong Kam Khen kiangah, Hong ciah nawn kei in. Nong ciah hangin na kimanna ding om kei. Nang hong samte paina lamlam na zui suak maiin ka cih hiven ciin hong nuisak zaizai a, ka tawl uh hong dam hanhan hi. Zozumpu te kicih dan, kimaingap dante ka muh ciang a ki-it taktak, a kingai taktakte pen suakta takin a nui khawm, a holim khawm, a nuamsa khawmte hi uh cih hong telsak semsem hi. "url": " comgamvai-leh-ki-ukna-lam-politics-bob-tuangpi", "depth": 1 --- Gamvai leh Ki-ukna Lam (Politics) Bob Tuangpi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Gamvai leh Ki-ukna Lam (Politics) Bob Tuangpi posted on 3 November 2016 at 8:12 pm Lomkholna: BobTuangpi, News, Politics, Zomi GZA Youth Forum ah thusunna Paper Thu Patna: Ihun ngah lah tom peuh mahin igen ding thulu lah zailua ahih manin, atomin sut ni cih ong gen masa nuam ing. Gamvai leh ki-ukna vai (Politics) cih ciangin leitung mihingtekhuasakzia khempeuh tawh akisai ban ah nisim nuntakzonna, neekzonna ah mihingte ikizopna khempeuh politics nuai ah aom ahihi. Leitungah mihing a omlai teng buaina (problem) om ding aa tua mihingtebuaina alemtuah ding leh kisapnate akicingsak dingin politics kisem ahihi. Na khempeuh kizom dimdiam tek(inter-related) aa, tua khempeuh abuptuah in politics ahi hi. Lamgei ah mehteh mehgah azuak nupinu leh anbuukah an ahuan nupinu zong gamthu hoih kei leh sukha veve hi. Politics hoih kei leh pilna sinte in zong angah zah ding uh hamphatna vanzatte akipan pilna ngahzolo uh aa, nasemte in zong nasemta leh asepzah un thaman ngahlo uh hi. Papi khat in atate sang akahsak zawhlohna, an akhamhsak zawhlohna pen politics hoih leh sia tawh kisai mahmah hi. Zawnna leh tualniamnate zong politics ahoih loh man mah abulpi hizaw hi. Biakna, ngeina, pilsinna, nasepna, sumbawlna, nuntak khuasakna ah kideidanna leh apilte in apilna bangin thaman hamphatna angahna leh angahlohna pen gamvai leh gam ki-ukna hoih leh hoihlo tungah kingah hi gige hi. Gamvai leh ki-ukna ah panlakna leh gualtung tuanna anei minamte in gamkhat a ut bangbang un zeek thei uh hi. Tua ahih manin, gamthu leh ki-ukna athudonlo minam leh gamte khangtolo in mite nuai ah ong den tawntung uh hi. Tua hi aa, ei khangthak Zomi momnote in politics ah munluah in ithudon ding kisam mahmah ta hi. Politics I uuk kei aa ikin kei leh mite khutsung kitung ding hi. Mihingte in hong piangsak Vanglian Pasian piaksa ipianpih suahtakna, hamphatna leh mihing bangin vaangnei takin inuntakna dingin gamvai leh ki-ukna ahoihloh phamawh hi. Kipawlna tuamtuam, gtna: GZA, Zomi siamsin, ZYA, TYF, ZNCM te zong politics nuai ah a om hi aa, biakna sia makai I Pastor te zong politics nuai ah a om uh ahih manin, politics hoih kei leh hih bang kipawlnate kineitheilo ding hi lai hi. Politics akhiatna atomin gen leeng, mihing omlai teng buaina om ding aa, tuavai khempeuh politics tawh kisai ahihi cih leh ahitheilote ahithei dingin lampi sialna pen politiciante nasep hi cih gen nuam ing. Tua ahih mani, an na neek aa buan na silh naak leh nainggnanzayy tawh kisai na hi aw. Kawlgam Tangthu Tom I gam in gambup thukhunpi(constitution) buli kinei ngei khin hi. Suahtakna ngah khit 1947 gambup thukhunpi(Kawlte aituamphattuamna ding kigelh ahih manin one group show) khat kingei hi. 1974 gambup thukhunpi pen Burma Socialist Programme Party gualtung tuanna ngiat ding kigelh kinei ahih manin (One Party show) kici leuleu hi. Tutung aa izat 2008 gambup thukhunpi leulelu ciangin mimal khat aangsung aituam phattuamna dingin kigelh hi ngiat ahih manin (One man show) cin thukhunpi siam mipilte(consitutionalists) ten minvawh uh hi. Tua hi a, hih 2008 thukhunpi tawh kikalsuansuan lai ahih manin, kuakua in kumpi sem ta leh Democracy kingah nai paklo ding hi. Nung abeisa aa kibawl 21st Century Panglong Khawmpi khit ah damdamin lamlak (political roadmap 7) zui-in NLD kumpi in ong paipihsawm laitak hi. Adiakdiakin gambup makaipipa (President) pen gambu lutang leh gamuk kumpi makai himah ta leh ama thuneihna pen kiciangtanin galkaptetuamdang thuneihna(veto power)hangin muibunzo nailo hi. National Deference and Security Council member (11) thukhensatna bek tawh gambupvai athupi tatak teng kivaihawm thei pan ahihi. Galkap lam pan mihing(6) leh kumpi lampan mihing (5) meetang atamzaw khensatna tawh thutatak kivai hawm thei bek hi. President in thugin tangkona (state of emergency) neilo hi. Igam pen minam tuamtuam teenkhopna (multiculturalismmulti-ethnic country) hin ki-ukna vai ah State-nation tawh kikalsuan ding kimlai gamkhat ah minam khat bek atam teennatezat(Nation-state) tawh ong paipih uh aa, kibelpawlna gam (Union) kampi bek tawh cici napin un atatak ah mimal tamzaw khat minamte kalsuanzia(Unitary state) kikalsuan ahih manin tudong hih dinmun kitung hizaw hi. Presidentialism ci napi un kiteel ciang lah Parliamentary gamte zat general election kizangh zel aa, Presidential election lah kizanghlo zel hi. Cabinet minister teng akoih uh ciang lah Presidential danin hih gawp zel uh hi. Tun zong cikmah hunin aom ngeilo State Counselor cih bang ong om zel hi. Leitung political scientist minthangte na ngawn alung uh amzo liang hi. Tulaitak NLD kumpi bel gamthulam kantel pawl(political commentatoranalyst) ten lah akhauhluasamlo lah akhauhsim giapgiap gamukna (liberal authoritarian Democracy) kumpi cin minvawh phot uh hi. Zomi leh Zogam vai mailam ading lunggulhna 1: Zogam leh Zomi icih pen koi ciang huamsak tatak ding ihihiam. Zomi leh Zogam cih leitang ciangtannna leh hilhcianna (definition) khat Zomi bup deihna leh mailam saupi ngaihsutna tawh Zomi Khawmpi (Zomi National Conference) khat tungtawnin khensat aa Zomi bup deihna lakna(referendum) khat bawlin khensat leeng kimazang leh muibun pen dingin ngaihsun ing. Kawlgam lam om Zogam cih ciangin, tulaitak Chin State bup huamsak takpi ihi hiam. Aih kei leh, tulaitak Tedim, Tonzang leh Cikha townships leitang teng kipsak ding ihi hiam. Aih kei leh, tulaitak Tedim, Tonzang, Cikha townships leh Kalay-Kabaw Valley teng huamsak ding ihi hiam. Aih kei leh tulaitak Chin State teng ci ding maw. Chin state leh Kalay-Kabaw Valley teng Chin State(or) Zomi State aa laih sawm. Teel ding nam(4) nei hihang Tua khensatna pen mimal khat satna, party khat policy leh biakna kipawlna khat pepeuh in khensatlo-in, Zomi bup deihlakna(referendum) bawlin tua tungtawnin kalsuan leeng imailam himialmual nawnlo pah dingin, itupna leh I tungnopna kimucian sitset pan ding hi. Tua thukimna pen mipi in Zomi makaitetungah phalna leh apna piakna (legitimacymandatory) hipah ding hi. Tua bang minam khensatna pan ilampi ding sialna (strategy) leh ilampi totzia ding(tactics) kigeel cian thei pan ding hi. Tua pen Zomi bup minam vai leh gamthu ah ilamlakpi (Zomi nationalpolitical roadmap) hong hiding aa, tua panu in hih bang gen hi cihcih hinawnlo dingin, mipi zong tua lampi zui-in tangtakin taithei pan ding ahih manin, mimal khat bulphuhna(charismatic movementpersonel cult) bei in minam mainawtna muibun in mazang ding hi. Naakpi takin kikum ngelhngelhin Zomibup thukimna ( Zomi national Agreement) zui-in Zomi national vision khat nei thei in, tua tungtawnin ilampi ding leh thugui let ding (strategy policy) tawh kalsuan leeng kitung baih ding hi. India lam om Zomi te in zong amau Zogam ahuamsakna uh Manipur gam sung teng India gamsungah leitang ciangtanna kician khat na nei phot ding uh aa, eimun ciatah akilawm ciang dinmun itun tak teh adang lampite ahunzui-in zon tohtoh ding hizaw hi. Tua bang ahih kei leh ngim neimello in huihlak akapkap tawh kibang bek ding hihang. Lunggulhna 2: I gam zong damdamin ahoih lam ah ong mainawt tohtoh zenzen leh asawtlo-in Democratic Federal Union ah akikalsuan theihna dingin 2008 gambup thukhunpi ong kipuahzo zenzen leh I Zogam pen tu dinmun mah ah munuam ding ihihiam. Tuzawh kum(30) teh iminam igam koici lam ding ihi hiam. Tu bangin a liim(design) geelkholh hun mahmah ta hi. Isanggam mualtungmiten amau deihna bangin a gamliim ding uh suaihsa neikhinzo ta uh hi. Tua ahih manin, tua bangin kikum tangtangin, I Zogam adingin(Zogam thukhunpi) State Consititution gelkholh hun ta hi. Isanggam Laimi lamte in Chin state consittution ding ahampi(2)vei bang apuahna uh hita hi. Zomi State consittution drafting committee bang neih huai mahmah ta hi. Federal ukna tawh kipai leh Union leh State ah thuneihna kiciantakin kihawm ding aa, eima State tekah zong State bup zatding pautaang(common languageofficial language) kisam ding ahih manin Chin State bup ah Zomi mintapnei, kamphenkullo 25 bang pha ihih teh thutampi geelgeel huaita hi. Federal Ukna tawh kikalsuan leh gambupah official language (3)bang kinei ding aa tua pan ah State khatciatin amau minampau zong a State vuah zangh thei ta ding uh hi. Gtna:gambup ah Myanmar, English kizangh thei kim ding aa, Member state khempeuh in amau State sungah azat ding uh pautaang khat kiciamteh ding hi. Federal Ki-ukna tawh pai le hang Zomite tawh bangdan Federal ki-ukna kituak pen ding ahi hiam. Asymetrical FederalismCentalized Federal(India,Belgium, Spain) kituak zaw ding ihiam. Aih kei leh America te Federal danin phualpi pan thuneihna khiapna(decentralized federalism) tawh ikituak ding hiam. Gambup ki-ukzia (government system) zong Parliamentary System tawh Zomite kituakzaw ding maw. Presidentialism tawh kituakzaw ding. I gam min ding pen minammin zuisak ding maw. Igam leitangmin tamhsak ding(ethnic-based state(or) geographical state) hih ding. Cihte mailam ading kikuphuai mahmah ta hi. Adiakdiakin, Zogam dingin tulaitak Tedim, Tonzang, Cikha huam teng ding bang hileeng, gambup constitution sung pan ingah theih ding hamphatna ei leh ei kivai hawmna koi bang ciang dinmun ngahzo leeng hoih pen ding ahihiam. Federal Union nuai ah ki-ukna adawldawl nam(6) bang om thei hi. 1. Union, (2) Member state, (3) Autonomous region, (4) Autonomous Areas, (5) National Area, (6) Native title cih bangin kikhensuk diudeu hi. Gambup Innpi (Union Assembly) leh Member State bek in thukhun bawl theihna nei uh hi. Union in Sovereignty Power aneih ban ah Member state teng in zong thukhun bawl theihna thuneihna (domestic sovereign powerinternal self-determination) nei hi. Tualo teng Member State nuai ah hi. Ahizongin, Union tawh direct kizomin, thuvaihawm theihna tuamtuam om thei veve hi. Tua hileh ei koi dinmun hi ding ihi hiam. Koi tawh kituak pen ding ihi hiam Zomi bup khensatna kisam hi. Lunggulhna3: Zomi tampi tak kumpi nasepna mun thupite iluahzawh nadingin, thasankik leh hanciamkik huai hi. Gambup thukhenzum lam, pilsinna zumte, galkaplam(airforce, navy), police force lam, cidamnazum lamte ah zalianpipi nei le hang, gambup hauhna igam ilei ading kizeek ziahziah thei ding hi. Kawlgambup kalsuanzia ding lamsialte(policy makerstragegists) lam dong leh department tuamtuamte ah mipil dinmun (scholar)isuahzawh nang munthupi diakdiakte iletzawh nang lunggulh huai mahmah hi. Tua bang hileh mimal itawm mahmah hangin ikhutsungah Kawlgam nopsakna, hauhna kizeekkhazo pan ding hi. Zomi min tawh political party khat peuhmah athahat detna ding leh Kawlgambup ah Zomi minpua MP ong omzawh detna dingin kipawlna phuahphatna(institutionalization)bawl zelin, athahat semsem na dingin akisam siamna(technical support) piaktheihna lampi zon ding ahihi. Lunggulhna 4: Zomi sung kipawlna tuamtuamte in ahih leh mipi amitkeuhna dingin pilna piakna(capacity building) khuakimah neihzawhna ding lampi zon aa sepkul ding hi. Gammi hoih leh Democracy ki-ukzia ngeina(democratic culture) ineih theihna ding, khua leh tui, beh leh phung, biakna pawlpi zui-in kigimneihna leh mittawsialkhau letna(stereotyeprejudice) abeitheihna dingin Zomi cih minampi lungsim a om theih nang nuntakzia(civic education) te Zomi nautang sungah akizalh theihna ding panlaak hunta hi(gtna:ZYA, TA, Zomi Siamsin, GZA) cihte Zomi sungah gamvai minamvai leh biaknavaite(politicsreligion) amau mun ciatah kihualkimin atonkhop theihna ding pilvangtakin kalsuan kul ding hi. Lungulhna5: Zomi sung kipawlna khempeuh in atawntungin mimal hamphatna(personel interest) sangin, akipawlna thahatna dingin nasep khopsiamna lungsim(team spirit) aneih ding akisap ban ah, kipawlna hamphatna ding sangin Zomi Zogam hamphatna, khantohna ding(Zomi national interest) masakin minam tungah acihtak ding kisam pen ding hi. Minam sungah gamvai leh biakna makai semte in zulhtatna golhgukneekna(corruption) a om leh apholhkhia ding leh mipi atheisak den ding thukizakna(media) kician leh a encikden ding kipawlna (watch dog) tampi kisamlai hihang. Tua bang hikei leh makaite simtatna gam-le-lei hamphatna ding azong mi om thei tawntung ahih manin, amaute a encik, acingding kipawlna tuamtuam(institutions) neihkul hi. Mihing pen thu nei leh paikhial thei(when people are in power, they are corrupt) zel ahih manin akisaikim ding( check and balance) Zomi sungah kisam hamtang hi. Thugawm Khopna Gamvai sepna, kumpi sung nasepna, minam ading ameet omlo aa kipawlna tawh mapang kipawlna khempeuh amau mun tekah gamtangin akisapna munah minam hamphatna ding leh mailam ading akalsuan diamdiam loh in minam khat leh gamkhat khangto theilo hi. Minam khat leh ki-ukna athahat nadingin, CSOs te athahat loh in minam khat leh gamkhat khangto theilo hi. Tua ahih manin hih hun panin Zomite mailam koici bangin kalsuan ding ihiam cih lamlak(polticalnational roadmap)kician khat mipi tungah tangko khiat ding hun hita hi. Minam ading na hoih gengenna panin nahoih sepna ah paita ni cih tawh ka thusun hipan ka hial bawl hi. Vekpi tungah Lungdam mahmah e. Thusung: Bob Tuangpi 22. 10. 2016, Yangon. Articles Christian Hymn-te Tangthu Knowledge Nang Kong Beel Hi (Hiding in Thee) AgelhZam Khat Kham By: LAIBUSAAL Date: October 22, 2021 Nang Kong Beel Hi Hiding in Thee (Late 31:2) AgelhZam Khat Kham William O. Cushing (1823-1902) Ira D. Sankey (1840-1908) Hih la a phuakpa William O. Cushing pen America gam Hingham, Massachusetts ah December 31, 1823 ni-a suak ahi hi. America gam Nisuahna lam kuamah kum 20 val sung a lawhcing mahmah pastor khat ahi hi. 1870 kum a zi a sih khit ciangin a ci hong dam het lo mawka a nasepna pan a tawp loh hong phamawh hi. Tua hun sungin hymn phuah ding hong lunglut mahmah a, dawng 300 val phuak hi. Topa aw, Nang ading ka sep theih ding khatpeuh hong pia in ci-in thungen ngiat hi. Pasian in a thungetna dawnga la ngaih tampi a phuak dingin zang hi. Mi nuam mahmah khat hi a, amah tawh a kitheikha peuhmah amah a it lo kuama ta om lo hi, kici hi. Gospel la makai minthang Ira D. Sankey, Robert Lowry, George F. Root-a kipan mi minthang tampi tawh kop-in la tampi phuak hi. Hih la a phuahna thu ama gen bangin genkik lehang: Nang Kong Beel Hi la bel Moravia, New York ah 1876 kuma kiphuak ahi hi. Khitui tampi, lungsim gimna tampi, leitung in hong piak theih loh lungsim lunggulhna tampi pana hong luangkhia la hi mai hi. Hih la a kiphuah taktakna bel Mr. Sankey in, Ka gospel nasepna-a ong huh ding la thak khat hong khak dih in ci-a hong ngetna pana kipan ahi hi. Tua bang mi khat tung pan tua bang tupna tawh tua banga huhna ong kinget ciangin Pasian hong sawl hi ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Kei zong thu ka ngena, Topa aw, Nangma minthan nadingin bang khatpeuh hong pia in ka ci hi. Tua banga thungena ka ngak laitakin hih la hong kipia hi a, Mr. Sankey in a aw ding hong phuaka, ama siamna hangin hih la in Topa nasepna ah a kimang thei dingin kha hong nei hi ci-in gen hi. Hong Pai Ciangin (When He Cometh), Ring the Bells of Heaven (Nuamna Siklong Tum Un-Xtian La No. 331) te zong ama phuah mah ahi hi. Ira D. Sankey bel father of gospel song (gospel late pa) a kicih zahkhat-in D.L. Moody tawh a kithuahna khempeuh ah hih bang late vive sa-a gospel la tampi phuakin kaikhawma a khenkhiapa ahi hi. Ama kaihkhop labu Sacred Songs and Solos bekbek bang kum 50 sungin bu awn giat val (over eight million copies) kizuakkhia hi. Philip P. Bliss leh George C. Stebbins tawh kopkhawma a khet uh Gospel Hymn Numbers 1-6 te bang bel tuni dongin evangelical palwpite-a kizang mahmah lai late ahi hi. Laisiangtho sunga Late la-a sakna, hymn leh gospel la tuamtuam sakna i cihte 16th century lai-a Protestant Reformation huna kipan bialpiakna khempeuh-a kizang den ahih hangin Ira D. Sankey in lasakzia thak khat hong phuangtawm-a, a awl-mawh lote phawn nading, a lungtang khauhte nipsak nading leh a zong mite Zeisu Khazih kiang a tunpih ding mipi lasakzia khat hong phuangkhia hi. D.L. Moody in lungdamna thu sermon-a a gen zahlian-in Ira D. Sankey in tua lungdamna thu mah la-in gen hi, kici hi. Ira D. Sankey pen August 28, 1840 ni-in America gam Edinburg, Pennsylvania ah suaka, 1856 kumin pianghtak hi. 1857 kumin New Castle, Pennsylvania ah lal uh a, tua lai-ah Methodist Episcopal pawlpi ah lut hi. A sawt lo-in Sunday School superintendent-in kikoih a, choir leader zong sem hi. American Civil War (tual gal) sung, 1860 kumin Union Army ah lut hi. Sergeant za ciang ngah hi. September 9, 1863 ni-in State Senate member John Edwards tanu Fanny V. Edwards tawh kiteng uh a, tapa nih nei uh hi. Gal ven ciangin New Castle ah ciahkik-a a pa nesep Internal Revenue Service ah a pa huh-in om hi. 1867 kumin amau khua a YMCA ah secretary, tua khit teh president cih bangin kitel hi. 1870 kumin Indianapolis khua a YMCA kikhoppi ah taangmi-in kah-a D.L. Moody tawh kimu uh hi. Moody in hun-bit-a Pasian nasem dingin zol hi. 1871 kumin D.L. Moody tawh kithuah dingin Chicago ah kituah a, kum 30 val kithuah uh hi. 1873 pan 1875 sung Great Britain ah lungdamna thu tangko-in pai hi. 1873 kumin Sacred Songs and Solos khenkhia hi. Kikhen kikkik-a, la zong kibehlap toto hi. 1903 kuma a kikhet ciangin la dawng 1,200 pha ta hi. 1874 kumin Philip P. Bliss tawh kopkhawma a khet uh Gospel Hymns Numbers 1-6 khetkhiat kipan uh a, la dawng 739 pha hi. 1881-84 sung British Isles ah lungdamna thu tangko-in zinkik uh hi. 1885 kumin a labute zuakna pana kingah sum lak panin Newcastle, Pennsylvania a YMCA inn lam nading 40,000 piakhia zo hi. 1891-92 sung British Isles ah zinkik uh a 1898 kumin Holy Land ah zin hi. 1899 kumin mangpha khakna in England gam zin leuleu hi. December 22, 1899 ni-in a lawmpa D.L. Moody si a, dah mahmah hi. 1903 kuma kipan a mit in khua mu nawn lo hi. August 13, 1908 ni-in i Topa kiang Van-inn ah ciah ta hi. Hih la banah, Huihpi Nun Cianga Kidalna (A Shelter in the Time of Storm), Jesu Muang In (Trusting Jesus), The Ninety and Nine cih late zong a aw Sankey phuah ahi hi. Lungsim gal dona leh dahna sung panin, Kei sang a sangzaw suangpi ka bel nuam hi, Mawhlua, gimlua zo, Nang aa hong hi ta ning, A kip suangpi aw, Nang mah kong belta hi. Nang kong bel hi. Nang kong bel hi, Nangmah kong bel hi, A kip thupha suangpi. Sun in gam daiah, dah in lungleen lai tak, Ze-etna in a vang tawh hong tuam ciangin, Nuntak huihpi nung, Tuipi ki hual laitak, Thupha suangpi aw, hong liah in bittak in. Gal do lai takin, gal in hong neh ciangin, Tai in kong kozel hi, Ka belh suangpi aw, Tui hual bang ze-et gimna hong tun ciangin, Na sung kong bel hi, Keima kha suangpi aw. Articles Knowledge Pasian Thu I BIAK PASIAN (Matt 6:6-34). Agelh Rev. Dr. J.M. Ngul Khan Pau By: LAIBUSAAL Date: October 19, 2020 I BIAK PASIAN (Matt 6:6-34) Agelh Rev. Dr. J.M. Ngul Khan Pau Yangon panin Kalemyo lam zuanin April 21, 2015 ni-in ka lengto hi. Vanleng sungah Lai Siangtho ka sim, ka lungngaih dide lai-in Topa Pasian in Ama thu zangin hong hopih hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh, Topa aw, na thumaan hi cih ka thei a, ka up loh hangin tangtung veve ding hi. Tua hangin na thu panin nong hilh nopte mu thei dingin ka mit hong honsak in, ka ci hi. Ka simsim ngeina ahih hangin Topa in kei hong tel mahmah ahihna leh hong naih mahmah ahih lam ka muh nadingin Ama thu panin hong hopih hi. Philip Yancey in The Jesus I Never Knew sunga a gelh bangin, Topa pen a thu in kithei a, ahih hangin amah tawh kikholhna taktak i tawm neih manin kha lamah kikeu hi. Topa ahihna bangin theician leng - bang zahtakin nuam ding hiam cih na ngaihsun ngei hiam? Leitung in hong zo khin zo lua ahih manin i lungsimah 'Pasian aw' kiza thei nawn loin, 'leitung aw' bekbek kiza ahih manin tua aw in hong uk hi. Na Khristian nuntakna ki-enpha lecin na lung a kim hiam? Midangte adingin thupha hi dingin Pasian in hong deih lai-in nang nuntakpih thukhun nei loin na om hiam? Tunai in tangval khat in, Pa Pau, ka sepna ah sum leh pai tam mahmah, tua bek lunggulh a kisem hileh lungkim takin sepmai ding hi. Ahi zongin ka nuntakna manpha takin zang nuam ka hih manin leh kum 70 khawng kong ka phak ciangin ka nunlui etkik ni ka neih ciangin kisikna ka neih loh nadingin ka nungta nuam hi, hong ci ngeungau hi. Mihing Pasian tawh kizom dinga hong kibawl ahih manin tua kizopna i neih kei leh hawm kisakna tawh i kidim ding hi. Topa na thei taktak maw? Amah tawh na kihozawh a sawt zo hiam? Tua na nuntakna na ki-et ciangin na lungkimtakpi maw? Topa in Lai Siangtho panin Ama hihna taktak hong muhsak thu nam nga khawng kong gen nuam hi. I Pasian pen a nungta vaihawm leh tuni mahmah a zong hong kem Pasian hi. Tua ahih manin i phawk loh hangin Aman hong kem gige na hi hi. Tua nam gukte in: Pasian in mu hi: Topa Jesu in midangte huhna i piak ciangin mite muh theih dingin hih kei unla, kuama muh loh a na gamtatna uh a mu Pasian in note tungah thaman hong pia ding hi (Aneu 6). Tua mah bangin thungetna i neih ciangin mite muh dingin lampi kiang khawngah ngen loin kuama muh loh a i gamtatna a hong mu Pasian kiangah nget ding na ci hi (Aneu 6). Anntanna i neih ciangin mite muh ding ngaihsun loin kuama theih loh a hong mu Pasian tawh kizopna-a neih ding hi (Aneu 18). I gamtatna khempeuh hong mu Pasian ahih manin nisim i kampau, i gamtat kikep ding leh Topa Pasian in hong mu gige ahih lam phawk kawmin i gamtat ding thupi mahmah hi. Hagar in Ishmael a paai zawh ciangin Sarah bawlsiatna hangin Hagar zong Abraham innsung panin hong taikhia hi. Gamkeu lakah tui nei nawn lo cimawhin a om laitakin Pasian vantungmi in na hopih hi. Abraham inn ah ciahkik dingin sawlna a ngah ciangin, Hagar in Topa Pasian min dingin Beer Lahai Roi Topa pen, a mu thei Pasian na hi hi, ci hi (Pian. 16:13). Hagar mah bangin na dawn ding tuithawl ah bangmah nei nawn loin na om lam zong hong mu Pasian hi. Tu mahmah in na pulak nop loh hangin na cihmawhnate a mu Pasian hi. Nang zong Hagar mah bangin Kei a hong mu Pasian na cithei nuam hiam? Pasian in thei hi: Thungetna i neih ciangin thu-um lote bangin kam nainawng zang loin, thu tampi gen zong kisam lo hi. Ahangin Topa Pasian in na kisap uh na ngetma nangawnun thei khin zo hi (Aneu 8, 32). I kisapna hong mu bek hi loin hong theikhin Pasian i neih manin bangzahin i hampha hiam? I nget ding ei lam panin i mawhpuakna hi a, ama theih loh om lo hi. Pasian in hong thei mahmah ahih lam Late 139 sungah a kicingtakin i mu hi. Kam tawh i gen khiatma in i gen ding thute thei khin hi. Tua bangin hong thei ahih leh bang hangin thunget zong kisam ding hiam na cikha thei ding hi. Na tate adingin na neih leh lam khempeuh na phalsa ahi hi. Ahi zongin hong nget ding uh na lamen hi. Tua bek hi loin, hong ngetna bangin na piak ciangin lungdam hong cih ding uh zong na lamen hi. Pasian in hong thei lua ahih manin ama kiang panin a taikhiat sawm peuhpeuh amau leh amau kigim bawl uh ahi hi. Zi leh tate kiangah panin amau theih loh ding nuntakna zang papi tampi om kha ding hi. Ahi zongin Topa in nang leh nang na kitheih sangin hong theizaw lai hi. Ama kiang panin bukna ding Singlamteh cih loh om lo hi. Singlamteh a beel mite Pasian tawh kikalah patauhna nei nawn lote ahi uh hi. Pasian in za hi: Nungzuiten Topa kiangah nget khat bekbek nei uh a, thungetzia ding hong hilh in na ci uh hi. Bang hangin thungetzia ding na hilh hiam cih leh i Pasian in a za thei Pasian ahi hi (Aneu 9-13). Mi pawlkhatte in hih Topa thungetna, nungzuite zat ding bek in Jesu in a hilh hi, ci uh hi. Ken bel Topa in ken zong ka zat dingin hong piak thungetna hi ci-in ka sang hi. Topa Pasian a bilngawng lo ahih manin i ngetnate na za hi. Bil nei napi-in a za thei lo Pasian hi loin, na kikona aw malngat penpen zong a za, kam tawh na genkhiat loh na lunggulhna nangawn a za Pasian hi. Na ngaihsutna phawkna (conscious mind) leh phawk milmelna (sub-conscious mind) nangawn Aman telkhin hi. Bil bawlpa in khuaza lo ding hiam? Kam leh lei bawlpa in a pusuak thute tel lo ding ahi hiam? A za thei Pasian ahih manin ka nget khempeuh hong dawn pahpah loh hangin hong za cih ka theih lungkimhuai hi. Suang leh sing bia hi leng hong zak ding ki-um ngei lo ding a, ngaih semsem in ka kiko hang zong hong dawng tuam tuanlo ding hi. Topa Pasian in na aw hong za bek hi loin na nget simin a bil hong dawh hi. Tua bang Topa na neih hampha na kisa hiam? Pasian in vak hi: Mihing khempeuh, a zawng a hau in nisim i buaipih mahmah khat pen nek leh tak hi. Topa Pasian in nek leh tak nangawn zong na lunghimawh kei un, bang hang hiam cih leh van a vasate in nisimin ann zong tawm uh a, a bawlpa Pasian in annvak tawntung hi, ci hi (Aneu 25-27). Tua vasate sangin a manphazaw amah lim leh mel sun-a hong bawl mihingte hong kem ding, hon van ding ahihna i mu thei hi. Hong vak ding ahih manin bangmah sem lo ding cihna hi lo hi. Ahi zongin nek leh tak ding i buaipih laitakin hong bawlpa in zong hong pia ding cih hong ciamsa mangngilh lo ding hi hang. Lai Siangtho sungah Topa Pasian in ann a vak mi tampite sung panin Israel minamte kum sawmli tawntung manna tawh na vak hi. Minam khat gilkial in sehnel gam ah annek hun ding kipelh loin a vak Pasian hi. Elijah zong Kerith luigei ah kibu dingin Topa in sawl a, zing leh nitak simin sa minsa va-akten puak hi (1 Kum 17:2-4). Va-ak in amau muk ah sa minsa zing leh nitak in puak ziahziah hi. Amau sa minsa cih thadah a uih nangawn a duh vasate hi. Tua bang vasaten kamsangpa ann puak ahih uh leh nang zong Topa cihna munah om peuh leteh na tasam kei ding hi. Pasian in kem hi: Unok pakte kuama muh loh in amau pona munah na pak zihziah uh hi. Topa in tua pakte kumpi Solomon in a kumpi puan tawh a kizep ciangin tua pak khat nangawn dem zo lo hi na ci hi (Aneu 28-30). Silh leh ten mihingten i lunghimawh ciat uh hi. A zawng a hau in silh ding i lunghimawh ciat uh hi. A hoih silh zo a om bangin puan gina nei zo lo leitungah tam mahmah hi. Topa in hong kempa, hong khualpa ahih lam i phawk ding deih hi. Hong kem leh hong khual hibang Pasian nei ihih manin bangzahin hampha i hi hiam? Upna neu manin amah muang loin i gamtat hangin amah muanhuai loh hun nei ngei lo hi. Pasian in a bawlnate a kepzia i et ciangin lamdang i sa uh hi. Leitung mipilten, "hong piangtawm lel hi uh a, a bawl om lo hi," a cih uh hangin a kibawl nate i et ciangin a bawlpa, a geelpa om hi cih kimu thei hi. Pasian in pia hi: Topa Jesu in, "Pasian gam leh ama dikna zong masa un, tua hileh na kisap uh adang nate zong hong piathuah ding hi, na ci hi (Aneu 31-34). Lunghihmawhna tawh a kidim leitung mite adingin a dam nading thusim hih laiah hong hilh hi. Topa mah nambat khatna in koih photphot leng a dang kisapte hong pia lua mahmah ding hi. Aman hong pia tawntung a, a manpha bel a tapa Jesu Khris hong pia hi. Vantung gam Amah a um mite kiangah hong piakhin zo hi. Jesu sungah kisel khalam hamphatna thuphate zong hong pia hi. A tomin gen ni cileng, Pasian in hong piapa hi tawntung hi. Tuni mahmah in hih thu sim a thei dingin khuamuhna hong pia Amah hipah hi. Na muh theih singkung leh lopa, mual leh guamte ama bawl vive hi a, nang leh kei zat dingin hong pia hi. Tua ahih manin i Pasian in bangzah in hong it, hong khual Pasian ahi hiam? Phat dingin a kilawm tawntung Pasian ahi hi. Thukhupna: Tuzing a ka laibu simna ah, innkuan khat in a pa uh khualzin tung dingin na ngak uh a, ahi zongin tung zo lo ahih manin a zi leh tate dah mai tawh lum uh hi. A zing ciang Zingsang Kiallap a nek laitakun a pa uh inndei tungnung panin hong kumsuk a, lamdang sa uh hi. Dahna mai khempeuh nuihna leh kipahna in dim hi. A pa uh zankim zawh ciangin na tung a, amau kuamah in a phawk loh dingun inndei tungnungah na giak hi. Tung khin napin amau a theih loh manun zingsang kiallap dong dahna tawh na kidim uh hi. Tua mah bangin Topa Pasian tel semsem leng, i dahna leh lungdam lohnate hong bei ding hi. Amah na muh loh hangin aman nang hong mu a, nang kiangah a om gige na hizaw hi. Ama aw na zak loh hangin nang aw za zo hi. Na deihte hi loin na kisapte aman hong pia dingin hong ciam zo hi. Hih bang Pasian ka neih hampha kisa ing. Nang bang om lo hi Nang bangin ka lungsim sukha om kei A tawntung tawntung in ka zonzon hang mu keng Nang bang om lo hi. Laibu Saal Zomi eLibrary Tags Rev. Dr. J.M. Zogam Aksi 3 te Pu Gin Pian Khup ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zogam Aksi 3 te Pu Gin Pian Khup posted on 1 November 2020 at 11:09 pm Lomkholna: News , Politics , Zomi Zogam Aksi 3 te Pu Gin Pian Khup Zomi le Zogam tangthu ah thupi deuh Zogam Aksi ci-in min kipiathei ciat hi. Tua bangin i piakte sungah nasepna le panmun tawh kizui in ii piak hikha ding ahih manin, kuamah kimawhsak theih omlo hi. Ahi zongin Minam le gamvai ah Zomite ading madawk bek tham loin abeisa le tuni dong i et kikkik ciangin, 1900 khit ciapteh thamcing mi 3 om hi. Tuate in; Pu Hau Za Lian (Sukte Independence Army-SIA) Pu Mang Tung Nung (Chin National Organisation-CNO) Pu Chin Sian Thang (HCSU, ZNCZCD ) 1. Pu Hau Za Lian pen Sukte Independence Army i a mangpi Commander-in-Chief hi a, Kawl ten Japan te a do ma Zomi te makaih a Japan do ahihi. Anti Japanese movement ah leitung theih a ciampteh thamcing khat ahihi. Tua banah Pu Kamhau leh Ukpi hun a Zogam galkapte British te i lelh nunga, Zomi tawh kisai galkap phutkik masa pen ahihi. Japan lah do, British lah langpang ci in galpi nihna zawh ciangin British te nangawnin matsawm liang ahihi. 2. Pu Mang Tung Nung pen Panglong tungtangah Federal Union deih ung ci a, mumal tak a dawng thei om sunsun ChinZomi mipilam palai khat ahihi. Tuabanah 1947 constitution pen Federal Constitution tawh laih ding a, Taunggyi mualmi leh mualgam khawmpi ah Zomi palai teng makai ahihi. Ni masa ni bekin thugen a, a kik ciangin Zomi lak a Law sin masa pen leh Hill Chin Student Union Chairman Tg. Chin Sian Thang tonpih in ama tangin thugen in pantah a, tuni dong Pu Chin Sian Thang Federal Politics ah makai suak ahihi. Zomi lak ah King Commission kici mangkang galkap bawk 3 za taktak angah masa pen ahihmanin, Captain Mang Tung Nung ci in thanga Captain pa zong kici hi. A za taawpna taktak pen MajorBohmu ahihi. Nasep teng akhawl ciangin makai leh ulian dangte bangin Kawlgam ah a sih dong vaithamloin, apiangna khua Muizawl khua, Zogam ah ciahkik ngiat in tengkik hi. A sanggampa tate 2 Zomi milian leh makai sem ngei Pu Khen Za Mung leh adangdangte nangawn tuni dong Zogam ah tengkik tamlo hi. 3. Pu Chin Sian Thang pen Sitnipa kici a Zomi lak ah LL.B zo masa pen ahih banah a degree lakna pen Amerian Constitution ahihi. Zomi milui lak ah constitutional law thei omlo kikeuh a, khangthak ah zong tuni dong mah khutme kuaih theih lai phial ding ahihi. Taunggyi Conference ah Pu Mang Tung Nung tawh a kithuah khit uh ciangin, 1974 Constitution vai ah zong Federal Constitution Zomi ten ka deih uh hi ci in Myanmar Army chief Ne Win kiangah Pu Lian Uk ( Haka) te tawh makaih in lai pia uh ahihmanin mat leh thuak lawh hi. 1988 zawh ZNC ah president dinmuun la in Federal Cause mah dingpih suak ahihi. Gamsung gampua te deih Panglong Conference samkik ding tawh kisai Kalay Declaration makai in tangko ahihmanin gambup cihmawh laitak tawh kituakin, Aung San Suu Kyi in zong thukimin amah ki-ap suak hi. 2016 kum ciangin kilemna khawmpi kibawl ding pen in min 3 aneih lak ah 2 ahi 2nd Panglong leh 21st Century Panglong pen Kalay Declaration huzap tawh kiloto suak ahihi. Pu Hau Za Lian leh Pu Mang Tung Nung pen aKawl aZo cih omlo, leitungbup theih hita a, tangthu nei Zomi aksipi 2 hita in, Pu Chin Sian Thang bel bangmah theilo hai ciakciak teng,hong ki nung-leh -kaih saklo a, tutung Panglong ah mualmi mualgamte lunggulh tawn tung ahi Federal Constitution mah hong dingpih suak a leh Aksipi 3na in kiciamteh suak ding ahihi. Note: Pu Hau Za Lian lim mupaklo ka hihmanin Pu Mang Tung leh Pu Chin Sian Thang lim 2 tawh hong suakkhawm sak ing. Thuzep: CNF lamte zong nidanga Tedimlam ten tangthu ah bangmah semlo cihdaan a haipau nawnaw den uh hi. 2000 kum kiimpawl ciangin, Shan ten Taunggyi Conference thu laibu limtak hong suaksak uh leh tua pan dai uh hi. CNF mi phamawh mahmah khat in Pu Mang Tung Nung bel zahtak ung ci in kei kiangah hong gen liang hi. Tualo mi minthang dang nengnengte bel Minam khat maban tawh kisai a Aksipi a ciapteh tham cing omlua nai lianglo hi. Zomi leh Khuado Part 1 Japan kumpi te ZDF te laikhak ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zomi leh Khuado Part 1 Japan kumpi te ZDF te laikhak posted on 20 October 2014 at 10:08 pm Lomkholna: Khuado , News , Video , Zomi Zomi leh Khuado Part 1 Japan kumpi te ZDF te laikhak Zominam te Khang zui in kumciin khuado ni bul phut in ZDF ki pawl na pan Japan kumpi te tung lai khak. An expression of the bereavement along with Japan government, Japanese and Zomi people. Sno ZDF27 2014 Date 10-10-2014 An expression of bereavement and gratitude on the day of KHUADO Festival During the Second World War from 1943 to 1945, we the Zomi people living in Zomi areas (boarder between India and Myanmar) northern part of Chin State, Myanmar. Namely: Tedim, Tozang, and Cikha districts Zomi areas. We shared the effects of the Second World War with the Japan soldiers. We felt starvation together; we felt the warm and cold together with Japan soldiers. We, Zomi people and Japanese shared the same feelings. Not only that, some of our fathers served as levies to the Japan government and they fought together. As a result, many of our fathers died during the war along with Japan soldiers. Thus, we, on behalf of all the Zomi people and the bereaved Japanese, Zomi Development Foundation (ZDF) would like to express the sad feeling of the bereavement. On the other hand, after seventy (70) long years in Zomi areas: Tedim, Tonzang, and Cikha districts, we, the Zomi Development Foundation (ZDF) and Japan government working together on the project of researching the Japan soldiers camps, armys clinic, remains, and the arms of Japan army in Zomi areas for seven (7) months from April -2014 to October- 2014. We are grateful to say that the successful completion of searching the Japan soldiers remains and have found many of them. Central Executive ZDF (1) Moreover, we are so grateful to work together with Japan government on the other side of war after seventy (70) long years. We envisage the future development in every aspect of our lives for working together with the Japan government. As we have had brotherly and sisterly love and shared the same feelings of the outcome of the Second World War. Therefore, it is an expression of our gratitude and warm welcome, on behalf of all the Zomi people, Zomi Development Foundation (ZDF) expresses our heartfelt thanks to all the allotted persons and those who are willing to engage for the betterment and development of our Zomi areas. We express our heartfelt attitude on the day of, one of the most important festival of Zomi people KHUADOPAWI khuado festival. We are looking forward to the Japan government and Zomi Development Foundation (ZDF) to work together cooperatively for the development of Zomi people in Zomi areas. 3- Objectives: The friendliness and togetherness spirit be endless between Zomi people and Japan government. The healthy and heartily relationship between Zomi people and Japan government becomes more mature in the days to come. To be protest the barriers and hindrance between the smooth relationship between Zomi people and Japan government. Friday10102014 Zomi Development Foundation (ZDF) Central Executive Office (B59) lawibual, Tedim Town Chin State, Myanmar. Articles English Version Ngeina Tuamtuamte Zomi Traditional Festivals And Sacrifices: An Analytical Study By Dr. H. Thangtungnung By: LAIBUSAAL Date: July 25, 2019 Abstract Bangtung Kithoih Introduction Haitungmut Kithoihna Zomi traditional festivals Sumtawng Kithoihna Khobawl Khawdou Tualsuang-at Conclusion Abstract The Zomis are a group of tribes who were historically referred to as Kukis or Chins. They belong to the Tibeto-Burman group of Mongoloid race and occupy the trans-border region of India and Myanmar. They mainly settle in Manipur, Mizoram, Assam, Nagaland and Chin State of Myanmar. The major tribes of the Zomis are Tedim, Paite, Zou, Simte, Vaiphei, etc. The Zomi forefathers are rich in traditions and culture relating to festivals, dances and rituals apart from customary practices. Since their conversion into Christianity, they gradually abandoned most of their ritual sacrifices and festivals. They eventually lost many of their dance forms. Their festivals, rituals and dances were in one way connected to one another as they were usually performed together. Today, they still maintain some of their festivals and dances, which conveyed their old belief and agricultural activities. Though we are unable to focus on the dances here, we examine some interesting festivals and rituals, which were relevant in the past Zomi society. It is an attempt to study the Zomi traditional values, some of which are still current in these days. Introduction The Zomis were traditionally rich in rituals and festivals. These rituals and festivals were of great significances in the Zomi pre-Christian society as they indicated their belief and social practices. Both of them were interlinked to each other as festivals were usually celebrated with some kinds of rituals. In the past, different types of festivals were celebrated according to the cyclic nature of their jhum cultivation. They reflected their economic activities as well as the social and religious lives. They also conveyed deep meanings to their day-to-day affairs. The different types of Zomi traditional festivals are examined below: 2.Zomi traditional festivals 2 . 1 Khobawl: It was celebrated in March or April every year. It was a New Year festival for the Zomi forefathers to begin their jhum cultivation. On this occasion, they performed sacrifices as a means to propitiate the spirits which they believed to cause harm or shower blessings. Fig 1: Zomi farmer Khobawl festival was also known as Tapphou. It was usually known as Sialsawm Pawi in the Chin Hills and Chapchar Kut in the Mizo Hills . It was celebrated after clearing the jhum field, the arduous task of jhum operation. It was celebrated for a day, but could last for three days. Boys and girls put on their festive dresses and the whole village prepared a common feast in its celebration. As the festival was mainly observed as a joyous moment, it usually began with singing and dancing. Both boys and girls would sit in rows facing one another to play a game of merry-making like putting hard boiled eggs into each others mouth and then sipping a traditional rice beer called Zupi (Neihsial1993:195) . A big feast was organized to celebrate the new season. The main objective of this festival was to cleanse the village from evil spirits, diseases and acute poverty ( Ibid. 197). On the eve of the festival, the village runner called Tangkou would ask the strangers to leave the village. Here, strangers meant the evil spirits who were supposed to dwell within the village premises. On the following evening, the village priest would sacrifice an animal, either a he-goat or a dog at the entrance of the village. The flesh of the sacrificial animal would be served to some village dignitaries like members of the village council while the skull of the sacrificial animal was hanged at the village gate. In this sense, it was more a solemn ritual than a celebration. 2.2 Tualsuang-at: It was a festival in which the blood of sacrificial animals like goat or dog was splashed at the doorposts and in the courtyard of a house. This festival used to be observed for seven days during which Zubel (beer vase) and fermented drinks were detached from the house.1 The village priest offered a sacrifice to propitiate the spirits at the water spring of the village. 2 It was similar to the Jewishs Feast of Unleavened Bread found in the Bible. Fig 2: Beer vase 2.3 Bangtung Kithoih: It was a festival of the first fruits.3 The other name of this festival was Pawl Kut. During the festival, children put on their best dresses and ornaments and each household participated in a common feast (Shakespear Reprint 2008: 87). To feast to his or her hearts content was what everyone desired and Zu would be served in abundance. It was celebrated with much singing and dancing. It was one of the greatest Zomi festivals celebrated during JuneJuly. 2.4 Haitungmut Kithoihna: It was an occasion in which various musical instruments were played for amusement. Some of the instruments played during this festival were Phit, Tamngai, Guate, Taal and Semgua . The village Siampu used to blow trumpet to commemorate the festival. 2.5 Sumtawng Kithoihna: Another name of this festival was Mim Kut. It was celebrated during the month of August or September. It was observed with fasting till sunset. 4 Traditionally celebrated only for a day, every male member in a family offered sacrifices to the spirits on this day. But after the day was over, the villagers heavily feasted with the involvement of Zupi. This festival was more a ritual than a joyous occasion. There was a myth on the origin of this festival. Once, there was a man named Sawngkhar whose wife was Chawngvung. She was severely ill and died very soon. Her spirit went to Misikhua , the abode of the dead. Her husband missed her so dearly that he could never comfort himself and so, he died. He met his wife at the Misikhua but saw her very thin and restless. After enquiring the reason, she told him that she was continuously starving for want of food and requested him to go home and bring some vegetables from their field. Sawngkhar instantly came alive again and went straight to their field as his wife had asked him. On reaching the field, he found the vegetables growing lively and abundantly. He wept profusely as he cut them, for he recollected the times he had spent with his beloved wife. He carried home whatever he gathered to put in a bawmpi (big basket). He then returned back to Misikhua. After this, his wife became as fat and pretty as before and even healthier than she had ever been (Niehsial, op. cit. : 195-96). They then lived together in the Misikhua happily. Since then, people started to celebrate Mim festival with a ritual sacrifice. They offered Mim cake made of maize or millets to appease the spirit of a person who had died within their family . There was another version how this ritual festival began. It started as a ritual firstly by the legendary orphan brothers, Thanghou and Liandou who led a pitiable life. Many times, they were starved and led a life of acute poverty. One day, the spirit of their deceased grandmother appeared to them at their verandah. She blessed them and told them to offer daily rituals at their verandah. Since then, Sumtawng sacrifice began as ancestor worship. Sumtawng means mortar and Kithoihna means sacrifice and it literally means mortar sacrifice as the two brothers used to offer their sacrifices at the place where a mortar was kept within the verandah (Kamkhawtuan 2010: 17). In the later period, it came to be celebrated in the form of a festival, known as Mim Kut . Mim means millet and kut means festival. As the orphan brothers were provided millets daily by their deceased grandmother, it came to be known as millet festival. The Zomis offered this kind of ritual until they were converted into Christianity. Due to its animistic origin, the people themselves had discarded it. 2.6 Khawdou: It was the greatest festival of the Zomis. It was usually celebrated within SeptemberOctober after the harvest normally lasting for eight days. They fixed branches of palm and bough of thick trees at the entrance and fences of their houses.5 They feasted lavishly with much cheering and delight. Thus it was a joyous occasion to celebrate the completion of their jhum labour. During Khawdou, no stranger was permitted to enter or leave the village as ritual rites were performed under the village priest, called Siampu (Bertram Tuck 2008: 199) . In matters related to such a sacrifice, a Siampi 6assisted the Siampu in the rites and the entire village plunged into taboo (Shaw Reprint 1997: 76-77). The term Khawdou is composed of two words, khua, and dou. Khua could denote various literary inferences like khawhun or weather, khauzing or evil spirit and khua or village. Similarly, dou might mean both entertaining a guest or fighting the enemies.7 But the combination of the two words literally means to ward off against the evil spirits or demons. khawdou could also mean to dine together with the spirits of ones dear ones who had passed away. Moreover, it was a complete rest from one years labour soon after the harvest was over. The origin of Khawdou festival is not certainly known except that it had been celebrated from times immemorial. There is a myth as to how Khawdou came to be celebrated. Once, the daughter of a certain chief got seriously ill. As spirits were believed to cause such illness, the chief sacrificed various animals like pig, hen, dog and goat to propitiate the spirits so that his daughter might recover. Nevertheless, his daughter died. The chief got so infuriated with this that he vowed to fight against the spirits. He consulted a sorcerer who suggested him that spirits had no specific dwelling place and they roamed about from one place to another. They were afraid of broad daylight and used to hide themselves from the sight of human being. They dwelled in thick jungles, dark woods, junk and stinking places around a human settlement. They normally roamed out late at night when human ceased their activities. Therefore, instead of fighting against them, we should hound them away with flames and cleanse their abodes. Accordingly, the chief began his campaign. His villagers were asked to burn meilah (fire flames) and to take up arms. They formed a group to yell , Dawi hang, kau hang, uisanpa, duhgawlpa, voknou dawng kaipa, aknou dawng kaipa, na zun na ek namsia, na khua na tui ah pai in, (You bloody spirit, greedy fool, who took away pigs and chicken, you are a disgusting lot, go back to your land) while they dangled their fire flames. Then, the chief would shout, He is running, he is running, in which the rest enquired, In which direction? and so, everyone would emulate to pursue. After pursuing till Khomual (outskirt of the village), they all shouted in one accord, Taimang ta ei (they has vanished) and left their meilah burning there, in the hope that the spirits would dare not return back. After they arrived back to the village, they hung a burning meilah on a high pole to frighten away the spirits. When it was all over, they feasted with Zupi for days to commemorate the triumph . The first day was celebrated as a joyous event. The village youths went out for hunting expedition on the second day (Dev and Lahiri 1983: 95). The remaining days were also spent in eating and drinking with merriment. This feast came to be known as Khawdou Pawi. One Khawdou song consistently sang at this occasion was: (a) Dou na lingling, dou na lingling e, Gual in kumkhua dou na lingling e; (b) Gual in kumkhua douna lingling e, Dou han ah naubang ka kap hi e; (c) Naubang ka kap khaubang va chiah ta,ng e, Khua leh chiautui taang na silsial e. 8 The above lines were composed by legendary Thanghou while moaning deeply for his deceased brother, Liandou during a Khawdou festival. There is another account on the origin of Khawdou festival. Once, a Siampi (clan priest) had a strange dream about a spirit. The spirit who appeared in his dream asked him, Worship me and I will give you whatever you require, to which the Siampi replied, If I have to worship you, what should I call you? The spirit told him that he should be called Khozing, and must be worshipped in flesh and blood. There after, the Siampi arranged a feast after every harvest and worshipped the spirit ( Khozing) with rice beer, meat and animals blood. But, he neither became prosperous nor better off in doing this. At last, he performed humans blood sacrifices. As his fortune still remained the same, he completely abandoned this ritual and subsequently enticed his villagers to fight against the spirits. This event came to be known as Khawdou. Since then, Khawdou was observed as an occasion to ward off evil spirits to clean the village, water springs and other surroundings (Stevenson Reprint 1986: 160). The third day of Khawdou was a day for Khuai-aihni (bee-luring day). On this day, the village youths went to the jungle for collecting honey. When they returned back home, they were greeted with zupi by their female counter parts. As it was the belief that the future could be predicted with a bee, they danced around the bees to perform a sort of rituals. After it was over, the bees were released unharmed. There were some reasons in doing this practice. In olden days, a dead body was kept unburied for days or months. When the dead body became so stinking, bees prevented the flies and moats to harm the dead body. Therefore, there was a notion that a person who participated in a khuai-aih in his lifetime would have the advantage of his body being prevented from flies after his death. When bees were caught for this purpose, only a few selected ones were taken. The rest of them were smoldered and the hive was broken. If the young bees were seen lively, it was presumed to indicate that the coming year would be a good year for the villagers, but if it was otherwise, illness or ill luck can befall them. Similarly, if the larvae were fat, then in the ensuing year, there could be rich harvest, but if there were dead larvae, then equal number of the villagers might expire in the coming year. And if there was no larva at all, it would be taken that the village would be deserted for another village (Kamkhawtuan op. cit .: 125). As such, there was a song (meant for the bees) Nang in kumkhua na thei a, kong dong hi (I will ask you as you know about the next season). The Zomis have many khuai-aih la or bee songs, which they used to sing during Khawdou like: (a) Ka lounawl a Khuai aw e, Simngal hen, Zo ngalhen, nang in kumkhua na thei a, kong dong e, (a) Nang in kumkhua na thei a, kong dong e. Ningzu a ken dong, aisa a ken dong. In olden days, when one heard such a song sung, heshe would certainly know that the bee catchers had arrived back home and then, heshe would rush out to greet them. A crowd would gather to dance to the following tunes: (a) Mual ka bawl mual ka bawl e, Laamtual diing mual ka bawl e, (b) Laamtual zil in za hen aw, Luai naubang kivei leng e. (a) I level the ground I level the ground, I level the ground for dancing podium, (b) Let the ground be large and spacious, So that I will dance like a child. (a) Chiah ning ka chih ka omna Om ning ka chih ka chiahna, (b) Chiah taleng bang a sam diam, Inn ah ka ngaih om hi e. (a) If I said I will go, I remained staying, If I said I will stay I moved going, (b) What will be needing if I go, My beloved is there at home. Another Khuai dance song goes like this: Ngaltun e ngalthen e khuai aw, Ka loupam a khuai aw e, sim ngalthen e, Nang in kumkhua na thei a, kong dong e; Sanpi sanou na huai leh na kik aw, Mim leh sawmtang na huai leh hong pai aw khuai aw e. Its free rendering is: Oh Ngaltun! Oh Ngalthen, Oh you bee! The bee near my jhum land, Oh Southern Ngalthen! You know about seasons and I consulted you; Be back if you lure Sanpi Sannou, Come to us if you lure Mim and Sawmtang . After celebrating Khawdou for seven days, the eighth day was celebrated with great exhilaration. At the end of the day, the crowd cheered in a chorus, Lililili, hahahaha. In this way, the grand Khawdou festival came to a close after eight days of hectic celebration. The month when Khawdou was celebrated is known as Khawdou Kha. In Myanmar, it is celebrated for three days as a national holiday, officially so recognized by the government (Neihsial op. cit. : 196). Its equivalent one is Chavang Kut in Manipur; Manipur Government declares 1st November as a State holiday on this occasion every year. In Mizoram, it is celebrated as Pawl kut. Conclusion The Zomis celebrated various types of festivals. Some of them were observed in the form of ritual and sacrifices. They played a significant role in the Zomi society, as they were normally associated with economic and religious activities, social lives and agricultural season. These festivals and rituals revealed the Zomis view on diseases, life and death. While some festivals were meant for joyous celebrations, the others were related to ritual events that resulted from the belief in the existence of supernatural spirits. These practices or celebrations gradually ceased due to the mass conversion of the tribes into Christianity in the twentieth century. Festivals like Khodou or Chavang Kut is still celebrated as a post-harvest festival in a modified and modern form. Chapchar Kut is also revived in Mizoram but without any originality. It, therefore, emerges as a challenge as to how to preserve and sustain the tribal traditional values. gelh Dr au Za Cin Suante By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 18, 2023 ZOMI PIANNA, KIPATNA LEH HUNLUI, NGEINA, BIAKNA, LAISIMNA MAILAM (CREATION, ORIGIN, HISTORY, CULTURE, RELIGION, EDUCATION ROAD AHEAD) gelh Dr au Za Cin Thupatna: Zomi, Pasian in minam khat dinga a tuamkhenna Sengam pan tuni ciang ah kum tulthum pha ta hi (1027BC 2006AD) engam pan Kabaw zanggam ah kikhinsuk in kum zagiat val teeng uh a ua pan mualtung khua Khampat ah kum zanga val tengin Mawngpi suan uh a, Cimnuai ah kum sawmnga, Geeltui ah kum za, tua pan Tedim sat in, Kam Hau ukpi sep laitakin mikangte Zogam hong tung, hong sim uh hi aipian Pau Cin Hau in maangmu in Zomite lai neih masakna pen hi a, Biakna thak neihna, Lai sim kipatna ahih laitak in Christian missionary masa pen Rev rthur E arson thu nupa Zogam hong tunga, tua ni-a kipan Zomite leitung hong kilamdang in Zomi thak hong pianga Zomite mit hong keuh hi untakna thak neiin, ngaihsutna thak tawh leitung tuancil dingin kalsuan kipan hi OMI PIANNA (ZOMI CREATION) 1. 1 omi pianna thu: A kipat cilin Pasian in vantung leh leitung a piangsak hi (Piancilna 1:1) i, Kha, Aksi, Tuipi, Ganhing, Lopa, Huih, adang na khempeuh a bawl khit ciangin a uk, kem a khoi dingin Amah lim leh meel sun in mihing bawl a, tua ah Zomite kipatna pianna thu ahi hi asian in, Eima lim, eimah hong sunin mihing bawl ni uipi ngasate tung, huihlak vasate tung, ganhingte tung, leh leitunga a bokvakte khempeuh tungah ukna neisak ni, a ci hi mah in mihing piangsak a, pasal leh numei a piangsak hi asian in amaute thupha pia a, amaute tungah, Ci pha-in tampi pha un la, leitung dimin zo un uipi ngasate tung, leitungah a gamtang, a nungtate khempeuh tungah ukna nei ta un, a ci hi asian in, En un, leitung maitang khempeuhah a om, tang a piangsak kungnote khempeuh leh a gah sungah tang a om singkung khempeuh note tungah kong pia khinta hi uate an-in na nei ding uh hi, a ci hi ua mah bangin a piang pah hi asian in a bawlsate khempeuh en a, hoih sa mahmah hi (Piancilna 1:1 - 31) i masa pen Adam pen Zomite pa hi a, a zi Evi pen Zomite nu hi hang tampi hong pai zawh ciangin Adam leh Evi suan pan tuni a Zomi pen hong ka khia a, a sanggam dangte mah bangin Zomi in zong ngeina leh biakna nei in, inkuan khat, minam khat a hihna kilahna dingin ngeina kician khat nei hi ua pen Adam suan leitung mi khempeuh neih a hi hi awlkhat in Zomi cih pen mualtungmi cihna hi ci uh a, ahi zongin Zomite bek mualtung ah teeng hi lo hi ua manin Zomi cih pen mualtungmi cihna hilo a, Zhou ukpipa suante ihih mana Zomi ihi zaw hi. a). Ei teng khawlkhawm, a tuam omlo, vannuai ci peuh Khul a piang, laigui kizomte hi ngeingei hang e b). Laigui kizomte hi ngei ngei a, tunsung khat pan piang hi ngeingei, piang hi ngeingei e Zogam zaina (Zogam Zogam pen sim leh mal teha a dung lam pen Equator mal lamah latitude 21. 56 degree leh 24. 30 degree kikala om hi a, tai (mile) 250 khawnga sau-in kituat hi ak leh khang a vai pen longitude 92. 16 degree leh 94. 20 degree kikal hi-in, tai (mile) 220 khawnga zai-in kituat hi ogam sing leh sa (Zogam flora and fauna): Zogam khua hun pen hoih mahmah ahih manin singkung lopa leh nuntaakna a nei ganhing nam tuamtuam tawh kidim hi ogam ah taaksing, ngeisok kung leh gua tuamtuam tam mahmah hi ua lo Dol, Hiang, Tei, Mawng, Vau leh Vong singkungte zong pha mahmah hi aak nam tuamtuam - Ngeisok, Palpi, Heisa, Zozam, Tumtai, Phuitong, Lingpaak tuamtuamte a hunhunin paakin Zogam etlawmsak mahmah hi ahang tuamtuam, Vom, Gamsial, Ngal, Sazuk leh Zawng nam tuamtuamte teenna gam hi a, vasa nam tuamtuam - Vaphual, Tawlawk, Mu, Gamak, Vagik, Va-ak, Vaki, Simbu, Baibek, Pengpelepte tam mahmahna ahi hi ih bangin Pasian in Zogamah Zomite nuntaak nadinga kisap teng a kicingin koih ahih manin Zo minamte pen minam hampha mahmah ahi hi ua ahih manin hih gam pen itna leh zahtaakna tawh a kep ding Zo minamte mawhpuakna ahi hi I OMI KIPATNA LEH HUNLUI (ZOMI ORIGIN AND HISTORY) 2. 1 omi kipat khiatna: Adam pan khang tampi a phak zawhciangin Sengam ah Zomi ukpi Ji Fa, "Zhou Wu Wang" (Zomite Ukpipa Wu a cihna, Wang Ukpipa, Kumpi, King cihna hi) in vaihawm hi hou inkuan ukpi sepsung (Zhou Dynasty) kum zagiat a hi hi (1027 221BC) ih inkuan pan Zomi a piang hi. Zomi na hih uh leh Zhou suan na hi ding uh hi. Zhou Ming (Chinese) cih ciangin Zhou mite cihna hi (ming mi) ciin Dr ommy Tsai Po-Yu, National Taiwan University, Taipei in hong hilh hi hou Ming cih pen lai ineih ciangin Zomi ciin ki at ziau hi ding hi. 2. 2 en gam om lai thu: BC 1757 pawl in Xia ukpipa in mipite itna leh hehpihna tawh uk lo in, gitloh na leh ki phatsak natawh uk a hih manin Shang Dynasty uk na hongpiang hi. "Shang" ukpipa in khuakim ah hausa upa koih lo ahih manin, Zomite in ol takin a ukna BC 1027 in sutkhia hi C 1046 -1043 hun tak ciangin Zomi ukpipa Ji Fa in a uk ciangin khuakim ah hausa upa koihkim a hih manin kuamah in ukpi zaa sutzo pak lo hi omite uksung in khangto mahmah uh a, ki-ukzia zum nasepzia, khat leh khat kizahtakzia, lo khoh singpuak na leh sumbawl paiibawlnate ah khangto mahmah uh hi ih hun pen Sengam khantoh mahmah hun hi ente miciim Con Fu Cius in siangthona, huahna, dikna leh pilna, khat leh khat kithupi simna, nupa ki kal, lawm leh gual kikal, ulian uneu kikal ah kizahtakzia, inkuansung ki zahtakzia, inkuansung nuntakzia, beh leh phung kiit zia dingte, kimakaihna, innluahna, sahawmziate kician takin hilh hi ua a hilhziate Zomite in i ngeina (Zomi culture or tradition) i cihcihte ahi hi. "Zhou Wu Wang" hong khanga kipan in kipum khatna hong khanga a mah pen VANTUNG TAPA (Son of Heaven) kici liang hi antung pan hong kumsuk kumpipa hi dingin ummawh uh hi un hong paito zel in Ji Fa inkuan sungah vaihawm ding khang kisam a, Ping Wang ukpipa (BC 770 720) hun panin Zomi vaihawmna pen a minbek hita a, Ji Fa inkuan zahtakna omnawnlo in, vaihawm upate in kumpi bangin vaihawmgawp uh ahih manin BC 221 ciangin Hui Wang khut panin Qin Shi Huang in Zomi vaihawmna suhsak hi. 2. 3 en gam pan Chindwin luidung ah: Tuabanga Zomite ukpi sepna a kisuhsak ciangin ukpi thakte in Great Wall lam ding hong kipan a, mihing nasem dingin zang uh hi ih nasep gimhuai leh ukpi hihna a khahsuah uh nuamsa loin Sengam nusia in leitaw lam zuan in suahtakna dingin na paikhia uh hi C 4 hun ciangin Szechwan kim ah tengin Pagyi khua sat uh a, AD 6 ciangin Chindwin luidung ah tengin Dahpa leh Penglamte hunlai AD 108 kiimin Pugam leh Pupa khua na sat uh hi D 600 ciangin Ji Fa suan sungpan Thet mite Zomi suak hi. 2. 4 hindwin pan tuni ciang: AD 800 hun in Khampat khua satin hun sawtpi teeng uh hi hampat khua pen zang leh kham kipehna, kham kipatna ahih manin Khampat a kici hi ualtunggam genna 'Kham' cih kammal pen Zomite bekin nei hi D 1300 in Ciimnuai satto in, 1350 ciangin Zomi nungak melhoih Leng Tong Hoih pen Ava mangpi zi in na om hi. 1450 AD in Thang Ho, Lian Do, Galngam, Hangsai, Cing Khup, Ngam Bawmte Ciimnuai leh Geeltui ah teeng uh hi (Ciimnuai a sa kibak Geeltui ah kithuk ciin upate in kammal na nei uh hi) abaw luidung pan kham kahtoh, Khampat, Cimnuai leh Geeltui hun pan Tedim khuasat (1570), Kam Hau hong khan (1840), mikangte hong pai (1886), Pasian thu hong tun (1899), lai ineih (1900) tan zong eimau beh hausa, khuasat leh ukpite makai-in kizangin ki-uk ciat a, Zomi Nam Ni (February 20, 1948) ciangin tua ki-ukna bei in Zomite a suakta minam ihi ta hi abaw Valley pan a paitoh na vuah Tuingou leh Thangmualte kantan to in Ciimnuai ah khul a tuak uh hi ua lai pan suakta taktak kisakna neita uh ahih manin amau leh amau ukpi ding kisehtawm in khul a piang na kici uh hi. 2. 5 am tuamtuam tawh ten khawmna: Ciimnuai pen Phaileng leh Saizang kikal Tedim pan taisawm a gamla ah om hi ua laiah Zomi nam tuamtuam na tengkhawm uh a, mihing hong tam ciangin Sengam pan a hihngei uh loneihna zong hong hamsa ahih manin amautenna mun leh gam ciat ah ki-ukna tuam neihin, a bawngbawng in hong kikhen uh hi uate tuni a - sihzang, galte, gangte, paite, simte, thadou, vaiphei, zoute, lusei, khelma, baite, rangkhols, langrong, aimual, anal, chiru, lamkang, kolken, kom, chote, hmar, tedim, sailo, ngawn minamte ahi hi. 2. 6 omi kumpi in ciamteh: Zomi lak pan laipil masa, Mandalay University, Burma ah Lecturer a sem ngei, Rev au Go in Zopi (highland) ah i teen manin Zomi a kici hilo in, i pianna pi leh pute Zo ahih manin amau min kepna in Zomi aki ci ihi hi opi sung I tenma, luipi dung zangsungah I tenlaiin zong Zomi ikici zo hi ciin na ciamteh hi u Thawng Khaw Hau Zo Khang Simna Laibu leh Captain K hup Za Thang Zo Suan Khang Simna Laibu (Genealogy of the Zo Race of Burma) laibu sungah Zomite kipatna pen Zo hi ciin kiciamteh a; Dr um Kho Hau A Profile of Burma Frontier Man laibu leh Dr um Son Zo History in zong Zomite kipatna Zo hi ciin na ciamteh uh hi ev owards, Secretary, American Baptist Missionary Society in 1953 kum in Zomi Baptist Convention na patpih a, 1953 in Zomi Theological College na phuan hi. 1988 ciangin Burma kumpi in Zomi ciin hong ciamteh a, Zomi National Congress zong pawlpi min khat in sang hi. 2. 7 eitung civilization in hong pha: Zomiten tanglaiin lai kinei a, savun tunga kigelh ahih manin Savun Lai, Tualsuak Lai kici hi (AD 1400) osuante lakah Zomi bekin Lai cih kammal kinei hi ua ahih manin Zomite in tanglaiin lai nei ngei takpi i hihna leh Savun lai pen Zomite aa ngiat a hihna kilang hi ua savun lai pen ui in tuah mang ahih manin lai kinei nawnlo hi ai neilo theilo uh ahih manin thu pen lungsim leh la tawh na ciamteh uh hi gal mat sa mat zah uh singkhuam pang liamin ahi zongin, singkhuam dawnah sa lu gal lu suangin khau khihbawkin ahi zongin na ciamteh uh hi ing hiam suang hiam suiin a sa mat a gal mat uh lim bawlin zong khawmualah na phut uh hi au Cin Hau lai leh Mangtual lai i neih zawh panin a lim bek hi nawn loin a thu (laimal) tawh kihelkhawm to hi omite in lai i theih cil pen Kawllai hi ding a, Zomite leh British galkapte kidona ah Mang Pum (Khuasak) kimanin Yangon thongah 1894 pan kum li a kiat sungin Mang Pum in Kawllai siam man a, Zomi sung pan lai thei masapen hi dingin kituat hi ua ma-in Khuasak khua mah Hang Kip in zong Kawllai siam zo a ci zong om hi ang Pum in 1898 kumin Khuasak khuaah Kawllai sinna sang hong hi BM ten Kawlzang pan hong tonpih Karen mite zangin 1902 kumin Tedimah, 1904 kumin Khuasakah, 1905 kumin Tonzangah sang (mission school) hongin Kawllai hong sinsak uh hi. 1900 kum in Pau Cin Hau Lai kici Lailui khua, Pau Cin Hau (1859-1948) in mang a muhna pan 1896-1898 kum sungin kammal khat teh laimal khat ta ahi laimal 1050 bawlkhia a, laibu-in bu guk suah hi aipian Lai, Zotual Lai zong kici hi. 1901 kumin khaw 13 pan mi 51 sinin siam uh a, tuaten amau khua ciatah midang hilhsawn uh hi alpi Khatna sunga France pai Zomite leh innlamten lai kikhakna in a zat theih sun uh hi a, tua in Zomite lakah Zotual Lai kizeel mahmah ta hi ua ahih manin ABM missionary Rev ope in zong 1931 kumin Mualtung Thuhilhna bu bawlna-in Zotual Laiin a zang hi hin Hills Deputy Commissioner Lt ol urne leh Rev ope malakpihna tawh 1936 kumin Thang Cin Kham, Pau Za Dong, Cin Khaw Gin leh Sian Khaw Cin ten puahpha uh a, consonant 21, vowel 16, tonal sign 20 suahin a vekin laimal 57 phasak uh hi u dong Laipian Pawlpi sungah kizang lai hi ulai taka i zat leh i zat suak ding zong hih tuak Mangtual Lai (or Zolai or Ni Sagih Lai) i cih pen 1908 kuma Rev ope (1882-1938) hong tun phetin Zomi Khristian suak masa pen Khawsak khua-a Pau Suan leh Thuam Hang thu nih Hakha-ah samin Zopau kihilhsak a, tua pan Mikang laimal (Romanised script) tawh laimal hong bawlsak kipan pah ahi hi. 1919 kumin Tedim uk sunga hausa lian teng samkhawmin bang kam tawh laihilh ding cih genna pan Kam Hau kam (Tedim pau) zat dingin thukimna bawl uh hi ev ope in Zomite adingin Tedim pau leh Roman script tawh bawl laimal mah hoih pen ding hi a cih teitei ciangin Deputy Commissioner Mr urne tawh kimukhial dekdek heel uh hi omite laimal ding Roman script tawh bawl pen Royal Asiatic Society in zong 1912 kumin hoih a sak pen thu na pulak zo hi. 1925 kum pan Zogama primary school tengah kawllai kiphiatin Tedim pau, Hakha, Falam leh Chinbok tawh laihilh hong kipan to hi ih bang teng hang tawh Rev ope pen Zomite in Sangmangpa kici a, Cope topa cih tawh min nih kitangsak hi. 2. 8 uma kum zakhat sung a tom in: Kum 1904 Zomite palik tum cilna hi a Zomi palik kiphuan in, sila kiphiat hi. 1914 Tedimah Zolai tawh Thukizakna kihawm pan hi uizawl khua, Pau Khen in siah a piaknop loh manin Falam gamah lal dingin kisawl. 1915 Zokam tawh Lungdamna Matthai bu kikhen. 1917 Piantit (France) gam pai ding mi 1000 Tedim pan ding khia ondon hawh. 1921 Chin Hills Census, Tedim uk (Tonzang tawh) sungah inn 5045 leh Mihing 36,048 om ogamah ann hoih lo ahih manin, Lusei gamah mi tampi tak peem, sang khempeuh ah Zolai hilh ding thukim. 1923 Zomi 300,000 sung panin 2,351 in lai sim thei. zahtak huai mahmahta hi ci hi hi zongin mualtunga teng Zomite ngeina pen namdang hong lutte in dausak a, siasak hi ciin a laibu Awakening of the Northern Chins ah at hi here are evidences that these people once had a higher civilization his is seen from the fact that they are completely clothed and do not appear ever to have been headhunters or cannibals here is even a tradition of a written language hey differ from many Hill tribes in that violent crime is rare polygamy not very common, women more respected, and warfare carried on less brutally than in many Hill districts. fter reaching Khat Thang posted on 28 March 2015 at 2:08 pm Lomkholna: Article , Khatthang A lamdang Leitung, A kipeipei hizen veh! 1892 lai-a, Stanford University ah thu piang takpi ahi hi. Kum 18 apha tangvalno khat in, a Sang saap piak ding sum hong nei nawn lo hi. Tagah hi sawnsawn ahih manin sumlepaii a ngetna ding mel thei lo-in hong cimawh lua peuhmah hi. Ahi zongin, ngaihsutna hoih khat hong nei thei-in, a lawmpa khat tawh musical concert khat a sang huang sung vuah bawlin sum zong ding, tua tawh a pilna sin zom ding cih ahi hi. Concert a ding piano tumsiam minthang Ignacy Jan Paderewski cial theih dingin hong kiho thei uh hi. Ahi zongin, piano tumsiampa cial man dingin, a manager pa in 2000 piak dingin ngen hi. Tangvalno nihte zong thukimin concert limcitak khat bawl zawh ding hong kipan uh hi. Pawi bawl ni hong tung petmah hi. Paderewski zong piano tumin Stanford Sangah hong kihel takpi hi. Kamsiatna ci ding i hiam, tangval gel in, a concert ticket zuak uh a tup zah un khawng lo uh ahih manin 1600 bek hong ngah mawk uh hi. Lungkiat huaipi mahin, Paderewski kiangah hong pai uh a, a haksatnate hong gen tamai uh hi. A sum ngah sunsun uh 1600 pia-in, a kisam lai 400 pen check at sa-in pia uh hi. A manlang thei penin hih check na thoh theih dingin hong hanciam nung, ahi zongin, tawmvei bel hong ngak in ci-in kamciam pia-in hong thum uh hi. Paderewski in Hi thei lo ee, tua bang ngeina om lo hi a cih kawmin tua check balkekin, sum tang 1600 zong leh piakkik kawmin, pawi a ding na sum bat tenguh lohkik un la, na Sang saap piak ding kisamte na piak khit uh teh a val lai leh tua a val teng kei hong pia un ci-in gen hi. Tangval nihte zong um ngam lo phialin lamdang sa kawmin, lungdam thu hong ko uh hi. Paderewski a dingin a cihtak het lo huhna khat himah tase leh a picing mihing khat ii sep ding, a kilawm thu khat a sem khia kha na higige mawk hi. Bang dinga, cikmah a, meltheih ngei loh tangvalno nih huh kha ahizen tam maw? Eite in zong, hi bang dan thute tuak kha ngei ciat ding hi hang. Eite a tam zaw in, Hunna pia zenzen hi leng, kei bang ka sup lawh tam? cih lam bek i ngaihsun kha ding hi. A picing lungsim tawh kidim mite in ahih leh, Ken hun kei mawk leng hite bang suak mawk ding? cih lungsim nei uh hi. Ngahkik ding khat peuh lamen masa lo zawin, sep ding a kilawm thumaan khat a semin kingaihsun zaw uh hi. Piano tum siam, Paderewski a gam ahi, Poland ah ciahkikin Prime Minister hong suak hi. Makai picing khat hi sam napi, kamsiatna ci ding hiam, leitung galpi khatna in, Poland gam zong hong nawk kha citciat hi. Poland gammi 1.5 million bang a gam sungah dongtuakin, sum nei lo, an nek ding nei lo-in hong om uh hi. Paderewski huhna ngetna ding thei lo-in, hong cimawh lua peuhmah hi. US gam an le dongtuak huhna lam thu saipi (US Food and Relief Administration) kiangah huhna hong gal nget hi. Tua mun san ah a lian pen thusaipi pa Herbert Hoover (a sawt lo a US President a suak to pa) na hi hi. Hoover in zong Poland gam cimawh dongtuakte huhna piak ding thukim pahin, nek theih tampi puak pah lian hi. Huhna kicing takin hong tung ahih manin, Paderewski a van gikpi hong zang pah hi. Lungdam lua ahih manin, US Food and Relief Administration a makaipipa tawh kimuh ding, lungdam koh dingin vaihawm pah hi. Hong kimuh phet un Paderewski in zahtakna pia in, a mai ah kun phial a lungdam thu a gen sawm laitak, Hoover in nawh satakin, na nial aa, Kei tungah nang lungdam nong koh ding om lo hi, a zahtakhuai Prime Minister aw! Nang bel zong phawk kha nawn khol lo ding hi teh. Ahih hangin, tuma kum tamkhin sim lai-in, US gamah mi nih college sang kah a zop suak theih na dinguh, na huh ngei hi, tua mi nih lakah kei zong khat hing The world is a wonderful place. What goes around comes around!
