Minam kemcing Upadi (Law Dan, Ngeina) 2 ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Minam kemcing Upadi (Law Dan, Ngeina) 2 posted on 18 December 2014 at 4:13 pm Lomkholna: Langkhankhai , News , ZomiTimes Minam kemcing Upadi (Law Dan, Ngeina) 2 Kipi kitenna tawh kisaiin Kawlgam ngeina sung ah ngeina leh biakna in ukgawplo-in aki-it akingai theite mimal bulphuhin biakna vai kihel lo-in zong kiteng thei a, maanlo hi kici tuanlo-in Kawl ngeina, Zo Ngeina tawh kibawlin kibawl kei taleh ngeina tawh kituaklo hi, kiteng theilo ding cih omlo hi. Akiteng dingte phuggyi gawm, Pastor deihsak, biakna ngeina upadi (law) tawh kituakding,mihaute vaihawnsak ciangbek a akiteng hilo hi. Zineih taneih pen biakna ngeina upadi tawh kituak bek kiteng thei ding cih hituanlo a, akingai akiitte kiteng hilel hi. Biakna neih man a zi leh pasal nei hilo-in mihing hihna hang a zinei pasal nei kihizaw hi. Khan khat sungin zi khat, pasal khat bek kinei hileh hoihpen hi. Kawlte in pasal 23 neih ding phallo napi zi 23 neihkhawm thei hi. Tua bang veve, Muslimte in zi 23 aneih banghangin khaktan sawm ahiam? Zomite zong Malay, Delhi, USA, Singapone paiin Living Together-Inn khat ah tengkhawm, zilehpasal bangin omkhawmsa hinapi Kawlgam hong ciah leh zi leh pasal nei nailo bangdanin om khem tampi om hi. Zomite in zi 23 neih genloh, papi lawmngai khate zong kimuneu a, kamsiatna hi, misiatna leh neihlehlam kiam kipatna hi kici hi. Atawpna ah Minam Kemcing upadi (law) pen Kawlgam buaina kipatna hithei kha dinga, U Nu hunlai bangin Tualsak mite in Kawlte muanlahna hangin gal kihona om thei ding hi kici hi. Kawlgam sungah minam leh biakna ah suakta hi kicipen tu-in Buddha biakna leh Kawlte simloh, adang minamte aa dingin lungmuanna omlo tawh kibang hi. Translated by Uptodown Localization Team PUBG MOBILE is the version for Android devices of PUBG: Battlegrounds, the popular cross-platform battle royale that has been one of the video games with the highest number of active players in the world since 2017. This version for touch devices offers a gaming experience virtually identical to the one you can enjoy on PC or desktop consoles. If you're good at playing with a keyboard and mouse, chances are you'll be good at playing this portable version as well. Configure the controls to your liking Being comfortable with the controls is very important in a game like PUBG MOBILE. That is why, from the options menu, you can customize them as you wish. You will have the option to adjust the size and position of each and every one of the game's buttons, from the virtual movement stick to the different buttons for crouching, jumping, and shooting. You will also be able to choose which type of controls you want when you get behind the wheel of a vehicle, and you can even activate the Android device's accelerometer when using the weapon's telescopic sight. And, if your device has triggers, as is the case with the POCO F4 GT, you can use them to shoot. Advertisement Remove ads and more with Turbo Enjoy crossplay in PUBG Mobile Although not all gamers know, PUBG MOBILE has crossplay. However, Android players will not play against PC, Xbox, or PlayStation players. This ensures that everyone is on an equal footing. After all, using a mouse and keyboard or playing on a console can give you a very noticeable advantage over players who are using touch devices. For this reason, if you play on Android, you can only play against other players who are also playing on Android or iOS. Even players using the official emulator will be on a separate server, playing only against other emulator players. Experience the traditional battle royale The ultimate goal of PUBG MOBILE is to be the last remaining survivor. The typical structure of these games is widely known all players (usually 100) start by parachuting onto an island. As soon as they land, they will have to try to find weapons and other useful tools, which they can use to fight against other players who, of course, will be doing the same. An energy field will also reduce the size of the playable area as time goes by so that in a maximum of half an hour, only one player will be left standing. This classic mode can also be played alone, in pairs, or teams of four. Many more modes and special maps to discover Over the years and with new versions, PUBG MOBILE has added new game modes and new maps. Battle royale mode is still king, but you can also play classic deathmatches, in which two teams of five players can face each other in much faster and more furious battles. Similarly, there are also smaller maps than the original Erangel, where you can enjoy the traditional experience but with a smaller number of players and in quicker games. As is the case with the controls, the game's strong point is once again the large number of options on offer at all times. If you feel like playing a game but only have 10 minutes, just play on one of the small maps, such as Karakin or Sanhok. Special events each month It is very difficult to get bored with PUBG MOBILE. Each month, there is at least one special event, and there are usually two or three. These events usually consist of exclusive collaborations of all kinds, ranging from unique Blackpink skins to game modes inspired by movies like Godzilla or King Kong to partnerships with footballers such as Lionel Messi. The events never stop. All the content you acquire during these limited-time events will, of course, remain linked to your account forever, and you will be able to show it off as you please. Open loot boxes and get unique rewards Loot boxes or reward boxes are a feature of almost all video games for iOS and Android. And PUBG MOBILE is no exception. With the coins you earn by completing games, you will be able to unlock a great number of boxes. Inside these boxes, you can find everything from pieces of equipment to weapons and unique skins. Many companies, such as Xiaomi and POCO, also offer exclusive boxes. These gift boxes sometimes have limited rewards that can only be obtained for a very short period. Fully customizable visuals The first time you launch PUBG MOBILE, the game will try to identify the optimal graphics options for your device. However, this first configuration is not always the best. From the visual options menu, you can customize the graphics to your liking, adjusting everything from the quality of the textures to the frames per second rate, including anti-aliasing use. In addition, you will also be able to use several different filters, which will subtly change the look of the game. Finding the visual configuration you like the most is very important to enjoy the game properly since you will most likely spend many hours looking at the screen. Download the APK of PUBG MOBILE and enjoy one of the best battle royale experiences on Android devices. Bum le ai tawh kipelhna Lian Tuang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Bum le ai tawh kipelhna Lian Tuang posted on 7 June 2019 at 9:25 am Lomkholna: Article , Liantuang Bum le ai tawh kipelhna Lian Tuang 2006 kum in bum leng ai leng khat in ong sukha dektak hi. 2006 kum tuk kipat ding ciangin tu laitak ka nasepna Micro station (Letsikan kici bualpi gei, Sawbua ye sen khua nisuah lam tai 17) ah zum In-charge panmun ong kipia hi. Promotion hi loin nasep kibehlapna hi zaw sa kahih manin thupi lua in ka ngaihsun kei hi. Mi 4 ka pha uh a, kei a naupang pen ka hi sawnsawn hi. Zum nasep le inn lam ciah nading lem zaw ahih manin Tamu pan Kawlpi Micro zum (MPT) ah ka kituah hi. Kawlpi ah ka om tam zaw hi. Tamu a ka lawmte a zinsuk a zinto peuhpeuh ong bang tangtang in nuam ka ci sa mahmah uhi. Khat vei Tamu lawmte khat ong hawh in kikhen thei loin ka paupau uhi. Nitak amah ka khak kawmin Lansong (kamka bom) ah niangtui dawnin ka ciakciak lai uhi. Guah phinphin banah ka kiho uh laklawh ahih manin ama zin ah giak dingin ka zui vet hi. A zinte pen a pute (a nu nau pa) hi in a thu nuam mahmah khat na hi hi. Tuilum hawp in a pu tawh zong ka ciakciak leuleu uhi. A pu in ka nasep vai innkuan sung vaite tampi ong dong hi. Lup ding ciangin zingciang kiallap na nek khit ciangin ciah pan in, ka tupa tawh tu zan lungmuang takin ihmu in tawlnga hithiat in ci in a kawl pasian tau mai ah ong lum sak hi. A pu pen bum le ai tawh kisai nasep tuamtuam a sem siampupi khat na hi mawk hi. Ka lup khit phet in ka ihmu pah hi. Ahi zongin zingsang lam nai 3 pawl ciangin ka khanglo siasai hi. Ihmu kik thei nawn loin ka hak kelkal hi. A pu pen khuavak ma nai 4 in tho in a khi khinkhin hi. Amuk phunphun hi. A gamtatna khempeuh puanza kawm panin ka enen hi. Khuavak ciangin ka thokhia pan hi. Ka lawmpa tho nai lo ahih manin innlim ah keikia ka tu hi. Ka thawh lam a theih ciangin a pu zong lengla khan ah ong tuaksuk hi. Ihmu thei hiam, mang na nei hiam cih teng ka kiho khit uh ciangin ka naseppih lawmte min khat ong lo leklak hi. Hih pa na bangci muh hiam ong ci laizang hi. Lamdang sa kawm in ka zum naseppihte pen kei adingin ka innkuanpihte mah hi pah hi ci in ka dawng kik hi. Pau loin tawl khat a om khit ciangin Mg Tuang aw, nang ong kem khat om a, tua hang in na vang pha mahmah hi. Tua ahih manin ken zong nang tungah bangmah kong bawl kei ding hi ong ci miau hi. Tua banah na nasepna ah zakhanna a kipan neihsa lamsa le lawhcinnate na lunggulhleh kei kiangah zong ong pai thei hi teh. Kong bawl sak thei ding hi ong ci beh lai hi. Bangmah pau thei loin amah ka en lemlam lel hi. Ka khuasikmul tho hanhan hi. Pau awk kawmkawm in lungdam mahmah ei ka ci mualmual hi. Tua khit ciang kihei kik in a khi khin zom kik ziau hi. Kiallap nek khit ka ciah ding ciangin a pu in Mg Tuang aw na lawmpa a om loh hang ong hawh veve lel in, inn bangin ong nei thei hi teh. Na kisap a omleh ong gen in. Na upna, na thukhualna le na gamtahzia ngeinate na khahsuah mahmah kei in, thupi sa in kong pakta mahmah hi ong ci beh lai hi. A pelh tentan ka hih loh hangin tu ni dongin ka hawh kik nawn kei hi. Ahi zongin khat veivei lamkal khawng ah ka kituah thei zel uhi. Cycle pai kawm sa peuh in ka ki ot san valval thei uh a, ong it bawl mahmah hi. Tua hun lai thu ka ngaihsut kik ciangin ka panmun thak pen thupi lua ka sak loh hangin ka lawmte in a deih mahmah bek tham loin biakna kibanglo, minam kibang loin amau sangin naupang zaw le nasepna sungah kum tampi Junior zaw pa khut nuai ah a om khak uh a lungkim zo kholo uh uh na hih tuak hi. Hih thu I gen kikna pen muh theihloh vangliatna nei tuamtuamte kiang pan Pasian ong kepna thu a gen nuam i hi hi. Kei ong susai dinga kicialte nangawn ka meltheih le ka lawm dingin Pasian in ong hei sakna thu a gen nuam i hi hi. A lamdang Pasian ong kepna ahi hi. (Hih thu pen kuama kiang ka gen ngei khol kei hi. Nungdeuh in Yangon pan inn lam ong ciah pak ka neu lawm Sm Nuamboih (AG pastor, Ygn) tawh kimu in kam kizom in hih thu ka gen leh mi dangte kiang gengen ve, lai in zong at ve, Pasian ong kepna lamdang lua ei ci in tha ong piak ciangin thangah in kong gelh kik ahi hi.) Dr. Lien Cin Khup Taithul, Kum (80) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Dahna Pulakna: Mangpha Rev. Dr. Lien Cin Khup Taithul, Kum (80) posted on 14 January 2017 at 10:18 am Lomkholna: Dahpihna, News, ZIUSA, Zomi USA gam, Georgia State, Atlanta khuapi a teng Rev. Dr. Lien Cin Khup Taithul Kum 80 in abeisa January 08, 2017 ni zanlam nai 10:00PM hunpawlin Motor tuahsiatna hangtawh lipkhaphuai leh dipkuathuaitakin a leitung nuntakna ongbeisanta cihthu izahmanin Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in nakpitakin kidahpih, ki lainatpih hi. Rev. Dr. Khup pen Zogam, Lamka khuapi a teng hi-in Pilna sangkan sinnopna hangtawh abeisa 2003 kumin USA gam ongtung ahihi. leitung a nuntaksungin Pilna deihmahmah ahihmanin sangminthang tuamtuam ah kahkawikawia gualzawhna tampi ongngah hi. Zomi leh Zogam it mahmah khat ahihmanin a tuntunna ah Minam kipawlnate ah ahihtheihzahin ma apangden Makai muanhuai mahmah khatzong ahihi. a nuntakna a beidong, a hutawpna asankhiat dongmah Pasian gamleh Minam adingin ma apangden makaimuanhuai mahmah khat in hicibanga ong nusiat vatmawkpen a innkuanpihte bek supna hilo in I Zomi bupa supna lianpi khat hicih Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in kiciamteh hi. I it, I zahtak mahmah Rev. Dr. Khup Taithul pen USA leitangtunga ong nusia Zomi laizom khat ahihna tawh kizui-in Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in Paakkual khattawh Mangpha khakna kinei ding hi. I siapa tawh a nunungpen hunzatkhopding pen ong tungding January 14, 2017 (Sat) ni-in Memorial Dr. Prebyterian Church, 5140 Memorial Dr, Stone Mountain, GA 30083 ah 12:00PM hunin amahtawh a nunungpen hehnephunbawlna kineidinga tuakhitciangin Floral Hills Funeral Home Cemetery, 3150 Lawrencesville Hwy, Tucker, GA 30084 ah a luanghawm vuina, daitansakna kinei ding hi. Related: Malaysia akithat Kawlgammi 5 te vaitawh muanmawh mi 15 kimanta I it mahmah Rev. Dr. Khup ong nusiatna hanga adah akap, a lungleng khuangai a suan akhakteng leh Tanau meltheih akua mapeuh tungah ibiak Vanglian Pasian khasiangtho in aluang khituite ong nulsakhenla lungnoptawldamna ongguatsak kimciat tahen cih Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in thu kongngetpih uhhi. Dahpihna lianpitawh, Executive Committee Zomi Innkuan USA, Inc. January 13, 2017 Reader Interactions Previous: ZAM Thupuak:: 15 January 2017 Next: Dahna Pulakna: Mangpha Tg. (How is your appetite. ) Agelh Rev1 2r1 21 21 2gul Khan Pau By: LAIBUSAAL Date: March 29, 2023 na Ankam A Lim Hiam. (How is your appetite. ) Agelh Rev1 2r1 21 21 2gul Khan Pau 1989 kumin Mizogam ka hawhna ah papi khat in, Sia Paupu, na thau si cia. hong ci a, ken zong, Ka ankam lim loh hun nei lo, ihmut nop loh hun om lo, tua ciang midang hazatna nei lo ka hih manin ka thau loh nading om lo hi, ci-in ka dawng hi1 2nkam lim manin thau ding cihna ahih loh hangin ankam limte thau baihzaw hamtang uh hi1 2 pumpi adingin huih, tui leh an kisam a, tuate ngah kei leng kisi ding hi1 2i cidam khat adingin ankam lim loh hun om ngei lo hi1 2a mangngilh theih loh khat - 1976 kumin Sumchinvum ah Chin Baptist Association Gospel camp om a, tua lai-ah kei zong ka kihel hi1 2iapi Shing Khan Thang zong Kikhopna bang ci uk ding. cih thugen dingin hong pai hi1 2amp annek khit in amah hong tung hi a, anhuanten an tam lo ahih manin kuang bang zah khawng ne ding hiam, cih kei hong dongsak uh hi1 2 Shing in, Tulai lunat leh khuasik tawh dam lo ka hih ciangin kuang nih khawng hoih bek ding hi, ci hi1 2en zong nui kawmkawmin1 Cidam hi leteh kuang bang zah ne ding. ka cih leh, amah zong nui hiuhiau kawmin Kuang li khawng bek kine ding hi, ci hi1 2ong ciamnuihpih ahih lam ka thei a, ahi zongin mi cidamte in an tam ne deuh uh cih kithei hi1 2umpi ah an i duh loh ciangin a hang om na hi gige hi1 2nkam lim lohna a hang tampi sung panin ahi thei ding pawl khat gen leng: (1)1 2am lohna tuamtuam hang hi thei hi. (ii)1 2ungkham manin an duhna bei thei hi. (iii)1 2ungkiat luat manin an zong mangngilh theih hi. (iv)1 2ingaihpih numei leh pasal tawh thubuai hangin kikhen khak ciang. (v)1 2umpi gimluat hun ciangin. (vi)1 2 gilvah lua khin zong hi thei hi. Tua mah bangin khalam ah zong an duh loin ki-om thei hi1 2umpi ah an i kisap bangin khalam ah zong an i kisam uh hi1 2ha an duh lo na hih leh na dinmun hoih lo cihna hi1 2halam ah kha an duh lote zong natna nei cihna hi1 2ua ahih kei leh na gilvah khin zo cihna hi1 2ha an hi lo bang an tawh na gilvah na hiam cih ngaihsuthuai mahmah hi1 2rench Scientist Pascal in, Mihing lungsim sungah Pasian bek om theih nading mun-awng (empty slot) om a, na dang khat peuhpeuh in luah thei lo hi, ci hi1 2asian thu duhna nei lo na hih leh bang in hong luah dim hiam1 2ua mah bangin St1 2ugustine in, Topa aw, kote nang adingin nong bawl ka hi uh a, ka lungsim uh nangah a khawl mateng kitawlnga thei lo hi, na ci hi1 2opa in hong tawldamsak hi loin sum leh pai khawngin hong tawldamsak ahih ding lauhhuai mahmah hi1 2halam an duhna i gen ciangin kumpi David mah lungsim ah hong suak hi1 2umpi ahihna, neih leh lam a hauhna, galte tungah a gualzawhna in khalam dangtakna beisak tuan lo hi1 2ma tung panin Pasian ah gilkialna leh dangtakna leh gilvahna, lungkim nading nam guk khawngin en ni1 2ix Satisfying Sources from the Psalms of David. Hunger for the person of God (Pasian mahmah deihna hangin gilkialna) Hunger for the presence of God (Pasian ompihna lunggulh mahmahna) Hunger for the praise of God (Pasian phatna leh pahtawi nop mahmahna) Hunger for the plan of God (Pasian gelna theih ding lunggulhna) Hunger for the precepts of God (Pasian thukhamte deih mahmahna) Hunger for the people of God (Pasian mite tawh kikholh ding lunggulhna) HUNGER FOR THE PERSON OF GOD: (Pasian mahmah deihna hangin gilkialna) Pasian aw, keima Pasian na hi hi1 2angmah kong zong a, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh nang kong deih hi1 2ui om lohna gamkeu bangin ka pumpi bup in nang hong deih hi (Late 63:1). Sakhi in luitui luang sialsial a lunggulh bangin nang ka hong lunggulh hi, ka Pasian aw1 2 nungta Pasian kong deih hi1 2ik ciangin kei hong pai-in Pasian maitang hong mu thei ding ka hi hiam. (Late 42:1- 2). Thungenin nang lamah ka khutte ka hong zan a, leikeu in tui a duh bangin nang ka hong duh hi. (Late 143:6)1 2 U N G E R F O R T H E PRESENCE OF GOD: (Pasian ompihna lunggulh mahmahna) Topa tung panin na khat ka ngen khin a, tua ngenin ka zon ding pen, Topa inn sungah ka khan tawntung om ding1 2opa hoihna et ding leh ama biakinn sungah thudot dingte ahi hi (Late 27:4). Ka lungsim leh ka pumpi zawngkhal kha ding a, ahih hangin Pasian pen ka lungsim hatna leh keima a hi tawntung ding hi (Late 73:26). Vanglian Topa aw, nangma tenna mun bangzah takin etlawm ahi hiam1 2en ka lunggulh mahmah hi1 2opa huangsung ka lunggulh mahmah a, ka lungsim leh ka pumpi a nungta Pasian tungah lungdam mahmah in la a sa hi (Late 84:1-2)1 2UNGER FOR THE PRAISE OF GOD: (Pasian phatna leh pahtawi nop mahmahna) Topa ka phat tawntung ding a, amah phatna ka gengen ding hi1 2opa ka phat ding a, gimna thuakte zasak unla lungdam uh hen (Late 34:1-2). Ka suah tung a kipanin nangmah kong bel a, ka nu gil sung panin hong lakhia pa na hi hi1 2angmah ka hong phat ngitnget hi (Late 71:6). Ka Pasian leh ka Kumpipa aw, nangmah hong pahtawi-in a tawntungin nangma min kong phatphat ding hi1 2isimin hong pahtawi-in a tawntungin nangma min kong phatphat ding hi (Late 145:1-2)1 2UNGER FOR THE PLAN OF GOD1 (Pasian gelna theih ding lunggulhna) Nang hong zahtakte adingin na koihsa na hoihte, nang hong belte adingin mite muhna ah na bawl nangma hoihna kicing a, mi khempeuh in thei uh hi (Late 31:19). Topa sungah lungkim in, amah in na deihna hong pia ding hi1 2opa tungah na vaiteng ap in1 2mah muang in amah in hong sem ding hi (Late 37:4-5). Nangmah hong muang ka hih manin zingsang simin na itna kip kei hong phawksak in1 2angma tungah thu hong ngen ka hih manin ka paina ding lampi hong hilh ta in (Late 143:8)1 2 U N G E R F O R T H E PRECEPTS OF GOD: (Pasian thukhamte deih mahmahna) Kham (gold) sangin ahi zongin kham hoih pen sang ahi zongin na thukhamte deihhuaizaw a, khuaizu leh khuailuzu taakte sangin zong khumzaw lai hi1 2ua tham loin tuate hangin a nasempa in thuphawkna ngah a, tuate zuihna-ah noptuamna lian a om hi (Late 19:10-11). Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh nang ka hong zong hi1 2a thupiakte panin kei hong pialsak kei in1 2angma tungah kong khialh loh nadingin ka lungsim sungah nangma thu ka khol hi (Late 119:10-11). na kam sung pana thu pen kham leh ngun tul tampite sangin kei a dingin hoihzaw hi1 2angmah in kei hong piangsakin na hong bawl hi1 2a thupiaknate ka sin theihna dingin thu theihtelna hong pia in (Late 119:72-73)1 2UNGER FOR THE PEOPLE OF GOD: (Pasian mite tawh kikholh ding lunggulhna) Leitungah a om mi siangthote ahih leh amau nampi hi a, amaute sungah ka lungkimna teng om hi (Late 16:3). Leitungah a thuman mite kei tawh a om theihna dingin maipha ka pia ding a, paubanna a om loin a gamta mi in keima na hong sem ding hi (Late 101:6). En un sanggam bangin mite pumkhat suakin a tutkhawm uh ciangin bangzahin hoihin nuam ahi hiam. (Late 133:1)1 2avid in Pasian loin nopna taktak omlo ahih lam hong phawksak a, ama dangtakna leh deihna in Topa bek mah ahi hi1 2ernard Langer pen US ah Golf kimawlna a siam mahmah khat in kiciamteh hi. 1986 in US leh Leitung bup ah number 1na hi1 2man, Golf kimawlna ah leitung continent ngaah a siampen hihna ka ngah ngei a, leitung ciamtehna ah number 1na ka hi hi1 2i melhoih tak ka nei a, sum ka dam sunga ka zat zawh loh ding ka nei hi1 2hi zongin ka nuntakna ah bang hiam a kim lo, kisap khat om hi (Yet something is missing) ci hi1 2asian loin bang hiam khat kisam den hi1 2opa Pasian in na khalam gilkialna ah a beithei lo an lim penpen hong pia hen1 2ource: Lungdamna Aw (An Organ of the Chin Baptist Association) Vol1 2LI No. 03 Laibu Saal Zomi eLibrary Tags Rev1 2r1 21 21 2gul Khan Pau Previous article THUCIIN HOIH (70) A pan Z1 2gelh Thang Cin Lian Next article Jesuh Khephung ah 51 2gelh Kap Za Khai LAIBUSAAL Share post: Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp Popular HUNTHAK KHA MANGTHANG1 2gelh Kap Za Khai (Photoh) TEDIM GAM LEH MUHMAWH GAL1 2gelh Go Deih Mung AMA THUSIM1 2gelh Kap Za Khai (Photoh) Ka Neuthu Mangmawh Pawlkhat Part 2 (Pa phawkna No. 07-10) (Astract from Ka Pian Sinthu Vol I) Agelh Awn Za Pau Mihau Taktak (Luke 16:19-23)1 2gelh Suang Khen Pau More like this Related HUNTHAK KHA MANGTHANG1 2gelh Kap Za Khai (Photoh) LAIBUSAAL - "url": " "depth": 1 --- Christian Hymn te tangthu: Keima Topa Zeisu Lamdang Honpa Hi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Christian Hymn te tangthu: Keima Topa Zeisu Lamdang Honpa Hi posted on 14 December 2016 at 3:00 am Lomkholna: Article , Biakna , Hymn , Zamkhatkham He Hideth My Soul (Isaiah 32:2) Fanny J. Crosby (1820-1915) William James Kirkpatrick (1838-1921) Fanny Crosby laphuahte tul thei lo-a tuni dongin kideih den hi. A hang tuamtuam tampite lakah, Fanny in la a phuah ciangin Laisiangtho mah bulphuh dena thungenin ki-ap masa-a a phuahna hang hi, kici hi. A la phuah peuhmah Laisiangtho tawh kituak dena, Laisiangtho upna thugil doctrine tawh kitukalh ngei lo hi. Hih la Keima Topa Zeisu Lamdang Honpa Hi mahmah zong tua banga a phuah ahi hi. Laisiangtho mun tampi bulphuh-a a phuah ahi hi. Isaiah 9:6 a, Ama min in Lamdang, a cihna muna kipan Late 16:8 a, Amah ka taklam ah om ahi manin hong kiliingsak kei ding hi, Thuhilhkikna 33:25 a, Na ni tawh kizui-in na tha hat ding hi, Isaiah 32:2 a, Mi khat in huih nunna pana bukna mun, huihpi pana kiliahna mun; mun keu-a gun tui luang leh keugaw gama suangpi limliap bang hi ding hi, Paikhiatna 33:22 a, Suangpi kitam heengah kong koih dinga, ka khut-in kong liah ding hi a cihna munte la-a a phuah ahi hi. Hih la a phuaknu Fanny Jane Crosby pen America gam Southeast, New York ah March 24, 1820 ni-in suak hi. Kha khat leh a lang (nipi kal 6) a phak ciangin a mit na-a, zatui kinuh khial a hih manin a mit taw-a, a khan tawntung mit khua mu lo-in om hi. A sih dongin New York City a St. Johns Methodist Episcopal Church ah pawlpi mi citak mahmah khat-in om den hi. A neutunga kipanin a pi in thu le la kici khempeuh ah pantah hi. New York School for the Blind kici mit khua mu lote sangah pilna sin hi. 1847 kum panin 1858 kum dong tua sang mah ah sangsia sem hi. 1958 kumin tua sang mah-a sem mite zahtak mahmah music sia Alexander Van Alstyne tawh kiteng uh hi. A neu tunga kipan in laphuah lam a vak hi a, ahi zongin a la phuahte leitung la pian vive hizaw hi. Church music lam-a minthang mahmah William B. Bradbury thuzawhna tungtawnin kum 40 a phaka kipan gospel lamal bek phuaka, ama genna ah tua gam sunga a lungnuampen mi hong suak hi. Fanny Crosby in la a phuah ciangin khukdin-in thungen-a Pasian makaihna zong masa lo peuhmah-in la phuak ngei lo hi. A Laisiangtho sungah American lan (flag) khat tep liklek den se hi. Ama hun-a gospel laphuak minthang mahmah Ira D. Sankey, William H. Doane, John R. Sweney, George C. Stebbins, George F. Root, William J. Kirkpatrick, leh a dang tuamtuamte tawh kithuah-in la tampi phuak hi. A khan sunga a laphuah pongpong dawng 8,000 val hi, ci-in kiciamteh hi. February 12, 1915 ni, ama kum 95 a phak laitakin i Topa kiang hong zuatsan hi. Fanny Crosby phuah late lakah hih la, Keima Topa Zeisu Lamdang Honpa Hi (He Hideth My Soul) banah, Hong Paisan Ken, Migi Topa (Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior), Lungmuanna Thupha (Blessed Assurance), Amah Thei Ning (My Savior First of AllI Shall Know Him), A Sia Ding Honkhia In (Rescue the Perishing), Lam Tawntung A Hong Paipih Hi (All the Way My Savior Leads Me), Pasian Min Pha Ta Hen (To God Be the Glory) cih la ngaihte kihel hi. Hih la a aw a phuakpa William James Kirkpatrick bel February 27, 1838 ni-in Ireland gamah suak hi. A neu lai-in a nu le a pa tawh America gamah lal uh a, Duncannon, Pennsylvania ah teng uh hi. Khutsiam lettama nasep sema, ahih hangin a uk taktak bel music ahi hi. Violin, cello, tamngai leh fife tum sin hi. Kum 17 a phak ciangin Methodist Episcopal pawlpi ah lut a, biakna la lamah kipia hi. American Cilvil War (tual-gal) sungin 91st regiment of Pennsylvania Volunteers ah 1861-1862 sung galkap sung misic makai leh fife tumin om hi. (Fife i cih bel tamngai tawh a kibang pian tum theih namkhat hi a, galkap sungah kizang deuh hi. ZKK) Tua khit ciangin tembaw lamna ah sema, kum 12 sung Philadelphia-a innsung vanzat furniture kibawlna ah sem hi. Sunday school nasepna thupisa dena, 1859 kumin camp meeting-a sak ding la pawlkhat khen hi. 1865 kumin Philadelphia ah organist leh music director suaka, 1878 kum ciangin a khutsiam nasep nusia kiuhkeuh ta hi. Gospel laphuah leh biakna la editor sema, John R. Sweney tawh kopkhawmin biakna labu 50 dektak kaikhawmin khenkhia uh hi. Amah guak in bu 40 khenkhia leuleu hi. September 29, 1921 ni-in Germantown, Philadelphia ah la dawng khat a phuah laitakin si hi. Tua la a phuah kawmin a Topa in sam ta cih thei leh kilawm hi. A taang masa leh a nunung lam a khutlam kibang lo-in nawh tektek leh kilawmin zulh semsem hi. A laisimna inndei sungah a ging a om loh ciangin a zi lungnuam lo a a et leh a laikung tawi kawmsa-in na si khin ta hi. A sih laitaka a phuah la hih bang ahi hi: Just as Thou wilt, Lord this is my cry; Just as Thou wilt, to live or to die. I am Thy servant; Thou knowest best. Just as Thou wilt, Lord labor or rest; Just as Thou wilt, Lord- which shall it be; Life everlasting is waiting for me. Or shall I tarry here at Thy feet? Just as Thou wilt, Lord, whateer is meet. A Mangkamin ngaih mahmah-a, ei kama i tei teh ngaih zo khol lo hi taleh, hih la ei Zokamin kong teikhia pong hi. A khiatna leh a rhyme mahmah ngaih zo khol lo ahih manin mun dangte bangah letkhia se lo-a a English version mah kong suahsak den ahi hi. Nang deih bang, Topa, hih kong thumna; Nang deih bangbang, hin ding leh sih ding. Nang hong thei pen teh; Na nasempa. Nang deih bang, Topa, sep ding khawl ding. Nang deih bang, Topa tua bang piang hen; Nuntak tawntungnan kei hong ngak den. Aih keh Na khephung hiah ka khawl dia? Nang deih bang, Topa, Nang deih bangzia. William J. Kirkpatrick in la-aw ngaih tampi phuaka tuate lakah hih la Keima Topa Zeisu Lamdang Honpa Hi (He Hideth My Soul) banah Huhpa Hong Pai Khin Ta (The Comforter Has Come), Hong Ciah Ing (Lord, Im Coming Home), Thum lo-in Ngak In (Wait and Murmur Not), Zeisun Hong Hon Hi (Jesus Saves), Deeper Yet, Jesus Comes, Heaven at Last, We Have an Anchor, Redeemed, Stepping in the Light, When Love Shines In, O to Be Like Theecih late zong a la-aw ama phuah mah ahi hi. Rev. AgelhZam Khat Kham By: LAIBUSAAL Date: September 10, 2021 Kong Up Kong Muanna Lian My Faith Looks Up to Thee (Ephesians 3:12) AgelhZam Khat Kham Ray Palmer (1808-1887) Lowell Mason (1792-1872) America gam suahtak nading galpi a ven khit ciangin America gama Pasian thu ki-upzia nakpi-in hong kikhel hi. Mite in Laisiangtho up loh ding peuh thupisak zawsop mawk uh hi. Zeisu Khazih Pasian ahihna peuh um lo-in, biakna pongpong gimneih nopna hong khang hi. Ngongtatna, thanghuaina, thaikapna leh phengtatna hong khang mahmah hi. Ahih hangin a kicing Ama geelna leh a bei thei lo Ama itna hangin Pasian in America gam sungah the Second Awakening a kici a nih veina kha khanlawhna lianpi tungsak hi. Pawpi sung bek hi lo-in, Pasian thu a awlmawh lo College sangnaupang tampite hong piangthakin Zeisu Khazih sungah mi thak suak ziahziah uh hi. Tua bang sangnaupangte lakah Ray Palmer zong kihel hi. Amah November 12, 1808 ni-in Little Compton, Rhode Island ah suak hi. A pa pen tua kiim-a thukhenmang khat ahi hi. Kum 13 a phak ciangin upmawh lohpi-in sum leh paii hatsatna tuak-a a sangkah zom zo nawn lo-in Boston-a vanzuakna khat-ah lai-at sem hi. Tangthu-a minthang Park Street Church ah kikhawm dena tua lai-ah Zeisu Khazih a Honpa-in sang hi. A sawt lo-in Ama nasem dingin Pasian sapna a ngah lam kitel-a, Andover Academy ah a sangkah zomkik-a, 1830 kumin Yale University panin a sangkah zo hi. Tua university ah theology a sin kawmin New York City a numeinote sang khat-ah laihilh hi. Yale University pan sang a man khit, a sepna sangsiapinute innkuan tawh a omkhop laitaka hih la a phuah ahi hi. Tua kumin a ci nana a, a lungsim neu mahmah hi. Zan khat, singlamteh mai-a khukdin, a hehpih huai mahmah mawhnei mi khat thu kigelhna German poem khat a sim leh a lungsim lawng mahmah hi. Tua German la Mangkamin letkhia a, phuahbeh in taang 4 behlap hi. Tuateng Kong Up Kong Muanna Lian ci-a i saksak la hong suak hi. Ama genna ah, Hih la sunga kammalte kei hanciam kul het lo-in ka lungsim sungah hong suak lel hi. Christian hymn-a kisa ding cih thadah, midangte muh ding nangawna ka ngaihsut ngei hi lo hi. Na mai kong muh ciangin, Tatkhiatsa ka kha in a cihna a tang tawpna ka tun ciangin hotkhiatna leh tatkhiatna nasep khempeuh kihel a, a tawntunga Pasian a kiphat nading thu hong lak ahih manin ka lungsim hong khoih lua-a ka khitui tampi a luan ka mangngilh thei het kei hi ci-in gen ngei hi. Mr. Palmer in a ip sunga a puakden laibuneu sungah hih lamalte teikhia a, khatveivei amah leh amah Pasian tunga ki-apna a neih cianga a sim ding cih sim loh ngaihsutna dang nei lo hi. Tua zawh kum nih khit ciangin Boston a va hawh leh a lawmpa Lowell Mason tawh mi tam mahmahna lampi khat-ah kituak ciitciat uh hi. Thucin thutang a gen laitakun Dr. Mason in tua hun laitaka a kaihkhop labu sunga hel ding lamal kiphuak thak khatpeuh a nei hiam cih dong kha zenzen hi. Mr. Palmer in zong a laibuneu sunga a la phuah lak ngam pak lo pi-in lak hi. Dr. Mason in tua la dal khat ngen hi. A gei-a vanzuakna khat-ah lut uh a, tua la dal khat tei uh hi. Tua zawh ni nih ni thum khit ciangin lampi-ah kituak leuleu uh a, Dr. Mason in Mr. Palmer kiangah, Kum tampi nungta-in na lia n tampi na sem zongin a khang khangin,Kong Up Kong Muanna Lian cih la a phuakpa-in hong kitheizaw ding hi ci hiau hi. Dr. Mason in hih la tawh kituak ding la-aw khat phuak-a, Olivet ci se hi. A la sunga thu tawh kituak dinga a phuah ahi hi. 1832 kumin Spiritual Songs for Social Worship kici labu sungah kihel pah a, a kikhet masaknapen ahi hi. Tua hun-a kipan tuni dongin evangelical labu peuhmah ah kihel den hi. Lowell Mason genkholhna tangtung takpi hi. A kum 79 pha-a a sihkhiat ciang dong Dr. Palmer in na lianpi tampi mah semkhia hi. Kum 30 sung America gam Nisuahna lamah Congregational pawlpi nih kem-in pastor sema, American Congregational Missions Program ah corresponding secretary zong sem hi. Mi tampite deih mahmah biakna la leh biakna lai tampi gelh a, hymn dang dawng 37 zong phuak hi. Ahi zongin kum 22 a phak lai-a a phuah, Kong Up Kong Muanna Lian la a phuakpa ahihna tawh mite in tuni dongin phawk lai uh hi. Dr. Palmer pen a nuntak sung buppi Topa a it mahmah, mi cidam, maitaii den a kithuah khakpih mi khempeuh in a it mahmah mi lungsim hoih, hokum nuam mahmah khat ahi hi. A kum hong tam-a hong ham semsem ciangin nidanglai medieval hun lai-a Latin hymnte Mangkam-a teikhiat ding hong uk mahmah a, tua bang late teikhia-a pawlpi sunga a kisak nadinga a hanciam masapen ahi hi. Tua banga a teikhiat Latin late lakah 12th century lai a khang, O Sacred Head, Now Wounded (A Lu, Tun Liamgawp-Xtian La No. 93) a phuak St. Bernard of Clairvaux phuah a minthang mahmah la khat ahi Jesus, Thou Joy of Loving Hearts ahi hi. Hih la a aw a phuak Dr. Lowel Mason pen Father of American Church and Public-School Music (American BiaknaPawlpi leh Sang lam Music-te Pa) kici zawzen hi. January 8, 1792 ni-in America gam Medfield, Massachusetts ah suak hi. A khangno lai-in Savannah, Georgia ah teng hi. 1827 kumin Boston ah kisuan-a, tua lai-ah a ten sungin Boston School of Music phuan hi. Boston-a sangte ah music a kisin nadingin a phuangkhiapa ahi hi. Tua khit ciangin Europe gam lamah zin-a laihilhzia sin hi. America a tunkik ciangin music kikhoppite vaikhawma mite in paakta-in mi zo mahmah hi. 1851 kumin New York City ah kituah a, tua lai-ah hymn leh la tampi kaikhawmin khenkhia hi. La-aw dawng 700 val phuak hi, ci-in kiciamteh a, tuate lakah, Vuuk Paakna Gam Mual Panin (From Greenlands Icy Mountain), Nang Tawh Naizaw Nuam Ing (Nearer My God to Thee), Vanglian Kumpipa Hong Sihna (When I Survey the Wondrous Cross) cihte kihel hi. Leitung Lungdam Topa Hong Pai (Joy to the World) la a gualphapa (arranger) zong hi lai hi, a aw bel George F. Handel (1685-1759) phuah hi, kici hi. 1855 kumin New York University in Doctor of Music degree pia a, America gama sang khatpeuh in tua bang degree a piak masaknapen ahi hi. Kong up kong muan-na lian, Hong hon Topa Pasian, Hong tan Tuu-no, Kong thumna hong ngai in. Ka mawh na teng paai in, Tu ni a, Ki panin hong tang khin aw. Kei ma lung sim zawngkhal, Hong guan in tha le ngal Tha nuamsak in, Kei a ding Nong si ta Kei zong nang kong it-na Mit ngei lo Ka sungah lumsak den in. Lungman' khuamial lakah, Dahna tampi lakah, Lam hong hilh aw, Khuamialna vaksak in, Dahna khitui siak in, Piallo hong naisak in, Nangmah kiang tawh. Nuntak tom leitung ah, Sihna gun ka tungah, Hong tuum ciangin, Launa, lung hih mawhna, Hong paikhiatsak inla, Na tatsa keima kha Hong lato in. Malaysia, PJ sung aom Billboard khat kicimsuk in mipi ki patau ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Malaysia, PJ sung aom Billboard khat kicimsuk in mipi ki patau posted on 8 December 2017 at 7:35 pm Lomkholna: Malaysia , News , Sawltak , World Malaysia, PJ sung aom Billboard khat kicimsuk in mipi ki patau Malaysia, Petaling Jaya vengsung aom Advertisement bawlna Billboard golpikhat kiasuk, ki cimsuk ahih manin khuasung mipi te ki lauthawng mahmah cih theStar pan kiza hi. Petaling Jaya, Jalan SS201 tungah tuni Friday (Dec 8) sunlampawl in thupiang ahihi. Hihvai tawh kisai in thuneikhat ahi MCA Petaling Jaya Utara chairman Tan Gim Tuan in agenna ah hih buaina Incident hangin Kuala Lumpur khuapisung aom adang Billboard tezong bangacidiam, amuanhuai mahdiam cin ki lunghimawh mahmah cihi. Adiakdiak in mipi omna Housing Areas tawh akinai in akilam Billboard te amuanhuailo ahih khakding kipau mahmah hi. Tuaban ah hih Billboard tepen kumpi phalna mahtawh akibawl, akilam ahidiam, Legal mah ahidiam cihpen kitheilo hi. Tuni akicim Billboard pen lamzikpi Main Road tungah kiasukmawk a, khuasungvak mawtaw te kuamah dengkhalo bilbel hi. Hih Billboard akiatsukna tengpen khuasung mipi te teenna Residential Area sungteng hisawnsawn a, hihbangdan buaina aom kikding pen ki lunghimawh mahmah hi cin genkhia hi. Petaling Jaya mayor Datuk Mohd Azizi Mohd Zai in agenna ah hih akicimsuk Billboard pen alui hi a, aki phelkhiatsawm laitak in aki cimsuk cihi. Alui aomsa Billboard pen LED Billboard tawh laihding in akisawm laitak in aki cimsuk hi cin genkhia hi. Hih Billboard bawltheih lamtheih nadingin phalna Licence pen 2003 kumin akipia cihi. Tukum August khasung in aomsa Static Billboard pen LED Billboard tawh laihtheih nadingin MBPJ ten phalna apiak uh cihi. More: Malaysia, PJ SS3 sungah numei khat aguaktang in kileh kawikawi ZD Alui aomsa Static Billboard pen aki lakkhiat laitak, vangik dopna Crane ii akhutbom pen kitan in Billboard pen akiasuk hi cin gencianna nei uhhi. Hih Billboard kicipna hangin khuasung mipi te alim abaai omlo, Public Property zong asia omlo hi. Nitaklam 5pm hunin akicimsuk Billboard teng ki hemkhia khin hi cin Mohd Azizi in genkhia hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- USA gam leh naupang kepbitna Nu Sung ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW USA gam leh naupang kepbitna Nu Sung posted on 29 April 2020 at 8:56 pm Lomkholna: Article , Family USA gam leh naupang kepbitna (United States of America and Child Protection) Nu Sung 1. Thu Kong Honna Pasian lam honsakna tawh 2010-2012 kum sung ka vei leh uk mahmah ahi, Social Work, sin thei dingin USA ka tung hi. Sangkah sung USA-Zomi gambel innkuante leh a tate uh tawh kisai, adiak in pilsinna tawh ki sai thukanna (research) bawlin Zomi nu-le-pa, sangnaupangte leh mikang lai ahilh siasiamah pawlkhat tawh holimna ka nei hi. Tua thukanna (research) pan ka muhkhiat khat in, nu-le-pa leh tate ki kaal ah khang ki lamdanna (generation gap) om hi, cih ki mu khia hi. Kum hong sawt toto leh tua khang ki lamdanna hong lian semsem ding hi, cih thukanna pan ki mu thei hi. Tua hi a, khang ki lamdanna a piangsak thu tampi lak panin thukhat ahi naupangte pattahna leh naupang tawh kisai thukhunte tawm hong gelh ing. 2. USA gam leh naupang kepbitna (USA and Child Protection) A khangto sa gam (Developed Countries), a diakin USA gammi ten numeite leh naupangte thupi bawl mahmah uh hi. Kician takin numei le naupang tawh kisai thukhun kipte nei uh a, tuate tawh numei leh naupangte thuneihna kembit uh hi. Ahi zongin, khantohna lam a manawh gam tampi lakah (Developing Countries) Myanmar gam bangah, numei le naupangte thuneihnathukhunkipte ki thupi sim khol in ki thei mel lo banah theih dingin zong ki tuat lo kha hi. Ahang tuamtuam tawh, Myanmar gam panin USA ah gambel in i om ciang, neek leh dawn, silh le teen, leh gamtat luhek zia te, i omna mun tawh ki zui-in kipuahphat ding tampi om hi. I omna state le gammi te thukhun, adiak in kikhelna tampite sungpan naupang tawh kisai thukhunte zuih zia ding kikum khawm ni. 3. USA ah Federal le State Level aa Thukhun (Child Protection Law) 1974 kumin USA kumpi federal law Child Abuse Prevention and Treatment Act, thukhun khat bawl hi. Tua federal law siksan in USA gamah state khem peuhin amau state tawh kituak in, Child Abuse Law, bawlciat hi. State khat leh khat i thukhun pen tawmta ki lamdanna nei ciat hi. Tua a ki lamdante lakah, tate ciang tawh sat-a thuhilhna (coporal punishment) a zui le zui lo state, ci-in kikhen hi. Tua ahih manin, i teenna state thukhunte theih ding le zuih ding kisam pha mahmah hi. Tua bang thukhunte kip lua mahmah ahih manin, sang inn khempeuh ah nai 24 sung kithuzak theihna nading (24 hours hotline report) phone numbat te tate tungah kihilh tangtang uh hi. Nu-le-pa ten naupangte thu a hilh ciangin ciang tawh nong sat leh palik te sam ninghong mansak ning, ci-in taten nu-le-pa te tona in nei uh a, tua bangin amau le amau kidal thei uh hi. Nu-le-pa tampiten naupang tawh kisai thukhunte telcian lo ahih manun lauthawng gawp in, tate thu a hilh ngam nawn Zomi sungah ki om hi. Bek tham loin, naupang tawh kisai thukhunte i telcian lohna hangin, tate tungah child abuse law, palsat zah dongin tate thu a hilh ngekngek nu-le-pa zong Zomi sungah ki om hi. Tua banah, thukhunte i telcianloh manin innkuan khat kim lai, zumkong mangkong a ki tun na ngawn Zomi USA innkuan sungah ki om mawk hi. 4. Naupang pattahzia le thukhun theihlohna hang aa ki tuak thei buaina (Khang Ki Lamdanna Generation Gap) Gamthumna, USA ah i khuasakzia in, nu-le-pa leh tate ki kaal ah khang kilamdanna (generation gap) nakpi takin piang sak hi. Nu-le-pa ten pau le ham a siamloh manun zum vai le zing vai tuamtuam ah a tate uh muang uh hi. Tate in nu-le-pa makaih in thulela vaanpih ahih manun, nu-le-pa ten tate tungah thu ngam nawnlothu nei zo nawn lo mai uh hi. Tate zahtak in lau bawl ta ahih manun innkuan sungah kithuhilhna om nawn lo hi. USA khuasakzia pen tate adingin zuihnopzuih baih mah ta se leh, nu-le-pa ten bel zui zo bek loin, nuam sa lo mai uh hi. Tua hangin, khang kikhaatna hong lian semsem a, a lung hih mawh huai mahmah khat hong suak mai hi. 5. Seppah ding pawlkhat (Practical Steps) A tunga i gensa mah bangin, khang kilamdanna hangin zumkong mangkong i tung khin a, a dah huai din mun i tung ngei zo a, i tungtung kha lai ding hi, cih ka ngaih sut ciang ka dip ngek na mahmah hi. Hi bang siatna le cikzethuaina pan i suahtak theih nadingin lampi dang om lo a, Zomi khangthakte pantah leh kimakaihna hong kul pelmawh hi. Tua ahih leh I. Nu le Pa te aw! Ih omna state in a neih naupang kepnahuutna (Child Protection) thukhunte kan ni. I theih nadingin hanciam ni. Zui pah ni. (gtn. Laibu simna, youtube pan etna leh a theisate dotna etc.) Tate a makaih zo dingin Pasian in hong muang hi. Muan tak ni. Tate thupha piak ding manggilh kei ni. State thukhun tawh kituak in hilh in lamlak den ni. II. Zomi Makai khempeuh Aw! I mipi te in naupang tawh kisai thukhunte a theih nading un hanciam ni. Thusinsakna, laigelh a hawmkhiatna cihte tawh panpih ni. Pawlsungminam sungah tuailai khangnoten nu-le-pa zahtak siam a, innkuan cidam i suah nadingin lampi tuamtuam tawh hanciam ni. 6. Thukhupna I Zo ngeina a hoihte leh tapidaw ngeinate kem siam in, USA ngeina hoihte zong sin in zangkhia pah ni. Khangnote pantah siam in, Zomi mipil tampi a khansuah dingin itna tawh hong hanthawn nuam ing, Lungdam. (Ki kum toto lai ni.) Naupang khat a neu lai in lampi maan tawnsak lecin a teek dongin lampial nawn lo ding hi (Paunak 22:6). Biak Sung (Nu Sung) UNICEF, Myanmar, Child Protection Officer Source: FindLaw Kirst-Ashman, K. K. (2010). Introduction to Social Work and Social Welfare: Critical Thinking Perspectives. Belmont, CA: Thomson BrooksCole. "url": " "depth": 0 --- A theihhuai Nattun natna (Influenza, Flu, Tot-kuae) Dr. Thangboi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW A theihhuai Nattun natna (Influenza, Flu, Tot-kuae) Dr. Thangboi posted on 12 August 2015 at 12:22 pm Lomkholna: Article , Health A theihhuai Nattun natna (Influenza, Flu, Tot-kuae) Dr. Thangboi Swine flu leh Bird flu te ei aa ding in a lauhuai takpi mah hiam? A beisa kum 2003 pan 2008 sung leitung mun tuamtuam (a tamzaw Asia sunga gam tuam tuam) ah Bird fluak nat-tun natna hangin mi 300 kim bangin sihlawh in, ak tampi leh sum leh pai tampi kisuplawh hi. A beisa ni 3 khawnga hong kipan khia Swine fluVok nat-tun natna hangin Mexico gamah tu ni (April 28, 2009) ciang, a si mi 149 hong pha ta hi. Tua bektham lo in USA, Canada, UK, Spain, New Zealand cih bang gam tuamtuam te ah zong tua Vok flunattun natna nei mi (mild cases) te mukhia ta uh hi. Flu koi pan hong piang? Mihing leh ganhing nam tuamtuam (tui vasa tuamtuam, ak, va tawt, vok, zawhngeu, ui, sahang, etc.) te tungah flu (ei pau in Nat-tun, kawl pau in Tot-kuae) ih cih pen virus nam khat a hi Influenza virus Type A hangin a kingah natna a hihi. Hih lungno (virus) pen a diakin Vasa namte neih tawntung virus nam khat hi in, vatawt leh tuivasa pawl khat te bangin amau pumpi sungah virus a neih uh hang bangmah natna thuak lo in, a mau lengleng paipai na lam dungdung ah virus ki zelsak mang uh hi. Flu virus pen a mau sunga om Haemagglutinin (HA) leh Neuraminidase (NA) kici RNA segment nam nih tungtawn in a tuam (sub-species) in kikhento lai hi. Tu ciangciang HA nam 16 leh NA nam 9 kimu khia khin ta a, tua HA leh NA tegel a ut bangun kithuah in virus nam tuam tuam hong piang thei hi (Gtn: H1N1, H2N2, H3N2, H5N1, ., H16N1, H14N9, etc.). Vasa nam sungah hih HA leh NA tuamtuam a nei virus te mukhia khin ta uh hi. Flu han a sihna te A masa pen flu natna pen 1878 kum in Italy gam pan Edoardo Perroncito a kici pa in hong pholak khia hi. Tuni ciang flu natna leitungbup nasia takin kizel in sihna leh natna a piansak (pandemic) 3 vei phakhin ta hi. 1. Spanish flu (1918) H1N1 virus hang hi in, mi million 50 val bang si ding in ki-ummawh hi. World War I sangin mi tam sisak zaw hi. (tuni dong hih H1N1 virus mihing e lakah kizel lai hi). 2. Asian flu (1957) H2N2 virus hang hi in, mi million 2 bang si ding in kiummawh hi. Hih H2N2 virus pen kum 11 sung mihing te tungah natna a piansak khit cingin, hong mangthang hi. 3. Hong Kong flu (1968) H3N2 virus hangin, mi million 1 bangin sihlawh dingin kiummawh hi. Tuni dong hih H3N2 pen mihingte sungah omthei lai hi. Bang hangin Flu lau huai? Ei mihingte sungah kumsim in ih tuah den flu pen H1N1 leh H3H2 te hang hi pi pen hi. Hih virus nam 2 te pen mihing te sungah a kizelh zawh sawtta ahih manin, ih pumpi in tua natna dona (immunity) ih neikhin tek hi. Virus thak atam zawte in ak leh vasa tuamtuam aading khauh mahmah in, mihing ta dingin natna piangsak zo lo hi. Tu laitak in mipilte patauh mahmah na a hangin, ei mihing te sungah ih tuahkhak ngei nai loh, a khauh mahmah leh mihing leh mihing a kilawhbaih mahmah virus namthak (highly pathogenic) khat hong piankhiat khakding cih thu ahi hi. Hih bangin kilawh baih mahmah (rapid human to human transmission) leh a gu khauh mahmah virus thak khat hong piang zenzen leh kuamahn natna donatha (immunity) neinai lo ahih manin a thuakkha mi a tamzaw in sihlawh dingin kium hi. Virus natna ahih manin, natna dona zatui (vaccine Kar- kuae-say) bawl zawh nang a tawmpen kha 6 bang sawt ding ci uh hi. A poina khatah Virus thak hong pian mateng in Vaccine ki bawlkhol thei lo se hi. Tua ahih manin, Virus thak hong pian leh vaccine kibawl zawh ma sungteng pen mihingte ading bang mah zatui nek ding omlo ding hi. Virus a that zatui (anti viral) a om hangin mikim ading kingah zolo ding hi. A diakin gam khangto nailo a om, gam mi ta dingin lametna tawm diak cih ding ahihi. A masa pen flu pandemic hong pian lai (1918) in gam khatleh gamkhat kikawm nangin Tembaw (Ship) kizang lai hi. Tua hun lai nangawn in, hih flu natna leitungbup kha 2 sungin kizel zo ci uh hi. Leilu leh leitaw nikhat thu in kikawm theihna tuhun in, virus thak hong piang leh kilawh nang hong manlang mah mah lai ding hi. Gamlian tampi te in tuahun hongtun khakleh kigin kholh nang ci in Emergency preparedness plan neikim uh in, a gammi khempeuh a dingin zatui (anti viral) a kicing in a neih banuh ah, vaccine a manlang penin bawlzawhnang zong kigingsa in om uhhi. Tua virus thakin hongdo sungteng a, a site kaihkhop dingdan, a nungtalai tading bangcih panpih ding cihbang ciangdong in kikup kholhsa in neikhin phitphet uh hi. Bangciang Flu Virus thak hong piangding? Tuni dong kuamah in ahunding genkhol theilo uhhi. A hihhang tunai ahong piangthak Bird flu leh Swine flu te I et ciang a lauhuai virus thak hongpian nang hongnai semsem cihpen kimu theihi. Mihing leh mihing kilawh thei flu virus hong koici piang? Mihing ta dingin a lauhuai lo Bird flu pan, mihing khat leh khat a kilawh thei a lauhuai mahmah flu virus thak nam 2 in hong piang thei hi. 1. Flu Pandemic masa pen (1918) Bird flu virus pan in damdam in hong kikhel in (progressive adaptation, mutation), a tawpna ciang mihing leh mihing kilawh thei , a gu khauh mahmah flu virus hong suak hi ci in um uh hi. 2. A beisa pandemic 2 na leh 3 na (1957 1968) te pen mihing te tung hong tun theih nang birdak sunga om flu virus in Vokpi pumpi sungah hong kipuahpha in (reassortment) in, tua hong piangthak virus in mihing leh mihing a kilawh baih thei virus thak hong suaksak hi ci in kium hi. A lau huai pandemic flu virus hong pian nang bang teng kisam? Mihing ta ding a lauhuai flu virus hong suah theih nang thu 3 kisam hi. 1. Flu virus in a gu khuah mahmah ding kisam (highly pathogenic) 2. Tua flu virus pen kilawh baih mahmah ding (ability to transmit rapidly) 3. Mihing leh mihing kilawh zo ding (ability to transmit human to human) Tu laitak a hong lang flu virus te in number 1 leh 2 te cinzo ta hi. A thumna in hong cin ding bekin a kisam lai suak hi. Tedimpau Tedimlai cih kammal ziak-a apiang thusia lianpi Pu Zokhai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Tedimpau Tedimlai cih kammal ziak-a apiang thusia lianpi Pu Zokhai posted on 19 March 2022 at 2:43 pm Lomkholna: Article , Politics , Zokhai Tedimpau Tedimlai cih kammal ziak-a apiang thusia lianpi Pu Zokhai Kampau-thei khempeuh phial-in Zomi, Zomi,. ci phangphang saam hang-a, ahizong-in 1962 kum-a kipian hong kisaatnim dikdek khuaknimna lawhsia ziak-in paukam (language) hitaleh minam vaai hitaleh adam theilo guhnatna lianpi-in naakpi-in zungthuuk kha-a, zunglot pakding haksa mahmah dinmun-ah a catch 22 acihbang-in I-minam tangciak cip-hi. Tedim-tawh kizom kipawlna ahihkeileh mapanna khempeuh-ah Kawl Gamukte-hiam Vaai Gamukte-hiam kihtaakna ahihkeileh maai-etna ahihkeileh phalna ngahlohding launa-ziak khatpeuhpeuh hiambel theikhang Tiddim cih kammal nana zangh uh-a, Zopau-ah tuabang kammal limlim a-omlo ahihlam ngaihsut-in neilo-uh, bangciang siattutna omthei, bangciang lawh-thei cihte peuhmah muhkholhna anei ngiatlo kumpi naseem ulian neih sunsunte khutma kimu-hi. Zomi cihcih kawm-in thankiik-in saaipi khaguh balkhap sawm acih thuciin bang-in Zomi-pen Chin State buppi ahuam lungsim-tawh penglam pawlkhat-in ma hongpanpih leuleu-a, tua lungsim ziak-in Tedim Lai SiangthoLabu-pen Zomi cihding hilo, Zomi cih-in Laimi, Laizo ahuam ahihteh Tedim ci-ni cih-tawh Tedim cihding kipsak uh-a, Tiddim ci sese laai uhhi, bangzah-in laainat-huai cih anuai-ah ensuk in: Kumpi naseem ahihkeileh Kawlgam Kiukna sung-a ulian lubawk neihsunte-in, Zomi cihteh Chin cihna hi-a, Tedim cihteh Tedim Khuapiseh leh Tonzaang Khuapiseh-a pau kitheithei khempeuh hihang-a, Zo, Siyang, Teizaang, Dim hihang cise-hi. Tua ahihman-in Zopau, Zolai hilo Tedimpau, Tedimlai ci uhhi. Hih guú (poison)-pen damdam-in hong kizelh-a, Ei haam-pen Tedimpau hi-sih Siyangkam sese Tedimpau hi-ngawl cih lungsim-in tua Tedim hong vaatsuk ahihman-in Lai Siangtho leh Labu-pen Siyangkam leh Zohaam-tawh hong kikheenkhia ahihi. ZolaiZopau ci lo-in Tedim ci-a hongki pattahkhial man-in hihbang dinmun hileh Keupau-belpen Tedimpau hi o-ing Ko paubel Tedimpau hikeivaak Ko paubel Tedimpau hikiak Cihte nangawn-in hong zomzom theiding dinmun ahihi. Kigawmna (Unity)-pen athu-in agengen-uh hang-in Tedimpaulai aci valval denkeeite-pen kikhenna (division) lungsim asungtawng-ah nungta-a ahong po-khia cihna ahihi. Zopau, Zolai (kei mimal khiatna-ah) cihciang-in Tedimpau cihna hilo-in, Zomi namkee tuamtuamte awsuah kidang diimdiamteng ahuamkhawm paukam (language) ahihi. Pawlkhatte-in paukam cih lamdang sakha dinghi. Kampau-pen speaking (a word that comes out of your mouth) cihna ahihteh language-pen literature lamsang-a apiicing kammal ding-in paukam hong pulaak ka-hihi. Khangthak khempeuh-in I pate khialhna pumgup lo-in (langpang-a paampaihding cihna hilo), paukam leh lai lamsang I concept themcik khangkhaan hamtangding hihang. A-uut teng-in Tedimpau acici zong-in nang leh kei-in Zopau, Zolai, Zomi, Zogam mah ci ngiatngiatding hihang. Tua nangawn eite khang-ah mual I-suahdingsuahlohding kigen thei naailo-hi. Tedim lam-ah I-ki naak-hei luatleh ahihkeileh tua lam-ah I-kipiak luatleh veenglehpaam nangawn I-khahsuah (khitsa) khahsuah thuahthuah laaiding hihang. Zomi, Zogam, Zolai, Zola, Zolaam, Zongeina alaamsaang ding leh atawisaang ding-in I pate kipan naailo, kipan ngei loding-hi. Nang leh Kei diangkhia-in eima khe tung-ah dingkip-in, mah sah lah khedap suahkhia-in, Postmodernism khedap bulh-in naakpi thasaanding hihang. Aphual-ah, amun-ah hongpaiciah pahve. cihcihte khuak neilote kampau ahihi. Nang na omnana-pen Zomi phungvuh nading aphual hipah-hi. Israel te-in aminam apuah hun-in gamdang vive-ah om uh-a, siamsinna naakpi-in sin-uh, pil-uh, siam-uh, hau-uh, tua takteh agam-uh a-etzia muiibunh thei-hi. Ciakciakbek kei-ni, ein I-lap keileh tate siamsinna lam-ah tawsawn ni. I-tawsawn tantan nangawn deihciang hongtung zolo khalaai dinghi. Zolai, Zopau, Zola, Zongeina theisak ni. Hilhni. Atheizawte hilhsak ni. Ei tapkual-a I-phawk kiukiau-khawng Zongeina avekpi sa pahpah kei-ni. I zaak ngeilohte Zomi-tawh akisailo sa pahpah kei-ni. Nang leh kei-in I ngeina I-kep lohsa-in kuan hong kepsak laaizang loding-hi. Haanciam gamgam-a I-tawsawn nangawn hong nengniam-nuam aphualphual-ah omlaai dinghi. Zomi it mahteh, minam khual mahteh. Gahkhia sak in. It ing cihcih sang-in na itna-pen Zopau, Zolai, Zola, Zongeina phungvuhna-tawh lak in. It mahmah-ing, ahizong-in Zolai, Zopau, Zola thupi sakeng, cih tepawl khuakcinglo, mibanglo (abnormal) mite zialehtong ahihi. Nang leh kei peuhmah tuabang hilo hihang acidam kingkeng, athahaat gipgep, apil sitset vive hihang. Kua kihta laaizongding I-hihiam? Thahaat inla, haangsan in. Zomi-aw! Zomi Pasian Thupha! "url": " commehteh-mehgahte-leh-nang-cidamna-a", "depth": 1 --- Mehteh mehgahte leh nang cidamna (A) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Mehteh mehgahte leh nang cidamna (A) posted on 2 March 2015 at 10:16 pm Lomkholna: Article, Health Mehteh mehgahte leh nang cidamna (A) (1) Mehthuk Pumpi sung cancer natna a pianlohna ding in a dal antioxidant ahi licopene tampi kihel ahihmanin nawi cancer le naubu cancer te a pianna ding kiamsaktuam hi. Mehthuk nekna hangin nivang sung aaom UV khuavak zang (rays) ten i vun a sukkhakloh nading in dal hi. Tua bekthamloh poly phenol in sisan pengsak in lungtang cidamna hoihsak hi. A hoihpenin ankamlumpakgawbipak (cauliflower) tawh huankhawm leng mehthuk i thahoih pente kingah hi. (2) Kawlkai Kawlkai ah cancer natna a dal antioxidant dat tampitak kihel hi. Tua bekthamloh in thaza ahi carbohydrate, a zangdat (fiber), vitamins tuamtuam, manganese, potassium cih datte zong kihel aa pumpi cidamna hoihsak mahmah hi. Dr Nang Khan Lian (Zingsol) Ref: Aroyam Health Magazine Reader Interactions Previous: Khuak a nosuah det na ding Nk Khanno Next: Awle khat ii khitui Peter Suumpi Comment piaknop aomleh. 2015 Zolai khanggui Timeline 11:22:00 PM Zolai hong piankhiatna leh a khantohzia (Timeline version) - Zomite I Lai Neih Masakna pen, khangluite genna ah Zomite in nidang hun sawtpi lai pekin, lai kinei ngei khin hi ci-in gen uhhi1 2ua lai pen savun tungah a kigelh hi aa, Go Cin in tua savunlai nisa ah a pho leh ui-in na neksak hi1 2ua aa kipan, Zomite in lai a kinei nawnlo hi ci-in gen uhhi. - 1900 kum masiah, lai kigelhna savun (Savunlai), ui-in a neksak khit, lai I neih nawnloh aa kipan suangpeek tung leh singpeek tung cihte ah lim suai tawm aa, lai bangin na zangh uhhi1 2ih limsuiah lai pen, mualsuang gelhna-in na kizangh phadiak ahihi1 2tn1 2abenna, samanna, sagawhna, laamsaaina cih bang dan, a tuamtuamte ciaptehna leh lakna dingin na lim zat uhhi. - 1902 kum aa Pu Pau Cin Hau tungtawnin, Zotuallai hong piangkhia hi1 2ai hong piankhiatna pa, Laipian pa ci-in kithei leh kiciamteh pah hi. - 1904 kumcin, George A1 2rierson (Linguist Survery of India) in, Zopau lam kankhiatna India aa Manipur base in nei ngei-in kithei hi. - December 1911 kumin Rev1 21 2heratt (Laisiangtho thuvanpi) pen Rangoon (Yangon) pan Chin Hills ah tung ahihi1 2hin Hills ah Sub-division thum; Tedim, Falam leh Hakha omin Tedim khawk pen zai penpen hi1 2uahunin kumpi uliante ngaihsut leh upmawhna ah Tedim khawk sung panin tangkam (Lingua Franca) hong piang dingin lamen uh hi1 2uahangin, J1 21 2ope in 1913 kumin, Matthai bu teikhiat zawh ding kipan pah ahihi. - 1912 kumin, Cope Topa I cih Rev1 2r1 2oseph Herbert Cope in, Sizang awsuah tawh Zolai hong bawlsak hi. - 1912 kumin Royal Asiatic Society cih kipawlna khat kiphuan aa Royal Family mah in sum leh pai (patron) sem pah hi. 1904 kum aa kampau leh lai lam "Linguistic Survey of India" kici laibu khat a gelh Dr1 21 2ierson in makaipi sem ahihi1 2ih kipawlna panin laibu leh thukizaknate hawmzel uh aa, July 1912 kum aa abawl uh laibu sung pan laimai 647-663 kikal tengah, Zopau pen Zolai in gelhkhiatciang, Kawllai Alphabet sangin Roman Alphat zat ding kilawmzaw hi cih thu guang (gelh) uhhi. - A kumkik 1913 ciang, awsuah awkaih kibanglo Zomite sungah zattanglai ding bawlna leh kipsakna kinei thei hi. - 1913 kumin, Cope Topa in, "Tual lai sintawmna bu" cih laibu khat hong bawlsakin, Zolai akigelh ciilna a masapen ahihi. (Hih hun lai-in, Mangtual lai kici hi. ) (2013 kumciang, Zolai kum 100 cing ahihi. 2002 kumciang, Zotuallai pen kum 100 cing ahihi. ) - 1914 kumin, Zolai Sizang awsuahawkaihin, la dawng 24 apha laibu khat Cope Topa in hong bawlsakin, tua pen Zomite ii neih masak penpen laibu ahihi1 2ope Topa in Biakna lam (Laisiangtho leh labu tampi) leh Leitung lam (Gamlei thuGeography, Nate' thuScience, Gannan buMathamatics) thu aa kipan, laisimbu adang tuamtuam hong bawlsak hi. - 1914 kumin, Cope Topa in laibu hong bawlsakin, a sung aa Doxology pen, a nuai aa bang ahihi1 2hupha khempiu hawng pia Topa, letung mihing a minphat ta, Vantung mi zong in Topapi, Jesu, Khangsiangtho minpha hi. - 1915 kumin, Cope Topa ii bawl; Matthew Laisiangtho 4:1-3 "Atuciangin, a doi mangpa je-et ding in, a Khangshiangtho in Jesu gamlak ah, a pai pi hi1 2i sawmli le' zan sawmli an ngawl aa a nungciangin, a gil hawng kiel hi1 2 je-et pa in, hawng nai aa, Nang ma in Pashian Tapa n' hi le' hi shuang thu kho mun n' shuawk sak in a cihi. " - 1915 kumin, Matthew (Mate) Lasiangtho Zolai tawh hong gelh sak hi. - 1918 kumciang, La dawng 100 Zolai tawh hong gelh sak leuleu hi. - 1919 kum, Kaukha (October kha) in, Zolai tawh laihawm masak pen, "Tedim thu kizaakna lai (The Chin Hills News) ci-in, hong hawmkhia hi1 2adras khuapi, India pekpah khensakin Tedim, Zogam ah a hawm ahihi1 2ditor pen Cope Topa mahin sem pah hi1 2ua laihawm pen Madra, India ah kikhen ahihi1 2ua laihawmna sungah, Tedim lai a thei kitampen ahih man in, Tedim lai kigelh ahihi ci-in kigelh hi. (laimal leh laigualte puahphat): Tedim awsuahawkaih, a thei kitam pen ahih man in, Zolai Tedim awsuahawkaih zui in kigelh ahihi. " ci-in, kigelh hi. - Mikang kummpite leh Christian biakna makaite in, Chin Hills ah Kawllai zatna tawm hu-ngaihin hong en phawt uhhi. 1920-1921 kum pawlciangin, Educational Conference Thukimna ci-in Falam khua ah khawmpi khat kinei hi1 2ua laipan, Roman Alphabet bang tawh Zolai phungvuh ding khentatna om ahihi. 1923 October 23 ni ciangin, Chin Education Conference cih khat, Maymyo (Pyin Oo Lwin) ah om leuleu hi1 2ua panin Zolai tawh sanglai simbu bawl ding thukimna hong om thei ahihi. - 1923 kumciangin, Zola dawng 283 hong gelhkhia leuleu hi. - 1923 kumin, cope Topa ii gelh Lungdamna Laisiangtho hong gelh khiat sak hi1 2awhang Laisiangtho 3:22,28 "22: Tu a nungciangin, Zheishu in a nungzhui thu tawh, Zhuda gam ah pai uh leh tua san tak ah, a mau thu tawh a omkhawm a tui shung ah a phum uhhi. 28: Keimah in, Khazhih kah hih kei hi, Khazhih mai ah hong pai sak pa kah hi, ken ka cihi. " - 1923 kum Theino sihkha (November kha)ciang, Cope Topa in, Zolai a bawlna hangin, kumpi in "Kaisar I Hind (KIH)" cih pahtawina pia-in, Ngun Medal ngah hi. (Kaisar cih pen German pau hi-in, Ukpi acihna ahihi1 2indi leh Urdu pau tawh akhiatna-in "India gam ukpi" cihna ahihi1 2ih pen, England kumpi ukna India gam sung aa, na thupi semte pahtawina-in a kipia ahihi. ) - 1923 October 23 ni ciangin, Chin Education Conference cih khat, Maymyo (Pyin Oo Lwin) ah om leuleu hi. (1920-1921 lai-in Falam ah om ngei khin hi. ) Tua panin Zolai tawh sanglai simbu bawl ding thukimna hong om thei ahihi. - 1924 kumciang, Tanbul sang (Primary school) khempeuhah Zolai tawh sinsak ding, thukimna om hi. (Hih kum panin, Kawllai ii hong deepna pan Zolai hoihtak in lim sinkik ding, ki-ngaihsunin, thupi kisa tek hi. - 1925 kumciangin, Education Conference nih vei a kibawlsate tungtawnin, Rev1 2ope pen kumpite in Honorary Inspector of Schools za pia uh aa, a ma bawlsa laibute Chin HIlls sangte ah hong kizangh hi1 2ua kipanin, Zolai pen Roman Alphabet in hong kip paisuak ahihi. - 1925 kum mahin L1 21 2aylor a cih, Zomilo namdang khat in A practical handbook of chin Languages (Siyin dialect) cih khat bawl ngei-in kithei hi. - 1926 kumin, laihilh siate sin dingin, Leitung thu leh Gamlei thu (Geography) thu Zolai-in hong gelhkhiat sak hi. - 1927 kumciangin, 1926 kum aa laibu abawlsa pen, hong puahphakik hi. - 1931 kumciang zongh, 1926 aa laibu 1927 in a phuahphat pen hong bawlpha lai hi. - 1931 kum mahin, Pu Thang Cin Kham (Tonzang), Pu Cin Kho Gin (Ngennung), Pu Pau Za Dong (Lailui) leh Pu Sian Kho Cin (Mualbeem) thu in Zotuallai na puahpha uhhi. -1. 1. kumin, siktawlai ah Zotuallai a ki-ngah nadingin, Pu Thang Cin Kham (Tonzang), Pu Cin Kho Gin (Ngennung), Pu Pau Za Dong (Lailui) leh Pu Sian Kho Cin (Mualbeem) thu Tongoo khua ah na pai uhin, hong ki-ngah sak thei uhhi. - 1931 kumin, British and Foreign Bible Society (kipawlna) pan, Zotuallai tawh, Mualtung thuhilhna (Mathew Laisiangtho alian 5 na sung) na khenkhia uh aa, dal 500 pha hi. - Zotuallai, laimal (Alphabetic Script) tawh kisimin, hong ki-ngah to aa laimal 57 hong pha hi1 2ua mal 57 sung pan, 37 te, Lailung (Consonants leh Vowels) hi-in, adang mal 20 te, Dawngtawi (Tone marks) ahihi. - 1932 kumciang, Laisiangtho thuciamthak bup, Zolai tawh simtheih dingin, hong bawlkhia hi. - 1932-1977 kikal, laisiangtho puahphatna omloin kizangh toto ahihi. - 1935 kum Tangkha (June kha) ni 10 ni-in, Zolai hangin, Colgate University pan, Zolai hong bawlsak Cope Topa in Honorary Degree Doctor of Divinity (D1 2) ngah hi. - 1937 kum, India leh Burma (Myanmar) a kikhenciangin Zomite a tamzaw Burma (Myanmar) lamah kiom aa, atawmzaw deuh India gamah, Manipur leh Mizogam sungah atam diakin kiom ahihi. - 1939 kum, Tonzang khua, Zogam ah Roman Catholic Mission kipan dingin, ukpi Pu Pum Za Mang thukimna tawh Roman Catholic in sang hong hi. - 1954 October 2 in, Tedim khuapi, Zogam ah Eugenie Jane Andrina Henderson (Wife of George Meier) pen nipi li sung taam hi1 2 mah pen, School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London ah Professor of Phonetics hi-in, Tedim a om khak sung Zopau na lim kan mahmah hi1 2iapi vul Za Thang leh Rev1 21 2au Go (Sukte) tawh na kithuah uhhi1 2u Hau Za Lian tung panin zongh Zopau Teizang awsuahawkaih na dong man ahihi1 2iapi Vul Za Thang ii gelh "Dahpa thu (A Dahpa Story)" leh Rev1 21 2au Go (Sukte) ii gelh "Khua Lei (The Chin story of the origin of the Great Bear)" cih laibu nih bulphuh-in, "Tiddim Chin a Descriptive Analysis of Two Texts" a kici laibu khat 1965 kumin na bawlkhiat hi. - Japan gal khitciangin Tedim khawk leh Zogam sung thu kizak theihna khatpen, Tedim pan aa kibawl "Thu kituahna" lai kici aa, pawlpi thu lam ah pen Tiddim Baptist Association TBA pan "Lungvakna" lai ahihi. 1961-63 sung Yangon pan Pa S1 2 Khual Za Kham leh Pa G1 21 2in Do Lian thu in a khet uh nipi kalsim thukizakna lai "Zomi Tangko" hi aa, Myanmar sung leh India gam Manipur, Mizogam dong ah kikhawm ahihi1 2ipi sung lai tawh nasepnate pen, Zozumpi dangte leh biakna kipawlna lian dang tuamtuamte pan hi masaloin, Yangon aa pilna sin Zomi sangnaupangte ii bawl "Hill Chin Students' Union Annual Magazine" cihleh "Zomi Zingsol, Zomi Magazine" kicite pan hizaw ahihi. - 1964 kumin Dr1 2arrison, (Linguistic Consultant, BFBS) London ah a sem kimlai tawlkhat sung North East India kampau thu a kan dingin Linguistic Adviser, Bible Society of India Ceylon min tawh Shillong ah tung hi1 2ev1 2arrison in "A Report on Bible Translation in North East India kici a gelhna sungah Tedim pau (Zopau- hih mun ah Tedim pau ci-in zangh hi. ) Manipur gamah a kizangh kampau khat hi cih thu laimai 60 na ah a gelh hi. - 1965 kumin, Eugenie Jane Andrina Henderson (Wife of George Meier), School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London ah Professor of Phonetics in, "Tiddim Chin a Descriptive Analysis of Two Texts" a kici laibu khat English (MikangMang) lai tawh na bawlkhiat hi. - Kum 1792 hun pekin gam a tuamtuam panin company a tuamtuamte kipawl khawmin sumzuak sumlei vaii a sep khopna pan New York Stock Exchange akipan Bank lianpipi om cingtengin Finacial District akici liang ahihi. Sen sai zong tam peuhmah a, Yangon khuasung dan mah hi pahin a inn mai tengah van phah ziahzuah uhhi. Taih sang vive kilam ahih manin ih tung lam en leng vandum tawm khat kimu kiukiau thei bek hi. Tua papa pen Myanmar panin China, Shaanxi Province zuanin aciahlam in akiman ahihi. Thunei te genkhiatna ah hihpa pen Shaanxi Province aom Xianyang Airport panin akiman hi a, agil sungah vankham Cocaine honkhat kimukhia cihi. Tua Cocaine tepen akam panin a valhsuk Swallow cimawk hi. Vankham khempeuh akigawm in agihna 330 grams pha a, Plastic tawh tuamsawn in akam panin avalhsuk ahihi. Hih Chinese papen Guangdong Province sungah Seafood zuakin akivak khat ahihi. Asum zonna alemmelloh laitak in, alawmte khatin Myanmar gamsung ah ahawhding in zol ahih manin, Myanmar gamsung ah azinkhia ahihi. Myanmar gampan in aciahding ciangin vankham puakding in kicial a, Chinese Yuan 10,000 (US1500) ngahding himawk ahih manin, tua Cocaine te avekin akam panin avalhsuk ahihi. Ahi zongin Xianyang Police ten hihpa in agil sungah vankham puading cih zaksimna nei, Tip-off ngah ahih manin, vanleng tungpan in akumphet in namanpah uhhi. Agil sungah apuak vankham Cocaine tepen agihna akigawm in 330 grams hi a, zatang bekbek akigawm in tang 57 ahihi. More: Myanmar Academy a ngahngei Actor khat vankham tawh kiman Abeisa kha 4 hunlai inzong Xianyang aom Police ten hihbangdan in gilsung ah vankham apuakhat hih Xianyang Airport mahpan in kimanngei hi. Tuapa ii genkhiatna ah akam panin avalhsuk Cocaine pen akigawm in 380 grams gik ci a, avekin avalhsuk nadingin ahun nai 7 leh alang sungbang hunbei ciliang hi. "url": " "depth": 0 --- A Pa hun 20 tawh alei numeino ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW A Pa hun 20 tawh alei numeino posted on 16 July 2024 at 9:59 pm Lomkholna: Article , DavidTuang A Pa hun 20 tawh alei numeino Hun khat lai-in nupa kopkhat in tanu meino khat nei uh a, a pa in company khat ah nasem in lup hun lo buang inn ah tam om ngeilo hi. A zi leh a tanu tawh a kikholh khop hun uh tawm mahmah ahih manin a tanu in a pa ompihna kikholh pihna cihte lunggulh mahmah hi. A lawm a gualte ahih leh a nu leh pa tawh vakkhawm hialhial, kimawlna paakhuan (park) khawng ah paikhawm a muh ciang eng mahmah hi. Nikhat, a pa kiangah Pa aw nang na nasepna-ah naikhat bangzah ngah na hi hiam ci-in hong donga, a pa in naikhat 20 ngah ing ci-in dawngkik hi. Tua ni-a kipan amah zong sum khol hong kipanin, inn kiim inn kiang khawngah mi sum tang kiatsak nengneng peuh kai khawm in, tua leh a nu leh a paten moh man dingin pek khat pek nih a piakte uh hong khol thiamthiam a, nitak a lup ding ciangin tua a sum muh sunsun te gawm khawm in hong sim zel hi. Ni tampitak tua danin hong kaihkhop khit ciangin 20 hong cing ta ahih manin, a zingsang thawh ding bang ngaklah lua kisa-in zan bang ihmu theilo liang hi. Zingsang a thawh phetin a pa kiangah tai pah vingveng a, pa aw, na nasepna-ah naikhat 20 ngah na hih leh ken tuni na hun naikhat 20 tawh kong lei ding hi, na hun hong kileisak in la, kei tawh hong kimawl khawm in kei tawh hunnuam hong zangh khawm in, ci-in agen tak ciangin a pa lungsim sukha lua mahmah ahih manin a pa in zong a tanu ngawngkawi in hong kapziahziah hi. Tua ni-a kipanin a pa in a zi leh a tanu ading hun hong khenin a tanu in a eng mahmah a lawm a gualte mah bangin a innkuan un vakkhawm kimawlkhawm in hun nuam hong zangh khawm liailiai thei ta uh hi. Hih taangthu tungtawnin paten i ngaihsut ding thu pawlkhat om hi. Pate pen inn sung lutang ihih mah bangin innkuan adingin i sepbawl loh phamawh, i hahkat loh hong phamawh ahih manin pate dinmun zong bel baih hetlo hi. I nasep a tuam, i innkuan (zi leh ta) leh a langlang i huhet nopna tawh hong hilai mawk ahih manin i vangik mahmah hi. Ahi zongin nasep hanciam lua hahkat lua lianga i tate hun ipiak zawh vetloh zong na hoih hetlo zel hi. Pate in zi leh tate tawh hun nuam zat khop ding lem gige napi-in zi leh tate hun nuam i zatpih kei leh ei pate khialhna mah hong hizel ding hi. I tate pen a neulai un nu leh pa tawh hun tampipi laak khop ding lunggulh uh a, nu leh pate mah tawh kikhawlkhawl nuam uh hi. Tawm hong gol khin le uh nu leh pa tawh kikholh ding khawng a neu lai zahun hong lunngulh nawn khollo thei ding uh ahih manin ei tawh a kikholh nop lai un hun nuam zatpih zel ni a ci nuam ihi hi. Tate a neu lai un hun nuam zatkhoppih ngei mello a, i koihcip mawk leh ei tawh omkhop kikholhkhop sese loh hang phamawh hongsak nawnloh hun uh hong tung dinga tua hun ciangin ei nu leh pate mahin khasia-in i khitui hongluang ding hi. Hibang i ki gen ciangin, nasep khawl lawh liang, nasep kipelh liang leh vai khatpeuh kipelh liangin tate tawh kikhawl ni, hun la khawm ni, aci ihi kei-a, i buai kawmkawm, i manlah kawmkawm mahin tate ading hun khen dan siam ni, cih a kigenphawksak nuam ihizaw hi.(Kei zong ka kisinsin thukhat hi). "url": " "depth": 1 --- USA, Georgia ah kum 4 aphapan Zomi naupangno Lun Thang (Lun Nuam) mawtaw in taihlum ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW USA, Georgia ah kum 4 aphapan Zomi naupangno Lun Thang (Lun Nuam) mawtaw in taihlum posted on 19 October 2017 at 7:40 am Lomkholna: Dahpihna , News , Sawltak , USA , Zomi USA, Georgia ah kum 4 aphapan Zomi naupangno Lun Thang (Lun Nuam) mawtaw in taihlum USA, Georgia State sungah naupangno kum 4 aphapan khat mawtaw in Wednesday zingsanglam in taihlum cih Fox News pan kiza hi. Tua naupangno ii aminpen Lun Thang kici hi. Georgia, DeKalb County sung aom Clarkston City ah thupiang hi a, ataihkha mawtaw pen taisuak kicihi. Indian Creek Elementary School ii alanglam aom North Indian Creek Drive, 700 Block ah mawtaw khatin ataihlum ahihi. DeKalb Police te genkhiatna ah Lun Thang pen Indian Creek Elementary School ah sang akah hi a, Pre-K Student khat cihi. Lun Thang ii innkuanpih te genkhiatna ah Lun Thang ii meltheih Aunt khatin Lun Thang leh asanggam kum 6 khat sanginn ah akhading in apaipih cihi. Wednesday zingsanglam 6:45am hunpawl in Crosswalk ah lamzikpi akanlaitak mawtaw khatin Lun Thang pen ataihkha ahihi. Police te genna ah mawtaw in ataihkhak ciangin Lun Thang pen huihlak ah kilonto in, akiatsuk ciangin mawtawdang khattawh kinawkkha leuleu cihi. Tuaciang in Lun Thang pen amanlang in Hospital ah kipuakpah a, Critical Condition cihi. Lun Thang ii apa Zam Thang in agenkhiatna ah katanu pen mawtaw in anawkkhak ciangin kilawnkhia a, Pi 100 bang kilawnding hi cin genkhia hi. Apa Zam Thang in agenbehna ah atanu Lun Thang pen asanggamnu tawh khutkilensa in Crosswalk panin lamzikpi akantan uh cihi. Tualaitak in Northbound lamzuan in apai Sedan mawtaw khatin Lun Thang taihkha in, huihlak ah kilawnto a, akiatsuk ciangin Yellow PT Cruiser tungah tusuk cihi. Police te genkhiatna ah tua ataihkha mawtaw pen Lun Thang ataihkhak khitciangin amawtaw Control theilo in, tawmvei khawlpak cihi. Tuakhit ciangin tuaphual panin amawtaw hattak in taikhiasak vingveng hi. Mawtaw Driver papen ataihkhak naupangno zong a ending in kumkhialo in, ataisuak cihi. Ataihkha mawtaw pen Dark Color, Sedan Model aluite khat kici a, Toyota ahih keileh Honda khat hitheiding kici hi. Mawtaw pen amailam zong siatheiding a, amai Headlight zong kitamding kici hi. Lun Thang pen amanlang in Medics ten Egleston aom Childrens Healthcare of Atlanta ah puakpah uh himahleh, tuapan in anuntakna beiziau hi. Christ Mission Church panin Deacon Pau Kap in agenkhiatna ah hih Lun Thang te innkuan pen innkuansung nop asak mahmahding laitak uh hi a, ahi zongin tuzingsang thakhatthu in hihthu hongpiang hi. Anu pen kapthapai ahih manin, hihte innkuan adingin thungetsak kisam mahmah hi cin genkhia hi. More: US, Iowa State ah Pa Stephen Pau Suan Kim (Tonzang, Naulak) thautawh kikaplum Police ten hih mawtaw Driver papen amanlang in amathu in hongki ap nadingin tangkokhia uhhi. Khuasung mipi amukha tenzong amanlang in DeKalb County Police Department ah hong zasak un cin genkhia uhhi. Dahpihna lianpi tawh, Sawltak zomidaily Update: Hongnusia Lun Thang akici pen Fox News te ii suahsak dandan in hongki gelhkhia hi a, Zomi te theihna ah amin taktakpen Lun Nuam kici hi. ZAM Thupuak :: 16 Feb 20 (Zomi Nam Ni Malaysia) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW ZAM Thupuak :: 16 Feb 20 (Zomi Nam Ni Malaysia) posted on 15 February 2020 at 7:15 pm Lomkholna: Malaysia , News , Refugee , ZAM , Zomi Zomi Nam Ni ah laambang paak khawmni February 20 ni ZOMI NAM NI hi ih cihcih zingciang hong tungkik ding hi a Malaysia gamsung a om Zomi U leh nau ih vekpi in laambang paak khawm leng Lungdeih zatam libangcing ding ci-in ih Zomi National Day 2020 Committee mintawh pello nong kihel nangin kong zawn uhhi. Tukum Zomi Nam Ni ah zin mangpi dingin GZA pan I zahtak mahmah leh I muan mahmah khat ahi Rev. Dr. Do Suan Mung hi ding a, tua bek tham loin kawlgam pan hong zin lasiam Cingtom leh Zomi Idol Malaysia te in hong zaizaih zaih ding uh hi. MAPANG KHAWM IN A SEM KHAWM ZOMITE Zomi Nam Ni ading mimal hanciamna, khua kipawlna, Pawlpi ciatpan na vei nate uh nong lahkhiat manun lung dam kohna kong taangko uhhi. A kihel kha nailo na min, khua leh pawlpi min a om leh Zomi Nam Ni ciang Usher te kiang ah zong kipia theilai hi. Zomi a ding nabeina khempeuh Topan azah tampi hong dipsak henla, Zomite ading Pasian hauhna nang tungtawn pan in a zek ziahziah dingin sianin hong siam ta hen. SECURITY TAWH KISAI Hongtung ding Zomi namni ah security dingin palik leh Rela te leh Malaysia a om Zomi Khua Kipawlna tuamtuam pan makai te hi ding a, Buaina bawl Zu kham, kitawng, kilai a om leh palik ten tavuan hong lak sak pah dinghi. February 20 ni Zomi namni a hihmah bang in Kuala Lumpur sung a uk, palik thunei zumpite phalna tawh kibawl Zomi Nam Ni a hihman in buaina nabawl keinak leh nang a dingin bangmah lau huailo hi. Kumsim in khat leh khat I kikhual na tawh Security lam pen ei leh ei ci in I kimai sak hong tam lua mahmah ta ahih manin tukum pen a thu om bangin hoih takin kisem ding ahih manin I minam pawi a muak dingin hong pai mite a ding nop mahmah ding a, buaina piangsak sawm in hong pai te adingin hong nuam khollo thei ding hi. I minam pawi ahih mah bangin khat leh khat a et lawm thei pen in I muak siam I pahtawi siam dingin zong I kizawn phapha hi. I minam pawi ah I minam a pahtawi I hih ding thupi ding a, mite muhna ah a zahpih huai leh mindai sak I hih loh ding Zomi khempeuh I vaipuak lianpen ahi hi. PAHTAWINA: Zomi Cup football ah gualzawhna a ngah team te leh kimawl siam, a madawk deuh teng zong pahtawi na om ding hi. UNHCR ZUM PI AH APPOINTMENT LA TE KI SAMSAM TA HI NA PHONE LIM TAK LEN IN ZAM Zum pan in UNHCR ah appointment la in ih lai tinsak te Pawlkhat kisamsam om ta a hihman in ,a kisam pawlkhat te February ni10 khitlam ah UNHCR zum lam pai ding hi ta uh hi. Tua kawmkal ah Phone contact kingah lo zong om lailai I hihmanin I phone tawi te hoihtak kidawm in Phone hong lutleh len ciat ni. Hong kisap leh Kawlgam pan na tai na leh Gambeel mi na hih na kician tak in na gentheih ding ong kisam ding hi. Tua ban ah appointment na nget lai in na at thu tawh a kituak ahih hamtang ding zong hong kisam mahmah ding hi. Tua bang in hoih tak na gel siam theih kei leh a thei ding leh lam hong lak thei ding te kiang ahi zongin, ahih kei leh ZAM zum ah hong pai in kidong thei hi. ZOMI NAM NI AH PANKHOP DING NGETNA Malaysia a om Zomi ten kumsim a i bawl den ahi i minam ni a sawtloin hong tung ding hita hi. Abeisa kumte mah bangin tukum zong thupitak leh picing takin bawl theih na dingin 06 January 2020 in ZAM zumpi ah kimuh khopna kinei hi. Zomite in minam pi cing leh minam kician I hih na kician takin I lah na leh I minam I pahtawina tawh in 2020 Zomi Nam Ni zong nopcitak leh picingtak a i bawl zawh nang sum leh pai tampi mah hong kisam ding ahihmanin muan naleh lametna lianpi tawh Zomi Nam Ni Committee in anuai a bangin ma i pankhopding kong zawn uhhi. Mi khat peuh ahih kei leh kipawlna khat peuh I pawi hi loin Zomite I minam ni pawi ahih manin mikim in mawh puak lain pang khawmin I sepkhop ding zong I kizawn hi. Zomi Nam Ni adingin sum leh paai tampi kisam ahih maninin I pankhop ngeina bangmahin tutung zong Khuakipawl nate panin RM 200 leh biakna Pawlpi te panin RM 300 tawh mapang khawm dingin I kizawn hi. Khua kipawlna, Pawlpi bek hi loin mimal mahmah in zong ka minam ni pawi ading kihelnuam ing acite zong lungdam takin kisang hi.
