Articles Mimal Taangthu Dr. Vum Son Tangthu. Agelh Mang Khan Cing (Bianca Son) By: LAIBUSAAL Date: May 18, 2018 Dr. Vum Son Tangthu. Agelh Mang Khan Cing (Bianca Son) Ka pa Vum Son Suaktak pen Pu Ngul Zam le Pi Neam Mang-te sungpan 1937 November 9 ni in Sizang khua ahi Tamdeang khua ah suak hi. Asuah ma-in a u te 2 sungtholh tawh si uhi. Tua ahimanin unau 8 lakpan aupen ong suak hi. Vum Son pa pen health inspector khat hia Zogam akhunglam khuapi 3 ah nasem hi. Apa tawh mun tuamtuam ah zui kawikawi ahimanin Zogam khunglam aa kampau lianzawte pau thei gai hi. Pau thei bekhilo Zomite sungah kampau dangdangte in adangdang kampaute atheih theih nadingun zong bawl lai hi. Zogam ah Sangmangte 1812 akipan ong lutta uh ahi hi. Anulepate pen Tapidaw aciik mahmahte uh ahi hi. (Tua hun lai aa) Tapidawte in kamdawn tangthute pen biakna tawh kituakloin ngaihsun uh ahiman tua bang kamdawn tangthu gennate kikham hi. Ahizong Vum Son ii anu lampan apu in khua na mukhol-a tua kamdawn tangthute kemcing zo ahimanin Vum Son in Zo Tangthu (Zo History) thu ong thei thei ahi hi. Hih bang tuahkhakna hangin amah bek hilo adang mitampi ii nuntaknate seekpha ahi hi. Falam ah Tan X a on khitciang Zangkong pilna sang sinna RASU ah sang zomin BSc (Geology) ong ngah hi. Hih mun ah Vum Son in kampau thak, Kawl pau, sin kha-a ngeina thak khat tawh kituak kha hi. Kawlgam mun tuamtuam pan sang naupangte tawh kimu kha zel ahimanin minam dangte tawh kithuah zia ong sin toto thei zel hi. Tua mun ah zong mualsuak hi. Zangkong aom sungin amah pen aksi khin kimawlna (Chinese checkers) siampen ahimanin minthang simsim hi. Gam bup laivuanna ah mat sang tak tawh gualzo ahimain Freiberg, Germany (nidanglai East Germany) ah pilna sinbeh theihna hamphatna ngah hi. Tua mun ah MSc zo-a tua khua mah aa Petroleum Exploration and Mining Academy ah PhD zom suak hi. Zogam tawh gam zapi akigamlatna hih mun ah zong lawl le gual neihna le a sia professor-te zahtakna ngah thei zah dingin nungta hi. Atatakin PhD kam kinialna (defenses)te ah angai dingin sapna tampi ngah zel ahi hi. Tua kikalin ka nu, German tualsuak, tawh kimu uhi. Kiit kingai pah uhi. PhD angah hun in zi nei-a tanu 2, kei le ka nau, zong nei hi. Sangnaupang visa bei ahimanin hih innkuan note Kawlgam ciahkik uhi. Hih bang ciahkikna in khialhna khat hi cin mukhia uhi. A li un Kawlpi le Zangkong ah aom dan uh nuamsa napiun ka nu ading khuahun pen thuaklahhuai khat ong suak hi. Amah le atanu tegelte West Germany ah exist visa tawh ka pai thei uhi. NidanglaiGam mangtulak sung phu-a Vum Son pen Salween gunpi gei Sawletha, Karenni siah le galkap phual khat, ah ong tung hi. Tua panin maban zop theih nading kiphallo hi. Tua mun aa galkapte pen agilkial mahmah na hi uhi. Vum Son in pen khut guak tawh ngasa man thei se hi. Tua bangin akhut tawh ngasa mana gal phual aa teng khempeuh vak vah didek ahimanin galkapten zahtak mahmah uhi. Tua hang mahin Chaing Mai ah paisuak theih nading phalna ngah thei suak hi. Chaing Mai ah Germany siikzum tawh kizom thei hi. Hih bang teng tawh West Germany aa om a innkuante tawh kigawm thei-a 1979 ciangdong tua gam ah om uhi. Vum Son nasepna company in amau innkuan US ah piang sak hi. Namgim khukte ah nasemkawmin Zo History laibu ading thukanna le laigelhnateh deihtak ong kipan thei ahi hi. Zo History pen ahih leh 1986 kum in kihawmkhia zo hi. Hih in Zomite tungah khauh tak mahin nasemin mi tampite in sung khat, zang khat suan i hih lam telkhia thei uhi. Vum Som in Kawlgam aa Chin, India aa Mizo le Kuki akl Bangladesh aa Bawm minamte pen minam khat pan ong hiangkhiate hi uha hih Zo minamte pen Mangkangte ong lut ma le ong lut khit hunte ah kithehthang mang ahi uhi cin lakkhia ahi hi. Zo History in kigawmkhawmkikna (reunification) nasepna tampi piang sak-a tuni dong mah gua bang hinghing lai uhi. Zo History akhet ahawm khit, ka pa pen tual vai le gam vaite ah deihtak ma ong pang semsem hi. Foundation for Democracy in Burma ii lutangpi dingin kum 5 sung sem hi. Committee for Restoration of Democracy in Burma ii pawllut khat zong ahi hi. Tua khitciangin Chin National Council le Chin Freedom Coalition-te ong phuankhia hi. Chin Forum zong ong gawmtuah thei hi. Hih Chin Forum pen mailam Chin State ah zat ding gam thukhunpi agelh ding ahi hi. Zomi Innkuan, Washington DC, ii thudotpi dingin zong panla-a Political Affairs Committee of Chinland (PACC) ii thudotpi pawl ah zong kihel hi. Mihing ngahhuai vaite ah zong ka pa pen nak pan mahmah-a 1987 kum UN le UNHCR ah Kawlgam vai thugenna aneihna tungtawnin ngahhuai maphu khat ong suak hi. Zo History ah alunglutna hang mah in ZORO (Zo Reunification Organization) ii pawllut khat le ZOLITE (Zomi Literature Institute) aphuankhiate lak ah khat in kihel hi. Vum Son in hiamgam tawilohna thu pai zia aup mah bangin hiamgam tawilo-a langpan ziate ahilh hi. 1991-99 sung NCGUB le adang kipawlna tuamtuam ah nasem hi. Vum Son ahih leh khantawn pilnasin khat ahi hi. Kawlgam thautawite in galhiam tawh lehpan ding athupit sak laitakun Vum Son in ahih leh hiamgam tawiloh langdona tawh deihtak panla hi. Ama dinmun tawh kisai kinial suah theih ding tampi oma ahizong amah in ahih leh ama upna aom bangin ma phu toto hi. Lai (thesis) khat ong gelha Ne Win Doctrine cih ahih hi. Tua sungah Ne WIn in singnuai thautawite hangin hamphatna angahnate kawkkhia hi. Ama genna ah Ne Win in Kawlgam nam neu tualmite tungah a galkapte gamhtatnate akisam hi cih paulap ngah sak hi ci hi. Bekthamlo damdam le geelsiam takin nam neute aphiatsiang theih nading thautawi langpannate kisam sa hi cih ahi hi. Gam vai nasepnate banah Vum Son in refugee tampi mah panpih hi. Germany atung masa Kawlgam pan refugee-te pen ka pa huhsa tampi mah om uhi. Azi tawh akikhen khit US atun zawhkhit nung a inn pen refugee akua mapeuh ading kong honsa ahi hi. Atanu tumpen, tua hun lai a kum 12 apha, Lianna bang zumkong mangkong ah tonpih thei zel hi. Amau unau gel in ahih leh amah pen Khamtung pan ong pai apiandang mi khat in mu liang uhi. Azi tawh akikhensiang khitteh Washington DC ah kituah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua teng pen sum zonna hoih bek hilo athupizaw ah DC ah Mizo bulomkhat om hi. Mizo-te in u khat nau khat banga a angvannate mun tam simsim ah gen zel hi. Zang khat suan cih theikawmsa mahin Vum Son in a angvan-a atawpna ah kipawlkhawm hi. Asawtloin Chin le adang refugee-te US ah ong lutlut thei uha tua bang mi tampite a inn ah ong ciahpihin gam vai gambel siauhna ah huhin panpih hi. Pawlkhat bang in amah pen Kawlgam suahtak nading kal masa hi, ci liang uhi. Zomite bek hilo avom akang minam kim ading a inn kong pen akihong ahi hi. Ni khat bang Vietnam-te khat in ka inn kong uh ong kiu-a Vum Son tawh va kimu lecin om nading mun ong pia ding hi, ong kici hi, ci hi. Vin,Vietnam-pa, pen California pan Washington DC ah nasep zonga ong pai ahi hi. Nasepna tuamtuam ah dawp kawikawi-a om nading nei keng cih zong gen thei zel hi. Tuaciangin Vum Son sam in kici hih tuak hi. Vin pen ko tawh kha 2 bang, akhongin, omkhawm hi. Annek lim hetlo ding cih thei ahimanin Vum Son in akong va kiu aa ko tawh ong ne in, va ci thei zel hi. Tua bang ciang Vin zong nitak an ong nekpih zela tun ahih leh zi tawh ta tawh om ta uhi. Ni khat, Vum Son in American-te khat inn ong ciahpih hi. Amah ko tawh omkhawma ka kitheihpih mahmah uhi. Inn sung lutkawmin Vum Son in, amah pen thong sungpan ong pusuak lian hin, omna ding neilo, ci hi. Citatak leng, Vum Son in ahih leh mel nam tuamtuam mite akem ahuh hi. Patrick akici Mizo-te khat tawh akiteng Piantit-te khat zong om hi. Ko innkuan tawh kithei pah saisai lel hi ung. Ahizong, amah pen thukhen zum tawh buaina nei den-a Vum Son nangawn tawh buai ngei uhi. Ka pan hih pa pen thong sungpan tam veipi mah va tankhia den hi. Ahizong ka pa in ahih leh phunsan seloin Patrick le amah banga adang mite ading inn kong hon denin om ahi hi. Nidanglai_IINamgim khukte ah khat vei kuan leh atate tawh kaal tampi mah kikhen uh ahimanin tua nasep pan khawla, akhawl khitciang nasep thak khat pat sawm hi. Atate tawh omkhawm ding, gamvai aukte semsem dingin atawpna ah tawlnga ding cih adeih thu hi. Leitang lei-a inn lam ding ong khensat hi. Singkung aphatna khawk khat ah atamman lualo inn khat ong lei-a tua inn puahkik dingin Vum Son in a hun awngte ong zanghta hi. Sun hun in nasep tampi sem-a van zuakna sai ah ahizong taxi hawl ahizongin sem kawikawi hi. Zogam ah ahih leh mite in amau inn ding amau mah in lam uhi. Ama khan sungah zong inn tampi lam ngei-a anu ading buuk alam khawng zong gen thei zel hi. Atanute ahi kei le ka nau in zong lampih hi ung. Ahiin ci ni ci leng inn lam dante tawh kisai ngaihsut zawhloh zah dongin ong hilha ko tegel in ka hih uh leh tua pilna siamnate mah ka zanghzangh lai uhi. Vum Son in inn lam nuamsa hi. Washington area ah innkuan khat omna inn 4 lamin anunungpen bel alungngaihngaih inn ahi hi. Vum Son in anau naupen ahi Thawng Ngo ading inn khat lam sak-a tuni dong mah tua inn ah teeng lai uhi. Vum Son nuntakna pen abei kuan ong hita hi. A lungngai ngaih inn zong lam zo in, a tuahtuahna ah a gualzo nuntakna tawh nungta zo hi. Tu 3 aneih khit nungin Pu min pua taktak in leitung nuntakna nusia ahi hi. Vum Son nuntakna pen abei kuan ong hita hi. Alungngaihngaih inn zong lam zo. Atuahtuahna ah agualzo nuntaknate nungta hi. Atu 3 na zong asuak dek hia amah zong nuam mahmah zo hi. Zo History tawh kisai zonbehna tuamtuamte khangguikante tawh sepkhop ding zong geelkhin. Kipawlna tuamtuam ah lawp takin kihel bek hilo thului tampi zong gelha internet le adang lai kibawlte ah ong suakkhin hi. Asia ni suahna khang lam aa om pilna sang sinte in Zo tangthu tawh kisai atelthei khatin ngaihsun uha khangno Zo tangthu kan tampite in thudot holimna tampi zong bawl khin zo uh. Vum Son pen biakna mi hilo. Tua sangin mihingte kha, tua khate ii sikdona, pangpuatna, pilna le hihzawhnate ah upna nei zaw hi. Amah in ahih leh alamdang mahmah mihing khat ahi hi. Dr Vum Son in atanu 2 ahi Mang Khan Cing (Bianca Son) le Zam Lian Vung (Liana Suantak), tu 4: Otilio, Dim Hau (Sonora), Son Zo Khai (Alina) le Neam Mang (Joule)-te, laiguizom 5 ahi: Suak Kang, Vung Khai, Cin Za Dal, Lian Kop Cin le Ngo Cin Thawng-te nusia hi. Note: Hih Dr. Pu Vumson Tangthu tom pen a tanu Lia Mang Khan Cin Bianca Son in Mikang lai (English) tawh a gelhna pan Zomite simtheih kim ding deihna tawh Tongsan Tanute in hun tampi la in Zolai tawh hong kiletkhia ahi hi. Atei Tongsan Tanute Brief Biography of Dr. Vumson Suantak Date of Birth : November 9, 1937 Place of Birth: Tamdeang, Tedim Township, Chin State, Burma. Date of Deceased: September 19, 2005, Laurel Hospital, Maryland, USA. Educational Background 1957 - Matriculated from Tedim State High School , Tedim Township. 1961 - BSc. (Geology Chemistry) Rangoon University 1965 - M.Sc. (Petroleum Exploration at the Mining Academy) Freiberg Germany. 1969 - Ph. D (Doctor of Natural Science) Bergacademie, Freiburg - Germany Publications 1970 - Geochemical Explorati on of Trace Elements (in German versio n) 1986 - Author of Zo History (in English) Jobs He worked as a Geologist in Burma, Germany, Norway, Scotland, Ireland, and the United States. Social and Political Activities 1987- 2005 Foundation for Democracy in Burma member and for five years served as its President. Member of Committee for Restoration of Democracy in Burma Founder of Chin National Council and Chin Freedom Coalition (Washington) and Chin Forum (Ottawa), Founder, Former Chairman, and Advisor of Zomi Innkuan Washington D.C (USA) since 2001. Zomi Innkuan D.C Chairman 2001 from 2004. Member of the Board of Consultants of the Political Affairs Committee of Chinland , Human Rights Activist since 1987. Founding member of Zomi Literature Institute (ZOLITE) Member of the Zo Re-Unification Organization (ZORO) since 1995 and served as coordinator. USA branch ZORO President. Member of Advisory Board of the Chin National Community Japan . Lecturer in Non-Violence Actions, Human Rights and Minority Rights . Represent Chin Forum in Constitution drafting federal and state in various Burma related seminars. Worked together with the NCGUB from 1991 to 1999 and other organizations. Promote Peace and Democracy in Burma and encouraged armed groups for peace negotiations. He political activities involved, among other works, lobbying Congress and the US Government for the cause of bringing democracy to Burma and giving interviews to the media such as the BBC, Voice of America, and the Radio Free Asia etc. FAMILY Photo: His Childhood, with his Family, Standing second from left Parents Father - Pu Ngul Zam Mother - Pi Neam Mang Photo: Seen together with his two daughters and grandson Daughters Nu Mang Khan Cing ( Bianca Son) - Germany Nu Zam Lian Vung (Liana Suantak) - Germany Grandsons Otilio - Germany Sononar - Germany Photo: seen with his brother Pu Ngo Cin Thawng's Family in Maryland Brothers and Sisters Pa Suak Kang - Tam Deang, Tedim Township, Chin State, Burma. Zolai gelhzia alunglutte tung ngaihsut piakna ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zolai gelhzia alunglutte tung ngaihsut piakna posted on 4 August 2014 at 1:37 pm Lomkholna: Article , Literature , Zamsiansum Zolai gelhzia alunglutte tung ngaihsut piakna Zolai pen hongpian zawh sawtnai hetlo nungdeuh in kum 100 cinpawi kibawl pan hi. Ataktak in Zolai simbu ci-in sanginn ah Formal takin isin hun 1924 kumkhawng hipan ahih manin kum 100 cing nailo hi cileng khiallua loding hi. Tuamah bangin Linguistics pan enleng, Zolai tawh kisai Philology, Syntactics, Discourse, Pragmatics, Semantics, Structuralism, Grammar, Phonetics, Phonology, etc. cih bangin sintheih ding, puahding maban tampi omlai hi. Tu tadih inbel Morphology, Lexicology, Morphophonemics ciang buaipih lunglung lai hihang. Taangpi taangta theih dingin tomkaih pakleng laimal gawmdan SpellingWord Structure ciangah buai lingling hihang. Tua kawmkal ah awsuahawkaih (Accent) kibanglo ihih manin lai igelh ciangin akihual kiim theiding hamsa sim hi. Gentehna in; gamngam, ginngin, gawmngawm cihbang dan tepawl. Pasian hehpihna tawh Zomite Laisiangtho sinna lamah mazangin Ph.D. tampi i om ta hi. Ahih hangin Secular lamah kitawm lai mahmah cihding hi. Tua kawmkal ah Lai lamah cileng Linguistics, Literature Majors te tawh DoctorD. Lit. ngah kikhaat mahmah a, M.A. ciangzong kitawm mahmah hi. Katheih khialh keileh D.Lit. ngahbang ki omzo nailo hi. Tua banah hong nusiakhin pawlkhat om in, anungta lai kitawm hi. Mailam ah khangthak sungah Zolai zuunding pilna sangnei tampi hong piankhiat dingzong lamen hang. Tuabang teng kawmkal ah nuntak khuasak haksatna hangin lai-uk, laideih, laisiamnuam, laitheinuam veuveu themcik khat lobuang atamzaw in sumngah nading, hauhpak nading, meetpak nading leh zalian pipi, makai pipi suahtheih nading bek buaipih in laigelhdan peuhmah awlmawh in neilo uh hi. Tua bektham lo-in tulai khangno tampite in Zolai zong ginatak in gelhthei nawnlo uh hi. Zolai siamlo in English zong siam tuanlo zelmah hi. Tua kacih ciangin pawlkhat bangin zahdah khamai dinguh a, ahi zongin tuciangciang online ah English tawh lai kigelh te ka-et ciangin hoihtakmaantak a gelhthei mi 10 zong a-om teiitam kaci hi. English abul abal a thei, endik (edit) semthei dingciang mi 34 bang ih omzo teii tam ci-ing. Cianlian keng (Not quite sure). Lamkhat pan tuazong ahiding mah hi. Mikangte mahmah zong amau lai English maantakhoihtak gelh theilo tampi omlel uh hi. Mangpau leuleu bel maanse takei leh dangnal zalzal, eusuk euto a pauthei tawh, uun-ham duadua a pauthei tawh ki-om nianua hi. Hibang teng kawmkal ah Zolai avei zawdeuh te in amau kivakna Specialization ahih zenzen loh hangin hong zuunsak toto in Tan 4 (Standard Four) ciang kisinthei a, laigelh thei liamliam dinmun tungta ihih manin amau tungah ilungdamna lian mahmah hi. Hih atung a igen bialbual teng kikumni cileng hongsau luading ahih manin tulaitak Zolai gelhzia hong lungmangsak dekdek awsau, awtom, aw-eu tawh kisai them eusuk ni. Amasa in Cope topan hong bawlsak Zolai pen Languages tampi te mah bangin awsuah zui-in laimal gawm hihang. Tuatawh kizui-in laimal cin bangpen Mikang awkaih in sin himawk ahih manin telkhialh loh nadingin chin tawh na malgawm sak hi. Tua huhau-in Zomi upa Cin minnei pawlkhat Chin in na malgawm uh a, pawlkhat bang lungmanlawh dektak uh hi. Tua banah nidang Zo laibute enleng zong awkhat malkhat Monotonic Syllables zui-in kigelh tamzaw hi. Gentehna in: Pau Hau in thau a nei hi. Ni a sa hi. Mi li a si hi. Sih ah sa a pang hi. Tuhun leuleu ciangin aw 45 bang malkhat asuah sukziau zong ki-om ta hi. Gentehna in; pheituamsungteenthak cihbang dan. Atung a igensa mah bangin awsuah zui-a malgawm pen kitamzat pen hi. Ahih hangin Zolai pen Manglai danin Phonetic Alphabets atuam in neilo ihih manin kammal pawlkhat awsuah banglian aleikiat zui-in malgawm haksa hi. Gentehna in: Hai 1) Kanau in huan ah hai gah alo hi. 2) Mihai tawh kikhawl kei in. 3) Hai ciakciak kei in. 4) Tutung mopawi ah tanute leh haitawite buaideuh uh hi. 5) Mi suangtum tawh kideng ziahziah namuh ciangin en heihai kei in. Atung a gentehna teng lakah 1 leh 5 na ah laimalgawm hai sangin haai zangleng awsuah tawh kinaizaw hi. Ahih hang laigual 1 na ah hai bangzong izatzatsa leh ikingeina sehnasa hi-in alaimal imuhphet in imitkha ah hai lim hongsuak pah hi. Laigual 5 na-a hai sang haai cileng zong khialh omlo, cikei lengzong telkhialh nading liang omsam lo hi. Tua hi-in laigual 1 leh 5 na ah haihaai laimalte pen awsuah kibang hinapi akhiatna atuamtuak hise hi. Mikang ten tuate pen Homophones naci uh hi. Tua banah 2 leh 3 na ah hai pen akhiatna akibat hang awsuah kibang lotuak hi. Laigual 2 na ah hai pen aw-eu leh awtom kigawm hi-in, 3 na-a hai leuleu pen aw-uunniam leh awtom hi citciat se hi. Tuamah bangin 3 leh 4 pen awsuah kinai huaipian napi akhiatna tuamtuak hivet sehi. Hih atung a hai teng bangzong Mikangpau in Homonyms cileng huamkiim hi. Tua ahih manin hibangdan kammalte igelh ciangin Kawllai danin awsuah khenkhiatnakilamdan sakna tuamtuam neilo, Manglai danin lah Phonetic Transcription tuam neihlo ihih manin asimte in laiguallaipai (Context) en a bangci awsuah ding cih ngahsut siamkul hi. Nidang ciang Phonetics atuam a ineih zawhleh thukhat ci ni. Anuai ah khat ensuk lai ni: Pai Sumkuang lampai ahat kei hi. Ninbung sung bekah ninpai in. Note pai kawikawi unla lungdamna thu vataang ko un. Hih atung a pai teng bang isim ciangin awsuah kibang lo hi. Double Vowels zattheih nading zong om tuanlo hi. Double Vowels zattheihna pen anuai a bang munte bek hi: Khat lah kateem, khat lah kapaai himawk in kagup zawkding thei keng. Naupaiite gilo thei hi. Zolai ah hibangdan awsuah banglian a ki-at theilo, akhiatna lah kitel veve laimalte deihtak kancian laileng tampitak omlai ding hi. Maban sah mahmah omlai cihna hi. Hun ingahciang zom toto ni. Tu tadih inbel awsau zatdan them telkheh nuam hang. Awsau pen Zolai in ih at ciangin atamzaw in Double Vowel zang hihang. Gentehna in; Ciim,Meii, Thaam (gulpi), Taanghaam, Taangmi, etc. Double Vowels zathuai laimal gawmdan pawlkhat Ciim, Ciin, Daan, Kiim, Leeng, Leii, Maang, Meii, Taang, Teel, Tuu, Zaan, Zuu, etc. CiimCim Sawm Piang pen sang akah ngeiloh hangin ciim (cim hilo) vilvel se hi. Langno lo huung pen cimlua (ciimluahilo) in ihmu cipkha hi. CiinCin, MeiiMei Tuni thapai meii (mei hilo) kaii in guah a ciin (cin hilo) hi. (meii awlai leh awsau kigawm; ciin awsangeu pian leh awsau kigawm) DaanDan Migam milei ah nuntak dan isiam keileh daan kituak thei hi. (Daantuakdaanpia cihbang munte lobuangah dan kizang lel hi.) KiimKim Mikiim (kim hilo) in haksatna kinei ciat hi. Simbeng zong kim (kiim hilo) ciitciat tangzangh kiguan. LeengLeng Vanleeng tual ah sakolleng tailo hi. Lehbulh khaleng akhiatna tuampi suak hiau hi: Vanleng tual ah sakolleeng tailo hi. LeiiLei Sai mai-ah vanlei nuam mi hongpai ciang naleii naphen khakei in. MaangMang Mingelh ciangin atamzaw in Mang limzat zaw uh a, awsuah bangin gelhleng Maang ding hizaw hi. Laigelh ciangin akitel khialthei munte ah zatsiam kul hi: Galkap Maangpa (Commander) in anautaangte thu apia hi. Galkap mangpa (lost soldier) kimukik ta hi. (Hidan munte lobuangah maang leh mang kizang taang kawikawi a, laisim te in zong kitelsiam lel hi.) TaangTang Thang Ho leh Lian Do inzong taangtang phelhawm kici hi. Kawlgam innpi ah Taangmi pawlkhat ihmut suakin lusu ngeingai uh hi. Ngalkhaat tetangtat (taangtat hilo) uh hi. (Taang pen mun tampi ah kizang thei a, tang tawh khenkhiat siam kul hi.) Teeltel Mipil kiteelna ah thutel meello mihai lomtangg vakihel hi. Laigual sungah teel leh tel lehbulh khaleng akhiatna tuampi suak hi: Mipil kitelna ah thuteel meello mihai lomtangg vakihel hi. TuuTu Hiah tu inla pau kei in. Jesuh in Tuucing (tucinghilo) hoih ahi hi. Kei nong it leh katuute (tutehilo) nakem in. (Laigual masapen bangah tu sangin tuu in malgawm leng awsuah tawh kinai zaw hi. Laigual nihna ah Tuu bangpen awtom hi-a, Tucinghoih cileng awsuah tawh kinaizaw hi. Theihding ah tuu, tuuno, tuupeek cihte pen Cope topan hong bawlsak laimalgawm lakah tudong zatngeina Convention zahphial a ineih laimal hoih hi-a, awtom, awsau koimun koimun ah Double Vowels tawh gelh hamtang kul hi. Tu-le-ta te (PosterityDescendants) munah tuu-le-ta te (Sheep and Children) ci-a gelhkhak lohding zong thupi zel hi.) ZaanZan Zaan ni zankim pawlin hong kimeng hi. Zaanzan in hong kimeng hi. (Mundang tampi ah zan tawh kicing lel hi.) Mangpu ihmut suaklua kizan deedaa hi. ZuuZu Zuudawnte in zuumi (zuu tawh mehkhoppih) dingin zusa (zuusa hilo) emkeu uh hi. Hih atung a teng lakah Ciin leh Tuu lobuang atamzaw awniam, awlai leh awsau munte ah double vowel kizang phadiak hi. Ciin pen aw-eu pian leh awsau kigawm hi. Aw-eu mun khempeuh ah double vowels zat pahpah lohding hoihzaw hi. Izatkhak leh ilaigelh ziate hong kitukalh mangding hi. Atung a teng banah honkhat omlai hi. Tua banah Double Vowels zang taleng, zang takeileng akitel laimal pawlkhat om leuleu hi. Gentehna in: KhaangKhang KhangnoteKhaangnote in minam nasep kinbawl uh hi. Zomi te in khangkhaang tangthu thupiseh uh hi. (Khang zatna atamzaw pen awlai leh awsau kigawm ahih manin Double Vowel tawh malgawm leng khiallo napi, Single Vowel tawhzong kitelcian mahmah hi. Atamzaw in Single Vowel tawh malgawm uh hi.) Ahih hang khang leh khaang akizat khawm theihlohna om ciitciat hi: Ihmu in Topan hongkem ahih manin ka khanglo (khaanglo hilo) hi. Guah tamlua-in leitang akhaang (khang hilo) hi. (Risen hilo Cracked cihnopna ah) IinIn Zopaulai ahin kici affix pen kitamzat mahmah a, atamzaw suffix in kizang hi. Awlai leh awsau kigawm ahih manin awsuah lianin gelhleng iin ding hi. Ahi zongin laimal dangtawh telkhialh nading om peuhmah lo ahih manin atamzaw in Single Vowels mahtawh kizang suak a, Norm khat bangin kingahsunta hi: Tuakhit cianginciangiin uiphuk mangpa tuisungah alutsuk hi. ZouZooZo Ataktak in tulai Zo, Zomi, Zolai, Zopau cihte ah Zo pen awlai leh awsau kigawm ahih manin Double Vowels tawh ZouZoo cih bangin gelhleng awsuah tawh kinaipen hi: Zo(awsuah Zoo) lakah sa ataa hi. Zomite gualneek zo kasakei hi. Zomi ka hi hi. Laigual 2 nasungah Zo laimal munnih ah om napi, amasa pen Zoo ci-in awsau tawh isim a, anunung pen zo, gualzo, galzo, cihdan awtom tawh isim se hi. Hipen Kawlten igelh ciang amaan, isimciang a-aw (ရတ အမန ဖတတ အသ) aneih mah bangun Zolai ah zong anei hihang. Double Vowels limzat mahmah honkhat bangin himun ah hongzang samlo uh ahih manun lungdam huai hi. KaawlgaamKawlgam Awsuah liantawh gelhding hileng awsau leh awlai tuak ahih manin Kaawlgaam cihding hi. Awsuah liantawh gelhsang Kawlgam cileng laimal ciiksuah zaw hi. Double Vowels pupite inzong Kawlgam mah hongzat pihlai uh hi. LaaiLai Muntampi ah kizang khel kawikawi hi. Ahi zongin khuamin Laaitui bangzong amau zatdan zatpih ding thuman ahi hi. Lai (Writing) leuleu pen awlai leh awsau kigawm hilo, aw-eu leh awsau kigawm zong hilo ahih manin lai, laimal, laigual, cihding hilel a, Double Vowels behlap kul peuhmah lo hi. Khatvei leh laimal khatvei leuleu leh laaimal cih thimthum kullo hi: Laaitui khua-ah laimal (laaimalhilo) gawmzia kisin hi. Tulaitulaai tak lai kagelh hi. LuungsiimLungsim Awsuah lian hileh Luungsiim ding hi-a, laigelh ciang Lungsim mah kizang kiim hi. Luungsiim ci-a malgawm kikhaat mahmah ding hi. SeemSem Thadah ten nasem (seem hilo) nuamlo hi. Zolai ah seem kizatna tawm mahmah ding hi. PeenPen Awsuah in peen ahih zenzen hang laigelh ciang pen kitam zatzaw hi. Bangmah dangtawh telkhialh nading omlo ahih ciang pen mah zangsuak leng hoihzaw hi. Tuanu pen mi gensiat hatlua kici ve aw. Double Vowel zatnop leh anuai a bang laigual te ah zathuai hi: Gol peenpeen mehneu tawi, neu peenpeen mehgol tawi. GaalgiingGalging Anih tuak in awlai leh awsau ahih manin awsuah lianin gelhleng gaalgiing ding hi. Zat ngeina ah galging, galkap, galhang, cih bangin Single Vowels kizang zaw hi. Ahih hang theihhuai thukhat ah, Zopau ah awsau pen tam simsim ahih manin laigelh ciang awsau omna khempeuh ah Double Vowel zangleng laisim dan alemloh naciang om banah, Conventional Writing tawh hong ki keelki thei hi. Mi pawlkhat te bangin lai malgawm ciangin Double Vowel tamzat lua-uh ahih manun amkham gawp in khat veivei awtom Single Vowel zangleng kitel siuseu zaw, maltu zawding hiphial taleh awsau Double Vowel zangkha vaivai zong om khelkhel hi. Awsuah lian zui-a laigelh sin dihni: Luun Maang peen Kaawlpi ah Zoo ngeina lam laam dingiin nuungkaal pek aa paaisuk hi aa phone lah hongseet lo diil deel mawk aa zaan haal ziing saang iin a paaipih te uun innlam hopih katheih ciang iin, keizong kadot leh, theikei uung hong cii luungkham lua iing. Koilaai koiteeng ah omcih hongkaan pih uun, hehpihna tawh. Luungdaam. Atung a laigualte enleng, awsuah liantawh ki-at hi-a, khialhna a-omloh hangin simhak simsim leh dausuah simsim hi. Tua manin S. T. Hau Go in Zolai pen awsuah lianlian in gelhleng lemtaang khinlo nacingei hi. Adiak in, awsau, aw-eu khempeuh Double Vowels bektawh zepthuah, behlap pahpah pen Zolai dausuahsak, peengsuahsak zawsop hi. Ahoih theipen a puahding, zuunding mawhpuak neiciat ihih mah bangin Double Vowels bektawh hilo-in akilawm zaw Phonetics tuamneih zo-in, laimalte ahih leh aciilgil theithei, aciik theithei in malgawm kisinleng ahoihzaw tam ci-ing. Zomi linguists te maban tampi omlai cihna hi. Mailam ah kikum toto ni. Khuahun a sat mahmah laitak hi. Nitak naigiat hunpawl hi-a, vok-an huanna meipuak leengthem pen pat kaapsa a kikoih tung tu hi. Tua panin mei hong kuang hi. Taangkona tausaang tungpanin daak saatin kiko hi. Meiikaatna inn koilai-ah om ci-in kuzaza-in hilh hi. Innkiim dimin khangno pheikhai thei khempeuh hong kim ziau hi. Numeite in tuiphel khatciat tawh hong delh uh hi. Pasalte in tuiphel saangkhia-in buak tawh saat tawh thuah hi. Meikuang baba pen tawmvei sungin saatlum hi. Kawlte khat in, ko Kawl khua hipeuhmah leh khuazangin tum ding hi ci-in gen hi. Khatvei meigong khat cisanatin si hi. Kei zong khuultote huh dingin kapai hi. Kei, niangbeel phungah hong tusak hi. A khawl masasa haitehin numeino khat in hawm hi. Khangnote pen a seemnuam kituhin kilai dekdek uh hi. Naikhat sungin hongzo ziau uh hi. Kawlgam ah Christian hankhuuk tawhna munah zong kapai ngei hi. Khat in toto a, adangte ciamnuih genin nui nahnah uh a, khelh ding ngaihsun lo uh hi. Upa khat in a khel ding bankaih ngiat hi. Khatvei, sanggam sumbawl khat kithat a, Aizawl khuataw ah kiphum hi. A sawtlo-in a luang la dingin kapai uh hi. 1963 kum ahi hi. Mihing guk kapha uh hi. Tua hunin Tonsim leh Aizawl kikal khakhat jeep khatvei bek paizo hi. Kumpi in lamlian a tawhsan laitak ahi hi. Khe tawh nisagih kapai zen uh hi. Misi kaphot ciangun a luangbupin muatlo-in na omlai ahihmanin, niangteh kuanghawm lian mahmah sungah kaguan khit u ciangin guatawn tawh puak ding ahi hi. Tua laitakin Aizawl khua ah Chief Minister Pu Saplawnga in a sep laitak ahi a, ama huhna tawh Taiban kangah uh hi. Khuakhat khit khuakhat kisaang lianlian uh hi. Ciaugun gal eilamah nga-in hong nusia uh hi. Tamvei a puakha kidemin sauvei a puazo kituh uh hi. Pawlkhat mapai-in kisut uh hi. Hibang kidemna pen ahoih kidemna hi a, minam domto ding kidemna ahi hi. Kavante uh hong saangkhia-in hong guakpai sak uh hi. Hih mite tlawmngai hi, ci-in buhtang, meh hong pia uh hi. Kapailam un, Ciau panin niguk kapai pen u, nungdelhin taitai kahihman un, nilii sungin katung uh hi. Ciau panin Haimual khua dong kapua uh hi. Haimual khua katun uh ciangin Taiban kangen uh hi. Taibaan pia cih genvet kei o, misi pua ci-in zing hong tung sak lo hi. Haimual panin Tuitawh kadelh uh hi. Gamsi hong kipua ci-in inn simah sawlhing nabaang uh hi. Christianity zatsiam ni Sanggam Mizote pen Christianity zatdan siam a, limci takin na khansuah uh hi. Etteh huaite enteh leng hoih hi. Tua kacih ciangin Mizo suak ding, Mizo kampau ding kacihna hilo hi. Etteh tuakte enteh ding hang a, sepkhop theihna khempeuhah seemkhawm ding hang a, unau bangin i om ding hi.Ngeina hoih tawh minampi i suahna dingin kipuahin ih khanpih ding hi. Kapteel khua-ah Lawki beina pawi kibawl hi, ci-in email sungah kasim hi.Ih khantoh pih zotam, ci-in lawptakin kangaihsun hi. Sanggam Mizote kipiakzawhna uh bulpi pen Christianity zatsiamna pan hikhin siksek hi. Mi hehpi theihna, thumaanna, pumpi thatang leh neihsa dongin piakngamna, gam leh minam huutna dingin nuntakna dong piakngamna zungpi pen Christian zungkhakna pan ahi hi. Jesu thuhilhna khempeuh practical a zat dingin sin pah uh hi.Zong siam uh hi. Nangma pumpi na it bangin na innveengte it in Nang tung a hong kibawl ding na deih bangin midangte tungah bawl in, Keimin tawh naupangno khat tui haikhat nasuah ciangin Kei tungah hong bawl nahi hicih kammalte nuntak pih hi. Biakna, Pawlpi kibanglo cihtawh kideidanna omtuan lo hi. Pasian thuzui Christian ahihna uh thupi sak zaw hi.Tua ahih ciangin gam leh minam buppi-in thupha ngah a, tu-in ei phakzawh ding dinmunah omnawn lo hi. Kawlgam pan a pai anduh gilkialte nasep naguan uh a, hoihtakin omna napia uh hi. Guta tatsia ukzawh lohin omphial taleh, kan unau te ci-in panpih tantan uh hi. Uzaw lungsim, nampi lungsim icih pen tua hipah hi. Mitkeuh ding a kithawi Zomite in, kiim leh pam khuadakin ahoih khempeuh i enteh ding hi. Pawlkhatte in Zomi hoihna bek gen ding, ahoihlohna genlo ding a ci om hi. Socialist kumpi mittaw sak policy ahi hi. USA taangthu sutte in, abeisa hun a thanemna a gallelhna, azawhna sutsutin, kipuah uh hi. Enzong i thanemna kanin, a damna ding zatui zong imuh dongin zonding hanciam ding ahi hi. Zomi it kineih tampi pen neektawm zonna hi a, tua bang mite hangin kikhenkhapna nasia tektek zaw hi. Kampau zui-in kikhen hi. Beh leh phung zui-in kikhen hi. Amun-amual zui-in kikhen hi. Tulaitakin Zomi a khenkham pen Christian kinensuahna pan ahi hi. Zomi Christian kilomkikna panin kipumkhatna hong om pan ding hi. Ih Christianity zangsiam ni. Tualsuak Zomite le Pemta lungsim Dr. L. Lam Khan Piang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Tualsuak Zomite le Pemta lungsim Dr. L. Lam Khan Piang posted on 20 June 2016 at 7:31 am Lomkholna: Article , Lamkhanpiang Manipur state sung a Tedim-Chin Union a kiphut zawh kum sawnga cinna souvenir vaisai pawlin thului hong ngetna bangin ka lungsim a kavei, bawldik tuak ka sak thute kong lui khia hi. Hih thului pen minam itna leh a hoihzaw ding geelna a hong kigelh ahih manin a sang siam tek dingin khat-leh-khat kingen masa hang. Thulu a ka zat Tualsuak Zomite ka cih pen English in Indigenous Zo people ka cihna ahi hi. Ei Zomite pen i pu-pa luahsa gam leh leitang teek a luah i hih manin pemta hi lo-in tualsuak minam i hi hi. Tua ahih manin i pemta lungsimte uh paikhia in i minam, ngeina, tawndan, gam, khua leh tui puahin zuun ding a thupi pen in ngaihsut huailua ta hi. Bang hangin eite in pemta lungsim nei danin hong gen ka hi hiam? Nautang kihonate khongah hih bangin thu kiza thei zel hi, a gam nei te, cih bang ahih kei leh, gam nei lo minam cih bang te kiza thei zel hi. Ei Zomite history limhtak suut le hang, eite pen kuamah gamah teng ngeilo, bektham lo-in, Mikang kumpi in hong ukh ma-in, kumpi dang kuamah ukhna nuai-ah omkha ngei lo minam te ihi uh hi. Ei-leh-ei a ki-ukh ngiat minam i hi uh hi. Mikang kumpi hong khangin Zogam bup hong ukh khit uh ciangin, vaihawmna a baihzawkna dingin Zogam pen mun tuamtuam panin hong ukh uh hi. Japan Gal a bei ciangin Mikang kumpi in gam tuamtuam a ukhna uh pan in kizuuk khia uh a, ei Zomite pen gam tuamtuam ukhna nuai-ah hong nusia uh ahih manin, tu ciang dong ei-leh-ei kivaihawm theihna ding hamphatna hong kipia lo hi. Hihte hangin tu ciangin Union of Burma, Union of India leh Bangladesh ah khenzak in i om uh hi. Hih thului in Zo minam bup thu hong huap zo lo ding a, hih laigelh a telthei Zominam pawlkhat Tedim Zomi i cih thu bek hong huap ding hi. A diak in Tedim-mi leh Paite tribe thu luikhiat ding ka ngaihsutna hi a, bamcihleh kei ngaihsutna pan in hih Tedimmi a kici te leh Paite a kici te pen Zo minam sung panin bawngkhatpawlkhat bangin ka ngaihsun hi. Bang hangin hih bangin a tuam liuliau bangin hong om kha hi hiam cih pen thu lamdang lua hi lo-in, ei sunga laithei masate in history a etzia uh tawm bang dik zo lo deuh hi ding hi. History i suut ciangin hun (temporal aspect) pen poimawh mahmah in, a thupiangte zong a pianhun teek mah bangin gelh ding ahi hi. Mikang kumpi hong tun ma-in Chin Hills cih bang mual min zong na om lo a, kuamah Chin Hills pan zong na kipem zenzen lo hi. Ciimnuai-geltui panin milip i khan tawh kituakin i luahna gam hong zai semsem hi lel hi. Mikang Kumpi hong tun hun ciangin tu a Guite kual i cih bang a kiteng khin thamta hi. I luahgam hong lian semsem in Meiteite bang tawh va kigamgi kha liang kihizaw hi. Ahih hangin eite in kuama gamgi kikan kha lo hi. Chin Hills pan paikhia cih bang ngaihsutna a nein a om kha ngei hi, tua bang ngaihsutna pen thudik in kisang thei lo ding hi. Hih bangin lai khong gelhin i tangko pih leh i gam hong etlahsak namdangte a ding panmun khawhsak i suak ding hi. Tua ahihmanin thudiklo tawh i gam zuakzuak kei ni. Namdangte in thudiklo nangawn tawh a gam uh venbit a sawm lai un, ei Zomite in thudiklo tawh i gam zuak kha ihih manin, i history a ciahkik in pemta lungsim nei kha i om leh manlangin paaikhia ding hi hang. Lamka pan khangkhia khangnote in minam thu i theiloh zia pen a lungkham huai liang mah hi khong! Laisiam lah hi si, BAMA bang hi lianluan ahih hang i history uh thei hetlo kilkel bang zong na om zen hi. Khat veivei bang Tedim kam a ka pau pawlkhatte in a zak ciangin. Nang Chin te maw? cih peuhin hong dong thei uh hi. Bang hang maw? ci-in ka dot kik ciang Chin pau in na pau a hong kici sawnsawn lai. Chin pau cih na om tuam vilvel hi leh bel Chin state ah common language ding buai lo mah ding hi ve un. Lamkhat pan leuleu in, ka pau pen Chin pau ahih leh, hong dong pen pau bang hi ding hiam? Nidang Pu Tun Khaw Pum hun lai in Paite National Council (PNC) makaihna tawh Chin Re-unification ding ngetna memorandum bang India Kumpi kiangah na khia ngei uh hi. Tua ahih leh kua teng Chin hi a, kua teng bang Chin hilo cih pen laisim khangno te in thu i kan ding uh kisam mahmah ta hi. Nautaangte buaina tuamtuamte Kuki bang hi a? Chin bang hi hiam? Hih ci kawmkal ah Zomi bang hi leuleu hiam? cih khong pen khangno laisiamte in theitel in mite kiangah i hilh ciat ding uh hun mahmah ta hi. Khangmasa laisiamte in history limhtak na suut mello ahih manin hih bang teng, unau kal kitheihsiamlohna na ngawn kituak kha hi. A maute pen minam itlo hilo in, buaipih dingte sang buaipih loh dingte ah na kin zaw kha uh hi lel hi. Hih minam min tawh kisai-in kei ngaihsutna hih bang hi ziau lel hi. Tualsuakmi ihih manin tualsuak min i ngeina, tawndan, sing-leh-lou, khanggui, gam (mual-leh-guam), leh adg., tawh kizopna a nei minam min pen a manphatzia hong kithei semsem ahih manin Zomi pen hong kilaam sang ahihna theih huai hi. Mikang kumpi hong tunma in zong eite in Zomi, Zophualva, Zolengthe, Zovawk, Zozu, Zozam, leh adg., te ah Zo cih pen na kilimzat mahmah hi. Tua ahih manin, Zomi i cih ciangin i tualsuak minam min hi cih pen i theihtel a i lapsang ding ahi hi. Lai theimasate in history a etdan uh diklo kha ahi phial zongin, khangthak siamsin momnote in limhtak adik-aman bang hi hiam ci-in thu kan dingin tavuan lak hunta hi. Bang hangin i history etdan uh diklo hi ci ka hi hiam? Hih history etdan dikloh manin bang teng hamphatna kitaan hiam? Bangzah in a ki-it ding te ki-el den kha hi hiam? Tedim leh Paite entity tuam bang a hong kilatzia thu pan hih a tung a dawtnate suut ding hi hang. Tedim i cih khuamin na hi masa in, kum 1550 A.D. kiim pawl a Guite beh Pu Gui Mang in a sat hi, kici hi. Mikang Kumpi hong khangin, Zogam hong lak lai tak in Ukhpi Kamhau in vaihawmna phualpi in nei hi. Hih khua pen khualian mawhlo khat ahih man Zo pau cituamtuam a zang tampi na tengkhawm uh hi kici hi. Tua ahih manin, hih pau tuamtuam teng hong kigawm in kampau a tangzai zaw khat hong piangkhia hi. Hih pau pen Mikangkumpi in Kamhau ukhna sung a om teng in thei tek banah, amah ukhpi vaihawmna a pau kizang ahih manin kamhau dialect na ci uh hi. Mikang kumpi in Tedim khuapan a ukhzawhna ciangciang pen Tedim Township ci-in administrative division khatin na koih uh hi. Mikangte hong tun tawh Ukhpi Kamhau lutlai kituaklian hi. Ukhpi Kamhau ukhna gam pen na zai mahmah a, hih bangin la na phuak hi, Setang kaihna sak ciang Teimei ka hialna Lamtui na cih hi. Alexander Makenzie in laibu sungah hih bangin kimu thei hi. Guite hausa Gou Kho Thang Meitei lengpan zekhemin a mat khit ciangin, Ukhpi Kamhau te pata in Mualbem panin palai Kai Khual (kikoul) Meitei lengpa kiangah sawl uh hi. Tua ahih manin, Kamhau ukhna pen Meitei gam dong na hi hi. Tua lai-in Meitei gam pen neu mahmah a, Meitei lengpan a mite khalna pia-in a gam pua-ah a hawlkhiat ciangin Kak-Ching ahih kei leh Kwakta lak khongah hawlkhia zel hi. Hih hunlai in Meitei gam leh ukhpi Kamhau ukhna a gamgi limhtak kikhung ahih loh hang, hih atung a thu-leh-la te in hong tel sak mahmah pah hi. Tua India leh Myanmar gamgi pen na hideksuai lo hi. Hih gamgi pen tua Guite kual i cih na mun khong ei Zomi ten i luahkhit zawh Mikang kumpi hong khan ciang bek hong kikhung pan hi. Tua ahih manin PNC constitution, 1947 ah a kigelh Chin Hills pan ManipurIndia lut i cih pen thudik hilo a, a lauhuai mahmah thu ahi hi. Hih constitution in Paite i cih minam min pen definition pia ngekngek hi. Paite cih min pen limhtak ngaihtuah phathak in, i history uh tawh taihtuah in hi leng kisam sa lo kha thei ding hi hang. A hangin hih history hmuhzia inn eite pemta hong suaksak thei khong a hih man in, aman lang in kikuphuai mahmah thu khat hong hi mawk hi. Mite in Kuki te pen nomad (pemta) hi uh, tribe min khat zong Paite hi, ci-in lai bang hong kigelh ciangin i zanuam het kei uh hi, tua ahih manin limhtak ngaihsut huai sa ing. Thu dengdel, sehnel bangin ut bangbang a khen lamdang theih, THU tungah i-minam, i-inn-leh-lou, i-khua-i-tui kingasak kei thei leng. Thutak, Suangpi bang a a-linglo, a-kip, kikhel ngeilo THU tungah i minam kingasak leng kuamahin ut bangbang in hong suksak theihlo ding hi. Hih bangin kituam lak ding ngaihsutna tawh i minam min phuakkha i hih manin, thudik mello tungah i identity kingakha hong suak hi. Tua ahih manin mite in hong simmawhsakin hong philsuk-philto se uh hi-in ka ngaihsun hi. Khangnote in dawtna tampi nei-in, ahih hangin dawna kician mulo ahih manin, mailam kalsuan din zia gelkholhna a haksatna lianpi om hi. Khangno pawlkhatte in ka kiangah thu hong dong thei zel uh a, adiak in Paite leh Tedim i cih pen bang dingin hih bangin na kikhen kha hi mawk hiam? cih thu teltak thei nuam tampi om hi. Tua ahih manin, Tedim leh Paite ci-in a tuam dan a kihuaite pen ahi ci ding mah hiam. cih ngaihsunna lianpi ka neithei zel hi. Kei ngaihsutna panin khat hinapi i khen teitei uh hizaw hi ci ing. Lam tuamtuam pan a malmal in suut leng: 1. Nampuan : Zou leh Tedim in nampuan kibang zang hi. Paite in nampuan tuam phuak lo bang hi leh bel a kibang ding mah hi. Kei ngaihsutna ah bel Ciimnuai-Geltui a suak tengin nampuan hih bang teng kinei hi: puanlaisan, puandum, Khephiau, Zoniik, mongkhak, tualpuan (angkhi) leh tangciin. Puanmongvom kici pen i sanggam Thadou lam ten tu ciangin na zang phadiak uh hi. 2. La: I Zolate un pumkhat hihna hong lak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh lamsai tawng e gual aw e, i sai thei dialdial na maw. Hih bang pen Teizang pau lamte phuah hi ding in um ing, hih la bang pen Paite lamin na sa phadeuh se uh bang hi. 3. Laam: Laam pen i neih taang uh hi na pi-in, unau pasal teng pa go kihawm bang a, laam teng zong kihawm mawk. Minam tuam hih sawm teitei tentan. 4. Beh: Beh tawh kisai a bel kuamah a tuam om lo hi. 5. Pau: pau pen akaih bek kilamdang hi-in thei ing. Thelno khat-leh-nih pen a om koikoi ding mah hi ing ngaihsun ing. English tektek zong American-english, Canadian-English, leh Australia-English ci-in na kibang khin sam lo hi. Ahih hang kilamdang liang zong hi tuanlo zel leuleu hi. 6. Pawi tuamtuamte : I pawi tuamtuamteKhuado Pawi, Sialsawm Pawi, leh adg te pen nidanglai in a nei tuam om lo-in khuacih in zang ngeingai a, ahih hang tu hun ciang a neiphadiak bang kiomsak se. Pawlkhatte bang pupa ngeina pawite neikhangeilo mah bang zawzen. Hih pen i kituamlak nawp tek man hi ci lel ing. Hih a tung a teng banah zong lamtampi-ah et theih lai ding hi. Hih pen Laithei khangmasate ngaihsutna tawh kibang lo kha ding a, tua ahih manin khangthak thutak kan te-in hih sang in i telzawkna ding un hanciam ding hi hang. Tualsuak minam khatin leitung bup dongah miten hong ciapteh thei na dingin i ngeinate, i pawite (festivals), ki-ukhzia, khangthu, tualsuak minam min, leh adg te kisam mahmah hi. Tuate i neihloh hi lo in, i zuun loh man bek hi. Hih i pupa pan i luahsukngeina, tawndan, pau-leh-ham, gam-leh-lei, leh adg te i zuun ciang mite in hong zahtak in minam picing hong sang pan ding uh hi. I biak Pasian hoihna hangin, khanthakte in, i minam puahin zuun ding hongkipan ta hi. Tua ahihmanin kuapeuh in itna tawh semin, eima angsung bek khuallo-in, takhahna tawh takkheih! Ci-in hanciam in mailamnawt ding hi hang. Phattuamna om hetlo-in eite kituam lakin vaituam bang i hawmhawm phial zongin, cikhat-namkhat i hihna pen telkhialh ding hi peuhmah lo a, i khangthudik leh history te ah i minam vai peuhmah nga-in hi le hang, thudik in hong gumkhia ding hi. Tu ciangin leitung khantohna sang mahmah ta in, tuamanin communication zong hong baih hiaihiai ahih manin i pau-leh-ham uh zong na kigawm hiaihiai ta hi. Tua ahih manin i pau-leh-ham te uh a luankhop hiaihiai bangin, a mite in zong Zotui bang luankhopna ding vai sawm thei dingin Pasian in i minam thupha hong pia ta hen. Dr. L. Kumnih aphapan naupangno khat Pi 20 athuk hawkguam sungah kiasuk ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Kumnih aphapan naupangno khat Pi 20 athuk hawkguam sungah kiasuk posted on 3 May 2017 at 9:54 pm Lomkholna: China , News , Sawltak , World Kumnih aphapan naupangno khat Pi 20 athuk hawkguam sungah kiasuk China ah naupangno kum 2 aphapankhat inn kilamna Construction aom tuinin paikhiatna hawkguam sungah kiasuk cih South China Morning Post pan kiza hi. China, Henan Province sungah Saturday ni thupiang hi a, akiatna hawkguam dumthukpen Meter 6 (Pi 20 dektak) athuaksuk ahihi. Hawkguam tuinin luankhiatna Drainage Pit zongpen azaina Diameter 36cm bek hi a, huih zong hoihtak ngahlo cisawnsawn hi. Akia naupangno pen numei hi a, akiat akitheih ciangin tua tuinin paihna Drainage pen Firefihters leh Emergency Service ten tokhiapah ngekngek uhhi. Firefighters ten naupangno huihsiangtho hoihtak ngahloding cih thei uh ahih manin, Oxygen huih anuai ah aluttheih nading in hanciam uhhi. Leisungteng Crane mawtawpi tawh tokhia uh a, nai 1 sungbang mitampi in abuaipih khit uhciangin naupangno pen anuai ah mukhiazopan uhhi. Video Clip aki Record zong ki khahkhia a, naupangno pen aki muhkhiat ciangin amanlang in zato ah kipuakpah cihi. Hih naupangno pen lamzong apaithei nailo, abawhvaksa in akimawlna panin hih dumthuk hawkguam sungah akiasuk ahihi. Video Clip pen Online Social Media ah aki khahkhiat ciangin ahonkhiat Firefighters leh Emergency Service te kipahtawi mahmah a, thupi kisa mahmahtak hi. Abeisa kum 5 sungah hihbangin tuikhuk leh dumthuk sungah naupang kia cihpen Sengam ah tammahmah cimawk hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- ZAM Thupuak :: 19 Jan 20 (Zomi Cup kipan tading) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW ZAM Thupuak :: 19 Jan 20 (Zomi Cup kipan tading) posted on 21 January 2020 at 11:29 am Lomkholna: Malaysia , News , Refugee , ZAM , Zomi ZOMI CUP 2020 KIPAN TA DING Hong tung ding February 20, 2020, ZOMI NAM NI pahtawina I bawl Zomi Cup pen January 25-27, 2020 sung Padang Bola E RRI Sungai Buloh tualpi ah kimawlta ding hi. Tukum Zomi Cup ah khua 13 pan team 14 hong kihel thei uh a, Tuipi khua pan in A leh B in team nih hong ding khia uhhi. Zomi Cup 2020 ah team 14 te Group 4 in kikhen hi. Zomi Cup 2019 hon pawi pen January 25 ni zingsang nai 10:30 AM hun in kipan ding hi. Zomi Cup -2020 ah kimawl ding ahi zongin, a en ding a hong pai ding te ahi zongin zuu khamsa leh zuu thawl, beer bung cih te pua sa in nong pai loh nang uh leh kuncil te peuh mah lampi tung, inn umna kawmte tung cih te ah nong thangsiat loh ding uh zong I kithum phapha hi. Zomi te minam neu hiloin minam picing leh minam lian I hih na kilang sak ni. Hall ahi a, kimawlna mun te ahi zong khat vei nih vei I zat khit ciang hong kideih nawnlo pahpah cih din mun pan in pusuak khia in I hih na peuh ah hong kideih in hong ki it ding leh I minam picing hih na a pulak khia ding ei teng mah I hi a, tua bangmah in I minam hong ki neu muh theih na ding a sem a bawl zong ei teng mah I hih lam ki phawk ciat ni. Zomi Cup 2019 ah Champion pen Anlangh te hi a, First Runner up pen Ngalzang leh Second Runner up Tuipi khua te ahi uh hi. Zomi Cup 2020 ah kua in Champion hong ngah ding cih a sawt loin kimu ta ding hi. Group A Anlangh Bukphil Heilei Buan Group B Ngalzang Tuipi (B) New Darkhai Group Vangteh Phaiza Singzung Tuimui Group C Tuipi (A) Voklaak Ngente Groud D Vangteh Phaiza Singzung Tuimui PASTOR SASA LE ALAWM TE ZAM ZUM AH HONG HAWH Korea Pastor Sasa makaih na tawh Pasian nasem leh cidamna lam a sem siavuan te kikop in ZAM zum ah hong hawh uh a, Malaysia om Zomi te din mun, Kawlgam pan I pai khiatna thu cih bangin thu tampi kikum khawm thei hi. Tua ban ah sang nau -pangte leh cina pawl khat zong hong vel sak in a kisam bangin hong bawl sak uh hi. Zomi te thu teng I gen ciangin hong vei mahmah in thungetna zong nasia takin hong neih sak ban ah mailam ah Zomi te ading in a sepnop tuamtuam te uh zong kikupkhopna ki nei thei hi. ZOMI NAM NI AH PANKHOP DING NGETNA Malaysia a om Zomi ten kumsim a i bawl den ahi i minam ni a sawtlo in hong tung ding hita hi. Abeisa kumte mah bangin tukum zong thupitak leh picing takin bawl theih na dingin 06 January 2020 in ZAM zumpi ah kimuh khopna kinei hi. Zomi te in minam picing leh minam kician I hih na kician takin I lah na leh I minam I pahtawina tawh in 2020 Zomi Nam Ni zong nopcitak leh picingtak a i bawl zawh nang sum leh pai tampi mah hong kisam ding ahihmanin muanna leh lametna lianpi tawh Zomi Nam Ni Committee in anuai a bangin ma i pankhopding kong zawn uhhi. Mi khat peuh ahih kei leh kipawlna khat peuh I pawi hi loin Zomi te I minam ni pawi ahih manin mikim in mawhpuak la in pang khawm in I sep khop ding zong I kizawn hi. Zomi Nam Ni adingin sum leh paai tampi mah kisam a I pan khop ngeina bangmah in tutung zong Khua ki pawl nate panin RM 200 leh biakna Pawlpite panin RM 300 tawh mapang khawm dingin I kizawn hi. Khua kipawlna, Pawlpi bek hi loin mimal mahmah in zong ka minam ni pawi ading kihel nuam ing a ci te zong lungdam takin kisang hi. 2020 ZOMI NAMNI Committee ZOMI NAM NI ADING PANKHOPNA HONG PIASA TE 1. ZEM Pawlpi RM-300 UN AH APPOINTMENT KILA THEI UNHCR zum ah mithak san na a lunggulh te in online pan in appointment kigen thei hi. Hih pen ei mimal tek in I om na mun pan in lak theih ding in hong gelsak uh hi a, ahi zongin ei leh ei lak ding lem a salo te in I kipawlna zum te pan zong ki hih sak thei ding hi. Tua ban ah hih appointment ngetna ah I zat Phone No. te pen khel thimthum loin hoih tak I zat ding kisam hi. Ei Zomite sungah phone No. a nawh khel mahmah om a, tua bangin I khel leh UN pan appointment hong pia in hong sap ciang contact ngahloin om leng mi dang supna hilo in ei mahmah I supna pi suak ding hi. Tua ahih manin zum ah I piak sa contact No. te it in kemcing ding zong thupi hi. Hih online pan appointme -nt lakna ei leh ei a la nuamtein ; ci-in Google ah at leng hong suak pah ding hi. Innkuan lutpih nuam a ngah thei nailo te zong online pan in appointment kila thei hi. Ei leh ei a hih thei lote in zong kipawlna zumte pan zong nisim in kihih sak den hi. 2020 ZSM LAIBU KINGAH TA HI Malaysia zomi Genvai Kipawlna (ZSM) 2020 ading ki lutthei ta a, ZSM laibu te zong kila thei ta hi. ZSM lut man mi khat ciang kum khat ai RM 20 hi a, hih na lutna hang tawh ahamsa a dong tuak I mipihte a panpih, a dah akap hun ah a khitui anulsak na hi gige hi. Hih ZSM ah member na lut na in nang a ding a pia na hikei a, panpihna akisamte a panpihna hizaw hi. A kisam khat I panpih na in Pasian deihna zong ahi hi. 2019 sungin zong tu ciangciang Zomi pih te luang (29) bang lei ah I tuh theihna in nang leh kei I pankhopna ahih bang mahin mailam ah zong mapang khawm lai dingin zong kong zawn phapha uhhi. ZEM Pawlpi RM1500 PILVANG TAK IN OM SAWM NI Tuhun laitakin kimat kihen hong tam mahmah a, Malaysia kumpite in a gam sungah phalnalo tawh om mi tampi tak siangsak nuam ahih manin kimat kihenna hong tam to semsem ding hi ci gen khia khin uh hi. Mun tampi ah Oparasi lut kawi kawi ahih manin I omna ciat ah kidawm tak, pilvang tak in om ding hanciam ni. A thukin lua mahmah ahih kei leh vakvak kei zaw ni. A diakdiakin Immigration te leh CID te uniform silh loin vakvak uh a, tua tungtawn in pawl khat in sum zon na in hong nei beh lai uh a, hong pang kawikawi in tampi pi tawh hong kitan sak uh hi. I vak suk vaktohna ah kiim leh pam zong hoih takin I et theih ding hong thupi mah mah hi. I omna veng kim veng pam ah zong gam tat zia om zia te hoih tak kidawm ciat ni. Mite mitdong ding leh midangte a nawngkaisak lo dingin kidawm ciat ni. Kimat kihen bek hiloin migilo zong tam ahih manin I kim I pam om zia hoihtak telpha in gamta ciat ni. Na sepna ah thunei te in sitna khat hong neih leh kei pen UNHCR ah gambel in hong san ding ngak in a om hi ingUNHCR card tawi gambelmi ka hihi. Ka nuntak nading hih teng ah part time tawh na a sem pak hi ing ci-in I gen theih ding thupi ding hi. Malaysia om Zomipih a kuamaciat I omna gam huihnun zia tawh kizui in kidawm ciatni cih hong zasak phapha ung. A zenzen in kimat kihenna khat natuak leh ZAM zum ah hong zasak pah in. Nang ading in a ready sa in om den uh hi. WELCOME TO ZAM Kawlgam, Vaigam, tuipigal leh gam tuamtuam pan Zomi tampi omna Malaysia ah hong zin Zomi makai ten Zomi zumpi ahi Zomi Association of Malaysia(ZAM) ah hong hawhphak hamtang in thapiakna leh idea tuam tuam piakna nong neih nadingun kong zawn phapha uh hi. ZAM ZUM AH HONG HAWH Lingthuk Khua mi, Yangon ah Mercy Baptist Church ah Senior Pastor asem Rev. Pau Khan Khual in Malaysia ah hong zin sungin Zomite a itna leh a vei na tawh kizui in ZAM zum ah hong hawh in thapiakna leh thungetsak na hong nei thei hi. Topan siapa nasepna te ah hong lawhcingsak semsem ta hen. NATGUAL (Influenza) TAWH KISAI TANGKO NA UNHCR Pan in NATGUAL (Influenza) tawh kisai tangko na ong nei uhhi. Hih natgual (influenza) natna pen huih dikna lampi (respiratory system) pan in hong lut in a kilawh baih mahmah natna namkhat ahihi. Hih anuai a dan natna bang in lim hong lah leh zato ah amanlang in kilah pah ding hoih pen hi. 1. Cisa in 38 C sang tamzawh a hihleh 2. Ci leh sa na, nungzang khut leh khe na 3. Khuasik in khua-ul nel kaikai 4. Lutang na 5. Bukkhuh 6. Thabei in gim thapai 7. Nakbing in naptui tolh den Hih natna a ngah baih phadiak te 1. Kum cing nailo naupang te leh uham sa te 2. Cina don nasem te leh naupang a kepna ah nasem te 3. Mitampi tawh a om khawm te 4. Cancer, Zatui zangte, HIV, AIDS dan in pumpi a zawmsak natna a nei te 5. Zunkhum, sikhum leh awmsung natna a nei te 6. Naupai te in ngah baih pha diak uh hi. Hih natna pan kikep kidal theih na dingin 1. A tungah natna bang kipan in limlahna te a om leh zato ah a manlangin kilak pah in. 2. Na khut siangtak in sil denin. Na nak, nakam leh na mit te na khut sawpsiang loin lawngnuai kei in. 3. Mi tam na mun peel in Hih natgual natna pan kidalna a hoih pen in 1. Khut hoih tak leh siangtak in sil den ding 2. Khuh laitak ahih kei leh sneezing laitak muk leh kam hum ding. 3. Nak, kam leh mit te khut nin tawh sawk lo hamtang ding 4. A zenzen in hidan dam loh-na na-neih leh nai 24 sungbang inn ah om in tawlnga hamtang ding. 5. Damloh laitak in natna kilawh loh na dingin midang tawh kiho, kizom selo ding 6. A thei zato lam siavuante tawh hoih tak kilak pah ding. Articles Ni Thupi Pasian Thu Khristiante Nisim Sep Ding Thuli. Agelh Kap Za Khai (Photoh) By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 7, 2023 Khristiante Nisim Sep Ding Thuli Agelh Kap Za Khai (Photoh) Jesuh Khrih pen honpa le gumpa a sangin a nung a zui khempeuhte nuntakna sungah nisim in sep ding thuli om hamtang hi. Tua thuli-te pen a thupi lo a bat hangin Lai Siangtho in hong hilh hi a, citak takin a sem zote ahi dingin i hanciam tek ding ahi hi. Tua thuli-te in: (1) Lai Siangtho simna Lai Siangtho pen Pasian thu ahih bangin eite kiangah Pasian ii direct a hong kizopna ahi hi. Pasian thu a tawntungin kip a (Late 119:89), nuntakna, vangliatna leh kicinna tawh kidimin namsau sangin hiamzaw (Heb. 4:12), bek tham loin Pasian humuap thu ahi hi (2Tim. 3:16). Topa thu kicing a, nuntakna a thaksuaksak hi. Topa thupiakna siang a, mi pillote pilsak hi. Kham sangin ahi zongin kham hoih pen sang ahi zongin tuate (Pasian thu) deihhuaizaw a, khuaizu le khuailuzu taakte sangin zong khumzaw lai hi (Late 19: 7, 10). Eite in Pasian hong kamciamna thuphate i theihtel nop ciang ahi zongin, eite tungpan Pasian in bang hong deih hiam cih i theih nading ahi zongin, Lai Siangtho simna tungtawnin a vekpi in kitheithei ahi hi. Sawltak Paul in zong thu-ummite Pasian thu nungta Lai Siangtho limtak simin kanin hanciam ding na hanthawn hi (2Tim. 2:15). Tua ahih manin ei thu-ummite in nisim nuntakna ah i tuahkhak leh i thuakkhak thulelate sungah Pasian deihna koi dan hiam cih i theihtel nadingin leh koi bangin geelin, sepkhiatna tawh nungta ding hiam cih lamman muh theih nadingin Lai Siangtho simden ding ihi hi. Zingsang tungin Lai Siangtho tang khat ahi zongin, a lian bup khat ahi zongin pongman simzo den lehang kum simin Lai Siangthobup kizo thei hi. Ahih keileh mimal thalakna in i thangahna munte bek simin lot ngah leng zong hoih hi. A thupipen ah nisim Lai Siangtho mun khat bek ta sim tangtang ding ahi hi. (2) Thungetna Lai Siangtho pen Pasian in mihingte tungah hong hopihna thubu ahih bangin, thungetna pen mihingte in Pasian tungah i hopihna, thumna, pulakna ahi hi. Thungetna bangzah in thupi cih pen Paul in, tatsat loin thu na ngen un (1Thess. 5:17) cih a hanthotna tawh kitelthei hi. Thunget nadingin thungetzia leh thunget nading mun cih bang kiciangtan lo hi. I lungsim takpi tawh thuman tak leh upna tawh thunget ding bek a thupi ahi hi. Jesuh Khrih pen eite adingin a lianpen siampi ahihna tawh kizui-in thu-ummite in Jesuh Khrih tungtawnin Pa Pasian kiangah direct in deih teng nget theihna, mawh sut theihna, pulak theihna hunpha a ngah thei ihi hi. Tua bek tham loin i thungetna khempeuhte Pa kiang ah hong thumsak dingin Pasian kiangah palai Jesuh i nei a (1John 2:1), tua manin thu i nget ciangin Pasian Tapa min ahi Jesuh Khrih min suangin thunget ding Jesuh mahmah in hong vaikhak ahi hi (Johan 14:14). I kitangsap khempeuh i ngetma in Pasian in theikhol khin mah taleh ei mahmah in i nget ngiat ding a lunggulh Pasian ahih mah bangin amah tungah thungen dingin Pasian in hong sawl a (Matt. 7:7), eite in zong i kitangsapnate Pasian tungah ngen in, i ngah thuphate hangin zong lungam koh theih ding a kisam ahi hi. Khristian khat hi napin thunget kithadah thei mah hi. Ahi zongin kam tawh ahi zongin, lungsim tawh ahi zongin thunget den ding pen Pasian deihna ahi hi. (3) Kilawmtatna Khristiante pen ei le ei bek tawh a kilungkimte hi lo ding hanga, thu-um midangte tawh kikhawl in kilawmtatna neih zel ding a kisam ahi hi. Pawlpi kipatcil hun a thu-um mi masate zong kilawmtatna mah ultungsak uh hi. Thu um khempeuh kikhawlin om khawm uh a, a neihsate uh zong a neikhawm uh hi. Amaute in a neih a lamteng uh zuak uh a, a sumte pen amau kisapna tawh kizui-in amaute lakah a hawm uh hi. Nisimin biakinn ah kikhawm uh a, a innte uhah an nekhawm in, lungdamna le kiniamkhiatna tawh a ne ciat uh hi. Pasian phat uh a, khatlekhat thupha kideihsak in a om uh hi. Pasian in nisimin hotkhiatna a ngah mi kibehlapsak tawntung hi (Sawltak. 2:44-47). Hebru 10:25 sungah zong, Mi pawlkhatte in kikhop a pelh bang hi loin, eite in kikhop khawmnate pelh loin om ni. Topa hong pai ding Ni hong naina thu thei ihih manin khatlekhat kihanthawn semsemzaw ni, ci-in kikhop loh ding lamah hanciam loin kilawmtatna ahi biakpiak kikhopna leh khatlelkhat kihanthotna lamah hanciamzawk ding na hanthawn hi. Kilawmtatna pen biakpiak kikhawlkhop nading ahi zongin, Pasian thu tawh thalakkhop nading ah ahi zongin a kisam mahmah ahi hi. Tua bangin kilawmta in kikhawlkhopna hangin khatlekhat tuahkhak thute kihawmkik thei bek tham loin kitangsapna bangin kipan in kihuh thei ahi hi. Thu-uppihte tawh a kilawmta nuam lote pen a piangthak taktakte hi lo kha ding hi. A piangthak taktakte in Pasian tawh ahi zongin, a thu-uppihte tawh ahi zongin kikholh kilawmtat nuamsa mahmah uh hi. (4) Lungdamna thugenna Jesuh Khrih lungdamna thu pen midangte tungah genkhia in teci pan ding pen thu-ummi khempeuh ii seploh a phamawh nasep in hong kisawlsa ahi hi (Matt. 28:19). Tua sawlpi sungah Jesuh a um mi khempeuh a kihel ding hi a, leitung mun khempeuh ah genkhia kawikawi in midangte Jesuh Khrih ii nungzui suahsak ding ahi hi. Tua ahih manin eite in hih leitungah Pasian ukna gam koi bangin tangzaisak thei ding ihiam cihleh lungdamna thu pen kam tawh tangkona leh lungdamna thu nuntakpihna tawh tangzaisak thei hihang. Thu-um nai lote tungah Pasian thu genkhiatna a thupi hi a, ei le ei sungah zong Pasian hoihnate teci pan ding zong kisam hi. Lungdamna thu pen a um khinte tungah zong gengen ding hi a, a um nailote tungah zong gengen ding thu ahi hi. Paul laikhakte sim lehang, pawlpite tungah lungdamna thu mah na hah genna leh lungdamna thu tawh kituak gamtat luhekzia neih ding na limgen ahihna kimuthei hi. Leitung thu nengneng peuh i kigengen sangin lungdamna thu mah kigen in kihawm ni. Tuhun ciangin mun tuamtuam ah Pasian gam a tangzai theih lohna pen Khristiante in i sep ding nasepte limtak i sep lohman ahi hi. Lai Siangtho simna tawh Pasian deih kitheitel in, Thungetna tawh Kha Siangtho vangliatna kingah in, Kilawmtatna tawh thathak la in, Lungdamna thugenna tawh hih leitungah Pasian gam tangzai theih nadingin Khristian khempeuh in lawptakin kihel dingin kong zawn hi. Mihing cilesa hihna tawh Lai Siangtho sim ding, thunget den ding, kilawmtatna bawl ding, lungdamna thugen ding kithadah hun tam ding hi. Hi thei mah hi. Ahi zongin eite in Kha Siangtho thahatna tawh mainawt tantan ding kisam hi. Mihing cilesa utna kizo sak loin Pasian deihna kizawksakna tawh hih thu li zui in masuan toto ni. Kam Za Tual (Siyan) admin 4 years ago 3 years ago 0 1 mins Thuklai khua Pu Mang Za Cin leh Pi Vung Dim te tapa hi a, 1966 kumin suak a, 1.1.2006 ni-in Kalaymyo ah hong nusia hi. M.A (History) tawh degree ngah hi. Aneu tung pan la uk mahmah a, laphuah siam, lasak siam in music zong siam kim hi. A ma laphuah leh asak te anuai a bang kong gelh hi.(1) (1993) Band-IC, Studio Lynn,(2) (1994) Band-IC, Studio Lynn ,(3 (2006) Band-IC, Studio Lynn hi a, hih la a khum laitak in hong nusia ahih manin album suak man nawnlo hi.Siyan hong nusiat zawh kum (10) cin phawk na in cih album sia Christopher, Nyipu, Sung Tin Par leh Zamnu in sa ding a, a Band pen Phus 3, arrangement pen Bo Kyin (Cin Khan Pum) nabawl in hong suak ding hi ta hi. Kai Khen Thang (Phaipi beh, Laaitui) in hongnusia ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Sihkohna: Capt. Kai Khen Thang (Phaipi beh, Laaitui) in hongnusia posted on 28 June 2018 at 12:45 am Lomkholna: Dahpihna , Laitui , News , Zomi Sihkohna: Capt. Kai Khen Thang (Phaipi beh, Laaitui) in hongnusia Asleep in Jesus: Capt. Kai Khen Thang(Retired)C.Th., B.Th., M.Div.), Kum(57), Phaipi Beh, Laaitui Laaitui khua a teng Phaipi beh Pu Pum Khaw Gin leh Pi Dim Za Cin te tapa tumpen hi a, 4.1.1961 kum in suak hi. Kumpi sangah tan 8 dong kah hi. 1980 kum in galkap tum in gam a dingin nasem a, citak kuhkal in gal hang mahmah hi. 1989 kum in Officer Training kah a, Captain dong hong ngah hi. Galmai samai ah hangsan a hih manin pahtawina tampi tak ngah hi. 2016 kum in Galkap sung pan a khawlkhit ciangin Naypyidaw Construction Deparment ah Huandok za tawh kumpi na sem hi. Tua panin Pasian sapna ngah a hih manin Tedim Christian College, Vision Bible Institute(Faith Bible Training Center) te-ah Pasian thu sin in C.Th, B.Th, M.Div te a zo hi. 1985 kum in Nu Awi Ngaih Cing (Gualnam) tawh kiteng a, tapa 2 leh tanu 3 nei hi. Khua leh tui u leh nau khual in a it mahmah hi a, minam vai leh biakna vai ah zong a hat mahmah khat a hihi. Mingalardone Zomi Baptist Church ah zong kum tampi makai sem a, Yangon Full Gospel Assembly ah zong upa khat a hihi. Bo Khen in a pum tungah galte kapna thautang them paii a, tua tawh ki zomin dam lohna tuamtuam tawh 27.6.2018(Wed) 10:00AM in Mingalardone galkap zato pi pan hong nusia hi. Bo Khen tawh hun tawpna pen 29.6.2018(Friday) 3:00PM in Yewai Christian Cemetery ah hun ki bawl khit ciangin han kitang sak ding hi. More: Taingen leh Hiangzing kikal ah mawtaw kibung, mi 5 si A zii leh a tate omna 315316, Padamya Street, 21 Htaukkyint New Ward, Mingalardone Tsp. pan 1:30PM in mawtaw 1, Insein Paakhuan pan mawtaw 1, Full Gospel Biakinn pan mawtaw 1, Sule Emmanuel biak inn mai pan 1, Yuzana Padauk lampi pan mawtaw khat ding khia ding hi. Zomi te-in i suan i muan ding makai khat i sum hi ci-in dahna thu kong taangko hi. Interview with Pu Zokhai (ZAM Founder) Zomi Daily Zomi namvai avei mahmahkhat hi a, aomna peuhpeuh ah minamvai aseptheih bangbang in ki helden hi. Tulaitak zong Pu Zokhai in Australia gamsung aom RMIT University ahzong (Staff No. e 01409) tawh Laihilh in Zolai Diploma piakkhiatna zong na neithei khinhi. Minam thu ah Zomi akici pen kamphen kullo, dawi biakna kibang ngei, lasak kibang, Laam zia kibang, zia leh tong kitel kithei teng Zomi ahihi ci hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Tutung mimal dinmun Bob Tuangpi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Tutung mimal dinmun Bob Tuangpi posted on 15 February 2021 at 9:40 pm Lomkholna: BobTuangpi , News , Politics Tutung mimal dinmun Bob Tuangpi Tutung bel kei akikal ah ( neutral) sawmmai ing. Kum-5 sung ASSK zongh theihkhin, kum-5 sung-5 USDP zongh thei khin, pute pate ban ah tukhang hunsung galkaptezia thei khin in lawp nading le gen ding kammal neikhollo mai hing. Ahizongin mipite in ih makai ding Democracy kalsuanzia tawh ih teelcing kumpi khutsung pan gambup thuneihna mungpi -3 teng thumanlo zuauthu tawh abuluh thaumuukthatang hat suang galkapte le apawl teng thukimpih ngiatlo-in asang pen mawhpaihna ka pia hi. Amanlang thei pen akhahkhiat ding uh pello akisam thukin cih ka pom hi. Thukhat ah bel kuakua in bangbang agen zongh 1974 U Thant vai buaina, 1988 buaina, 1996, 1997 buaina le 2007 buainate pan thu tampi kisin thei hi. Va kibual kha vanglak leeng lah ki uang lua in cin kei le kei ki control zaw ing. Sangkahpih minam tuamtuam khangno meltheih honpi khat mah in hong hopih in deihtak panlaak ding hong zasak tampi om mah hi. Tua ban ah tutung buaina vai pen 2020 kiteel dungzui aa kumpi mai kum -5 sung 2008 thukhunpi nuai ah kalsuan ding cih himawk hi. Alangkhat ah 2008 thukhunpi kip tetek nading lampi hibilbel hi. Tua bel ei mualmite in deih hetlo hi-hang! Tua ban ah mai kum -5 sung tutung gambup teelcing Party in kumpi ong sem kik mah leh zongh 2008 thukhunpi ciingduaipi mah tawh ong zep zel lel ding ban ah galkapte in tu aa dan mah aa a ut hunhun vua thuneihna mungpi thum teng buluh den keii lel ding hin keidinmun le ih mualmite dinmun tawh kituak ka sa kei hi. Tua teng bilbial kawmkal ah galkapte ngimnapolitical road map political agenda ka khinkhai teh tutung buaina pen vai lemzo-in um keng. Alangkhat leuleu ah gambup teelcing Party makai lamte dinmun ka et teh tutung mipi lawhcing zenzen mah leh zong Hluttaw sung pan 2008 thukhunpi puah zawh nading lampi mutuanlo ding ban vuah, tua kantan nading akician lampi sialnapolitical agenda nei hetlo uh cih tutung akalsuanzia uh ah kitel sinsen hi. 2008 thukhunpi ii piaktheih hamphatna le thuneihna ciang bek tawh ong nitum pihpih lel ding dan uh ahih teh kei mimal dinmun ( Political view) ah akikal ah om ding ka kizo hi. Hibel Democracy dan aa suaktatak keima mimal dinmun hi a, hivai ah eimah mimal khat ciat kizawhna leh dinmun ahih ban ah suaktatak thutuam kaitheihna ( Agree to disagree) mikim in anei ihihi. Hiciang dinmun akitunna pen alangnihtuak makaite in buainate kikum khawmin vailem nading geelna a omlohna hang hipi pen hi. Alangkhat tuak ah ding tekin eima panna tek aman pen hi cih makai khat le nih sialkhau kisuhna pan hong piang khia hi a, taangpi taangta in akithuak dikdek zeel ding ahihi. Kawlgam gamvai buaina khempeuh ih etkik tak ciangin minam khat le khat, kipawlna khat le khat kizahtak tuakna ( Mutual respect) omlo-in alangnihtuak ki thupi simna ( Mutual recognition) a omloh ziak hipi pen hi. Azote in aguallelte luzang ah mei-amsa buakin akhe uh tawh tuanciil nuam den ahih manin khat le khat kimuanna ( Mutual trust) a om zo nawnlo himai hi. Tua teng hang mah in azote in zoden ding, aguallelte in thuak den ding cih tawh kikalsuan mawk aa, vekpi alangnihtuakin meetkim ding ( Win win political solution) a omloh thaman agah tudong gambup le taangpi taangta in akithuak toto ahihi. Bangbang ahita zongin Democracy ading le gambup mailam khualna tawh akipiakhia mapang kumpi nasemte, biakna nasemte, khua le tui makai upa makaite le tualsung taangpi taangta kipawlna makaite akipan khangno numei pasal, nupi papi le piteek puteek aciangciang aa mapang khempeuh thupi ka sa aa, zahtakna sang pen ka pia hi. Bang hang gambup milip million 50 val mipite le gambup mailam ding ka khual uh hi, aci alangnihtuak makaite in hiciang dinmun hong tunpih mawk uh hiam! Dr. Nang Sawm Piang - Mipi La (TD No. 242) Amah Muang In - Thupha Piakna: Honorary Pastor - Amen Thum TBC-Y Chruch LENGTONG PAUNO LEH LENGTONGTE THU - SIA.DO KHUP 10:11:00 PM EVAN.LANGH DO KHUP , INNPI , LENGTONG PAU NO , ZOMI No comments Tuzingin Lengtong Pauno in hong nusia cih i za a i dah mahmah ciat hi. Amah pen lasiam bek hiloin lakam tawh laphuah siam khat hi a, ka zahtak mahmah khat ahi hi. Amah i theihna pen LIA LEH TANGTE LENGTONG lakhuite pan ahi hi. LENGTONG MUSIC GROUP HONG PIANNA Lengtong cih min pen Zomi ten nih kinei a, khat pen i tangthu sunga a mel hoih mahmah Leng Tong Hoih nungaknu hi a, a khat pen Lengtongpak kici daitung khawng a zam pak hoih namkhat ahi hi. 1977 kimin Pasian mizat Rev. Hau Lian Kham tungtawnin khangno tampitak kikhel uh hi. Tua sung pan Tg. Sua Mang, Tg. Zam Thang (Rev. Zam Thang, Grace AG, Yangon) Tg. Lam Cinte unau leh khangno pawlkhat biakinn ah la sin music sinin om den pah uh a, Tedim khangno music siam masate ahi pah uh hi. 1978 kim panin Tg. Sua Mang in Bass tumin ama naute Tg. Pau Thawn in Drum, Tg. Go Hau in Lead tumin amau unau in LENGTONGHOIH music group phuan masa uh a, Tg. Tuangpu in Rhythm tum zel hi. TEDIM AH DRUM A OM THEIHNA THU Tedim ah AG pawlpi in music tawh Pasian phatna zang masa pen uh a, Tedim khangno tampi-in music siam lawh uh hi. Sia Lianbawi (Rev.Gin Za Lian, Agape) leh Tg. Sua Mang Drum lei dingin Aizawl paito uh a, Tedim ah Drum om masa pen suak hi. Tua khit ciangin Tg. Suamang, Tg. Pau Mung leh Tg. Lianpute Lamka paitoin New Lamka a, Sia Mangtate Drum hong puasuk uh a, Lengtong music groupte drum hong suak hi. 1980 kum Sia Lianbawi vaihawmna tawh AG pawlpi in Grand Pianno khat Ks.10,000 tawh lei uh a, Tedim ah pianno om masa hipah hi. TEDIM KHUAPI AH STAGE SHOW KIBAWL Tedim khuapi sungah ni thupi a kiciamteh nite ciangin stage show (concert) bawl zel uh hi. Tua hun lai a Lengtonghoih ah lasa masate; 1. Tg. Sua Mang 2. Tg. Lengtong Kam Khen 3. Tg. Lengtong Go Lian 4. Tg. Cia Khai 5. Tg. Paupi (Si) 6. Tg. Khaipi (Pum Za Khai) (USA) 7. Tg. Eng Khual (Pyidawtha) 8. Tg. Kai Za Tuang (Si) NUMEI LASATE 1. Lia Luan San (Suamang zi) (Si) 2. Lia Zam Cing 3. Lia Sawsuai 4. Lia Thianpui 5. Lia Dimtoih (Lamsiam,Tedim) 6. Lia Cing Hau (Lamsiam, USA) 7. Bo Sing Za Nang (Lam' hilh) 8. Pa Van Kim (Thu leh la vaihawm) LENGTONGHOIH PAN LENGTONG KICIHNA THU Tedim ah pawi bawl ding ciangin kumpi phalna nget kul a, Kawllai zat kul hi. Tua lai a Tedim press ten Kawllai Hoih cih khetna laimal neilo uh ahih manin LENGTONG cih min tawh phalna ngen uh a, tua panin LENGTONG a kici suak ahi hi. Sua Mang in amau music group min tawh series khat bawlkhiat zawh nading hanciam den hi. 1981 kum ciangin tua lunggulhna a tangtun nadingin Pu Pum Kap (Lasiam Zamnu Pa) in gam leh minam a veina tawh a sum a paai bei teng na sik ahih manin LENGTONG SERIES a banbanin hong piang toto hi. Tua LENGTONG khui sungah lasa dingin Tg. Suamang in tuni a hong nusia i it mahmah Tg. Pauno na zawn ahih manin LENGTONG PAUNO ci-in i theih masakna hong suak hi. (Lengtong khui a lasate music tumte pen a khui tungah om khin ahih manin gelh nawn lo) LENGTONG PAUNO LEH LAKAM Lengtong pauno pen lasak siam bek hiloin laphuah zong siam mahmah a, numei naupang theih dingin lapau tawh la dawng tampi a phuah mah bangin Zomite ngeina kep nadingin lakam ngiat tawh a phuah zong dawng tampitak om hi. LAPAU La pau i cih dingin a khiatna ngaihsut kul loin a kitel pahpah ding a kiphuak namte hi a, ahi zongin pau zat tangpi i tualpau kammalte bel hisam lo hi. La dingin a kilawm kammal zatzia deuh om a, tua dan a zang siamte' laphuahte ngaih deuh se hi. Tua pen lapau kici hi. LAKAM Lakam i cih bel a khiatna a ngaihsut kulte ahi hi. A gentehna in i pianna Nu leh Pa i gen nop leh Tun leh Zua cih kul hi. Khangluite in Lamal pen lakam tawh a phuah bek uh hi loin a la ii thupaipi pen la thusim tawh phuak sawnsawn uh hi. A it a ngaih khat uh a gen nuam hi napi-in ni, kha, aksi, vasa, singkungte tawh genteh hamtang uh hi. A laphuah pawlkhatte uh pahtakna phatna tawh a kibat hangin a khiatna taktak i tel ciangin kiko gawpna nahi gige hi. Tuate pen La el, ci uh a, ki-elna, lungkimlohna late ahi hi. Khanglui lapite ah lakam lim zat phadiak uh a, gal la, sa la cihte pawlkhat ah lapau zong zang pha mahmah leuleu uh hi. LAPAU SANGIN LAKAM IN HONG BUNZAW HI. Kha Siangtho neilote in Kha Siangtho thupina a theih se loh mah bangin lakam theilote in lakam manphatna thei theilo uh hi. A thu kibang veve pen lapau tawh kiphuak late sangin lakam tawh kiphuakte in lakam thei lakam neite lungsim tawng dengzaw bunzaw thamtham hi. LAKAM SUNGAH LAKHA OM HI. Zomite adingin Pasian in i pu i pate tung pan gamh-in i luah suksuk ding a hong piak ahih mah bangin lakam sungah a nungta la ii kha khat om hi. Tua pen lakam siam mahmahte bekin a theihtheih a thuak (feel) theih uh thu ahi hi. Tulai khangnote in tua lakamte siam nawn lo ihih manin i Zolapite leh lakam tawh a kiphuak late ii limna leh a thuthuk zia a thei zo nawn lo ihi mawk hi. Na sungah zu a om kei leh zu kikham theilo a, na sungah Kha Siangtho a om kei leh Kha Siangtho limna kithei theilo hi, cih tawh genteh leng kitel pen ding hi. Na sungah lakam a om kei leh lakam limna na thei zo kei ding hi. A MINTHANG VANGVANG MI MASATE La tawh kisai-in mi masate minthang vangvang deuh se uh hi. Lengtong, Sihna kigo zo, Agape cih lakhui a lasate minthang vangvang diak se uh a, amaute in Pasian leh Zogam it theihna lungsim hong guan mahmah uh hi. Internet om nailo ahih manin leitung a mi minthangte tawh tehkaak nading zong om lo ahih manin minthang diak uh zong hikha ding hi. Amaute pen ki-it ngiatin a mi mahmah a kimu nuam ngiat himawk hi. Khuata lam bangah Ken lasiamte mu kha ci-in a kisial liang ka hi uh hi. LENGTONG PAUNO MIN SI LO DING HI. I it mahmah Lengtong Pauno a pumpi a sih hangin Pasian leh Zomite adingin a phuah late, a sak late nungta den ding a, a min si ngeilo ding hi. Sinai Hq (ZRA phualpi khat) kiim a khua khat a, Training zo tung te field practical kuan dan a post kihong thak ahi hi. Aihhang in Lingthuk khua pelhna dingin Haiciin khua tot kul veve hi, zingsang nai 5 ma in Haichiin khua gei kitung khinta hi, tua pan in thu kikan a, mi kava etkhiatsak uh ciangin kua mah duty omlo uh, khualai ah om uh, a sap uh ahi i Zomi te' inn building khat ah giak uh cih kitel mahmah hi.
