Tua laitak in School sak a Mualtung a om te'n van lam ngat in thau na lawnlawn uh hi. Deihna bulpi bel akhua lam pan a hong leh um khak ding uh kilau ahihman hi. Hong lut pheite pawl a khua hong tung dekta uha lam kawina mun a po mawngkung pan in meitei te mi nih in thakhat a ding kawm in na brass (kap) mawk uh ahih man in ZRA te zong lam pam leh lei lak bawh pah lian uh hi. Tua mun pan ma hong sawn theilo uh cih akitheih ciangin mualtung a om ZRA te khat kumsuk in mawngkung omna lam va brass (kapzak) suk hi. PLA te'n asak vuah mi om cih atheih uh ciangun thau leh bomb tawh kap to ta uh hi, pan zawhloh ding khop in thautang bekbek guah zuk bangin zu zuahzuah hi. Athautang zat te uh zong nih vei a puak te hilai hi. Akap khiat ciang un puak a, mun khat akhak ciang in puak kik leuleu hi. Bomb tampi tawh zong khuasung lampan leh lampi lam pan in kap ziahziah lai uh ahih man in singkung dawn te ah abomb uh puak ziahziah hi. Lampi lam ate'n lah ma hong sawn theilo, mualtung a omte lah aki heptoh uh kul ta..tua hun ah meitei te mi 3 khuasung lam a ki withdraw (nungkin) kimu a zigzag (a kawi zikzek) in tai uh hi, mualtung a omte'n tua te ban kap uh a, mi innnuai a alut dong uh kimu hi. Damdam in thauging hong dai a, kizong tuah in Lingthuk lampi ah khualbuk khat ah ZRA te kisutuah in, amau zong mangtakihemkhia ta ahihciang un ci in kuanlam a totlohna lam ah pai ding in ka kithukim uha, lui khat zuisuk suk in Singngat a ana om Zomi mi 3 omte kiangah lampi ong hilhna dingin ka ngen uh hi. Lui dung zui in ka paipai uh a India gam a khua ka tun uh ciang un nitak nai 10:00 pm hita hi. Pasian in Zomite a ompih dan leh Pasian a nei Minam ihihdan tua ni a kipan katel sinsen hi. Meitei te mi 35 full arms (avui atang tawh kidim sitset) pen ei Zomite mi 15 bek, van (thau) tawi mi 12 khawng hilel ding hi. Khua lam a lut dinga hong taiphei lai un meitei te'n ana kap na uah, ih cadre (galkap) khat athau magazine (thautang bawm) kha vang kha, adang khat a bag rucksack (thung ip) ataklam liang a agui kap tan uh, Mualtung a omte belh ding Singkung a lian om vetlo ahihhang galte' bomb te'n amau mun kha ngei lo, khat in apam ua singkung gei kha in abomb hu bek in zap kha. Meitei te pen thautang, thau, bomb bukim mahmah uh, thautang khat na kap a na panmun na laih pah kei leh bomb in hong deng ziahziah ding hi. Anungta Pasian a nei Zomi te pen Pasian in ompih den ahihman in galvan bek hilou in, ikikona husa nangawn in zong nasem mawk hi. I mipih Zomi te asih a liam khak ding uh ki khual lo hizen leh Meitei te tampi si ding uh hi, ahihhang in Meitei makai pa' omna Zomi te zong gal banga ki ngaihsun lo in, itna tawh aki et man in amah buaina ding bangmah akigel lo ahi hi. Tua hikei leh khuavak ma a khuasung ah kikapna piang khin ding hi. ZRA te'n Pasian ki muang mahmah a, Thautang khat i nei zong in i gal te kidelh ngam hi. Tua mahmah hi hong lauhna pipen uh. ZRA in na khatpeuh a sep kuan ciangin lungsim saupi nei a, i khua te ah va om zo den ding, va vengbit zo den ding ihih vet kei leh na vasep pen saupi poi pha hi. Mipi in thuak thei a hausa in zong thuak ding ban ah amipi te mahmah zong kawl galkap te'n bawlsia gawp thei lai hi. Tua ahih man in mipi' thuakding khualna tawh adiak in kawlgam lam ah ki gamtang mengmeng nuamlo hi. Tu'n sung khat pan piang hi ngeingei hang e laizom Zomi teng aw. Galsiam sasiam nam Zosuan tateng in ih siamna gawmtuah thei in zatsiam hileng sim leitung ah kuama' ta in hong nang zolo ding hi. Zogam Galkap ZRA damsawt hen ! Note' itna sung ah Mung Laan Thang Zangkong AUSTRALIA KUMPI IN "ZOMI" THEIHPIH TA 7:08:00 PM ZOMI Thumasa: Myanmar Census 2014 result kicing 2017 kum kipat sung hong kipuangkhia ding cih thuging kiza hiauhiauta hi. Tua tawh kitawizawn-in Australia ah Minam min leh Pau adingin ZOMI pen Australian Kumpi hong sansak zo ahihlam hong gennuam ing. 2016 August kha sungin Australian Kumpiten Australia gambup Census hong kaikhawm uh hi. Tua result kicingte pen April 2017 in hong taklang dinguh ci hi. 2016 Census ma in anunungpen Census ahih leh 2011 lai in khat vei na kikaikhawm khinta hi. Tua 2011 Result tungtawnin Australia Kumpi in Australia sunga kizangh kampau thupi tampi sungah ZOMI kampau thak zong 15 July 2016 in Language (Lai leh Kam Picing) khatin Code Number (6105) tawh na lut thaksak ta uh hi. Australian Standard Classification of Languages (ASCL) kici Pau Kizanghtam leh Lai Picing ciaptehna sungah ZOMI lai leh ZOMI pau cih hong kiguang khin cihna ahihi. ZOMI Kicitangtang Ciat Tani: ZOMI bekmah zangh leng midangten zong ZOMI mah hong ci lelding hi. Mi hong cihding ngak masak ding hilo-a, hong kicih nadingin ei adeihteng leh asangtheitengin i zat masak ding hipah hi. ZOMI cih kammal gawm leh awsuah mahmah pen tulaitak Tedim, Tonzang, Chikha, Kalaymyo leh Tamu khuapite ah ateeng Tedim Chin kici in namdangte leh Kawl Kumpi in hong kiciamteh tengin akideihkim min leh kammal hi cileng kikhial loding hi. Ahizongin hih ZOMI min leh kammal pen i deihzah bangin kuaman kizanghlo, kizumpih ngamlo hi cileng zong kikhiallo ding hi. ZOMI Zatzia Ding Lunggulhna: Minam (National) min pen ZOMI ah kipsak ni. Beh leh Phungte leh ZOMI kikimsak khaden kei ni. Ei Phung min khawng peuh khualna leh amanthan ding lauh manin ZOMI pen alangpan tampi om hi. Pawlkhatin ZOMI omngei kei, Tedim Chin kicih ding hi, letkip ding hi acizong om hi. Gentehna pakin enleng, 1980 ma in Mizoram leh Mizo Tong cih om ngeilo cileng kikhial loding hi. Ahizongin amau tun omsak zota uh hi. Minam min MIZO mahin kisam tangtangta in, apau uh zong MIZO tong(pau) mah kici hi. Minam min MIZO ahihmanin MIZO tong mah kicipah hi. Minam min ZOMI i kicih leh i pau zong ZOMI pau cihding banghang hamsa samawk i hi hiam? Ei sungah kitelsiam mah taleng gamdang miten hong tel zolo uh hi. Gamdang Australia khawng, USA khawng ah minam min ZOMI kipiaciat napin na pau bang ahia?(What language do you speak?) hong kicih ciang atamzaw in ZOMI kici ngamlo mawk hi. Pawlkhat in, Zopau, Tedim, Tiddim Chin, khawng peuh kici ziazua mawk hi. Tua hangin Kumpite ciaptehna leh amau muhna ah ZOMI cikim leeng khat suak ziau ding kimlai atuamtuam in hong ngaihsuunta uh hi. Mangkangten hong dot ciang kei ZOMI ka hi, ka pau zong ZOMI mah hi cih ding hita hi. Ei ngaihsutna ah tua pen ahaivai tawh kibang khading hi, ahizong ZOMI kiciten ZOMI language mah i pau ding angeina hizel hi. Mizoten Mizo Tong acih tangtang bangin ZO Tong cise lo uh hi. Laigelh siamte leh Laibu tuamtuam abawl ding ten hih thu nong ngaihsut mahmah dinguh thupi ding hi. Lai Siangtho khawng zong ZOMI version mah citangtang zoleng vaisiang ding hi. Tun ZOKAM, TEDIM CHIN cih khawngin kiciamteh bialbual mawk hi. Khangthakten ZOMI i zatngam giap ding thupi ding hita hi. Australia gam sung bangah Kumpi nasepna leh Zum tuamtuam ah Mangkang pau atheikhin dingin hong lamen hetlo uh hi. Tua hangin Multicultural Minister Vuankyi bang hong koihsak in, phone set nuam leng zong Kamphensakna (Translation Services) akhongin hong koihsakden uh hi. Tua services te i zat ciang i min lawh leh i pau zatzia kibanglo ahihman in amau zong theilo mawk uh hi. Gentehna in genleng, NAATI akici The National Accreditation Authority for Translators and Interpreters Kumpi website sung enleng ei ZOMI tading mun nih bang(Chin-Tedim leh Zo (Zomi) kici mawk hi. Tua nih pen ei muhna ah kibang himah leh i piakdan leh i lawhdan kibanglo ahihmanin Kumpite ciahptehna hong om hipah hi. Translation and Interpreting Service kici Kumpite muan mahmah service website ah pen amanadik lianin hong gelhsak (Zomi a dialect of Chin kici in taklang hi) uh hi. Ahizong Migrant Resource Centre munte ah CHIN-Tedim ciin kikoih leuleu hi. Mailam-ah I Kalsuan Zia Ding ZOMI hing cihtangtang ding. ZOMI language khatin Australia Kumpi in Code (6105) hong piak khit nungsang i kampau (language) i cih i gen ciang zong ZOMI mah cita ni. Hih language code tungtawn in mailam ah Ethnic Radio Program khawngah ZOMI language min tawh Slot(hunseh) kingenkingah thei ding hi. Language code kinei ta ahihmanin nidang ciang ZOMI tawh kisai thugenna leh laigelhna tuamtuam, laibu bawlnate ah zong ZOMI mah cih i zat ding hita hi. Translation services i zatding ciangin ZOMI language hong sapsak un cita ni. Forms tuamtuam leh Kumpi zum tuamtuam ah minam leh kamapu hong kidotnana ah ZOMI zat ding hi. Mailam-ah Census tuamtuam aomkhak leh ZOMI cih akipsa hisak ni. Australia Khuapi khat ah Zomi Huaiding kipawlna(gentehna Zomi Innkuan) khat bek neih ding hi-a, tua kipawlna pen Biakna Pawlpi tawh kideidan loin tha i piak ding ahi. Pasian nasemte(Pastors) ahih nak leh minam makai in koih loh ding hi-a, amau pen minam makaite ataingam ding leh asiatnate uh akawk ngam dingin aomding hizaw hi. Thukhupna: Australia gam sungah ZOMI kiciantakin Kumpi in hong ciamteh khinta cih kilang hi. Language Code hong pia khin ahihmanin tua ZOMI Language azangh atamsemsem leh hong taangzai semsem ding hi cihna hi. Lungneu lo takin ZOMI dialect ciang hilo-a, Language pikhat ahicih phawkden ni. Tua ahihmanin namdangten na ZOMI pau uh hong sinsakhilh in acihciang ei khua pau peuh, awkaih neuneu peuh sinsak loding hi hangh. Taangpi zat leh theih ahi Tedim pau pen Tedim Pau cici nawnlo in ZOMI pau cita ding hi hangh. Nasep Na Kheel Cianga Theih Ding Pawlkhat Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Nasep Na Kheel Cianga Theih Ding Pawlkhat Hau Za Cin posted on 17 July 2014 at 11:26 am Lomkholna: Article , Hauzacin Nasep Na Kheel Cianga Theih Ding Pawlkhat Tuhun pen nasep a kip, a kho cih om nawn mello in a hoihzaw nasep a om nak leh kum thum kum li zawh ciang nasepna thak ah mite a kisuan ziahziah uh hi. Hih pen tuhun leitung paidan hipianta hiam cih theih hi. Leitungbup khuata banga olno taka a kizop ziauziau theih khit zawh hih banga nasep khek ziauziau pen hong tam semsem hi. Tua banga nasep na kheel ciangin maitak takin na sepna lui nusia inla, na seppih luite zong kuamah nopmawhna dingin kampau, gamta kha kei in. Amau zong hun hong pai zel leh nangmah tawh hong kituahkhawm kik, nangmah tawh hong semkhawm kik kha thei hi. Tua manin, bangzahta in na seppihte na mudah, na hua phial zongin a kimukik dinga kikhenpak bangin lungdam maitai takin kikhen zaw un. Tua hileh na paisante in zong hong muhna ah picing hong sa ding uh a, na kimuhkik uh zong nuam ding hi. Nasep na laih ding ciangin na paikhiat ma in hih a nuaiate hih teitei in; na kisik kei ding hi. 1. Na tungsiahte tawh kitelsiam, kiho khin masa hamtangin: Nang hong makaih, hong kem, hong panpih, hong huh leh hong pattah na tunga panu tawh na paikhiat ding vai limtak kiho masa in. Kiho masa cih ciang na tawpna ding laikhak na piak ma in na tungsiahate kiangah na mailam khualna hang tawh na tawpnop thu leh nasep dangah na pai a kuldan theisak, hilh, telsak masa hamtangin. Amau hilh masalo, theisak masalo in thakhat thu in tawpna lai khak veva kei in. Lamdang sa ding uh a, zong hong muhna uh kiam ding hi. Na tawp sawm hangin na sep hun sung khempeuh kuhkal tak, citak tak a nasep ding khempeuh na zawh ding thu hilh in. Na sep nunung ni ciang dong hahkat takin nang sepding teng sem khin in. Kilawmthawsak leh kikhutzaw sak in om kha kei in. Na tungsiahte hoihtak in hilh, telsak lecin amau a kilawma pusuak dan leh nasep khawldan nangawn hong hilh in hong makaih toto lai nuam ding uh hi. 2. Lungduai hamtangin: Na tawp ding vai na gen, na theihsak ciang na tungsiahte in hong hehsanin hong thangpaihbawl, hong nuakbawl kha thei ding hi. Ahi zongin lungduai takin om tentan in la, nang bel heh sawm het kei in. Na heh phial leh zong kidek teta inla, na lawmte leh na seppihte muhna ah na hehna lakkhia kha kei in. Na mawhna hong zongin na thanemna dingin hong bawl kha ding uh a, na nopmawhsak theihtheih dingin zong hong gamta nuam phial dinguh hi. Ahi zongin lungduai in maitai ding hanciam hamtang in. Na nasepna na laihnop manin na kisuanlah nading omlo a, nopmawh nasak nading zong omlo hi. Mite in hong engbawl hangin na hehna ding om tuanlo a, na kidek zawh leh nang mailam adingin hoih penpen hi. 3. A kisam khempeuh hih mengmengin: Nasep na tawp ding ciangin na tawpma in na hih ding pawlkhat om thei hi. Tuate bangteng hiam cih kanin thei inla a manlang theithei in hihkhin mengmeng in. Na ni nunung pen a tunma in na hih ding khempeuh zo hamtang in. Nasep nawnloh ciang na va khuadak dawkdawk kik kul nawnlo dingin kiva setset in. Na sum ngahzah ding, na nitha bangzah omlai cihte limtak in tuatkhin in. Na tawpna ding vai a saite tawh kithuza inla na tawpna lai zong a hunlap in pia in. 4. Na tawp ni dong nasep hanciam in: Na sep ni nunung pen dong hahkat takin sem inla, a tawp ngeilo ding bangin hanciam in. Tua bang hileh na lawmte lungsim ah a zingciangin zong nang a kuanlai dingin na koihphial ding uh hi. Nang sepdinga hong kipia peuhmah na zawh man zahzah zo hamtang inla, kiziakai sak tuam het kei in. Na tawp ding manin na lawmte tawh na kizopna tatsak kei inla, lawmhoih bangin kikhawlthei suak un. Na kizoppih suak nopte a min uh leh a kizopna dingte lai tawh ciamteh in kipia tuah un. 5. Hong zol uh hang ngaihsun pha mahmah in: Na tawp ding hong it lua bang phial in hong it bawl in hong deih bawl in hong kho nuam kha ding uh hi. Na khasum nangawn hong behlapsak in hong semsak nuam lai mai ding uh hi. Na za hong khan in na hihna hong behlap in makai dingin zong hong lamto nuam kha ding uh hi; ahi zongin limtak in ngaihsun pha mahmah in. Banghang hiam cih leh mite genna ah, a theite genna ah, tua banga a kikhohte a kideih kei kik vat leh manlang takin kinotkhia, kitawpsak in kipampaih hi, ci uh hi. Hong deih lai un hong deih mahmah uh hangin hong deih nawnloh uh ciangin hong nawh nawlkhin mahmah ding uh hi. Na tawp nop thu a theih khit uh ahih manin amau lam pan paulap ding ol mahmahta hi. A tamzaw tua banga kikhote kum khat val sem zom zo mello hi kici hi. Banghang hiam cih leh na mawhna a zonnop uh leh na sep ut nawnloh thei uh, hong deih kei le uh zong na ut nawnlohpi, na tawpsawm khin veleh hong ci lel ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin na tawp ding a kitheih khit cianga hong kikhoh a, hong kilettaang nop leh limtak in ngaihsun kik masa in: Sakhi nangawn in zong a tatna ding kuam kua khual kici sam hiven! Tua ahih manin pasal in na sawmsa khat pen nungkik lo in lungdam maitai takin phusuak vet zaw in. Ahi zongin na sepna ah citak in na hih peuhpeuh hanciam na hi cih lak khial ngei kei in. Tua hileh na lawm leh gual, na seppihte in mi citak, mi kuhkal, a nasepna ah muanhuai, ngimna kician nei, a sawmna khat ah kip tinten ciin hong ciamteh dinga, hong pakta semsem ding uh hi. Hong kipakta peuh leh hong kizahtak ding hamsalo hi. Tua pen mihing khat thupina a kilatna hi a, mihoih a hong kiciamteh nading ahi hi. Na omna peuh ah nahoih sep khawlsan ngei kei in. COPE TOPA NUNTAKNA ATOM IN GENNA Thupatna: Pasian in mihingte a mangthang dingin hong deih lo ahih manin Amah mah in mite hong zonna Piancil sung, Eden huan sung pan i mukhia thei hi. Tua hi-in Lai Siangtho lui sungah a mangthang ding mihingte Amah mah in a zon hun, Kamsangte zangh in a zon hun zong om hi. Lai Siangtho thak hun ciangin a Tapa Jesuh hong zangh hi. Zomite lakah 1910 kum ciangin a mangthang ding Zomite a zong dingin Cope topate nupa hong zangh hi. Tua Cope topa i cihcih pen Pasian zatzia leh Zomite hamphat zia, Pasian in eite adingin a tuam vilvel a hong puak ahihna tawmcik a nuai a thulunote tungtawn in ih ensuk ding hi. 1. Cope Topa Pianna: Pasian thu, Zolai leh Zomite thangthu a kigen simin Cope topa thu kihel lo-in thuguipi cing thei mahmah lo hi. Banghang hiam cih leh Khamtung gam ah Pasian thu gen dingin 1899-1966 kikal sung America gam pen a hong pai innkuan sagih pha hi. Tuate in Carson, East, Cope, Woodin, Strait, Nelson leh Johnson-te innkuan hi-in tua innkuante sung panin 5-te in Haka phualpi pan nasem uh aa, Cope leh Nelson-te innkuan in ahih lehTedim phualpi pan hong sem uhhi. Rev. Dr. J.H Cope pen America gam Pennsylvania State, Philadelphia khuapi, Germantown veng ah teng uhhi. A pa Joseph leh a nu Elizabeth Danford Cope sung panin November 21, 1882 ni-in suak hi. A nu pen India, Assam gam, Gawhati khua thuhilh mangpa tanu ahi hi. Kum 11 a phak ciangin Germantown Second Baptist Pawlpi sungah a min pia in tawpidaw suak hi. A nu leh a pa in zong sangsia semtek uh in tua khua mahah Nipi sang (Sunday school) sia sem uhhi. A ma minpi in Joseph Herbert Cope hi. Pasian thu khuavaak hong puakpa, Zolai hong phuatsakpa, Lai Siangtho hong teisakpa, Labu hong teisakpa, Sangukpipa leh Zomite nuntak khuasak zia hong lamsangpa, Mi thum nasep a sem, a gim theilo tawh a kibang ngilhmawh Sangmangpa ahi hi. 2. Pasian thu (Khuavak) Hong Puakpa Hi: Cope topa pen Zogam hong paima, 1900 kum ciangin North East High School panin tan sawm hong ongkhia hi. B.Sc degree a ngah khit ciang in kum khat sung Utah gam Morman mite kiangah missionary sem hi. University a kah hun lai a kipanin khamangthang a vei khinsa hi aa, gammial nasep kum khat a sep khit ciangin Lai Siangtho sang hong kah hi. 1908 kum in B.D. degree ngah hi. 1908 kum mahin Northern Baptist kikhoppi Oklahoma khua ah tung aa, amah zong pawisim in pai hi. Gamdang thuhilh ding a puakpawl (Baptist Mission Society)te President pa Dr. Haggard in J.H. Cope kiang ah Kawlgam khamtung (Chin Hills) ah na pai ding hi a ci hi. Cope in Chin Hills kicihna mun za ngei nailo ahih manin, Koi mun hi peuhmah hiam? Gamlim sungah na zong dih in, ci-in a lawmnu sikkhau sat hi. A lawmnu in zong ka punote khat in Gamtawh kisai laibu (Gezetter) nei in tua sung hong en ning, tuakhit ciangin sikkhau hong sat ning ci hi. Tua laibu a et ciangin Kawlgam nitumnalam, gam mong khat, kuamah a ukzawhnai loh (Unadministrated) gam khat kici hi ci- in a zing ciang sikkhau thuk kik hi. J.H. Cope leh a lawmnu Elizabeth Caldwell 1908 kum September kha ni 3 ni in hong kiteng uh hi. Zogam khuavak puak dingin September kha 30 ni-in Boston khua pan tembaw tuangin hong dingkhia pah uhhi. Cope topa Kawlgam hong paiding ciangin a pawlpi (First Baptist Church, German Town, Philadelphia)-te kam vaikhakna hong nei hi. Tua a vaikhak kammal pen Tu-in kei Pasian thu a za nailo Kawlgam saklam Zomite lakah khuavak puak dingin va pai ding hing, Cidam in kong ciahkik ngeingei leh ka min hong khel un ci hi. Missionary sem dingin hong kuankhia pah a December 21, 1908 ni-in Haka khua hong tung hi. Carson topa pen April kha sungin na si khin ahih manin Carson tonu leh Dr. East-te tawh tawlkhat sung Haka ah Pasian nasepna (Gupna thugenna) leh Zo pausinna hong nei hi. Khamtung gam leitaw lam, Haka phualpi ah ah Dr.Hjalmar East in hong sem in, leilu lam Tedim ah Missionary phualthak sat dingin Cope-te innkuan hong dingkhia aa, November 1, 1910 ni-in Tedim hong tung uhhi. Tua Tedim hong tunni pen Tedim gam adingin khuavak tanni, Nisuahni, Suahtak ni cih ding himawk hi. Banghang hiam cih leh Pasian thu a thei nai lo, minam picing khat hih nading a kisam ahi Lai kineilo, khuamialpi lak a om nuntak khuasak zia bangmah a thei nailo Tedimte lakah nasep a kipat ni hipah hi. Hong tunni pan a kipan in pausinna leh gupna thu genna nei pah ngelhngelh hi. Pasian in thupha pia in a nini in Pasian thu-um kibehlap toto sak ahih manin 1913 kum ciangin Tedim gamah mi 91 tuiphum hi. 3. Zolai Hong Bawlsakpa Hi: 1885 kumin Mangkang kumpi in Kawlgam buppi a lakkhit, 1891 kum ciangin Zagam zong hong lato zo uhhi. Gam ukna phualpi pen Haka khua ah hong phut uhhi. Surgeon Major A.E. Newland in Haka khua ah nasem in om a Haka numei melhoih mahmah khat tenpih hi. Haka pau hong sinpah in A Practical Handbook of the languge of the Lais as Spoken by the Kakas cih laibu khat bawl in 1897 kum in hawmkhia hi. Mangkam leh Hakha pau Dictionary bu masa penpen hi ci-in kiciamteh hi. Sangmang A. Carson in Biakna thu hilh theih nangin Lai hilh masak ding kisam cih thu hong mupah in Yangon A.B.M phualpite thukimna tawh piangthaksa Kayin sia pawlkhat Zogam ah hong sam to in Zomite Kawllai tawh laihilh hong kipan uhhi. 1900 kum in Sia San Win in Haka khua sang naupang 7 tawh sang neu khat hong (Phuan) in sang masapen hipah hi. Rev. J.H. Cope in lailam siam (linguists) thum hong tonpih in Newland leh Carson-te maban hong zomto in Haka leh Matupi gam a zat ding Lai, Falam gam adingin Laizo, leh Tedim gam a zat ding Tedim lai hong bawlkhia hi.Tua bang in hong hanciamna sung panin 1913 kum ciangin Zolai Simbu khat hong bawlkhia zo hi. Khuakhal sangkhak sungin nitak sang (night Class) in sinsak zel hi. Ama bawlsa laigelhzia, lai ngeina (orthography) a kip nadingin hanciam tak in kum 30 sung bang Cope topa mahmah in hong puah toto a tuni dong ih zat Zolai ahi hi. 4. Lai Siangtho leh Labu Zolai in Hong Teisakpa Hi: Missionary sep kawm leh khuan ciah hun nangawn in tawlnga vetlo a Cope topa nasep thupi mahmah khat in laitei (Translation) nasep ahi hi. Khualzin hun, khuan ciah hun sungin zong annek leh ihmut kikal longal in Zo Lai Siangtho leh Labu tei ngelhngelh hi. Tua kawm mahin Sang Laibu, Khrisitan Biakna lai, Tedim Thukizakna Lai cihte tatsat lo-in bawllai tazen hi. Lai Siangtho I neihcil pen Matthew hi a 1915 kumin Cope topan hong teisak ahi hi. Tuabangin tawlnga man lo in laitei nasep hong semsem in Thu Ciamthak (New Testament) 1932 kumin zo hi. Piancilna leh Paikhiatna zong teikhin zo a a laidal (manuscript) in om hi ci-in kiciamteh hi. 1914 kum in dawng 20 val a pha Labu bawl in, 1918 kum in la dawng 101 a pha labu khat teikhin hi. 1923 kum in dawng 283 a pha labu leh 1927 kum in kawng 300 a pha labu bawl hi ci-in kiciamteh hi. Zomite ading in Laibu nam 36 gelh hi ci-in a kiciaptehna tampi om hi. 5. Zogam Buppi Sang Ukpipa Hi: Haka khua hong tunphet in Carson tonu tawh sangsia sem hi. Khualzin hat in thugen a siam banah lailam kivalua ahih manin Mangkang kumpi in 1925 kumin Khamtung gambup sang Ukpipa (Honrrary Inspector of Schools) tavuan za pia hi. Khasum ngah lo hi. Tua kumpite sang a zat ding laibu khempeuh bawlsak hi. Tuabangin khamtung gambup sang ukpipa tavuan a let manin Sangmangpa cih min a ngah ahi hi. Cope topa in Pasian thugen, Lai teilet nasepte a sepnate leh Sang laisimbu tampi hong bawlsaknate banah in leitung sangte khempeuh ah sangukpi a sepna hangin Mangkang missionary-te khempeuh in zong sangmangpa cih min ngahlawh uhhi. 6. Sum le Pai tawh Zong Zogam Hong Vaan Hi: Khamtung gambup sang ukpipa a sepna hangin Mangkang kumpi in Khualzin nading in a piak (T.A) Rs. 700- ngah hi. Tua sung panin Tedim thu kizakna lai hawmkhia hi. Tua bek thamlo in I gam le i lei kepcing theih nading leh guahtui mantak in i ngah nadingin kumpi Singhalh (Cuvuai) hong bawlsak hi. Hi cuvuai hong bawlsakna hang in Yangon Governor-pa in pahtawina sum Rs.2000- pia hi. Tua sumte tawh nitak sang hong phuan in lai hilhna leh sia cialna in zanglai zensam hi. Pilna siamna leh thagui thatang bek thamlo a sum leh a paai tawh Zomite adingin na hong sem hi. 7. Doctor Divinity Kipia: Khamtungmite adingin pilna siamna, sum le paai, thagui thatang tawh mipil thum nasep (Translator, MissionaryPreacher, Educator) a sepzawhna hangin June 10, 1935 ni-in New York, Colgate University panin Cope topa Honorary Degree of Doctor of Divinity (D.D) kipia hi. Cope topa Doctor a kipiak laitak in tua University a Dean-pa in hibangin gen hi. Kuhkal tak in nasepna leh lungkia ngei lo a hanciamna tawh khamtung mite kam nam 40 val pen nam 4 in gawmtuahsak hi. Laigelhzia ngina kip bawlsak a, Sang laisimbu bawlsak hi. Ham namtampi tawh labu bawl a, kam nam khat tawh Lai Siangtho thak (Tedim Lai Siangtho) letkhia hi. Pau nam tuamtuam tampi tawh Lai Siangtho thak sung mun tampi letkhia hi, ci-in mipite mai-ah genkhia hi. 8. A Nuntakna Ni Hong Tumta: 1938 kum April kha pawlin Khanglam, Kawlgam gamgi neh tengah thuhilhsia phengvak pawlkhatte hangin thu nawngkaina tampi om ahih manin J.H.Cope leh Col. Burne-te tua thu vaan dingin va zinkhia uhhi. Hih a khualzin hunsung uh guahzu a, lampi haksa hi. Lampi ah guahthuak in kawt gawp uhhi. J.H.Cope in gilsan natna leh nattun natna hong ngah sawnsawn ahih manin sakol tung tuangin khualgamlapi panin hong ciah hi. Hakha myone Sulkhua a tun uh ciangin sakol tung tuangzo nawn lo aa, tua pan Rev. Sang Fen tai 50 val bang a gamla Haka khua ah thuko dingin a paisuak vingveng hi. Haka khua panin a hithei bangbang in siavuante tawh kithuah in va dawn kik uhhi. Cope topa gimluata ahih manin taal in kizawng aa Haka hong tun uhhi.Hih hun in Cope topa gim mahmah ta hi. Haka panin Tedim a om Cope tonu sikkhau sat uh aa, Cope tonu in sikkhau a ngahphet in vuandokpa Thomson tawh a zing ciangin hong delhpah uhhi. Falam gun lei a tun ciangun J.H. Cope June 11, 1938 ni 5:00 a.m. hunin Cope topa nuntakna nite hong tumta cihna thu lai ngah uhhi. Tua lai Cope tonu in a sim khit phetin thum ding, mau ding, kap ning ci lo-in, Mi thum nasep a sem a gim theilo tawh a kibang mi khat nuntakna beita hi. a cih khit ciangin Haka a om tapidaw-ten limtak na vui un ci in vaikha aa, Tedim ah nasep mabante sem dingin hong kileh kikpah vingveng hi. Haka biakinnpi gei Rev.A.E.Carson kivuina han kiangah June 12, 1938 ni-in kivui hi.Tua sihvuina mun ah Dr. Strait makai in tualai ah Strait in hibangin gen hi. Pasian thuhilh sangmang khat hihna tawh Dr. Cope in Topa ading nasepna ah ama khangualte sangin kipia zozaw hi. Ahih hangin hih thupen ama thu a telmahmahte bek in phawk a, ama pumpi a kipiakna hangin bangmah kisuangtak ngeilo-in nungta hi. Ama ngaihsutna in a biak Pasian adingin zatkhiat ding leh ama pumpi mahmah kipumpiak ding ahi hi. Ama lawmte leh amah a theite in amah pen a tawntung in phawk a, mi pawlhuai mahmah, a migi mahmah leh a lungduai mahmah khat in ciamteh uh hi. A biak Topa nuntakna bangin amah in thuhoih sem dingin hong kipia hi ci hi. Hibang in a missionary a seppihte in zong ama nasep zawhnate lamdangsa phialmawk uhhi. 9. Cope Topa Kivui Ni Kumpi Laan A Laizang ah Kikhai: Cope topa sihvui ni-in Haka khua ah Naylor mangpa in Dr.Cope zahtakna in Haka a kumpi zumte khempeuh khaksak a kumpi laante khempeuh zong (Half mast) laankhuam lang bekah khaisak in supna, dahna lianpite kilangh sak hi. Pasian nasem khat a sih manin kumpi-in a laante a laizang ciangah khai-in kumpi zumte kikhak a, dahna a kilat sak pen khamtung gamah a masapen leh amah bek hiding hi. 10. Cope tonu Kam Vaikhakna Hun: Cope tonu in a pasal tawh a sep mabante a sep khit ciangin a ciah ding hong kulta hi. Tonzang a Rev. Vial Nang vaikhak in July 18, 1938 ni-in Tedim Biakinnpi sungah hun nunungpen mangpha khakna biak kikhop bawl khawm uhhi. Sia Vial Nang thugen dingin kithawi a Cope tonu a ciah ding a ngaihsut ciangin dahin lunglen huailua mahmah ahih manin a khitui tak ngelhngel thapai in thu gen thei phalo hi. A nunung ciangin Cope tonu in thugen in a khitui luang ngelhngelh na pin a thugen themcik zong hoi lo-in hihbangin gen hi. Kei a ciah dingin hong kisamta hi. Banghang hiam cih leh kei ka ciah kei leh Sangmang a thak hong pai lo ding hi. Tua ahih manin a manlang theithei in ka ciah ding kisam hi. Lungkham kei un, Topan hong kem ding hi ci hi. Tonu leh pawlpi mite hun nunung kamvaikhakna a man ciangun Cope tonu pusuak in khuangzang mual (U Suan Khan Khamte inn mai) ciang thu-ummiten kha-in khut kilen in kap kawmkawm mahun lunglen khuangaihna tampi tawh mangpha kikhak uhhi. 11. Cope Topa Hong Zat Ni le khate: Cope topa khamtung gam hong tunzawh thum vei a khuan va ciah hi. Khamtung gam sung a om hun sung khempeuh Kum 25 leh kha 7 (Ni 9419) sawt hi. A khuan ciah hunteng ni 1345 sawt hi. America gam pan hong dinkhiat a kipan a sih dong kum 29 leh kha 7 sawt hi. Tua a khuanciah hun sungin zong tawlnga hithiat tuan lo in Lailet (Translator) nasepte semkawm veve hi. 12. Cope topa leh Tulai Zomite Dinmun: Cope topa hong pailo hizen leh Zomite tulai khuahun luanzia in hong taisan in mite nungah a om denkeei dingte ihi hi. Khua hun paizia manlanna tawh kizui in Mipilte in min tuamtuam na vawh uh aa, The age of Knowledge ci-in pilna hun ci-hi. Tuabangin min a kivawh zah khat in Zomite zong pilna kihanciam in siingdang eng lo, tanbang kim in a ki-om hita hi. Tua bek tham lo in leitung khantohna tawh kizui in mindang khat kivawhna omlai aa The age of Globalization ci-in tua hun sungah khantohna tampi om in siatna lam zong tampi mah khang hi. Khantohna manlang mahmah in na hoih tampi a khantoh mahbang in siatnate zong tampi khangto hi. Tuabangin siatna leh phatna tampi khangto in Leitung a kalsuan laitak in a hoihte zuithei in siatnate i pelh theihna zong Cope topa hong vawh khaici hang hitazen hi. Zomite in khantohna delhtum in Kiim le paam ah siattheihna leh natna tuamtuamte in hong umcih ahihna thu kiphawk aa AIDSHIV cihbangin a dam theilo natnate hong laang mahmah hangin Pasian thu in hong kem hi. Nupa sung, khualzinna, a tuamtuamte ah kikep siam ding kihanciam in Lai Siangtho tawh kituakin I nuntakna pen I ngah khak Cope topa khaici hang ahi hi. Khantohna tawh kizui in mite khuaneu panin khuapi liante ah kizuan ngeingai ahih manin tuhun pen The age of Urbanization ci-in min vawhna zong na nei uhhi. Hitakpi hi. Khuano sung sangin khuapi sungah pilna, sumzonna, khantohna, thumuhnate omzaw ahih manin khuapi kizuan ngeingai himawk hi. Ahi thei zah in khuapi sung zuat ding kihanciam keei hi. Khuapi sung zuatna hangin midangte tawh pilna, neihna, khuamuhnate hong kikim theita ahih manin I hamphatna lianpi ahi hi. Hih leitung pen Upna tuamtuam neite tenkhop ngeingaina leitung ahih manin mipilte in leitung min na vawh uh aa Pluralistic World na ci uhhi. Hilua hi. I kiim le paam ah Buddist-te, Hindu-te leh Pasian thu um lo mitampi tawh i teng khawm ngeingai hi. Amau upnate sung pan a hoihte laksak in ei Khristian-te upna I hawpsawn ding Cope topa hong nusiat khaici hoih khat ahi hi. Cope topa hong puak Pasian thu in ei Khristian-te bek lo in upna kibang lo midangte tawh zong hong kilem sak hi. Tua upna tuamtuam a neite tawh I tenkhopna hih leitungah Cope topa hong puak Pasian thu khahsuah lo-in ih nuntak pih ding leh tua thu manpha a san theih nading un eite tavuan lianpi khat hita leuleu hi. Tuate banah I.T. (The age of Information Technology) hun ci-in thu kizakna malang mahmah ahih manin leitung buppi nangawn khuatano khat (Global village) ciziau hi. Leimong khat a thupiang pen leimong khat pan a pianhun mah in kiza ziau hi. Ei Zomite zong muntuam gamtuam ah kithehthang in ih om hangin pianna Zogam sunga omkhawm mah tawh kibang lelmawk hi. Sun le zan, ut hunhun in thu kizakna I nei thei lel hi. Nidang in internet, email, Gtalk ci-in mite gengen I zakzak pen tu-in eiten nuamtak in I zangh zihziah theita hi. Tuabangin muntuam gamtuam ah I omna panin khuano khat sunga tengkhawm bangin ih omna leh pumpi kigamlat hangin lungsim hong gawmtuah in khuatano khat sungah tengkhawm bangin hong gawmtuah Cope topa hizen hi. 13. Cope Centennial Jubilee Leh Zomite: Tedim mite bek hilo, Zogam bup adingin a nuntakna, a pilna hong kipiakna hangin Zomite hiciang dinmun a tung thei ih hihi. Cope topate nupa hong pai lo hizenzen leh Zomite bangci dinmun ciang ah ih om lai zen tam? A beisa hunin Cope Jubilee tawh kisai Tuiphum Pawlpite in 1985 kum in Rev. J.H. Cope Diamond Jubilee bawl uhhi.1999 kum ciangin Cope Diamond Jubilee mah kibawl kik khin hi. Tua hi-in Cope Centennial Jubilee zong Tuiphumte bek in bawl ding maw? Bawl zenzen lo ee, Cope topa pen Tuiphumte bek pia peuhmah loding hi hangh. Cope topa hong puak Lungdamna thu (Pasian thu), Cope topa hong phuat sak Zolai, Cope topa hong teisak Zolai Siangtho, Zo Labute pen Zomi buppi, Pasian thu a sang peuhmah leh Zolai a zangh khempeuh ii pawi ahih manin Zomi buppi ii khaam ding pawipi ahi hi. Tua Cope Centennial Jubilee bawl nading tawh kisai in a hunte hong toi mahmah ahih manin kum thum sung tha thak lakna ding thu bulphuh 3 kinei hi. Tuate Zomi bupin ki-apna, thungetna leh thuhilhnate ah zangh tek leng ih Zogam hong cidam in Zomite khantoh nading leh Zomite thupha ngahna hong suak taktak ding hi cihna tawh 2008 a dingin Pasian aw, Na nasepna adingin hong siansuah in (Joel 2:16-17), 2009 adingin Pasian aw, acitak nasem dingin hong bawl in (Late 40:11) cih leh 2010 adingin Pasian zat Minam: Pasian aw, na deihna a tun nadingin vaang hong guan in. (Pai.19:5-6; I Pet.2:9) cihte ahi hi. Hih thubulphuh thumte thungetna leh ih pawlpi tek ah thuhilhnate ah zang kiim tek leng ih Zogam leh Zomite adingin Pasian in a lamdang khat teitei hong pia takpi ding hi. Tua ahih manin 2010 ciang i khaam ding Cope Centennial pawipi pen Zomi bup Lungdamkoh Pawipi cihna zong himawk hi. Tua pawipi hangin Pasian in ih gam le lei, ih minam adingin damna leh thupha ngahna hong hisak pelmawh hamtang ding hi. Thu Khupna: Leitungah minam picing khat ih suak nadingin Lai kician neih ding kisam hi. Rev. Dr. Hre Kio genna ah Leitung ah Kha thum hal in minam khatta manthang hi. Banghang hiam cih leh Lai a neihloh man uhhi ci hi. Ih Kha a mangthang ding kimlai Cope topate nupa hangin Ih Kha bek tham lo-in ih minam mangthang lo hi. Kamdang khat in gen leng Zomite a mangthang lodingin hong khoipa leh hong khansuahpa pen Cope topa ahi hi. Tuabang Sangmang ih ngahkhak manin zong ih hamphatna lianpi khat ahi hi. Zogam ah Cope topa nasepnate ih ngaihsut ciangin lamdang liang hi. Pasian in Zomite adingin a tuam vilvel a hong piak Sangmangpa ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Cope Centennial Jubilee bawl dingin ih kithawi laitak in Pawlpi lungsim, beh lungsim, nam lungsimte panin minam lungsim ah kalsuan to-in 2010 November 4 -7 ni sungteng sim le maal, sak le khang, gam sung gam pua leh tui lu tuitaw pan kikaikhawm henhan in Kum 100 pawipi Tedim khuapi ah a muak khawmtek dingin hanciam ni (Sian Tongluan wordpress pan kila) Tagged: Baptist Biakna Cope Topa Hakha Innkuan Nei Missionary Pasal Pasian thu hong puakpa Tedim Zogam Sangmangpa Zolai Laisiangtho bawl Zolai Simbu bawl Post navigation Previous: Buanli Khua Next: ZBC piankhiatna Leave a Reply Your email address will not be published. Gin Khan Nang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zomite khuamuh ciilna Rev. Gin Khan Nang posted on 17 June 2016 at 6:10 pm Lomkholna: Article , Ginkhannang Zomite khuamuh ciilna Rev. Gin Khan Nang Thu patna: Zogam pen Mikang kumpi in 1895 kum a kipanin hong uk uh hi. Kum 1914-1919 sung England leh Germany gam kido uh a, galpi khatna (First World War) kici hi. 1916 kumin London khuapi-ah gal vaihawm pawl (War Committee) thukimna bangin Kuli (Labor Corps) lak ding thukim uh hi. Tua pen gal sung a Kuli nasem ding ci lehang kitel pen ding hi. Tua hun lai-in Mikang kumpite in gam tampi uk (colonized) uh a, Mikang Kumpi gamah ni tum ngei lo hi kici liang hi. Egypt, Fiji, India, Malta, Mauritius, Seychelles, British West Indies, South Africa leh China gamte panin Kuli ding la uh hi. Egypt panin 100,000, India panin 21,000, South Africa panin 20,000 kila hi. China panin mi 50,000 la uh a, tua lakah 2000 bang si hi kici hi. Kawlgam pen India tawh kigawm hi a, Hindu, Shynteng, Khasi, Lusei, Meitei, Bihar, Orissa, Pathan, Bengali, Kumoan, leh Zomi zong la uh hi. Mikang kumpi in Zogam Ukpite tungah mi pia dingin a nget bangin Ukpite in nial ngam loin piak dingin thukim hi. Khamtung mi 3000 sung panin Zomi 1000 kila hi. A pai ding mite pen si dinga kipia ahi uh hi. Dahin kapin, innkuanpihte tawh khitui luangin a kimu nawn lo dingin kingaihsun uh a, sivui-in kivui-uh a, sa kigawh uh hi kici hi. Lawm ngaih neite ading bangin na diak ding hi. Mi tampi mah zong si takpi hi. Tua hun lai-in Zomite khuamuhna toi mahmah a, koimah puapial ngei lo, leitung dang a om cih zong thei lo uh hi. Zomite in Gunkhawm khang lamah mihing om nawn lo dingin ngaihsun uh a, Mizote in Silchar khang siahah mihing om nawn lo dingin ngaihsun hi kici hi. Kumpite in a paite pen Dolsing inn leh Zanglo piak ding ci-in kamciam bawl uh hi. Tedimah tawlkhat kisinna a neih khit uh ciangin inn lamah ciahkik sakin, Tedimah kituahkik uh hi. Zogam panin Capt. Fowler makaihna tawh kum 1917 May 27 ni-in Gunkhawm paisuk uh a, tua panin meileeng tawh Zangkung tung uh hi. India panin khamtung mite zong Syhlet (Chittagong) zui-in Akyap tawnin Zangkung pai-in Zogam pana pai khamtung mite tawh kisutuah uh hi. Zangkung panin Teembawpi tawh dingkhia-in Kolkata, Mumbai, Eden, Suez Canal tawnin France (Piantit) gam Marseilles khua kum 1917 August 15 ni-in tung uh hi. Amau pen France leh Belgium gamgi-a om dingin kiseh a, kidona phual panin tai 25 bekin gamla hi. Nisimin galkidona thau kap leh thaupi kap san ziahziah mu den uh hi. A nasep ding uh pen galsunga a liamte tawm ding, galvan suah leh kaihkhop cihte ahi hi. India Company 61 leh 62 ci-in ciamteh uh hi. Laisiam lo uh ahih manin a min uh leh a omna gam uh savun khat tungah gelhin a ban uhah bulhsak uh hi. A min uh a kisap ciangin a thei lo zong om a, a omna gam uh leh khua zong a gen thei lo om hi kici hi. Pu Song Theu leh Pu Thawng Za Kai cihte in kamphen uh hi. Zomite in misan, mivom, mikangte tawh na sem khawm uh hi. Marseilles panin Meaulte-ah kisuan uh a, tua panin Fricourt Salvage, tua panin Abancourt leh Rouen tung uh hi. Rouen panin Marseilles ah kilehkikin Taranto panin inn lamah ciahkik uh hi. Khua vot thuak zo lo leh dam lohna tuamtuam hangin mi 1000 lak panin 24 si a, France gama galkapte han (war cemetery) ah kivui uh hi. Hih a kivuina mun pen Marseilles khua hi dingin ki-um mawh hi. Hih han-ah India mi 1002 kivui hi ci-in kiciamteh hi. Tua a site pen Suan Thang, Zuan Pum, Kai Gin, Maha Peng, Gin Dam, Ngul Gin, Pau Pum, Son Neng, Thang Eng, Tut Lang, Tuang Pum, Vial Dam, Vum Dai, Gin Nang, Kam Nang, Go Kam, Sian Lut, Lang Za Khen, Kam Ngul, Tual Kim, Lun Kap, Khup Za Dal, Khoi Cin, Cin Khai cihte ahi uh hi. Nasepna-ah kuh kalin, thahatin, thuman uh ahih manin Mikang kumpi King George V in London khuapi en dingin sam a, Capt. Fowler makaihna tawh Mang Pum, Thawng Za Kai, Song Theu, Kam Za Mang, Vung Za Kham, Thuam Pau, Vial Zen, Hau Za Nang, Hang Khaw Cin, leh Cin Kamte pai uh hi. Mikang pau a thei teng hi kha ding hi. Kum 1918 March 27 ni-in London khuapi sunga Kumpipa inn Buckingham Palace kici tung uh a, innpi sung teng etpihin, datsian (cinema) ensakin, uliante an nekhopna-ah kihelsak uh hi. Kumpi inn cing santali (duty) te pen khauh lua uh a, mit zong phia lo liang uh ahih manin milim kisa-in, milim lah mihing kisa hi ci uh hi. Zomi khat in zong santali (duty) ding khat a lim sa-in a khoih leh mihing ahih lam phawk pan hi kici hi. Kumpipa in Haksatna khat peuh na tuak uh leh hong ko un, ahi thei bangin kong huh ding uh hi ci-in Zomite tungah kamciam pia hi kici hi. Mikang galkap suak nuamte suak thei ci uh a, pawl khat in min pia-in tentan (training) zong nei uh hi. Ahi zongin inn lamah gal om cih a zak uh ciangin kuamah omsuak ngam loin hong ciahkhin leuleu uh hi. Hih Kuli lakna-ah Khalkha mite ut loin nial uh hi. Khalkha khua-ah galsim ding mi 5000 kikaikhawm uh a, kumpite lehdo uh hi. Khalkha leh Falam kikal lampi khaktan uh a, kumpite na do uh hi. Inn lamah kidona omin lo kho thei loin mipite haksa mahmah hi cih a zak uh ciangin ciah ding ngen uh a, an ngawl liangin a nget uh ciangin ciahsak uh hi. France gama Kuli dinga paite pen Piantit Pai kici a, Piantit pen Kawl pau hi a, France gam cihna hi. France Gam Paite cih ding hi. Lungleng khuangai-in a omna uh panin ciahkik ding pen kilawp lua mahmah uh ahih manin la phuak uh hi. a) Pian tui a gam lei aw e, sial zatam tuang a tunna, b) Sial zatam pian tui ngak hen aw, I sau lam zong ta ni e. Galkap taktak ahih loh uh hangin, galkapte mah bangin ki-uk a, gawtna kipia a, khasum zong kipia hi. Khasum pen mi khat in 10, 15, 20, 25 bang hi a, kam phente in 20, a site luang man 100, liamna tuakte 50 kipia hi. Zomite gamdang zinkhiat a khatveina hi a, a khua muh ciilna uh ahi hi. A na muhte uh vanleeng, teembaw, thaupi leh tuipi a muhte uh thupi sa-in gencim thei lo uh hi. A muh thute uh leh a tuah thute uh tangthu banging en belin nei uh hi. La zong tampi phuak uh hi. Khasum cih bang a kitheih cilna ahi hi. Hong ciah uh ciangin sum pua tek uh ahih manin kithupi ngaihsut mahmah a, nungak a deih peuhpeuh uh tenpih thei hi kici hi. Khua muhna hong kidang ahih manin Khristian a suah lawh zong tampi omin, Khristian hong khang tuam hi kici hi. France gam pai a meetna 1. France gam paite hong ciah uh ciangin sum nei uh ahih manin a pai lote sangin nuntak nuam sa zaw uh hi. Leitung khua muhna bek hi loin sum thalawh ciilna zong ahi hi. 2. Galpi khit ciangin nakpi takin Zogamah Khristiante khang hi. 1918 kumin Khristian 500 bek om a, Kum 1924 ciangin 4,046 pha ta uh hi. Khristian a tam zaw pen Tedim mite sung pan hi a, France gam paite hang hi kici hi. 3. Zomite gal hang sa uh ahih manin Mikang kumpi in Zomite adingin galkap phuan uh a, First Chin Battalion kici 1921 kumin Kawlgamah kiphuan hi. Battalion thum dong kiphuan a, First, Second, Third Chin Rifles kici hi. Kawlgamah galkap kumpi a khan ciangin kiphiat kik hi 4. France gam paite tung panin puansilh zia kithei ta hi. A puansilh uh pen Police puan tawh kibang khakhi puan, bombi sing, puan-ak bantawng, zian lukhu, puan khedap mawza leh ngalvial nei uh a, thupi kisa mahmah hi. Galpi khatna ma-in puan kisilh mel loin, pasalte in dialkaih tawh zum selin, numeite in puan them letmat li ding tawh a nuai lam sel a, a tung lam pen kai lihliah sak lel uh hi. Galpi khatna khit ciangin puansilh a kisap zia kithei ta hi. A meet lohna 1) France gam pai ding pen aana tawh kila hi a, ut lopipi mahin a pai uh ahi hi. A pai nuam lo Khalkha mite leh kumpite kidona-ah Khalkha mi 40 bang si-in khua 18 kihalsak hi. Hih pen Anglo-Chin War (1917) kici hi. Hih kidona hangin France gama Kuli nasem a om Zomite hong ciahkik uh hi. 2) India lamah zong Manipur a om Kukite in France gam pai nuam loin nial uh a, kumpite lang pan uh ahih manin Mikang kumpi in galkap 100 sawlin simsak hi. Kukite in zong na do uh a, kum nih sung bang kido uh hi. Khua 86 kihalsakin, mi tampi kithat uh hi. Hih kidona pen Anglo-Kuki War (1917-1919) kici hi. 3) Mikang kumpite in Zomi Kulite tungah a kamciam uh ahi Dolsing inn leh Zang lo pia lo hi. Capt. Fowler in a genna-ah Zomite in gal kidona a tawp dong sem zo loin gal a venh ma-in ciah uh ahih manin a kipia lo hi ci hi. Thukhupna: Khatvei Lusei nupi khat Kolkata pai hi. Vanleng tual pan a tuah khiat ciangin Kalate na tam mahmah hi. Pau dang thei lo ahih manin Lusei pau tawh hopih a, kua mah in thei lo hi. Nupi nu in zong Mizo trawng pawh hre lo in va aa tak e ci hi kici hi. Tua mah bangin Zomite in leitungah mi dang om ding cih zong a theih ma uh a France gam pai cih pen lamdang a sak ding mah uh hi. Niikten puansilh zong a silh nai lo minamte France gam pai cih mawk pen lamdang thu khat hi mawk hi. Nidangin sum kizang loin, van kilei ciangin van mah tawh kikhek cih danin kilei hi. Gan a lei nop uh ciangin buh seu tua zah, cih danin kilei uh hi. France gam paite hong ciah uh ciangin sum zatzia kithei ta hi. Puansialh zia a thei nai lote in puansilh ding ahih zia kiphawk ta hi. Nagate bang pen puan zong silh loin dialkaih bek mah tawh pai uh hi. Ahi zongin thatang hat uh ahih manin Mikang kumpite in pakta mahmah uh hi. Hih pen Zomite khuamuh ciilna hi a, Uino mit keuh a kicih mah bangin Zomite khuamuh ciilna ahi hi. Tedim-tawh kizom kipawlna ahihkeileh mapanna khempeuh-ah Kawl Gamukte-hiam Vaai Gamukte-hiam kihtaakna ahihkeileh maai-etna ahihkeileh phalna ngahlohding launa-ziak khatpeuhpeuh hiambel theikhang Tiddim cih kammal nana zangh uh-a, Zopau-ah tuabang kammal limlim a-omlo ahihlam ngaihsut-in neilo-uh, bangciang siattutna omthei, bangciang lawh-thei cihte peuhmah muhkholhna anei ngiatlo kumpi naseem ulian neih sunsunte khutma kimu-hi. Zomi cihcih kawm-in thankiik-in saaipi khaguh balkhap sawm acih thuciin bang-in Zomi-pen Chin State buppi ahuam lungsim-tawh penglam pawlkhat-in ma hongpanpih leuleu-a, tua lungsim ziak-in Tedim Lai SiangthoLabu-pen Zomi cihding hilo, Zomi cih-in Laimi, Laizo ahuam ahihteh Tedim ci-ni cih-tawh Tedim cihding kipsak uh-a, Tiddim ci sese laai uhhi, bangzah-in laainat-huai cih anuai-ah ensuk in: Kumpi naseem ahihkeileh Kawlgam Kiukna sung-a ulian lubawk neihsunte-in, Zomi cihteh Chin cihna hi-a, Tedim cihteh Tedim Khuapiseh leh Tonzaang Khuapiseh-a pau kitheithei khempeuh hihang-a, Zo, Siyang, Teizaang, Dim hihang cise-hi. Tua ahihman-in Zopau, Zolai hilo Tedimpau, Tedimlai ci uhhi. Hih guú (poison)-pen damdam-in hong kizelh-a, Ei haam-pen Tedimpau hi-sih Siyangkam sese Tedimpau hi-ngawl cih lungsim-in tua Tedim hong vaatsuk ahihman-in Lai Siangtho leh Labu-pen Siyangkam leh Zohaam-tawh hong kikheenkhia ahihi. Kigawmna (Unity)-pen athu-in agengen-uh hang-in Tedimpaulai aci valval denkeeite-pen kikhenna (division) lungsim asungtawng-ah nungta-a ahong po-khia cihna ahihi. Zopau, Zolai (kei mimal khiatna-ah) cihciang-in Tedimpau cihna hilo-in, Zomi namkee tuamtuamte awsuah kidang diimdiamteng ahuamkhawm paukam (language) ahihi. Pawlkhatte-in paukam cih lamdang sakha dinghi. Kampau-pen speaking (a word that comes out of your mouth) cihna ahihteh language-pen literature lamsang-a apiicing kammal ding-in paukam hong pulaak ka-hihi. Khangthak khempeuh-in I pate khialhna pumgup lo-in (langpang-a paampaihding cihna hilo), paukam leh lai lamsang I concept themcik khangkhaan hamtangding hihang. A-uut teng-in Tedimpau acici zong-in nang leh kei-in Zopau, Zolai, Zomi, Zogam mah ci ngiatngiatding hihang. Tua nangawn eite khang-ah mual I-suahdingsuahlohding kigen thei naailo-hi. Tedim lam-ah I-ki naak-hei luatleh ahihkeileh tua lam-ah I-kipiak luatleh veenglehpaam nangawn I-khahsuah (khitsa) khahsuah thuahthuah laaiding hihang. Zomi, Zogam, Zolai, Zola, Zolaam, Zongeina alaamsaang ding leh atawisaang ding-in I pate kipan naailo, kipan ngei loding-hi. Nang leh Kei diangkhia-in eima khe tung-ah dingkip-in, mah sah lah khedap suahkhia-in, Postmodernism khedap bulh-in naakpi thasaanding hihang. Aphual-ah, amun-ah hongpaiciah pahve. cihcihte khuak neilote kampau ahihi. Nang na omnana-pen Zomi phungvuh nading aphual hipah-hi. Israel te-in aminam apuah hun-in gamdang vive-ah om uh-a, siamsinna naakpi-in sin-uh, pil-uh, siam-uh, hau-uh, tua takteh agam-uh a-etzia muiibunh thei-hi. Ciakciakbek kei-ni, ein I-lap keileh tate siamsinna lam-ah tawsawn ni. I-tawsawn tantan nangawn deihciang hongtung zolo khalaai dinghi. Zolai, Zopau, Zola, Zongeina theisak ni. Hilhni. Atheizawte hilhsak ni. Ei tapkual-a I-phawk kiukiau-khawng Zongeina avekpi sa pahpah kei-ni. I zaak ngeilohte Zomi-tawh akisailo sa pahpah kei-ni. Nang leh kei-in I ngeina I-kep lohsa-in kuan hong kepsak laaizang loding-hi. Haanciam gamgam-a I-tawsawn nangawn hong nengniam-nuam aphualphual-ah omlaai dinghi. Zomi it mahteh, minam khual mahteh. Gahkhia sak in. It ing cihcih sang-in na itna-pen Zopau, Zolai, Zola, Zongeina phungvuhna-tawh lak in. It mahmah-ing, ahizong-in Zolai, Zopau, Zola thupi sakeng, cih tepawl khuakcinglo, mibanglo (abnormal) mite zialehtong ahihi. 2017 kum Zomi te maasuan 2 Khup Khan Thang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW 2017 kum Zomi te maasuan 2 Khup Khan Thang posted on 10 January 2017 at 12:55 pm Lomkholna: Khupkhanthang , News , Zomi II. Nget ding 1. Tedim District. Kamdawn ih zakna tung tawn in, Tedim Khazai (District) siauhna (Motion) lai pen, Kawlgam Hlutdaw meetingah ih Pyithu Hlutdaw MP pa in na tin ding, ngetna thusung dingin kisawl hi. Ahih hangin ih MP pan na tinlo, thu nasunglo hi ki ci hi. Thantlang Pyithu Hlutdaw MP nu in, Khalkha leh Thantlang myone nih gawm in, District ngetna (Motion) Pyithu Hlutdaw meetingah natin in, thu nasunghi. Tua ciangin ei zong District Hludaw ah ih ngen kik aa, District kituh nih hong suak hi. District vai Chin State Hlutdaw ah, kikup ding thu hong suak hi. Chin State Chief Minister in, telkak ding (option) thum hong pia aa; (1) Tedim District pia ding; (2) Khalkha District pia ding (3) Anih tuak in kua mah pia nailo dingin, a thu diahphot (Pending) ding. Ahizongin, ih Tedim MP khatin mee khia aa kidem dingin thu nasung aa, mee khiat na tawh thuki khen hong suak hi. Mee lel in Tedim District ihtaan hi. (a). District ih kituhpih Khalkha Thantlang; lelhding thei gegu aa, Pyine Hlutdaw mee (Secret vote) ding aa ih tawn zong Kawlmitphial or Kawlngian (Burmese illusion) ahihi. Ih ngah meetang 5 lakah, mee khiatin kidem ding cii a thusung ih Tedim MP pa mee zong paading paaloding kitheilo hi. Ih Tonzang MP pa, Pyine Hlutdaw Okathah pan amaa meetang khianailo ding ci leng, ei MP mee 2 leh adang meetang 3 pen kua Myone te mee aitam theih ut huai mahmah hi. (b). Mee khiat tawh thukhen ding tawng ihhi leh bang ding aa, in Tedim Tonzang MP ten a dang Myone 5 MP tetawh sizungyee nabawl lo hiam? (Falam, Matupi, Kanpetlet, Mindat leh Paletwa) (c). Lel ding theih gegu bang dia, Pyine Hlutdaw Okathah pa in, a Veto zangin, hih thu minnailo, meekhia aa khenlo ding, pending photding na cilo hiam?. 1. Sep ding (Action) Tedim, Tonzang MP teng Pyithu Hlutdaw ah ngenkik ding. 2. Maha Dat line Khalkha, Falam in ngah khin; Tedim leh Tonzang in ngah nailo. Bang hang? ZCD pu a interview na sung bang aa, mipi hong nget ciang a ngak maw? No a semsem mah ko mipi in angaklah lua maw leh? (Mipi na ngaklah kei un interview na aa na cih) Beltang Hydro- Power bang ciang tung? Tedim leh Tonzang Myone MP teng tavuan la in hong sul zuih un. 3. Sapan Zozang lampi 4. Tulsuk Pimpih Laibung ayan mawtaw lam 5. Lampi thak, Lawibual zaang pan leilum, Sezang, Sonsing lamka ah Sapan ah nidang aa Lam Mingyi U Lal Bik zonsak alignmemt. Tedim leh Tonzang Myone MP tengin hong vaan un. Sapan Zozang lampi pen Socialist kumpi te in myone khat le khat kikal antang puak ding khaktan ahihman in Tedim gambuppi hausa khempeuh tawh kop in kumpi huhna tawm (number cian pak keng) leh Tuiphum (BBC) lam pan Dr. Kyaw Than vaihawm na kigawm in Sapan, Tuisau khua, Vando khua, Tuivial khua, Dolluang khua, Mualzang khua, Mualnuam khua, Zozang khua teng nawk a kito lampi ahi hi. Tuisau le Vando kikal ah leinip mincim den khat om in zekai tuam mahmah hi. Hih Sapan Zozang lampi pen 1974 kum in, tawh kipan hi. Rev. Kam Do Thang (Retd. Tedim Township People Council E.C.) hong gen bang aa kong at hi. Tulaitak aa Tedim- Kalaymyo lampi saangin tai 18 bang tom zaw hi ci uhhi. Hih lampi pen nidang pekin, Pu Khup Za Cin in, tawhding aa, agengen ngei lampi hi aa, tu aa Tedim leh Kalemyo ihlampi saang tai 20 bang tomzaw ding hi ciden hi. Lt. Col. Son Khaw Pau zong lamto ding taangthakuan a pai, lamkal ah phung ah kingam in si hi. (Hih mi tegel thu kong gen na pen, ih mimaasaa ten, ihgam leh ihlei ading hong deihsak dan uh konggen na ahihi.) Kalay Tulsuak (Taikua) Pimpih-Laibung lampi pen tunai kum 4 kum5 lai aa kisem hi. Kumpi in Ayanlan (Feeder Road) ding aa angim hi aa, private contractor tawh kito hi. Lumlet Kumpi (Tawlanye asuyah) hong kah maa 1958 kum pawl-in Lam Mingyi pa U Lal Bik in, Lawibual zaang pan Leilum khua sung nawkin, Sezang khua ah, Hawpmual Tedim lam kaai mual daang zui in, Sonsing lamka ah mawtaw lampi thakding alignment khat hong zong aa, tu aa ih lampi saang phei zaw bek thamlo in, Thaangmual ihkal dong Tedim pan mawtaw paisuk paito te zong kigalmuh thei dingaa hoih mahmah ding hi. Tua Road Alignment zong tuni ciang dong khelam in kizangh thei lai hi. Songsiing lamka pan, Kennedy peak ah kahto nawnlo in, Thuamtuilii dek ah, Sapan-Zozaang lampi tawh kimat na ding alignment thak khat zong lai leng lampi phei mahmah ding aa, Tedim pan Kalemyo tai 40 zong pha nawnlo ding hi. Tu aa ih lampi saang tai 20 tomzaw ding hi. Hawp phei, Sozang kiang, Akluai gei, Taingen khua taw, Aicik paam, kumsim aa mencim (Lampi cim) teng kinawk nawnlo ding aa, Tuuk tawh Khaal tawh Tedim leh Kalemyo noptak, baihno tak in kipai ziahziah ding hi. Articles Tangthu VIETNAM TEN MY LAI MASSACRE PAWKNA ZANG VIETNAM WAR THU TOM KIM. By: LAIBUSAAL Date: March 24, 2018 VIETNAM TEN "MY LAI MASSACRE" PAWKNA ZANG VIETNAM WAR THU TOM KIM. A kaikhawm: Thang Khan Lian Hollywood fiction-action movies leh US pumgup ten Vietnam War (1 November 1955 30 April 1975 i.e. kum 19, kha nga 5 ,nipi kal 4 leh ni 1) sung US President li - John F. Kennedy, Lyndon B. Johnson, Richard Nixon, Gerald Ford command na nuai tawh a guallelhna uh pen a gualzawhna dan un a lah uh history kan lo leh thei lo tengin um heha dep zaw lai uh hi. April 30, 1975 in Saigon khuapi kilak khit nungin Vietnam a US omte helicopter in kihemkhia uh a, gal bei hi. Gal bei khit nungin US gualzo thei ding maw? Vietnam War ah US gualzo takpi hiam cih en suk ni. US ten Vietnam War nasiat lai March 16, 1968 in South Vietnam a Son Tinh District sunga om Son My khuata ah nautang thau tawi lo 374-504 kikal US Army a Company C, Ist Bigate, 23rd (America) Infantry Division sunga Charlie Company ten a lomthah (mass massacre) ni uh phawkna dingin Vietnamese mi 1,000 val in hih kilomthahna leh numei tampi a buanni ni uh kum 50 phawkna tu kum 2018 in "My Lai massacre" kici March 18 in zang uh hi. Daily Mail ah bel US galkap ten nautang thau tawi lo mi 504 that hi ci-in suaksak hi. A kithatte lakah numei, naupang leh naungek piangcil naungeekte (infants) kihel uh hi. US galkapte ciaptehna ah mi 347 kithat a, 400 in liamna tuak hi ci hi. Vietnam government ciamtehna ah nautang 504 My Lay leh My Khe khua-ah US galkap ten that uh hi ci-in ciamteh hi. Hih banga ngongtat US galkap mi 26 tungah "criminal offence" ngawhna US government in a bawl hangin C Company platoon makai Lieutenant William Carey Jr. bek kimawhpaih a, khuami 22 that hi ci-in ngawhna tuak ahih manin a dam sung thongkia dingin dan kipia hi. Ahih hangin thong ah kikhum lo lai a, kum thum leh a lang bek a inn ah kikhumcip (house arrest) hi. US ten chemical weapons nam khat Napalm bomb kici Galpi Nihna hun in Europe leh Pacific gamte ah zang masa uh a, tua khitin Korean War leh Vietnam War ah Vietnam, Cambodia leh Laos gamte ah nak zat mahmah uh hi. US ten 1963 -1973 kikal sung bekin Vietnam War ah napalm bombs 400,000 tons (400,000 1,000 kgs) na khia uh a, Vietnam gam mite 60 ten fifth-degree burns (kangtum) uh hi. Fifth-degree burns kici pen guh nangawn kangtum cihna hi. Tua loin US ten Vietnam War ah chemical weapon a nak zat mahmah uh Agent Orange hi. Agent Orange pen a tui hi a, 2,4-D leh 2,4,5-T herbicides (lohing thahna za) hi a, nipi kal khat bang tua zatui hangin sihtheihna (toxic) piangsak hi. Vietnam War lai-in US ten Agent Orange pen gammang leh lo lakah khaici leh singkung teng a sihna dingin vanleng panin khia uh a, a galte uh Viet Cong leh nautangte gammang lakah a buk theih lohna ding uh leh a nuntakna ding uh piang khiasak lo a khaici khempeuh sihna dingin a zat uh ahi hi. Orange Agent hangin Vietnam gal bei khitin kialpi tung a, mi tampi in sihlawh hi. US ten Vietnam War ah South Vietnam gam leitang 24 sunga singkung leh khaici leh lohing khempeuh thahna dingin Agent Orange 43 million liters (11.4 million gallons) na khia uh a, a za a kapna uh (spray zone) sung pen khua 3,000 sung hi. Hih khua 3,000 valte ah Agent Orange a kapna hangun khua mite pumpi sung, a an nek uh leh lei nuai-a tuite (groundwater) ah gu hoih lo dioxin kici lut hi. Lei nuai-a tuiphulkhiatna leh kikholna (underground aquifer) ah sih theihna gu (toxin) Vietnam War bei khit nung kum 100 om suak lai ding hi. Hih thu hangin kum 10 tampi khit nungin dioxin hangin Vietnamese mi tampi in pumpi cidam lohna leh naungak piangte mi bang lo piangsual (health problems and birth defects) a suak uh a, Vietnamese government in USte Agent Orange poisoning hangin mi 400,000 a sih banah naungek million kimkhat piangsual uh uh hi ci hi. US galkap ten hih chemical galvan a zat uh Agent Orange gu hangin US leh a kipawlpih galkap ten cancers natna namtuamtuam - soft tissue sarcoma, Non-Hodgkin lymphoma, Hodgkin disease leh lymphocytic leukemia kihelin natna ngah uh hi. Vietnam, Korea leh mundanga USte chemical galvan napalm leh Agent Orange gu thuak ten chemical weapons bawl Monsanto leh Dow Chemical companies tampi vei heek uh hi. 2006 in chemical weapons bawl Monsanto leh Dow Chemical companies ten Vietnam War a USte ngongtatna gu thuak South Korean veteran (galkap pensionte) tungah huhna sum 63 million a piakna dingun thu kipia (ordered) hi. Napalm chemical galvan kizatna munte ah a gu thuak khate 800 -1,200 degrees C (1,500-2,200 degrees F) in kang uh hi. Vietnam War ah USte chemical weapons zat napalm mihing tungah a tukkhak ciangin a zatui man (gel) sam, vun leh puan ah belh a, genzawh loh natna, nasia takin kaatna, khuaphawk lohna, husapna leh sihna (causing unimaginable pain, severe burns, unconsciousness, asphyxiation, and often death) piangsak hi. Napalm a kihel chemical 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-para-dioxin or TCDD pen mihingte adingin sihtheihna za nam lak panin a hatpen pawl hi a, a mihingte pumpi sunga fat cells ah teng ahih manin hormone systems nawngkaina leh cellular kilamdanna piangsak a, ta neih theihna ding kilaihna (genetic changes) piangsak hi. Kiim leh kiang a ngeina mun (natural environment) ah a dioxin za kum sawm tampi sih theihna piangsak a, lei panin tui sungah lut a, organic matter a themte a nin (sediment) ahih manin tua panin food chain omna mun tungto hi. Vietnamese Red Cross ten a tuatna ah Agent Orang hangin mi naupang 150,000 piangsualte kihelin mi 3 million in a natna ngah uh hi. Studies tuamtuam in a muhkhiatna ah Vietnam gam mite pumpi tunga Agent Orange gu hangin TCDD level sangpi tung ahih manin Agent Orange gu thuak nu leh pa ten ta a neih ciangun a tate uh piangsual uh hi cih mukhia uh hi. Vietnam gam ah US President lui Obama a hawh khitin Japan gam zong va zin a, US ten Hiroshima leh Nagasaki khuapi-ah Galpi Nihna hun lai-in atom bomb a khit khit nung Hiroshima ah US president lenlai a pha masa pen suak hi. Obama in Hiroshima a phak lai-in US ten Japan gamah atomic bomb a khiat maisakna a nget ding hi cih gen a tam mahmah hangin US in Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia gam mite thuakna ding a bawlnate leh chemical galvan a zatna hangin maisakna a nget ding hi ci kuamah om lo hi. Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia gam a teng mi ten Agent Orange leh napalm chemical weapons kizatna hangin maisakna ngetna ngah ding bek a ngah dingun kilawm lo-a, USte bomb khiat a puakkham lote hangin maisakna ngetna a ngah ding uh kilawm lai hi. US in Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia gamte ah a bomb khiat puakkham lote hangin June 2016 dong unexploded ordnance removal kici tawh Vietnam tungah huhna sum 80 million, Cambodia tungah 100 million leh Laos tungah 85 million pia ta hi. Huhna sum a piakte a gentham loh hangin bangmah hih loh sangin hoihzaw a, US government ngaihsutna tawm kilaih hi cih kimu thei hi. US in 2014 panin Iraq leh Syria ah ISte bomb khiatna ah sum 7.4 billion na beisak a, Vietnam, Cambodia leh Laos gamte ah kum sawm bang zah hiam sung US in a bomb khiat a puakkham lote siansuahna dingin a sum zat zah sangin Iraq leh Syria gamte ah bomb khiatna dingin sum zatkhiat a leh 27 sanga tam zaw zang hi. 2007 panin US in Agent Orange leh khaici za (herbicides) puakna leh sengna mun dingin galphualpi in a zatna uh dioxin hot spots kicihna munte siansuahna ding leh tua kiim-a tengte Agent Orange gu hangin natna leh sihna a tuah lohna dingun sum 130 million health and disability programs dingin zang ta a, tua banga a nasepna uh sunzom lai uh hi. Ahih hangin US in Vietnam War ah Agent Orange a zatna hangin Agent Orange leh natna tuamtuamte leh naungek piangsuakl a piang pen kizopkhakna nei lo hi ci-in nial lai hi. US in Vietnam War lai-in Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia mite tungah bombs million tampi leh lohing zatui (herbicides) millions gallons a khiat manin sep ding tavuan lianpi leibat nei lai hi. Tua bang a sep ding uh a mawhpuakna bek uh hilo a, sia leh pha khentheihna (morally) tawh a sep loh uh phamawh a, adiakin dioxin hot spots kicihna kiimte ah a thuak khate (victims) tungah huhna a piak loh theih loh hi. Tua loin US gam pen leitung adingin galvan tam zuakkhia pen leh leitunga dictatorships nasia pen leh human rights palsat nasia pente tunga galvan tam piakhia pen ahih manin indirect in a kigolhna hangin huhna sum piak ding leibat genzawh loh nei lai hi. A poimawh diak thu pen USte mi hoih hilo hi napi mihoih kineihkhemna (hypocrisy) ahi hi. Vietnam ah human rights nasia takin a palsat bek uh hi loin Vietnam kiim-a gamte ah a human rights palsatna uh nasia mahmah hi. France in Vietnam gam kiim-a a ukkhum gamte (colonies) lak kik ding a lawhsap ciangin US in France hong huh a, Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia gamte ah amau bekin a lipkhaphuai gal dona (own bloody campaigns) a pat manin millions tampi sihna leh liamna a piangsak banah mi lomthahna leh mulkimna bei-a ngong gamtatna tampi (series of massacres and atrocities) a bawl ban uh-ah Agent Orange kihelin chemical weapons herbicides gallons millions tampi khia lai hi Chemical galvan millions tampi a khiat hangin Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia gamte US guallel dimdem a, 1975 in Vietnam War a bei hangin a chemical galvan zatna hangin tu dong hih gam thumte ah natna hoih lo leh piangsual tam mahmah lai a, a si leh mi bang zo nawn lo-a liamna tawh nungta tam lai mahmah uh hi. Hih gam thumte ah US in a bomb khiat tampi puakkham lo ahih manin a guallelhna lianpi uh suaksak hi kici hi. Vietnam, Cambodia leh Laos gam-a teng ten US bomb khiat puakkham lote hangin tu dong buaina tuak lai uh a, bomb puak lote sik kha le uh a puah ding kal ngak bomb tampi om lai hi. Gentehna dingin Vietnam War bei khit nungin USte bomb khiat puakkham lote sikkha a sihna tuak mi 40,000 leh liamna tuak mi 65,000 om a, Cambodia 1979 khit nung USte bomb khiat puakkham lote sikkha a sihna leh liamna tuak 64,000 om hi. Cambodia gam-a bomb puakkham lo pawl khatte bel US in a cil in a gup leh amau piankhiatsak Khmer Rouge or Cambodian government' landmine hangin 1970s leh 1980s a si leh liam zong tampi om hi. Laos ah USte Cluster bombs bomb khiat a tam pen history adingin kimuhkhia hi ci-in Mines Advisory Group (the preeminent humanitarian organization working to clear land mines and other unexploded ordnance) in ci hi. US in history per capita a et-in Laos ah bomb tam khia pen a, 1964-1973 kikal sungin bomb 2 million tons (21,000 million kgs) na khia a, Galpi Nihna lai-in US in Japan ah bomb a khiat sangin Laos gamah bomb a leh 12 val tam khia zaw hi. US in Laos ah hih bangin bomb tam a khiatna hang pen Vietnam gam makai Ho Chi Minh gum Vietnamese communist forces galkapte leh Laos gam-a a kipawlpih communist Laotian Pathet Lao kicite a ngimna hang hi. Tua bang US in ngimna a neih hangin 1968 in US President Lyndon Johnson in North Vietnam ah bomb khiat khawlsanna dingin thu a piak khit nungin US in Laos ah bomb nasia zaw sem khiat beh lai hi. Tua banga US thu Senate testimony ah Deputy Chief of Mission Monteagle Stearns in, US gal vanlengte bangmah hih loin bawhcip uh ahih manin bangmah hih loin kikhawlsak thei lo hi, ci-in dawng hi. US ulian ten a gam mite theih loh dingin Laos ah a bombing campaign thusim imcip uh a, a bombing campaign hanga siatna lianpi piang thusimte gal lai-in Laos gam-a galtaite lak-a om US aid worker Fred Branfman in Laos gam mite haksatna thu lim takin ban dot a, a zak thute leh a muh thute "Voices From the Plain of Jars" kici laibu in hong bawlkhia hi. The Plain of Jars kici pen US in Laos gam-a bomb khiatna lak panin a nasiatna pen khanglui lai-a na lui suang beel;bawm (ancient archaeological stone jars) genna hi. Freelance writer leh US foreign policy hangin gamdangte gentheihna lianpi thute gelh Brett S. Morris in USte zuau bulomtang teng 21 Lies They Tell You About American Foreign Policy kici laibu sungah na gelh a, Vietnam War bei ding kuanin US galkap ten B-52 srike bombers vanleng zangin 500 pound high explosive bombs kici bomb puak hat mahmah tampi khia uh a, Vietnam, Laos leh Cambodia ah a bomb uh Galpi Nihna hun lai-in Europe leh Asia ah bomb kikha zah sangin nih vei sangin tam zaw a, hih gam thumte ah US in bomb 7 million tons (ton khat i cih 1,000 kgs hi) khia hi ci hi. Vietnam War ah US guallelh Pian'na: Fall of Saigon (Saigon khuapi a Tukna): South Vietnam khuapi Saigon pen April 30, 1975 in People's Army of Vietnam(PAVN) National Liberation Front of South Vietnam (Việt Cộng zong a kici) ten a lak zawh manun Vietnam War gal bei kipatna leh Socialist Republic of Vietnam nuai-ah North leh South Vietnam gam kipumkhatna dingin kilaihna hun (transition period) kipatna ni ahi hi. PAVN galkapte General Văn Tiến Dũng command na nuai-ah April 29,1975 in Saigon khuapi nawk hong kipan uh a, thaupi leh bomb tawh USte suamna nasia takin thuak Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) galkapte General Nguyễn Văn Toàn makaihna tawh pangkhawm uh hi. US ten ARVN galkapte bomb nasia takin a khiatna hangin Tân Sơn Nhất Airport ah a bomb khiatte un Vietnam War adingin US galkap si nunung pen nihte - Charles McMahon leh Darwin Judge in sihlawh kha uh hi. April 30, 1975 nitak lamin PAVN ten Saigon khuapi sung US galkapte leh a kipawlpih South Vietnam galkapte khut sung panin laksak zo uh a, Saigon khuapi sunga mun poimawhna munte a lak khit nungun South Vietnamese presidential palace ah a laan (flag) uh khai uh hi. Saigon khuapu North Vietnam President phamsa Hồ Chí Minh phawkna dingin Hồ Chí Minh City ci-in a min laih uh a, tu dong Hồ Chí Minh City kici suak hi. Saigon khuapi kilak khit nung phetin Saigon khuapi panin American nautang leh galkap om khempeuh phial leh US tawh kipawl South Vietnamese nautang tul sawm tampi kinawnkhiatna leh puakkhiatna dingin US ten Operation Frequent Wind pan uh ngeekngek uh a, Saigon panin kihepkhiatna (evacuation) pen history adingin helicopter tawh mi kihepkhiat;kinawnkhiatna lak panin a nasia pen in kiciamteh lai hi. Tua loin Saigon khuapi a kilak khit nungin communist ten thukhun thak tawh a ukna hangun galtai tampi taikhiat beh hi. US ten a Saigon khuapi sunga om American nautangte leh US galkap khempeuh phial leh amau tawh kipawl South Vietnam regime gum nautangte hepkhiatna dingin Operation Frequent Wind kici min zangin galtai nawnkhiat April 29, 1975 panin pan uh a, Tan Son Nhat Airport a US gal vanleng omte rockets leh thaupi (artillery) nasia takin a kikap manin Philippine gam-a US galphual Clark Air Base panin mi puakkhiatna dingin a vanlengte C-130E, 72-1297, cn 4519, 314th Tactical Airlift Wing kikapsiatsak hi. A vanleng hawlte a vanleng kuang sung panin taxiway ah kihemkhia uh a, C-130 bawhna munah kipuak hi. Rocket kikap zom ahih manin a vanleng phual a na themte (debris) hangin Saigon a US defence ulian kilkoih General Homer D. Smith in US Ambassador Martin kiangah vanleng lengkhiatna leh bawhna mun (runways) kizang thei lo ahih manin Saigon panin emergency evacuation dingin vanleng golte kizang thei lo ding a, helicopter tawh galtai khempeuh nawnkhiat bei loh phamawh hi ci-in ci-in hilhna hoih (advise) pia hi. Ambassador Martin in evacuation dingin vanleng phual-a om fixed-wing aircraft zat ding sawm veve a, ahih hangin a hawlpa South Vietnamese pilot in North Vietnam galkapte lamah lehtai dingin thukhensatna a bawl manin runways panin a lengkhiat ding hun in a vanleng lengkhia sak nuam lo hi (tua vanleng bel kikapsia lo hi). US Secretary of State Henry Kissinger nawhna hangin Martin in Marine guards-te kiangah Tan Son Nhat airport kikap lai-in a kipaipihna dingin thupia a, tua mun-a thupiang va enkhia hi. Martin in fixed-wing vanleng tawh evacuation kibawl thei lo ding hi ci-in a muh ciangin helicopter evacuation pat dingin a manlang thei pen in ut lopi pi-in green light pia hi. Saigon khuapi nawl panin PAVN galkap ten hong neh mahmah ta hi cih reports hong tung hi. 10:48 a.m. April 30 in Martin in Kissinger' phalna tawh FREQUENT WIND" evacuation plan bawl ding kingakkhum ahih manin Kissinger in minute thum sungin FREQUENT WIND" evacuation pat dingin thupia pah a, American radio station in Irving Berlin' lasak "White Christmas" kici North Vietnam galkap ten galkapte manlang takin a kihepkhiat sawm lam uh a theih lohna ding leh manlang takin kihepkhiatna ding evacuation points munte ah American galkapte kihepkhiatna dingin lim lahna dingin pia (signal) hi. FREQUENT WIND" evacuation plan tawh USte helicopter gol CH-53 leh CH-46 helicopters-te Americans leh US a pawlbawl Vietnamese mite South China Sea a om Seventh Fleet teembawpi kihelin teembaw ah nawnkhiat ding cih geelna nei uh hi. Kihepkhiatna ding munpi (main evacuation point), Ton Son Nhat a DAO Compound zang uh a, khuapi sunga bus ten a sawt loin nitak lamin airport ah passenger a dim a ha in hong nawn ziahziah uh hi. Nitak lamin amasa pen dingin DAQ Compound ah CH-53 hong bawh a, Americans 395 leh US gum Vietnamese 4,000 val kinawnkhia hi. 23:00 in DAO office a kinawnkhia ding galtaite U.S. Marines galkap ten security pia uh a, DAO office suksiatna ding, American vante (equipment), files, leh sumte nawnkhiat ding zia geelna nei uh a, Air America UH-1s nangawn evacuation nadingin zang uh hi. Hih banga kihepkhiatna dingin helicopter nasia takin zat ding geelna masa pen in nei lo uh a, galtaite hepkhiatna hong pat ciangun US Embassy ah mi tul bang zah hiam nawnkhiat ding (Vietnamese mi kihelin) om lai hi. Sih ding kihta US gum Vietnamese tampite US Embassy umna kulhbaang panin hong kah beh a tam banah keekkia, huihpi leh guahpi hong kithuah sawnsawn ahih manin zingsang panin zan dong galtaite helicopter tawh nawnkhia ngeekngek uh hi. April 30, 1975 zinsang nai 03:45 in Kissinger leh President Ford in US Ambassador Martin kiangah North Vietnam galkap ten Saigon khuapi a lak ding uh lunghimawhin American mite bek hepkhiatna dingin thupia hi. President Gerard Ford in Ambassador Martin kiangah evacuation helicopter ah tuang dingin thu pia a, a helicopter call sign dingin "Lady Ace 09" kizang a, a helicopter hawl Gerry Berry hi a, 04:58 am in Martin in Saigon a nusiatsan nuam loh hangin ama bitna dingin a puakhia ding leh a man dingin US Marines galkapte thu kipia hi. US Embassy evacuation panin Americans 978 Americans leh Vietnamese 1,100 kipuakkhia a, a vanleng nunung pen 07:53 am in US Embassy panin lengkhia hi. Ahih hangin Vietnamese leh South Korean mi 420 US Embassy compound ah a kinusiat banah US Embassy kulhbang pua-ah US gum tampi om laite kinusiatsan lai hi. Americans leh galtaite (refugees) kihepkhiat theihna ding pen North or South Vietnamese kigolh loin a kihepkhiat theihna dingun phalna kipia a, Ton Son Nhat manawh a American helicopters hawl ten PAVN anti-aircraft guns ten a lengna mun uh hong encik (tracking) uh hi cih man napi un kikapkhiatsak lo hi. Vietnam gam makai ten Americans leh galtai kinawnkhiate nawngkaisak lo dingin thupia uh a, a kinawnkhiatna dinga kizang Americans mite tuanna security pia dingin Saigon policete thu kipia hi. Hih bangin thakhat thu-in USte guallelhna April 29-30, 1975 in Saigon ah a piang manin Vietnam leh a kiim-ah American military operation bei hi. Ahih hangin Vietnamese mi tampi in a gam uh teembaw leh vanleng tawh nusiatsan zom uh a, Republic of Vietnam Air Force (RVNAF) pilots tampi in American teembaw omna munte Thailand gam dongah galtai a hunkhop om uh hi. Ambassador Martin in Vietnam War hun sunga US gum Vietnamese leh South Koreans mite nusiatsan nuam loin amah a kipuakkhiatna USS Blue Ridge teembaw panin US Embassy compound a kinusiatsan laite lakna dingin helicopter a nget hangin a ngetna President Ford in saansak lo hi. Seventh Fleet teembaw sungah Martin ni bang zah hiam om laite amaute ngak American ten teembaw ahih kei leh vanleng tawh a puakkhiat ding kal dong ngak dingin kithuzawh zo hi. Ford Museum ah muh theih dingin kikoih lai hi. Vietnamese government in Saigon khuapi kilak khit nung kum nih sungin Saigon khuapi mi 1 million in nusiatsan a, state government in mi 500,000 kihepkhiat theihna ding ngimna nei hi ci hi. Pasal te Thahatna Ding Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Pasal te Thahatna Ding Hau Za Cin posted on 17 August 2015 at 10:11 am Lomkholna: Article , Hauzacin , Health Pasal te Thahatna Ding Numeit ten a et uh ciang limci sa pian pah uh hi. Pasal in numei en leh a mel ahoih hiam, a kizepna a hoih hiam, a kipuah siam hiam kici hi. Numei in pasal a et ciang a thahatna, a mel leh puam, a din sanna, a awm golna, a khut leh a ban hatna en uh hi. Numei leh pasal i kilamdanna tuate hipah hi. Adang tampi omlai. Tuni in i gennop bel thu tuampi khat hi. Pasalte tha a hatna dingin ngasa sungah tha or ci tam kiphum pen hi, kici hi. Tua man in ngasa sial tam ne Japan te bang a ci uh hoih, hat, cidam mahmah hi kici hi. Ahang pen ngasa sungah omega-3 fatty acids tampi om ahih hi. Japan ann minthang Sushi bang pen tam nek ding a hoih mahmah dan hi! Tunai in University of Illinois, USA pan researcher te in a muhna khat vuah pasal ci sperm pen a mukzum tawh numei egg or tui a sukkhak ciang a dawtvang theihna dingin a mukzum a hoih mahmah kisam a, tua a mukzum a hoih theihna dingin omega-3 fatty acids namkhat docosahexaenoic (DHA) kisam hi. Tua DHA pen ngasa sungah tampi kingah hi ci uh hi. Tua manin pasal ci a hoih mahmah zongin a mukzum hoih kei leh numei tui vutvang zolo ahih manin pasal ci pen hat kici theilo hi. Tua DHA ngahna dingin Sushi ah a kilim bawl mahmah ngasa nam nih Salmon leh Tuna hoih penpen hi kici hi. Aktui sial, bawngnawi khal, maimu leh singgah keu tuamtuam, kawlkai, ankampak leh asparagus cihte zong tam nek ding hoih hi kici hi. Harvard University te sinna pan a muhna vuah annek gina lo hangin pasal ci hatna kiam thei hi ci uh hi. Tua manin meh kan a tam nekte, bung tawh a kikemsa ann namte tam nek luatna in pasal tha hatlo sak thei hi. Ahi zongin ann siangtho (Zohuan meh nam) a tam nekte, anteh leh ngasa tui huan a tam nekte in thahatna tam ngah hi kici hi. Nupi te lungdamna ding bek a gen hi kei hang, he heee.., cidamna ding a gen hizaw hang. Sanggam laizom pasal 4 leh numei 2 lakah upen nihna hi. Pasian in thupha pia in degree nam nga bang pia hi. Sangkahna: (1)PrimarySchool,SHS,Yankin,No (12), 1974-70, (2) Middle and High School, SHS, Yankin, No. (1), 1980-85, (3) B.Sc.(Zoology), (Q), Hlaing Yangon University, 1992, (4) M.Sc(Zoology), Yangon University,1999, (5) Diploma of German, (Geman language University, 1996, (6) M.A.(Q),German Language University, 2010, (7) M.A.(German), German Language University, 2014, (8) Sanggam laizomte: (1) Tg Thawng Khan Cin (hong nusia zo).(2) Lia Thang Khan Dim (Lecturer) Assistant Director.
