Dr. John Thang Hum Dim Lun Zam By: LAIBUSAAL Date: November 19, 2020 PETER A KAWK NUMEI NO Matt 26:68-75; Lk 22:55-62; Johan 18:16-18; 25-27 Agelh Rev. Dr. John Thang Hum Dim Lun Zam Hih Peter a kawk numei nonu min leh a innkuan pian zia a cingtak in I thei kei hi. Ahi zongin, hih numeino zong Jepthah tanu bang a, khantawn a siampi te nasem ding a kipia te khat hithei ding hi (Hih mun te sim in-Gam 27:8; Thuhilhkikna 25:5-10) sungah ki mu hi. Ih nuntakna ah ih ngaihsut khak ngeiloh mi pawlkhat in hong lunglut in i omdan I tat, i heek dan khempeuh hong en cik gige na om thei hi. Ih theih loh kaal in hong pakta aom mah bangin dik hong sa khollo zong na om thei gige hi. Hih Peter a kawk numeino in zong amah kuamahn a phawkkhak loh ding hang, amahn mite na en cikcik in, kua te bangci cih na thei mahmah a, Peter zong na ciamteh thei mahmah hi. Khris a kimat ni zan in, Peter leh Johan in siampite nasepna phual dong vazui hi. Tualai ah Peter pen miten na thei hi. Nungzuite pen Galilee gam pan a tamzaw kila hi a, a omzia amel uh zong milak ah tuampian hi kha thei ding hi. Peter a kawk te khat in zong, napau na awsuah mahmah, Galilee awsuah hi, na ci thei hi. Peter in ahihleh utlo in na nanial phangphang lai hi. Hih bang kikawk nate ci leh sa tawh deih huailo ahih hangin, kha lam ah a sang siam ta ding phattuamna lianpi piang thei hi. Peter omzia Upna leh muanna lamah madawk, nungzui pite lakah makaipi za angah Peter, lungsim manlang, kampau manlangin na khatpeuh sep ding khensat semsem thei hi. Topa Jesu in, Kei, miten kua hong ci hiam? Acih ciangin in, nungzui te in kamsangte khat in hong ngaihsun uh hi, ci in dawng a, No-e leh kua nong ci uh a, acih ciangin, Peter mahmah in, Anungta Pasian Tapa Khris hi teh, ci-in na dawng hi. Tua pulakna ci leh sa pan hilo a, Pasia n Kha Siangtho pan ahihna Topan gen hi. Hih pulakna hangin Topa lungdam in, Hih suang tungah ka pawlpi ka lam ding hi, ci-in gen hi. Hih suang acih pen Peter a genna hilo in, Peter pulak khiat, Peter in a kawk, Jesu tungah ka pawlpi ka lam ding hi, a c ihna ahi hi. Topa kammal muan ngamna, upna tawh kalsuan nalam ah kisin ngam in, lungsim manlang hi. Topa Jesu tui tungah apai lai-in Kei zong hong pai thei sak in, ci-a, anget ciangin, Jesun, pai ve acih leh kisin ngam pah a, tuitung pai thei takpi hi. Peter pen a lawpna khauh mahmah a, lawp baih in alung zong akiabaih thei nam ahi hi. Kamciamna piazeel napi nungkik pah cih bang dan ahi hi. Topa Jesu in, hi bangdan Peter lungsim puak zong na taai zel hi. Kei, galpa khut sungah ka kipia dinga, si hna ka thuak ding hi, acih ciangin, Peter mah pau masa in, Na tuaci kei dinghi, na ci hi. Topan Peter kampauna deih loh in, Satan aw, ka nungah kihem in, na ci hiau hi (Mk 8:33). Mikhempeuh in hong taisan ding uh hi, cih Topan a gen ciangin, Peter in, Midang ten hong taisan hang, ken hong taisak ngei kei ningh, na ci phangphang hi. Jesu in, Akkhuanma in thumvei nong nial ding hi, na ci leuleu hi. Topa Jesu leh nungzuiten paisanpawi an anek khit uh ciangin, Gethsemane huanah a zatngei bangun thungetna neikhawm uhhi. Tuamun ah zong ngak zolo in ihmu khin uh hi. Topan, Kei tawh nai khat beek, ngak zolo ding na hi uh hiam? Ze-etna tawh na kipelh na ding un, thu nangen un, ci-in gen hi. A sawtlo in, aman dingte hong pai a, Topa hong akimat tak c iangin, Peter in temta a selsim khinkhian dok in, siampipa nasem pa ngawng vat dinga ahihleh a ngawng bel vatkha lo in, abil na vat kha hih tuak hi. Topa in, tua pa bil bulh sakkik hi. Tua zan mahin siampi lianpen pa maiah thu kisit dingin ki paipih hi . Peter in zong gamla sim pan in Jesu nung a zuizui hi. Siampipa inntual ah, mei kicih a, tualai ah siampipa nasem te in mei awi ngeingai hi. Peter zong meiawi in a vapai leh, tualai a-om, siampipa nasem numeino khatin amel natel liana, nang Jesu tawh kip awl hilo na hiam? ci-in vakawk phei hi. Peter in, hi peuhmah keng, ken theingei keng, ci-in nial hi. Tualaiah om midang ten zong, Nang Jesu pawl hi teh, a vacih uh leh Peter in zanuam lo in, kiciam phangphang leuleu hi. Tua bangin thumvei agen khit ci angin aak hong khuang hi. Tua ciangin Peter in Topa thugen phawk a, kap dapdap hi. Ih dinmun manlo pan i ciahkik theihna ding Pasian in lampi tuamtuam, thu tuamtuam zangh thei hi. Israel mite a nungtolhna pan aciah kik theih nading Pasian in kamsang te z angh hi. Pasian kammal mah zangh in Pasian in ih manlohna hong phawkkik sak thei hi. Midang khatpeuh zangin zong hong gen thei hi. Ganhing nangawn zangh in i mawhna hong phawk sak thei hi. Athupi pen ah, i lungtang khauhsak lo in i sansiam ding thupi hi. P aunak ah Tamveipi ki hilh khit cianga, amang nuamlo mi, thakhat thuin siatna ngah ding, ci hi (29:1) . Nungzuite lakah, Peter leh Judas Iscariot in Topa nial tuak uh a, ahi zongin Peter in kisikkikna tawh Topa zong kik ahih manin Topa in sang kik hi. Pasi an in awnem tawh hong zol hun om a, tua ih manloh ciangin a khauh tawh hong pai thei hi. Thukhupna Ih Khrisian nuntakna ah, ih lampi tang sinsen in kipai theiloh hun hong om theizel hi. Ahangpen, ei zong thungetna ki neilo, ci leh sa in hong zawh hun z ong om, kiim leh paam in hong nehthawh hun zong om hi. Tua bang hun ciangin anungtolh ih hihi. Hih bang ih nungtolh hun ciangin bangin hong kaikik ding hiam? Pasian in lampi tuamtuam zangh thei hi. Adiak in mihing, midang, thu-um (or) thu-umlote mah zangin hong sem thei hi. Hih Peter tungah numei nonu nasepna in ngaihsut ding thupi hong musak hi. Peter in anial hangin Topa itna mah in amah kaikik teitei hi (Lu 22:31). Topan eite hong nusia ngeilo hi. Ih paisan khak ciang, hong delh in hong zong kik veve hi. Satan in nang hong seepkhia nuam in hong ngen hi. Ahizong na puk loh nading thu kong ngetsak hi, ci-in gen hi (Luke 22:31) Topan lampi tuamtuam zangin i mawhna, i nungtolhna kiphawk theih nading thu hong gen ding hi. Khatveivei hong sat lai ding hi. Tua pen hong itna hang hi zaw hi. I laksiam leh ei hampha, thupha in zong hong zui dinga, ih lak theihkei leh i daupai ngeilo ding hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, a mawhna leh nungtolhna kiphawk kik napi Topa kiang aciah kiklo mi tampi om hi. Hi bang mit e lakah ih kihel loh kh akloh ding thupi hi. Peter leh Topa aleh heek, Judah a mawhna uh ki bang tuak hi. Ahi zongin Peter in Topa zuankik a, Judas in zuan kik lo hi. Pasian in hih numei nonu bangin i nuntakna ah hong kawk ding mi koih ding hi. Tua bang hun I tuak ciangin hong kawkte muhdah na ding thu omlo hi. Numeino bang zangh kei leh mi gilo khat peuh zong zangh thei ding ahih manin, hi bangdan, thatang hatna suanglo, kam tawh hong gen ciang bek te zong lungdam huai ahi hi. Mihing pen eitungah kuamah om nawnlo cih bang I ngaihsut ciangin midang te hong gen ding I ut kei hi. Hih pen alau huai ahi hi. Numeino nu bang dan ih nuntakna ah I tuah khak leh I lungdam mahmah ding ahi hi. Tua pen eimah hamphat na ding hi zaw hi. Dotna: Ze-et na tawh kipelh nading bang hih ding ci hiam? Peter a nungtolhlam thu bangzah tawh ki thei hiam Peter akawk numei nu deihna bang hiam? Na nuntakna ah hih numei nonu bangdan mi na tuak kha ngei hiam? Nang bangci na thuhkik hiam? Pasian in na dinmun manlo a kiphawk th eihna hong piak ding na lunggulh hiam? Bangci dan hi leh na lunggulh hiam? Tags Dim Lun Zam Rev. Articles Kammal Hoih Kei leh Nang Agelh Dr. Kham Khan Khai By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 8, 2023 Kei leh Nang Agelh Dr. Kham Khan Khai Lecturer, Faculty of Education, Asia-Pacific International University Kei cih kammal pen ki phatsakna hi aa, Nang cih kammal in ki khenna piang sak hi. Ka cih kammal pen huaihamna hi aa, Na cih kammal in deidan na piang sak hi. Ko cih kammal pen a lauhuai kammal hi aa, No cih kammal in ki totna piang sak hi. Lawm a neilo mipanu pen a hamsia pen mi hi aa, Kei cih kammal in lawm te tawh ong ki gamla sak hi. Ih puuk hun ciangin ong domto, ong phong ding lawm ih ki sam aa, ih nuam hun in ong nuampih, lungdam pih ding lawm zong neih kul ve ve hi. Lawm ngah ding baih aa, lawm kep cing ding pen talent hi. Ahi zongin lawm hoih taktak ngah ding pen baihlo aa Pasian ong piak thupha hi. Tua ahih manin kei cih kammal in lawm te tawh ong ki gamla sak aa, Nang ci in ih ki dei dan kha zel hi. Tua hi aa, Kei Nang cih kammal sangin Ei mah ki ci liailiai in sem khawm, ne khawm liailiai leng 112 hi aa, ahi zong in 111 in ki pumkhatna ong lak aa, 113 in ki pumkhatna ii a thupii zia leh a gualzawh zia ong mukhia sak hi. Phualva iitna a paai Zota te, Pupa patsa iitna a kemcing, a pom cinten ding leh, ih mai aa paisa Pupa te Khekhap a zui a len cinten tek dingin Zomi Siamsin Momno te lunggeel khawm iin khut ki len mapang khawm ciat ni Na neihsa uh iitna na taisan uh hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Na RSD, UNHCR vai hoihtak kiging in ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Na RSD, UNHCR vai hoihtak kiging in posted on 16 April 2018 at 7:30 am Lomkholna: Malaysia , News , Refugee , Zomi Na RSD, UNHCR vai hoihtak kiging in Gambel galtai mikhat a hong ki ciapteh nadingin a thupi mahmah leh kal masa ahi Refugee Status Determination (RSD) cih pen UNHCR tawh na kizopna ah athupipen khat a hih lam khatvei ih kiphawk kiksak hi. Adiak in Malaysia a om 2013 Card te RSD interview appointment na ngah a kipan limtak a na tangthu na etphat nading ih kitheisak hi. Banghang hiam cihleh gambel galtai khat a santakpomtak dinghiam cih sittelna ahih manin a hun nangah lai in kiking khol in. Na theihlohna sangin na kin lohna in na maban tampi hong khaktan ahih manin na masak dingte nunun keizaw in. eg. Card na neih naikei leh innnuai na tuah sukpak na ngawn zong a lauhuai hi, Palik Malaysia Pu ten Malaysia nong paina ahang hong dot ciang nadawnna pen gambel khat ading santak pom tak ahih kei leh tua na kampan apusuak kammal in UNHCR USA Australia hong tut zawh kei leh kawlgam hong tun ding a hih man in tu a na kampau leh natot lampi koi a tawp ding cih khinkhai sa in nungta hi. Tuni na sepna in zingciang a na siksan ding hipah ahih manin a mawk na cihbang omlo in a thupi vive hi den hi. Tuni tuhun pen na nuntakna ah a thupipen a hihman in thupi nasakpen mah sepna ding nahun pia in. Tu mahmah a na hun nai 1 pen zingciang hong tungding nai 24 sang manpha zaw cih phawk in. RSDUNHCR te thudotna na zawh kei leh bangzahta in hehpih huai dinmun natun hang UNHCR te lampi na tawn thei ngei kei ding hi. Lungdam! A telsiam ding Topa thupha hong pia hen. RSD LEH AUSSIE EMBASSY AH VAI NA NEIH LEH RSD leh Aussie embassy ah vai na neih leh ZAM zum ah hong pai masa in. Gambel galtai mikhat a hong ki ciapteh nadingin a thupi mahmah leh kal masa ahi Refugee Status Determination (RSD) cih pen UNHCR tawh na kizopna ah athupi pen khat a hih lam khatvei ih kiphawk kiksak hi. Adiak in Malaysia a om 2013 Card te RSD interview appointment na ngah a kipan limtak a na tangthu na etphat na ding ih kitheisak hi. Banghang hiam cihleh gambel galtai khat a santak pomtak dinghiam cih sittelna a hihman in a hun nangah lai in kiking khol in. Na theihloh na sangin na kinlohna in na maban tampi hong khaktan ahih manin na masak dingte nunun keizaw in. UNHCR pan in laidal pi a ngah te in na laidal uh copy khat ta na kem hamtang un. More: RSD UNHCR leh Galtai makaite Meeting kinei (March 24) AUSSIE EMBASSY na lut ding appointment na ngah ciang in bangteng kiging ding a, bang teng tam dot pen cih leh nang tangthu te hoih tak kiging khol in. WHO WE ARE Who are the Zomi People? Ist World Zomi Convention,1988 khoob 2025-08-01T10:59:3700:00 Ist World Zomi Convention,1988 DATED AIZAWL THE 30TH OCTOBER 1988 FIRST WORLD ZOMI CONVENTION Venue : Champhai: Mizoram MAY 19 21, 1988 DECLARATION We, the people of Zo ethnic group, Inhabitants of the highlands in The Chin Hills and Arakans of Burma, The Chittagong Hill Tracts of Bangladesh, The Mizoram State and adjoining hill areas of India Are descendants of one ancestor. Our language, our culture and tradition, And no, less our social and customary practices Are clear evidences of the ethnological facts. Further, our historical records, And footprints both written and unwritten In the sands of time testify To the truth of our common ancestry. Much against the interest for preservation, Consolidation and promotion of our ethnic identity, The British colonial rulers after subjugating us During the later part of the 19th century, Exercised the imperialistic policy Of Divide and Rule. As a result, our ancestral homeland was divided, So were members of the Zo community distributed Like cattle sold and separated. Adding grave insult to injury, The emergence of the sovereign state Of India, Burma and Pakistan in 1940s Had the administrative fragmentations aggravated And gave birth to deeper agonies of separation For the constitutional laws of respective countries Divided Zo ethnic origin into different nationalities. For better part of the century, Largely because of our limited outlook Both in terms historical and political, The gravity of our uncertain situation And the danger for our ethnological demise Received no meaningful political response. The genocidal threat of neo-colonialism Against our Zo ethnic survival Still remain ever unredeemed. Now with political consciousness gaining momentum, And the spirit of nationalism quickening us Come fuller realization of our human rights And of our political prerogatives We cannot but feel burdened With the paramount importance of Zo Reunification For preservation and existence of Zo ethnic identity. Re-asserting, therefore, our faith and confidence In the code of comity of Nation For redeeming injustices done to Zo ethnic origin, We, the delegates to the First World Zo Convention of Zo Reunification Ethnically enshrined on this day Twentieth Day of the Month of May In the year of our Lord Nineteen Eighty-Eight Upon the alter of Zo Reunification As under: CHARTER OF AGREEMENT I We solemnly affirm the truth That members of Zo ethnic origin Now living in Burma, India and Bangladesh Are a people of common ancestry Speaking a common language, Blessed with common social, Cultural and religious background, And destined to common political fate and destiny. II We sincerely pledge and affirm Solidarity and integration to take on A just struggle for Zo Re-Unification Under one Administrative umbrella In conformity with the resolution of the Chin-Lushai Conference Held at Ford William, Calcutta On January 29, 1892. III We firmly hold the universal truth That our political aspirations for Zo Reunification Regardless of international boundary constraints Are the inalienable rights of all Zo ethnic origin, Further, we solemnly acknowledge the claim For Zo Re-unification to be wholly legitimate. IV We firmly adopt the principle of non-violence For attaining the Zo Re unification. V We sincerely appeal to the consciences Of all heads of States and Governments Under whom Zo Communities are citizens respectively To recognize and acknowledge The rightful claim for Zo Reunification. Further, we appeal to one and all Believing in the Universal Human Rights To lend support to the just struggle For Zo Reunification At all levels and at different stages. ORGANISATION In order to promote the just struggle For Zo Re-unification I We solemnly affirm and resolve That a loose political forum Called the ZO RE-UNIFICATION ORGANISATION be formed. (And is hereby formed) Further, we resolve that Zo re-unification Organisation (ZORO) Be a forum covering all political parties And Individuals (i) Acknowledging the rightful claim For Zo Re-unification; (ii) Accepting the paramount importance Of Zo Re-unification Above and beyond party politics, and (iii) Willing to subscribe the ideas and views As may develop time to time Through the forum of ZORO. II WE affirm and resolve that (i) ZORO as a forum shall not interfere In any local political programmes and activities Of any constituent political party; (ii) No constituent political unit of ZORO In absence of consultation with ZORO Shall organize any local political party activities As may adversely affect the objectives of ZORO; (iii) Any of the political parties Involving and participating in ZORO Shall enjoy the privilege of exercising certain discretions As to form frontal organizations Within the respective party concerned Primarily for promotion of the just struggle For Zo Reunification, and (iv) ZORO, as a forum, shall normally finalise Important policy decisions In matters related directly or indirectly To the just struggle for Zo Re-unification. WE, the Undersigned, For and on behalf of Zo people, Living and children yet to be born, Look to God in prayer, And seal this document with our signatures. LONG LIVE ZO RE-UNIFICATION. SIGNED BY 40 DELEGATES REPRESENTING DIFFERENT ORGANISATIONS. AND NINETY EIGHT OTHERS. (Source: True Copy) It was not the people who derived their name ZO from the high altitude of their abode, but on the contrary it was the high lands and especially the farm lands there, called Zo Lo which derived their name from the Zo people who cultivated the farms Mizoram : New Magazine, Winter ISsue, No. 2 (1982), p.18, as quoted in Mangkhosat Kipgen, Christianity and Mizo Culture, MTC (1996), p.20 2014 - 2026 Zogam.org . On the other hand, train travel is a great help in getting used to the high altitude. Lhasa is a very popular destination for travelers, here you will appreciate its famous historical buildings Potala Palace, mysterious Jokhang Temple, bustling Barkhor Street, the biggest Tibetan monastery Drepung, and the most distinctive Monastery Sera, to get acquainted with Tibetan Buddhism and the daily life of local Tibetans. Day Route Attractions Activities 1 Train: Chengdu - Lhasa Get to Chengdu West Railway Station on your own 2 On the Train Enjoy the beautiful scenery on the way 3 Arrival in Lhasa (3,650m) Pick up and transfer to the hotel 4 Lhasa Sightseeing Potala Palace, Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street 5 Lhasa Sightseeing Drak Yerpa, Sera Monastery 6 Lhasa Departure Send off to the airportrailway station Daily Itinerary Expand Collapse Day 1 Train: Chengdu - Lhasa Please go to Chengdu West Railway Station on your own and you'd better reach there 1 hour before departure. Usually, you need to show your original passport, the booking number a copy of your Tibet Travel Permit (maybe 1 copy will be kept by the conductor) to pick up the train ticket at the ticket office. Your travel consultant will send you a copy of the Tibet permit at least several days in advance and you need to print it out (3 copies are highly recommended) to bring with you. You may also need to show a copy of your Tibet permit to get on the train. Stay overnight on the train Day 2 On the Train Today, you will spend the whole day on the train and you can enjoy the fantastic view along the railway. In the morning, you will pass through Shaanxi and Gansu provinces to witness the majestic mountains and the barren land of western China. At noon, you will arrive in Xining - the start point of the Qinghai Tibet Railway . You will see massive deserts, immense grasslands, vast valleys, snow-capped mountains, picturesque lakes, and flocks of yaks and sheep. Stay overnight on the train Qinghai Tibet Railway Day 3 Arrival in Lhasa (3,650m) Your guide and driver will greet you at Lhasa Railway to transfer you to the hotel. From Lhasa Railway Station, it usually takes about 20 mins. After being transferred to the hotel, you will be free for the rest of the day to wander around the city on your own but try not to overtax yourself. The first day's well-rest is crucial to acclimatize to the high altitude. Remember to drink lots of water and eat light. Not to have a shower if you can help it. Stay overnight in Lhasa Day 4 Lhasa Sightseeing Today you will visit the famous world heritage Potala Palace . Its situated on the Red Hill of central Lhasa. Potala Palace is the highest ancient palace in the world, reaching 3,767.19m at the topmost point. The most valuable collections of Potala Palace are the gilded burial stupas of former Dalai Lamas and the meditation Cave of the 33rd great king of Tibet. In the afternoon, take an easy visit to Jokhang Temple in the center of old Lhasa city town. Jokhang Temple is the most sacred temple in Tibet and it is always bustling with earnest local pilgrims. After visiting the temple, you will have time to walk around the Barkhor Street , which is one of the most devotional circuits as well as the crowded central market of Lhasa. In the early days, it was the most famous local market but now it's the tourist shopping center. Stay overnight in Lhasa Potala Palace Jokhang Temple Barkhor Street Previous Next Day 5 Lhasa Sightseeing In the morning, you are heading to Drak Yerpa , the most famous meditation retreat near Lhasa. It's a monastery embedded in the cliff wall. Drak Yerpa is described as the "life tree" or spiritual axis of Lhasa. The site had strong spiritual power, having been visited by almost all great Tibetan masters. You can feel the power of the meditation caves here. In the afternoon, you will pay a visit to Sera Monastery , which is one of the "great three" Gelug monasteries of Tibet. Monks debate from 3 pm to 5 pm. If the debate is not your type, you can also enjoy the three sand Mandalas and colorful rock paintings of Buddha. The sight here is splendid because you can see wild roses around. That's why people also call it "the Court of Wild Rose." Stay overnight in Lhasa Drak Yerpa Sera Monastery Previous Next Day 6 Lhasa Departure Your tour ends today. Our guide and driver will collect you from your hotel and transfer you to Lhasa AirportRailway Station for your next destination. Articles Knowledge Lai Nasepna LAISIMNA HANGA KINGAH HAMPHATNATE. Agelh Job Cinpi By: LAIBUSAAL Date: May 30, 2023 LAISIMNA HANGA KINGAH HAMPHATNATE. Laigelh Job Cinpi Laisimna hangin hamphatna le hoihna tampi kingah hi. Laisimna hanga kingah hamphatnate thu a kicingtakin a gelh ding hi le hang, laibu golpi khat dimin gelh ding om kha ding hi. Ahi zongin laisimna hanga kingah hamphatnate i ngah theih nadingin a kisam thu masa khat om lai hi. Laisimna hangin hamphatna tampi kingah hi. Ahi zongin, laisim siam le siamloh tungah hamphatna a tawm a tam kilamdang ahi manin, laisim a siam lote in laibu tampi a sim phial uh zongin hamphatna ngah tampi ngah lo thei uh hi. Tua ahi manin, laisimna hanga kingah hamphatnate i genma in laisim siamna thu tawm khat gen huam hang. Laisim siamna i cih in laimal gawmsiamna le laisim manlanna hi peuhmah lo hi. Laisim siamna i cih in, laibu telsiamna a gen nuam ahi hi. Mi khat in ama nuntakna tawh a kituak lo, a kizawitawn lo laibu khat a sim hangin hamphatna bang mah ngah lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khat in, na khempeuh hihthei khin ding, telsiangkhin ding cih bang om thei lo hi. Leitungah laibu tampi om hi. Tawlnga loin i sim phial zongin tua laibute kisimkhin zo ngei lo ding hi. Tua ahi manin, hun ngah lopipi a laisim nading hun napiak ahi manin, na nuntakna na maban tawh kisai laibu hoihte na telsiam ding thupi mahmah ding hi. Tuma kum tul tampi lai-in, laimal le laibu cih bang om loin mihingte in thu le la khatpeuh a theihnop uh ciangin thu le la a theite kam a kihon ding bek ngakin nei uh hi. Thu hoih la hoih khat a zak ding uh haksa mahmah ahi manin a zaksa thute sing le suangte tungah kuih theih kuih mawhin ciamteh uh hi. Ahi zongin tu hun ciangin thu khatpeuh i theihnop a om leh mipil misiamte kam le muk kihon ding ngak kul nawn loin amaute gelhsa laibute tungtawnin pilna le thutheihna tampi kingah thei hi. Tua bang danin, a beisa huna thupiangte khangthakte in a theihtel theih nadingun khangluite in laibu sungah gelhin na ciamteh uh hi. Bang hanga hih thute hong gen ka hiam cih leh mi pawlkhatte in laibu lui a kici sim nawn loin khang hun a kigelh laibute bek sim nuam uh hi. Kong gennop thu in, laibu khat kum nih a phak ciang, min a neih kei leh tua laibu simtak lo hi kici thei hi. Laibu hoih i cih in a kigelh kum hi loin a sunga thute a hing, a nungta cih tawh kigen zaw hi. Laibu hoih laibu minthang a kici khempeuh simkhin kei in, ci-in, laigelh Siapi, Phay Myint in na gen hi. Midangte ading a hoih mahmah hangin na lungsim tawh a kituak kei leh sim dah lel in. Bang hang hiam cih leh lunglut lo a laisimna in laisim hong thadahsak thei hi. Tua bek tham loin lunglut lo ahi manin, tua lai sunga thute in laisimte ading phattuamna piangsak lo ding hi. Lunglut lo a laisimna in a sunga thute pangpan nopna lungsim hong neisak zaw ahi manin, na lungsim tawh a kituak lo ahi nak leh bang zahtaka minthang ahiphial zongin sim kei lel in. Laisimna hang kingah hamphatna thu a gen ding hi le hang, hamphatna le hoihna tampite lakah lai a sim cih ciang bek hi loin ngaihsutna tawh lai a simna ngah ding hamphatna pawlkhat cih ding hi. Laimai khat kal khat Laisimna i cih in khualzinna tawh kibang hi. Laimai khat na sim simim na lungsim le na ngaihsutna khual a zinkhia hi pah hi. Laimai khat kal khat bang hi a, laibu khat ciangin mun khat, khuapi, khuano khat, cih bangin khual a zin kawikawi tawh kibang hi. Tua khualzinna ah na muh thute in na hamphatna hi pah hi. Bang dingin khualzin na hiam ? ( Bang dingin laisim na hiam?) Muhna tangzawisak nading tawh khualzin ( laisim) na hi leh tua hamphatna bek mah ngah pah ding hi teh. Ahi zongin phawk ding a thupi mahmah khatah, laimai khat le nih, ahikeh laibu khat le nih simna tawh khuamuhna tangzai na kisak khak ding kidawm in. Tedim gam sunga pheklek mi khat na hi phial zongin, Zogam sung, Chin pine sung, Kawlgam sung le leitung kimkot cih bangin a banbanin na kot kawikawi zawh nading hanciam den in. Mihingte thu a tel zawin thei Laibu pen mihingte gelh ahi mah bangin mihingte tawh a kisai lo thu kigelh khol lo hi. Mihingte nuntakzia, kim le pam kep ding zia le mihingte lungsim le ngeinate laibu sungah kigelh ahi manin, laisim mi khat in a sim lo mi khat sangin mihing lungsim tel zaw tham hi. Khemna a tuak lo hi loin, khemzawhin om pakpak lo uh hi. Mite lungsim thei ahi manin, a galte le a lawmte teltakin kheltel thei a, a lawmte a it mah bangin a galte nawlkhin dan zong siam hi. Muhna le ngaihsutna tangzai zaw A tunga i gelhsa thu a om mah bangin laimai khat kalsuan khat bangin i gen hi. Lai tampi sim a, thu tampi a theite in thu khatpeuhah sau mi zawin tangzai muh zaw uh hi. Buaina lungzinna khatpeuh a tuak uh ciangin Laisim a thu theite in buaina le lungzinna vengsak baih zaw uh hi. Pelh theihte pel uh a, nawk nading munte ah kdawm siam uh hi. Laisimna in, na khatpeuh ah a hoih a pha hong tehkaksak thei hi. Laisimna sungah pumpi cidamng, sianthona le pumpi kep ding ziate thei ahi manin, cidamna zong thupisak thei pah hi. Lungsim ngaihsut ding pia Ngaihsutna sungah ngaihsut ding thu a om kei leh ngaihsutna hoih lo pawlkhat hong lut thei hi. Midangte thu peuh kingahsutsakin, midangte nuntakna tawh kibuai thei hi. Ahi zongin laisimna in tua banga lungsim zakzauna pan hong dal thei hi. Lai sungah thu om ahi manin lai a simte in ngaihsut ding thu nei uh hi. Lungkiatna a om ciang, a gualzosate dinmun hong phawksak, hong ngaihsunsakin lungkiat ding sangin hanciam ding a hoih zawkna hong ngaihsunsak thei hi. Nuntakna khel thei. Laibu hoih khat in mihingte nuntakna khel thei hi. Laisiangtho tang khat a simna hangin nuntakna a hoih pen ding a hanciam nuam den zah donga kikhel ( Piangthak) mi a om mah bangin, mi pilte Paunak khat hangin a gamtat luhek a phatlawh mi tampi om uh hi. Laibu hoih khat a sim kha ngeite in tua laibu sunga thute manh teh thei lo ding uh hi. Sum zonna tawh kisai a kigelh laibute hangin a hauhlawh mi tampi om uh hi. Lungsim thapiakna laibute hangin lungkiatna pan lungkhauhna ngaha a gualzo mi tampi i za ngei hi. Mi tawh kizopna siam. Laigelh siapite bek kampau mukpau a siam uh hi lo hi. Laisim a thahatte zong kampau mukpau sim in mi tawh kizop siam uh hi. Lai sung pan pilna tampi ngah ahi manin, a moi a ham, a zawng a hau, a pil a mawl ci loin mikim tawh kamkum khawm thei hi. Thutheih hau ahi manin, a lawm a gual mai ah zahlak ngei lo hi. Thu thei ahi manin, a khangual a lawmte thudotin om thei hi. Ngaihsutna khuak hatsak Laisimna in ngaihsutna khuak hatsak hi. Khuak i cih in thu ngaihsutna le lungngaihna hangin siatna piangsak lo hi. Thu ngaihsutna le lungngaihna in khuak hoihsak semsem zaw hi. Ngaihsutna le lungkhamna i khentel theih ding thupi hi. Sum bangci zon ding cih pen ngaihsutna hi a, laiba loh zo kei leng cih pen lungkhamna ahi hi. Lungkhamna in khuak bek siasak loin pumpi zong gimsak hi. Ahi zongin thu ngaihsutna in khuak hatsak semsem hi. Laisim a thahatte in a khuak uh zang den ahi manin laisim lote sang thu ngaihsut hat zaw uh hi. Lungkiat natna dal Lungkiatna i cih in natna khat hi a, sepna khatpeuh ah guallelhna hanga lungkiatna hi loin ommuan a lungkiatte a gennuam i hi hi. Laisimna in tua bang lungkit natnate pan hong dal thei hi. Nopna dahna ah lungsim puak zia hong siamsak thei hi. Lungsim tawng pan a pai khia hehna le kipahnate ah zong a kilawm ding bangin hong gamta siamsak thei hi. Thu masa ah i gen mah bangin laisimna hanga kingah hamphatna tampi om hi. Ahi zongin laisim dah a siam le a siam lo zuiin hamphatna kilamdang ding hi. A tunga thute in, laisim mawkmawkte ngah hamphatna hi loin thu hioh thu manpha a telsiamte le lunglut taka a sim mite ngah ding hamphatna hi cih kong gen nuam hi. Tuak peuhpeuh a simte sangin a sim ding a zong, a kante in hamphatna tam ngah zaw uh a, a simkhak thu peuh a nuntakpihte sangin a nuntakpih nop thu a zongte in hoihna ngah zaw ding uh hi. Laigelhsiam Sia Job Cinpi kiang-ah hih article I ngetna tungtawn in a hong gelhsak ahi hi. Lungdam mahmah hang. I biak Pasian in hong zatsak semsem ta hen. as my) is a state in western Myanmar hin State is bordered by Sagaing Division and Magway Division to the east, Rakhine State to the south, the Chattogram Division of Bangladesh to the west, and the India n states of Mizoram to the west and Manipur to the north he population of Chin State is about 488,801 according to the 2014 census, and its capital city is Hakha 4 The state is named for the Chin people an ethnic group native to Chin State and neighboring Rakhine State uch of the state is mountainous and sparsely populated, with few transportation links and low levels of economic development t also has Myanmar's highest poverty rate, at 58, according to a 2017 report. 5 History Early history Situated in the remote hilly region of the Chin Hills Chin State was traditionally autonomous and far from their neighboring powers like Burman kingdoms in the east and Indian states in the west to reach. 6 Until the British advancement in the region, independent city-state s such as Ciimnuai (ChinweChin Nwe) later shifted to Tedim and Vangteh in the north, 7 Tlaisun (also recorded as Tashon) and Rallang in the mid-land, and Hakha Thantlang and Zokhua (Yokwa) in the south played important political role in securing peace of the region, 8 and each city-state practised its own independent sovereignty in their own rights. 20th century Upon Burma's independence from the United Kingdom in 1948, the Chin Hills Special Division was created, with its capital at Falam akha later became the capital owever, three townships that are today part of present-day Chin State ( Mindat Kanpetlet and Matupi ) were previously part of the Pakokku Hill Tracts of Pakokku District and Paletwa Township of the Arakan Hill Tracts, until 4 January 1974 n this date, the Chin Hills Special Division was granted state status and became Chin State. 9 "Chin National Day" is designated on 20 February to commemorate the "General Assembly of Chinland" held in 1948. 10 The first celebration of Chin National Day was held in 1951, but it was not recognized by the Myanmar government until the 2010s. 11 Myanmar civil war See main article: Chin theater hin State, like much of Myanmar, has been deeply affected by the Myanmar civil war since it broke out in 2021 ens of thousands of Chin State residents have fled to neighboring Mizoram India, and towns such as Thantlang were destroyed in the fighting. 12 Since the war broke out, several armed opposition groups have emerged calling themselves the Chinland Defense Force he groups are reportedly funded by the Chin diaspora and by the National Unity Government of Myanmar an opposition government-in-exile. 13 On 6 December 2023 the Chin National Front adopted a Chinland Constitution, proclaiming the state of Chinland 14 But resistance groups from 5 townships (Falam, Kanpetlet, Matupi, Mindat, and Tedim) out of 9 townships in Chin State objected to this constitution. 15 Administrative divisions Falam District Northern Ei ginatloh mana i thuakna pawlkhatte pen, i thuak dingin a kilawm mahmah hilel ahih manin, bang hang thuak nuamlo pong mawk ding ihi hiam? Ei khankhat nopsak nading ciang ngaihsun hi leng bel, i ut bangbang semin, i ut bangbangin i gamta zongin phamawh khol kei sam na ven, ahi zongin ei ginatlohna pen, i tu khang, i ta khangah na thuak suksuk ding uh cih ngaihsunkik taktak leng bel, i ut bangbang sephuai hetlo a, i ut bangbangin gamta ngam huai hetlo hi. Delayed gratification or Delay of gratification; Da-dam in e, a ngakzote thupha ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Delayed gratification or Delay of gratification; Da-dam in e, a ngakzote thupha posted on 25 February 2019 at 10:55 am Lomkholna: Article , Nantalsuan Delayed gratification or Delay of gratification; Da-dam in e, a ngakzote thupha Taaidikdek in, a kisuk khitteh zankhua-thapaai thuktung-ah a kihuan vaimimciim tawh a khangkhia minamte ih hi uh hi. Damdam-in a ki-uui dildel, antuilim duhphadiak in, ih nekciangzong keu tawh hawp-in a hai ngiingeeilai-nuamteih hi uh hi. Tuadung zui-in, thatanghoih cidam bek hilo-in, ih lungsim-puakziate zong neemzaw leh gina zaw-in, hehna-lungkimlohna khatzong, ih cillum tawh a valh ding-in, a kigen-a ki hanthawnden a thukhual leh ngeina-hoih nei Zomi a kicite ih hi uhhi. Ih nuntaak, ih khannading takpi meh-uui manlo aa, ih kansukzual ban-ah, haaimanlo in, ih neksuk-buatbuat ciang phattuamna ih ngahdingzah-in, kingahlo thei hi. Nasep a kikin-luatna munlehgamte-ah inn-ah kihuan manlo-in, nekbaihtheih fastfood pen teelmasak hilo napi kizuan phamahmah hi. Tua hi-aa, mangkanggam bang-ah ansai pawlkhat ten homecook a cih-uhleh, ki thupisak-zawdiak hi. Mihing zong, a hivulvulte sang-in, a gamta hiathiatte tawh kikhawlh nuamkisa zaw hi. Nasepna ahzong a manlangding a kisap mahbang-in, zulhlo-in septanghtangh-ding zong thupi kisa mahmah hi. A hizong nasep-sumsilaabek in, ih nuntaakna a kilamh khaakding kidophuai a hihi. Mailam saupi en-in, lungduaitak-in gamtatna pan agah, a limciizaw leh sawtvei kimangzaw thupha pen, lungsim piicingte deih leh theihbek hilo zuihngiatding gamtat-ngaihsutnahoih thu manphakhat a hihi. Ankungte zong tulehtu in, a gah kine-theipah samlo hi. Nekbaihding-in, a kibawltheizong omkha-mahding aa, gahhun gahphaat-in a gahte tawh kibang theilo hi. Suanlehnek kithuah taktak theisam lo hi. Tua hi-a, suanhun omsak aa, lungduaitak-in, a gahlimcii a piandong ngak tinten-ding cihna a hihi. A ngakzo ten thupha ngahding cihpen ih theihciat hi aa, tua ngakzawhna pen pilvanna leh cihtak-gentelna thupha khatzong a na hi gige hi. An amin-mateng, singgah a min-mateng, nekpahding kilawmlo bek hilo, gilsungzong damlosak thei hi. Lamkhat leuleu ah, a minsa nagawnzong a huntun-mateng nekcinglo bang-in kikoih thei hi. A duhlo hi-lo in ki-uaisak, a limzaw ngakna-in, kibilhphot thei hi. Psalm a simten Innlamte in a nilkhiat suang pen, innkiu suang bulpi suak khinta hi, cih ih thei khinzo hi. Ih gumpa mahmah zong a muanhuai-suangpi ahihna zong etteh taak hi. A leitungvai -in ih kithuntantan seloh-hang, ih hihna-ah na omkhinkhian peuhleeng, hong kizatciang thupizaw cih upna a hihi. Pawlkhat in, ih gamtat luheek a hoihlo khatpeuh en-in, a pianpih hi, peuh kicinuam phadiak laizang thei hi. Hatsat gentheihna khat tawh kipelh, suakta cihbang ih genciang-in, dawihaa-vang kikal pan suakta, ih cithei hi. Hikhinlo na hihtuak hi. Ngaihsutna haat mipilten gamtat luheek puahtheih, kidawptheih nading lampi a sialtheih nading-un a sakhituineek pan telgeh leh kantelnuam uh hi. Meikang bang hileh, a katkipatna a thu leh a mun theihloh phamawh sak uh hi. Natna hileh, a kipatna kan-in dalkhol nuam uhhi. Mihingte a hainuam leh hai hong kicihding a ut ki tawmpha mahmah hi. A hizong, zawng bang-in, a ma-tawkheng mulo-pi, mi-aa peuh a koko zong ki omlel hi. Lungsim limlangh ah ki-en zel kisa mah taleeng zong, lungsim tawphah dungzui-in a gah ih nek-mateng a diktak-in, ih kimutheipak kei hi. Tua lungsim tawphah in, ih nuntaakna hong khangkhan keileh hong kiamsak kici hi. Mipil ten bel tutawm aa, sintheih a hihteei hang neulai pek-pan khaicii bang-in vawhkholhhuai naci uhhi. Lungsimpuakzia tampi a omna sungpan, ih thulu damdam in e ih cih pen a kammalhoih bek hilo, zaknophuai thu a hihi. NulehPa hoih a kiciten a tateuh masakden cih pen, a ngeina ahihmah bang-in, makaai-hoih a kigen ciang-in, midangte-a diakdiak in, a nungzuite-uh, masak-zodending cih lungsimvaangh-neihna pen a thupi-mahmah neihloh theihloh in kigen a hihi. Leader eats last-Makaaiten nenunung kici aa, sepding doding leh thuakdingte bek masak in, nekding a kicinkei-lehzong ngawlngam lel kici hi. Banghang hiam cihleh, makaai-ten mailam saupi (big picture) mukhol uh aa, a kilunggulh-taktak pen ngakzo lel cihna a hihi. Ih paunak Muhpeuhpeuh nepahpah hauhciang omlo a cih tawh kilehbulh-in, lungduai tak-in, a hoihzaw a limciizaw ngaakzawhna lungsim-kizawhna tawh damdam in e a kici, ih hi gige hi. Lo kikhawh ciang-in Zolo leh Simlo namnih om aa, Zolo pen kilahak zaw in nget (lungno) in zong nehak bek hilo, liimzawdiak kici hi. Tuhun nekbaihtheih-kiallap ding a kibawlte sang-in kumtawn-khatawn innkhawite mah limzawdiak leh lunggulhhuai zaw a hihi. Kiallap bektawh lungkimsawm pahpahbel sup-huai lua hi. ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Singkung thongkia cihbang naza ngeihiam? posted on 7 September 2016 at 2:21 pm Lomkholna: Cimphawng , News , Sawltak Singkung thongkia cihbang naza ngeihiam? Singkung thongkia, singkung matleh hen tuak cihbang naza ngeihiam? Pakistan gamsung aom Mawngkung (Banyan Tree) khat kolbulh khaukhih tuakmawk hi. Atung a Photo pen kolbulh khaukhih atuak Mawngkung hi a, akungtung ahzong I am under arrest cih thulu tawh lai kisuangmawk hi. Hih Mawngkung pen Pakistan, Landi Kotal kici khuasung ah aom hi a, athupiang pen 1898 kum pekpan ahihi. 1898 kum in hih Landi Kotal kici kuamteng ah British Army Officer khat om a, tuapa minpen James Squid kici hi. Hih Officer pa pen khatvei nitakkhat zukhamlua mahmah in aom laitak hih Mawngkung pen aomna munpan in kikhin kawikawi, ama omnalam manawh in paipai cihbang in zukhamsul in ngaihsun hi. Amahzong ahehsuak mahmah ahih manin Mess Sergeant khat thupia a, hih Mawngkung mancipsak hi. Sergeant pa inzong apu thupiak ommah bangin hih Mawngkung pen mancippah a, sikkhau, sikkual tawh hencip bikbek hi. Hih Mawngkung pen akimatzawh kum 100 bang valkhin himah taleh tudong kolbulh khaukhihsa mahin ki koihkoihlai cimawk hi. Tuahunlai in British Army tepen kilau mahmah a, amau ii gamtatna khatpeuh khuasung mite alangpang aomleh amauzong lehthuakthei cih ahih manin, kuamah in hih Mawngkung pen sikkhau sutkhialo in tudong aki koihsuaksuak hihtuak hi. I AM UNDER ARREST ONE EVENING A BRITISH OFFICER, HEAVILY DRUNK THOUGHT THAT I WAS MOVING FROM MY ORGINAL LOCATION AND ORDERED MESS SERGEANT TO ARREST ME. SINCE THEN I AM UNDER ARREST. Hih Mawngkung tungah atung abang in lai kisuang a, akung asihdong, apukdong mat atuakding hihtuak mawk hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Dahna Pulakna: Mangpha Andrew Nang Lian Tuang (Nautuang, Buffalo, NY) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Dahna Pulakna: Mangpha Andrew Nang Lian Tuang (Nautuang, Buffalo, NY) posted on 31 October 2014 at 9:55 am Lomkholna: Dahpihna , News , ZIUSA , Zomi Zomi Innkuan USA Executive Committee Dahna Pulakna: Mangpha Andrew Nang Lian Tuang New York State, Buffalo khuapi a teng, Zogam pan HaupiThangkhal khuami, Kawlpi khua a khangkhia, Gualnam suan, Tg. Andrew Nang Lian Tuang (Nautuang) in Oct. 27, 2014 ni in a tenna inn phualzang panin lam-etlohpi in a leitung nuntakna hong nusia hi. Andrew Nautuang in hong nusiat laitak in kum (26) phapan a, khangno tangvallai khat ahih manin, na kisa mahmah in kidah mahmah hi. Tuaban ah, Kawlpi a teng a nu leh pa ahi, Pa Nang Lam Tuang leh Nu Kham Lian Cing-ten tapa nih a neih sung pan tapa upa pen hi a, nutha patha dawn ding a kithawipan ahih manin, kikhasia phadiak hi. Tg. Andrew Nang Lian Tuang hong nusiat manin adah akap a om, a nu a pa, a sanggam pa leh Maryland State sung a om a nite innkuan a kipan a meeltheih tanaute, a khua a tui leh a pawlpi mipihte, leh Zomi Innkuan Buffalo kipawlna tawh a kibang in Zomi Innkuan USA Executive Committee pawlzong kidah mahmah hi. Andrew Nautuang pen US gam ah ahong peemtak zawh kum (3) khawngbek cingpan a, a khangto gam a nuntak khuasak zia a kisinsan laitak in abawlpa Pasian in a hun tungsak ahih manin a beidan anuam in inn phualzang pan hong nusia hiding in kihehnem hi. Andrew Nautuang hong nusiat manin ZIUSA kipawlna in dahna lahna in Paakkual tawh mangpha kikhak ding hi. Andrew Nau Tuang tawh hun nunung pen Nov. 01, 2014 (Saturday) ni in RC Pawlpi ngeina tawh kibawl ding a, hanmual ah kikha ding hi. Tg. Andrew Nang Lian Tuang hong nusiatna hangin adah akap lungleng khuangai a om laizom u leh nau, nu leh pa, lawm leh gual khempeuh anungta Pasian in hong hehnem henla, adamlai teng cidam takin nisim mabante kalsuan in, thupha tawh thathak ahong guatkikna dingin thu ka ngen uhhi. Dahna tawh; Executive Committee Zomi Innkuan USA, Inc. Articles Innkuan Nopna Ding Thute SIHNA IN HONG KHEN MA TENG (Laibu) - Khoi Lam Thang INNKUAN I CIH: THONGINN. Agelh Khoi Lam Thang By: LAIBUSAAL Date: June 4, 2020 INNKUAN I CIH: THONGINN Agelh Khoi Lam Thang Inn khat-ah nau kap aw, nuih aw khawng kiza zuaizuai in, lengla lawm le gualte sungtum pusuak in hong om leh innkuan gim hong nam deuh se hi. Ahi zongin tua innkuan sungah lungkhamna omlo, nuihna le maitaina tawh kidim kinken cihna hi khinpah lo hi. Ahih hangin, zi nei lo, pasal neilo a, a kul a khaat a nuntak sangin zi nei pasal nei in tate tute tawh dah hun, nat hun thuak khawm ziaizuai pen nuam zaw tham lai hi ci in kigen hi. Innkuan i cih: laigelh siamte' gelh tangthu hoih tawh kibang hi. Tua tangthu sungah nopna leh dahna, khasiatna leh lungkimna, lauhuaina leh lungmuanna, kihtakna le kilawmtatna, lungdamna leh lungkhamnate hel kim uh a, i sim ciangin hong nuisak, hong dahsak, hong di pkuasak hi. Tua bangte laibu hoih kici hi. Kitot hun le kilem hun, kisel hun le kiman hun, kinuak hun le kizol hun cih bang a kihelh diimdiamna in nuntak bukimna hi zaw hi. Innkuan i cih pen tuipi tung a paipai tembaw tawh zong kibang hi. Huih nem a nun laitak kilungmuang a, huihpi a nun ciangin, " Kalaisai! Kei aw! ngasa an ding ka hi ta veh maw " cih hun om thei hi. Huih dam hong nun bangin huih sia zong hong nung thei hi. Innkuan i cih pen thonginnpi khat tawh kibang hi. Tangval suahtakna kikhumcip a, nungak nopsakna kol kibulh hi. Tua thonginn sungah ei mimal kihihsakna khempeuh kihencip hi. Midangte i kigualzawh sakna mun ahih manin i guallelhna mun ahi hi. Ei' deihna nial-in, mi' deihna i sepna mun ahi hi. Utna le deihzia kikumkhawm-a, nopna le haksa tna thuakkhopna mun ahi hi. Hong it lua ing, hong ngai lua ing, nang lo in nungta zo kei ning i kicih itna a gahsuah theih na dingin, "KEI" khempeuh "EI" tawh a kikhekna mun in innkuan ahi hi. Source: SIHNA IN HONG KHEN MA TENG (Laibu) Agelh: Khoi Lam Thang Laigelh siapa in Laibu Saal Zomi eLibrary ading in phalna ahong piak ahi hi. cinpuzomigmail.com Tags Khoi Lam Thang Previous article Lungsim Limlangh Laibu Sung pan Teeltuam kammal. I pumpi pen a hoihlo na khempeuh pan humcipin a hoih na khempeuhte nuntakpih na dingin kiptaka lungsim khensatlencip, cihna hi. A tomkim ding in pumpi kikhalna mah ci le hang hoih pen, kician pen dingin ka um hi. Laisiangtho sungah ahi zongin leitung thu-ah ahi zongin, makai minthang mithupite nuntakna en le hang i muhtheih tawntung khat in pumpi kikhalna ahi hi. Ahih hangin a dahhuai thukhatah siamna le kivakna nei makai tampitakte pumpi kikhal zawhlohna hangin zakia-in khantohna sangin kiamsukna lam manawh zaw uh hi. Tua bangte pen a kipatna uh a hoih tei hangin a tawptung lo uh ahih manin a siamna uh leh a kivaknate uh zong a mawkna suakthei hi. A phawkhuai thukhatah makaite bek kikhal ding cihna hilo-a, pianthak khat ihih nak leh pumpi kikhalna i neih loh phamawh hi. Banghang hiam cih leh pumpi kikhal na in Khasiangtho gah nam 9-te lak ah a nam 9 na hipaha (Gal 5:22, 23), piangthak ihih nak leh i nuntakna pan i gah khiat ding ahi hi. I pumpi i kikhal kei-a leh tua Khasiangtho gah zong a kigah lo hipah lel hi. Khasiangtho gah i gah kei lai leh a kikhami lo bek thamlo-in piangthak taktak maw cih zong kisittel huai mahmah ding hi. Piangthak khat in a pumpi kikhalna tawh Khasiangtho gah gahkhia ahih leh piang thak makai khat in gah tampi a gahkhiat zawk ding kisam hi. I hailai in Leitung i uk nuam a, I pil ciangin Ei le ei I ki-uk nuam hi. Nang le Nang Ki-uk Masa In Amah le amah a ki-uk zolo mi in mi suakta hilo hi. Pumpi kikhalna a neilo mi-in makai hoih bangci suahtheih ding ahi hiam! Amah le amah a ki-uk zolo mi-in midangte bangci bangin uk zo ding hiam! Inn kuan-khat, kipawlna khat, Pawlpi khat, khuakhat, gamkhat bang ci uk zawh ding ahi hiam! Zeisu in hih thu thei ahih manin Phariseete kiangah makai dingin na cingtaak kei uh hi, na ci hi. Amau le amau kikhal zolo pi-a makai sem nuam mawkmawk uh ahih manin mittaw makaite, naci lai hi. Mittaw makai a suah loh na dingin Pawlu in Kawlentu pawlpite kiangah: Ka pumpi ukin ka kikhal hi. Tua hi kei leh kei mahmah zong midangte tung thu kagen hangin ka cingtaak kei ding hi, na ci hi (Kawlentu masa 9:27). Pawlu in piangthak tampi a makaih zawh nading leh a mahmah Pasian koih saksa nasep a zawh na dingin pumpi kikhalin hanciam hi. Lungduaina in thahatna sang hoihzawa, Lungsim ukzawhna in gamkhat laakna sang hoih zaw hi. Paunak 16:32 Prussia gam makai mithupi Frederick the Great in Berlin khuapi sungah khatvei lam a siauh leh puteek khat tawh kituak hi. Nang kua na hia, acih leh puteekpa in: Kumpi khat hing e, na ci hi. Frederick in nuihsan in: Bang kumpi gam maw na uk, acih leh puteek pa in: Kei le kei, ciin dawng ziau hi. Amah le amah a ki-uk zo mi in kumpi gamkhat ukpa sangin thupi zaw hi. Khat vei mikhat in D. L. Moody kiangah: Moody aw, kua in na nasepna hong nawngkaaisak pen hiam, ci-in a va dot leh: D. L. Moody sanga hong nawngkaai sak zaw om kei, ci-in dawng pahlek hi. Leitung pian zawh mi thahat pen leh ngalhat pen khat teel le hang Samson longal kuama dang omlo hi. A pilpen kan leng zong Solomon losiah kuama dang om nawn lo ding hi. Ahi zongin Samson in pumpi kikhalna nei zolo-a, tua mah bangin Solomon in zong a pumpi khal zolo ahih manin numei huhau-in anih un thukhenna thuaktuak uh hi. Makai pa Makaih masak ding Mi in Amah ahi hi. Bucephalus (a khiat-na bawngtal lu) kici sakol in ama liim amuh nak leh lau ahih manin kuaman zual zolo hi. Ahi zongin kum 10 a pha pan Alexander in a pa kiangah tua sakol ngen hi. A pan a taigawp hangin ngen veve ahih manin ngah hi. Alexander in tua sakol hoihtakin zualsaka, sakol tuan hong sin pah hi. Siam mahmah ahih manin a pa in: Alexander aw, Macedonia gam pen nanga dingin neulua ta hi; nang tawh a kilawm zaw ding gam zong in, ci hi. Alexander in tua sakol kum 30 a phak dong hoihtak zang thei hi. Philip II in Alexander a pil nading leh a hat nading zong deihsak ahih manin Leonidas tung pan siamna leh Aristotle tung pan pilna na sinsak hi. Sakol tungtuan siam in galsiam galhat mahmah ahih manin ama hunlai-a gam kitheitham khempeuh zo gawp hi. Ni 11 sungin tai 400 bang galsim kawmsa-in tungzo hi. India a tun ciangin: Ka galsim nading om nawnlo maw, ci-in kap zawzen a, a khan sungin gallel ngeilo hi. A tuung lamin kikhal zo mahmah hi. Ahi zongin Persia gam khawng hong lakzawh khit teh tua gamsunga hauhna khempeuh zong ngah ahih manin nuamsa mahmaha, a-ut bangin hong om ta hi. A galkap mangte tawh zudawn peuh kidemin nuamsa mahmah hi. Khatvei a zudawn kidemna uah a lawm it pen khat in zu thawl 18 a dawnkhit phetin si pah lian hi. Tua zawh a sawtlo-in aman zong zu thawl 9 bang a dawn leh cisanat ngahin si hi. A sih in kum 33 phapan hi. Gal lel ngeilo-a, leitung lumletin lei-tung mite kampau nangawn khelzo hi. Ahih hangin amah le amah kizo nawnlo hi. Leitung a-uk pa amah le amah ki-uk zolo, kikhal zo nawnlo ahih manin sihlawh hi. Mite in Na thugente A bilkha uah Za zel uha, Na gamtatnate A mit kha uah Luai den hi. Ei le ei i ki-uk zawhlohna mah in hong nawngkaai sak pen a, i gualzawh ding zahin hong gualzosak lo hi. Ei le ei ki-uk zo phot limlim le hang midangte zong ki-uk zo-in kimakaih zo bek ding hi. Makai hoihlo pawlkhatte paunak ahi: Ka cih bangbangin sem, ka sep bangbangin semlo, cih i zatkhak leh makai hoih suak ngeilo ding hi hang. Makai khat in a ma paina sanga, a gamla zaw mun ah kuamah makaih theilo hi. Nungzuite zong a cihtak uh leh makai pa paina ciangciang bek pai uha, a khekhap zui-in a sep bangbang sem uh hi. Makai hoihlo pawlkhatte paunak ahi: Ka cih bangbangin sem, ka sep bangbangin semlo, cih i zatkhak leh makai hoih suak ngeilo ding hi hang. Makai khat in a ma paina sanga, a gamla zaw mun ah kuamah makaih theilo hi. Nungzuite zong a cihtak uh leh makai pa paina ciangciang bek pai uha, a khekhap zui-in a sep bangbang sem uh hi. Tua ahih manin makai khat ihih nak leh pumpi kikhalna pen i hanciam ding thupi mahmah hi. Hunmaan ngeilo makai khat in hunmaan un, aci thei diam! Zatep tuibuk, zu leh kuunza zang napi midangte zatloh ding a gen thei diam! Ama pumpi a kikhal zolo makai in midangte khalzo lo dinga, ukzo ngeilo ding hi. Gamtatna in kampau sangin ngaihzawa, muibun zaw hi. Mite in na thugen a zak ma un na gamtatna hong mu uh hi. Na thugen umlah thei uha, ahi zongin na gamtatna amuh bang un um uh hi. Na thugen a zuih ma un na gamtatna hong etteh masa uh hi. Na thugen sangin na gamtatna ngaih zawa, muibun zaw hi. Mite in na thugente a bilkha uah khat veivei zazel uha, ahi zongin na gamtatnate ahih leh a mitkha uah luai den hi. Mite in a kampau leh a gamtatna a kituak makai lunggulh uh hi. Tua dingin nang na ut hiam! A.D. 1100 lai pawl, Westminster Abbey hana Anglican bishop khat ih han tunga lai kigelh khat hoihsa kahih manin a nuai ah kong guang hi. Tun Kikhal In Kikhalna a omkei leh a dang nakhat peuhpeuh i hanciam nate nangawn zong guaksuak thei hi. Makai khat Ka khangno lai in Leitung kakhel nuam, Ahih hang haksa ka sa; Ka mipihte kakhel sawm, Ka khel zawh loh lam ka thei, Ka khua ka tui kakhel sawm, Kakhel zawh loh lam ka thei, Kei ka teek semsem; Ka innkuanpihte kakhel sawm, Kakhel zo tuan kei, Tun ka tee k ta mai; Kakhel zawh khat bek hong om, Tua pen KEI ka na hi mai; Laitat ding kihi ta, Sawtpi laipek in Kei na kikhel hi zen leng, Ka innkuanpihte lawh zo ding, Innkuanpihte tawh kop zo zen leng, Ka khua ka tui ka lawh zo ding; Lawh zo ding ka minam, Leitu ng khel zo taktak ding Ka hih gige lam Thakhat thu in ka kiphawk. in amah le amah a kikhal zawh kei-a, thadah a, ahih sitset kei leh makai gina, makai picing suak theilo hi. Makai hoih suah theih nading pilna siamna nei napi na kikhal nai kei leh tun kikhal kipan in. Piangthak khat na hih nak leh Pasian in nahoih sep na ding leh kikhal nading utna hong pia khin hi. Ama deihna hoih tawh kituaka Na gamtat theih nading leh na lunggulh theih na dingin Pasian in na sungah na hongsem hi (Phil 2:13). Zingcianga kipan ka pumpi kikhal ta ning. Kazat na hoihlo tuamtuamte kideek ta ning. Nasep hanciam ta ning. Ka vaipuak khat peuhpeuh zo ta ning, ci-in nahih ding khat peuh peuh sottoto ken. Zingciang pen nanga ding hilo khathei ding hi. Tu-a kipan, ahih kei leh, na neulai mahin kikhal in la, tua na kikhal nate pen na zongsatna hisak pahpah in. Gualzawhna Sum tawh Kilei theilo. D.D. Eisenhower Donald Barnhouse in: USA a mithupi 40,000 te kum 28 a phak ma un amau le amau a kikhalte ahi uh hi, ciin ciamteh hi. Neu lai maha kikhalte pen hong picin uh ciang zong kikhal zo-in makai muanhuai, makai picing hong suak pah uh hi. Samuel Chadwick pen zingsang nai 6 in tho dena, tuuk tawh khal tawh tuivot bek mah zangin kisil den hi. A laisimna mei zong zingsang nai 2 in mitpan den hi. A pumpi a kikhal lam kimu thei hi. George Whitefield pen a khansung tawntung nitak nai 10 in luma, zingsang nai 4 in tho den hi. Lengla hau-in sepding bawlding tam mahmah ta leh nitak nai 10 hongsat nak leh: Lumtani-ei guaite, ci-in lum lianlian hi. John Wesley in: Kum 80 bang ka phak taktak teh zingsang nai 5 a thawh ding pen kiziat noppianin om veh aw, ci ngei hi. Beethoven kiangah mikhat hongpai-a: Beethoven aw, Pasian hongpiak talent na ngah hampha taktak teh, a va cih leh Beethoven in: Pasian hong piak talent na cih pen maan mah hi. Ahih hangin nang zong hi talent na ngah nop leh nikhat in nai 8 sung piano tum in la, kum 42 sung tum leteh na ngah ding hi, cihsan hi. A kikhal zolo khat in nikhat nai 8, kum 42 sung bel piano tum zo hetlo ding hi. Talent nei-a a kikhal lote sangin hamciama, a kikhalte mi-thupi suakzaw uh hi. Siamna khat peuhpeuh uuk ding le sin ding haksalo-a i siam na dinga pumpi kikhalna haksa zaw hi. Zingciang Kua hi ding na hiam Cih pen Tuni Kua na hi hiam Cih in Honglak hi. America-te football tangthu ah a minthang pen khat ahi Jerry Rice gualzawhna bulpi in kikhalna ahi hi. A kimawl-pih dangte sangin nakpi takin kikhal zaw hi. A hatzawk na ding leh a gimhak zawk na dingin nakpitakin amah le amah zong kisin hi. Kaih 40 a sang mualtungah nisimin nawhsa takin suktai totai den hi. Nisa lak buannawi lakah zong tai kisin hi. San Carlos, California-a om parktrail ki-cihna tai 2 le a lang a pha mualtung ah zong manlangtakin taizo ahih manin a lawm ten zong phazo lo uh hi. Pumpi kikhalin hanciam mahmah ahih manin mi minthang mi gualzo khat hong suak hi. A vulthei pahtawina ngah nading leh a kimawlpihte a makaih zawh nading hizahta in kikhal ahih leh piangthak makaite a vultheilo pahtawina kumpite Kumpipa kiangpan i ngah na dingin bang zahta-in kikhal-huai zawlai hiam! Hih banga pumpi kikhalna thu i gen ciangin, i siam semsem nading, i hat semsem nading ahi zongin, i pil semsem nadingte bek a gennuam hilo hi hang. Ci le sa deihna a nialhuaite i nialna tawh zong pumpi i kikhal ding kisam hi. Piangthak makai a kici khat in zu peuh, Beer peuh dawndawn mawk leh, teptheih tepmawh teptep mawk leh, mite muhna ah a kilawm lo-in gamta kampau leh kua man zui nuam lo ding hi. Amah le amah a kikhal zolo mi in kua makaih zo ding hiam! Kuan zuinuam ding hiam! I tua cih khak le zong i kipuahphat ding thupi hi. Mite in a kikhal makai ihih lam hongthei leh ciintak zuihtak hongsa ding uha, ei nuntak bang, ei kikhal bang mahin ahih zawh nading un hanciam ding uh hi. Pumpi kikhalna ah a thupi mahmah khat in zongsatna hoihlote phiatna hi. Talen nei a A kikhal lote Sangin Hanciam a, A kikhalte Mithup i suakzaw hi. I zongsatsa khat peuhpeuh pen i phiatpah ding haksa mahmah hi. I zongsat nai loh khat zong i nuntakpih ding baih tuanlo hi. Tua ahih manin zongsatna hoihlote paaikhia-a, zongsatna hoih i neihtheih na dingin hih a nuai-a, lamlahna nam 10 te i zuihzawh na ding kisin ni:- 1) Na kikhal zawh loh nam 5 gelhkhia in. 2) Na zawhzawh na dingin hanciam pah in. 3) Khat khit khatin zawhsawm in. 4) Bangci zawh ding cih pen Laisiangtho le a dang ngaihsutna hoih tuamtuamte in honghilh ding hi. 5) Zongsatna hoihlo a phiatsa mite kiangah bangci bangin phiat uh hiam cih dong in. 6) Zingsang tungin minute 15 sung bangci kikhal ding ka hiam, cih ngaihsun masa in. 7) Sunkim ciangin minute 5 khawng hunla in la, bangci bangin kikhal zo kahiam cih enkik in. 8) Nitak ciangin minute 5 khawng mah hunla in la, bangci bangin khangto ka hiam cih enkik in. 9) Zongsatna hoihlo khat na phiat khitteh a dang khat na phiatkik ma-in ni 6 sung bang hunla phot in la, zongsatna lui pen zo dipdep phot in. 10) Na gualzawhnate hangin mite tawh lungdam khawm in la, midangte zong nang mah bangin a kikhal zawh na ding un hanciam pih in. Thakhat thu-in bel kikhal zo pah khollo khamah ding hi teh. Hun sawtpi a ngakkul lam phawk gige in la, lungkia kei in. Hih bang cieuciaute tawh kipanin gualzo le teh a dangte zong hong zawhnop dinga a kikhal makai hoih nasuak ding hi. Mite in na nuntakna ciintak, etteh tak hongsa-in nang nuntak bangin a nuntak zawh nading un hanciam ding uh hi. Kithumaansak mahmah uha, mimawhte tawh zong an nekhawm nuamlo uh ahih manin Zeisu in thuhilhin taai zelzel hi. Misiangthote thokik ding cih um uh hi. 2) Frederick the Great pen January 24, 1712 in Berlin ah suak hi. Kumpi pa tapa hi napi pilna siamna a sinnate ah mi dang mawkmawk khat bangin a pa in sinsak lel hi. Dopbawl tuanlo-in ngattakin pantah hi. 1740 kumin Prussia kumpi ahi a pa zalaihin kumpi sem hi. Hih Frederick in leitunga pahtawina hoih mahmah khat ahi Great cih pahtawina zong ngah hi. Hi pahtawina a ngah mi tawm mahmaha, tuateng lakah Alexander the Great, Herod the Great, Constantine the Great, RC Pope ahi Leo the Great le Gregory the Great, Russiate makai Peter the Great, Catherine the Great le Napoleon the Great te kihel uh hi. August 17, 1786 in si hi. 3) D. L. Moody February 5, 1837 kumin suaka, 1855 in piangthak hi. December 22, 1899 in zakhang ahih manin leitungah omthei nawnlo-a vantungah Kumpi Pa tawh mangkhawm hi. Sanggam pasal 5 le numei 2 nei hi. Kum 4 a phak ciangin a pa in sihsan ahih manin a van neih sunsun uh leiba tang dingin kilaksak hi. Kum 20 a phak ma-in Chicago ah khedap hong zuakin tua bang peuhtawh kivak hi. Ahih hangin sawtveipi khedap zuaklo-a, Pasian nasem dingin hong kipiakhia hi. A diakdiakin Pasian nasem khat ih kampau ahi: Tulaitak Pasian a ding a kipumpiak zo khat om leh Pasian in leitung in a muhkhak ngeinailoh na lianpi tua pa tungtawnin semding hi, cih in a nuntakna laih hi. Kum 13 a phakin tan 6 sim-a, tuaciang bek sangkah zo ahih manin ama pau ahi Mangkam nangawn zong maantak in pautheilo hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in zang mahmaha ama tungtawnin USA ah khakhanlawhna tungsak hi. Greek Laisiangtho cih thadah Mang Laisiangtho nangawn a telkhin sitsetlo pa pen England gama mipil thuhilh siam mahmah Spurgeon bangmahin Pasian in zang hi. A nuntak sungin tai awn khat khualzina, mi awn 10 val tungah thugenna nei hi, kici hi. 4) Aristotle (384-March 7, 322 B.C) pen Macedon kumpi pa siavuan pa tapa hia, kum 18 a phak ciangin Athen khua-a Plato sangah a sangkah zom hi. Socrates leh Plato-te zahmaha Greek mipil thungaihsun pu minthang mahmah khat ahi hi. A zi Hermias a sihkhit ciangin Philip Macedon in Alexander sia dingin sam hi. Kum tam simsim Alexander lai a hilh khit ciangin Athen ah hong ciahkika, BC 335 in Lyceum kici sang khat phuan hi. 5) Samuel Chadwick pen 1840 kumin suaka, kum 8 a phaka kipan pathekna phualpi khatah a pa nasep huh in nikhatin nai 12 sung nasem hi. Kum 21 a phak ciangin Methodist pawlpi pastor khat suak hi. Thugen minthang khat hi-a, Cliff College ah zong Siapi sem hi. Laibu hoih pawlkhat zong gelha, a sihkhit (1932) zawh tua a laibu gelhte pawlkhat kikhenkhia lai hi. A kampau hoih ka sak mahmah khat in: Thungetna om lo laisinna, laihilhna leh thugennate Satan in kihta lo hi. I han ciamnate hong nuihsan lela, i pilnate hong zahpih lel hi. Ahih hangin thu i nget teh linglawng hi, cih ahi hi. 6) George Whitefield pen December 16, 1714 in England gam Gloucester khua, Bell Innah suak hi. Mi inncing, a zawng mahmah khat ih tapa hilel na pi-in tuni dong mah thugen siampen khatin kiciamteh lai hi. Oxford University ah sangkah in sangsum pia zolo ahih manin sangnaupang dangte nasem khat bangin oma, a sumngah sunsun tawh sangkah hi. Sangnaupang dangte nasem suak ahih manin a khedap uh taihsak, a laibu uh tawisak, a laite uh bawlsak banah zingsangin tua a sangkahpihte phong kinken hi. Kum 21 a phak ciangin tua Oxford University ah piangthakin Pasian nasep hong kipana, nikhat in 3vei 4vei bang thugen hi. 1739 in huihlak tualpi ah thugen kipana, a khan sungin 18,000 vei bang thugen hi. USA le England ah thugenna nei kawikawi-a, nakpi takin khanlawhna tung hi. Mi 40,000 mai ah awliatna zanglo in thugen zo hi. September 30, 1770 in si-a, John Wesley in hanthotna hoih mahmah khat tawh vui hi. A tagah kepte a khoi a vak na dingin sal (sila) pawlkhat a khawi pen kigensia pian hikei leh mundangte ah kawkbang hetlo hi. 7) John Wesley pen June 28, 1703 in suaka, March 3, 1791 in si hi. Kum 36 a phak ciangin a si hileh leitung taangthute ah a min kigelhkha nailo ding hi, ci-in tangthu siam khat in gen hi. Zingsang nai 4 in thodena, nikhat in nai 18 sung nasem hi. Pasian thu a gen kawikawi na-ah sakol tawh tai 250,000 val bang khualzin hi. A laisim na leh a laigelhna sabuai pen sakol elzaang hi lel hi. 40,000 vei bang thugena, nikhat in 5 vei bang thugen hi. Japan Gal Vai Dawmna (S.I.A, Pu Hau Za Lian Suangzang) Diary pan 1942 kum kipatcil-in Japan galkapte kawlgamah ong lut uh a, Mangkang galkapte in nang loin taisan uh ahi manin kha thum sung bangin Kawlgam sung siangtho takin tung khin uh a, Khamtung ong paisuak-pah lo uhi. Tua hun laitakin Tedim Vuandok N.W.Kelly hi a, Khamtung gamah Japante ong lut loh nadingin kawlgam tawh gamgi pan nan theih nading vaikikupna khat bawl dingin Ukpi, Hausa le Upa khempeuh ong khawm a,1942-April 14-16 sung kikupna ka bawl uhi.Tua kikupna-ah Sukte Gam le Sihzang Gam mite in kawlgam tawh gamgi pan Japan galkapte nang dingin Levy phuan ding a, do ding cih kithukim a, Kamhau Gam mite lungkim loin Levy phuan a Japan galkapte i do sangin i thau neih teng ap zaw ding hihang ci uhi. Banghangin Kamhau Mite In Do Nuam Lo Burma Rifles sungah Zomi Battalion khat om a, tua sungah atam pen Kamhau mite a hi uhi. Tua Kamhau mi galkapte , Japante in a na mat khak-te uh na bawlsia kha ding hi. Tuate a bawlsiat loh nading deihna tawh, Japante kiangah lai khakin ;Ko lah ong kap kei nung in no lah Kamhau mi galkap na matte uh lah ong bawlsiatsak kei un ci-in mi nih sawlin lai piasak hi hang ci uhi. Khamtung Pan Japante Bangci Kido a, Bangci hun-a Ong Tung Tedim gam panin 1942 April kha-in Levy kiphuanpah a, Kham le Zaang cinah Japante kidal hi. Tedim gam teng Tedimte in dal-in Falam gam teng Chin Hills Battalion in dal hi. Japan galkapte Tedim lam pan hatin damdamin ong pai toto uh a, Chin Hills Battalionte a kipan India galkapte ong kibehlapin a nung ciangin 17th Divisiante ong tung hi. Mangkang galkapte ong nuamhuai mahmah uh ciangin Kauhau mite zong Levy sungah ong lut nuam ta uh a. A- Levy le B- Levy ci-in namnih-in kikhen hi. A-Levy-te in khasum Rs. 20, a sih leh luangman Rs.300 ngah ding a, B-Levy-te in khasum Rs.10 hi a, khua cing le laitai sem uhi. Chief Pum Za Mang in B-Levy uk a khasum Rs.150. ngah hi. Tedim gamah A-Levy makaite a nuai-a bang hi. Kamhau Gam 1. Vung Za Cin ( Tonzang) 2. Khup Za Tung ( Haupi) 3. Thang Za Kai ( Tuithang) 4. Awn Khaw Mang ( Hiangzang) 5. Pau Cin Kham ( Thangzang) Sihzang Gam 1. Lian Thawng ( Khuasak) 2. Thian Pum ( Buanman) 3. Lam Khaw Mang ( Thuklai) 4. Mang Pum ( Voklak) Sukte Gam 1. Thawng Za Khup ( Saizang) 2. Hau Za Lian ( Suangzang) 3. Thuam Za Mang ( Mualbem) 4. Hau Za Nang ( Heilei) 5. En Khaw Zam ( Suangphei) Mangkang galkapte muanhuai mahmah ci-a i ngaihsut laitakin 14-3-1944-in Tedim pan India zuanin nungkik uh a, 19-3-1944 ni-in Japante in Tedim ong luah ta hi. Mangkang galkap 17th Divisionte Tedimah ong om uh a, galkap, thaupi, vanleeng kapna, mawtaw , laa, apawlcingtakin om ahi manin muanhuai kisa mahmah a, kuamahn zo ngei kenteh , ci-in a kilungnuan mahmah laitakin thakhatin ong nusia hiitheet uhi. Japan galkapte in Phaipi, Kohima lamah nakpi-in a sim ban uah, Meitei gun nitumna lam pan na khiangtanin Tonzang khua gei, Mualtawhtan ( Tuitum Saddle) a cihna mun le Vialcian khawngah na pang uhi. Tua pen galsim dan laibute-ah Long Range Penetration a cih, theih loh kal a, a kigin lohna mun, a gamlapipi- ah lutsim a, khaktan ding galsim zia kisin nai vet lo ci uhi. Japante in tua Long Range Penetration a cih galsim zia tawh a bul lamah lutin a khaktan sim ciangin patau gawp-a nung kik uh hih tuak hi. Japante In Ong Bangci Uk Japan galakpte in Tedim ong luah phetin Ukpi le Hausate tungah: Tua ni a nong tun kei uh leh na ngawng uh ong kitan ding hi, ci-in ong sam uh a, thu ong genna-ah Suang in a delhcip a, a khang thei lo kiakte bangin mangkang kumpi in note ong nencipin na khang thei kei uhi. A delhcip suang i lakkhiat ciangin akhang thei pan kiak bangin no hong nencip mangkangte kong paihkhiatsak zo uh a, tu-in suahtakna na ngah zo uhi. Tu-in Japan kumpi in na khantoh nasing uh kong vaihawmsak ding uhi. Hong langpang na om peuhmah uh leh na ngawng uh ong ki-attan ding hi. Na uk sung khua mite na gen dung uha, hong nen niam Mangkangte ong lut kik loh nading in Chin Defence Army (CDA) na phuan ding uhi cih thu ong pia hi. Japan galkap makaipa in kei ong samtuam a, No nitumna lam gam le mangkang galkapte omna kinai ahi manin CDA galkap na phuanpah inla, nang, South West Commander na sem in, ci-in thu ong pia hi. Hih thupiakna zui-in Sukte Gungal Nitumna lam khuate-ah CDA galkap kiphuan kawikawi hi. Suahtakna le Khantohna cih kammal i zat theihna pen hih lai pan ong kipan khia hi. Japan Kumpi Ong Uk Zia Japan kumpi ong ukzia panin Mangkang dangka ong zangsak loin amau bawl tawm. dangka lai ong zangsak hi. Sial, Bawng, Sakol, Vok , Ak, a kipan ei khawi loh ngasa nangawn a tawi-in ong ngen mawk uh a, mehha, mehtui ong kipuaksak den hi. Thumaan tawh thu sittel na bawl lopi-in upmawh thu bek tawh a kiman, a kithatlum ong omom hi. Banghangin Sukte Independent Army Kiphuan: Japan Kumpi-in Tedim gam ong uk khit a sawt loin gam kaang thu lel peuh tawh amau upmawh mite man uh a, sing lamtehsakin a sih dong thautei tawh dawt uhi. Tua banga Japante ong bawlsiatna thute ka ngaihsut ciangin thuak zo loin na ka sa lua a, bangci kibawl leh Japante kinawh khia zo ding hiam cih thu bekbek a sun azanin ka ngaihsunsun hi. A nungciangin thuak hak sa lua ka hi manin CDA galkap ka phuatna sung a, mi nuamhuai teng tawh thu kikupsimna khat ka neihpih hi. Tua lai-ah; A khuakhua-ah mi muanhuai teel khia-in thu kikupkhopna bawlin Khut khat tawi khe khat khai bangin ma pang khawm-in Japante lehdo ni, ci-in thuciam ka bawl uhi. 5-6-1944 ni-in Japan Kumpi in Tedimah ong sam a, ka vaihawm simnate ong phawk a ong sam hinteh cih ummawh ka hi manin pai loin kap ning, cih ka geel masa hi. A hi zongin thakhatin kikap pah leh gungal ni-suahna lam-a om U le Naute in gim thuak ding uh, cih ka ngaihsut ciangin bangbang hi leh kipai phot dih hen ci-in ka pai kik hi. Ka tun ciangin kei bek ong sam hi loin Ukpi, Hausa khempeuh ong sam na hi uh a, van man tanna le ei le ei in bangci sep leeng khangto ding , cih thu 10-6-1944 dong ong kikuppih uhi. Tua kikupna-ah a pau a ham ngam kuamah om loin kingai dide bek hi. Kei zong thuak zo loin thu khat ka genna-ah Nippon Kumpi in Mangkang Kumpi khut sung pan ong suaktasak na hi manun nuam mahmah ung. Khantoh nading nong bawlsak ding uh zong tam mahmah ahi manin nuam mahmah ung. Kong gennop thu khatah gal tawh kipawl a ong langpang taktak mite pen gam sung upadi- a om bangin ong that mai un. Tua hi lo a, thuman lopi ong kipia kha tam mahmah ding ahi manin a kiman mite peuhmah a maan le a maan lo thu a kisittel khit matengin nong thahsak loh nadingun kong thum hi, ka cih ciangin Vuandok a sem, Zabiak ( Falam- a Japanmin Hachita) in gungal nitumna lam-a om i thum thah ding om a, a thu a kikan laitak hi, ci-in ong gen hi. Tua thah ding a cih mi thum teng pen, Pu Hau Za Lian- Suangzang, Pu Cin Za Dal -Suangzang, Pu Tun Thual- Kaptel -te na hi uh hi. Guahtui ong tam tading a hi manin gungal nitumna lam peuhmah in thau le sakol om khempeuh nong puak khit kei uh leh na ngawng uh ong ki-attan ding hi, ci-in thu ong pia a, 11-6-1944 ni-in ong ciahsak hi. Lampi panin nitumna lam hausa upate kiangah: Keima thu loin thau le sakol peuhmah na puak kei un, ci-in ka vaikhak hi. Khua ka tun ciangin Mangkangte ong nusiat lai-a ka seelsim uh, thau le thautangte la-in Sa-ek-a om, Lt Thawng Cin Thang tawh kithuzakna ka bawl khit teh ka mite thau tawh kithawisakin Kaptel khua-a CDA-te umcih-inong lut un ci-in ka man uh a, sakol khempeuh, thau khempeuh, hausa upa khempeuh, mat bangin paipihin Sa-ek khua-ah ka piphualsak hi. Hih thu hangin gungal nisuahna lam a om u le naute tungah bawlsiatna a zat loh nadingin thu ka thangsak a, Mangkang galkap tampi ong pai-in hausa upa le thau le sakol khempeuh kiman khin a, Kaptel-a CDA-te zong man khin uhi ci-in Tedim-a om Japan kumpi tungah lai ka piasak hi. Tua khit ciangin gun lei khempeuh sattatin gungal nitumna lam khua tengah vak kawikawi-in Japante do dingin galkap ka phuan a, thau nei lote zong singkhuah suangtum tawh na kithawi un ci-in ka vaikhak hi. Japan galkap ong pai a om leh khah-suah lo ding ka cih ciangin kuamapeuh thukimin khe khat tawi bangpah ngeingai uhi. Lungnophuai ka sak ciangin Lt Thawng Cin Thang le a taipih Levyte , Suangzang Khualu , Taakzang munah samsukin phualpi ka saat uh a, tua hun-a kipan amah tawh thusia thupha ka vaihawmkhawm uhi. Sukte Independent Army Min Ong Pianna Lt. Thawng Cin Thang ong tun ciangin Japante do ding a kiphuan galkap pen Free Chin Movementmin ka na phuah sa uh pen ei pau-in Zo Suakta min kiphuaksa ahi hangin thu ngaihsun thei mi tampite in galkap phuatna a min a gam tamin Sukte Independent Army min deihzaw uh ahi manin liangko tungah S.I.A. kisuangsak hi. Hih Sukte Independent Army min ong pianna hih bang hi. Mailam nasep nading tawh kisai-in Taakzang phualpi-ah 1-9-1944 ni-in kikupna khat om a, tua lai-ah Bu Tun Thual, (Phiamphu, Kaptel, A pusawn Tuang Ngam khang pek panin Pute tawh na ki-it na kipom den uhi.) in: I min pen Free Chin Movement sangin nasep nading kipatkhiatna phualpi, mun le gam tamsakin Sukte Independent Army kituakzaw lo ding hiam ong cih ciangin a om khempeuh lungkimin laih uhi. Tua ahi manin Sukte behmin kilawhna hi loin a phuatna mun kilawhna a hi hi. Tua khit, a nungciangin thu kikupna khat-ah Khuasak U Awn Zam in: S.I.A. bang a cih nopna hiam? ci-in ong dong hi. Pu Hau Za Lian in: Sukte Gam Taakzang panin kiphuankhia ahi manin a phuatna mun le gam kitamsakhi, ci-in a gen ciangin U Awn Zam in: Ko Sihzang mite zong Japan nawhkhiatna-ah kihelin notkhia khawm ihi manin Sukte le Sihzang cihna S kibang ahi manin SukteSihzang Independent Army ci lehang hi thei lo hiam ci-in a dot kik ciangin Pu Hau Za Lian in: Eite nasep , Japante nawhkhiatna-ah min deihna tawh nasem, galdo hi loin i gam i lei, i minam itna tawh i nuntakna khamin i mipihte a that nuam Japante do-in mipite nuntakna hon khia ding a nasemte hihanga, hih Sukte Independent Army pen amin kiphuah laitak-a a mun kitap a, mipi lungkimna tawh a kiphuak ahi mnain keikia thu-in kibehlap thei lo hi, ci hi. S.I.A. galkapte training sinsak ding a, guahtui kan, November 1944 ma-in ,Tedim gam sunga om Japan galkapte simin siamsak ding ngimna om bangin tangval, a teitang company khat India-ah training dingin ka pai-sakuhi. Tua training paite lakah Neng Khaw Kam( Kamkip, Saizang) in hi bang in laphuak hi, (a) Zata tongdot ka ciin Thang in gual len va zil aw,ci e ; (b) Gual in al bang mang vaak ci e, pupa phaksap khua mu ing e, ci-in la na phuak hi. Gunlei khempeuh kisattan khin ahi mnain gungal kaai nadingin a khuaciatah khau ka heeksak uhi.Nisuahna lam u le naute tawhkithuzak nading ka bawl uh a, Chief Thuam Za Mang ( Mualbem), Chief Thawng Za Khup ( Saizang), Pau Za Kam ( Tedim Headman)-te a kipan akuamapeuh ong huhna tawh suangtang tungah lai khih khawmin gungal khat le gungal khat kilotin hoihtakin thu kiza thei hi. Japan Vuandok a sem Za Biak in Sihzang gam ukpi hausa le thau khempeuh , Sukte gam ukpi hausa le thau khempeuh, Suahliim-ah puak ding, Sihzang gam panin (Mualbem 14-9-1944) ni-in tung ding cih thu a piakna kazak uh ciangin ka ngim masakna uh ,November kha kingak thei nawn loin kithawi biangbuangin 13-9-1944 ni-in Mualbem khuataw panin ka galkah uhi. Tua galkahna pen Mualbem khua mi, Thual Nang,( Sia Thang Do Khen sungpa) in gunlei khau tungah mi 5 a tuan theih nading kawn leengpei neii hong bawlsak theih manin kimanlang diak hi a, ama tungah ki lungdam mah mah hi. Mualbem khuataw gungal panin galkapte khennih suahin khenkhat Saizang ah, khenkhat Mualbem ah pai-in 14-9-1944 zanin Japan galkapte ka sim uhi. Mualbem galsimna-ah Za Biak le CDA galkapte kihingmatin Japan galkap khat kikaplum hi. S.I.A. galpak Phawng Kim, Si-in , Khai Za Khup, Hau Khual,Vial Lang le Ngo Nang te , mi 4 lian uhi. Tua mite in Suangzang khua pan vive hi a, Suangzang khua-ah ki pua uhi. Mualbem le Saizang ka zawh khit uh ciangin Mualbem Chief Thuam Za Mang innah phualpi ka phut uhi. Mualbem phualpi panin a khua akhua-ah hausa le upate khawmin amau gam le lei ciatah S.I.A. galkap phuanin Japante do ding ka genpih uh ciangin lungkimpah diamdiam uh ahi manin Mualbem phualpi pan thau le thautang pia-in galsim ka kipansakpah uhi. Tedim Japan phualpi le mun tuamtuam-a om Japan phualpite pan Japan sung-a sem galkap pawl khat Mualbem S.I.A. phualpi-ah ong lut uh a, Mualbem phualpi panin Japan galkap omna phualpite kisim kawikawi-in Tedim gambup mite hanciamna tawh November kha cin ma-in Tedim gam sung aom Japan galkap khempeuh kinot siang khin hi. Tua ciangin 5th division galkapte tungah tavuan ki-apna 27-11-1944 ni-in Thang Mual-ah kibawl hi. Tedim gamsung a siantho khit ciangin Lt. Thawng Cin Thang pen Civil Affairs Officer hi a, amah tawh S.I.A. galkapte minphatna le pahtawina lai ka pia uhi.( Ka Pa Hau Za Lain ciamtehna lai pan, Cin Khen Zam ) S.I.A. nasepna tawh kisai a la kiphuakte dawng 9: Bu Siing Lian:( Bank Manager , Khup Pum Pa) (a) Ngual in a taaitaai ong ci e, dam didial-in hei kik ing e; (b) Suktui lunmang hawmsiam kom a, suul-ah ong hei kik ing e, (a) Limbelh gua bang phuk hi ci a, sunkim nau bang kah lawhng e, (b) Batphu zong tu suktui taanggual, suntung phulum phul bang e.
