Kuki-Chin-Naga Kuki-Chin Central Mizo Early forms Proto-Kuki Chin Central Kuki-Chin Mizo language Writing system Latin ( Mizo alphabet ) 3 4 Bengali-Assamese script 3 Official status Official language in Mizoram (India) Recognised minority language in Manipur Tripura Regulated by Mizo Language Development Board Language codes ISO 639-2 lus ISO 639-3 lus Glottolog lush1249 Linguasphere 73-DCA-a Regions where Mizo is educational, and official Regions where Mizo is educational, but not official Regions where Mizo is not official and not educational Regions with significant Mizo speakers, and where Mizo is a working language Mizo is classified as Vulnerable by the UNESCO Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger This article contains IPA phonetic symbols. Without proper rendering support , you may see question marks, boxes, or other symbols instead of Unicode characters. For an introductory guide on IPA symbols, see Help:IPA . Mizo also known as Duhlián ṭawng is a Tibeto-Burman language spoken mainly in the Indian state of Mizoram , where it is the official language and lingua franca . 5 It is the mother tongue of the Mizo people and some members of the Mizo diaspora . Other than Mizoram, it is also spoken in Meghalaya , Manipur , Tripura , and Assam states of India, Sagaing Region and Chin State in Myanmar, and Chittagong Hill Tracts of Bangladesh. It is mainly based on the Lusei dialect but it has also derived many words from its surrounding Mizo clans such as Hmar , Pawi, etc. 6 The language is also known as Duhlian and Lushai , a colonial term, as the Duhlian people were the first among the Mizo people to be encountered by the British in the course of their colonial expansion . 7 Classification edit Main article: Tibeto-Burman languages Mizo is a member of the Sino-Tibetan language family . 8 Most linguist scholars classify Mizo as a part of the Central Kuki-Chin languages . 9 10 In Mizo, the Kuki-Chin languages are recognised as Zohnahthlâk ṭawnghoMizo ṭawngho . 11 Within the central Kuki-Chin group, VanBik places it in the North Central group with other neighbouring languages such as Laiholh and Maraic . 12 Other scholars, such as Schafer, classified it in the Kukish section of Burmese. 10 Paul K. Benedict classified it under Central-Kuki under the Kuki-Chin-Naga branch. 10 13 Phonology edit Vowels edit Monophthongs edit Mizo has eight tones and intonations for each of the vowels a , aw , e , i and u , four of which are reduced tones and the other four long tones. The vowel o has only three tones, all of them of the reduced type. The vowels can be represented as follows: 14 Front Central Back Close i i , ɨ , iː u u , ʊ , ʊː Mid e e , ɛ , ɛː aw o , ɔ , ɔː Open a ʌ , a , ɑ , ɑː , ä Diphthongs edit Starting with a Starting with e Starting with i Starting with u ai ( aɪ , ɑːi or ai ) ei ( eɪ , ɛi or ɛɪ ) ia ( ɪə ɪa , ja or ɪa ) ua ( ua or ua ) au ( aʊ , ɑːʊ ) eu ( ɛu , eʊ or eʊ ) iu ( ɪʊ or iw ) ui ( ɥi or ʔwi ) Triphthongs edit Mizo has the following triphthongs : iai , as in iai , p iai iau as in r iau ruau, t iau tuau etc. uai , as in uai , z uai , t uai , v uai uau , as in riau r uau , tiau t uau , s uau s uau Consonants edit Mizo has the following consonants, with the first symbol being its orthographical form and the second one its representation in the IPA : 14 Labial Dental Alveolar Velar Glottal median lateral Plosive Affricate voiceless p p t t ch ts tl tl k k h ʔ 1 aspirated ph p ʰ th t ʰ chh ts ʰ , tʃ ʰ thl tlʰ kh k ʰ voiced b b d d flap ṭ tɾ aspirated flap ṭh tɾʰ Fricative voiceless f f s s h h voiced v v z z Sonorant plain m m n n r r l l ng ŋ aspirated hm ʰ m hn ʰ n hr ʰ r hl ʰ l ngh ʰ ŋ glottalised 1 rh r ʔ lh l ʔ The glottal and glottalised consonants appear only in final position. Tone edit Because differences in pitch and pitch contour can change the meanings of words, Mizo is a tonal language . The eight tones and intonations that the vowel a (and the vowels aw , e , i , u , which constitutes all the tones in Mizo) can have are shown by the letter sequence p - a - n - g , as follows: 15 long high tone: páng long low tone: pàng peaking tone: pâng dipping tone: päng short rising tone: pǎng short falling tone: pȧng short mid tone: pang short low tone: pạng Notation of vowels with intonation Short tones Long tones mid rising falling low peaking high dipping low a (ǎ ă) ả (ȧ ã) ą ạ â á ä à o (ǒ ŏ) ỏ (ó) ọ (ò) aw (ǎw ăw) ảw (ȧw ãw) ąw ạw âw áw äw àw u (ǔ ŭ) ủ (ů ũ) ų ụ û ú ü ù e (ě ĕ) ẻ (ė ẽ) ę ẹ ê é ë è i (ǐ ĭ) ỉ (ĩ) į ị î í ï ì Note that the exact orthography of tones with diacritics is still not standardised (notably for differentiating the four short tones with confusive or conflicting choices of diacritics) except for the differentiation of long tones by using the circumflex from short tones. As well, the need of at least seven diacritics may cause complications to design easy keyboard layouts, even if they use dead keys and even if not all basic Latin letters are needed for Mizo itself, and so publications may represent the short tones using digrams (e.g. by appending some apostrophe or glottal letter) to reduce the number of diacritics needed to only four (those used now for the long tones) on only two dead keys. Grammar edit Main article: Mizo grammar Verbs edit Conjugation edit In Mizo 16 verb tense is indicated by the aspect and the addition of particles, such as: 17 ang (simple future), tawh ( simple past and past perfect ), mék ( progressive tenses , present and past), dáwn ( simple future ), dáwn mék ( near future ), Modification of verbs edit Mizo gerunds and past participles are formed by a change in word ending called tihdanglamna ; the resulting modified forms are called stem II in English-speaking linguistics literature. Examples of tihdanglamna verb modified (stem II) form ziak , ' to write ' ziah , ' writing, written ' tât , ' to whet ' tah , ' whetting, whetted ' mà , ' to divorce ' mâk , ' divorcing, divorced ' Nouns edit Mizo nouns undergo declension into cases . Mizo noun declension 18 nominativeaccusative genitive ergative instrumental nụlá , ' the girl ' nụla , ' the girl's ' nụláịn , ' by the girl ' nụláin , ' by means of the girl ' tǔi tǔi tuiịn tuiin Thangạ (a proper noun) Thanga Thangȧ'n Thangạ-inThangạ hmangin Nouns are pluralised by suffixing -te , -ho , -teho or -hote . Pluralisation examples singular plural mipa , ' man ' mipa te , mipa ho , ' men ' naupang , ' child ' naupang te , naupang ho , ' children ' Pronouns edit All Mizo pronouns occur in two forms, namely in free form and clitic form and are declined into cases. hers, its ' amah , ' him, her, it ' ama'n , ' by him, by her, by it ' an , ' they ' an , ' their, theirs ' anmahni , ' them ' anmahni'n , ' by them ' free forms kei , ' I ' keima , ' my, mine ' keimah Hih zinlinna hangin khuasung innte kicim in van tampi siatlawh a, Electric Power zong ki ngahlo ahih manin khuasung mipi te cimawh mahmah uh cih Local Officials tenzong pulakkhia uhhi. Pacific Tsunami Warning Center of the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration ten hih zinlingna hangin Tsunami zahdongding in lauhuai patauh nading omlo ci uhhi. Philippines Seismic Agency pan thunei te genna ah 1879 kumin 6.9 hatna tawh zinling aomkhitzawh hih zinling pen ahuaisiapenpen hiding cin genkhia uhhi. Khuasung mipi te zan giahnading, lupnading omlo ahih manin ageinai aom pak huan leh belhbukding in akibawltawmpak Shelter Areas te ah omphot uh cihi. Electric Power aki siatcip banah dawnding tuisilhzong hoihtak pailo cisawnsawn hi. Khuasung kikawmna lamzikte, lei te kicim in Hotel khatzong kicim cihi. Thei-a zuuilo-zong hithei saam incin. Signboard-tawh suang lenlan keitah ci ahidiam kizuui khollo-hi. Cil-pen kamsung pan-in gilsung lam-ah luutsukleh cidamna ahih-tawh kilehbulh-in kampua lam-ah paikhia-leh minute 3 sung-in bacteria piang-a, natna lungno piang-hi. Zateép lehang khu ahihman-in kiimlehpaam huih niinsak-hi. Tuap thahaatlo khat-in gimpih thei-hi. Saanginn genloh saanghuang limlim-ah zateép akikhaam ahihi. Australian Thukhaam (Law)-in phallo-hi. Neektheih-pen zato te diakdiak-ah numei naupang kituahna mun ahihman-in neektheih kiphallo-hi. Na tate khawng-in khomun-khawng ne laulau-a Receptionist ten hongtaái kholloh-pen mawltuak hong salua hilel-hi. Neektheih-pen AU buang-ah ta-nei nulehpa khempeuh-in khomun tawmcilik man-bek leizo kimciat dinghi. Mipi lak-ah neekding akiphallohna ahang-pen naupang khat-in neek aneih ciang-in adang naupangte-in duhgawh thei-hi. Duhgawh ahihteh ci-a hopding-pen Cidamna lampan kiphallo-hi, banghanghiam cihleh kihuatpih neektheih tamlua-hi. Lahpakding: Peanut (Mawngphali)-tawh kihel neektheih neleh husam-in abuai naupang tampi om-a, naupangte-pen akihuatpih tata duh mahmah sese thei-hi. Tua bang-a akihua naupang khat muhna-ah naupang dang khat-in mawngphali ne-in na-kihawm khale-uh naakpi-in lauhuai-a, athu-zong lian mahmah-hi. Tua ahihman-in na tate agil akialleh mawtaw tung-ah nesak inla, mi lak-ah neektheih nesak laulau kei in. Mi-in hai hongsa-in hong niammuh mahmah uhhi. Naupang-nei mi kiang-ah na-hawh ciang-inzong hawhna tunma-in na tate-in lampi pan-in aneek-uh gaisiang sak in. Hawmcing keileh buaihuai peuhmah-hi. Zomite-pen tate-khawng mi lak-ah aduh bangbang pia cihdaan-a midangte-in apaakta ding-a lamen-hiam theihloh, akidem bang-in tawi laulau, ne-phauphau sakse hihang. Hailua kei ni. Inn-ah vaaklah bang-a hongkici zawsop thei-hi. Neek kidemna mun-ah ava-dem hilo cih phawk theihding mi ngeina batna hiphiing laai-hi. Nulehpate-aw, Tate mi lak-ah neektheih ne-laulau sak nawnkei ni! Gilkial-uh ahihleh inn-ah or mawtaw tung-ah nesak ni! Mi tate-zong naupangmihing-mah ahihteh khual ni! Nungak, Tangvaal te-aw, Naupangte muhna khawng-ah neektheih tuamtaum nene sedah ni. Hong duhgawhleh khat leh nih na-hawm zong-in hawmcinglo ahihman-in adangte hehpihhuai-hi. Naupangte-zong cilphuulthei veve mihing ahi-uhhi. Na gilkial ahihleh mi tate muhlohna-ah ne in. Hih-pen Zomi Tuan Pupate Ngeina Hoih Mahmah Khat ahihi. Pa Pau Thual (Zampi khua, kum 40) dahna khitui ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Pa Pau Thual (Zampi khua, kum 40) dahna khitui posted on 7 August 2016 at 7:18 pm Lomkholna: Dahpihna , Dalsianhung , News , Zomi Pa Pau Thual (Zampi khua, kum 40) dahna khitui Indianapolis, USA gama khuasa aom Pa Pau Thual in zanni 6 Aug 2016 ni-in khuapihte mi 3 tawh nga bengin gunpi khat ah pai uh hi. Nga a siah kawmkawm un Pa Thual in suangtum khat sik kha a, tua suangtum naal lua ahih manin taalsuak in gunpi sungah tuikia in hong sihsan hi. Pa Pau Thual pen khua le tui adingin thungaihsun mahmah mipil khat hi a, thu le la ah a kikonlawh mahmah thuthei, thu ngaihsun khat ahi hi. Zamtui momnote hongit le hongkhual ngiat hi in, Malaysia ah aom sungteng ama hih zawh tantanin khuapihte adingin apilna aneihsa leh ahun le avai khempeuh hong piakhia mi thupi khat ahi hi. Kawlgam panin a zi le a tate sam dinga a vaihawm laitak hi a, hibang thu hong pian ciangin a innkuanpihte bangzah in lungsim ki tamzan ding cih i ngaihsut pih ciangin na mahmah hi. Pa Pau Thual tawh kibangin a zi le a tate, Malaysia aom Pa Gin Do Dal (Pa Thual upipa) le innlam aom sanggam ulenau akua mapeuh tawh kibangin dahpihna thu i pulak hi. Malaysia ah Tutpihna: A upipa Pa Gin Do Dal le meltheih tengin dahna kahna gawmkhawmin Sungai Mas aom Pa Gin Loh Thang innpi ah tuzan tutpihna kinei ding hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Update: Mi 113 atuanna Cuba vanleng kiatna pan mikhat bekbek nungtalai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Update: Mi 113 atuanna Cuba vanleng kiatna pan mikhat bekbek nungtalai posted on 26 May 2018 at 10:34 am Lomkholna: News , Sawltak , World Update: Mi 113 atuanna Cuba vanleng kiatna pan mikhat bekbek nungtalai Nungkalsung in Cuba gamsung ah Boeing 737 kici vanleng golpikhat kia hi. Tua vanleng sungah Passenger leh Crew nasem akigawm in mi 113 atuangkhawm uh ahihi. Vanleng akiat ciangin mi 113 lakah mi 3 bekbek ahingin suakta uh himahleh, tua 3 te lakahzong mi 2 sihbehkhin in, tulaitak anungtalai khatbekbek cianlai cih AFP pan Update kiza hi. Tua khatbekbek anungtalai pen numeikhat hi a, amin Mailen Diaz kici in, kum 19 aphakhin khat ahihi. Tulaitak zato ah akikep laitakmah ahihi. Vanleng akiatcil in anungta in aki honkhiathei mi 3 himahleh tuate lakah amin Emiley Sanchez de la O akici kum 40 aphakhin khatpen nung zanni Friday ni in zato panin sihi. Adang khatpenzong nung Monday ni in sikhin hi. Tuapen amin Gretell Landrove kici a, kum 23 aphakhin khat ahihi. Tua ahih manin vanleng golpi sungkhatah atuangkhawm mi 113 lakah khatbekbek anungta gelgallai himawk a, khasiat huai leh lungleng khuangaihhuai mahmah hi. Mexican company ahi Global Air te genkhiatna ah atuahsia Cuban Airliner Boeing 737 sungah Passenger leh Crew akigawm in mi 113 atuang cihi. Vanlenghawl leh asungah nasem Airline Crew tepen akigawm in mi 6 hi a, Maxican Crew vivei kici hi. Tuatezong avek un si uhhi. Tualo Passenger asi lakpan gamdangmi asi tepen Argentina gammi 2, Mexican gammi 1 leh Western Sahara pan mi 2 cihbang ahihi. Sawltak zomidaily Video: The Cuban Health Ministry says the toll from the crash of a passenger jet in Cuba has risen to 112 after another survivor of the catastrophe died. A ministry statement says Emiley Sanchez de la O succumbed to her extensive injuries early Friday after nearly a week of treatment. Cuba gamah Boeing 737 vanlengkhat kia in mi 100 val si Cuba gam ii Capital khuapi Havana vanlengtual panin alengkhia Boeing 737 vanlengkhat kia in mi 100 val si cih AFP pan kiza hi. Tua vanleng pen Cuban State Airways hi a, vanleng sungah Passenger leh Crew akigawm in mi 113 atuangkhawm uh ahihi. Tua Boeing 737 vanleng pen Friday (May 18) ni Havana Airport panin alengkhiatzawh asawtlo in kiasukkik a, meikuang ziahziah hi. Cuban State Media te pulakna ah vanleng sungah atuang mi 113 te lakah mi 3 pen ahingin vanleng kisiacip sungpanin ki kaikhiathei ci uhhi. Ahi zongin nakliam mahmah uh a, Critical Condition ah Hospital ah zatui Treatment kibawlding in kipuakpah uhhi. Hih atuahsia Boeing 737 vanleng pen Cubana de Aviacion te ii neihsa hi a, kum 40 bang akizangkhin vanlengkhat ahihi. Alengkhiat khitzawh asawtlo in Havanas Jose Marti airport geinai aom singlak ah kiasuk in, meikuang ziahziah cihi. Vanleng sungah atuangkhawm mi 113 te lakah mi 107 pen Passengers vive hi a, adang mi 6 tepen vanleng sungah nasem Airlines Crew (Mexican Crew) kici hi. Vanleng pen alenkhiat khitdeuh in akiakikpah ahih manin, akiatlam kitheipah a, Firefighter leh Ambulance ten delhpah ngeingai in, anungtalai in mi 3 aki honkhiathei bilbel ahihi. Hih vanleng tuahsiatna tawh kisai in athu hoihtak akancian dingin Ministry of Transport ten Commision khat phuanpah uh cih kiza hi. Boeing 737 aircraft te ii azat Engine pen CFM International te ii bawlkhiat hi a, CFM International tepen leitungbup ah aki limzatpenpen Engines Supplier ahihi. CFM International pen GE Aviation (General Electric of the United States) leh Safran Aircraft Engines (Safran of France) te kipawlkhawm in Joint Venture in abawl uh ahihi. More: Istanbul Airport ah vanleng kia in tumnih kisuahliang, asi omlo in lamdang kisa Cuba gamsung vanleng tuahsiatna anunungpenpen ahihleh 2017 kumsung ahihi cin Aviation Safety Network ten genkhia hi. 2017 kumsung in Military Flight khat tuahsia in, vanleng sungah atuangkha mi 8 in sihlawh uhhi. 2010 kumsung inzong Commercial Aero Caribbean Plane khat Cuba gamsung ah kiasuk in, vanleng sungah atuangkha mi 68 avekin sihlawh uhhi. Mipi te in September 29,2014 nizong nasiatak in lungphona zomto suakding in geelna nei uhhi. Iraq gam IS migilo te phualpi lian zawdeuh ahi Falluja, Amariya al-Falluja khuapi teng US leh Apawl te in September 28-29 ni sun le zaan tatsatko in kaap uha, Iraq gaalkaap te in zong Leilampan atha neihzah mah un nanawk gawp uh ahihman tamsimsim kikgo zo hi ci in Iraq kumpilam thunei te in taangkokhia uhhi. Kumpi kiteelna abawlzawh uh sawtkhop khat sung mee tang vaai a abuai Afghanistan gam sung Kumpi ding a teelcing makaai ahi Dr Abdullah leh Mr Ghani kikal thukimna hoih mahmah khat ongnei uha, tukithukim na dungzui in Mr Ashraf Ghani Afghanistan gam I President ding in September 29 ni in kiciamna la taktak ta hi. 2014 kum sung bekbek in Mediterranean tuipi tung ah gambelh ding zong peemta mi 3,072 Europe gamlam zuanding te in anuntaakna uh beilawhkhin ta hi ci in Gambeel vaaisai International Organization for Migration ( IOM) te in September 29 ni in thusuah taangkokhiatna bawlkhia uhhi. Belgium gamte in IS migilo tawh kizom hiding a upmawh Belgium gammi 46 te September 29 ni in Court ah sam uha, mi 8 bel court ah kah in adang mi 38 te Syria gam ah pai a si maw ahihkei leh bu mang maw cih Belgium kumpi theunei ten telcian tak a akan laaitak uh ahihi. Europe gambup pi pan IS migilo te huhding mi 3,000 kuankhia ci in Prime Minister David Cameron in nungkaal in genkhia khin hi. Ukraine gam Donetsk khuapi sung a om International vanleeng tual naaihuai teng ah Ukraine gaalkaap te leh Russia deih migilo te September 29 ni in nasiatak in kikaap uha, Ukraine gaalkaap 7 in nuntaakna beilawh ci in kumpi thuneite in genkhia uhhi. Hihthu hang in gaalkidona kikhan semsem ding ci in Ukraine ten gen uhhi. Articles Kammal Hoih Pasian Thu THANGVAN DAWNG I TUN CIANGIN: (When we all get to heaven). Agelh Rev. Dr. J.M. Ngul Khan Pau By: LAIBUSAAL Date: January 6, 2021 THANGVAN DAWNG I TUN CIANGIN: (When we all get to heaven) a phuak Eliza E. Hewitt (1851-1920) Agelh Rev. Dr. J.M. Ngul Khan Pau 2017 kumin Imphal, Manipur ah mun tuamtuam panin Priscilla Center a sem makaite khawmpi nei uh a, kei zong thugenpi dingin hong sam uh hi. North East India state 4 panin hong paikhawm numei makaite' tawh Nipi ni ka zangkhawm uh a, ken thugenna "Pasian kihelna neu cih omlo" (Little is much when God is in it) cih thulu zangin thugenna ka nei hi. Tua zingsang kikhopna ah Meitei nupi 20 gualin hih la hong sa uh hi. Thangvan dawng i tun ciangin Deih teng le lailung damna ngah ding hi Kumkhua in lasa ni, Topa Jesu i phat ding hi. Amaute Hindu panin hong kikhelte ahi uh a, Priscilla Center Imphalte'n amau Pasian thu tawh na pattah uh hi. Amau a pasalte uh AIDS natna tawh a sikhin vive na hi uh a, amau mahmah zong a pasalte' tung panin hih natna na ngah uh hi. Hih bangin a pasalte uh hong khuai uh ciangin a tekte'n, "Nang hangin ka tapa si hi, hamphatna hong puak loin kamsiatna hong puak na hi hi, inn panin paikhia in," ci-in a nawhkhiatte ahi uh hi. Ka lungtang hong vut ngeungau ahih leh hih meigongte kingakna ding nei lo, inn le lo panin kihawlkhiate'n hih leitungah lametna nei loin "Thangvan dawng i tun ciangin Jesu i phat ding," a cih un hong lawng mahmah hi ding hi ven, pulpit tungah ka khitui hong takdatdat hi. "Aw Topa, leitung lam a et uh ciangin lametna ding nei lote'n vantung lam hong et toh uh ciangin lametna kongpi nang sungah om," ci-in ka lungdam, ka khasiat hong suak hi. Hih meigongte'n Jesu upna tawh a sa'n manun nisim thungetna leh lametna tawh nungta uh hi. Upna tawh Jesu mu khin zo uh a, ahi zongin ni khat ni ciangin amau mittang tawh mu ding cih lawpna tawh hong sa uh hi. Amau pumpi AIDS hangin damdamin a kiam hangin amau kha nuntakna pumpi pen Khris hangin nisimin thaksuak den hi. Hih meigongte ka et ciangin Lai Siangtho mun nih ka lungsim sungah hong kilo hi. Khatna, Matt 25:37-40 sung ah "Tua ciangin mihoihte in, Topa aw, cikin na gilkial hong mu-in an hong pia a, cikin na dangtak hong mu-in tui hong pia ka hi uh hiam? Cikin khualmi na hih laitakin hong mu-in zin hong do a, cikin puan neilo na hih laitakin hong mu-in puan hong guan' ka hi uh hiam? Cikin cina na hih laitakin hong mu-in hong veh a, cikin thongkia na hih laitakin hong mu-in hong hawh ka hi uh hiam? a ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Kumpipa in amaute kiangah, Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Hih ka sanggamte a neupen khat nangawn na limbawl uh ciangin kei tungah a hong bawl na hi uh hi, ci-in a dawng ding hi. Leitungah a it dingte'n a pampaih uh meigongte itna tawh a kem numei makaite ka et ciangin hih kammal Topa'n ni khat ni ciangin amau tungah gen dingin ka um hi. Nihna, Galati 6:9-10 sungah sawltak Paul in, "Tua ahih manin na hoih sepding cimtak kei ni. Lungkia loin i sep nak leh a hun ciangin thaman i ngah ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin hunhoih i ngah simin midangte tungah a hoihin i gamta ding a, a diakdiakin thu upna sungah i innkuanpihte khempeuh tungah i hoih gamtatding i phawk ding hi," cihna ka phawk hi. Tutung Covid19 in hong phawksak ahih leh leitungah i kisap taktak na tawm mahmah hi. April panin October kha dong khedap hoih kibulh kha loin ki-om a, puantungsilh zong Video thugen ding ka hih kei leh ka silh ngei kei hi. Kong gen nop ahih leh na neih tampite Topa'n hong kepsak hi a, piakkhiat dingin hong kepsak ahih lam phawkhuai hi. Na pha sem ni, Topa sungah a cimawhte donin kem ni. Topa'n thupha hong pia ding hi. Amen. Laibu Saal Zomi eLibrary Tags Rev. Dr. J.M. Ngul Khan Pau Previous article A Kitamzan thei Lungtang. Tuapa minpen Wan Mokhta Zaimin cin pulak uha, kum 32 aphakhin khat ahihi. Hihpa pen mikhemkhem Criminal breach of trust tawh zanni Friday in akiman hi cin Subang Jaya OCPD Asst Comm Mohammad Azlin Sadari in tuni Statement abawlna ah genkhia hi. Zannitak in Police ten mawtaw tawh apuak laitak in USJ9 sungah akhut kol kibulhsa in taisuah uhhi. Palik nihin Kelantan panin USJ9 aom District Headquarters ah apaipih laitak in mat athuakpan kacina cin lua ahih manin, zatui zuakna Pharmacy khatah khawlin palik khatin zatui leiding in paikhia hi. Palik khatpa zatui leiding in apaikhiat laitak in akhatpa zong kumkhia in mawtaw anunglam ah apailaitak mawtaw anung tutna ah kolbulhsa in akoih amimatpa uh ahawlpa tutna ah tusuk in mawtaw tawh taikhia vingveng hi. Tua palik mawtaw pen tuamunpan in 3 km agamlatna munkhat ah ki mukik a, ahi zongin amimatpa uh mangciplai hi. Amimatpa uh kacina cin luakhia takpi ahih manin, hehpihhuai sa uh a, zatuisai khatah zatui leiding in palik khatpa apaikhia ahihi. Akhatpa zong mawtaw anungbuk vankoihna ah vankhat lakhiading in apailaitak amimatpa un mawtaw tawh ataisan vingveng ahihi. Mimatsa khat akhahsuah palik nihte zong hoihtak in Guidelines zuilo uhhiam cih ki kankhiading a, azuihkeileh anih un thu kibawlding cihi. Section 223 of the Penal Code for negligence by a public servant cih thukhun tawh kizui in palik nihtenzong mikhat ataisuah manin lehthuakkik khatheiding uh cih kiza hi. Tedim Khua Tangthu Tomkim (History of Tedim Town in Succinct) TONGSAN Tue eb 24th, 2026 TONGSAN NEWS Thuthak Sumbawlna News Thuthang tuamtuam Gamsung thu Gamvai Biakna Thului Mihing ki-ettuahna Lam Thului Tuamtuam Nate thue Pilsiamna Pil sinna Cidamna Khuasakzia Laihawm nasep Magazine Lai lam nasepna Tumging lam laibu hawmkhiatna Multimedia Downloads Interview Photo Gallery Radio TV Broadcasting Kipatna Tangthu tomkimcing Thu Suaksak Tongsan Media Team Sepkhiatte Kimawlna Lam Kitup Kilaina Fitness and Exercise Bawlung Lam Zokam Zokam Burmese English Thului Thului Tuamtuam Tedim Khua Tangthu Tomkim (History of Tedim Town in Succinct) By admin June 26, 2023 June 26, 2023 Tongsan Media Group Papi ten thu agen ciang Tedim khua-ah Taap (Hearth) kuavei kiluak hi ci hi edim khua pen kisat zel in kilaawi zel acihna ahihi eh kiim phial-in, a mau pute pate in Tedim khua sat hi ci nuam ciat ihih man in, ih beh kim phialin Tedim khua ah kiteng ngeihi cih na ahihi u Kam Hau (Sukte), Pu Mang Gin (Hatlang), Pu Khoi Lam (Hatzaw), Pu El Khat (Thawmte), Pu Kim Thuam (Naulak), Pu Gen En (Lethil), Pu Kai Hen (Hatlang), Pu Pau Am (Samte), Pu Pau Vum (Sukte) thu in Hausa upa semin, a nunung pen Tedim khua nasat na puahpha in na kemcing uh hi. (Lest we forget ol hen Za Moong, retd. ) 1890 kum ciangin Mangkaang kumpite-in, Tedim khua halin, a kilawi leuleu hi edim khua in Mangte omna khua ahi hi. (Zolai Simbu pan) Mangkaang kumpi in Tedim khua ki-ukna Vuandok zum omna khua dingin hong bawl hi edim khua-ah, Gurkha thu leh Kala (Indian) Sumbuk (Shop keeper) Dobi (Puansawp) leh laa cing (Derby)te tawm khat bek na teng uh hi ua hun-in Tedim khua-ah Gurkha pau bek kizangh hi eitung galpi khatna (WW I) maa in, Pu Neng Thawng thu innkuan Tedim khua-ah na teng masa uh hi umbuk zong na bawl uh hi iantit pai dingte a khasum masa pen uh a sanni in ka sahdah (Tobacco) zuak teng uh ni khat thu-in bei pah hi ci hi. (Citation of Sya Dim Lam Thang) Tedim khua-ah ateng mi damdam in kibeh lap aa, Pu Thang Langh, Pu Gin Thual, Pu Pau Za Kam leh Pu Thawng Cin thu Zomi inn 5 na teng uh hi. (Pu Thawng Cin pen khuano mi hi aa, a khua lam vuah lal kik ci hi) Tedim khua Hausa masa pen Mr uktan (Kala) ahi hi apan gal (WWII) galtai maa in, Zomi inn 30 ciang bang na phata hi edim khua Mangkang kumpi (17 Division) thu in 1944 kum Narch kha 14 ni-in nusia hi. (These rather alarming events had been reported to Scoones, and at 2040 hours on the 13th March he telephoned Cowan, ordering him to withdraw his Division to Imphal plan t 2200 hours Cowan gave out warning orders for the withdrawal of his Division the next day t was a long column that began to wind through the hills in the afternoon of the 14th efeat into Victory, Field Marshal Slim, Pg 294) ua khit akipan Japan thu ukna sungah ki om hi apante hong uk sung ei leh ei kihek in Japante tung kikhia leng thudot thu kantel mel om loin hong that pahpah uh ahih manin, Zomi mipi taang aa Japan uliante tung thu sung ding Chin leaders freedom league kipawlna na phuan uh hi omi lai thei khangno pawlkhat in, Galpi hun sungin, akem adal ding omlo Zomite mailam khuasak zia vaihawm nading Chin Leaders Freedom league naphuansim uh hi r um Son gelh Zo History ah hih bangin na ciamteh hi n order to look after the interests of the undefended local Zo population an organization called the Chin Leaders Freedom League was secretly formed he founding members were Vumkohau, Pauzakam, Khaimunmang, Vulzathang, Ginzatuang, Lunpum, Summang, Awnngin, Zuktsio and Pi Donkoting hey drafted the members of the Chin Leaders Freedom League to serve as civilian officers in the Japanese military administration at the Japanese Military Academy at Tedim. ) 1945 kum October kha 17 ni ni mangkang kumpi in Tedim khua hong lakik hi. (Defeat into Victory, Field Marshal Sir William Slim, Pg 357) Tua hun akipan Mangkaang thu administration sungah Zomite ki om kik aa, Japan gal ven ciangin, galtaina pan ahi zongin khua kiim khua paam pan ahi zongin Tedim khua kizuan kik hi. 1948 kum Kawlgam in suahtakna (Independence) angah ciangin Tedim khua ah township zum hong phut hi umpi tan 10 sangpi zong om aa, khua kim khua paam pan Tedim khua hong kizuan in mi hong tam semsem hi. 1962 kum galkap kumpi in hong uk ciangin nuntakna haksa semsem a, ration card bel in Tedim khua ah khua neute panin mi tampi hong peemta hi u in Tedim khua in Khamtung gam khua lianpi khat hong suak ta hi edim Khua Kisatna: Acil in Tedim khua sat masa pen Guite khang 14 na Pu Guimang kici hi edim cih min a phuak zong Pu Guimang mah hi dingin kigen a, 1550 pawl dingin ki ummawh hi ua zawh khang 18 na Pu Guilun hun ciangin Tedim khua hong kiam kik hi uite khang 21 na Pu Pumgo in Tedim anih veina hong sat kik hi ua hun pen 1760 kim pawl hi dingin ki ummawh hi ua zawh ciangin Pu Pumgo tapa Pu Mangsum hong teei ciangin Guite ukna zong hong bei suak hi. 1840 kimpawl ciangin Pu Kamhau (Sukte), Pu Manggin (Hatlang), Pu Khoilam (Hatzaw), Pu Elkhaat (Thawmte), Pu Kimthuam (Zil-om), Pu Gen en (Letil), Pu Kai en (Hatlang), Pu Pau am (Samte), Pu Pauvum (Sukte) thu in Tedim khua hong uk leuleu uh hi hih hangin Tedim khua asat masa pen Pu Guite Unau teng ahi hi u Songthu in Ciimnuai khua ah hausa sem in a om laitak in amin mang ding (innmang ding) lung hih mawh ahih manin, a zipi thukimna tawh suan leh khak kizop theihna ding ci in, a sanggam nu Pi Nemnep tawh lum khawm in ta nei hi i Nemnep in nau a paai sung a, a mang matna tawh kizui-in Ni tawh kizom nigui pan in piang hi ci-in nau aneih ciangin a zipi tawh ta nei kik a, amin dingin Thahdo phuak hi iimnuai khua ah Guite, Nigui, Guigen, Guimang, Mang Sum leh Tuahciang cih bangin khang 6 bang Hausa sem uh hi uite, Guimangte unau in gamvak apai khiat in Temdim mual dung va tung kha uh a, a gam alei hoihsa mahmah in, tenna dingin iplah mahmah pah uh hi ource: J hang Lian Pau (Zo Lawkta) Posted: Tongsan Media Admin Team Hits: 37 Post navigation မဏပရရ Meitei နင Kuki Zomi လမစမ အကဉခခခမစတဖမနင Zomi Their Country khoob 2025-07-28T06:15:4600:00 The Zomi Tribes The Zomi tribes may be classified into three zones according to their geographical habitation, viz Southern Zomi1 Central Zomi and Northern Zomi 1 2his classification is not very different from the conventionally made classification in the Linguistic Survey of India and other linguistic literature1 2o far as the history, language, and culture of the people are concerned, the Zomi would seem to be divided into North and South in contrast to the general east-west concept1 2he Zomi Tribes1 Southern Zomi The Southern Zomi includes the Asho, the people of Kanpetlet, Patletwa and Matupi areas such as Chinbok, Chinme, Chinbon, Khumi, Khami, Mro, and Matu1 2he Asho (or the plains Chin) are found to have been geographically concentrated in such locations as Thayetmo, Insein, Minbu, Prome, Aunglam, Akyab, Sandoway, Syrian and Cape of Morton in the plains of Burma1 2mong the Southern Zomi, the Khyang and Chaungtha in Paletwa district of the Chin State have old relationships with the Arakan, like that of the Old Kuki to Manipur and Tripura1 2he Zomi Tribes1 Central Zomi The Central Zomi includes the Falams, the Hakas, the Thantlang, the Maras (Lakhers), the Lushei, the Hmars, the Zahaus, the Hualngou, the Khuanglis, the Tlasun, the Laizou, the Bawmzou, the Zoukhuas, the Tawrs, the Zoutung, the Ngentes, the Kneltes, the Fanais, etc1 2hey are found to have been geographically concentrated in such locations as Northern Arakan District, the Pokokku Hills, the Central portion of Chin State (all in Burma), Mizoram, Tripura Hills and the Chittagong Hill Tracts of Bangladesh1 2he old Kuki groups of the anthropological and linguistic literatures like Bete (Biate), Halam, Chote (Purum), Hrangkhol, Ngente, Aimol, Kom, Anal, Chiru, Mayon, Monsang, Koireng, Tarau, etc. also belong to the Central Zomi tribes whereas the Vaiphei and the Gangte belong to the Northern group1 2he Zomi Tribes1 Northern Zomi The Northern Zomi constitutes the Galte (Ralte), Gangte, Paite, Sihzang, Simte, Tedim, Vaiphei, Thadou, Zoute, etc1 2hey are found to have been geographically concentrated in such locations as the Tonzang district, the Tedim district (both in Burma), the north-east of Mizoram, the Naga Hills, the Somra Tracts, the Hkamti district, the Kale-Kabaw valley and the North Cachar Hills and Karbi Anglong districts of Assam1 2he Northern Zomis socio-cultural system is basically complex but despite important structural distinctions, they have closer affinity to the Central Zomi, rather than to the Southern tribes1 2n Manipur, as many as 21 tribes are listed as Scheduled tribes in the 1956 Tribe Reorganisation viz, Aimol, Anal, Chiru, Chothe, Gangte, Hmar, Koireng, Kom, Lamkang, Maring, Mizo, Monsang, Moyon, Paite, Purum, Ralte, Simte, Suihte (Sukte), Thadou, Vaiphei, Zo1 2ven at present, the Mate, Kharam, Chongthu, Tarao and the Enpai are applying for recognition as a tribe in Manipur1 2ll these tribes, inspite of minor dialectical differences, belongs to the same linguistic family, sharing common customs, culture, folktales, folksongs, passing through similar historical process, are descendents of common ancestor, Zo and inhabiting contiguous areas1 2t may be noted that the Anal, Lamkang, Maring, Monsang and Moyon tribes in Manipur are ethnologically and historically the Zo descendants, however politically they are inclined to calling themselves Naga due to weak centripetal political movement among the Zomi in the past1 2he Zomi tribes inhabiting the Tripura state of India are the Molsom, Langrong, Chongrai, Bong, Kaipeng, Hrangkhawl, Ruankhum, Darlong, Lushei, Rangchan, PaitePaitu, Namte, Mizel, Lantei, Laifang, Fun, Khephong, Khareng, Balte, Jantei, and Hajango1 2n Bangladesh, about seven Zo tribes can be identified viz; the Bawmzo, Asho, Khami or Khumi, Kuki, Lushei, Mosho and Pankhu1 2lmost all the tribes inhabiting the Chin State in Burma and Mizoram state in India belong to Zo racial groups1 2thnologically, the above named tribes belong to Zomi group because their progenitor is Zo1 2he close ethnicity is proved by the peculiarity that though variations in dialects exist, the Zomi unlike other tribes can converse with one another in their respective dialects with 70 comprehension1 2hus the chain of their relationship is circumscribed not only by geographical bounds, but more often by racial unity1 2 more detailed study into Zomi languages was made in 1931 and 44 (forty four) separate dialects were recorded as belonging to Kuki-Chin (Zomi) group1 2s per the memorandum submitted to the British Government on April 22, 1947 by the Mizo Union, 47 (forty seven) major Zomi tribes were included, viz Aimol, Anal, Bawng, Baite, Bawngzo, Chiru, Chawhte, Chawrai, Chongthu, Chongthu, Darlawng, Dawn, Fanai, Hmar, Hrangkhawl, Hnamte, Kaihpen, Khumi, Khiang, Khiangte, Khawlhring, Kawm, Lushei, Lakher, Langrong, Mualthum, Miria, Ngente, Paite, Pawi, Purum, Pangkhua, Pangte, Pante, Pawite, Ralte, Renthlei, Thadou, Tarau, Tikhup, Tloanglau, Tlau, Vangchhia, Vaiphei, Zoute, Zawngte and Gangte1 2he Zomi Population It is difficult to ascertain the exact population of the Zomi, because their ancestral land, by the stroke of a pen, was carved up into three different political units1 2owever, on the basis of the 2001 Census of India, and available Census reports of Bangladesh and Burma, Zomi population can be estimated at around 9-10 million1 2r1 2umson, in his book, Zo History , which was written in 1986, estimates thus: There are currently about two and a half million Zomi. about half of them live in India and the other half in Burma and Bangladesh. Zomi Inhabited Areas The Zomi occupy a contiguous region of about 60,000 square miles1 not counting the Asho settlements in Lower Burma and Masho settlements in the Arakan (Burma)1 2he area extends from latitude 25º 30 North in the Somra tracts facing Mt1 2aramati, and in Nagaland across the Namtakik River and the North Cachar Hills, to about 20º 30 North Latitude1 2he longitudinal extension is between 92º 10 East and 94º 20 east1 2he North-South length of the Zogam is roughly 350 miles and East-West is generally about 120 miles wide1 21 21 2au Go, a former Lecturer of Mandalay University and an authority on the Zomi wrote: Our present geographical distribution extends from the Naga Hills and the Hukawng Valley in the north to Bassein and the Irrawaddy Delta in the south, from the Irrawaddy and Sittang Valleys in the east to the Arakan coast, Bangladesh, Assam and Manipur in the West1 2n short, we occupy the mountainous region between India and Bangladesh in the west and the Chindwin-Irrawaddy valleys in the east, and the plains and valleys adjacent to these hilly regions. One Zomi folksong tellingly delineates the area of Zogam as follows: Penlehpi leh Kangtui minthang, A tua tong Zouta kual sung chi ua; Khang Vaimang leh tuan a pupa Tongchiamna Kangtui minthang aw (The famous Penlehpi and Kangtui Between the two is the Zomi country The Southern King and our forefathers Made an agreement at the famous Kangtui) This old folk song clearly tells us the area of the Zomi ancestral homeland, for Penlehpi is a Burmese word for the Bay of Bengal and Kangtui is identified with Tuikang (Chindwin River)1 2his Zoland is geographically contiguous, compact and has been the land where the Zomi permanently settled for centuries (see maps )1 2ere they lived in complete independence before the advent of the British1 2hey lived without any outside interference and domination, and no part of her territory had been subjugated1 2ithin their territory, they were knitted together by common traditions, customs, cultures; mode of living; language and social life (see Zomi Nationalism )1 2hey governed themselves in accordance with their customary laws1 2t was a sovereign land where the people enjoyed perfect harmony on their own (see Zomi as an Indigenous People ). We proclaim that the racial name Chin should be done away with and Zou (Zo) must be re-instated to its proper place and status of racial identity. Nehkhojang, TR. 1 'Zomi Co-Ordination Committee, Resolutions,' Pearsonmun, Manipur (June 26, 1993) Common Identity: In the continuation of Zomi movement, the members felt the necessity of having a common identity with which all tribes can identify themselves without any reservation or hesitation for unity, solidarity and safety1 2he leaders present, therefore, adopted the name ZOMI for common identity which will take immediate effect from today. Pasian sungah lamet bei cih om ngeilo hi. Nuntakna haksa sa lua in lungkham khakuun den kei ni. Pasian adingin a haksa khat beek omlo hi. I geelna bangin hong tangtung loh ciang, lungneu pah kei ni. Pasian in ahoihzaw hong geelsak den hi. I lampi kikhak in i maa hong bing ciang, lungkia thanem pah kei ni. Pasian in lampi dang nak hauh lua hi. I lunggulh khatpeuh i ngah zawh loh ciang, thanem pah kei ni. I ngetngaihsutna sangin hong pia nuam zaw den Pasian inei hi. I damloh, i zawngkhal hun ciang, lamet bei, lungkia thanem pah kei ni. Damna Mangpa Zeisu inei hi. Launa leh lunghimawhna in hong nawk ciang, patau, linglawng pahpah kei ni. Huihpi tuihualte adaisak thei Zeisu ei tawh hong omkhawm hi. I lunglen khuangaih hun ciang, eiguakkhattang kisa kha kei ni. Nopna leh daihna kicinna ahi Pasian in hong ompih den hi. Lungkham haksatnaten hong nawk ciang, lungkia thanem pahpah kei ni. Pasian sungah lungdam nopsakna om den hi. I guallelh hun ciang lungkia pah kei ni. Hong zawhpih ding a thahat vanglian Pasian i nei hi. I cihmawh hun ciang, beidong kisa pah kei ni. Sap teng cinna Pasian sungah sapna teng kicing hi. Lawhsapna i tuah ciang, lungneu pah kei ni. Lawhcinna bulpi ahi Pasian ei tawh hong omkhawm den hi. Maizumna i tuahna ciangin, maizum den kei ni. Note zumna teng kong laakhiatsak aci Pasian inei hi. A beisa huna i thanemna, i guallelhna, i lawhsapna, i launa, i damlohna leh i maizumna khempeuh hangin lungkia, thanem loin Pasian sungah upna leh lametna tawh mainawt den ni. I Pasian sungah na khempeuh kicing hi. Pasian hangin i mailam taang den hi cih, mangngilh ngei kei ni. Amen Khazih sungah, David Tuang Reader Interactions Previous: Pilna cingtaak anei kuate hiam? "url": " "depth": 1 --- Tukhang khangnote khan Dr. Pau Khan En ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Tukhang khangnote khan Dr. Pau Khan En posted on 23 June 2019 at 4:59 pm Lomkholna: Article , Paukhanen Tukhang khangnote khan (The Youth of this Generation) Dr. Pau Khan En Leitung khang tangthute en le hang ngaihsutna thuthakte kum za om simin a na kikhel tohtohna teltakin i mu thei hi. Ahi zongin kum zalom sawmnih (twentieth century) bei kuan ciangin kum zalom khat ngakzo lo-in kum sawm lom (one decade) sung cih phial dingin thungaihsutna hong kinak khel pha mahmah hi. Kum (1980-2000) sungin Hunkhen thu pomzia (postmodernity) le Leitungbup huam ngaihsutna (Globalization) te-in leitung buppi hong zeel ziahziah ta hi. Hun khen thu pomzia hangin tangtawng ngaihsutna ahi thuman khat bek om (absolute truth) pan in thuman i sak bangbang aman hi lel hi (relative truth) cih thu hong lang mahmah pah hi. Thuman le maan lo pen i et na tungah kinga zaw lo (objective truth) in tua na a en nu a en pa tungah kinga zaw hi, (subjective truth) cih ahi hi. Tua bang mahin leitung zong a nei tuam om sese lo-in zang khawm ni, zangkhawm zeekkhawm ni cih hi-a, gam khempeuh ah sum zuak zum bawlna company te (multi-national company, transnational company) hong om to pah zuahzuah hi. Hih globalization kici taang leitung ngaihsutna ah a kilang pen zia le tong (characteristic) in kidemna (competition) ahi hi. A zote khang toto ding a, a lelte kia suksuk ding hi, cih hi mai hi. Hi banga khanghun a kikhek laitakin khangthak hun a nei, pilna siamna a sin Kalay University a om, Zomi Siamsin Kipawlnate in Laisin kum 2017-2018 kum ading Siamsin Magazine Volume 5 na sunga suahsak dingin thului (article) hong nget uh ciangin ka lungdam a thului khat kong gelh pah buatbuat hi. Ahangin amaute khangthak hun ah i muan i suan ding, i gam i lei le i minamte hong makaih dingte-uh ahi hi. Nawl khin theih loh ding tukhang leh mailam khangthak hun adingin i mi poimawhte- uh ahi hi. Kam dang khat in ci le hang tu khang leh mailam a ding a, a kithawi khol a kiging khol pilna siamna nei khangnote uh ahi hi. Tua ahih manin TUKHANG KHANGNOTE KHAN cih thulu bulhin ka ngaihsutna pawl khat hong pholh khia in Siamsin tuailaite zong ka vaikhak nuam hi. 1) Tulai Siamsin Khangnote in pilna mahmah hong bulphuh veva ding uh ka deihsak masa hi. Sangman ding leh degree ngah maimai ding ciang bek hi lo-in amau sin pilna siamna (major field) tektek theihpi a hong theih, siam pi a hong siam ding uh ka lunggulh mahmah hi. Pilna peuhpeuh a val om het lo hi. University a siamsin Khangnote aw, na sin uh thu (major subject) khempeuh siam mahmah dingin hong hanciam un. A zo, aman leh a tunga ka gen mah bangin degree ngah maimai ciang bek hi lo-a, a siamngiat ding leh i gam i lei, i minam sungah a zang khia thei ngiat dingin hong hanciam un cih kong vaikhak nuam hi. 2) Tukhang a Khangnote Khan ding aka deih, ka lunggulh leh Siamsin University a tuamtuam a om tuailai Khangnote ka vai khak nop thu in pasian mahmah mangngilh loh ding ahi hi. Pasian masak lo-in kikhawsuak zo lo hi. Gam leh lei, i minam kipuah zo lo hi. A tomin ci le hang midangte ading kinung ta zo lo hi. Tua bang ka cih ciangin Pasian thu bek ngaihsunin sang man ciangin hunbit Pasian nasem ding a cipah ka hi kei hi. Tua pen Pasian hong teel thu hi ding hi. Ahi zongin Pasian phawk kawm zahtak kawm a na sep khempeuh Pasian nasepna mah hi pah hi. Tu laitak in i minam sungah i kisap lian pen in hunbit Pasian nasem ding sangin Pasian bulphuh leitung nasem tampi i kisam zaw pek hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen taangzai zaw thuk bun zaw hi. Ka khualzinna a ka giahna hotel khatah laikhat na kisuanga tua lai in, Lawh nei dingin sin in (Learn to earn) Nuntak nadingin lawh nei in (Earn to live) Taangpite na sem dingin nungta in (Live to serve) ci-in lai na kisuang hi. Ka lungsim hong khoih hi. Hi kasa peuh mah hi. Pilsinna i kungmui in taangpite adinga nuntakna hi thong hi. Pilna na sin laitakin nanu napa, nakhua natui in nang hong lamen hi. Na Pawlpi in nang hong lamen hi. Kawlgam bupin nang hong lamen hi. Tua tetungah na hoih sem ding (to serve) in nang hong kilemen mahmah hi. Pasian bulphuh in nikhat ni ciangin minam makai leh gam makai na hih ding lamen in nang hong kilemen hi. Tukhang, Khangnote Khan in Pasian bulphuh khangnote hih ding mahmah thupi pen hi. 3) Tukhang Khangnote Khan ding a, a lungulh huai mahmah khat in muhkholhna (vision) neih ding ahi hi. Mailam kum sawm, kum sawm nih, ah Zomite koi ci kalsuan ding cih muhkholhna neih ding kisam hi. Muhkholhna (vision) nei om kei leh minamte kiam duaiduai ding hi. Ahi zongin tua Muhkholhna pen mimal khat bek muh kholhna hi lo-in mikim muhkholhna (common vision) ahih ding kisam ding hi. Tua bang mah in tua Mulkholhna zong sepna in a zuih ding kisam lai ding hi. I minam leh i gam i lei adingin Muhkholhna nei makai leh tua muhkholhnate a sem ding makai tampi i kisam hi. I minam pihte-in Siamsin Khangnote tung panin tua bang a Muhkholhna leh mangmatna (vision) a nei, tua Muhkholhnate a semkhia makai nong hih ding uh hong lamen hi. I minam leh i gam i lei adingin Muhkholhna (vision) nei-in tua Muhkholhna (vision) pen sepkhiatna (action) in a zuih ding kisam ding hi. Hi kei leh i Muhkholhna (vision) pen zalmang (dream) bek hong suak ding hi. Tua ahih manin Tukhang Khangnote Khan ding a ka lunggulh in Muhkholhna (vision) mahmah hong neih ding uh ahi hi. Tua phot lo-in i minam le i gam i lei kipuah kizuun zo lo ding hi. 4) Tukhang Khangnote Khan dinga ka deihsak lian mah khat in Gamsung ki-ukna (politics) ah kihel ding ahi hi. Kum 50 taang (1962-2010) bang khakcipna (restriction) i thuak hi. Tu-in i deih zah le i lamet zah ahih nai loh hangin tua henkol damdam in hong kisut ding tawh kibang hi. Hih hun laitakin pilna nei tuailai khangno tampi gam ki-ukna Nainganzi (politics) ah kihel ding kisam hi. I kihel kei leh mite nuai ah i om den ding hi. Tho to-in ei zong i deih na i awsuah ding (voice) kisam hi. Pasian nasem ding tua zah in i kisam pak nawn kei ding hi. Ahi zongin gam ki-ukna (Nainganzi) lam leh kumpi nasem lamah (civil service) tampi i kisam lai hi. Tua ahih manin Tukhang a Khangnote aw, i minam leh i gam i lei puah ding in ki-ukna (Nainganzi) a zui khangno tampi hong kipia khia un. Hong panpih dingin i minam bup in kong ngak uh hi. Hi pen biakna nasep zah mahin a siangtho, a manpha, a haksa nasep ahi hi. Kipiak khiat (sacrifice) kul hi. Baih lo, ol lo hi. Ahi zongin i minam le igam i lei na it uh leh sep loh in pha mawh hi. Ei in i sep kei leh mi-in hong sem ding a mite khut nuai ah i omom ding hi. Kei lunggulh ngel ah bel mai 2020 kitel hun ciang peuhmah in Zomi Siamsin Khangno sungpan in nih leh thum hong kidok khia in mekuang hong lui a, tua te mah Zomibup in me pia pah ngiat a Zomi tang mi hong hih dinguh ka lunggulh le ka thungetna ahi hi. Nainganzi peuhmah nawlkhin khakha lo-in thutak in sunglut in makai hihding tum dih ni. Siamsin khangnote aw, hong hanciam un. Tua zah khat mahin kumpi nasepna (civil service) ah zong pilna nei Tukhang Khangnote tampi lut dih ni. Khat le nih i om kiaukiau hi. Lungdam hi hang. Maingal tuam hi hang. Gam le minam ading a nuntak theihna, nasep theihna leh gamtat hoih gamtat pha teci pan khiat theihna tua mun ahi hi. Khangno tampi kumpi nasepna sungah hong tualbual le-uh cin cih i minam bup taangin kong hanthawn hi. Tukhang Khangnote Khan dinga ka lunggulh thu a ngana in khangnote lungsim taangzai a, a huam kim ding (inclusivism) cih ahi hi. Ei Zomi sungah zong ki batlohna tampi i nei hi. Kampau awsuah, i kibang kei hi. Teenna mun le mual kibang lo-in a kual a kual in i om hi. Biakna pawl (denomination) in hong khen lai hi. Hih bang nianua lak a, a om Zomite khatlekhat kigimneih lo-in i kihuaikim nading pen Tukhang a Khangnote Khan ding ahi hi. Kipuaseh ding baih a, kihuaikim ding haksa hi. Hita leh Tukhang a Khangno Siamsin mipil misiamte-in a minam a hiang a meng khempeuh puaseh het lo-a, sungtumin huaikim ding kisam hi. I kibat loh i kilamdannate kitelsiam kisang siam a thupi lapi a om ciangin lawng khat a ging zo ziahziah dingin i om ding kisam hi. Hih in Tukhang Khangnote vaipuak hingiat hi. Ei Zomi nam bek hi lo, sak le khang a omte leitungbup a om khangnote tawh suakta tak in kizom kipawl thei in mite thusim le zahtak banga a om theih ding pen tukhang Zomi Khangnote vaipuak lian pen ahi hi. Tung Pasian in Kalay University a om Zomi Siamsin kipawlna thupha pia hen la, akhang akhangin kip semsem zai semsem ta hen! A minam bup uh Kawlgam bup adingin zattheih pilna siamna a nei minamte suan minamte muan leh Tukhang Khangnote Khan a hoih a, a zeem le a zuun zo dingin i biak Pasian in hong siam ta hen! ci-in thupha kong paih hi. Kam-tawh minam it leh kineihna-tawh minam it na-hi kei-a, kalsuan khiatna-tawh minam itpa na hihi. Pulpit leh Online pan-a minam it na-hi kei-a, lungsim takpi-tawh minam it na-hihi. Zomi Association of Malaysia (ZAM) apiankhiat nading-in 2006 June 7 ni-in Pu Neng Hau Kim, Pu Khawm Khen Mang, Pu Hang Khan Kap cihte leh ka nau Langh Suan Cin te-tawh lei hong petlet Ngalliam Thang Khen Pau: Mite-in bangbang-in hongmu-in hongseh mahleh Na hihna taktak Minam Itpa na hihna khangsawn zata-in tuubang ciing dinghi. Malaysia pan-a Gam Thumna atung Zomite deuhdeuh-in phawkden uhhen! Ziilehta maáipha-zong muhloh lawhphial khading himahlecin USA pan-in Malaysia-ah hongpai-in Gamnuam tungsa Zomite kiang-ah hihteng-a dongtuak Zomite huh nading sumdong ding-in palaai kiguang le-uhcin ci-a veina-tawh hong tutpih mi thupi Ngalliam Thang Khen Pau: ZAM kalsuanna hong taángzai-in hong phungphat ciang-inzong Ka patsa, cih kammal-tawh ZAM Tanute thaneem nading kammal khatvei beék aging saklo Ngalliam Thang Khen Pau: Laulo, lunghianglo, lungneulo, kisuanglo tak-in Zomi minam na itna masuan inla, angtang tak-in awmpho leuleu-in Thangvaan Khuamual va-suak inmaw, Ngalliam Thang Khen Pau Gualnam! Zomi Salphate Salpha Thang Khen Pau, Daihna Sung-ah Tawlnga In. Minsial, T. Zokhai (Founder Former Gen. Secretary, Zomi Association of Malaysia) Established on 7 June 2006 Zosai (Cinpi and Khampu Pty Ltd.) ZAM pan dahpihna pulakna Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam pen June 2006 kum in Zomi te zong kipawlna kician khat neih loh phamawh hi ci-in veina lianpi tawh sum leh paai leh hun te pia khia in Malaysia gam ah hong zin a, Zomi Association of Malaysia -ZAM kipatna dingin hong hanciam khia khat na hi hi. Phulum phulna dingin leikha in petlet a cih bangin Zomi Association of Malaysia-ZAM a pian na dingin a petlet te sungah khat a hi hi. Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam pen Zomi itna leh veina tawh a sup lawh a bei lawh ngam khat a hi hi. Mitampi takin Zomi hangin met lawh sawm hi mah leh Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam in a veina taktak pen piakkhiatna tawh hong lak khia hi. Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam, Malaysia leitang tungah om veina tawh a kipiakhia Pu Zo Khai leh a lawmte makaih na tawh June, 2006 pan Zomi Association of Malaysia -ZAM kiding a,tuni dong mah maban kizom toto hi. Hih kipawlna hangin Zomi tampi tak mah gam thumna ki tun lawh a, gentheih haksa tampi tak mah zong noptuam lawh in thong kia ding tampi mah zong suahtakna ngah lawh hi. Zomi te tangthu ah a mang ngei nawnlo ding leh Zomite om lai teng a kigen den ding tangthu hoih khat a at khia Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam hi mun pan in zahtakna i pia hi. Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam in 23 September 2020 ni in a teenna California, USA pan in leitung nuntakna nusia in i Pa kiang ah hong ciah san hi. Pu Thang Khen Pau Gualnam hangin a dah a kap khempeuh Topan a lamdangin hong hehnem ta hen. Zomi Ngalliam Zuapa Pu Cin Sian Thang tangthu ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zomi Ngalliam Zuapa Pu Cin Sian Thang tangthu posted on 3 August 2021 at 3:41 pm Lomkholna: News , World , Zomi Zomi Ngalliam Zuapa Pu Cin Sian Thang tangthu A min : Sitni Pu Chin Sian Thang (kum 90) A sih ni : 31 July 2021 Saturday pm 5:34 A natna : Awmna A sihna : Ama inn, Kalaymyo Beh min : Neihkhup Kivui ni ding : 1 August 2021 Sunday am 11:00 Pawlpi : Leipi Baptist Church Pu Chin Sian Thang pen April 6, 1938 in Zogam Zampi khua ah suak a, pa min Sum Hang hi a, a nu min Niang Khan Cing (Gualnam) ahihi. A mah pen Neihkhup beh hi a, a min phuak pen Thual Cin-Cin Sian Thang ahihi. Ama matpongtin (မတပတင) ah 1938 hi ci-in kiciam teh hi mah taleh, amah suah kum taktak pen 1932 hi. Amau unau 6 pha uh a, pasal 3 leh numei 3 a hi uhhi. Pu Chin Sian Thang Don Khen Niang (Kawngte)leh Sian Nuam Bawi (Guite) Pu Pau Za Langh Pu Hau Khan Eng Cing Za Lun (Ngaihte) Pi Diah Za Awi Nok Do Pau (Gualnam) Tel Khan Cing Tuah Cin Kap (Songput) Niang Ngaih Cing A tate 8 ; pasal 5 leh numei 3 ahihi. Cing Sawm Lian pasal Si Si Am Aung Hang Khen Mung Kam Lam Khup zi Cing Lam Za Vung Langh Thawn Pau zi Cing Lian Vung Eng Biak Thang Cing Do Mang pasal Pau Khat Thang Gen Kap Thang Cing Khaw Man Lun pasal Thang Khan Gin Pu Chin Sian Thang pu Son Sum te unau Vangteh khua panin Heilei khua ah pem uh hi. Heilei khua ah a ten lai un pu Thual Cin in Mangkang (British Army)galkap khat that a, a lu ai hi. Heilei khua panin Chawhte ah tawmvei teng uh a, Zampi khua ah pem uh hi. Zampi khua pen Pu Cin Sian Thang unau pianna leh khankhiatna ahihi. Zampi khua a tun uh ciangin khanglui biakna siampi Tulpi pen a pu Thual Cin, a pa Sum Hang in sem a, amahn zong sem in Dalkhai, Tuimang, Vaivet leh khuakim ah kum nih sung sem hi. Christian Biakna ah 1953 kumin Zampi khua ah kituiphum a, Christian suak hi. A sangkahna te pen Zampi Primary School, Tedim High School, Mandalay Taingchit Private School panin 1958 kumin tan-10 zo hi. 1962 kumin Policital Science, Modern History leh International Relations te zo in B.A degree ngah hi. 1967 kum in B.A (law) zo a, 1968 kum in LL.B zo hi. Tua ahihmanin Rangoon University panin a degree ngah te pen B.A, B.A (Law), LL.B ahihi. 1969 kumin U Chan Tun Maung tung pan Advocate (Sitni) hih theihna Chamber sin hi. 1971 kumin Dr. Maung Maung tung panin Advocateship Licence ngah a, tua kum panin sitni sep kipan pah hi. 1986 kumin Kalay Township Lawyers Association President ngah hi. 1989 dong sitni sem a, sitni a sep sungin thu nei (case) 700 val sem hi. Thu lian mahmah 4, high court dong tung pih a, High Court ah zong zo ahihmanin a minthang mahmah hi. Rangoon University ah a kah sungin Chin-Hill Students Union Present, Rangoon University Chin Students Association President te sem hi. Rangoon University Chin Students Association President a sep sungin Taunggyi Federal meeting kah a, State Unity Organization (SUO) kiphuan a, CEC member ahihi. State Federal kamkupna te ah kihel kawikawi a, 1962 kum March 1 nitak BBC Kawlgam pan Radio tawh thugenkhiatna ah zong kihel hi. Tua banah Zomi Tangko Editor zong semkawm hi. 1948-1962 ciang Democracy tawh nuam takin a ki uk kimlai March 2, 1962 in Dictator Newin makai in Military Rule tawh galkapte in thatang thu in Kawlgam la uh a, Burma Socialist Program Party cih tawh 1962-2011 sung Kawlgam ukcip hi. July 7, 1962 in sangnaupang te zat innpi ahi, Union Hall pen mine tawh kisusia a, tua sung a om Zomi Sangnaupang laibu te leh man (photo) te a tunna lam kithei zo nawnlo hi. Kawlgam in Independence a ngah khit ciang kum 14 (1948-1962) sung bek Democracy tawh ki uk a, Socialist tawh kum 50 sung (1962-2011) ki uk hi. 1988 kumin Pu Chin Sian Thang makai in Zomi National Congress Party registration kibawl hi. August 4, 1989 in ZNC (Zomi National Congrees) Coference ah ZNC President dingin Pu Chin Sian Thang kitel a, Politician makaipi suak hi. 1990 kumin Myanmar election ah seat 492 om a, Pu Chin Sian Thang in MP candidate in ZNC ah kuanglui a, MP cing hi. NLD in 492 pan 392 MP ngah in 72.6 zo mah leh galkap te in kumpi za pia nuamlo ahihmanin NLD in kumpi sem theilo a, pu Chin Sian Thang in MP a hihna tawh bangmah sem theilo a, kiman zawsop hi. 1993 kum in kumpi in ZNC party mawkphiat sak sawm ahihmanin kumpi in party mawkphiat theilo hi, ci in Committee Representing Peoples Parliament cih kiphuan a, vaihawm te lakah kihel hi. 2008 kumin galkap kumpi in Achikhan Upadi bulpi teng a bawl zo a, 2010 kumin gambup kitel bawl a, CRPP member party te in nuaksan (boycott) a, Pu Cin Sian Thang in zong MP kuanglui lo hi. Myanmar President U Thein Sein in CRPP member te in party hing kik (renew) thei ding a cih ciangin Pu Cin Sian Thang makai in ZNC a hih kik uh leh ZNC sang nawn uh a, ZCD (Zomi Congress for Democracy) ngah uhhi. November 8, 2015 in Myanmar elction om a, Pu Chin Sian Thang in ZCD party ah MP candidate a, MP cing a, 2015-2020 sung Pyithu Hluttaw ah MP hi a, ZCD President zong ahihi. Pu Chin Sian Thang pen Kawlgam sung a om Zomi te sung pan LL.B a zo masa pen ahih mah bangin Zogam leh Zomi a dingin nakpi takin nasem a, kumpi te bawlsiatna tampi thuak a, Pahtawina zong pawlkhat ngah ahihi. Gam leh minam a dingin a sep sungin a khangno thahatna teng bei ta a, a kumcing kisa ta ahihmanin 2020 kum gambup kitelna ah kuanglui nawnlo hi. Pu Chin Sian Thang thuak haksatna te October 30, 1972 pan March 3, 1974 dong Yee Kyi Aing, Mingaladon ah thongkia. March 4-8, 1074 sung Insein ah thongkia. March 8-August 8, 1974 sung Mandalay ah thongkia. 4.March 12-19, 1992 in Kalay myo pan zingsang nai 4:00 kisam khia in Yangon ah kipuak a, thu kisit in kikhah kik. May 10-31, 1993 sung a inn pan paikhiat theilo (house arrest) dingin kikhumcip a, zingsang nai 8:00 leh nitak nai 5:00 in om mah ing cih na Kalay myo 17 MIS ah ki report. October 10-24, 1996 sung Kalay myo MIS ah kikhum cip. September 6, 1998 pan kha 7 sung 220 Bn Yemon ah thongkia, tua pan kha 4 sung 912 mile-stone ah thongkia, March 14, 1999 in a kal na in ki-at dingin kikhah khia. September 3, 1999 in MI-14 Quater, Botataung, Yangon ah. November 3, 1999-June 14, 2001 sung thongkia. September 28- October 30, 2007 sung Saffron Revolution, Insein ah thongkia. November 20-26, 2007 sung Aung Thapyae HQ ah. May 10, 2008 i motor in nawkkha in a nakguh 5 leh a liangguh khat kitan in RGH ah zato lum a, Pasian hehpihna tawh May 29, 2008 in zato pan tuak hi. Pu Chin Sian Thang in pahtawina a ngah pawlkhat te Zomi National Reconciliation Hero Award : 2009 kumin Norway a om Kawlgam mite in pia uhhi. Zomi Ntional Freedom Award : 2012 kumin Zomi Community USA in pia hi. Father of Zomi Award : ZAM (Zomi Association of Malaysia) in pia hi. Ngalliam Zuapa : 2013 kumin ZBCM in pahtawina laipi pia uhhi. Zomi te Pa : February 20, 2014 in Tuithang khua ah Zomi Nam Ni in kipia hi. Zomi Ngalliam Award : March 6, 2021 Saturday in ZYA General Headquaters Office ah Zomi Award leh motor khat k kipia in kipawlna tuamtuam panin lungdampihna laipi 70 kipia hi. Doctor of Law (LL.D) March 27, 2021 in Zomi Theological Seminary ah Doctor ki pia hi. Meltheihte kiangah a hawh nunungna March 13, 2021 in Kalaymyo a inn uh pan Zampi, New Darkhai lam pai dingin dingkhia uh a, Zampi ah giak uh hi. March 14, 2021 Sunday pm 2:00 in New Darkhai tung uh hi. 1532021 Monday in Sitni Pu Chin Sian Thang(Kalay myo), Pu Cin Kulh Thang (New Darkhai), Pu Lang Khan Do (Old Darkhai), Pu Kam Lam Khup (Yangon), Pi Zen Luan Cing(Kalay myo), Pi Thang Sian Ning(Yangon) te leh u nau sanggam a om thei teng tawh Pu Cin Kulh Thang Innpi New Darkhai ah kituah khawm uh a, Pu Kam Lam Khup in Sial khat go in pu Cin Kulh Thang in vok khat go a, ZYA ten tanu sem in khua zangbup tawh ankuang umkhopna nei uhhi. Tang bang dam a mel kimuh lai ci ni e ngaih cih dan khat in Pu Cin Kulh Thang(kum 94) te nupa leh Pu Chin Sian Thang te kum 90 val khin uh a, kum 80 val, kum 70 val khit ciang unau sanggam hizah kimu khawm thei in lungdam maitai takin tukhawm, khawlkhawm in, ankuang um khawm thei cih ka muh teh thupha sa mahmah ing. New Darkhai ah a om sungin a sanggampa Cin Khan Nang tapa (i)Thang Kap Piang (kum 38) in March 16, 2021 Tuesday am 7:00 in hong nusia hi. Pa Langh Khan Do zi (ii)nu Nok Khan Cing (kum 66) June 14, 2021 in, (iii) Pa Cin Kulh Thang (kum 94) ni in, June 19, 2021 Saturday am 1:30 ni in, (iv)Pa Langh Khan Do (kum 72) in July 3, 2021 in hong nusia hi. (v) Sitni Pu Chin Sian Thang in July 31, 2021 Saturday pm 5:35 in hong nusia hi. Tua hun sung bekbek in Pu Thual Cin suan sung pan mi 5 takin hong nusia hi. leh kaute hawlkhia a dona pawi hi hi. 2 ipatna: Khuado pawi i neih zawh kum za guk (600) peuh mah sawt khin dingin ki-um hi huado pawi pen khangthak ngeina zui-in Manipur gamah Tedim Chin Cultural Club makaihna tawh October 11, 1969 kumin Tangnuam khua-ah zat kipanin, Mizoram ah Zomi Society makaihna tawh November 12, 1994 kumin Sairang, Tlawnglui ah kizang hi uipi galkai Zomi ten Singapore Zomi Innkuante makaihna tawh 1995 kum panin Singapore khuapi ah Leitung Bup Zomi Khuado pawi min vawhin zat hong kipan to-in, tu ciangin leitung bup-ah Zomite omna peuhmah ah kizang kawikawi ta hi. 3 zat hun: Khuado pawi in NI nei loin a hun bek nei hi hi zongin a hun kum simin September leh October khasung hi hamtang hi ang hang hiam cih leh Khuado pawi in tuk hun anlak khit ciang a kibawl hi a, nlak pawi: Khuado pawi pen anlak pawi zong kici thei hi ang hang hiam cih leh Khuado pawi in tuuk an lak khit bek cianga a kibawl leh tua an thak, khai thakte muang-a a kibawl hi a, kum khat sung tung ding kum, kum hoih ding maw, sia ding. kicidam ding maw, kina ding. cihte theihnopna a aisaanna in a kizang ahi hi huaibu leh a note om zia panin kum thak sungah maban ding kithei ci-in hi. 7 iansuah Pawi: Khuado pawi pen siansuah pawi zong ahi hi pu i pate in mihingte a nasak, a sisak leh mihingte tunga tuahsiatna tuamtuam a tungsak pen dawi leh kaute ngawh uh hi ua dawi leh kaute tawh a tengkhawm hi dingin kingaihsun lai uh hi huado cianga Kaubetna leh Meidetna in a ngimpi pen zong mihingte a bawlsia dawi leh kaute notkhia-a innsung, khuasung, gamsung siansuah ahi hi. 8 igin ni: (a) Sagawhna: Khuado pen neihsa, khawisa, vulhsa teng tawh hih theih zahin kibawlin vok kigo pen hi ingsang vaikhuan hun ciangin, lawm papite in a pawl pawlin vok go-in, ni thum sung a khom ding aupangte in khuag leh zam, daktal leh sialki tumin asisate phawkna in mualte hah siang uh hi. (b) Dai hawhna: Sate a min phetin a sin, a lung, a tuap leh a kalte themno khat tek eu khia in sawm tangvalte in tua kum sunga misi a nei innkuanpihte puak uh hi ih sa sungkuate pen misite ading a kikhoih tuam hi-in, sun lam ciangin nupite in zu khaihsa leh tangsih tawh tua sate kengin han-ah misite va lui uh hi ih pen dai hawh kici hi sisa a innkuanpihte luguh sathau zutzut in zu leh sa, tangsih tah uh a, tua pen si ansuah kici hi huado pen a a si leh a hingte kizopna tawpna, kikhakna hunin kingaihsun ahih manin khuado ciangin mipawl khat lungleng khawngai-in kapkap mai uh a, la zong hih bangin na sa khawm uh hi. (i) Dona lingling, do na lingling e, gual in kumkhua dona ling ling e, (ii) Gualin kumkhua do na lingling e, do han ah nau bang va kap tang e. (c) Ankuang umna: Daihawh nupite inn hong tun kik masiah an kineksan thei lo hi itak ankuang um dingin kikai khawm uh a, mi a kim tak teh papi a tal taak pen in zu kam khat teepin, phihin phuisam hi ua khit ciangin a banbanin zu gual teep uh a, ankuang sa kuang umkhawm uh hi. ciangin kongsak leh kongkhangah meilah takna ding nahtang kuak kikoih masa phot hi ausapa inn ah pasal teng kikaikhawmin phot uh hi ua ciangin inn kiimin meilah de ciat uh hi ualteekpa (siampu pa) in bawk khat peuh tawi-in innsung tawng panin inntung innnuai innkawm teng bansat in: Dawi hang kau hang aw, na zun na ek namsia, na ni na kha cingta, na zi nata ten hong lametna sawt ta, na inn na lo ah lom khat khang gawl-ah, lom khat sak gawl-ah a kuangsa in siatin nusia hi ih pen dawite hong lut kik ngam nawn lohna ding ahi hi ua khaubengpa mi thumin zui in khat in khuang, khat in daktal leh khat in thau tawi hi aubet kipat ding ciangin thau khat vei lawnin, inn kong biang a tun ciangin khat vei lawm kik hi nn khempeuhah kau a kibet lai takin tum theih tum mawh teng tum in, thau lawnin ngeingai uh hi. 10 eidetna: Inn khempeuhah kau betna a man khit ciangin sawm tangval tengin gua dawnah meilah siatin adesa-in khuang, zam leh dak tawh a hon in hausa pa inn tual ah kisutuah in thum ah pai-in thumvei mah kimvial leuleu uh hi ih pen dawi neng kau neng bang neng peuhmah om nawn kei hen a cihna uh ahi hi awm tangvalte khua sung a hong lut kik uh ciangin meilah tum bang teng hong lutpih kik thei lo uh hi ang hang hiam cih leh, dawi nawhna lamah meilahte natawm nin bangin siangtho nawn lo dingin seh uh hi eilah tum bangte khuanawl singdawn, phungdawn peuhah siatin nusia uh hi un pawl khatah tua meilah a tum bang teng kaikhawm uh a, meiphual sat uh hi khu a tam theihtheih nangin sawlbawk tawh khuh uh a, meikhu a paikhiatna ding a laizang mun khat vangsak uh hi ua mun panin meikhu hong zam khiat ciangin siampupa in, SIM KUM pha hen na cih leh simah kai in, Zokum pha hen na cih leh zo ah kai in, Khai gui kha gah kong ngetna hi, Zokum kong ngetna hi im kum kong ngetna uh ci-in phuisam hi eikhu pen khua sung lamah a kai leh khua sung kicidam ding hi, ci-in khanglui mite in upna nei uh hi. 11 huailakna: Kaubet zawh lamna dianna teng a man ciangin, a kihawisa khuaibu la dingin sawm tangvalte kuan uh hi ua khuaibu leh a note om zia panin kum thak sungah ann leh tui kham leh kial, nat leh dam a kipan tuahsiat tuahphat ding kihilna in ngaihsunin aisaanna in a kizang ahi hi ua hi a, khuailakna pen kithupi seh mahmah hi huado khuai lakte pen zu (khuaizu) a nei namte hi loin no a nei namte, mi a deh thei nam, sing tung ahih kei leh lei sunga a kai nam tunpi, leh hi ih khuaibu la khiapa, tualteekpa in thuneihna a piakpa bek hi thei hi. 12 hek leh ni: Hih ni pen khuado ni nihna khekleh ni kici hi ih ni-in khuai tawh ai kisanin, nitakin ankuang sakuang (Saizang Tuiphum Pawlpi Diamond Jubilee Laibu pan) 1 TENG MASATE THU Hih Pakzaang gampen hunkhat lai-in Simzang gam kici hi ua hun lai-in Simzang gamsung, tu-aa, Kangmun, Ngallo, Simzaang leh Tumang cihna munte ah Duhlian mite teng uh hi maute pen Mongolia pan Chindwin ah, Kawlzang ah: cih bangin teenguh aa, Shan thu leh Kawlte hawlkhiat na hangin AD 1395 khitciang Khamtung ah kahto-in, Gungal kaai-in ateeng uh hi. (Ref: Central C nnual Magazine 2005-2006) Simzang gam lei hoih ahih manin Bepi gap khat ah tang (7) bang pha thei hi awlmim, taang hoih lua mahmah ahih man-in Sazuk in zong phulzo lo liang hi ci-in kigen hi utui tawh amai-uh phiat hi kici hi ibangin nuntaakna nuamin nasep kullo in makaite nungta zo uh ahih manin, tua hun aa khua vaihawm, amakai (hausa) pa minpen Tumang kicipah hi. (Tumang a khiatna pen, nasepna tu le heite mang hithiat a ccihnopna uh ahi hi. ) A ma mintap in Tumang khua akici ahi hi umang in Kangmun, Ngallo, Simzaang leh Tumang khua (4) or Veng (4) teng uk hi biakna uh pen LawkiiDawi bia hiding uh hi anghang hiam cih leh hih khua pan aki nawh khiat uh teh azu dawnna haipite, lei den na-in, leitangh hamsiat in paikhia uh hi kici hi ih munpan atai khiat uhteh, a tunna-ateen na mun India gam ah akhua minte mahuh na zangh kik uh hi ih Duhlian mite Pakzaang khua sat kum kitel lianlo a, 1395 khit 1400 kiimpawl cileng kikhial lo ding hi. 2 TAI KHIATNA THU Gun gal nitum nalam Seipi pan Tapei kikal ah Guite, Ralte, Sun thang Siak-eng mite khua (20) val ah tengin, Buanli khua dong ah teeng uh hi imzaang gamah Duhlian mite mun (4) ah teeng lai-uh a, tua hun AD 1600 kiimpawl hi-in, nikhat Hriangngai (Heilei) hausa Ralte minam Pu Mang Pum in, Hakha gam Ramthlo khuapan Thlanrawn mi Tong Rul hingmat in kum (9) sung a khum cip hi um (9) acin ciangin Tong Rul taisim in Thlanrawn hausa Thang Tirh a beel hi u Thang Tirh in khuangli hausa Pu Hrin Vungh leh akhuami Hawi Luan, Mualbem hausa Pa Ngai Neek thu galcial in Falam gam Seipi pan Gungal gamteng Buanli khua dong sim uha, azo uh hi ua hangin Duhlian mite gallel in Simzaang gampan atai khia-uh hi ih azawh na-uh gamte hawm uha, Mualbem hausa Ngei Neek (Sukte) in Nunglui pan Buanli gamdong a ngah hi ithu tawh kizui-in, Simzang gam khempeuh Sukte gam a suak hi hang (4) dong gam awng in om a, AD 1850 kum pawl in Tumang khua hong ding kik hi. (Ref: Heilei Mualsuang Sukte tangthupan) 3 HUA ADIN KIKNA THU Simzaang gampen Pu Ngai Neek (Sukte) hunpan a kipan Sukte gam hong suak hi u Ngai Neek pan khang (4) na, Khan Thuam hunteh azi nung Pi Kam Vung tawh a tapa Pu Khan Zam leh a zipi Dim Ciin thu Inntuan nading in Simzaang gam apiak ahih manin Gam leina bawl kullo hi D 1850 kum in Pu Khan Zam makai-in, Innkuan (10) thu Mualbem leh Zangzawl khuapan kikhin khia-in, Simzaang gam Tumang khua mun ah ateng kik uh hi u Khan Zam in hausa sem a, a tekciang in Thuam Khaw Hau, Za Ngin cih bangin kilaih suksuk hi kpi hunbei 1948 dong Za Ngin in hausa asem hi. Articles Christian Hymn-te Tangthu Knowledge Kei Ading Tam Khang Suangpi (Rock of Ages) AgelhZam Khat Kham By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 23, 2021 Kei Ading Tam Khang Suangpi Rock of Ages (Isaiah 26:4) AgelhZam Khat Kham Augustus M. Toplady(1740-1778) Thomas Hastings (1784-1872) Christian hymn-te laka suangmanpha tawh a kibang hih la pen Mangkam-a kisa late lakah a kisa munpen, a koimapeuh-a , a kuamapeuh in a deihpen la khat ahi hi. Salvation Army-te hotkhiat lamdung lamvai a mi vakvaite-a kipan a kivuina ah hih la mah kisa-a Westminter Abbey innpi sung thawn ziahziah-a a kisak Prime Minister Gladstone dong, mi khempeuhte kha lam tangsapna khempeuh a cingsak la hi, ci-in kigen helzen hi. Hih la a phuakpa Augustus Montague Toplady pen England gam Farnham ah November 4, 1740 ni-in suak hi. A pa galkap sunga major khat ahi hi. Toplady a ngek lai-in a pa in sihsan hi. Kum 16 a phak-in, Ireland a hawh laitak piangthak hi. Dublin, Ireland-a Trinity College panin sang a zawh khit ciang, 1762 kumin Anglican pawlpi sungah ordination kipia hi. A pumpi mahmah hat lohna leh lungdamna thu a genna ah na a uangsep luatna hangin kum tawm mahmah lai, kum 38 a phak-in si hi. Tawlkhat sung John Wesley, Charles Wesley-te leh Mothodist nasepnate thupisa mahmah a, ahi zongin John Calvin election doctrine lam mah ah kipzaw a, Arminian upna nei Wesley-te unau tawh sermon, laihawm tuamtuam leh kiselna debate peuh-in khat le khat ki dodo uh hi. 1776 kumin in Toplady in The Gospel Magazine sunga a laigelhna hih lamalte-in khuma, A Living and Dying Prayer for the Holiest Believer in the World cih thulu pia hi. Sianthosakna tawh kisai thu ummi khat in mawhna kici peuhmah pelh-a mawhna kisikkikna leh mawhna nei lo-a siangtho kiuhkeuh-a om ding cih Arminian upna a langpanna-a a gelh ahi hi. Taang nihna ah hih bangin na gen hi: Ka khut in ka sepna tawh, Thukham deihna cin zo lo; Hahkat den zo mah leng zong, Tawp lo khitui luan hang zong; Mawhna kiphel zo sam lo, Nangmah bek in nong hon zo. Toplady in mi khat kum 80 nungta hi leh mawhna awn tul nih leh awn za nga ( 2.5 billion) bang bawl kha thei ding ci-in seh a, kuamah peuhmah amah leh amah a kihonkhia zo ngei ding hi lo a, Honpa kisam hi, cih thu nakpi-a a genna tungtawna hong piangkhia la ahi hi. Toplady in hih la a phuahna ah a nungthu nih peuhmah om hi, ci-in kiciamteh hi. A masa pen Dr. Daniel Brevints sermon a zakna pana piang ahi hi. Tua sermon sungah siapa in, O Israel Suangpi, Hotkhiatna Suangpi, kei adinga kisatkham a khaangtam Suangpi aw, Emmaus a na nungzuite tawh anlum na balkhap lai-a na nungzuite lungsim bangin hih anlum ka balkhap uh ciangin Nangma nasem dingin ka lungsim uh hong lawpsak in. Na pang pana hong zuikhawm sisan leh tuite Horeb vum tungah dinga a gamlapi pana lunggulh bangin hong omsak kei in ci-in lunggulhna lianpi tawh a genna a zak ciangin a lungsim nakpi-in sukha a, mangngilh thei mahmah lo hi. A nihna pen bel nikhat, Topladay lungnuam takin Barrington Coombs ah vak hiathiat hi. Thakhat thu-in huihpi guahpi hong kipeii-a, van-ging keekkia in lau huai lua mahmah hi. A biakinn lamah taikik ding ci leh lah gamla lua zek-a, tua Coombs a suangpi kitam sung khat ah bu hi. A kiim a paam ah huih le guah nasia mah mah a, ahih hangin tua suangtumpi kitam sung beel ahih manin bittak-in om hi. Tua banga huihpi le guah kithuah a tuah laitak, suangtumpi bela bitna a ngah laitak-in a lungsim-ah Dr. Brevint semon hong suak denden hi. Tua a tuah huihpi leh guahpi pan a suahtak nadinga suangpi kitam heenga a bukna pen Zeisu Khazih in Calvary singlamteh tunga a nasep tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam, ci-in ngaihsun hi. Huihpi dai ta hi. Pastor Toplady zong a biakinn zuan-in ciah vingvenga, tua ni-a thupiangte leh thupiangte tungtawna a ngaihsutnate a lungsim pan a man ma-in, Kei ading tam khang suangpi, Nangma sung hong beel sak aw ci-in la hong phuak hi. Pastor Toplady phuah lamalte tawh kituak ding la-aw American church musician minthang mahmah Thomas Hastings in 1830 kum-a a phuah ahi hi. Thomas Hastings pen ama pilna siamnate America gam buppi ah Pasian phatna late a khantoh nadinga a pumpiak masapen ahi hi. Amah mah in khatvei, The homage that we owe the Almighty God calls for the noblest and most reverential tribute that music can render ci-in gen ngiat hi. Amah October 15, 1784 ni-in Washington, Connecticut ah suak hi. Music taktak a sinna tam lo-in a mit mahmah a hat loh den hangin a khan sungin church music bu 50 sanga tawmzaw lo gelh a, la-aw dawng 1000 leh lamal dawng 600 phuak hi. Mi tuamtuamte phuahsa la bu 50 bangmah kaikhawm lai hi. 1858 kumin the University of the City of New York in ama nasepna thupite pahtawina-in Doctor of Music Degree pia hi. American church music a khangtosak taktak Thomas Hastings leh Lowell Mason hi, ci-a ciaptehna ngah hi. Ama la-aw phuahte lakah hih la, Kei Ading Ta m Khang Suangpi (Rock of Ages) banah, Hong Hon Topa Zeisu Tal-Ah (Majestic Sweetness Sits Enthroned ), A Dahte Hong Pai un (Come, Ye Disconsolate), From Every Storm Wind That Blows cih kihel hi. Kei aa-ding tam Khang Suangpi, Nangma sung kong beel ding hi. Na pangvang pan hong ki zui, Thakhat luang khia si leh tui Mawh kiphel thuapna hi heh, Hong sut hen la hong sawp hen. Kakhut in ka sepna tawh, Thukham deihna cin zolo Hahkat den zo mah leng zong, Tawp lo khitui luang hangzong Mawhna kiphel zo samlo, Nang mah bek in hong hon zo Khutsung bangmah keng lopi, Na sing lamteh kong beel hi. Puan neilo Nangmahn nong guan, Cimawh hehpihna kong zuan Kih huai tuinak kong delh hi. Nong sil keh ka si ding hi. Kak nuntak lai hi ta leh, Ka sih laitak hi ta leh Theih loh gam ka kah ciang zong, Thukhenna mai kong tun dong Kei taang kitam suangpi aw, Nang mah sung hong beel sak aw. "url": " commalaysia-ah-english-teacher-te-manglai-hilhcian-kikna-kinei", "depth": 1 --- Malaysia ah English Teacher te Manglai hilhcian kikna kinei ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Malaysia ah English Teacher te Manglai hilhcian kikna kinei posted on 30 July 2015 at 2:26 pm Lomkholna: Malaysia, News, Sawltak, World Malaysia ah English Teacher te Manglai hilhcian kikna kinei Malaysia Education Ministry vaihawmna tawh Programme for English Language Teachers (ProELT) cih khatvei kineikik leuleu hi cin Deputy Prime Minister Tan Sri Muhyiddin Yassin in genkhia hi. Hih Program pen sanginn ah laihilh English Teacher sangsia te Manglai hoihtak ahilhthei nading in hilhcian kikna aneihpih uh hi a, hih Program sungah English Teacher mi 10,502 kihelthei uhhi. Hih Program pen Malaysia Education Ministry in 2013 kumpek pan ahanciam uh hi a, ahunhun in azom toto uh ahihi. Malaysia gamsung ah English Language Teacher pen mi 60,000 bang omding in aki lamen hi a, tualak ah hih Program akah pen mi 10,502 bang phamawk ahih manin, avaihawmna uh tangtung mahmah leh mi tampitak ki helzosak uh cihtheih ahihi. Banghang hihthu pulakkhia dihdih ihhihiam cihleh. Manglai athupisak masa hetlo tawh akibang Malaysia inzong agamsung aom English Teacher tepen hoihtakmah in Manglai ahilhtheih nading in sinciankikna neisakmawk uhhi. English pen thupi hi cih musemsem uh zong hikhading hi. Ei Zomi te e leh banglai thupi sakding, banglai sinsakding cihtawh buaibuailai dingmaw.
