Pu Zokhai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Genzawhthu-maw? Pu Zokhai posted on 28 February 2016 at 7:00 am Lomkholna: Article , Zokhai Written on 14 June 2012 Genzawhthu-tawh kisai-hiam, Thumaanthutak-tawh kisai-hiam Internet asimzo, hunpiazo, leh agelhzo zawdeuhteng-pen gampualam-a Zomite atampen ahihi. Leitung gam khatna atung khinsa pan-a laaigelhmi tampen-hi. Tualo Malaysia leh Delhi pan-in akicithei zawdeuhteng-in gelh taangpi uhhi. Zomite ataangpi-pen laaigelh ciang-in maaitang kituah-a kihona hilo cih lungsim-tawh uut-uut agelh om-a, mimal mahmah phin-giap, ko-ek, gensia-suk, zahkogawp cihdaan azangh mihaii pawlkhat zongtawh groups kizangh khawm-hi. Gam thumna ahihkeileh leitung gam khatna atungsa Zomite laaigelh adiak-in enpha lehang amau tunna gam-a ateeng ding-a kilawmlo zahdong-a tualniam kiphinna tamthei deuh-hi. Gam nihna-ah a-om laai-in thumaan genngam, pil-om, thukhual-tawh kisuun hi-kimlaai gam thumna atun ciang-in alaaigelh leh akampau, agamtatte hong kidang, nidang-a u-meel nau-meel atheidaan hinapi u-meel nau-meel thei nawnlo, minam kipawlna-ahzong mun a-ngah keileh langpanpah, mun angahleh adangte elbawlpah cihbang-in mihing zialehtong honpi-khat akikheel I-mu thei-hi. Hih thusunna-pen minam, biakna, tualsung kipawlna paizia akilawm bang-a kalsuan theih nading deihna bulpi ahihi. Zomite Kipawlzia naakpi-in kisam laai-a, kipawlna a-omleh adang kipawlna peuhmah elpah, langpanpah, gaalbawl phial zahdong kitung pahpah-a, minam cidam theilo-hi Gentehna-in, Malaysia-a ka om laai-a ka ki-itpih ahihkeileh ka it mahmah khat-in kei omna mahmah hongtun ciang-in kei-tawh holim manlo, kihawh manlo cihbang-a hun kipiak manloh kaalsung-in agen kiva mahmah pawlkhat-tawh tua ka itpanu ana-kithuah man-in tua mi-in kei hong elbawl nading thumaan hilo, ngeina hilo-hi. Atom-in, nangleh kei ki-maaingaapna a-omsa, I-kilawmtaatna a-omsa-pen kei kampau leh kei gamtatna ngailo, enlo-in kei-tawh na kimuh ma-a mi khat-in, tua Zokhai-maw, . ci-a hongki gensiat man-in nong elbawl, nong lanmuhpahding (kei ngaihsutna-ah) thumaan hilo, akilawmlo ahihi. Hihbang kikheelna anei Zomi tampi om-a, tua tung-ah laaktheih thuguipi khat-pen hihbang-in ka ngaihtuah-hi; Zomite ataangpi thumaan tung-ah dingkip lo-in, meeltheih-hiam, naahuai-hiam, kimuh masakpih-hiam khatpeuh thugenna tung-ah ding zawsop uhhi. Lengtong Kaam Kheen-in, ka sial-pen ..pa hongguuk ka mit-a kamuh hi-in, ahihangn Maang Lian Kheen-mah ummawh zaw-ing ci-a ciamnuih thupil agen-pen Zomite sung-ah ki-paksak lua-kha ahidiam ci-in ka ngaihsun-hi. Makaai khat-in gentehna-in kipawlna paulamh-in sum ngen cipak-ni. Thumaanlo, adiklo ahih thei gige napi-in tua makaaipa-pen I-maaltheih, I-naaihuai, I-lawm khatpeuh ahihnaakleh haiigup teeltaal cihbang mi om-a, gentehna mah-in, makaai khat-in na-hoih asep, mipi suplehbaaina lawhlo, Zomi min kizaak nading haanciam-a abawl-pen tua-mi I-naaihuai ahihlohziak, I-meeltheih ahihlohziak, panmun hongpiaklohziak-hiam khatpeuh-tawh hoih cih thei gige pipi-in siatgen denkeei, elbawl, langpan cihbang minam sung-ah dahhuai tak-in kimu thei-hi. Gam nihna-ah a-om laai-in thukhual bangdaan-in Zomi-mah ci-kengkeng, kipawlna-mah ci-gamgam, minam-mah ci-giapgiap, kipawlna makaaite lawmbawlthei, kitahthei hiteeisaam napi-in banghang-in gam thumna atun ciang-in Zomi honkhat kikheel uhhiam? Ahihkeileh kikheello-in amau hihna taktak hong kilangh hizaw-hiam? Ahihkeileh gensiat akiva mite genna tung-ah dingkinga uhhiam? Hihte I-suut ciang-in kipilsakvaai asa-zong ki-om dinghi, ahizong-in alawhtaak I-deihpen; Thumaan leh apiang khinsa thutak (truth reality) tungah kei kading-hiam ahihkeileh gensiat kivate thugen tung-ah ka kinga-hiam ahihkeileh ka zialehtong maantak apulaak hilel ing-e ci zawding I-hiam cihthu mimal kimciat-in kidong theilehang thusia-tawh kigamla tuamding deihna bulpi ahihi. Hihthu banghang-in deih I-hihiam cihleh gensiat leh misutuah akiva mite tung-ah makaai tampite akingak man-in kipawlna-in muiibunh ngeilo-a, kipawlna cihcihleh kikhenna suakden tawntung-hi. Zotawi Lianu sung-a Khualpu-in, kipawlna omkeileh kipawl-thei zaw-ni, acih bangkeek-in thumaan leh apiang khinsa thutak tung-ah I-kingakloh man-in kipawlna-pen kikhenna, kideiidanna, kituambawlna, leh ki-gimhuatna ciangdong tungto pahpah-hi. Zomi minam athahaat nading-in kei muhna-ah makaai hitaleh taangpi hitaleh thumaan leh apiangkhinsa thutak tung-ah kingakna thupipen ding-in ka seh-hi. Kipawlna himhim-ah I-maakpa makaihziak, I-sunghpa makaihziak, I-nuphalpa makaihziak, I-pawlpi mipihpa makaihziak, I-behpa makaihziak, I-khuapihpa makaihziak cihte cianglel-tawh kipawlna aki kalsuanzeel man-in kipawlna-pen Khualpu cihtak-in kikhenna suakden zaw-hi. Atung-a nengnengte ziak-in thalawp, thadah cihte-pen bangbang kipawlna kiopeuh-ah anawngkaaipipenpen hi-a, hihbang kipawlna ataangpipen gensiat leh suktuah akiva mite kampau tung-ah tampi kinga-hi. Tua ahihman-in minam kipawlna, biakna kipawlna-a kipan kipawlna khatpeuhpeuh-ah Thumaan leh apiang khinsa thutakte tung-ah dinkip theihding thaguipi khat hi-a, akiva mite thugenna, mite suktuahna, mite gensiatna peuh-tawh thukhenna leh lungsim piaksukna-tawh I-kalsuan laaiteng minam genloh I-beh, I-innkuan nangawn-ah kipawlna aliim-avaang kimu peuhmahlo dinghi. Nupa kilemkeileh tua nupate panlaakna kipawlna-ah meelmuhding adeihhuai tampi omlo dinghi. Nupa kilem, nulehpate leh tate kilem, tualsung, biakna, kipawlna sung kilem, minam thahaat cihbang-in alampi-maan, azingmaan I-totsiam nading lunggulhna ahihi. Muhlehsaanna akidang tengmah agawmtuahsawm I-hihman-in atelsiam kimciat ding-in I-kiseh khitsa ahihi. Zomi Pasian Thupha! Zokhai Reader Interactions Previous: Bang na kengsak a? ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zeisu dingmaw, Jesu ding? posted on 8 June 2012 at 12:28 pm Lomkholna: Biakna , News Zeisu dingmaw, Jesu ding? Kikum vanglak ni ci leng, Zeisu or Jesuh bek hi loin, LST sungah min tawh kisai kikup ding tampi om hi. Christ zong pen nidangin Khazih cin kigelh aa tu hun ciang Khrist aci tawh Khrih aci tawh ki om ahih manin, milak-ah LST ih sim ciang hong sim hak mahmah ta hi. A sim haksa hi loin ih sim dan a kibat loh ciang ei sim dan aa a sim lo khat pen a khial-in ki ngaihsun pah ahih manin, ki nuihsan hi. Ka neu lai-in Kawlgam-ah khang ka hih manin Zolai kasin kha kei hi. Ahi zongin Zomi ka hihna tawh Zolai ka thei nuam aa, kum 7 ka phak-in ka nun LST tungtawnin Zolai hong hilh hi. Ka Zolai mal theih masakna pen Lai Siangtho ahi hi. Hih laimal teng kigawm leh Lai Siangtho kici ahih ciang ci-in Zolai alphabet ih zat khempeuh ka kawi gawmgawm aa lai tampi ka suah hi. Tua khit ciang ka pawlpi sung uah, la makai hong sem Sgt. Tuan Khan Dal in A, E, I, O, U tawh Zolai paizia hong hilh aa, tampi hong baih tuam mahmah hi. Tua ahih manin tua hun LST kigelh dan-in ka sim aa ka zongsang hi. Mate, Maku, Luka, Zawhang mah ci tangtang leng, nuam ka sa hi. Topa Zeisu nu Mazih mah ci leng nuam ka sa hi. Zeisu Khazih mah ci leng nuam ka sa hi. Ahi zongin Tu hun ciang tua bangin sim leng, khangthakten hong nuihsan uh hi. Tua ahih leh, a gelh masa-te a khial maw? A ki gelh masak banga a sim-te a khial maw? A thak aa a khel te a khial maw? Ahih kei leh, a thakthak kikhel napin a zang thei lo-te a khial maw? A taktak in ci leng, Zeisu lah man kei, Jesuh lah man kei. A gelh-ten man a sak banga a gelh uh ahih manin a nih in man ci nuam leng zong man thei veve kawikawi hi. A sim-ten zong a kigelh bangbang aa a sim uh ahih manin, man kawikawi aa nuihsat ding zong hi tuan lo hi. Tua ahih manin min lawhna tawh ki selsel ding hi het lo hi. Thu khat-ah a man zaw zat ding sim dingin ih deih leh, man lo ih sak-te zat nawn loh ding cih bang khat thukhun a om kei leh, kizang suaksuak thei hi. LST bu lui khempeuh phiat mai leng, kizang nawn lo ding hi. Khanglui mi teng bei khin leh zong kizang nawn lo lel ding hi. Ahi zongin laibu puah phapha ci-in, min gelh dan a tuamtuamin ih khelkhel leh khangthak-te buaibuai den ding hi lel hi. Pawlpi pawl khat bang, min gelh zia huhau aa pawl kikhen bang om hel hi. A taktakin ci leng, min gelhzia tawh pawl kikhen zah dong ding pen a hoih het lo thu khat hi. A khangto nai lo minam-ten ih neih ngei loh, ih zat ngei loh na khat peuhpeuh pen, min thak ih phuah theih kei leh, ih lakna bangbang aa ih zat ding leh ih zatsuak theih ding kisam hi. A thei lo-ten a zat theih kei leh, a thei ten a man aa ih zat ding kisam hi. Gtn: ka neu lai-in, ka nuten brush pen bulut na ci uh aa, lime juice pen lemzuut na ci uh hi. A khiatna om sa lo ka hih manin, ka kankan leh brush leh lime juice a cihna ahih lam ka theih ciangin, khel sak hing. A khel theih kei uh leh phamawh loin, en a man aa ih lawh ding hi lel hi. Lo thei lo ci aa zong nuihsan ding hi tuan lo hi. Orange khawng zong pawl khat in lingmaw cin, pawl khat in lengmaw ci hi. Tua dan hi-a ih zak dan, ih sim dan aa ih lawh ahih manin kuamah khial khin lo cih theih hi lel hi. A tawpna-ah pil a kisa a tam pian ciang lai tawh kisai buaina tampi hong piang semsem ding hi mai hi. Ngaihsut theihna lungsim tawh ih khentel theih ding bek a thupi ahi hi. Genkhialh a om leh ngaidam! USA, Georgia ah kum 4 aphapan Zomi naupangno Lun Thang (Lun Nuam) mawtaw in taihlum ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW USA, Georgia ah kum 4 aphapan Zomi naupangno Lun Thang (Lun Nuam) mawtaw in taihlum posted on 19 October 2017 at 7:40 am Lomkholna: Dahpihna , News , Sawltak , USA , Zomi USA, Georgia ah kum 4 aphapan Zomi naupangno Lun Thang (Lun Nuam) mawtaw in taihlum USA, Georgia State sungah naupangno kum 4 aphapan khat mawtaw in Wednesday zingsanglam in taihlum cih Fox News pan kiza hi. Tua naupangno ii aminpen Lun Thang kici hi. Georgia, DeKalb County sung aom Clarkston City ah thupiang hi a, ataihkha mawtaw pen taisuak kicihi. Indian Creek Elementary School ii alanglam aom North Indian Creek Drive, 700 Block ah mawtaw khatin ataihlum ahihi. DeKalb Police te genkhiatna ah Lun Thang pen Indian Creek Elementary School ah sang akah hi a, Pre-K Student khat cihi. Lun Thang ii innkuanpih te genkhiatna ah Lun Thang ii meltheih Aunt khatin Lun Thang leh asanggam kum 6 khat sanginn ah akhading in apaipih cihi. Wednesday zingsanglam 6:45am hunpawl in Crosswalk ah lamzikpi akanlaitak mawtaw khatin Lun Thang pen ataihkha ahihi. Police te genna ah mawtaw in ataihkhak ciangin Lun Thang pen huihlak ah kilonto in, akiatsuk ciangin mawtawdang khattawh kinawkkha leuleu cihi. Tuaciang in Lun Thang pen amanlang in Hospital ah kipuakpah a, Critical Condition cihi. Lun Thang ii apa Zam Thang in agenkhiatna ah katanu pen mawtaw in anawkkhak ciangin kilawnkhia a, Pi 100 bang kilawnding hi cin genkhia hi. Apa Zam Thang in agenbehna ah atanu Lun Thang pen asanggamnu tawh khutkilensa in Crosswalk panin lamzikpi akantan uh cihi. Tualaitak in Northbound lamzuan in apai Sedan mawtaw khatin Lun Thang taihkha in, huihlak ah kilawnto a, akiatsuk ciangin Yellow PT Cruiser tungah tusuk cihi. Police te genkhiatna ah tua ataihkha mawtaw pen Lun Thang ataihkhak khitciangin amawtaw Control theilo in, tawmvei khawlpak cihi. Tuakhit ciangin tuaphual panin amawtaw hattak in taikhiasak vingveng hi. Mawtaw Driver papen ataihkhak naupangno zong a ending in kumkhialo in, ataisuak cihi. Ataihkha mawtaw pen Dark Color, Sedan Model aluite khat kici a, Toyota ahih keileh Honda khat hitheiding kici hi. Mawtaw pen amailam zong siatheiding a, amai Headlight zong kitamding kici hi. Lun Thang pen amanlang in Medics ten Egleston aom Childrens Healthcare of Atlanta ah puakpah uh himahleh, tuapan in anuntakna beiziau hi. Christ Mission Church panin Deacon Pau Kap in agenkhiatna ah hih Lun Thang te innkuan pen innkuansung nop asak mahmahding laitak uh hi a, ahi zongin tuzingsang thakhatthu in hihthu hongpiang hi. Anu pen kapthapai ahih manin, hihte innkuan adingin thungetsak kisam mahmah hi cin genkhia hi. More: US, Iowa State ah Pa Stephen Pau Suan Kim (Tonzang, Naulak) thautawh kikaplum Police ten hih mawtaw Driver papen amanlang in amathu in hongki ap nadingin tangkokhia uhhi. Khuasung mipi amukha tenzong amanlang in DeKalb County Police Department ah hong zasak un cin genkhia uhhi. Show all posts Tuesday, July 24, 2018 NEINO LEH TAWPI TAANGTHU ZoLanguage 7:34:00 AM Nidanglai in khua khat ah Neino,a kici nungak khat om hi.Nikhat Neino leh a lawmte singpua dingin a kuankhia uh hi.Hi mah leh a lawmte in hei a keng kei uh hi.Neino lawmte in ko zong na hei hong zangsak ve acih uh ciangin Neino in phallo a,kei ka nu-in Limsing nono,gelsing nono hongpua in hong ci hi ven acih ciangin a lawmte in zong singkangkeu peuh singbulsum peuh khawm mengmeng uh a,akhop uh a ngah uh ciang un,a lawm uh Neino ngak loin ciahsan uh hi. Neino in zong sing hoih nono a puakkhop ding a ngah ciangin aki suat leh aki suanzo kei hi.A khuadak leh a gal ah Tawpi singtawnpua a pailai a-mu hi.Neino in,ka gal a singtawnpua aw hongsuan in a cih leh Tawpi in hongsuan leng honglau ni teh aci hi.Tua ciangin Neino in banghangin honglau ding ka hia acih ciangin Tawpi in zong Neino vasuan in,a suat kawmin a samzang khat bawhsak a,khua mual suangpi nuai ah a koih hi.Tua ciangin Neino acii hong naa a,a thoihthoih uh hangin a damthei kei hi. Neino nu a lungkham lua mahmah ahih manin Neino damsak a omleh numei ahih leh ki zawlsak ning Pasal ahih leh ki tengsak ning ci-in a ciam hi.Tua laitak in Tawpi in,innkun panin na ngai sim a,a denciangin innsungah nalut in Neino nu kiangah Pi den in banggen nahia ci-in a dot leh Neino nu-in bangmah gen keng e naci hi. Tua ciangin Tawpi in genmah teh genkhat na nei mah ve,acih teitei ciangin bangmah ci keng e,tu laitak in ka tanu Neino a damsak omleh numei ahih leh ki zawlsak ning Pasal ahih leh kitengsak ning ci bek ing aci hi.Tua ciangin Tawpi in kei man thoihdam ning ci-in suangnuai a,Neino samzang vala a,Neino lutungah a koih leh Neino aci hong dampah hi. Tua ciangin Neino nu-in,a ciamsa mah bangin Neino leh Tawpi a kitengsak hi.A nu-in,a sa puak dingin innnuai a,vokpi go unla pia un aci hi.Tawpi in vok an pia a,Pi aw,hih ahi hiam?acih leh hi kei aci hi.Tua ciangin Tawpi in vokpi kongngak hoih hen voktal kongngak hoih hen aci hi.Tua ciangin vok tukguk khat napai a,Tawpi in Pi aw,hih ahi hiam?acih ciangin hi nai kei aci leuleu hi.Tua khit ciangin vok tukgiat khat napai leuleu a,Tawpi in Pi aw,hih ahi hiam?acih leh hi mah aci hi.Tua ciangin Tawpi innnuai ah va tuaksuk a,vok deksi a dawn hi. Vok gil bawlbawl a,Tawpi in vok gilzangteng inn-nuai ah ki kiatsuah khembawl in naupangte kiangah ka temta kiasak kha ing va tawm un,acih ciangin naupangte in a tawm nuam kei uh hi.A pi in,va topsak un acih ciangin Tawpi in,kei man vatawm ning ci-in inn nuai ah tuaksuk a,vok gilzang a khiatsukte a ne hi.Nau pangte in ensim uh a,hua lai ah Tawpi in sagil teng neve e ci-a akiko uh ciangin Tawpi in,naupang phialphual sa phialphual veihnamkhau ka i-uai aci hi. Tua ciangin a pi in,asa uh huan a,tawmvei a huankhit ciangin Tawpi in pi aw,sa a minta hiam?ci-in a dot leh min nai kei,inntungte tuibuk vasim tadih in,aci hi.Tawpi vapaikhia a,a sawt loin na tungkikpah a,pi aw,sa a minta hiam?acih leuleu leh min nai kei e,inn nuaite tuibuk vasim tadih in aci leuleu hi.Tawpi a sawt loin tungkikpah a,pi aw,sa a minta hiam?ci-in a dong thithe hi.A pi in,min nai kei innkongte tuibuk vasim tadih in acih ciangin Tawpi napaikhia leuleu a,hun sawtlo sungin tungkikpah a,a pi kiangah pi aw,sa a minta hiam?ci-in a dot thithe ciangin a pi in,a zak mahmah zong cimtak ing min in minta kei leh thuk mai un aci hi. Tua ciangin Tawpi in annthuk a,a ne ta uh hi.Tawpi in Neino kiangah Neino nang bak bangzah na gaita a,acih ciangin bak khat zong gai naikeng aci hi.Neino in Tawpi kiangah U aw,nang bak bangzah na gaita a,acih leh bak 34 bang gaita ing aci hi.Tawpi in dong leuleu a,Neino nang bak bangzah na gaita a,acih leh bak khat ka gaita acih kawm in,U nang bak bangzah na gaita acih leh bak 67 gaita ing aci hi. An a nekkhit uh ciang un,Tawpi leh Neino a innlam uh zuanin pai uh a,khua mual a tun uh ciangin Tawpi in Neino kiangah Neino aw,mi lampai bangin khe tawh pai maw,ahih kei leh miliam pai bangin khe bai a,pai koi na utzaw hiam?ahih kei leh vazuang len in leng leng na utzaw hiam?ci-in a dot ciangin Neino in,ei-ut thu hi leh vazuanglen in leng leng ka utzaw hi acih ciangin Tawpi in a meitawh Neino zialzial a,a zialkhit ciangin a lenpih vingveng hi.Tua ciangin a mo liahnu in Takha nu,Takha nu aw,na ta mi in lenpihta ei,ci-in kap ngutngutsa in a ciahkik hi. Tua khit ciangin Neino nu in,taksih ngan sagih huan a,Neino lazo dingte in hih ka taksih ngan huan gai ding a,hih taksih teng lomlom ding a,khepi cia phasak ding hi.ci-in tha a cial hi.A khuapih tangvalte in taksih ngan sagih nene uh a,a gaizo a omkei uh hi.A taksih huan lomlom uh a,khepi cia a phasak zo a omkei uh hi. PHUCHIL LEH NANTAL TE UNAU Tua ciangin a khuadak vua leh a gal ah Phucil leh Nantal te unau aisa sawk amu uh hi.Neino nu in,hua tak a,Phucil leh Nantal samdih un,acih ciangin a khuapihte in,ei hih zawhloh hih zo mahmah kei un teh a cihsan uh hi.Neino nu in,ci kei un hihzo kha thei ding uh hi,acih ciangin Phucil leh Nantal sam uh a,Phucil in ne a,a gaizo kei hi.Ahi zongin Nantal in a nek leh gaizo a,taksih ngan sagih a lomlom leh zabel cia khepi cia a phasak zo hi. Tua khit ciangin amau unau Neino ladingin kuanpah vingveng uh a,lampi ah a paipai uh leh munkhat ah Tawpi khekhap mu uh a,Phucil in,Nantal,Nantal,hih bang khekhap hiam?acih ciangin Nantal in,zu khekhap va khekhap aci hi.Mailam zuan in paipai uh a,munkhat ah Tawpi khekhap a om leuleu hi.Phucil in,Nantal,Nantal hih bang khekhap hiam?acih ciangin Nantal in Mu khekhap Tawpi khetot acih ciangin Phucil in Nantal ken lau ing acih ciangin Nantal in giahbuk khat bawlsak a,a zawngno mat tawh Phucil a nusia hi. NANTAL TAWPI TE KHAU AH Nantal amah bek pai vingveng a,Tawpite omna khua atun ciangin dainawl a Nupi khat kiangah zintung hi.Nantal in a zinnu kiangah hih ka temta Neino na piaksak in,acih ciangin a zinnu in,a temta Neino a pia hi.Tua ciangin Neino in Nupi nu kiangah hih koi a temta hiam?ci-in a dotciangin Nupi nu in,ka zinpa hongpiaksak hi,acih ciangin Neino in temta nam a,tang a,tuan a,Nantal gimlah a nam a,ahi leh na zinpa hong hawh hen ci-in Neino in Nantal a inn ah a hawh dingin a vaikhak hi.Tua ciangin Neino te inn ah Nantal a hawh hi. Neino te a tunciangin bang hong ci tun nahiam?ci-in a dot leh Sakhi khedap in hong nei in,Sazuk liangdap in hong zang ding a,Ngal khaat pua in,a bungbu lehlam in innka khuam ah hong kah ding hi,aci hi.Tua khit ciangin Neino in,Nantal phekhual tawh zialkhawm a,khintungah a koih hi.Tua khit a sawt loin Tawpi hongtung takpi a,Nantal gen bangin Sakhi khedap in zang a,Sazuk liangdap in nei a,Ngal khaat pua in,a bungbu lehlam in innka khuam ah a kahto hi. Tau ciangin sa ne uh a,Neino in,Momai sa paih ne ee,ci-in Nantal sa limci tata a paih hi.Tawpi in saguhbawk khat la a,khualau sa paih ni ee ci-in saguhbawk a paih leh Nantal taltang kha a,Nantal si a luangkhia hi.Tawpi in Neino kiangah ii inn miliam gim namlua acih ciangin Neino in banglak ah miliam gim nam mahmah ken teh khintung a,ka sasi koih kibua hi-in teh acih leh Tawpi in va en ning acih ciangin Neino in kei man va en ning ci-in Neino in en a,Nantal sisan luang khenpeuh a va nulsiangsak hi.Tua khit ciangin Neino in,a zu neih khenpeuh a pasal Tawpi dawnsak a,Tawpi zu kham in,a ihmu hi.Tawpi ihmut kal in,Neino in,abil sikzumsa tawh vuhsak a,Tawpi in Neino,Neino hongsuam nahi ding hi acih leh banglak a,suam khawng gen nahia,aci hi.Tawpi a ihmut kik ciangin Neino in,abil ah gatang abahsak hi. Tua Nantal in,a suktai sagih paltan a,a inn dung innvai kan in,a inn vengnu kiangah Tawpi in hong delhsawm zenzen leh hih ka kan teng a kanzawh leh hong delh henla kei hih bangbang ahih zawh kei leh hong delhvet kei hen ci-in a vaikhak zawh ciangin Nantal in Neino a ciahpih vingveng hi. Tua khit a sawl loin Tawpi khanglo a,a inn vengnu kiangah Neino koi ah hawh hiam?ci-in a dot leh a inn vengnu in den deuh mahmah in pasal khat tawh ciahta uh ei,Tawpi in delh a hong sawm leh a suktai sagih vei hong paltan henla a inndung innvai hong kan hen,hih teng ahih zawh kei leh hong delhvet kei hen ci-in hong vaikhat hi,acih ciangin Tawpi in a suktai pal a,a palzo kei hi.Hi mah leh Tawpi in a delh veve hi. Nantal leh Neino in,tungtun pangkhat ah sun an,a nek laitak un,Tawpi in a vapha hi.Tawpi in va bawhpah ngamsam loin khuai vah in,a leng diaidiai hi.Tua ciangin Pasian leh lungzai kiho uh a,Miliam ii gumzaw diam,Saliam ii gumzaw diam acih uh hi.Saliam in,zu leh sa neleh ne loplop Miliam in zu leh sa a nek ciangin pasian ana tai in,Lungzai ana tai kha in hong ci uh hi.Miliam gumzaw ni aci uh hi.Tua khit ciangin pasiante in,Nantal,Nantal natung a,khuai lenglai vat in,acih ciang un,Nantal in a namsau tem tawh a vat leh tumnih a kisuah hi.Nantal in Neino kiangah na pasal koi ah hawh hiam?ci-a,a dot leh sa beng hi ci-in dawng hi. LEINUAI MITE TAWH Tua khit ciangin Neino leh Nantal pai uh a,a Upa Phucil a nusiatna giahphual a tungkik ta uh hi.A zawng matpen in,I mote hong tungta e,acih vial leh kua U kua nau thei khang ci-in a zawng khekop pan man a,sangkil a den leh a ta bang a tolh zuahzuah hi.A zawngsa huan uh a,a nek uh ciangin Phucil in a khebom teng a tangkha hi.Ne ding a,a kithawi ciangin a zawng kheme te in,Phucil tal nasun pahpah uh a,a ne thei kei hi.Ne ning cileng hongsun zuazua acih ciangin Nantal in,hongla in,nasa zong ne thei lo ci-in suhsak a,a kuaihtan khit ciangin Phucil in a ne thei ta hi.Phucil in Nantal lim mahmah e,aci zaw mah lai hi. Tua khit ciangin a thum un pai uh a,Leinuaite in Neino a deihgawh uh hi.Leinuaite in,mual ah mual ah kua teng naki nil uh aci uh hi.Nantal in,Phucil tawh Nantal tawh Neino tawh kinil ung e,kawl khuang a,salang ka kaih,kasa tonpih na ngai un,PHUNG acih ciangin Leinuai mite a khinpah diamdiam uh hi. Tua zawh a sawt loin Nantal khanglo a,Neino koi ah om hiam?ci-in a dot leh Phucil lei attansak uh ahih manin Phucil pau thei loin a kiang a,phaipheng phung khat a kawkkawk hi.Nantal in hiah a bang om hiam?ci-in phaipheng phung a bohkhiat leh kuavang khat om a,tua kuavang sungah Nantal a valutsuk pah hi.Nantal Leinuaite khua a tunciangin ka U lei leh Neino hongpia meng un,acih ciangin Leinuaite in a nuihsan lel uh hi.Nantal in nong piakkhiat meng kei ua leh ka veih ka pek ding a,nakhua uh phel langkhat lengmang ding hi.Vai ka muutding a,na mit langkhat ciat uh a tawding hi.A cih ciangin Leinuai mite in nang veihpek hangin kuamah khua phel langkhat leng ken teh,a cihsa uh hi.Tua ciangin Nantal in a veih a pek leh Leinuai mite khua phel langkhat lengmang vingveng a,vai a muut leh Leinuaite mit langkhat tek a taw pah hi.Tua ciangin Leinuaite in,a U lei leh Neino a pia hi. Tua ciangin Nantal in,Neino leh a U leii leitungah kahtohpih dingin Phucil,Phucil khau nazun oh,acih ciangin Phucil in,khau na zunzun a,Neino leh Phucil leii,leitungah a tungto pah hi.Tua khit ciangin Nantal kahtoh sawm leuleu a,Phucil,Phucil khau na zunzun oh,acih ciangin Phucil in Neino deihgawh ahih manin ki zakkhem bawl in,sattat in naci ahia?aci hi.Tua ciangin Nantal in,Phucil,Phucil khau nazun oh,a cihkik leuleu ciangin Phucil in adawn ngei bangin dawng leuleu a,sattat in naci ahia?aci kik hi.Tua ciangin Nantal a hehsuak a,naluang naban sattat aw,acih leh Phucil in,sattat takpi a,Nantal Leinuai ah a kiasuk kik leuleu hi. Hun saupi khat Nantal Leinuai ah a om khit ciangin zi khat a nei hi.Tua ciangin Nantal in linggui suan a,Neino muzo dingin nongsiam leh ka linggui suan in,zan khat thu in,van na kawi in,aci hi.Tua ciangin Nantal zi in,a tate kiangah na pa linggui suan nabawh khiasak pahpah kei ua leh napa un,leitungah hong taisan mangding hi,acih ciangin a tate in,Nantal linggui suan a bawh khiatsak pahpah uh hi. Tua ciangin Nantal in,a tate kiangah hih ka linggui suan nong bawh khiatsak lai ua leh a botkhia masa penpen kong thatlum ding hi aci hi.Tua ciangin Nantal in lenggui khat suan kik leuleu a,Neino muzo dingin nongsiam leh ka linggui suan in,zan khat thu in,van nakawi in,aci hi.A zan ciangin a lenggui suan in,van nakawi takpi a,Nantal leitungah a kahtoh leh a tate in papa ngai in,akah nainai uh hi.Tua ciangin Nantal in a tate hehpihhuai sa ahih manin a vei leh tak ah a puak kawm in,lei ah a kahtohpih hangin a tate kiasukkik veve uh ahih manin Nantal bek kahto vingveng a,leitung a tung kik hi. Zuun siam Bawl siam Makaih siam Credit: Thelnah Saturday, March 26, 2016 Zolai Gelh Zia Zoliterature 5:51:00 AM Rev Khoi Lam Thang Gelh: Rev Khoi Lam Thang Tuni ciang dong Zomite' sungah Zolai gelh zia kician kinei thei nai loin, ei ut bangbang in kigelh ciat hi. Zolai zong Manglaite bang mah bangin laibul (Grammar) anei veve ahih manin, ut bangin kigelh thei tuan lo hi. Tua bang kawm kalah Zomite' sungah lai le pau lam bulkanna pilna sang anei (Linguist) Rev. Khoi Lam Thang in hih bangin atom kim hong gelh khia hi. 1. Khiatna khat nei kammalte gawm ding: Khiatna nei kammalte i gelh ciangin awmal (syllable) khatval a phak hangin a kop in gelh ding ahi hi. Khiatna khat nei cih ciangin Kawlkam, Mangkam khawng tawh zong kingaihsun thei hi. Genthehna: SA cih ciangin Voksa, Aksa om hi. KHI cih ciangin ngawnga ki-awh khi om hi. Ahih hangin SAKHI cih ciangin i gensa thute tawh a tuamtuak hi a, Sa le Khi kigawm maimai hi nawn lo hi. Ganhing Sakhi cihna hi a, khen ding hi lo a, gawm ding ahi hi. 2. Kammal kibang a kithuapte gawm ding: Zo kampau ah kammal kithuap tam mahmah hi. Tua bang kammal kituap peuhpeuh gawm pahpah lel leng kikhial lo hi. Tatna zem, pianzia zemte tawh kibang cih ding ahi hi. Tatna zem pianzia zemte pen awmal khat hi loin awmal kihualte a kopa kizang zong om hi. Gentehna: Pai pahpah, khang toto, hoih mahmah, pai sese, pai kheukheu, tu kheukhau, tai zaza, ding zeza. 3. Pauzepna kammal (participle)te gawm ding ahi hi: Pau zepna kammal cih ciangin Mangte in (Participle) acihte ahi hi. Zokam ah tampi om hi. Gentehna: Zawzen, zawsop, zawlai, tazen, mataw, khiamawk, tanghial, laidep.. 4. Mathuapte a zom kammalte tawh kizom ding: Mathuap kammal ki-, pi-, te a kipan a om peuhmah a zom kammal tawh kimat ding hi. A kimat manin khiatna a kitelkhial thei dingte thekna tawh kikhen ding hi. Gentehna: Ki - kideih, kiho, kilukhuh, kimawl, ki-um, ki-it, ki-at, ki-en Gentehna: Pi - pibawl, picing, pimuh, pingaihsut, pisuah, pi-et, 5. Nungthuapte amai kammal tawh kimat ding: Tedim kam ah nungthuap kammal tam sim om hi. Tuate in: bawl, dan, huai, kha, khia, khial, lam, pi, pih, sa, sak, tan, vai, ahi uh hi. Adang zong omlai ding hi. Hih kammalte akizat ciangin a mai a kammal tawh kimat ding hi. A khiatna a kitelkhial thei dingte thekna (-) tawh kikhen ding hi. Gentehna: - bawl : cilbawl, khembawl, pawlbawl, simmawhbawl - dan : bawldan, itdan, muhdan, omdan, zatdan - huai : dahhuai, haihuai, ithuai, pahtak-huai - kha : genkha, khialkha, lawngkha, nekha, sukha - khia : genkhia, honkhia, lakhia, mukhia, lawnkhia - khial: enkhial, mukhial, paukhial, telkhial, theikhial - lam : deihlam, gollam, hauhlam, khanlam, teklam - pi : bulpi, huihpi, innpi, lianpi, lopi, papi, tampi - pih : hopih, lungdampi, paipih, sihpih tonpih - sa : baihsa, neksa, luaksa, sepsa, mokhaksa - sak : damsak, deihsak, maisak, siasak - tan : kuaitan, nawktan, paltan, pektan - vai : cilvai, haivai, khantohvai, paupanvai - gai : negai, sigai, lungdamgai - siat : paisiat, lasiat, luahsiat - san : paisan, taisan, ciahsan - sat : kapsat, khensat 6. Nungthuapmathuap kikopte gawmkhop ding: Mathuap le nungthuap tawh a kithuah khawm kammalte kimat ding hi. A kitelkhial thei dingte thekna tawh kikhen ding hi. Thekna tawh a kikhen ciangin a kammal khiatna ngaihsun in khensiam ding kisam hi. ki-bawl: kihaibawl, kikhembawl,kisimmawhbawl google_protectAndRun("ads_core.google_render_ad", google_handleError, google_render_ad); ki-dan : kideihsakdan, ki-itdan, kikepsan ki-kha : kipalkha, kiphukha, kisatkha, kisukha ki-kia : kihawlkhia, kikhahkhia, kilawnkhia ki-khial : kitelkhial, kitheikhial, kizangkhial ki-pih : kiciahpih, kinuampih, kithuahpih, kisihpih ki-sak : kideihsak, kiphasak, kihehpih-huaisakdan 7. Kammal saute thekna tawh khen ding: Kammal thum val pha a, a sauluate nih suah in, thekna tawh kipeh thei hi. Gentehna Sakhi-tuihup, pheituam-sungten, khuasia-meide, va-singdangtu, kihehpih-huaisakna, kisimmawn-bawlna. Kammal sau mawkmawk hi lo a, Zomite i neih kamkop mal litethekna tawh peh ding hi. Gentehna: Annek-tuidawn, cimawh-genthei, gilkial-dangtak, huansak-huankhang, ankhing-tuibuk, Kawlgam-vaigam, innma-loma, innmun-logam, khualu-khuataw, nungak-tangval, pitek-putek, singkung-lopa, sungta-putu, zusa-vasa, hawhna-ciahna, thucin-thutang, cidam-mulmam, khamtheih-guihtheih. 8. H zatzia H laimal pen Zolai gelhzia ah namthumbangzah hiam in kizang hi. Tuate in : 1. Th, Kh, Ph munte a kizang H leh 2. Awtom-awniamsakna H te ahi hi. A tunga nam thum sungah a thumna thugen nuam hi hang. Laimal tawpna laimung (Final consonant) dingin h i zatzia kibang kim lo hi. Anuai a bangin zang khawm thei leng: (1) A pingsak thu khat peuh genna kammal (Conditional or if clause) dingin leh zat hamtang ding hoih hi. Gentehna: Na ut leh ciah ta ni. Hong it lo hi leh, (2) A piangsa thute gentelna ah leh zat ding ahi hi. Gentehna: Kilehkik, Zuthawl leh, lehkuan (3) Akibang het lo nih genkhopna ah leh zat ding ahi hi. Gentehna: Pasian leh Mihing, Yangon leh Tedim. (4) Khiatna khat nei a, kamkop bang a zatkhopte leh hi loin le tawh gawm ding a, kammal zong kimat ding hi. Gentehna: Si leh sa hi loin silesa (flesh), Nu leh pa hi loin, nulepa (Gender or sex), Mun leh mual hi loin, munlemual, Khat leh khat hi loin, khatlekhat (5) Min i gelh ciangi a kikhen thei dingin h zat ding hi a, a kisap kei leh zat hamtang ding hi lo hi. Kammal pawlkhat ah hunkhat lai-in kizang a, tu in kizang nawn lo hi. Gentehna: Cing (kicing) leh cingh (pianuam), Vung (Tuivung) leh a dang Vungh Khai, Lang, Cin, Lam Than, ing, ung, hang cihte ah telkhial ding om lo ahih manin h kulselo hi. Lai hong khak ing (ingh) hong lamen ing (ingh). (6) Ihmu, cih ciangin ih zathuai a, ahih hangin ih nu ih pa ci nawn se loin, i nu i pa cih ding ahi hi. Mi tampi in hici gelh khin ta a, mi tamzaw in hoihsa in kizuizui ta hi. Gentehna: I inn-ah i lawmte tawh ihmut nuamdiak hi. 9. A zatzia: A pen kizatna a tam mahmah kampau khat ahi hi. Pasian in leitung mite hong it mahmah ahih manin ama Tapa a um mi khempeuh si nawn loin a hin tawntung theih nadingun a Tapa neihsun a hong piak dongin a hong itna a hong lak hi Johan 3:16. A kizatna a tawm pen namthum om hi. Tuate in : 1. Mintang (pronoun) dinmuna kizang a. Hih dan a kizang a peuhmah tangdin den ding hi. a lawmnu, a ballpen, a lungsim, (amah, ama, amahn, cihte pen mintang (pronoun) vive mah ahih manin kikhen theilo hi. 2. Kamzopna (conjunction) a dinga, hong pai-a, khituite a luang dinga, Kamzopna khempeuh tuamdin lo dinga, awpheikop (awsuaksakte) tawh a kinai leh thekna tawh kidei ding hi. Kamzopna hi a, kamvui tumtawng ahih manin, a khit ciang coma , in zui denzaw hi. 3. Mangte in copula verb a cih kammal ahi hi, ahih hangin, asia apha, a suk ato, Hih kammal pen pawlkhatte in mintang (pronoun) hi-a, tangdin ding hi ci uh hi. A hi, na hi, ka hi; dinmun in laleng ahi ding bang napi, ngaihsun phapha leng hikhin lo hi. Mangte is Mizote ani, FalamHakhate asi tawh kiang hi. Tua banah, asia apha, asuk ato cih kammalte ah a pen pronoun hi hetlo hi. By: Rev. India kumpi nasem in Italy, Maldives, Hong Kong leh Jordan gamte ah om ngei a, tu laitak in Delhi, India ah om hi. Ama thu a kicingzaw in a laibu ah MIMAL HINKHUA ciin koih hi. A laibu kawm (cover) i et leh Zogam leh Zomi gim hong nam veuveu pah hi. Lungzuan huai in lenmui kaai ciciai a, Lengtong Pauno lungzuan late i lungsim ah hong dawk zangzang hi. A kawm i phen suk leh a naupang lai limlim pan thu leh la uk mi, thukan a thuciamteh mi hi cih laimal kigelh masa te pan kitheipah hi. A sangkah pan a kumpi nasep dong, zi leh ta a neih dong, a zinsuk a zintohna ah a tuah thute leh Zomi te in muhpih leng, theihpih leng ci a a iplahte a gelhgelh, a mawkbei ding a deihlo mi kuhkal leh; khatveivei ciang lah mi lungzuang theipi, lawm leh gual leh khuapih tuipihte a ngai mahmah mi hi cih kimu thei hi. Tua banga a kaih khopkhop, a kepkep, a gelhgelhte a BU in bawllo in kithehthaang leh a sawtna ciang khopkik baihlo ding ciin tu hun lian a i sim theih dingin a hoih mahmah laibu in hong bawl a, Zomite hampha hang! A laibu pumpi khenpi 9 in khen a, maan 6 koih in, pahtawina kammal 7 back cover ah tuang hi. Khenpi 9 te thulu: 1. Mimal Hinkhua 2. Na min theibang lou veng 3. Gamchiam Tulmawh 4. Khawtang Lunglen 5. Khawtang Lungkuai 6. Pathian Lungzai 7. Sappau Dihni 8. Sii-suk 9. Lavui A huampi a et pak in naupang dang mah banga sangkahna ollo pan hanciam a sangpi a tunna thu, gamdang a tun ciang nuntakzia a kilamdan thu, tunai a gal kido leitungbup in a mitsuan mahmah Israel gam zin a baih hetloh dan leh, ei, amipih, a sapihte hatzaw sema tai ding, khangto dinga hong deihna 'deihsakna kammalte' leh 'hicih zaw leeng....' a cih nguutnguut thute a banban in suut toh sawm ni..... Pil vai sa ing Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Pil vai sa ing Hau Za Cin posted on 29 November 2014 at 6:43 pm Lomkholna: Article , Hauzacin Pil vai sa ing Hau Za Cin Malaysia ah November 24-28, 2014 ka zin hi. Sangnaupang honkhat tawh hun zang khawm in amaute bangci in Christian nuntakna ah picingsak ding, pattah ding cih khawng ka kikum uh hi. Christian nuntakna gina tak nei a picing taka pattah dan ding a huh ka hi uh hi. An kivak in mun khat ah kigiak khawm a, khuasungah Pasian thu tangko (street evangelism, Street E) zong ka neihpih, pattah uh hi. Ka lungsim hong khoih leh ka en, ka deihngawh pawlkhat kong gelh nuam hi. Eng, deihngawh cih ciangin etteh huai leh etteh pha gamtatna ka muhte a gen nuam ka hi hi. A picinna uh leh a kipattahna uh a hoih ding dan ka en man hi. Zomi te in zong hih bangin i hih ciangin mite mit ah kilawm in mite in a khangto minam in hong mu ding hi cih ka phawk man hi. 1. An Kicinglo: Zingsang khat pen an a kivaikhak tawm hong kipuak deuh hiam, ahih kei leh annek ankamlim hi ding hiam an hong beih vat mawk hi. Malaysia leh Singapore khawngah mipi annek ding a kivaikhak ciangin a kicinglo cih pen a lamdang, a maizumhuai, a kilawmlo leh ahitheilo thu hi. Ahi zongin upmawh hetloh in hong cinglo vat mawk hi! Anne nailo mi 8 ding khawng omlai hi. Hong pai deudeu in hong kigual uh a, an beita cih gen ding hong nuam mello hi. Genloh phamawhta ahih manin ka gen uh a, themcik na ngak lai un a dang kivaikhak kik in tuzawh minute 15 ciang hong tung ding hi, ka ci uh hi. Tuani zingsang anhawm pen kei mawhpuak hi a, ka lung hong nuam hetlo hi. Anhawm kilaih den napi kei hun sese ciang hih bang hong piang cih pen ka lungnuamlo hi. Ahi zongin ka upmawh hetloh in khangnote in kamkhat zong paulo, phun cih thadah hehmai, lungkimloh mel cih bang melpuam pua kuamah omlo in a theilo, an duhlo bang keek in om thei uh hi. Picin vai kasa a, picing gamtat uh, lungsim kikemzo uh kasa hi. Hizah a pilvang thei khangno om cih ka muh ciang ka ngaihsutna hong sau vak mahmah hi. Tan 10 ka sim laiin Tonsim ah mipi annek khopna khat om a, tualpi ah mipi kigual in an kidawh a, eima pakan ciat tawh kine hi. A dawh masa ding, a ngah masa ding bang kituh in kilai phial, kitawng phial in kinawk ngengngang uh hi. An ngahlo om lo napi a dawh kik nuam, nihvei a dawh nuamte bangin a mai vuah mi tam kigual leh ka gilkial kik man ding hi, kinawh un ciin kiko vava thei mawk uh hi. Ciamnuih hilo, heh phial maha awsang tawh kiko uh ahih manin hong khantoh loh vai pian hi. Khantoh loh vai cih ciangin lungduai zolo, lungsim picing zolo deuh cihna hi. Banghang in mihing in i deih i duh i ngah pahpah loh ciangin kilungduai zolo hiam cih pen lungsim thuk sinna neite in a genna ah eima lungsim i kidek zawhloh man hi, ci uh hi. Kidek zolo cih pen ngaihsutna tom nei cih na hi a, a huam kim in ngaihsutna neilo cihna zong ahi hi. A huam kim in ngaihsutna cih ciangin mihing a kibanglo vive i hih na ah midangte lungsim ding, midang te ngaihsut ding bang hiam cih theihpih, muhpih, ngaihsutpih cih pen a kisam thu hong hita hi. Tua pen lungsim manlang leh pilna sang sinna neih man hilo in mihing khat in a huamkim in ngaihsut siamna gina tak nei maw neilo cih a kilahna ahi hi. Tua ahih manin ka tuah thu a khangnote in amau lungsim kemzo, kidekzo uh, phunlo cih pen an hawmte lungsim ah noplohna a om ding behlap khak ding kidawm, an kicinglo pen kamtam leh phun hat thu tawh hong kicing pah dinghilo cih thei, heh mahmah in awnggawp, gensia gawp, hang gawp taleng tua dinmun lian pen kibawlpha pah ding hituanlo cih thei uh hi. A kisam khempeuh a kisaipihte in sem uh a, a kisam vante kaikhawm kik in a hun a tun ciangin hong lem lel ding hi cih tel uh hi. An kicinlohna pen amau an ne nunungte gawtna leh bawlsiatna, engbawlna leh simmawhna hilo a, a ne masate deihsak zawkna leh anne masate bek khualna hilo cih thei uh hi. Hih bang thu pen a om thei mah hi a, kua peuh tungah tung thei in amau bek a kithuaksak hi cih om tuanlo ahihna tel uh hi. Naupang, khangno kum 14-18 kikal khawng dingte in hih banga lungsim picingtak, Zomi te in papi lungsim, nupi lungsim i cih lungsim pua thei uh cih pen a lamdang leh a etteh huai, a en huai, a deih huai lungsim puakzia ahi hi. 2. Lup Hun Nai 11pm: Zan lup hun, mei suhmit hun pen zan nai 11 hi a, tua zawh ciang mi khempeuh ihmu pah in daipah khip khep cih hituanlo hi. Ahi zongin zan nai 11 a sat ding ciangin khangnote in a lupna uh bawl in, a delhphah uh phah in a lum lian thei dingin kithawi khin uh a, a holim in ging ngaih mahmah veve hi. Ahi zongin zan nai 11 hong sat lian leh mi khat peuh in lup hunta ciin gen ziau a, meivak suhmitna tawh a kinai penin meivak sumit lian in amau lupna ding mun tek zuanpah uh hi. Hilh hilh, sawlsawl, gengen kullo uh hi. Tua banga tuam hilh a om khak ding zong a ut uh hivetlo cih kilangpah hi. A hun kiciangtansa om a, a hun cingta ahih manin makaite gelsa pen zuih ding hiziau hi. 1993 kum ahi tam maw, Lamka ah Bethany Christian College ah Camping kinei a, kei zong ka lawmte zuiin ka kihel hi. Zan lup hun ding ciangin Camp Makaipa in lup hunta ciin hong gen khit ciang dak hong sat ging a, mei sumit hi. Ahi zongin thakhat in mite hong awng ziaizuai in ka lupna ka bawl khin nai kei mei tawm hong vak laiun cih bang peuh tawh hong ging ngeingai hi. A dangte in zong amau hih nop khat, amau kiman nailohna hong tangko in meivak lai dingin hong ngen uh hi. Mei a kivakkik ahihloh hangin tua hun cin cianga makaite na hih pen a phatuamlo lama lehkaih kik sawm teitei nopna lungsim a lamdang, a khangto laitak minam, society i hi cih a kilatna ahi hi. Hih Malaysia ah Chinese khangnote in amau dinmun thei a, makaite dinmun thei a, amau ngaihsutna leh makaite ngaihsutna ah tua bang hi ding cih mukhol thei uh hi cih kilang hi. Makaite zahtak cih pen makaite zahtak a kulna om hi cih a theih uh ciangin a zahtak uh hi a, a mawk zahtak uh hi tuan samlo hi. Amau zong makai ahih loh lam uh leh makaite zong amau mah banga hun khat lai khangno, naupang ahi uh cih tel mahmah uh cihna hi. Makaite in a kam uh tawh a gen uh pen hih un ci a gen kikkik kullo in a bil vuah khatvei za peuh le uh zui hamtang ding hanciam uh hi. Makaite thusimlo leh neumuh, simmawh bawl, zahtak bawllo cih khawng omlo himai hi. A dik hetlo in a sep uh leh bel zahtak deklo, gen ngam mahmah kik lel uh hi. A hangsanna uh pen thudik gupna, thuman genna, a hi bang lianlian a kalsuanna in zang thei uh hi. 3. Amau pau thei sitset uh: Malaysia Chinese khangnote in a tenna gam uh Malaysia pau thei khinlo uh hi. A kisam khuasung vakna, khualzinna, annekna ding ciang bel thei lel uh a, ahi zongin a tampi theilo uh hi. Haivai si e cihnop huai phial hi. A taktak in a pilvai mahmah na hizaw hi. Banghang hiam cih leh amau amau pau Chinese ahih kei leh Mandarin pen hoihtak, gina takin thei sitset uh hi. Pau thei, gelh thei, sim thei uh hi. Tua manin a pau uh, a minam uh, a ngeina uh mangthanglo in kembit uh hi. India gam Kolkatta leh Shillong khawngah zong Chinese hon khat kum tampi, khang tampi om uh a, a pau uh leh a ngeina uh cihte khawng kem tinten lai mawk uh hi. Amau pau bek a theih uh pen a dangte a simmawhna maw, a thusimlohna maw, amau bek a kiliatsakna uh maw cih lam hilo in amau minam a kep bitna uh leh a minam hihna uh a angtanna uh ahi hi. Zomi te adingin hih vai ah zong etteh tak kasa a, i mipilte in Zomi te zong China gamke khat Mongolia pan kipan hiding hi hang a cih uh pen a hi takpi mah ahi tam cih nop hong huai semsem hi. 4. Liangko kikim in om siam uh: A nu leh pa pattah siamna ahi diam, ahih kei leh a sangkahna uh pan a kipattahna uh hi ding hiam, ahih kei leh a minam sung vuah a kipattahna uh hiding hiam, a biakna uh pan a theih uh hi ding hiam thei kei ing, liangko kikim in om siam uh hi. Liangko kikim in omsiam ka cih ciangin kuamah a kiliansak, a kineusak, a kisimmawh, leh a kitung et cih bang omlo in a kikim vive in kimu thei, kikhol thei uh hi. Mihingte pen a kikim in kuamah omlo hi hang. A hauzaw deuh om hi hang. A pilzaw deuh om hi hang. A teizaw leh a khuamu zaw deuh zong om hi hang. Melhoihna leh hihtheih, septheih zong kibanglo hi. Ahi zongin a khangto nailo minam sung leh mite lak ah ahithei zaw deuh om leh a dangte tungah kiliansak nuam, kiphasak nuam thei uh hi. Tua bang kiliatsakna tutung ka khualzinna vuah omlo hi. Pawlkhat pen a nu leh pate in BMW Car tawh hong kha a, pawlkhat pen Mercedes Benz Car tawh hong kikha a, pawlkhat pen car ngeina tawh hong kikha uh hi. Pawlkhat leuleu pen Bus in a honpi in hong kha a, pawlkhat pen amau neih sun bicycle khawng tawh hong pai uh hi. Pawlkhat in tuate zong neilo in khe tawh hong kuan uh a, a mun ah giaksuak zong tampi om hi. Ahi zongin a kikholhna vuah a haute tate in zong a hauhna uh suanglo, kiphatsakpihlo in a lawmte tawh a kibangin hihkhawm tek uh hi. Kiliansak in gamtalo uh hi. Annek zong a kibang ne uh a, mihaute tate bang inn ah a limzaw nek ding a bawl ding tawh om ding hinapi mipi tawh kibangin ne liailiai uh hi. A nu leh pate in a tuamin bawlsak tuanlo, ngek bawl tuanlo in leitung nuntakna a theih ding uh a deih ahih ding ka um tinten hi. Mun pawlkhat hileh hih mipi annek khawng ken ne nuam keng, ne thei kei ing a ci ding uh hi. Mi bek bang ne, mi silh bang mah silh lel, mi omdan leh mite hih khempeuh hih lel uh a, etlawm in thupi a, etteh tak mahmah hi. 5. Tate Pattahna Thupisak uh hiding: Ka lungsim a hong suak thu lian mahmah khat pen a nu leh pate in a tate uh a pattahna uh hoih mahmah hiding hi cih hi. A hoih a hoihlo zong thutuam in thupisak uh hi ding hi, ka ci hi. Banghang hiam cih leh tano nei khat om hi. A tano pen midangte in a mawk hopih ding, a noh ding deih khollo hi. A kilawm, a gina in a ta mite in a hopih hiam cih en sitset uh hi. A khangto nailo minam sungah hileh a neizaw deuhte tate mipi in kizahtak bawl in bangmah kicih ngamlo a, ki maiet zaw phial hi. A zawngte tate khawng pen simmawh bawl in ciamnuih bawlna, engbawlna leh zawhthawhna tawh a kibawl thei hi. Mihing khat ahihna zahtaksak ding cih hilo in a nu leh pa hauhna leh liatna vang teng khawng tawh kitungnung koih pian mawk hi. A khangto minam leh a khangto gam ah tua bang omlo in mi khempeuh liangko kikima nungta thei ding in kipattah uh hi. Hih thu ah a nu leh pa in a tate uh pattah siam kasa hi. A haute lah siam, a pilte lah siam, a zawngte in lah siam sem kasa hi. Hih bang gamtatna khempeuh ka ngaihsut, ka muh ciang ka eng a, hampha kasa a, kei minam sungah zong gina takin hong om in hong vaitham leh ka deih mahmah hi. I biak Pasian in hong kem dinga Zomite zong gual tawh tan bang kim dingin hong siam ding hi. Tua dingin nang leh kei in tavuan i nei hi. Minam dangte a neu tung uh pan a gamtat uh pilvai a, Zomi te zong a khanghamte bek hilo in i khangno leh naupangte gamtat hong pilvai mahmah ta hi. I vekpi in a khangto minamte tawh liangko kikim in laitual i lenkhopna leitung hong nuam semsem hi. Malaysia Zomi Khuado 2014 Ka Siimna 4 Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Malaysia Zomi Khuado 2014 Ka Siimna 4 Hau Za Cin posted on 24 October 2014 at 9:54 am Lomkholna: Article , Hauzacin , Khuado Malaysia Zomi Khuado 2014 Ka Siimna 4 Thugenpa in a thu bulpatna zong A laute ciah un, kei laulo hi ing cih hangsantak, kiciantak, kitel setset in hong gen a, i nak vang hanhan tawh kibang hi. Hilua veh aw, hilua veh aw ciin kilusu ngeungeu bek hi. ZAM makaipipa bang a ciltui kaai liang hi in ka thei hi. Zinmang hihna tawh thugen Pa Hang Khan Lian mah in thu bun in thu gen siam a, ahi zong gen ngam takpi hi. Mipite kisap leh mipite adingin gen giapgiap, awng kheh ngam ahih manin mipi in khut kibeng ziahziah hi. Zogam pen Zomi te in a luah ding gam hi. Zogam sungah Zomi in vai a hawm ding hi. Zogam sungah Zomi a teen ding hicihte a thubulpi hi a, zong ahi takpi hi. Tuhun khuahun tawh kituak in a kisam penpen laitak ahi hi. Zinmangpa gen bangin Zomi kicih ding a kihta, a lau, a linglawngte a ut leh ciah hen, a laulo, a angtang, Zomi a sihpih ngam om lel hi. Minam a Pasian in hong bawlna a angtanglo, a utlo a om leh amau thu hi tua banga minam hihna nangawn a dinpih ngamlote zong it huai mahmah masa hetlo lel hi. Malaysia ah Zomi kipawlna ah min khum bekbek zong 27,000 val pha a, a vakkhia thei nailo, min khum man nailo zong hunkhop omlai cih kithei hi. Tuate in hong khum khit uh ciang Khuado, Zomi Nam Ni cihte hong nuam semsem lai ding hi. (A thugen a kicingzaw in ama laigelhna sungah kimu thei ahih manin hih lai ah kong guang kik nawn kei hi. Ama gelhna sungah na sim khin ding uh lamen ing. A video zong hong kihawmkhia pah dingin lamen ing.) Pahtawina Hun: ZAM in Zogam leh Zomi adingin mi phatuamngai leh midangte adinga nasem pahtawi huaite min kaikhawm in pahtawina pia uh a, etlawm mahmah hi. A diak in Zomi te tenna leitang gamthak ah pau leh ham kibanglo in kihona a lemloh ciangin a kisam banga kam hong phensak dingin mi kisam mahmah hi. Kamphen ding cih zong a baih hilo a, kampau siam khempeuh zong kamphen thei hilo leuleu hi. Tua ahih manin minam leh a kisamzaw te adingin a sem, a gim, a tawlte a kilawm pahtawina uh leh mipi mai ah lungdam kohna, lungdam lahna in a dinkhiatsak uh a etlawm leh a hoih ahi hi. Mipi in khutbeng ziahziahin lungdamna kiko a, hin gim nam sak mahmah hi. Zomi bek hilo minam khempeuh hih bangin a haksazaw, a kisamzawte a kihuh, a kidomto liailiai a ngeina hi. UNO nangawn a kisamte domsang dinga kiphuan ahi hi. Zomi sungah huh kulte kinusialoin kihuh kipanpih ciat ahih manin nakpi takin lungdam huai kasa mahmah a, makaite zong geel siam uh kasa mahmah hi. Mipi adingin huhna a sem te bek hilo in mipi kalsuan dan ding, minam kalsuanna dingah a kilawm nasep a sem honpi khat na om hi. Tuate lak ah natna hoihlo a ngahte adingin sum leh pai a zonpih, zato a puak, cina luna khat peuh omleh zato ah a puak, sihna tuak a om ciang a luang va pham in hankhuk a tangsak, sum leh pai leh leitang a zonsak mite nakpi takin pahtawi dingin a kisam ahi hi. Tua banga semte in pahtawi ding lametna leh deihna tawh sem peuhmah lo ding uh hi cih pen mipi theihsa ahi hi. Ahi zongin mipi zong lungdam hi cih a kilatsak nopna uh pen a gel siamna uh leh a kilawm hi a, zong hih tangtang dingin a hoih ahi hi. Mimal in, innkuan in, beh leh phung in lungdamko in na pahtawi khin kha mai thei hi, ahi zongin Zomi minam bup mai ah a kipahtawina om nailo ahih manin hih bang hun ah kipahtawi pen a pahtawina ngahte lah hampha, a pahtawite lah thusiam sa ing. Zomite pen pupa hun pan thusiam a kituh dente hi hang. Zongeina hoih sungah thusia kidem cih om ngeilo a, thupha bawl ding pen kidemna siangtho khat hi den hi. ZAM makaite in amau a pattah, a dinpih, amau kha kham a paihsak upate (ZAM Advisers) pahtawina leh lungdam lahna a bawl uh zong siam uh kasa hi. Makaite, upate pen minam adingin vangil hi in amau theihna leh amau khuamuh masakna in laidal laikung tawh a kigelh khin theilo thuciamtehna ahih manin pahtawi huai mahmah hi. Zomi te tuhun ciang laigelh ki ukta in laidal tungah kiciamteh zaw deuh ta napi thu leh la tampi a kiciamteh zo khinlo omlai a, tuate upate in amau khuak sungah na kemcing uh hi. Zomi te laibusaal teng i upate khuak sungah kiciang venvan hi! Zolia leh Zotaangte hong pai deudeu leuleu: Thugenna khit, pahtawina khit ciangin mipi in a ngaklah leh a pua lama zuntha a pusuak pakte nangawn nawhsa a hong dianglut kikna uh Zolia Zotaang kitelna ding music hong ging ciaiciai ciang ahi hi. Den in khat vei hong kidawk khin uh a, tun a nihveina in mipi mai ah Zopuan tuamtuam tawh kizemsa in hong paikhia deudeu leuleu uh hi. Amasa pen banglo in tun bel a dawhsang (stage) tung bek ah hilo in a endik, judges te mai ah zong hong kilak uh hi. Kei bang endikte nung gual ah kitu ahih manin Zolia te bang a paknamtui uh kiza vauvau baan lel hi! A nik bawk uh a sangkhai deuh uh ciang bang ka gei a tute ka hehpih mai hi, banghang hiam cih leh a cil uh na valhvalh uh ahih manin!! A vekpi vua hong pai deudeu khit uh ciangin mipi mai ah kihelh diamdiam in hong pai leuleu uh a, thudotna hun hong tungta hi. Kei bang Zolia No. 3 na Lia Vung Saan Cing dongkha ka hih manin ka angtang gawp mai hi. Dongkha cih ciang amau lai dok in koh nambat tawh a kituak penpen a kidong hi a, aman kei nambat dok kha hi. Ka dotna bel tomcik hi. Dotna: Tuni i Khuado zat nuam na sa hiam? Dawnna: Nuamsa mahmah ing. Dotna: Tua ahih leh, Zomi ten Khuado zat toh zel hoih na sa hiam? Banghang in? Dawnna: Zomi ten i Khuado zat toh zel hoihsa mah ing. Banghang hiam cih leh i Zongeina i kepna leh Zomi i hihna a kiciamtehna khat hi a, pupa ngeina i kepna leh i Zongeina a thupina a kilahna zong hi. Ka lungdam. Mark 100 lak pan mark tampi ngah pah hi. Dotna in a deihna pen Khuado bang hi a, Khuado zat a manphatna bang hiam? a ci nuam ahi hi. A dawnna zong hoih a, zong dawngkha in, themkhat sau deuh lai leh cih a dongte deihna ahih hangin a lamet dawnna leh a zaknop thu genkha veve ahih manin a dawng siam mawhlo leh Zomi ngeina a thei numei khat hi cih kitheipah hi. Zolia khat in i Khuado, Sialsawm, Zomi Nam Ni cih khawng a kicing takin theilo a Zolia kidemna khawng hong kihel ding uh a kideihlo, a kilamenlo ahi hi. Tua manin Zomi ahih na a kithei takpi hiam cih telnopna zong hi a, Zolia in tel hi in a dongte in thei pah uh hi. Tua manin a mark tam piak huai pawl hipah hi. Zotaangte zong tua bang mahin kidong a, Zomi Nam Ni zat zel a hoih hiam, bang hang Zomi Nam Ni thupi hiam cih a kidot ciangin a dawng theilo Zotaang kidemna ah kihel khawng zong na om veve mawk hi. Pawlkhat ta leuleu pen Zomi te mailam ah bangci kalsuan leng kikhangto baih ding hiam cih bang a kilawm taka hong dawng thei om leuleu hi. Zomi sungah khangno thungaihsun pipi om hi, cih ahi hi. Zolia khat bang Zomi numeite lapsangna dingin bang sem ding na hiam? ciin a kidot ciangin a gen ding bei theilo phial hi pilna guan ding, khutsiam sinsak ding, cidamna thu hilh ding cih bangin a kicing takin a numeipihte lapsangna ding khawng na ngaihsun khin tek uh hi. Tutung Zolia leh Zotaang kitelna ah dotna leh dawnna te pan ka lungsim ah hong om thu khat pen nidang sangin tu khangah khangnote in minam leh gam khantohna ding, mimal leh innkuan khantohna ding, pawlpi leh khuasung khantohna ding bang kisam, bangci sep ding, kuatawh sem ding, koi pan kipan ding, cihte nakpi in na ngaihsunta uh, thu na kan mahmahta uh hi cih ka mu hi. Pawlkhat bangin Zolai thu leh Zokam thu, Zomi te gamdang tunna thu, Zomi te galkap suahna thu banah leitung thupiang tuamtuamte hangin Zogam leh Zomi in a kiginkholh ding thute kicing takin gen thei uh hi. Zomi te thumuhna, thutheihna leh thutheihnopna khang mahmahta, mi tate pil mahmahta hi cih kimu hi. Zomi te mit kihumcip sak nawnlo a, khua mu nuam peuh leh a mit kihongta, khuadak nuam peuh leh mualsang dawn pan dak theita, thugil kan nuam peuh leh laibu sim ding kingahta cih hong phawksak hi. Hih bangin a kipaitoh zel leh Pu Lengtong Pauno kammal kawm pak hileng, Zogam hong paal ding hi, hong paal hak nawnlo ding hi, tun zong a paalpaal hita hi. I tunna ciangciang pan mainawt lai ni. I tunna ciang en lehang zong i kipatna sangin nakpi in kisangkhaita hi. Nuam panpan ei guai. Zomi Party thak vai Pu Thangboi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zomi Party thak vai Pu Thangboi posted on 13 September 2016 at 11:55 am Lomkholna: News , Politics , Thangboi , Zomi Zomi Party thak vai Pu Thangboi Tusawng teng in kawlgam ah Zomi min tawh Party thak khat phuatding vai thu kikupna ah mi 50 val kah cih thu lengsawn kiza hiauhiau hi. Hih tawh kisai in ka muhzia leh ka ngaihsut zia sutlo in ka omthei kei hi. Zomi min tawh party akiphuat sawm pen tu tawm hilo in 2010 lai pek ahi hi. 2010 kum kitelna ah adem ding in Zomi min tawh party khat Kawlpi ah phuatsawm uh hi. Hih thu kazak ciang in kalung nuamlo ahih man in Pu Cin Sian Thang, Pu Gin Kam Lian, leh Sia Khen Za Sian te sam in Zangkong khualai zang Bo Aung Kyaw lampi aa Power Restaurant Sai dawl tungnung ah ka kikum uh hi. Pu Gin Kam Lian va paito in ava khoh ding in ka khensat uh hi. Kikupna mankhit phet in agei lam 40 aa om Pu Sawmno (Laitui) kiang ah Ks 100,000- leitawi in Pu Gin Kam Lian khutsung ah alamsap ding in kapia hi. Atom in gen leng party phuat ding vai hong mit hi. Hih thu Pu Go Sawm Khup (USA) in hong theihpih mahmah ding hi. 2009 kum pek in Hih Than Shwe 2010 kitelna pen ut in ut ta kei leng nawk kul ding aih teh bang cih ding? cih thu kikupna kinei den hi. ZNC in bel Zomi min him him zuaklo ding; Than Shwe mai ah Zomi surrender lo ding; Hih Than Shwe bawl kitelna ah Chin min tawh lah lutlo ding Zomi min zong lutsak lo ding cih thute kadinpih uh ciang un atawpna teh 2009 kum December kha in Zangkong aa Pu No Than Kap inn ah chin state bup phial pan alung himawh teng in Democratic Alliance of Nationalities (DAN) kiphuan khia hi. Tua ni in ZNC min tawh Pu Gin Kam Lian leh Pu Cin Suan Mang tawh ka thum un ka kihel uh hi. Tua zawh asawtlo in Sakura Tower dawn aa Ansaipi pen ah tulaitak aa Falam Ahmyothar Hluttaw MP Pu Zung Lei Thang in sponsor sem in sun an hong vak uh aa bangbang hileh Chin min mah zangh ni hong cih teiiteii ciang un tua ahih leh ko ZNC hong kihel dah nung cih tawh kikhen in amau CPP tawh hong laih uh aa kitelna ah lut in MP zong pawl khat in hong ngah uh hi 2015 kum kitelna leuleu ciang in ZCD in hong ngah kei zenzen leh (or) ZCD pen azenzen in ZNC lai dan mah in Matpongtin (registration) hong kiphiat khak zenzen leh amanlang thei pen in Zomi min pua party khat phuat kul cin kei dinpih thu hi aa tuni dong kilaih tuanlo hi Ahi zong in mipi in kisam sa aa Zomi min tawh party thak khat hong phuat sawm leh kakho nawn kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh: 1. Khua hun kilaih ta hi. Than Shwe hun lai dan in galhangte bek ii septheih sepngam hun hi nawnlo aa mipil misiam mihuaizote sep hun hita hi. 2. Khat sang nih hoih zaw Democracy ngeina tawh kidem ciatciat ding hita ahih man in khat kia a om sang in nih om leh hunsawtpi aa ding in hoihzaw veve ding hi. Nih val bel hoih lo ding hi. Eitawh kinai pen Mizoram ah zong MNF leh Congress omden lel hi. Khat kia hi leh democracy ngeina te nungta zolo ding hi. 3. Minam picing baih zaw ding Ei tawh ih pawl akibat kei nak leh ih gal ih sak pahpahnate hong kiam ding hi. Democracy zia tawh pawl zon dan ih siam pah ding aa ih migi tuam ding hi. Abawngbawng akhilkhil aa ih painate zong hong kiam tuam in ka um hi. Kitelna khawng hong om teh minam thusim aneih huai lam khawng zong ih thei pah ding hi. ZCD bang Tedim leh Tonzang ah hat aih teh tu aa athak pen Kawlpi leh Tamu khawng ah hong hat mahmah leh bel ih minam met mahmah ding hi. Atom in gen leng Minam Lian minam picing suakbaih tuam ngelngel ding hi hangh. Tua hi in party phuatsawm ten adang phuat akul nawnlo ding in ahuamkim thei pen leh atangzai theipen in nong phuatna ding un hong thuum ing. Articles Christian Hymn-te Tangthu Knowledge Nang Deih Bang, Topa! (Have Thy Own Way, Lord!). AgelhZam Khat Kham By: LAIBUSAAL Date: October 19, 2021 Nang Deih Bang, Topa! Have Thy Own Way, Lord! (Jeremiah 18:3,4) AgelhZam Khat Kham Adelaide A. Pollard (1862-1934) George C. Stebbins (1846-1945) Nang deih bang Topa, Nang deih bangbang ci-a thungen ngaungau nupi teek khat thungetna tungtawna kiphuak la ahi hi. 1902 kuma a kiphuah huna kipan tuni ciang dong ki-apna la kici peuhmah lakah a kisa munpen khat ahi hi. Mite in a nuntakna uh sit pha-in i Topa tungah a ki-ap theih nadingua a panpih mahmah la khat ahi hi. Hih laphuaknu Adelaide A. Pollard mahmah in zong lungsim gimna nasia tak in a thuak laitaka a phuah ahi hi. Africa gamah missionary-a a pai nading sum a kicinga a ngah zawh het loh laitakin a lungkia mahmah a, nitak khat thunget kikhopna khatah va kihel hi. Tua lai ah nupi teek khat in a kisap thuphate leh deihna tuamtuamte ngen peuhmah lo-in a nuntakna ah Pasian deihna a theih ding bek a thuum ngaungauna za hi. Nitak inn a tun ciangin Jeremiah 18:3,4 sunga beelsekpa thu lunggai pha hi: Beelsekpa inn ah ka paisuka, peiite zangin na na sem hi. Tungman pana a bawl beel a khut sungah kitam hi; tua ahih manin hoih a sak bangin beel dang khat bawl pha kik hi. (Kei own translation) Tua nitak a lup ma-in tuni-a i saksak hih la taang liteng phuak khin ta hi. Adelaide Addison Pollard pen misiangtho banga a nungta mi khat hi a, ahi zongin mystic khat banga nungta zong ahi hi. November 27, 1862 ni-in America gam Bloomfield, Iowa ah suak hi. Anute in Sarah ci-in a min phuak uh a, ahih hangin aman deih lo ahih manin Adelaide ci-in laih hi. 1880 kumte in Chicago-a girls school tuamtuamte ah sangsia sem hi. Tua hun lai-a kipan Laisiangtho hilh kipan hi. Tua khit ciangin Alexander Dowie nasep huh in evangelistic ministry ah kihel a, a diakdiakin cina damsakna nasep lampang sem deuh hi. Amah mah zong zunkhum natna vei hi napi-in Pasian in damsak hi, ci-in tecipang hi. Tua khit ciangin i Topa hong pai hun ding kithei lo a, hong pai vat thei hi cih thu a bulphuh mahmah Sanford tawh kithuah in nasem leuleu hi. Africa gamah pai-a nasep ding lunggulh mahmah napi-in pai thei pak lo hi. A tawpna ah pai thei sam-a sawt om thei lo sawnsawn hi. Galpi Masa pianga, tua gal hun sung khempeuh Scotland gamah om hi. Gal ven ciangin America gamah ciahkik-a dam het lo hat het lo pi-in New England kuam-ah na sem hi. Miss Pollard in la dawng tampi phuak napi-in a la phuahte nangawn ama phuah ahih lam a kitheih ding ut khol lo ahih manin dawng bangzah lian phuak hiam cih kithei lo hi. Ama phuah lakah tuni donga kisa la hih bek mah om hi. Hih la-aw bel George C. Stebbins phuah hi a, 1907 kuma a khet Northfield Hymnal with Alexanders Supplement kici labu sungah hel hi. Tua kum mah in a minthang mahmah Sankey labu Hallowed Hymns Old and New leh Sankey leh Clement-te labu Best Endeavor Hymns kici labute ah kikhen pah hi. American gospel music-a minthang mahmah George C. Stebbins pen February 26, 1846 ni-in Canada gam Orleans County, Ontario ah suak hi. Orleans County pen tuizeu minthang mahmah Niagara Falls pan nisuahna leilu lam tai 50 na pawla om ahi hi. Kum 23 a phak ciangin America gam Chicago ah lalsuk-in Lyon and Healy Music Company ah nasem hi. 1874 kumin Boston ah kisuanin Clarendon Street Baptist Church ah music director sem hi. 1876 kumin amah tawh nasemkhawm dingin D.L.Moody in sama kum 25 sung Moody leh Sankey-a kipan evangelist minthang George F. Pentecost leh Major D.W. Whittle-te tawh kithuah-in la makai, choir director, la-aw phuak, gospel la kaikhawma a khenkhiapa cih bangin om hi. La minthang tampite a la-aw ama phuah hi a, tuate lakah, Siantho Nang Hun Zang In (Take Time to Be Holy), Kei Dahna Khualmial, Koltanna Pan (Jesus, I come), There Is a Green Hill Far Away (Khuapi Umna Kulh Pua Lam Xtian La No.101 ), Ye Must Be Born Again (Nih Vei Na Suak Kik In Xtian La No. 464), Savior, Breathe an Evening Blessing (Topa aw, Ka Ihmut Ma-in Xtian La No. 34), Saved by Grace (Khatvei Ciang Khuangkhau Tat-in Xtian La No. 370) cih late kihel hi. 1924 kuma a khet ama tangthu leh a khan lai-a thute a gelhna Memoirs and Remeniscences kici laibu tungtawnin George C. Stebbins thu cing takin kithei thei hi. Pasian piaksa nuntakna man nei takin zanga, a kum 91 a phak laitak, October 6, 1945 ni-in Catskill, New York ah si hi. Nang deih bang Topa, nang deih bangbang Nangmah belsekpa, kei tungman bang Nangma deih bangin kei hong bawlin Tanglo mang dingin, nang kong ngak hi Nang deih bang Topa, nang deih bangbang Tuni in Topa, hong sit in nang Vuksang ngo zaw in tun hong sawp in Lungsim neem takin na mai kong kun Nang deih bang Topa, nang deih bangbang Ka liam ka gimna hong huh in nang Vangliatna khempeuh nangman na nei Hong dam sakin kei hong honpa aw Nang deih bang Topa, nang deih bangbang Keima nuntakna hong uk in nang Khazih keima sung mi muh nading Hong guan in keisung, na Khasiangtho Tags Zam Khat Kham Previous article Naupang Kepna Tawh Kisai. Articles Lai Nasepna Laibu ZOMITE KEI MUHNA PAN. Agelh Rev. Neng Za Khup By: LAIBUSAAL Date: March 30, 2022 ZOMITE KEI MUHNA PAN Agelh Rev. Neng Za Khup ZOMI i cih kuate ahi hiam? Zomi cih i khiatna kibang hetlo ding hi. Pawl khatte adingin Zomi cih pen Zote cihna hikha ding hi. Pawlkhatte adingin Kawlgam-a Tedimmi a kicite leh India gama Paitemi a kicite cihna hikha ding hi. Pawlkhatte adingin Tedim kampaute cihna hikha ding hi. Pawlkhatte adingin Zote, simte, Vaiphei, Gangte, Hmar, Kuki, Paite, Tedim leh Mizo a dangdangte i genna hikha ding hi. Tulaitak (nidang ciang kikhengkha thei) kei ngaihsutna pan in Zomi ka cih ciangin unau Mizo engnga pau zanglo deuhteng ka genna in ka ngaihsun a, Mizo ka cih ciangin Mizoram ateng leh engnga pau zang deuhte genna in ka ngaihsun a, ZO ka cih ciangin Zomi leh Mizote khaikhopna in ka ngaihsun hi. No ngaihsutna tawh kibang khinlo ding hi. Phamawhlo hi. I ngaihsutna kikhekkhek thei hi. 1980 laikhawngin Zomi ka cih ciangin Tedimmi leh Paitemite ka cihna hi. Tu-in tua pen ka ngaihsutna ahi nawnkei hi. Tua bangteng i genzawh ciangin i thugelh dingin a tuunkhak ding pen Engnga zanglote ka genna hiding hi. Ennganga zangte ka deihlohna hi zenzenlo hi. Mizo ka hi cih pen kei adingin haksalo hi. Gamtuam leh hong thei cianlote kiangah Mizo ka kici zellel hi. I vek in kici khinleng zong phamawh kasa kei hi. Ahih hangin tua ci thei nailo i hih manin a tamzawte pomsiamleh theihsiamna ciang tawh tutung hih thu kong gelh hi. Research bawl-a laisiamte gelh bang a gelh ka hikei hi. Thu ngaihsun nuamte leh thu ngaihsun mite ading a cithakkhuat ding tawm aom khakleh cihna tawh kong gelh ahi hi. Zomite Leh Laipilna I pianna, i tenna leh i nekzonna in tulai leitung pilna leh siamna sinna lamah mite tawh khekhai kibang dingin haksatna tampi hong tung hi. I khuak Pasian in hong piakpen midangte a sang hoihlo zaw sesetuanlo hi. Tua ahih manin i minam pen leitung pilna leh laipilna tawh kisai-in i tun ding tan tungzo lo hihang. Ahih hangin a tunga haksatna i gente leltak bangmah hikei ci a zumledai phamawh salo a laipilna a zongte i omna peuhah minuai a hituanlo hihang. Tua ahih manin Zomite i hanciamna na ding khat a ka ngaihsut leitungah mitawh kiton in painuam hang, i cihleh i siksan masapen ding Laipilna lamah atam theipen in i hanciamphat ding kulsa ing. Thauvui thautang leh thagum tawh hilo in laipilna tawh midangte i zo thei bek ding hi. Zomite Leh Sumbawlna I gam in lah hong zillo, kawlgam kumpi-in lah hong zillo a hih manin zomite sumbawlna-ah i kipia uh hi. I siamman leh i utman hilo in hih dingdang a omlohman hikha ding hi. Tua bang hi napi-in sumbawlna-ah zong a tuahphami theihpihzah a ahau zong om hihang. Ka gennoppen bel sumlepaai i zonna-ah hun paisa sangin citakzaw, muanhuaizaw in Pasian phawk leh zahtak takpikawm in sumzongleng deihhuai kasa hi. Banghanghiam cihleh sumlepaai zonna-ah muhtheihna ahih nakleh ci-in muhtheih muhmawh amuhsawm, zuaugen, mikhem phamawh salo, biakna lamah lah ki Pasian thu awisak mahmah sumpi bang tampi pi pia zawzen ahih hanga-lah i sumbawlna-ah siangtholoin omkha hileng kilawm hi. Tua bang pen i nutsiat ding hi. Zomite Leh Pasian Thu Dawi leh kau lauhna leh singbul-suangbul biakna khuamial sunga kipan khuavak hong musak Pasian ahi hi. Khristian i hihna kum 100 val paita hi. Pasian thu bang gen, bang hanga ei Khristian suak, banghang a Khristian Pawlpi om i hia cih ngaihsun a, tua i hihna hang hih tantung ding ci-a panlak sangin eima aituam pawl tuamtuam bawlin manlah hi lehang kilawm kasa hi. Pasian thu sinten zong paulam (excuse) a zangin English siamnopman peuh, sum zonna ading a khawdakna peuh a azangkha zong i omkhak ding lauhuai kasa hi. Pasian thu tua banga ei-ut bangbang a, zat ding hilo hi. Pasian hehna hong tungleh kua tan thuakzo ding? Tua ahih manin Zomite i omna peuhah laipilna sinte, sum zongte leh nasep tuamtuam a semten ahi ding bang taka Pasian thu i zuih a, sem ding hong cih pen muanhuaitak leh diktattaka i sep ciangin Pasian in thupha hong pia-in, hong zangin makai leh luleban in hong zang ding hi. Zomite Leh Leitung Vai Mihing khat i hih leh leitungvai tawh kikhen theihlo hi. I vek sai theihhilo a, asai dinga Pasian in asap om hi. Zomite i kamsiatna mahmah khat pen gamthum Kawlgam, Bangladesh leh India gamah kikhenkhia i hih manin gamkhat leh ki-uknakhat nei a, Paukhat leh Laikhat zang a i om ding pen thubaihlo ding hi. Ahitheilo ding cileng kikhiallo ding hi. Gam leh lei vai-ah i omna gam ciatah inntek pantheih dingdan ngaihsun a, a thuklut theithei a hampha himai dingin ka um hi. Tua dingin ah i vanzat ding omsun pen laipilna bek hi-in ka mu hi. Thauvui thautang leh thagum tawh mungeilo neilo hingeilo ding hi. Tua ahih manin Zomi nungak tangvalte aw laipilna nakpitakin zong ni. A siampen hih sawmni. Tua hileh leitungah kivallo ding a, i omna gam peuhpeuh ah na poimawh leh mun poimawh len in vaihawmna i khut sungah i tawithei bek ding hi. Zomite Leh Pau Zomite gamtuam leh muntuam ah i om hangin i Zomi hihna i kepbit theihna ding pen Lai leh Pau hi-in ka thei hi. Pau tawh kisai genpak leng: I innsung pau hiam Zomipau laka khat peuhpeuh i zatte i innsung ciatah zattheihna ding koigam koigamah omtase leng zatsawm hamtang lehang bang aci tam? Tua i omna gamte pau leh lai zong amau tawh kibang a siamsawm ciat lehang tua hileh i omna gam peuhpeuhah kimikhuallo ding kuaman hong simmawh theilo ding hi. Tua banah i pau kammalzat tawh kisai-in zong, i omna gam zilin hong tuamkha ding hi. Ahihangin tuate hang kibuaisaklo ding. Amau dik, ei adik amau-adikkei ei adikkei cih sangin theihsiamsawm phot ding. Tua hileh nidang ciang kitheituahkhin ding hang a, Zopau pen Kawlpau, Bangdeshpau leh Indiapau kigawm hong hiding a pau hausapi leh a hoihpikhat hong suak ding hi. Zomite Leh Lai Lai tawh kisai-in ah i gelhdan spelling pen kibangkim thei pahlo ding hi. Lauloh ding hi. Banghanghiam cihleh America-te gelh dan leh Englishte gelhdan bang zong kibanglo-a ahih hang tua pen kuaman buaipihlo hihang. Kithei theilel hi. English laigelhzia pen leitungah a haksa pen leh paizia a neilo pen cileng cihtheihphial ding hi. Ahihangin sin hang a, kithei lel hi. Tua bek hilo, kawllai, meitei lai hindilai i cihte ei Zomite adingin sikhalai tawh kibang hi. Ahih hangin sin hanga siamlel hihang. Tua ahih manin Zolai gelhdan tawh kisai-in I gelhdan ciat tawh gelhphot ding, hih dik, hih dikkei cih tamsaklo phot ding. Ei Zolai a hih nakleh sim theihsawm ding, a thugen uh theihsawm ding. Indiate zatdan, Kawlgamte zatdan, Bangladeshte zatdan ciding hang a asawt ciang kitheihtuah hun hong om ding hi. Tu laia o leh ou leh c leh ch leh Tuu leh Belam khawng buaipih a a dikzaw hih kituh-a kigawm theihloh cih khawng pen a tunga i gensate khawng ka ngaihsut ciang keibel ka nuihza bek hi. Kigawm utlo hihang ka cilel hi. Zomite Leh Thulela Zomite hong gawmkhawm leh hong kaikhawm ding i pau leh laiteng a kigawmna thulela hong hiding hi. Kum sawmnih paita a ka ngaihsut tuni dong-a a sitheilo khat pen Zomite la phuakte kaikhawm in, khatvei a kikhenprint khinpahzolo peuh mah ding ahih ciang La bul 500 khawng telkhia dingin khenprint phot ding. Tua pen Zomite omna peuhah zuakhawm ding. Tua bangin a bulpan lehang i kigawmna leh i kipumkhatna ding a vanzat poimawh mahmah khat hi dingin ka um tinten hi. Thu tawh kisai-in laibukhat peuhpeuh a gelh thei agelh zoten gelh ding Zomite omna gamah hawmzuak ding. Lai Siangtho pen tuletu hehu in khatzat ding pen haksa ding hi. Zomipau a Lai Siangtho omte neihsawm ding. Simtuahzel ding. English-a version tampi a ombang koihlel ding. Hihbang zong a lamdangpi a ngaihsutlo ding. Nikhat ni ciang Pasian in pha asak leh Paukhat leh Laikhat i zatkhawmtheih ding gam tuamtuamah i om hangin hong piangkhia mawhlo ding hi. Mi tampi hih ka laigelh a simten hihpa thugelh bangci ahia naci kha ding uh hi. Duh thusam cihbel ka utpeuh gen hilo in i haksatna leh i buainate thei kilkelkawm in, a piangthei hetlo ding leh hahkat lehang a piangthei dingte ngaihsunkawm in hahkat in sawm lehang apiangthei ciang kong gelh hi. Zomiten tulaitak i phatmawh pen Pasian athei, azahtak, diktat leh muanhuai, muhkholhna nei mi muanhuai leh misiam hangsan makai i kisam hi. I phatmawh lianpen hi kaci hi. Kawlgam Ayeyarwady luidungteng ah tuikhanggawp, U Bein lei zong tui in tumcipdek ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Kawlgam Ayeyarwady luidungteng ah tuikhanggawp, U Bein lei zong tui in tumcipdek posted on 24 August 2017 at 9:51 pm Lomkholna: Mandalay , Myanmar , News , Sawltak Kawlgam Ayeyarwady luidungteng ah tuikhanggawp, U Bein lei zong tui in tumcipdek Myanmar, Mandalay Region sungteng ah tuksung guahtui tamluatna hangin tuikhanggawp in, inntampi ki hepkhiatkul cih DVB pan kiza Kawlgam laizang ah aluangsuk ahi Ayeyarwady River gunpi zong alauhuai dinmun Danger Level ii atungah 37 cm bang khangto zawlai, tui tamlua mahmah cisawnsawn hi. Mandalay City panin 150 Kilometer agamlatna ah aom ahi Pakokku khuasung ahzong guahtui tamlua mahmah ahih manin mi 20,000 bang cimawh dongtuak in om uhhi. Tuciangciang asi aliam bel bangmah akigenkhia omnai samlo hi. Mandalay panin 10 km agamlatna aom Tadu-U Township, Zaycho khuasung ahzong tui khanggawp ahih manin, khuasungmi 3000 bang cimawh dongtuak in omkhin uhhi. School, Monasteries leh khuasung mipi omna innte avekin nawkgawp cihi. Zaycho khuasung aom Primary School ah sangsiapi Principal asem ahi Khin Saw Win in agenkhiatna ah adiakdiak in khuasung mipi te cidamna Health vai leh sangnaupang te sangkah kipelhding ahih manin Education vai zong ki lunghimawh mahmah cin genkhia hi. Kumsim in tuipen akhangzelzelmah hi a, ahi zongin hizahliang in akhanggawp ciangin khuasung mipi te ki patau mahmah hi. Tuaban ah tuininlak panin natna akilawhkhakding, Skin Infection leh Dengue Fever aomkhakding zong ki patau mahmah hi. Tulaitak ahihleh khuasung aom sanginn te ki khakcipphot cihi. Mandalay, Amarapura khuasung aom gamdangmi Tourist Attraction minthang mahmah khat ahi Taungthaman Lake kici buaitui zong khanggawp in, lei atungdong phial ah tui in tumtodek cihi. Leitung ah dolsing Teakwood tawh akilam Teakwood Bridge lakah asaupen longest teakwood bridge in the world in aki ciamtehzong ahihi. Zogam nuntak gim namta Pu Thangboi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zogam nuntak gim namta Pu Thangboi posted on 16 October 2018 at 6:10 pm Lomkholna: News , Thangboi , Zomi Zogam nuntak gim namta Pu Thangboi Zan ni (Oct 15 ni) Tedim nitak nai 5:00 in na tung ing. Meikhuamte hoih sa ing. Nitak teh innte ah mei apai loh hang lammei tangsak uh ahih man in nuam tuam hi. Khuapi vai mahmah ta a mawtaw hoih nono zong kilehleh mai hi. Zan kim zankhang dong mah saikel gin kiza hi. Khuamial khit ciang in sangnaupangten lai sim ziahziah uh hi. Hymnal lak ah ngaih kasak mahmah khat ahi Near The Cross la mikang la in akisa ziahziah khat zong kaza a, ka lung hong lengsak peuhmah hi. Bang bang aizong khantoh gim nam kasa hi. Lampi Kawlpi pan Thaang dawn dong lampi hoih ta hi. Tedim khuasung zong lampi hoih gawp hi. Tedim pan Zalui dong lampi hoih mahmah hi. Vialcian pan Tonzang kikal zong hoih gawp hi. Lampi hoihta gawp ahih man in mawtaw te tungbaih tuam mahmah hi. Kawlpi pan a Tonzang pai bus te bang zingsang nai 11:00 bang in tungta hi. Kawlpi Cikha zong kal khat in 3 vei bang direct in pai a nitun lianlian ta hi. Van Kizuak Nektheih leh vanzat tuamtuam zong Kawlpi pan in mawtaw saikel tawh hong zuakto tam mahmah hi. Singtang hong kivakta suak hi. Lol mahmah uh a Tonzang pen zingsang nai 8:00 bang in tungzo uh ahih man in zing an lap uh hi. Gas Kizangh An huanna ding in gas zong baihtak in kithun thei ta hi. Tedim ah thun khat tul 30 pan 35 bei a Tonzang ah tul 40 bei hi. Thun khat kha 2 bang kikhom ci hi. An sing pen Tonzang ah ton khat teng 1 nuai om lo hi. Tedim ah bel tammanh zaw in ka um hi. Gas tu a sang in akimanh zaw lai ding in ngah theihna ding in vaihawmzo hi leng ih gam cidam tuam mahmah ding hi. Tu mahmah in zong Tedim leh Tonzang ah gas tawh an huan tampi omta ahih man in sing phatuam mahmah ding hi. Sing sat tawm tektek leng ih gam cidam tektek ding a nuntak nuam tektek ding hi. Zogam nuntak gimnam ta hi. Zogam hong pia Pasian Min thang hen ! Hong pia Pan hong piaksa hi a akem ding eite ih ginat kul hi.
