Articles Knowledge Lai Nasepna TEDIM THU KIH ZAK NA LAI (The Tiddim Chin Hills News) AWGU KHA 1925 By: LAIBUSAAL Date: November 5, 2022 TEDIM THU KIH ZAK NA LAI AWGU KHA 1925 The Tiddim Chin Hills News Bu 6 Nambat 8 A SUNG A OM THU TE Tedim thu kih zak na lai Leitung gamtatna thu Khamtung gam simtona thu Ni pi ni sin nahding thu TEDIM THU KIH ZAK NA LAI A kih pian n kum 1919. Kham sim in Khalkha khua ah kih bawl hi. Lai bawl pa-------------------------------------Sang Mang pa Kum khat ah man hamu ah hi hi. Khalkha khua Awgu kha ni 1, 1925. LEITUNG GAMTAT NA THU Phalam uk sung ah kum 1924 sung ah nau suak 1356 pha hi. Mi si khempeuh 733 pha hi. Tua ahih ciang in ah siza sang in suasa in 600 dektak pha in. Phalam uk sung leh Khalkha uk sungah naupang te in Zo lai ah sin nuam hi. Khua kim khatah 30 ah cing zo a adang naupang ah sin zo kei hi. Khua hausa te in naupang dang naupang sam a lai ah sin sak hi. Piancit leh Sapeinte in Apihka gam sung amau ah ukna gam sung ah gimna ah ngah uh hi. Sapeinte in amau gam ah uk zo kei hi. Tu Piancit te in zong amau gam uk lai dingin nakpi in gal ah do hi. Tua ah ukna gam sung ah Musalman te ah om hi. Leitung Musalman te khempeuh in amau gam kih uk nuam hi. Tu kum India gam Madazi khua lamah huih khat vei nakpi ah nung a khua leh lam leh inn tampi ah siah sak hi. Madazi khua tak tak ah tung kei hi. Ah tung leh gimna tampi ah piang ding hi. Zun kha Khalkha Vuntawk Mangpa le Zato Babu khat in Khalkha kam kih suah hi. Khalkha Mangpa in kam 6 bang ah siam zo hi. Mei kha sia Aung Duai, sia Ngai Ling leh Sang Mangpate in Khalkha khua sivuaizi thu ah vaihawm uh hi. Hih thu ah ciamteh uh hi. 1.Sum bang zah ah ki ngah dng hiam ah kih thei nai kei hi. Tua ahih ciang in tu kum siate ah kha sum ah khang zo kei ding hi. Tua tham lo in amau in kuli man ah ngah zo kei ding hi. Autoba kha ah sivuaizi upate ah kih khawp khit ciang in sum ah om leh kha sum khang a kuli man ah ngah ding hi. 2. Zahuat leh Sang Lungte in khasum tam zaw ngah ding ah kih tuak hi. Anung ciang in sum ah om leh ah kih pia ding hi. Tu kum Sang Mang Pa leh Sang Mangnu thak hong pai ding hi. Mang Kang kam in ah min Strait ah hi hi. Zo kam ah hi le Street ah hi hi. Tuate in Amelika mi hi a ahih hang in amau thu dang kih thei nai kei hi. Cik ciang hong tung ding hiam, kih 1 hein ai kei hi. Amau in Khalkha khua ah om ding hi. Kam ah siam khit ciang in Sang Mangpa leh Mangnute te in ah khua ah ciah ding a kum khat khit ciang in Tedim khua ah om ding hi. Mihing Khempeuh in Mawna Ah Nei Hi Mihing khempeuh in mawh nei lo a siangtho nuam ciat hi. Bang hang hiam ih ci leh mawh nei lo, siangthona in Topa Zeisu hangah hing tawntung nawp sakna, Pasian bawlsa vantung inn nuam a man ngahna phual tung theihna hi. Ahih hang in: Kei ka mawh kei hi, cina om lo hi. Mihing khempeuh in mawhna nei ahih ciang in mawh phel ih deih mah siang hi. Ei ut bang in siangthona ih ngah zo kei ding hi. Bang mawhna nei ih hi hiam. Lung sim sung ah ah om mawhna in, leitung ah gimna khempeuh ah pianna ah bulpi ah hi hi. A hih hang in tua mawhna lung ngai a ah thei tam lo hi. Mawhna khempeuh ah tawpna in, mei kuang sung ah hi hi. Tua ahih ciang in mawh nei kei ing, ih ci ding eite tam(tham) lo in tang laiah Pasian in, ama mihing ding a lai ah tel mi nam lian Itazila mi pawlte ah cina Salan Lai Siangtho sung ah tel khia a Pawlu in ah at in: Mi pha khat beek om lo hi. Thu thei om lo, Pasian zong om lo amihing khempeuh in lam ah khial khin hi. Na ah kih mang lo. Ah pha ah gamta khat beek om lo hi, ci in ah at hi. Tua ahih ciang in in mawh kah nei kei hi, ci leh eimah pum kheem ih hi, ci in Zawhang in ah gelh hi. Lung sim sung ah zong mawhna om hi. Zeisu in hih thu ah gen hi: Mi sum guh ken, ah cina tham lo in mi sum deih gawh ken kah ci hi. Mi zi tawh mawh ken ah ci tham lo in lung sim nei a mi zi ah ente tua numei tawh ah mawh zo hi, ci in kah gen hi, ah ci hi. Tua tham lo in mi hehpi lohna zong mawhna ah hi hi. Bang hang hiam ci in gen leng mi ci na, lung kham ah dah te ah zawngte, thong kiate thu don lo na, ah hi hi. Ni tawp ni ciang in kumpipa in: Kah gil kial an nong piak lo. Kah dang tak a, ka don ding tui nong piak lo. Zin kah hih lai a nong vak lo. Puan ka sil lo a nong silh lo. Ka ci nat lai ahih zong, thong kah kiat lai ahih zong nong veh, nong nep loh uh ah ci ding a tuate in mawh sakna ah thuak tawn tung ding hi. Hehna, mi gensiatna, mi khasiat nang ah gamtatna zong mawhna lian mah ah hi hi. U leh nau mudah te in mi that ah hi hi. Mi that peuh mah te tung ah hing tawntung na kipia lo ding hi, no nah thei zo hi, ci in Zawhang ah ci hi. Tua bang ahih ciang in leitung nuntak lai ahih zong sih khit ciang ading ahih zong, mawh sakna dan ih thuak lo nahding in mawh phelna ih deih pen ding hi. Tua ahih ciang in mawhna kih sik a lung sim nuam khat a lung sim lui nusia a lung sim a thak tawh mawhna hong phel sak nahding thu ngen a thum ding hi. Mawh phel na deih in thu pha deih hi. Mi kim khat in mawhna pan suakta a ah siangtho lung damna ahih zong kih it na leh kih lemna tawh nungta ding in mawh phelna ah deih hi. Tua bang deih na in ah hawih pha pen hi. Mawsi in ama mi pawl ta ding in thu ah nget na in: Eguthu gam pan paikhiat ni ah kihpan tu ni dong in hih mi pawlte mawhna na phel ngei bang nong hehpihna ah lian zah mah bang in tu in zong hong phel sak in, thu kong ngen hi, ci in thu ah ngen hi. Tua tham lo in kumpipa a lian bel Davuih in: Kah kih niam khiat kah lung gimna hong en in, kah mawhna hong phel sak in, Topa aw, ci in thu ah ngen hi. Tua mah bang in lung niam sak in ih thu ngen ding hi. Pumpi ahih zong in lung sim ahih zong in thu hilh a Pasian min phat ding ah hi hi. Kah lung sim aw, Topa Pasian thu pha pia in, hong hehpih na mang ngil kei in. Nah mawhna khempeuh hong phel sak a na ci natna khempeuh hong dam sak ci in Davuih in thu ah ngen bang in ih ngaihsun ding hi. Tua bang ah um a lung sim niam khiat a thu ih nget leh ih ngah ding hi. A mawh nei ah kih sikte kiangah Topa Zeisu in: Nah mawhna kih phel zo hi. Nah upna in nang hong gum hi. Nuam tak in pai in, ah ci hi. Tua ahih ciang in kih sik leeng um leeng mawhna ah kih phel ding hi. A hih hang in a mawhna kih sik lo te mawh kih phel ding hi, ci a upna, lawpna om lo hi. Lungsim khel ding a mi dang mawhna phel sak ding zong lung sim ah kawih ding hi. Mi mawhna nah phel kei leh nang mawh na pa in ah hong phel kei ding hi, Zeisu in ah gen hi. Mawh phel na ih ngah khit ciang in bang dan in ih gamta ding hiam. Pawlu in Kawlawte pawlpite ah hong han thawnna in eite ading zong hi. Ah han thawn na in: Note Pasian tel mi siangtho ah it huai bang in kih hehpih kih ngaina thu pha bawlna lung sim khiatna lung nemsa lung duaina puan bang in sil un. Khat leh khat kih mawh sak na om ciang in lung duai un la mawhna kih phel sak un. Khazih in no mawhna hong phel sak mah bang in nah kih phel un. Kih cing na a pawl ah kih ci kih itna nah sil thuah un. Nah lung sim uh Khazih a kih lemna in hong uk ta hen. Tua bang ah deih manin pum khat sung pan no hongsam ahih ciang in thu pha ngaihsut a lung sim nei ta un, ah ci hi. Hih lai ah sim u leh maute kiangah kah pumpi kong pai ah hi kei zong in Topa Zeisu min tawh hih za kong gelh hi. Lung duai tak in nah sim un. Tun En. KHAMTUNG GAM SIMTONA THU Thang galkap te in Tonzang khua ah sim lai tak in Khalkha gal kap te in zong gal ah do uh hi. Tua gal kap te in Khalkha khua ah tun ciang in, a sawt veipi ah tam zo kei ding hi, ci in Khalkha hausapa te ah um mawk hi. Ah an ah bei khit ciang in ah ciah suk ding hi, ah ci uh hi. Ahih hang in lam siala an hong pua to ahih ciang in hausate ah lung mang hi. Khat vei vei Khalkha khua sim ding in hausate kih khawm a a vaihawm uh hi. Ahih hang in amau in zong apha takpi ah kih lem lo ahih ciang in ah sim zo kei hi. Phalam khua vai khat a: Hong hong tan, ah ci uh hang in Phalam hausa hong pai ngam kei hi. Ahih hangin khua khat mihingte in kumpinu tawh ah kih lem nuam kei hi. Khalkha khua pan in tai 21 bang ah gamla Sakta khua ah om hi. Tua khua pi te a lung khauh mahmah a: Kah lut kei ding hi, ah ci hi. Ahih hang in tua khua tangval te ah kih pha sak ahih ciangin lam pang a Khalkha Mangte in Sakta khua sim ning ci in gal kap 135 kuan a Sakta khuaa ah pai uh hi. Sakta khua pan tai nih bang kih hal ah tua uh ciangin lam pang pawlte a kap uh hi. Galkapte in khua ah tun ciang in ah delh hi. Ahih hang in kan ah sang lua a Sakta mite in nakpi ah kap man in khua sung ah lut zo kei hi. A delh uh lai tak in khuapite in gal kap mangpa khat ah that hi. Gal kap mang pa in Khalkha khua pan in gal kap dang sam ing, ci in ah lung ngai lai tak in Sakta hausa te in: Kih lem ni, ci in ah vaikhak uh hi. Mangpa ah kih lem nuam lo, khua ah sim nuam zaw hang in thau leh sia tawh ah lut sak hi. Amau ah kih lem khit ciang in gal kap te in Khalkha khua ah ciah hi. Sakta khua pan in tai 30 kih gamla Surkhua ah om hi. Tu in galkapte in tua khua ah sim hi. Ahih hang in lampi ah lam pang tampi ah om ah theih ciang in Bawinu gun kan tan a lam dang panin khua ah sim hi. Bawinu gun gal lam panin cingpi tawh khua ah kap ciang in hausa te kihta a ah lut hi. Amau sal zong ah kha kik uh hi. Tua lai tak in lam sial pawlte in Khalkha khua leh Phalam khua kih kal lampi ah sial hi. Phalam hausate leh Khalkha hausate in pha tak pi kumpinu tawh ah kih lem zo hi. A kih beh lap ding hi. Tapidaw in Haucinkhup kiangah Sa Piak Nahding Phalam Mangpipa ah Piakna Thu Phalam Khua, Meikha 17, 1925. Masa ah kih tuhna thu gelh kik ding in thu ah um in kah um kei hi. A tawntung Haucinkhup leh Tapidaw te ah kih lem zo kei hi. Tua thu sung panin ah nih mah in ah khial in kah um hi. Ahih hang in hih thu ah man in kah um hi. Mihing te in Tapidaw a suak ciang in saliang kim khat piak lo ciangin Haucinkhup ah lung dam kei hi. Hih saliang tang ding Tapidawte in na dang ah piak leh kih lawm hi. Hih thu in Tapidawte in zong ah ci hi. Tua bang ah pia lo leh Haucinkhup leh Tapidaw te ah kih lem zo kei hi. Hih thu khempeuh Sang Mang pa leh Haucinkhup leh Tapidawte tawh kah vaihawm zo hi. Tua ahih ciang in hih thu kah pia hi: Dawi bia nah ding ah hih kei leh Tapidaw khempeuh te in sahang leh sia ah pia ding hi. Dawi sep nah ding in bangmah ah pia kei ding hi. Taang sen, taang an, khua liu, sial ki liang man, ngasa liang ah pia ding hi. Innsa liang leh dawi biak nahding sia tang ding in Tapidawte in kum simin sa ah go masa pen ah liang ah pia ding hi. Thu gentehna: Vawk khat a go leh liang khatah pia ding hi. Vok nih ah go leh vok khat ah liang a pia ding hi. Vok nih leh sial khat ah go leh vok khat ah liang leh sial ah liang ah pia ding hi. Vok thum tawh sial nih tawh keel li tawh ah go le vok khat ah liang, sial khat a liang tawh, keel khat ah liang tawh ah pia ding hi. Shivuazi ah tapidaw te in ah gawhsa saliang ah pia ding hi. Tapidaw te in kum simin ah ganhing ah gawh masa pen dak sap ah pia ding hi. Tozang khua leh Tuitum khua leh Tungtuang khua sung ah sang inn leh sia inn ah lam zo kei ding hi. Kamhau uk sung khua dangah Mangpi pa in thu ah pia leh sang inn leh siate inn ah lam thei hi. Haucinkhup in sang inn mun sap man peek 3 kum simin ah ngah thei ding hi. Khua khat ah Tapidawte in sang inn ah lam nuam leh lai sung ah Tedim Topa kiang ah thu an ngen ding hi. Tua Topa in tua khua pai a nialna thu vekpi ah ngai ding hi. Haucinkhup leh khua hausa leh upate kiangah sang inn mun gi ah bawl ding hi. Tua khit ciang in Mangpipa kiang ah ama ngaihsutna lai ah khak ding hi. Tuimui khua, Losau khua, Tong Cin khua leh Luangel khua ah om sang inn ah om lai ding hi. Ahih hang in sap ah pia ding hi. Saliang le daksap man in Kamhau uk ngeina bang in ah hih ding hi. Ahih hang in sang inn sap ah ngah hang in inn khempeuh sap man ah ngen thei ding hi, ci hi. Lung ngaina ah om kei ding hi. Phalam Mangpipa. NIPI NI SIN NAHDING THU Septemba 6, 1925 Philipu Nasepna thu Sawltak Tangthu 8 1.Tua lai tak in Zezusalem khua ah om pawlpi te a nakpi kih bawl sia a Sawltakte sim lo in a dang Tapidaw khempeuh in Zudah gam leh Siamazih gamah mun mun kih the thang hi. 2. Thu zahtakte in Tetapan vai a amah hangah nakpi ah kap hi. 3. Sawlu in Pawlpi a sugawp a inn vekpi ah lut khit ciang pasal, numei ah kai khia in thong sung ah ah khum hi. 4.Tua ahih ciang in gam khempeuh kih the thang mite in ah vak kawi kawi a thu ah hilh hi. 5. Philipu a Siamazi khua pai a Kazih thu ah gen hi. 6. Mi honte za uh a Philipu ah hih na lam dangna ah muh ciang in tua thu lung sim kih khat in ah ngai ciat uh hi. 7. Bang ding hiam ih cih leh dawi vei mihing tampite pan nakpi kihko in dawite ah pusuak uh hi. A pum lang khat a si mi leh khe bai mi tampite in damna ah ngah hi. 8. Tua khua sung ah nawpna leh lung damna ah piang hi. 9. Simon, a min nei mihing khat in mit pial in dawi bawl te, kei zong mi lian khat kah hi hi, ci in Siamazi mihing te ah lam dang sak hi. 10. Upa, naupang khempeuh in, Hih mi in letna kih ci Pasian vang ah hi hi, ci in ama thu ah ngai uh hi. 11. Amah in mit pial in sawt veipi mi lam dang sak ahih ciang in amaute in ama thu genna ah ngai uh hi. 12. Philipu in Pasian gam leh Zeisu Khazih ah min in lung damna thu gen a tua mite in ah thu ah up uh ciang in numei, pasalte in um a tui sung ah kih phum uh hi. 13. Simon in zong um a tui sung ah khih phum khit ciang in Philipu kiang ah om a nalam dang leh ah bawlna a muh ciang in a lam dang ah sa hi. 14. Siamazi khuapite in Pasian thu ah sang in Zezusalen khua ah om Sawltakte ah zak ciang in Pitazu leh Zawhang ah sawl hi. 15. Amaute ah tun uh ciang in tua khua mite in kha Siangtho ah ngah nahding in amaute ading thu ah ngen hi. 16. Bang ding hiam ih ci leh Topa Zeisu min tawh tui sung ah kih phum bek hang in Kha Siangtho khat peuh mah tung ah ah tung nai kei hi. 17. Amau te in tua mite tung ah khut a ngak ciang in Kha Siangtho ah ngah uh hi. 18. Sawltakte khut ah nga ciang in Kha Siangtho ah kih pia, Simon ah muh ciang in: 19 Keima khut ah tung ah kah nga sate in Kha Siangtho ah ngah ding in kei zong vangletna hong pia tan, ci in dangka ah pia nuam hi. 20. Pitazu in: Pasian a hehpihna dangka tawh kih lei hi ci a ngaisun nah hi ciang in nang tawh nah dangka sia khawm ta hen. 21. Nang in hih thu tawh na kih kum nah kih tuak kei hi. Bang ding hiam nah ci leh nangma lung sim in Pasian maiah ah tang kei hi, ah ci hi. Cinawpna Thu (Atung a te a gen kikna) 1. Zudate in Tetapan ah that khit ciang in Tapidaw adang zong ah that nuam hi. Tu in Tapidaw ah that ngam hi. Tua ahih ciang in Tapidaw te ah tai uh hi. Ahih hang in amau ah tam man in mihing tampi te in Pasian thu ah zak uh hi. 3. Sawlu, Sawlu in Tapidaw ah huat pen pa hi. Anung ciang in Tapidaw suak a upna lian pen pa a suak hi. 5. Philipu, Tamandaw ah hih kei hi, upa ah hi hi. Siamazi khua. Hih khua mihing te in Zudah mi hi kei. Lawki mi ah hih kei hi. Judah te in Siamazite ah zawng sak a amau kiang ah Pasian thu ah hilh nuam kei hi. Philipu in Tamandaw ah hih kei hangin na lam dang ah bawl thei hi. 9. Simon. tua pa in Tapidaw sung pan thu zuau gen pi bel pa hi. Ah si mateng in Pasian thu a nial hi. Tua pa in Philipu na lam dang na ah mu ciang in ah tum dang sa a Philipu thu a zui hi. 14. Zudahte in Simazihte ah zawng sak hang in Tapidaw a suak uh Tamandawte ah theih ciang in amau kiang a pai thei hi. 19.Simon in dangka tawh Pasian vanglet na ah lei nuam hi. A hih hang in kuamah in ngun tawh Pasian thu pha ah ngah zo kei hi. Ama thu ah um mi kheempeuh te in thu pha lung dam na ah ngah thei hi. Septemba kha 13,1925 Philipu leh Etazawpih Pa Thu Sawltak Tangthu 8 26. Pasian vantung mihing khat in Philipu kiang ah: Nang tho in la Zezusalen khua pan in Gaza khua paina gampalak khang lam pai in, ci in a gen mah bang in. 27. Philipu tho a a pai hi. Tua lai tak in Etazawpih gam Kandet kumpinu nuai ah a vang lian ah vaihawm Mang amah sum khempeuh ah uk Etazawpih gam mi khat in biak nahdingin Zezusalen khua pai a 28. ah ciah kik lai tak in ama leeng tung ah tuang a Kam Sang Pa Hesiaza Lai Siangtho ah sim hi. 29. Kha Shiangtho in: Tua leeng nai in la bel in, ci in Philipu kiangah thu ah piak ciangin. 30. Philipu in ama kiang ah tai a KamSangpa Hesiaza lai sim za a: Nah simte nah thei hiam, ci in a dong hi. 31. Tua Mangpa in: Hong hilh a om kei leh bang ci thei ding kah hi hiam, ah ci ciangin Philipu in amah tawh kahta a tu khawm nahding a gen hi. 36. Philipu in a kam ka a tua Lai Shiangtho pan ah kihpan Zeisu thu ah gen hi. 37. Lam apai lai takin tui a om na a tung a Mangpa in: Tui a om hi. Kei mah in kah kih tui phum lo mahding thu a om hiam, ah ci hi. 38. Mangpa in leeng khawh nah ding thu a pia khit ciangin Philipu leh Mangpa ah nih man in tui sungah pai uh a a tui ah phum hi. Tui sung ah ah kahtoh khit ciangin Kha Shiangtho in Philipu ah la khia a Mangpa in a nung ciangin ah mu nawn lo hi. Cinawpna Thu (atung a thu agenkik na) 26. Gaza khua. Tu dong in ah om hi. Mang kangte gal kih do lai tak in tua khua ah Englante Tulkhite in khat vei kih do hi. Khua ah liau kei hi. Gampalak. Kua in gampalak thu hilh ding a pai ding hiam. A hih hangin vantung lam zong pa khat ah om manin Pasian in Philipu ah sawl hi. 27. Etazawpih gam. Tua gam in Apalika gamah om a tu dong in ah kip hi. Sawltak tte khang lai takin Etazawpih gam ah lian mah mah hi. Tu in a lian kei hi. Tapidaw vive a om hangin Pasian thu a teltakpi ah siam kei hi. Tua pa in Zezusalen khua a pai a hih ciang in Pasian thu a za nuam, ci in kih thei hi. 31. Mi tampi te in Pasian thu a ngaihsun hang in ah hilh ding kua mah a om kei hi.A hih hang in mihing khat peuh Pasian thu a za nuam tak tak ah leh Pasian in tua pa kiang ah thu hilh pa a sawl ding hi. 36. Kam Sang te in Zeisu thu a hilh khawl hi. Zudah mihing te in Kam Sangte thu a ngai nop leh Zeisu thu a zui ding hi. Philipu in mihing khat Tapidaw suah nah ding gampalak lam a pai hi. A hih hang in tua pa a ciah ciang in ama gam mihing kheempeuh Tapidaw a suak siat hi. Tua a hih ciangin Philipu nasep na in a neu bang hangin ah lian mah mah hi. Eite in mihing khat Tapidaw ih suak sak ciang inmihing dang bangzah in Pasian thu a za ding hiam ih thei kei hi. Septeba 20,1925 Sawlu Tapidaw Suahna Thu Sawltakte Tangthu 9 1. Sawlu in Topa nung zuite lang khat pang a that dingin ah nakpi ah nak lai takin hih Lam ah zui numei a hih hang in pasal a hih hangin a mu ciang in khau khit ciang in Zezusalen khua hong paipih ding in Damati khua sang innte kiang ah vaikhakna lai pia in Sawlu in Siampi uk pa kiangah a gen hi.3. A mah in lam pi ah pai ah Damati khua ah nai ciangin vantung pan khua vakpi in amah kimkot t h akhat in hong tang hi. 4.Amah in lei tung a puk a: Sawlu, Sawlu bang ding in kei hong bawl sia hiam, cina aw ah za hi. 5.Sawlu in: Topa aw kua nah hi hiam, ci in ah dot ciangin Zeisu in: Keimah in nah hong bawl sia ka hi hi. A hih hangin tho in la khua sungah tum in. Nah gamtat nah ding thu kong hilh ding hi, a ci hi. 7. Sawlu tawh a pai khawm mite in lung am ah pau lo ah ding a tua aw beek ah zak hang in kuamah a mu kei hi. Sawlu in lei pan ah thawh ciangin ah mit a hak leh kuamah a mu kei a hih manin amaute in a khut kai a Damati khua ah paipih hi. 9. Ni thum sungah bang mah mu lo, an ne lo,tui dawn lo in a om hi. 10. Tua lai takin Damati khua ah min Annani a ci, Tapidaw khat a om hi. Tua pa mang sungah Topa in: Annani aw ci in a sap leh Annani in: Kei mah kah om hi, Topa aw, ah ci in ah dong hi. 11. Pasian in: Tho in la Tang ah kih ci, l ampi pai in la Tasu mi Sawlu kih ci Zudah inah nah zong in. Bang ding hiam nah ci leh tua pa ah thu ngen hi. 12.Ama in Annini ah min nei hong pai a mah khua mu thei nah dingin ah khut ah nga ah mu zo hi, a ci hi. 17. Ann a ni pai a in sungah a lut a Sawlu tungah a khut nga a: Kah nau Sawlu aw, nang paina lampi nah kiangah ah hong kih lang Topa Zeisu in nang ma khua nah mu kik nahding a hih zong in Kha Siangtho tawh tawh nah kih dim nah ding ahih zong in hong sawl hi, ah ci hi. 18. Tua lai takin a mittang ah ngasa lip bang tahkhatah ah khia a khua a mu thei a a tho leh tui ah kih phum khit ciangin. 19. an ne a ah tha hong khauh kik hi. Cinawpna Thu 1. Zeisu khua ah Tapidaw a om kei hi, ah tai khin uh hi. Tua ahih ciang in Sawlu in khua dang ah Tapidaw a zong hi 2. Damati khua. Ah lam zawh kum 4,000 bang pha hi. Damati khua sang inn uk te in Zezusalen khua siampi uk pa khut nuai ah om hi. Sawlu in ni thum a tung thei hi 3. Sawlu in Tapidaw a suak ciang in thahkat in Tapidaw ah suak hi, a dam dam in ah ngaihsun kei hi. Ah kih pha sak hi. A hih hang in leitung ah lum lai tak in ah kih pha sakna ah bei hi. 5. Mihing khat in Tapidaw ah bawl siat ciangin Pasian zong a bawlsiat hi. Zeisu in leitung ah hong pai suk ciang in ama thu a um lote kiangah: Kah nau a neu pen tung ah nah heh pih lo man inah kei nong heh pih kei hi, ah ci ding hi. 8. Ah mit ah hak hi. Pasian thu a pha takpi ah ngaihsun thei nah ding in Pasian in a mit ah hak sak hi. 10. Annini. Tua pa in Sawlu kiangah ah a pai ngam kei hi, Sawlu a kih ta hi. 18. Ni thum sungah Sawlu a khua a ngaihsun thei hi. Tua a hih ciang in Annini hong pai ciangin tui sungah kiphum a Tapidaw tak tak a suak hi. Sawlu,Tapidaw a suah ciang in Tapidawte in phat na a ngah hi. Tu ma-in Tapidaw a tam pen in mi zawng te ah hi hi. Sawlu in mi lian hi a Zudah uk pa khat ah hi hi. Sawlu,Tapidaw a suah ma-in Pasian thu a huasa hi. A hih hang in Tapidaw ah suah khit ciang in adang Tapidaw sangin Pasian thu a um zaw hi. Ah si mahteng in bawlsiatna ah thuak hangin, zawng sakna ah thuak hangin Pasian na nakpi in ah seem hi. Zeisu sim lo in Sawlu sang in lei tung ah a lian zaw mihing a om kei hi. Septemba 26,1925 Sawlu Naseem Ding ah Kihpan Hi Sawltakte Tangthu 9 19. Sawlu in Damati khua Tapidawte ni ah tawm khat ah om khawm a. 20. Zeisu Pasian ta ahi, ci in sang in sung ah thu ah hilh hi. 21 . Azate in a lam dang sa uh a: Hih mi in Zezusalen khua sungah tua min ah suangte ah bawl sia tham lo-in amaute khua a siampi kiang ah paipih dingin hih lai tak a hong pai pa hilo ah hi hiam, a ci uh hi. A hih hang in Sawlu ah thahat seem seem a Damati khua ah om Zudah mite a gen thu sel a Zeisu in k h azih a hi takpi ah lang in ah gen hi. 25. A sawt lo khit ciang in Zudah mihing te in Sawlu a that ding in ah vaihawm hi. 24. Tua a han ciam na Sawlu in ah thei hi. Amah a that ding in tua mite in kong biang kiangah sun leh zan a pang uh hi. A ma nung zui te in amah la a seeng hai khat sungah a guan khit ciang in kul tung pan a khia suk hi. 26. Zezusalen khua a tun khit ciang in Tapidawte tawh a kih pawl ni ah ci leh amaute in Tapidaw a hi lam a taksa kei uh a amah ah kihta uh hi. 27. A hih hangin Banaba in Sawlu sam a Pasian sawltakte kiangah a paipih a Sawlu lam-piah Zeisu a muna ahih zong in amah tawh a kih hona ahih zong in Damati khua-ah Zeisu ah min tawh lau lo-in ah thu hilhna teng amaute kiangah a gen hi. 28. Sawlu in amate tawh Zezusalen khua ah om khawm a pai zel a ciah zel a. 29. lau lo-in Zeisu ah min thu ah hilh a Galik Zuda mi thu kih sel a amaute in amah ah that ni, ci in a hahkat hi. 30. Unaute in tua thu ah thei ciangin Sawlu, Ketazi khua pai sak a Tasu khua ah kha hi. Cinawpna Thu 19. Sawlu in Tapidaw ah sau khit ciangin thakhat mah in Pasian na ah seem hi. Kum thum ah gampalak ah Pasian thu ngaihsun nahding in a om khit ciang in Damati khua ah Zeisu thu ah hilh hi. 21. Mi gilo peuh in Tapidaw ah suak ciangin mi kheempeuh ah lung mang hi. A hih hang in Pasian thu ah huat mi pawl in Tapidaw a suak sa ah that nuam hi. Sawlu in thahkhat in bawlsiat a thuak hi. 23. Zudah mihing te Tua mihing te in Zeisu ah that hi. Amau in a pu ah pa ngeina beek a ngaihsun thei hi. Kham tung mihing bangin: Pasian ka bia hi, ah ci uh hang in aman takpi a bia kei hi. 25. Sawlu sangin bawl siat na a thuak zaw ah om in kih um kei hi. Ah bete, ah suahpite in Sawlu ah huat pen hi. 26. Sawlu in Tapidaw a suah, ci in Zezusalen Tapidawte a ngaihsun zo kei hi. Amaute tawh kih pawl khit ciangin Tapidaw a min thei a ah bawlsiat ding hi ci in a lau hi. 27. Banaba tua pa in Sawlu lawmpa a hi hi. Amah in a masa-ah lo khat zuak a Sawltakte kiangah man a pia hi. Tua a hih ciang in Tapidaw kheempeuh in ama thu a um hi. 29. Galik Zudah mi. Tua mihing te in Zudah mi ah hih hangin Galik gam a lal zo hi. Tu in kim khat te in Zezusalen khua ah om kik hi. Tua lai takin Galik mihing te in a lung pil pen ah hi hi. Ahih hang in Sawlu in Pasian lung pilna ah nei manin ah amaute a zo zo thei hi. Tua hih ciangin amaute ah zo zo lo manin ah Sawlu a that nuam hi. 30. Ketazia khua. Tua khua in tui pi gei khua ah hi hi. Tembaw kheempeuh in tua khua ah tung hi. Tasu khua in Sawlu a hingna khua hi. Tua a hih ciangin Ketazia khua panin tembaw tungah tuang a a khua a ciah hi. Tua a hih ciang in Sawlu in Pasian na ah seem nuam hang in ah haksa hi. Ama thu mihingte ah ngai nuam kei hi. "url": " "depth": 0 --- Gupna le Upna (Kitan thei maw kitan theilo) Zam Thuam ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Gupna le Upna (Kitan thei maw kitan theilo) Zam Thuam posted on 1 June 2020 at 9:33 pm Lomkholna: Biakna , News , Zamthuam Gupna le Upna (Kitan thei maw kitan theilo) Zam Thuam Mihing te pen ii up bangbang in a kigamta ahi hi. Gamtatna i cih pen lungsim sawlna pan hong pai hi a lungsim sungah upna a om bang in sepkhiatna hong pai hi lel hi. Tua pen Pasian thu sese hi nailo hi. Kimlepam kep kei leng leitung lum semsem in siatna tam semsem in kisia ding hi cih a um khat in singno suan, nin mawk paihlo, meikhu a tawm pen ding hanciam cih bangin a upna tungtawn in gamta in a thute zui hi. Gupna thu ah bel Um limlim leng kigum hi phot. A up nak leh gup na pen kip hi ci kingkeng ing ei. Aih hang gamtatna khempeuh pen upna in tawsawn ngiat leuleu hi ei. An ne kei leng gilkial ding cih thei naihcia an ne hi pah. Ne kei leng gil kial ding cih um naihcia sepna ahi an nek pen semkhia. Hanciamna gamtatna hang a gupna kingah hilo in upna hang in gupna a kingah ahih manin upna tawh na nuntakna tawsawn in gamtat ding hanciam ding hi leuleu hi. Gupna ngah nang upna a nei khat pen upna in a tawsawn nuntak gamtat luhek kampauna om pah lel hi. Gupna tawh kisai Gamtatna ah nam nih om hi. Gupna ngah nading in a hoih gamtatna neihna ding hanciam na le gupna ngah nading ahi upna in a tawsawn a hoih gamtatna te ahi hi. Tua ahih manin gupna hong ngahsak upna in na nisim nuntak khuasak gamtatna te hong tawsawn nak leh na upna kip lai ahih manin gupna zong kip hi. A taktak in Gupna pen a tawntung in kip a Gupna ii ngahna ahi upna pen na kiplo thei, a um kisakhial thei zaw mawk hi. Na upna a kip laisiah Gupna kip hi. Dr Kam Khua Thang hong nusiatna tungtawn a Phawk huai tuamtuamte ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Rev. Dr Kam Khua Thang hong nusiatna tungtawn a Phawk huai tuamtuamte posted on 10 April 2017 at 7:33 am Lomkholna: News , Zomi Zomite lungsim puakzia ding ih lunggulh thu Sia Kam Khua Thang a kipan hong nusia sa, Zomi lakah ih mipil, makai tuamtuamte tungtawnin ka ngaihsut theih zel thu pawl khat ih Zomi pihte lakah kong hawmsawn nuam hi. Kei ngaihsut bangin a ngaihsun kha zong tampi om dingin lamen ing. Ih minam sungah ki kholh pih zia, ih khan hun leh ih omna mun tawh ki zui-in a theih huai pipi kuamah ih ki theih kim loh hangin ei mi phazah tawh kizui-in mipil misiam leh mi hau zong tampi om khin zo hihang. Kaamsiatna ih ci ding hiam, Pasian deihna ih ci ding hiam tuate lakah mihingte mitmuhna ah a hun cing nailo pipi in lamet loh laitak hong nusia leh Sia Thang dan maha khangcingsa zong hong nusia tampi tak mah om hi. Tua hong nusia sa ih makai, mipilte in kuama phawk loh laitakin a pil a siamna leh a tha neih zah un na hanciam uh a, ih lamet ngam loh zah donga a thupi sepna leh pilna na nei mah uh hi. Ahi zongin tua a etteh taak pilna, sepnate pen a sihma, a damlai sangin a sih khit teh ki thei zaw, mipi aadingin ki pholh khia pan tamzaw uh hi. A hang kan ciat leng ih muhna tuamtuam om kha thei ding hi. Keima mimal upmawhna ah; ih mipil ih makai leh ih mihaute pen hong nusiatma sangin hong nusiat khit teh tha kipia, ki pahtawi, thu kidong nuam, pammaih kisa pan zaw in ka mu hi. Tua banah a misipa leh a pahtawi nuam pan leh a huh nuam phingte aadingin zong phattuamna om nawn in zong up huai khollo hi. Paunak Lai Siangtho a lian sawm, a neu nga sungah; A hun-a an a lapa mipil hi a, an lak hun-a ihmu-pa in maizumna a ngah hi. a cih mah bangin a hun lai a, tha ki piakna leh pahtawina in phat tuamna hong pia zaw tham ding hi. Ih sih cianga ki pahtawi zah in ih dam lai in ki panpihin ki pahtawi zo leng phattuamna tampi om zawkan lai ding hi. Pasian huhna tawh ei Zomite zong ih cihmawh luatna panin Pasian in hong phongto a, tu in tagah nawi muh bangin nuntakna tampi ki lamdangin ih lungsimte zong ki lamdang hi. Nidanga ih ngaihsut ngei lohte zong ki ngaihsun kha in, pau ding zonga ih ngaihsut ngei lohte zong ki pau khial kha thei hi. Zomite khan tohna ding ih manawh laitakin ih mipil ih mi siamte, ih mi haute, ih makaite thadah nading kammal leh lai peuh suangtat sat ngam, ak eek lawngngam banga ih gelh khak loh ding thupi phadiak hi. Kuamah ih kihuh zo kei zongin ih kammal leh laigelhna hang peuh tawh ih makaite leh, mipilte, mihaute ih thadah sak khak loh ding kidop huai hi. Mi thupi ih sak hat pen a sih ciangin ih pahtawi nop leh a dam lai in zong ahithei banga pahtawi kholh theih ding thupi mahmah hi. Ih mipilte leh mihaute in a dam sungin a hih theih tawp un Zomite aading ma hong pan ding uh lampi khak lo in hon sak den ding hanciam ni. Ih mipil leh mihaute in zong ih mite omzia leh thanemnate theih siam a, ih nuak , ih thangpaih lak het loh ding pen ciimna leh mipi cing hihna zong mangngilh kei ni. Khangnote leh ngaihsut kholh theihna a neilo khat leh nihte laigelh, kampau peuh tawh na ngim na tupna, Zomi te aading na deih saknate thakiam sak het lo in saipi banga, na kalsuan ciatciat ding a thupi ahi hi. Nasepna thupite a ki khaktan theih nadingin makai thupite ki khaktan masak ding Satan vanzat lian pen ahi hi. Satan molhtumte lakah a ki zangthei kim pen leh a gualzo pente in; Ki phatsakna, Ki hazatna, Thumaan lohna, Angsung bek khualna, Hun tomno sung bek khualnate a kipan a tuamtuam tampi omlai hi. A huampi in gen ni cileng, Zomite a tamzaw pen, mipi aading khualna sangin aituam kikhualna ah minam dangte sangin muibun zaw hihang. Ahi zongin a tawpna enleng, Kawlte pauciin khat om ngei mah bangin; Mi tampi aading a semte in ama aading lawhcing hi cih pen ih ngaihsut ding thupi hi. Leitung mipite lakah khat ahi, sisan luan kullo a, suahtakna a lathei India kumpi, Mahatma Gandhi kammal namnga te: (1) Na ngaihsutna(your thought) kidawm in, na kammal in zui ding hi.(2) Na kammal(your word) ki dawm in, na gamtatna in zui ding hi. (3) Na gamtatna (your behave) ki dawm in, na zongsatna in zui ding hi.(4) Na zongsatna( your habit) kidawm in, na manphatna in zui ding hi. (5) Na manphatna (your value) kidawm in, Na tawntung mun ( your destiny) in zui ding hi. Hihte pen Lai Siangtho a hih loh hangin mihing nuntakna ah a ki pelh theilo thuman thutak vive hi a, ih upna or ngaihsutna leh ih tawntung mun ding a ki zom paisuak nahi gige hi. Tawmvei sung ki mang ding bek ih ngaihsut leh a tawpna ah tua mah hipah dinga, a tawntung aading ih ngaihsut leh tua mah hong hipah ding hi. Zomite ih khantoh nading ngaihsun kawmin ih tawntung mun ding vangam zuatna zong ih ngaihsutna tungtawn mahin hong tangtung ding a, ih vawh bang khaici ih at ciat ding hi. (Gal. 6:7-10) Hih lai nong sim sak ka lungdam hi. A hoih lama lak siam dingin Pasianin thupha hong piakim ciat tahen. The Primordial Goddess of Konkan: Zolai Devis Presence in Every Village - Google Maps contribution stories - Local Guides Connect Local Guides Connect The Primordial Goddess of Konkan: Zolai Devis Presence in Every Village Google Maps contribution stories attraction , nature , culture , IN Praniketmore August 4, 2025, 7:37pm 1 Zolai devi 1473829 299 KB Location: Firstly we take a look with history reagarding zolai tempels In Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg districts, many villages worship the goddes Mahishasurmardini, locally called Zolai Devi.Zolai Devi is typically depicted with four hands the upper hands holding a sword and shield. while the lower hands hold a trident (Trishula) and grip the demon Mahisha by the jaw In other villages, variations include eight armed forms or depictions holding daggers or other weapons. Zolai Devi symbolizes protection, courage, and an enduring cultural bond that binds coastal communities together. Now take a look at our exploration of Asud village We visited the beautiful and divine Zolai Devi Temple located in this serene village. The temple is situated in a dense forest near a river, completely embraced by nature. The structure is grand, and what I especially liked was the wooden carving on the door frames not ancient, but incredibly beautiful and skillfully crafted. 1 19201080 244 KB 2 19201080 251 KB 3 40802296 667 KB 4 40802296 673 KB 5 19201080 209 KB Inside the main garbhagriha (sanctum), there are several idols along with Zolai Devi some of them are Gramdevtas, and a few are Zolai Devi idols from neighboring villages, referred to as her sisters. This represents the spiritual connection and unity among the nearby villages. There is also one of different Veergal present 6 19201080 525 KB The temple premises are neat, clean, and well-maintained by the authorities. In front of the temple, there is a saan (sacred platform) where the Shimga palkhi is placed. The surroundings are beautifully organized with well planted greenery that adds to the divine charm. A water cooler is available in the Sabhamandap (community hall), and dustbins are placed thoughtfully, ensuring that cleanliness is well maintained throughout the temple complex. 7 40802296 1.53 MB 8 40802296 1.17 MB 9 22964080 944 KB 10 40802296 1.41 MB How to reach : The temple is located in Asud village, Dapoli taluka.You can reach it by private vehicle or public transport. If youre coming by public transport, be prepared to walk for about 20 minutes from the main road to reach the temple.the nearest railway station is khed and situated 40km from location Where to stay : Temple having its own bhakta niwas near temple equiped with all facilities. Where to eat : At main road 800900m from temple there is several hotels are avilables. Wednesday nitaklam in Thornton ah akikaplum hi a, Police ten akaplum te azonsan laitak ahihi. Law Enforcement Sources te genkhiatna ah thaukapte lakah muanmawh Suspect athumna pen kimankhin ci a, adang mi 2 tepen aki nakzonsan mahmah laitak ci uhhi. Colorado Police Officers Foundation ten tua akikaplum Deputy pen Thursday zingsanglam in pulakkhia uh a, tuapa pen kum 32 aphakhin Heath Gumm kici hi. Heath Gumm pen zi leh innkuan aneikhin ahih manin, anutsiat a innkuanpih te huhna apianuam aomleh cin Donation Webpage zong ki bawlsakkhin hi. Police te genna ah hih thaukikapna akitheih ciangin kidelhpah a, ahi zongin aphual katun uhciangin tua Police Officer akaplum tepen taikhia vingveng uh cihi. Tua kuamsungteng hoihtak akizon kawikawi ciangin muanmawh Suspect Description tawh akibang pasal khat kimukhia hi cin Police ten genbeh hi. Police Spokeswoman khatin agenna ah tua thautawipa in Police Officer tawh aki nialkhit ciangin handgun thautawh Officer kapin taikhia hi cin genkhia hi. Tua Police Officer pen a awm kapkha in, amahpen khetawh taivingveng cihi. SWAT Team ten tua mikaplum te zonsanlai uh a, vanleng Airborne Drone te zangin tua kuamsungteng nakzon mahmah uhhi. Adams County Sheriffs Office inzong thau kikapzawh asawtlo in Twitter tungah Officer khat si hi, 88th leh Dawston Street te panin naki hemkhia un cin gelhkhia uhhi. Thautawite pen kimanzo nailo ahih manin, kidawm un cin mipi te zaksakna nei uhhi. Khuasung vengsung mipi pawlkhat te genna ah hih thaukikapna buaina apiankhit ciangin khuasung pen Security khauhmahmah hi. Officers te Rifle thautawi in kileh ziahziah uh a, Deputy khatin kidawm un, thautawi hongki muhkhakleh Rifle tawh ngimsa in hongki koih hi cin genkhia cihi. More: USA, Denver khuapualam ah thau kikap, Police Officer khat si, adang mi 6 liam Nungdiak khakhatzong acingnailo inzong Colorado, Douglas County sungah thaukikapna piangin Deputy khatmah kikaplum a, adangzong mi tampi liam ngeikhin uhhi. Zawnglua uh a hih man in kum 4 a phak a ki pan khuasung teng ah mawngphal zuak in sum zong hi. Hih sumzon na tawh annek khop zong ngahzo lo a hih man in puan hoih zong a silh zo kei hi.Sangkah hun a tun ciang in sanghong kah a, sangkah loh hun sung teng in a lawm te tawh khedap taih in sum tha lawh zelzel uhhi. Azenzen in khedap taih ding mi om kei leh annek ding nei lo in ngawl zel zel hi. Hih naupangno kum 12 a phak lai tak in nitak khat sumhau minthang khat in khedap taih ding in hong pai hi. Hih naupang no leh a lawm te nih in zong hih mihau pa kiang hong naih in, um ngei ngai uh hi. Naupang no 3 tak in a khedap taih sak nuam uh a hih man in mihau pa in zong kua taih sak zaw ding ci in khensat hak sa in en lela hi. Tua lai tak mihau pa in sum tang US 2 la khia a, Khedap taih man US2 hong pia ning kua in hong taihsak ding ci hi. Khedap khat vei taihsakpen US0. 20 khawng hi a, hih mihau pa in US 2 ci mawk a hih man in naupang no thum teng a mit uh hong vak in hong ki en en uh hi. Khat pa in kei hong taih sak in, tu zingsang pan in an ka ne nai kei hi, ka an nek na ding ngah nai lo ka hih man in ka gil kial in ka si ding hi ci in gen hi. Khatpa leuleu inzong ka inn vuah an nek ding nei lo a ka om zawh nithum pha khin hi. Ka innkuan te zong cidam lo in zatui leh an ka leisak kul ding hi, leisak zo kei leng ka nu in kei hong sak gawp ding hi ci in khasiat huai tak in gen hi. Tua nau pang no khat a cian lai pa in mihaupa khut sung a sum om US 2 en kawm in, tawm khat ngaih sun hi. A ngaih sut khit teh Azenzen in hih sum US2 ka ngah leh hih ka lawm te gel US1kong hawm sak ding hi ci in a genteh a lawm te gel leh mihau pa inlamdang sa uh hi. Hih ka lawm te gel in ka lawm it mah mah te a hihi.A mau a gil uh kial lua ta hi. Kei ka hih leh tu zingsang inka mawngphal zuak na sum tawh an ka ne hi. An neka hih manin khedap taih zawh na dingtha ka nei hi. Mihau pa khedap hong taih sak ta peuh in a cih teh Mihau pa zong thu kim in a khedap taih hi. Hih naupang no in zong khedap taih man US2 a ngah phet in a lawm te gel US0.50 tuak in hawm sak pah hi. Tua khit zawh a sawt lo in mihaupa in tua naupang no hong zong kik a, a ma na sep na ah nasem sak in anzong pia hi. Khasum tam pi a ngah loh hang in khedap taih tawh nuntak zong zaw zen sang in tawm bang nuam tuam zaw deuh a ki sa hi. Tua dan mun a tun theih na hang pen amah sang in a kisam zaw te a huh na hang a hi hi.Tua ahih manin hihnaupangno in midang a nei lo zaw te, huh na a ki sam te a tawn tung in huh tawn tung hi. A nungciang in hih nau pang no pen sangtawp in nasep na setzong lian pi khat ah na hong sem to hi. Nasem te tha man tawm na hang leh nasem te a ding kumpi te tung ah lung kim loh na pulak na ah a makai in hong om to hi. Kum 21 aphak inNasem ki pawl na khat ah hong lut hi. A kum 45 a phak ciang in Labour Party hong phuan khia hi. 2002 kum October kha in Hih gam sung a om gam mikhempeuhin nikhat in an thumvei ta ka ne sak zo ding hi cih tawh kum pi kiteel na ah honglut hi. Gammi khem peuh in a mah muang uh a, vote tam pi ngah a hih man in a gam vuah a 35 vei na kum pi kitel na ah kum pi ngah in hong sem hi. Hih gam ah nasem mawk mawk pan in kumpi a sem masa pen pen in minthang hi. 2006 kum in a nihvei na kiteel na ah ngah leu leu a, kum pi a sep sung in a gam ah a cih sa mah bang in annek tui dawn kita sam sak ngei lo hi. A gam vuah 93 naupang leh 83 ulian sateng in nikhat in an thum vei ta ne sak zo tak pi hi. Nidang in a gam uh pen gamzawng mah mah in leitung in ciam teh hi ta se mah leh tu in leitung ah gam mingthang 10 na ah hong ki hel zo ta hi. Hih pa inkua a hiam cih leh midang pi,theih ngeih loh khat hi lo hi. 2010 kum in kumpi pan in a khawl Brazil kumpi Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva a hihi. Hih a tung a thusung panin bang mu khia ih hiam cih leh miheh pih na leh ngim na tup naki cian a neih na ih mu khia hi. Pilna nei lo, sumleh paai nei lo hi ta semah leh kum pi innsung dong tung ding in a hanciam na te thupi ka samah mah hi. Et teh tak in thalak huai kasa hi.Tua a hih man in ihnuntak na ah bangmun bangmun ah om in niam hi ta se mah le hang, tha nem ding hi lo hi. Cik mah hun in ih ngim nate khahsuah kei ni. Thasaan ni. Mihing khem peuh in a gual zo thei te ih hi hi. Ih ngim na, ih tup na ih tung na ding in ei mah leh ei mah ih mawh puak tek a hihi. Lungsim thalak na ding ka deih na tawh mimin thang tuam tuam te tangthu kan in tua sung pan kong hawpsawn a hihi. ..Deih Tung.. ZAM Thupuak :: 28 Apr 19 (UN thukikhel te zaksakna) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW ZAM Thupuak :: 28 Apr 19 (UN thukikhel te zaksakna) posted on 27 April 2019 at 11:33 am Lomkholna: Malaysia , News , Refugee , ZAM , Zomi ZAM Thupuak :: 28 Apr 19 (UN thukikhel te zaksakna) CHIN STATE PAN HONG PAI GALTAI TE TUNGAH UNHCR THU KIKHELNA TAWH KISAI IN ZAKSAKNA Chin State khanglam buaina te hangin kawlgam ah ciah kik dingin lungmuanna omnai lo hi cih muh khait na tawh kizui in UNHCR in Chin State pan hong tai khia galtai te kepbit lai dingin kikhen tat hi. Hih kikhelna ah hoihtak leh manlang takin sep theih na dingin minkhumna (Register) leh gambelmi in ciapteh theih na ding sep zia bawl zia te ka puahphat laitak uh ahih lam zong kong thei sak nuam uh hi. Hih puahphatna te ih bawlna hang in Chin State pan hong pai galtaite thu tawh kisai (RSD interview) te hong zekai tuam ding hi. Hih vai tawh kisai in thuthak a om sim in zong kong zasak den ding uh hi. Gambel mi in a kiciamteh sa leh gambel mi in ciamteh ding a ngak lai te khempeuh pen amau hong pai khiatna gam koi pan hiam cih tawh ki-en loin amau ih hih na tawh ki-en pha in a kingaihsut phat laitak ahihi. Hih vai tawh kisai in thu kikhelna leh thu thak a om bangbang UNHCR pan in hong zasak den ding hi ung. Gambel mi a ciamtehna a ngah sa leh ciaptehna ngah dingin a ngak lai khempeuh te nunglamin ih zat ahi sep leh bawl ding gelna (policy) leh mimal in teel theihna te ngaihsun kik nawnloin 01 August 2018 pan 14 March 2019 sungin teelna a neite khempeuh a card uh ahih kei leh alaidal uh ki renewal sak ding hi. Khen khatna : 01 August 2018 pan 14 March 2019 sung mimal in etphatna a kibawlna ah kihel kha loin UNHCR pan in card renewal dingin appointment a kipia te khempeuh pen Malaysia UNHCR te ih paizia tawh kizui in hong ki renewal sakkik ding hi. Khen nihna : 01 August 2018 pan 14 March 2019 sungin mimal in etphatna sungah kihel in 31 December 2019 dong card tawi suak ding a teel te (Option 1 a teelte) Malaysia UNHCR te ih paizia tawh kizui in card kipia kik ding hi. Khen thumna : 01 August 2018 pan 14 March 2019 sung mimal etphatna sungah kihel in laidal a kipia te (Option 2 a teelte) khempeuh zong Malaysia UNHCR te ih paizia tawh kizui in card kipia kik ding hi. Hih a tung a khen 3 sung ah kihel te pen na card ahih kei leh na laidal a sihma (Expire Date) in UNHCR pan in hong kisam kik ding hi. UNHCR pan in sapna appoinment omlo pi in zum ah nong pai loh na ding uh zong hong thei sak ung. Phone number na khek or na laih zenzen leh a nuai a bangin sms kikhak in ki update thei ding hi. UNHCR zum ah phone No. puak dan ding Phone No. (alui) Space 791-09CSpace 791-001 Space Phone No. (Athak) hih teng khen in Phone No. 011 17225 222 ah sms khak ding. Na khak khit ciangin ni 7 sungin hong zasak kik ding uh hi. Hih phone pen message a lut bek kingah ding a, phone sapna in kingah lo ding hi. Appoinment a nei te kikhelna a om leh UNHCR pan in phone ahih kei leh message tawh hong zasak ding uhhi. UNHCR AH MEETING KINEI 25 April 2019 (Thursday) ni-in UNHCR pan RSDCLU leh RST lam pan ulian te leh Community tuamtuam pan makai te, Sangsia te leh pawlpi kem siate kimuh khopna UNHCR zum ah sun 2:00PM in kinei hi. Hih hun sungah UNHCR lam pan in amau nasepzia ding gelna (Policy) te hong gen khia uh a, tua khit ciangin dot na leh dawn na tuamtuam te kinei hi. Dotna leh dawnna tampi sung pan in Innkuan lutpih vai tawh kisai in zong kidong a, amau hong dawn kik na ah A lutpih ding te in UNHCR zum a hong report hun tawh ki en a, a lut pih pah thei kei zongin a lutpih hun in kum cing nailo ahih leh kum tampi a sawt zongin a file uh kigawm thei veve ding hi ci-in dawng kik hi. Damlo (Vulnerable Person) te tawh kisai in zong UNHCR pan in Register nong piak sak lai thei ding uh hiam cih dotna tawh kizui in UNHCR pan in damlo (Vulnerable) te nidang pek pan in Register kipia a, tuni dong mah in zong kipia lai hi. Ahi zongin UNHCR tawh akizom NGO zato te tungtawn in kipia bek ding hi. Hih zato te kiangah zong UNHCR ah report na ding tawh kisai sepzia bawlzia dingte kapuak khin uhhi ci in dawng kik hi. India pan Card Transfer te vai tawh kisai zong dotna kinei a, amau hong dawn kikna ah UN te in register hong piaksa khat pen koi mun koi mun pan in amau ih sepzia bawlzia tawh kizui in ama thu a cingin hong piak theih nak leh kizop sak thei mah hi ci in dawng kik hi. Kum tampi RSDRST akisam lote tawh kisai zong dotna kinei a, tua te pen a hun zui in meeting nei toto in tua pan in kikum toto leng hong lem toto ding in um ung ci in hong dawng hi. Sangnau pang te vai ding zong dotna kinei a Hih sangnaupang te pen Primary pan in Secondary akah na ding leh sang te hoih tak a zop toh theih na ding uh Malaysia kumpi leh University tuamtuam tawh kikupna ka nei denden uh a, mai lam ah thu hoih hong piang ding in ka lem en uh hi. ci-in dawng kik hi. Kimuh khopna pen nitak lam nai 4:00 kim in kizo thei hi. KIDAWM THEI LENG UNHCR te December 31, 2019 ciangin hong panpih nawnlo ding a cihna hong khel in tu-in kum 3 bang hong pia kik uh a, ih lungdam mahmah hi. Ahi zongin amau hong piakna uh tungtawn in ih zat dan ih siam ding kisam mahmah hi. Galtai dinmun a om ih hih leh galtai khat ih din mun tawh kituak in ih om ding kisam hi. Ih khut sung hong tungsa hamphatna te zang kha lo zek khaloin ih va ap kik khak ding kidawp huai mahmah hi. Nang mahmah in na kam pan na pulak thu pen nang mahmah in palsatin na pulak thu tawh a kileh bulh in na gamtatna in nang bek tungah siatna hong tung hilo a, na mipih tampi tungah zong tua siatna pen a kibang in kithuak khawm ahihi. Tua ahih manin galtai hi ing ih cih leh galtai khat din mun kho takin len in galtai hi kei ing ih kicih leh zong ih dinmun kho tak in ih letkip ding thupi mahmah hi. Ut hun ciangin ei thugensa mah palsatin ih gam ih lei ciahin ih ut hunhun ciangin pai kik zel, ih ut ciang ih card renew in ih ut loh ciang nusia zel cih dinmun pen nang suahtakna ahih hangin tua in mi tampi tungah sukha, buaisak tuam mahmah cih ih phawk ding hong thupi mahmah hi. Ei hong huh nuam hong panpih nuamte hong huhnop semsem leh hong panpih nop semsem na dingin ih sep theih ding leh ih kalsuan theih ding thupi a, ei hong panpih nuamte a hong muh na ah a panpih huailo ih suak loh ding hong thupi mahmah ding hi. Thu leh la khat peuh ah a ma hun zui in ih kalsuan ding zong kisam a, a hun ih lap ding leh a hun nailopi in ih ki pei ngawp loh ding zong thupi hi. UNHCR ZUM PAN PHONE HONG KISAP CIANG UNHCR zum pan in phone hong kisap ciangin hong sapna mun (RSD,DSURSTRSCOPE, DHS..etc) dong hamtang inla, bangvai tawh hong sam cih zong dot ding mangngilh kei in. Phone hong kiho ciangin zong hoih takin kiging kawmsa in dawng kik inla, thudot hong neih leh zong na zum vai tawh akipelh loh ding hoih tak ngaihsun kawmsa-in dawngkik hamtangin. Kam khat I dawn khialh na tawh supna tampi piang thei hi. A diakdiak in hong sapna Department I theih kei leh zum I pai ciangin nawn kai na tampi om zelzel hi. Zam Khat Kham ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW A Lian A Kang Tokhom Thukhenna Rev. Zam Khat Kham posted on 25 March 2015 at 10:47 am Lomkholna: Article , Biakna , Zamkhatkham A Lian A Kang Tokhom Thukhenna (The Great White Throne Judgment) Rev. Zam Khat Kham A. Thukhenna Nunungpen: A Lian A Kang Tokhom Kum tul maanna a bei ciangin mihingte tangthu ah a tawpnapen dingin a lian a kang tokhom thukhenna thu Laisiangtho sungah kigen hi (Kilaakna 20:11-15). A beisa huna midikte thu a kikhennate, leitunga nungtalai Israel mite leh Gentile-te thu a kikhenna tuamtuamte tawh kibang lo-in, hih thukhenna pen a tawpna thukhenna ahi hi; a kigenna i et ciangin mi gilote bek thu a kikhenna ahihna kimu thei hi. B. Vantung leh Leitung A Kisuksiatna A lian a kang tokhom thukhenna a kipat ma-in, Kilaakna 20:11 ah, leitung leh vantung taikeekmang hi; amaute om nading mun kimu lo hi ci-in kigen hi. Leitung tangthu a kikhin ding hi ta a, Kilaakna 21:1 sungah, leitung masa beimang hi; tuipi om nawn lo hi a cih mahbangin piansakna masa kisusia hi. II Peter 3:10-12 in Vantungte aw ngaihpi tawh beimang dinga, a sunga nate mei tuisuaksak dinga, leitung leh a sunga na khempeuh kangtum ding hi ci-a a genna pen ahi hi. Tang 11 ah, hih nate khempeuh tuimang ding hi ci lai-a tang 12 ah, vantungte mei-in kangtum dinga, a sunga om nate sa lua mahmah-in a tuimang ding hi ci-in na gen hi. Tu laitaka vantung leh leitungte a kisusia khin ahih manin awngthawlpi sunga ah a lian a kang tokhom thukhenna om ding hi. C. A Sisa Mi Gilote Thawhkikna Kilaakna 20:12 ah, John in, a sisate, a neu a lian-in Pasian mai-a ding mu hi. Kilaakna 20:13 ah, Tuipi in ama sunga om misite hong puak hi; sihna leh hell in zong amau sunga om misite hong puak uh hi ci-in gen beh lai hi. A sisa migilote kithokiksaka thukhenna thuak dingin Pasian mai ah kidingsak hi. Thukhennpa pen Topa Zeisu ahihna John 5:27 ah Pa in thukhen naidng thuneihna zong pia hi, bang hang hang hiam cih leh amah mihing Tapa ahi hi a cihna ah kilang hi. D. Mihingte Nasepna Laibute Kilem Kilaakna 20:12 in, Laibute kilem hi: nuntakna laibu ahi laibu dang khat zong kilem hi: laibute sunga kigelh bangin misite amau gamtatna bangin thu kikhen hi ci-in hong gen hi. Mi khempeuh amau gamtatna bangin thu kikhen hi ci lai hi (v. 13). Hehpihna a thusim lote thu a kikhenna ngaat mahmah hi. Khazih lo-in mawhna maisakna om lo-a (Sawltak. 4:12), ama hehpihna a nial mite thu a kikhen loh phamawh hi. A gamtatnate uh a ki-etkik bek hi lo-in, Nuntakna Laibu sungah a minte uh ki-en hi. Mi pawlkhatte upna bangin Nuntakna Laibu pen nuntak tawntungna a ngah mite min kiciaptehna ahi a mi nungta khempeuhte min lak panin hotkhiatna ngah lo mite min a kiphiatkhiatna ahi zongin thukhenna bel a kibang hi lel hi. A min uh a kimuh kei leh, nuntak tawntungna a ngah lo uh hi pah hi. a thuak dinguh kitangko a, Kilaakna 20:14-15 ah, Tua ciangin sihna leh hell meiliipi sungah kikhiasuk hi. Hih pen nihna sihna ahi hi. nuntakna laibu sunga a min kigelh lo khempeuh meiliipi sungah kikhia hi ci-in kiciamteh hi. Hih lai-a thu kikhen mite pawlkhat a dangte sangin a hoihzawk hangin, nuntak tawntungna a neih lohna un amaute thukhen ta hi. Nuntak tawntungna a nei lo mi khempeuh amau nasepna leh Khazih a nialna uh tungah thu kikhena meiliipi sungah kikhia hi. A dahhuai thu taktak bel, amaute ading leh hotkhiatna a ngah mite adingin Khazih a sih veve na thu ahi hi. II Corinthians 5:19 ah, Pasian in Khazih sungah leitung amah tawh kilemsaka, amaute mawhna bangin a mawhpaih kei hi ci-in kigelh hi. I John 2:2 ah Khazih pen eite mawhna kithoihdamna hi: eite ading bek hi lo-in leitung buppi mawhna ading ahi hi ci-in kigelh lai hi. Meiliipi sunga kikhia hih mite Khazih lamah kiheii uh hi leh hotkhiatna a ngah thei lua mahmah dinguh ahi hi. Amaute Pasian in a it loh man leh Pasian hehpihna in a hot zawh loh mana tua mun a tunguh hi lo uh a, a up loh man uh ahi hi. Lungdamna thu a za kha lo mite in leitung nate tungtawna Pasian teci pannna a nialna uh hangin thukhenna thuak uh hi (Rom. 1:18-20). Amau zong a neih uh khuavak nial uh ahih manin thutang takin thu kikhen hi. A lian a kang tokhom thukhenna pen Khazih a Honpa uh leh a Topa ua a sang nuam lo mite thu a khenna hi a, khasiathuai mahmah hi. Dotna 1. A lian a kang thokhom thukhenna leh tua ma-a thukhennate a kilamdanna bang ahi hiam? 2. A lian a kang thokhom thukhenna koi-a om ding hi a, tua ma-a thukhennate tawh bangci bangin kilamdang ahi hiam? 3. Tu laitaka leitung a kisauksiat nading thu gen in. 4. A sisa migilote a thawhkik nading thu Laisiangtho in bangci gen ahi hiam? 5. A sisa migilote bang thu bulphuh-in thu kikhen ding ahi hiam? 6. Bang hangin a sisa migilote thu a kikhenna khasiathuai deuh ahi hiam? 7. A mangthang mite in a tawpna ah bang tuak dinguh cih thu i theihna in bangci bangin Khazih ading kha mangthang mat nopna lungsim hong neisak ahi hiam? Rev. Suangkua holimna vai malep Pa Awn Khen Khup (Pu Thual Zen tapa) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Suangkua holimna vai malep Pa Awn Khen Khup (Pu Thual Zen tapa) posted on 14 July 2016 at 7:50 am Lomkholna: Article , Politics Akhat veina Date: 1511963 Amun: Lamzang Khua 1963 kum March kha in UNuh leh Niwin in Panlong kiciamna a palsat nopman un hong ki gulluk uha, Niwin in thu neihna hong lenin asawt loin sum bukteng hong tenghpah hi. Tua hangin Zogam bup genloh kawlgam bup nangawn in azuih uh i theihsa ahi, hi. Zogam bup a sumbuk neiteng, Nainganzi(politic)party teng, mipil misiamteng, gam leh lei itteng leh galkap lam a ulian te leh amah aki hel zawhloh hang thu dotpi khat ahi, Kyawzaw, tuateng thu hang in ku-sale(sawltak) tengin a khat veina thu kikup(meeting) Lamzang khua-a Japan galma a taih-inn(building) leh a huangsung kulhtawh kium Zogam galkap asem Mungzua a thongkia Pa Neng Lam Za Thang te inn ah 1511963 in thu ki kupna nei uh hi. Anih veina Date: 1231964 Amun: Lamzang Hausa Pa Neng Khua Zam Inn 1962 Ana tengh khit leh a khatvei na meeting ki kal sungin ki kupna atuamtuam om na pi-in ken hong holim pih theilo ka hih manin kadah mahmah hi. Athei ten ong holim pih theiding in ka lamen hi. Na khatpeuh ah ahoih leh ahoih lo aom mah bangin temta lang nih hiam pawlkhat naom kha in a kikup na uh thu teng aneng atawng in Niwin kiang nawhtun mahmah hi. Niwin in ei Zomi te thu akan ding leh akho dingin VANKULH hongsawl in Chin USii Putpau tawh Tedim ah hong paikhawm uh hi. Putpau Leilum ah tam in Vankulh pen galkap leh palik te tawh lamzang a Pa Neng Khua Zam inn ah, ni 12031964 in ki kupna leh ki hona nanei uh hi. Hih hunciang Pu Thual Zen gal kici nailo hi. Athum veina Date: 17071964 Amun: Suangkua Ki hona anih veina leh athum veina kikal sung kha thum kha li bekh sawt hina pi in amau sungah thu lamdang tampi piang man hi. I gensa mah bangi Zogam khantohding adeih lo leh Niwin bangkua(thalloh) te cimai ni e, Zomi sung ah zong Niwin thalloh naom kha zanzan aitam maw, hihte hangin Niwin in Zogam bup mipi sangin Zogam khantoh nading a nuntakna apia ngamte thupen telthieh zaw tham ahih manin a thalloh pa, ahai tawipa, a tanu pipa Vankulh hong sawlto leuleu hi. Vankulh in zong Chin USii Moo asem Son Khua Lian leh Putpau zawn in Tedim ah hong pai khawm uh hi. Panlong thu kimna bulphuh a Zogam hoih nading ahih nak leh anuntak na apia ngam pawl leh Vankulh, Putpau leh Son Khua Lian ten a nuntak na uh lauhuai sa uha, a langkhat in Lamzang hi leh ci, a langkhat in Tedim hi leh cituak uha, tua cibang kawm kal ah anih tuak un abit nading uh Suangkua hoihsa tek uha, tua mun na zangpah uh hi. Son Khua Lian leh Putpau ten zong thu genna nei uh hi. Vankulh thugen tawm malep pak ni. THUAL ZEN aw nang na khawl leh Miauh-uk(Vuan dok) za-in hong ki pansak ning ci hi. Tua ni pen 1771964 Suangkua ki hona ni, ki lemna ni ci-in a ciamteh uh, hina pi tua khitteh Khalkha leh Rih Sakhan (camp)te hong buai hi. Zogam ah Kha khanlawhna hong tun mah bangin Suangkua zong Sa khan lawhna tawh kibang kasa hi. A hangin Zogam khantoh nading in anun takna apiak nading un ki ciamna nasia tak in nabawl masa phot uh hi. Ngeina lui a aom lai ta dingin tuisia, aibuk(suangpet) in Christian sunga omte ading in Lai siangtho nam in Pasian thu tawh na kiciam uh hi. Zogam ading a anun takna apia ngamte ading Pasian thu tawh a makaih dingin Pasian sathau nilhte asap uh ciangin Suangphei khua a Sia Zam Khua Lian bekh mah na kipia ngam hi. Thong na ngawn tan lawh hi. Tamlua tawmlua nasa khaphial zong un hi zah tawh Suangkua thu hong malep pak hi ning. Lungdam. Zogam damta hen! ZIUSA kipawlna pawlmi mimal khat in (10) ahihkeileh atungsiah Mimal or Innkuan khat pan 100 pan atungsiah apiate Innpi kawmtungah aminte uh leh sumpiakzah cihte kisuansak ding hi. Zomi Innpi (Zomi Center) neihzawh nading sumkaihkhop hunding pen azekaaipen March, 2018 khabeima in kikaikhawm ding hi. hihsum kaihkhopna ah sum ong kipia zahzah sumngahna Receipt zong kipiadinga asawtlo in amunmun a om Zomi Innkuan makaite ngahdingin ong kikhak tading hi. Hih sum kaihkhopna tawh kisai ZIUSA Treasurer Pu Pau Lian Tuang in a kisam bangin nungzuihna, update na cihte ongbawl toto ding hi. I lunggulhna te a taangtun zawh nadingin akua mapeuh thasaanin hanciamtek ni. lungdam! Notengtawh mapangkhawm, Pa Tual Sawm Lian Executive Director Zomi Innkuan USA, Inc. KHOI LAM THANG , TUAMTUAM , ZOMI No comments Rev Khoi Lam Thang pen Tedimgam, Keizang khua hi in Falam ZTC ah DipTh, India Makokchung pan BTh, Yangon MIT pan M.Div a zawh khitteh BA zo lai hi. Thailand gamah MA (Linguistic) va zo a, Singapore TTC ahzong MTh sinbehto laihi. Tu in Myanmar Baptist Convention ah General Secretary a seplai tak a hi hi. Email tawh hih thului ongpuak the_dalvirgin broadband.com.au tungah lungdamna lianpi ihko hi. Zomite Zo leitang tungah Khristian I suah zawh kum 100 a cing hita hi. Khristian biakna in kum 100 sungin Zomite aniam mah mah mihinzia pan hong khaisang-a, a sangpente tawh hong kikhawlsak thei hi. Zomite I zia I tong, I ngeina, I khuasakziapawlkhat kinusia, pawlkhat kibehlap-in pawl khat kikemcing hi. Tuate sungah Zokam leh Zolai pen Khristian biakna in hong kepsak hong khansuah sakin hong zunsak hi. Tua a hih manin Zomi Khristian kum 100 mualsuang ah hih thu a ngaihsut taak mah mah ahi hi. Zomi bup kampau thu tangzai mahmah ahih maninTedim kam ci-in neuseek sukin a nuai-a thulute tawh kikum leeng: 1. Tedim kam khanggui sutna 2. Tedim Kam cih min i ngahna 3. Tedim kam Taangkam a suahna 4. Tedimkam kantelna 5. Tedim kam nungta i cingam diam? 6. Mailam ah i Tedim kam 1. TEDIM KAM KHANGGUI SUTNA Leitung mihing awn 6,000 valte in kampau nam 6,908 bang nei hi ci-in kiciamteh hi. Kawlgam sungah mihing awn 50 valte in pawunam 135 bang kinei a, Zomite pau 53 om hi ci-in Kawlgam kumpi in hong ciaptehsak hi. I Zogam neuseksek sawm leeng nam 100 val om dingin ka um hi. Leitungah hizah a tam kampau tuamtuamte a guigui, a behbehin kikhen dimdiam hi. Kampau lam a siam (Linguist) David Bradley thukanna siksan leng i Tedim kam khanggui (Language family) a nuai-a bangin kisut ding hi. Sino-Tibetan Tibeto-Burman North-eastern india Group Kuki Chin Naga Kuki Chin Chin Northern Chin Tedim 2. TEDIM KAM CIH MIN I NGAHNA Min thu gen-in pan ni cileng thukhupna a om thei nailo a buaihuai mahmah thu khat ahi hi. Zomite in kum 100 sungin minam minkip neizo nai lo hi hang. Chin leh Zo peuh kisut kituh lai-in zattaang theih ding kampau nei nailo hi hang. Hi bang bilbial kawmkalah Zomi a kici phadiakte in Tedim Kam cih min i ngahna thu a nuai-a bang hidingin ka um hi. Sangmangte hun lai-in Kamhau Dialect na ci ngei uh a, Kampau a kan mi masate in Sukte ci-in zong na minvawh ngei uh hi. Tua minte in tua hun lai-a ukpite beh min ahih kei leh ukpipa min ahi hi. Ukpite thuneih lai-in a mau bangkua sung pau na thupisak mahmahin gambup zat dingin thu na pia hi leh Teizangkam kipau ngeingai kha ding hi. Gam uk makai masate thukhualna leh picinna ahi hi. Tedim Kam cih pen midangte hong sapna hi loin ei le ei i kisapna min (egonymn) ahi hi. Pu le pa min khatpeuh a kitap hilo a, a te-dimdim vansang dim omna mun a kisat Tedim khua kitap (eoconymn) min ahi hi. Tedim khua pen 1550 kumin kisat hi cih tangthu kante ciaptehna ahi hi. Ahih hangin kilalsan zel kisuan kik zek hi. 1850 a kipan-in tuni dong tatsat loin kiteng a, ei Tedim mite khuapi ahi hi. Tedim khua ah i teng ngeikei phial zongin Tedimmi cih ding a angtanpih ciat i hi hi. Tedim khua ah hunkhat lai-in Teizang, Saizang, Thado, Vaiphei, Guite, leh Zo kampaute in tual khat zangin kitengkhawm hi, Tua bang a, pau tuamtuam tenkhopna panin pautuam khat hong pianga a nungciangin Tedim kam kici hi. A neituam kuamah om lo hi. 3. TEDIM KAM TAANGKAM A SUAHNA Hun khat lai-in Tedimgam i cih pen tu-in Tedim, Tonzang leh Cikha gamkhen (Myone) suakta hi hang. Tua sunga teng Zomite leh tua gam pan Kawlgam Vaigam a tung Zomite in i taangkam leh (common language) dingin Tedim kam zangkhawm theita hi hang.A mual a lui zui-in i awkaih tawmtawm kilamdang-a, ahih hangin kamphen kulloin kihothei hi hang. Tua a zang khawm thei kampau innkuan dungah Sihzang, Thado (Kuki), Zo, Dim, Guite, Khuano, Losau, Phailengm, Saizang, Teizang, Val leh Vangteh paute kihel hi hang, Tedim pau Taangkam a suah theihna thu kampau lam pan, tangthu lam pan, gamdung leilupzia pan a tuamtuam kan leng a hang tampi om kha ding hi, I gensa bangin ukpite in a mau kam bek kizang ding na ci uh hileh Teizang pau ki pau kha ding a sangmangte in a mau siam masak mah na thupisak hileh Sihzang pau kipau kha ding hi, Sangmangte in vai lian pi khat a angaihsut uh khat in pau nam tuam tuam a nei minamte pau nam a tawm thei pena gawmsak ding ahi hi. Tuabang hun lai-in Mangkang kumpi in hong uk a, Khamtung gam ah Zo lai tawh pilna sin ding hong vai hawm uh hi. kampau kigawm theite bang kampau tawh Laisimbu gelhsak ding cih thu lianpi khat hi leuleu hi. Tua ahih manin 1919 kumin Tedim vuandok zumah Tedim gam hausa lianteng kikhawm uh a, gambupah Sihzang pau zat dingin thu kisung hi. Tua ciangin Thado kampau Hiangzang khua hausa Pu Zam Khaw Thang, Zo kampau Phaitu khua hausa Pu Khan Thawng, Saizang khua hausa Pu Zaang Khaw Lian, Paihte kampau Tuimui khua hausa Pu Mang Za Thang, Haiciin khua hausa Pu Tual Pum-te in Sihzangkam a teltheih loh lam uh pulak hi. Ahi zongin Tedim, Ngennung, Haupi, Gawngmual, Leilum, Lezang, Tongsial, Lamzang,Laitui, Mawngken, Kahgen, Taklam, Tonzang, Tungtuang, Anlang, Gamlai, Khuaimual leh Seitual khua hausa te kuamah a pau a ham omlo uh hi. Hih bangin Tedim gam sungah Tedim kam pen taangkam hong suak hi. Cope topa in 1919 pan 1938 (a sih) dong khasim thukizaksakna lai a na bawl lai-in Tedim kam thukizakna lai na ci hi. Sang laisimbu hong bawl sak hi. A nung ciangin TTedim pau eima pau ci-in khangthak naupangte i awng ziahziah hi. 4. TEDIM KAMPAU KANTELNA Kawl leh Vai kikal-a om Zomite in kampau tuamtuam i nei hi. Kampau lam a kantel mipilte in tangzai takin hong kansak nai lo uh hi. Ei Tedim kampau zawdiak pen Mizo pau, Hakha paute zahin hong kikansak nailo hi. Tedim kam a pau mite sung pan Laipianpa Pau Cin Hau, Rev. Hau Go, Pu Gin Za Twang, Siapi Vul Za Thang, Sia Pau Cin Thang, Rev. Paul Thuam Thang leh ZCLS a kipan kampau a kin, a siam tampite in kanin na gelh ngei khin hi. Minamdang kampau siamte sung pan hong kantelsak mi tamnai lo hi. Kei theihphak tan ah: 1904: George A. Grierson: Linguist Survey of India 1925: L.B.naylor: A practical handbook of Chin Languages (Siyin dialect) 1965: Eugene J.A. Henderson: Tiddim Chin: A descriptive analysis of Two texts 1965: Ono Toro: The Reconstruction of Proto Kuki Chin: Initial Consonants 1979: David B. Solnit: Proto Tibeto Burma in Tiddim and Lushai 1989: Peri Bhaskararao: The process of Chimming in Tiddim Chin 1996: Peri Bhaskararao: Computerized lexical database of Tiddim Chin and Lushai 1998: Weera Ostapirat: Tiddim Chin tones in historical perspective. I Tedim pau pen a kampau ei Tedim mite leh a pua lam pan kampau siamte in kan khawm-in, laigelh-in i puahpuah i zunzun ding kisam hi. I tuntunna pan i kampau maizumpih lo-in hong dong a om leh lungsau takin genpih ding kisam hi. Sia Lian Bawi (Siapi Lian Khan Mang) in Japan pan gam a pai lai-in Ono Toro kiangah na genpih ngei a, Dr. Dal Lian in Bhaskararao kiangah na genpih ngei hi. 5. I TEDIM KAM NUNGTA I CI NGAM DIAM? Kampau dinmun (vitality) a tuamtuam om hi. Kawlgam ah Pyu minam leh Pyu pau beimang ta hi kici hi. Leitung kampau pawlkhat beibei-a pawl khat kipan khangto semsem hi. I Tedim kam nungta hi ci-ngam taktak ding hiam? Kampau nungta ih cih te a ki puahpuah a ki zunzun hi a, a kampau neite in it mah mah uh hi. A kampau uh khum sa-ngaungau uh hi. Tu laitak Tedim mite 70 bang bekin Tedim kampau dingin ka um bek hi. Kawlgam leh Vaigamate in pau tuamtuam peuh nuam i sa zaw a, Kawl lak a Zo khangno te bangin kawlkam kawllai leh kawl TV khawng bek tawh hun kibei hi. I thungaihsutna nangawn kawl-khuak tawh kingaih sun hi. Kampau i pau sunsun bangkua sung bek hi a, sangkil kitantan lo hi, Biakinn sung bek hi a, biakinn huangpua kantan lo hi. Hibang kampau dinmunte Muribung kici hi. I kampau it-in, i kep tinten kei leh beikuan manawh kampau ahi hi. I Tedim kampau zong meidawimahmah hi ci-in ka ciamteh hi. Mizo, Hakha leh Falam pau khawng ei pau sangin suahngal zaw hi. Kampau ameidawite a suahngalzaw kampaute in damdamin sung khumkhum dinga, a sawt lo-in valh ding hi. I kampau maizumpih kei ni. Zolia tawh kisai-in, Laipianpa Pau Cin Hau tungtawnin Zotuallai nam nih i nei ngei hi. Tu in i zatna toi semsem a, minam vangil khat banga kep ding din mun hi ta hi. Lai hihna (malgawm) tawh Mualtung thuhilhna zong na khen ngei uh hi. Sangmangte tung pan i ngah Mangtuallai (Roman alphabet) tawh laisimbu i neih zawh kum 91 cingta hi. Lai ih gelh ciangin lai-malgawmzia leh awsang awniam thu-ah i kumkum lai hi. Cope topahun a kibawl Zolai tan 4 ciang nangawn tu-in i nei nawn kei hi. Zolai tawh laibu kibawl tawm mahmah a, i neih sunsun zong Biakna lai bek ahi hi. Laibu i bawl ciangin Pawlpi sung a zat ding cih lai suang sawnsawn lai ihih manin i laibu a thatthat ihi hi. I leitung huihnunzia ahih manin tua lampi bek a nei ihi hi. Zolai i cih pen Lai Siangtho sim nading, Labu ettheih nading, Pawlpite thukizaksakna lai sim nading leh laikhak nading bekin kizang lawmlawm hi. Leitungthu vangtungthu theihhuai a tuamtuamte Zomite in a theih nadingin Zolai a kizat hun hong tung takpi tam! cih ngaih sutsut huai ka sa hi. Kampau nungta te in huihkhua in huihkhua tungtawnin Radio, TV leh tulai Cassettee, CD leh VCD te tawh theihhuai thute khahkhia ziahziah uh hi, Ut hunhunin mun khempeuh pan a kampau uh kingai thei hi. Cik hun ciang i tunna peuhpeuh pan i Tedim kam i ngaih theih hun hong tung zen tam! 6. MAILAM I TEDIM KAM Nam citawmte ihih hangin i kampau mangthang ngei nawn lo ding hi. Ahi zongin a khanton henhan ding lamet om lo hi. Kumpi ki-ukzia kikhello-in, tulai khuahun mah tawh maban i zopzop lai leh kawlkam in gam hong kekek dinga Tedim kam in sangkil kan zo nawnlo semsem ding hi, I theihloh kalin thozo nawnlo in, i phawk khak ciangin zekai lua ding hi. Khuahun hong kihei-in Kawlgam Vaigam-a om Zomite in gam lenam a ding vaihawmkhop hun hong tun leh lah Mizo kam hong innteek mahmah dinga, khangnote in sin-in mun khenpeuhah kipau ding hi. I Tedim pau bel khanglo kiamlo, si lah nungta-in omthei ding hi. Tua kawmkalah ei Tedim kampau innkuansung pan i kinensuah sawnsawn leh i huang hong toi semsem dinga i theihloh kal-in mite huangsung i tung ding hi. Hi thei hileh Kawlgam Vaigam-a om Zomi a kici khempeuh in Mangkam i taangkam dingin zangkhawm mai le hang, kum 30 sung bang i buaipih phial zongin manlang takin hong khantohpih thei pen dingin ka um hi. Taangkam dingin Mangkam i zatkhit ciang i nampau ciat i keptheih bangin i kem ding am kuamah kinawknawk se lo-in khat le khat kithupisimna tawh i kalsuan leh i minam khangto thei pan ding hi. Minam a khantoh leh i kampau mangthang ngeilo ding hi. Email This BlogThis! Sign in Welcome! to your account Forgot your password? Get help Password recovery Recover your password A password will be e-mailed to you. Articles Knowledge Lai Nasepna PETER A KAWK NUMEI NO. Agelh Rev. Dr. John Thang Hum Dim Lun Zam By: LAIBUSAAL Date: November 19, 2020 PETER A KAWK NUMEI NO Matt 26:68-75; Lk 22:55-62; Johan 18:16-18; 25-27 Agelh Rev. Dr. John Thang Hum Dim Lun Zam Hih Peter a kawk numei nonu min leh a innkuan pian zia a cingtak in I thei kei hi. Ahi zongin, hih numeino zong Jepthah tanu bang a, khantawn a siampi te nasem ding a kipia te khat hithei ding hi (Hih mun te sim in-Gam 27:8; Thuhilhkikna 25:5-10) sungah ki mu hi. Ih nuntakna ah ih ngaihsut khak ngeiloh mi pawlkhat in hong lunglut in i omdan I tat, i heek dan khempeuh hong en cik gige na om thei hi. Ih theih loh kaal in hong pakta aom mah bangin dik hong sa khollo zong na om thei gige hi. Hih Peter a kawk numeino in zong amah kuamahn a phawkkhak loh ding hang, amahn mite na en cikcik in, kua te bangci cih na thei mahmah a, Peter zong na ciamteh thei mahmah hi. Khris a kimat ni zan in, Peter leh Johan in siampite nasepna phual dong vazui hi. Tualai ah Peter pen miten na thei hi. Nungzuite pen Galilee gam pan a tamzaw kila hi a, a omzia amel uh zong milak ah tuampian hi kha thei ding hi. Peter a kawk te khat in zong, napau na awsuah mahmah, Galilee awsuah hi, na ci thei hi. Peter in ahihleh utlo in na nanial phangphang lai hi. Hih bang kikawk nate ci leh sa tawh deih huailo ahih hangin, kha lam ah a sang siam ta ding phattuamna lianpi piang thei hi. Peter omzia Upna leh muanna lamah madawk, nungzui pite lakah makaipi za angah Peter, lungsim manlang, kampau manlangin na khatpeuh sep ding khensat semsem thei hi. Topa Jesu in, Kei, miten kua hong ci hiam? Acih ciangin in, nungzui te in kamsangte khat in hong ngaihsun uh hi, ci in dawng a, No-e leh kua nong ci uh a, acih ciangin, Peter mahmah in, Anungta Pasian Tapa Khris hi teh, ci-in na dawng hi. Tua pulakna ci leh sa pan hilo a, Pasia n Kha Siangtho pan ahihna Topan gen hi. Hih pulakna hangin Topa lungdam in, Hih suang tungah ka pawlpi ka lam ding hi, ci-in gen hi. Hih suang acih pen Peter a genna hilo in, Peter pulak khiat, Peter in a kawk, Jesu tungah ka pawlpi ka lam ding hi, a c ihna ahi hi. Topa kammal muan ngamna, upna tawh kalsuan nalam ah kisin ngam in, lungsim manlang hi. Topa Jesu tui tungah apai lai-in Kei zong hong pai thei sak in, ci-a, anget ciangin, Jesun, pai ve acih leh kisin ngam pah a, tuitung pai thei takpi hi. Peter pen a lawpna khauh mahmah a, lawp baih in alung zong akiabaih thei nam ahi hi. Kamciamna piazeel napi nungkik pah cih bang dan ahi hi. Topa Jesu in, hi bangdan Peter lungsim puak zong na taai zel hi. Kei, galpa khut sungah ka kipia dinga, si hna ka thuak ding hi, acih ciangin, Peter mah pau masa in, Na tuaci kei dinghi, na ci hi. Topan Peter kampauna deih loh in, Satan aw, ka nungah kihem in, na ci hiau hi (Mk 8:33). Mikhempeuh in hong taisan ding uh hi, cih Topan a gen ciangin, Peter in, Midang ten hong taisan hang, ken hong taisak ngei kei ningh, na ci phangphang hi. Jesu in, Akkhuanma in thumvei nong nial ding hi, na ci leuleu hi. Topa Jesu leh nungzuiten paisanpawi an anek khit uh ciangin, Gethsemane huanah a zatngei bangun thungetna neikhawm uhhi. Tuamun ah zong ngak zolo in ihmu khin uh hi. Topan, Kei tawh nai khat beek, ngak zolo ding na hi uh hiam? Ze-etna tawh na kipelh na ding un, thu nangen un, ci-in gen hi. A sawtlo in, aman dingte hong pai a, Topa hong akimat tak c iangin, Peter in temta a selsim khinkhian dok in, siampipa nasem pa ngawng vat dinga ahihleh a ngawng bel vatkha lo in, abil na vat kha hih tuak hi. Topa in, tua pa bil bulh sakkik hi. Tua zan mahin siampi lianpen pa maiah thu kisit dingin ki paipih hi . Peter in zong gamla sim pan in Jesu nung a zuizui hi. Siampipa inntual ah, mei kicih a, tualai ah siampipa nasem te in mei awi ngeingai hi. Peter zong meiawi in a vapai leh, tualai a-om, siampipa nasem numeino khatin amel natel liana, nang Jesu tawh kip awl hilo na hiam? ci-in vakawk phei hi. Peter in, hi peuhmah keng, ken theingei keng, ci-in nial hi. Tualaiah om midang ten zong, Nang Jesu pawl hi teh, a vacih uh leh Peter in zanuam lo in, kiciam phangphang leuleu hi. Tua bangin thumvei agen khit ci angin aak hong khuang hi. Tua ciangin Peter in Topa thugen phawk a, kap dapdap hi. Ih dinmun manlo pan i ciahkik theihna ding Pasian in lampi tuamtuam, thu tuamtuam zangh thei hi. Israel mite a nungtolhna pan aciah kik theih nading Pasian in kamsang te z angh hi. Pasian kammal mah zangh in Pasian in ih manlohna hong phawkkik sak thei hi. Midang khatpeuh zangin zong hong gen thei hi. Ganhing nangawn zangh in i mawhna hong phawk sak thei hi. Athupi pen ah, i lungtang khauhsak lo in i sansiam ding thupi hi. P aunak ah Tamveipi ki hilh khit cianga, amang nuamlo mi, thakhat thuin siatna ngah ding, ci hi (29:1) . Nungzuite lakah, Peter leh Judas Iscariot in Topa nial tuak uh a, ahi zongin Peter in kisikkikna tawh Topa zong kik ahih manin Topa in sang kik hi. Pasi an in awnem tawh hong zol hun om a, tua ih manloh ciangin a khauh tawh hong pai thei hi. Thukhupna Ih Khrisian nuntakna ah, ih lampi tang sinsen in kipai theiloh hun hong om theizel hi. Ahangpen, ei zong thungetna ki neilo, ci leh sa in hong zawh hun z ong om, kiim leh paam in hong nehthawh hun zong om hi. Tua bang hun ciangin anungtolh ih hihi. Hih bang ih nungtolh hun ciangin bangin hong kaikik ding hiam? Pasian in lampi tuamtuam zangh thei hi. Adiak in mihing, midang, thu-um (or) thu-umlote mah zangin hong sem thei hi. Hih Peter tungah numei nonu nasepna in ngaihsut ding thupi hong musak hi. Peter in anial hangin Topa itna mah in amah kaikik teitei hi (Lu 22:31). Topan eite hong nusia ngeilo hi. Ih paisan khak ciang, hong delh in hong zong kik veve hi. Satan in nang hong seepkhia nuam in hong ngen hi. Ahizong na puk loh nading thu kong ngetsak hi, ci-in gen hi (Luke 22:31) Topan lampi tuamtuam zangin i mawhna, i nungtolhna kiphawk theih nading thu hong gen ding hi. Khatveivei hong sat lai ding hi. Tua pen hong itna hang hi zaw hi. I laksiam leh ei hampha, thupha in zong hong zui dinga, ih lak theihkei leh i daupai ngeilo ding hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, a mawhna leh nungtolhna kiphawk kik napi Topa kiang aciah kiklo mi tampi om hi. Hi bang mit e lakah ih kihel loh kh akloh ding thupi hi. Peter leh Topa aleh heek, Judah a mawhna uh ki bang tuak hi. Ahi zongin Peter in Topa zuankik a, Judas in zuan kik lo hi. Pasian in hih numei nonu bangin i nuntakna ah hong kawk ding mi koih ding hi. Tua bang hun I tuak ciangin hong kawkte muhdah na ding thu omlo hi. Numeino bang zangh kei leh mi gilo khat peuh zong zangh thei ding ahih manin, hi bangdan, thatang hatna suanglo, kam tawh hong gen ciang bek te zong lungdam huai ahi hi. Mihing pen eitungah kuamah om nawnlo cih bang I ngaihsut ciangin midang te hong gen ding I ut kei hi. Hih pen alau huai ahi hi. Numeino nu bang dan ih nuntakna ah I tuah khak leh I lungdam mahmah ding ahi hi. Tua pen eimah hamphat na ding hi zaw hi. Dotna: Ze-et na tawh kipelh nading bang hih ding ci hiam? Peter a nungtolhlam thu bangzah tawh ki thei hiam Peter akawk numei nu deihna bang hiam? Na nuntakna ah hih numei nonu bangdan mi na tuak kha ngei hiam? Nang bangci na thuhkik hiam? Pasian in na dinmun manlo a kiphawk th eihna hong piak ding na lunggulh hiam? Bangci dan hi leh na lunggulh hiam? Tags Dim Lun Zam Rev. Chin Lam Thang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Pasian gam ading in: Rev. Khoi Lam Thang Rev. Chin Lam Thang posted on 3 December 2017 at 1:39 am Lomkholna: News , Zomi Pasian gam ading in: Rev. Khoi Lam Thang Rev. Chin Lam Thang Pasian mizat mahmah nih Rev Khoi Lam Thang (General Secretary, Bible Society of Myanmar) leh Rev Chin Lam Thang (Former Regional Secretary, India Evangelical Mission) tawh holim na hunnuam tak zangkha thei. Rev Khoi Lam Thang in tuciang BSM tung tawnin Kawlgam ah Paunam 200 kiim bang omlak ah 38 bangin Lai Siangtho bu neita aa, tulian Paunam 19 te ading pawlkhat puahphat na leh Lai Siangtho letkhiatna kineih laitak hi. Pasian in siapa cidam khansauna hongpiak sak semsem tahen. Rev Chin Lam Thangin Pasian thupha tawh India Evangelical Mission tawh kikop in kum 21 sung tawntung Missionary asepna, Pasian in Southeast Asia sungah Missions nasep maban semdia asap nate hong hawmsawn in tha tampi hongpia in lungkim huai mahmah hi. Siapa Pasian in cidamna hongpiak sak henla, sepzo bawlzo dingin ong kalsuan pih sak tahen. Siapite tawh ka holim nate uh thu manpha leh Pasian gam tangzai nading seppah ding sephuai om aa, sep leh gen thuahkawm nuam i hih manin nidang ciangin alai tawh zong ong gelhkhia in sepna zong ong hawmsawn tozel ding hi ingh. More: Lungtang tunga kigelh Lai Rev. Khoi Lam Thang Pasian gam tangzai nadingin i sepzia i sepna mun leh i septheih ki bangkim lo aa, i sepkhoppih zong ki bangkim lo hi. Pasian gam adingin i septheihna i sepzia leh sepna mun tek pan semkhawm in mapang khawm ciatni. Cin Khan Pum (Bo Cin) admin 4 years ago 4 years ago 0 3 mins Buanman khua Pa Siing Za Ngo leh Nu Ciang Pum te sung panin Maymyo khua ah suak hi.Mandalay pan khangkhia in Yangon ah music lam na sem hi. Ka neu lai kum 5 kaphak pan kipan Maymyo ah ka om lai pek in Guitar ka uk mahmah hi. Mandalay katun uh ciangin zong Guitar tum kawikawi ing. Mandalay khua sung a om Band minthang khempeuh ah tum ngei ingh. Ka ciapteh sunsun Shell cih Band te khempeuh ah tumngei ingh. Mandalay pan ka lawm te cih te in Yangon ah la a khum uh ciangin Emperor pan Ko Zaw Myo Htut, Ko Maung Maung Lwin te tawh kizom ingh. Tua hun pan kipan Emperor Band tawh kipawl in Series tampi tak leh Stage Show tampi tak tum ingh. Tua khit teh Band pantawpin ka uk mahmah music tawh kisai mah semsem ing. Tu laitak in Plus Three Music Band ah ka tum laitak hi.Zomi khangthak te leh momno tetung ah konggen nop pen in, Zo minam mimal tawm mahmah lak pan Pasian in hih ciangdong hong lamsang to, Pasian min nakpi takin kaphat masa hi. Ei zomi te sung pan music uk momno te kahih zawhzah in hong panpih nuam mahmah ing. Hih pen ka lungsim tawng pan a konggen hi. Bass Guitar bek zong hilo, music tawh kisai na theihnop uh, nongdot nop uh a om leh katheih zahzah konghilh nuam hi. Tu laitak in No.3537, First Floor, 53 St, Botataung Towhship, Yangon ah kazi Man Suan Hung leh ka tanu Esther Kaang Thian Neam leh anau tawh khazih sungah nuamtak in om ung cih tawh hong vaikhak nuam ing. Topa tung leh Zomi khempeuh tungah lungdam mahmah ing. Cin Khan Pum (Bo Chin) Email: Esther Kaanggmail.com Ph.095062806,0943119882. ZomiSiamsin Magazine Volume-1,2005 Kalay University pan kitom lak hi.
