Tedim khuasung lampi vai: Theilohman hi zaw khong ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Tedim khuasung lampi vai: Theilohman hi zaw khong posted on 4 June 2018 at 11:53 pm Lomkholna: News , Tedim , Zomi Tedim khuasung lampi vai: Theilohman hi zaw khong Khuasung lampi kikek golsak ding ciang a huang neite phalna ki ngen masa phot hi. A zenzen in a phal kei uh leh ki khoih saklo hi. Leitang huang lampi ding in ki kek sak leh liausum (လက) a ngah ding dan in ngaihsun uh hi. Kumpi in tua liausum ding budget hong pia zenzen lo hi. Ngaihsutna lianpi tawh khuasung khantoh nang i deih taktak leh tawm bang bel supnabaina om kha mah ding hi. Galkap thuneih hunlai bang in zawhthawhthu tawh kikalsuanlo hi. Ih minam leh i gam i khualna zong hoih mahmah hi. A hi zong tuipigal khatpan thu tel munmel neilo pipi in i mawk ciakciak pen deihsakna tawh a sem a bawlte a ding thanemna zong hi thei hi. A vei taktak i hih leh a mun vapha ngiat in a thu a la limtak kantel masaphot leng hoihzaw kha ding hi. Kum 5, 10 sungbang i om loh ciang omdan khawldan tampi ki lamdang mawk hi. Tedim khuasung lampi vai: Gen kikkik mah leng Lampi a ki-kekgolsakna munte pen lampi mah in koih lel leng hoih zaw lo ding a hiam? Eimau innmunlogam letmat khat nangawn a mawk piak ngamlo leitang manpha a sa phadiak minamte ihi hi. Tua hi aa eimau innmun leitang i piak lah hilo lamsaklam ki-kek leh lamkhang lam ten a sak neh to pah sese mawk ih hiam?Lampi a gol zahding a gol theih loh na pen tua ziak ahi hi. Eimau innmun letmat khat nangawn pia ngawmlo i hih ciang mipileitang lampi te keklek se dah hi.Pakmehteh mehgah zong lampi dung teng um in suansuan dah zaw leng. Lampi mun neu tuam sak mahmah hi. I ciin nop leh gamlak ah leitang val ciin theih na ding muntampi omlai sam hi. Ngaihsun taktak leng eimau leitang i piak sangsik lampi khawng i kekkek pen daupai huai hetlo hi.I pu te i pa te hunlai a mau a lopi innmunlo gam na deih tuanlo uh hi.Huang kek kigi khin cihte zong luang in tuak cin thucin thutang in na nei tangtang uh hi. Mipiphat tuamna ding ahih nak leh i huang pi khat pi nih ciangciang piak huai zawlo a hiam? Leitang manpha i cihsam hang tua pi khat pi nih sungah bang piang tuan sam diam?Suai a piang ding cih hi leh thu khat. Nuntak tomkal sung eimau innkuan mimal noptuam nading sang mipi tampite noptuamna-ah leitung thuphavantung thupha om zaw ding hi.Hakai pahtak lungleng a cih bang tek in i muan i suan tata hong gen hak zaw thei mawk uh hi. Tedim khuapi khantoh ding i deih takpi leh huang kekkek nawnlo in a kisap leh eimau huang nangawn pi khat pi nih i piak zawh ding thupi ding hi. More: Tedim ah Bus Station kician neihhun mahmahta Sakhi in a tat nang kuamkua khual a cih bang mailam hun ding saupi ngaihsun in inn i lam ciang lampi gei neh pah tentan lo zaw in mawtaw buk ding leh nikhat ni ciang lampi hong kikek kha leh cih ngaihsun kawm in nasem ni!!! Pu Khen Za Mung ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Interview with Col. Pu Khen Za Mung posted on 18 May 2021 at 2:52 pm Lomkholna: Article , Interview , Politics Interview with Col. Pu Khen Za Mung CW : Colonel pa na suah ni, pianna mun, nu le pate minte nong gen thei diam? Col : 1924 kum May 27 ni in Tedim gam huam Muizawl khua ah suak ing. Ka pa Thong Za Khai le kanu Lian Kho Niangte ahi uh hi. Unau 11 pha in kei pen unau pasal lakah a lianpen ka hi a, ka tungah u numei guk om in kei a sagihna ka hi hi. CW : Na neulai thu tom kim cingin hehpihna tawh nong gen diam Colonel pa.? Col : Ka neulai in ka pa pen galkap bu khat ahih manin, khua khit kua khatah kituah lal kawikawi ung. Maymyo ah zong teng ngei in, Malaysia nangawn ah teng ngei ing. Ka naulai in nuntakna bel nuamsa mahmah ing. Ka u te numei vive ahih manin tua hun lai takin laisin ding kiphal loin ko Unau sungah kei bek mah sang hong kikahsak hi. High School ciang ka kah khit ciangin Japan gal hong tun in galkkap ka tum a, pilna sinna hih ciang tawh ka khawl suak hi. CW : Colonel pa aw, na neulai Zogam thute le Tedim, Falam, Hakha le Kawlpi khua thu cihte tawh kisai tulai Khangnote in thutheihna (Knowlege) angah na dingin nong genthei diam? Col : A tung a kong gensa mah bangin ka pa galkap bu khat ahih manin mun tuamtuam ah teng kawikawi in, Zogam ah ka tannga le tanguk sung teng bek om kha suak ing. Tedim thu bel hoih takin thei ingin, Falam pen ken zong Zo khuapi cih ciang bekin thei ing. Tua hun lai in Zogam ah District (4) omin om tuate pen; Kanpetlet district, Haka district, Falam district le Tedim district te ahi hi. Paletwa pen Mangkang ten Rakhine gam sungah koih uh hi. Zogam ah Mangkang te koih Palik (police) tawm khat le Zomi kumpi nasem pawl khat bek om hi. Tua District 4 te pen Mangkang Vuandok (Assistant Superindentent) 4 in uk pah uh hi. District khempeuh pen Falam khuapi a tu Mangkang VuandokMyingyi (Deputy Commissioner) khat in uk hi. Tua hun lai in Kawlpi pen Zogam sungah lah kihel lo, Kawlgam sungah lah kihel loin om hi. Kician takin bel thei cian lian keng. CW : Colonel pa aw ,, bang kumin galkap lut a, bang hang teng tawh alut na hia cihte tawm nong gen diam? Col : Kawlgam ah Japan te hong lut ciangin Augsut 1, 1942 ni-in Chin levies ah galkap ka lut hi. A hih hangin Japan galte tawh kikap kha lo hi ing. Tua hun laitak in Mangkang te hong phuat sak hong piak min pen Chin Levies kici a, Japan te hong tung ahih man in India gam Manipur ah kihemkhia kha nei lai hi ung. CW : Zomi sungah nang sim loh Colonel dang bangzah om dinga, a mau mimal ciaptehna (Personal number) cihte nong gen theih om diam? Col : Japan hunlai pekin lut khit ta ka hih manin ka Personal number pen Mangkang te hong piak nambat hi. ABRO Commission nambat kici hi. Suahtakna ngah khit ciang nambat kilaih leuleu hi. Ka nambat pen B.C 5007 hi. Tedimte bekbek atuam in galkap kiphuan in Chin Levies kici hi. Falam, Haka district te ah zong Mangkang ten tua bang mahin phuat sak hi. CW : Galpi khatna (First World War ) lai in Zomi tulthum val Europe ah kipaisak cih kiza ngei ahih manin, galpi khatna thu na theih zahzah nong genthei diam? Col : Galpi khatna lai in suak nai lo ka hih manin, tampi thei tuan keng. Ka theih sunsun hong gen leng ai ve maw. Ka pa Mangkang te sawlna tawh Tedim khua kimah mi tulkhat gal sungah van pua dingin kaikhawmsak in hi. Tuate pen mikang pau in Labour Corps zong ki ci hi. Ka pa pen Labour Corps makai hipah a, Mangpau kam phen zong semin,ama makaihna tawh Pyintit (France) ah pai uh hi. Falam le Haka pan mi tul khat ta mah pai maw lo cih kician tak in thei kha keng. Mangkang ten bel mi tulkhat ta van pua dingin sam uh cih bel thei ing. Ka pan koi ci bangin mangpau thei hiam cih theih pih keng. Pyintit paite lakah upmawh loh pi a thau in akhakte le kamsiana tawh nattun vei in asite lo buang a vekpi in Mangkang ten ciah kik sakin, a khua atui ciat mahah tung kik uh hi. CW : Zomi leh Pinlong Treaty tawh kisai khang thakte a dingin na thei zah , na ciap teh zah thuman deih na in hong gen ve Col : Pinlong Conference bel kah keng. A masa Pinlong Conference pen1946 khawng hi in,Conference kah ding a pai Pa Pum Za Mang te group tawh Mandalay ah kituak kha ing. A nihna Pinlong Conference ah bel Pu Pum Za Mang hi nawn loin Ukpi Pu Thawng Za Khup te group tawh lampi ah kituak kha lai ing. Kei pen Battalion sungah ka om tam zaw hi. Pinlong Conference pen ei Zomi te ading in hoih mahmah hi. General Aung San in Kawlte tawh avot alum thuak khawm dingin Zomi te hong sap ai ve. Union i cih pen gam neu ( State tuamtuam te akigawmkhawm gam lian khat cihna ahi hi. Zogam ,Shan gam , Kawlgam, Kachin gamte kigawm khawm Union cihna ai ve. A Ngimna bel nak hoih lua. CW : 1948 Falam Peoples Conference ah na kah kha hia? Democracy le Chin National Day hong piankhiatna dingin a thupi mahmah Falam Conference tawh kisai bangci muhna hia? Col : Falam Conference kibawl lai takin Maymyo ah om ing. A hih hang tua hun lai tadinsa le Chin Division Document te pan Falam Conference ah Peoples delegate tulnga bang kah cih thei ing. Main Land Government pan hong pai Kawl delegate ka thei zah ci leng President Sat Shwe Taih nangawn Falam hong pai cih thei ing. Tua teh Paletwa pan zong delegate te zong hong pai hi. A maute Rakhine te hi lo uh hi. Eite tawh minam kibang sikhat sakhat, u le nau sang gamte mah hi hang ci-in Falam khawmpi ah hong gen uh hi cih thei kha ing. Falam Conference lai in Ka pa nau ka pano Captain Mang Tung Nung le Takhin Vuam Tu Maung ten makai uh hi. Tua Falam khawmpi pen mipite deihna mantak a lakkhia zo Chin Conference hi ci-in mu ing. CW : Tua hun lai in Sawbua pawl khatin Falam Conference thu kim pih lo in za ing. Chin Affairs Minister U Za He Lian i nau in Falam Conference pen mite gen bang in delegate tulnga a kahna Conference hi lo hi, delegate zanga khawng bek a kahna Conference hi ci-in gen kici ahih manin tua thu pen koici dan ahia? Col : Delegate tulnga cih pen kei gen hi loin, kei zong Falam ah om kha lo hi ing. Ahih hangin tadinsa te, Chin Division document te , a va kah ngiat delegate ka lawmte tung pan kamdawn in ka zaksawn kik hi. Tulnga le zanga bel kikhai sa lua liang ing. Tulthum tulli bang kah ci leh kikhai khollo hi. Tua hun lai in Sawbua te ,Uk pi ten Falam Conference man khit teh sum tul tampi ,Then tampi cih bangin amau tawh kituak in Liau na ngah uh hi. A mau Sawbua sem suak ding ci leh zong sum tua zah mu zo lo ding uh hi. Zomite zong a siah piak uh zang pah ai ve. Kei zong ka pu ka pate Ukpi nam ahi hi. Tedim gam a minam liante mah cih ding hi. A hih hang ken Falam Conference thukimpih mahmah ing. Tua pen Democracy diktak tak ai ve. CW : Zogam ah tua hun lai a tualgal kici Chin Armed Forces a makaite min nong gen thei diam? Tua laitak in nang koi lai Armed Forces ah bangza (Rank) tawh panmun nasem na hia? Col : Chin Armed Forces 1, pen Falam le Haka mite kigawm khawm uh hi. Commander pen Lieutenant Colonel Haran Tiyo le Deputy Commander pen Major PhuKong a kici Kawl-Zo (Haka) hi. Chin Armed Forces 2,pen Tedim mite tawh kiphuah hi. Commander pen Colonel Dal Za Kam hi in deputy commander pen Major Tual Khup hi. Chin Armed Forces 3, pen Zomi vekpi kigawm hi. Commander bel ciamteh nawn keng. Tua banah Chin Commander le makai lamte kilaih pahpah hi. Haran Tiyo bekin semto suak hi. Chin Armed Forces (4) pen Chin Armed Forces (3) mah bangin Zomi vive kigawm khawm hi. A hih hang (3) le (4) ah a tamzaw Tedim mite vive ahi hi. (4) sungah Tedim pan Sihzang le Falam pan Hualngo minam te ahi hi. Chin Battalion (2) galkap zumah thuvanpi sem ding hong suak ahih manin galkap zumah duty sem hi. A za bel Major hi. CW : Tual gal sungah Chin Battalion te hih zawhna bang ciang dong cihte nong gen thei diam? Col : Tual gal sung ahChin Battalion (1) le (2) in apha deuh in galdo uh hi. A dang Battalion 3 le 4 ten zong amau tunna khua ciatpan rebel te do uh hi. Chin Battalion te bek tham loin Kachin Battalion nih leh Burma infantry khatte in zong Insein battle ah gal do uh hi. Kayin revolutionist te tawh battle ah Chin Battalion 1 le 2 te pen officer le adang galkap a si le a liam Zomi zathum val pha hi. Tua hun lai-in Sergeant Taih Chuan in Aung San Suriya buah ngah hi. A dang khatin siha sura buah ngah hi. Officer le adang gal kap tuam tuam ten Tuyegaung matdanwin tazeih ngah uh hi. Chin Battalion Commander Haran Tiyo tual gal sungah si hi. Tuate en leng Insein Battle bang zahtak a nasia cih kimuthei hi. CW : Tua bang a minam kim ciatin rebellion a hih lai takin bang hangin Zomi te Kawlte lamah pang mawk ahi hiam? Col : Kawl te lamah a kipang hi loin Union tungah Ciampel lo i hih man ahi hi. Kayin ten ko Yangon la ta ding note ko lamah hong pang un hong cih hangin kithudon loin Union Government lamah akipang tinten ahi hi. CW : Tual gal sungah Colonel Haran Tiyo i role hong gen ve. U Nuh tawh relation vai zong ee. Tua banah Colonel Haran Tiyo na phawk na thu a om le hong gensawn kik dih aw za nuam lua hang. Col : Colonel Haran Tiyo pen kei tawh kimeltheih mah mah ing. Kei sang post khatin lian zawin amah pen Lieutenant Colonel hi. Ka Battalion uh a kibatloh hangin a kilawmta mahmah le ka lawmit mahmah khat ahi hi. A mah pen makai picing mahmah hi. Relation zong hoih mahmah in galhang mahmah hi. A mah zah a galhang ding tuni ciang dong mu nai keng. U Nu in a tanu tawh kitengsak ding cih thu kigenngei khat pen amah thukim in um lo hing. A mah pen pasal picing mahmah khat hi. Pawl kaiht siam, tukpeng siam, a ma khut nuai mite tungah thudik, a ma sih khit akipan in Chin Battalion sungah kilemlohna hong om pah hi. Kei galkap zumah thuzekpi sem lai tak Major pan Lieutenant Colonel ah hong khang sakin Chin Battalion (1) ah Haran Tiyo zaluah dingin Military Headquarters in order hong pia hi. Battion 1 a military officer Major a ngah zawh asawt nai lo Van Kulh le Lieutenant Colonel Son Kho Pau le adang Haka galkap bu te ki pawl in HQs ah pai uh, kei zong tua laitak Colonel Kyaw Yaw tawh kimu dingin HQs ah tungin Van Kulh te group Colonel Kyaw Yaw zum sungah a lut cianin kei zong zui in lut ing. Colonel Kyaw Yaw mai ah kei pen Battalion 1 commander ding kilawm kei-in, kei ka zi Kayin Christian te hi ci-in Brigadier General Kyaw Yaw mai ah Van Kulh group ten kankuat uh hi. Chin Battalion 1 pen Haka le Falam mite tawh a kiphuan a hih hangin upmawh zahin kilem lo uh hi. Pu Haran Tiyo hun lai-in a lungkimlohnate uh a gen loh hangin amah asih khit teh kilemlohna nakpi takin hong kithei khia hi. Falam le Haka na ngawn a ki lem lo uh teh Tedim mi ahi kei pen Battalion commander ding in hong deih lo zaw kan kan lai uh hi. Kei tua lai tak in Major bek hi pan ing. Van Kul sang senior zaw ka hih bek tham loin post khatin lian zaw ing. Tua ciang in Van Kul pen a dang Battalion ah puak hi. Kei zong Battalion 1, commander dingin hong koih nawn lo hi. A gamla a tung Pho Kung pen Battalion 1 commander ding in koih in nawng kai na te veng sak hi. A hih hang kei Battalion 2 commander bel sem ing. Kawlte ngaihsutna man lo ai ve. Zomite vive ahih ciang akilem ding sa uh hi ven. CW : Zomite kikal ah atawntung a kilemlohna thu nang koi ci muh na hia? Col : A hoih bawl le ahoih aphi ki ngah ding in um ing. I gam zong en kikkik leng nidang ahoih ahoih lo bawl cih tun akimuthei ve le. tua ahih ciangin lungsim hong sak un . A hoih semsin ve. Tua hi leh a senpi ding ai ve. CW : Socialist hun sung Chin State Chairman len in Chin State na ma kaih na Chin State a ding na hih sak a om leh hong gen ve. Col : 1974 Pyitu Hluttaw representative State councilor ka suah ma 1972 pan 1974 dong Chin Division Security and Administration Chairman sem ngei ing. Pilna lamah a masa lam Parliament hun lai tawh et kak leng khantohna ding bawl sak ing. U Nay Win pen mi tampi ten hoih lo hi ci-in a gen hangin, ei Zomite tungah mihoih khat hi. Zogam ah lampi kizopna ding (transportation) hih theih zahin hong sepsak hi. A hih hang mi tampitawh nakisem khawm hi in ei State neuno khat ading nasepna baih lo hi. CW : Zomite phawksakna (warn), hanthotna, sepsak nopnate na nei hiam? Col : I pu i pa ten Zogam mualtung gam atelna uh pen tua mun adeih man uh hi lo hi. Minam golte gal lau in akihephep kawm in Zogam mualtung gam atung uh ahi hi. A mau telna gam hoih lo hi. Kalay-Kabaw Valley ciangah kiptak in na om uh leh nak hoih mahmah kha dingin um ing. Kawl gam sung a State le Division sungah minam sit sit bek atenna Chin State bek om lai hi. Zomi bekbek adim alet a omna Chin State ah kipumkhatna om lo ding cih pen kilawm het lo hi. A dang State te ah minam dangte tawh kigawmin kitengkhawm in kipumkhat lo hi le zong kilawm zaw lai ding hi. Chin State a om Zomi te khat le khat ki it ding , kipumkhat ding nakpi takin kisam pha mahmah hi. Ko Tedim lam pawl khatin Zomi cih pen adang i sanggam (Chin brother) te a dingin en leng hoih het lo hi. Ko ka neu lai un Zomi cih thu popular het lo hi. Ko leh ko eimi (Our people)kici hi ung. No lamah zong Falam ten Laimi na cici ve vua. Tua pen ko Tedimte ading in hoih lo hi. Bang bang hi ta leh kipumkhat sawm un. Chin people te a dim a let atenna ah Chin State i kipumkhat kei leh etlawm het lo ding hi. Good Friday Eve Thupuak (Unau Lii-te Taangthu) Pu Zokhai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Good Friday Eve Thupuak (Unau Lii-te Taangthu) Pu Zokhai posted on 25 March 2016 at 10:20 pm Lomkholna: Article , Zokhai Good Friday Eve Thupuak (Unau Lii-te Taangthu) Pu Zokhai Unau Lii-te Taangthu: Leitung mihing khempeuh ading-in neihding-a akisam athupipenpen unau lii om-a, a-upen Pilna, anihna Kivakna, athumna Siamna leh nautumpen Thutheihna ahihi. Pilna (Wisdom): Vaantung leh leitung akipiansak ciil-a kipan-in Pasian-in Pilna-tawh piangsak (Paunaak 8: 22-31)-a, TOPA mahmah kihtaakna-in Pilna kipatna (Paunaak 9:10., Late 111:10) ahihi. Pilna-pen lungsimkha (psyche or soul) lamsang hi-a, vaangliatna leh thahaatna tumdang mahmah anei Pasian kiang pan-in leh tuabang vaangliatna leh thahaatna namte-mah anei Dawimaangpa kiang pan-in hongpai theibek ahihi. Pasian kiang pan-a hongpai pilna-pen itna (love), thumaanthutak (truth) leh sahkhua thutanna (social justice)-tawh kizuui thukhualna, thumuhna leh thumuhkholhna cihte-tawh nungta-in kalsuan den-hi. Alangkhat-ah, thukhual-tawh akisuun zialehtong, thumuhna leh thumuhkholhna tengmah nei-in nuntaak kalsuanna-ah duhhopna (greed), sahkhua thutanlohna (social injustice), angsungtheihna (selfishness), hazaatna (envy)-a kipan leitung mihingte siatna bulpi khempeuh piltak leh ciimsan tak-a azanghte pilna-pen Dawimaangpa (Satan) pan-a hongpai pilna ahihi. Hih pilna namte-pen Pasian pilna-tawh theihkhialh khop ding-in ki-itsak, thukhual kineih cihte-ah dangnaal mahmah-in kizen mahmah zawsop-a, mite maaivilding a-uut mahbang-in mite maaivil dingzong maaizum vetlo-in, awzol zatsiam mahmah zawsop thei-hi. Hih pilna laikhil nihte lak-ah anihna-in leitung ukcip khinzo-a, atua teekteekmah deihpen leh lunggulhpen-in kinei zawsop-hi. Pasian Kammal: Tapa leh Tapa-in atheihsak mite longal-in Pa theikei, acih-tawh kisuun-in athei-nuam mite ading telnop mahmah taleh kihucip-in bingcip-hi. Mihing Tapa hongpai ciang-in upna amu dinghiam? acihpen hihthu ziak genkholhna ahihi. Mikhempeuh-in laikhil khatna-a pilna thudon nawnlo-in, Dawimaangpa piak pilna lunggulh-uh ahihman-in kuamah-in Pasian kihna nawnlo-a, Khazihmi kici diakdiakte bang-in amau sawltaak bang-in Pasian ngaihsun gawpmang uhhi. Pasian hong deihsak pilna ahihleh Amah kihtaakna-tawh Ama lungdeih-tawh kituak lungsim ngaihsutna leh nuntaakna hi-a, hih pilna aneite-in duhhopna kamkaih letsiam ahihman-in agualzo mi-peuh, alawhcing mi-peuh, ahau alian-peuh maaivil saisai, phat huhu cihbang nei theilo uhhi. Mite phatding alunggulh kholloh mahbang-in mi mawkphat ngeilo uhhi. Thumaanna leenkip ahihman-in maaitang zahtaak neilo uhhi. Meigong tagahte ahopihzia leh ulian mihaute ahopihzia kidang saklo uhhi. Mite hehding laulo uh-a, thumaan agenloh khaakding lauzaw uhhi. Tua ahihman-in lawm haulo uhhi, banghanghiam cihleh hih leitung Dawimaangpa kumpi-gam ahihtawh kizuui-in ama nungzuuite-in thumaan mite mudah-in nawlkhiin uhhi. Kivakna (Talent): Kivakna-pen sintawmna, siamsinna pan-a kingah hilo-in pianpih siamna tuampian hi-a, Khazihmite ading-in Pasian piaktuam cihding ahihi. Kivakna-pen ahampha mi khenkhat-in nam tampi neithei uh-a, kivakna khatzong aneilo mi om veve-hi. Kivakna anei mite lak-ah hunlehmual alemtaang leh nulehpate nungthuap panpihna (backup support) ziak-in kivakna ataat-hiamm (sharpen)-zo mite-in taangpi lak-ah kilatna, kidawk zawhna cihte lawh-in, kivaakna-a anei azanghthei khenkhat om-hi. Alangkhat-ah, neutuúng pan-in akilangh mahmah kivakna anei neupang khat-in nungthuap panpihna aneihloh ziak-in tua kivakna amualsuah zolo mi tampitak om-a, Zomi sung bang-ah tam phadeuh khading-hi. Kivakna nam tampi om-a, tua kivakna aneite-pen sinzah kibang vive taangpi mite saang-a siamzawk deuhna, kilatzawk diakna cihte ahihi. I-uuk mahmah na khat-pen taangpi mite saang-a siamzaw deuh cih genloh taangpi tanzil nangawn I-bat keileh tua-pen ei akivalo cihna hi-a, ei kivakna hilo-hi. I kivakna ahilopi na khat-tawh gualtung tuanding suunmang suutsuut nawnlo-in, ei kivakna bang-hiam cih kankhia thei lehang I maailam hizaw dinghi. Kivakna tungtaang phawk-pak thu-ah, ka leenciil hunlaai-in Kawlgam-a bawhlung siampen team (first class: ပထမတန) te saang-a asiamzaw Zomi honkhat om-a, ahizong-in sahkhua thutanna omlo ahihman-in tua mite kivakna kimengcip-in kilangh zolo-hi. Kivakna-pen Kawlgam diakdiak-ah abeisa hun khempeuh-ah nungthuap panpih theiding mi omloh ziak leh sahkhua thutanloh ziak-in akidiahcip, paankaai-a akilanghlo naakpi-in tam-hi. Adiak-in kidemna pan-a kilatna lam-ah sahkhua thutanglo cih nungsang-in na-siam mahmah zong-in ulian mihau meeltheih naaihuai na neihkeileh hong kiteel loding theihna ahihi. Ulian mihau meeltheih leh sumgolh-tawh vaai akihawm man-in akiva mite kiseelcip-a, ahihthei liamliam khawngteng akilat man-in gualzawhna cikmah hun-in Kawlgam-in ngah ngeilo-hi. Kivakna-pen mi saang-a tungtuan zawkdeuhna ahihman-in naakpi-in manpha-in deihhuai-a, tuabang zing khatpeuh-ah akilangh naupang I-neihleh naakpi-a nungthuap panpihna hahkatding minam sung-ah kisam mahmah-hi. Kivakna-pen asin tektek lak-ah tungtuangdeuh, ahihthei vive lak-ah kilanghdeuh cihte hi-a, sinzawhthu, sawlzawhthu, hahkatzawhthu hi taktak lo-hi. Sintuam theihloh, leituam theiloh hamphatna tuampi khat hi-a, Pasian kiang pan-a hongpai pilna mah-tawh kisuun-in, pilna zom-a athupi leh amanphapen sil ahihi. Tua ahihman-in gamnuam-a khuasa Zomite-in I tate banglam-ah kiva uhhiam cih kician tak-in kankhia-a, amau lawpna leh uukna tungtawn-in nungthuap panpihna naakpi-a kipatding kisam-hi. A-uuk hetlohpi, asiam hetlohpi khat-peuh I-pumsawl gawpleh alungsim hongnång (dulhgawp, zulgawp) khading-a naakpi-in kisumh zawding-hi. Tate kivakna leh a-uukna (game ahilo) te encik ciat-ni! Siamna (Skill): Siamna ataangpi-in muhlehtuah (experience) tungtawn-in hongpiang-hi. Thupiang khatpeuh mu-in, tua muhna tungtawn-in asia apha khensiamna, tua apiang khinsa thu bangci kamkaih letlehang apha lawhtaak tam zawding, koici bang-a muiibunh zawding cih theihtheihna tungtawn-a sepsiamna-pen siamna ahihi. Hih-pen ataangpi-in kisintheih, hahkatzawhthu-tawh ngahtheih hi-a, thupiangte omzia, thupaizia leh sepziading theihna ciang-tawh hih siamna kingah lo-hi. Ataangpi lungsimpia tak-a mapanna, haanciamna leh lungkhona (lungkiatlohna)-tawh kalsuanna-in siamna phungvuh-in kilangh sakthei-hi. Siamsinna-tawh ataangpi akizomding abat hang-in mi khenkhat-pen lukhu-neelkaai angahna subject-tawh kizom seplehbawl lam-ah siam mahmah lo-in, ama uuk atuamdangpi khat-khawng aseem mi honkhat omhi. Tua ahihman-in siamsin zawhna leh lukhu khuk zawhna ciang-tawh siamna kingah khinlo-hi. Lpd; saangkah ngeilopi-a radio, tape, cbt puahphat-khawng siam cihtak-a asiam cihdaan tampitak om-hi. Math sin ngeilopi-a sing kibik tuat-khawng siam cihtak-a asiam om-hi. Hihte-pen kivakna nam-khat cihtheih hi-a, lai sinna, siamsinna tung-ah kinga-kim lo-hi. Kivakna a-on zawhlohna-pen saang-a asin ataangpi mite sang-a siamzaw gawp ahihlohna ahihi. Ahuampi-in siamna-pen sepsuahna-ah kizenna ahihman-in haanciamna leh lungkiatlohna tungtawn-in ataangpi kingah-hi. Atheih ngeiloh vaaihawmzia khat-pen atheisa khat-in ahilhna muang-in, tua-tawh kituak ding-in cilgil tak-in lamkhun zuui-a akalsuan mi-in siamna ahun-amual zil-in ngah toto thei-hi. Lungkiat baihna-in siamna ngah nading pan-in hongdaal thei-a, lungkhona-in siamna hong ngahsak thei-hi. Thutheihna (Knowledge): Thutheihna-pen ataangpi siamsinna (education) pan-in kingah-hi. Siamsinna-pen Kawlgam diakdiak-ah saanginn bek ahihpian saam hang-in akhangkhin gamliante-ah munlehmual tuamtuam om zihziah-a, anteh theipuam zuakding nangawn siamsin phot-in siam mahhi ci-a theihpihkip sinzawhna (recognized certificate)-tawh akiseem ahihi. Kawlgam tanzil-tawh suut lehang, thutheihna ataangpi saanginn pan-in leh tutkhop holimna pan-in thutheihna kingah-hi. Siamsinna-pen thuneihnaletcipna (dictatorship)-tawh kiukna ahihziak-in akhangkhin gamlian-a akisin gualbaan siamsinnate Kawlgam-ah hawm kitang lo-in Kawlmaangte thu-peuh ahoihlam bekbek-in kisin-a, saanginn mahmah pan-in khuaknimna-tawh nasia tak-in hongki pantah-hi. Khawlkhawm, leengkhawm holimnate-ah adiak-in Kawlgam tanzil-a siamsinna ahizekte mah-in pulpit luahzaw hamtang ahihman-in gampua lam-a gualbaan holimzia, khuasakzia, nuntaakzia leh kalsuanziate ataangpi-in Kawlte censor cut khitsa (athupi leh kiukna hoihteng apaihkhiat khitsa) tengkhawng kikuppi-in kinei-hi. Saangsiate-tawh kitotna, Kawlgam nai-ngan-ye tawh akisawh khalo I-hih naaknaakleh Uni bangpen kiat omlo-in ongpass hiden lel-a, tua tuihual zuui-in mi ataangpi luang lel-hi. Atam hetlo khenkhat ahihleh akhuak teii-in ciim ahihman-in ama hahkatna-tawh lukhuneelkaai khu ciangbek hi saamlo-in asiam mahmah pawl omveve saam-hi. Siam mahmah cihciang-in tua asin siamsinna gui-tawh kituaksepna-ah kizanghthei mahmah cihciang hi-a, pil cihna hilo-hi. Ahuampi-in tomgenna-ah, siamsinna-pen pilna hilo (education is not wisdom)-a, ahizong-in pianpih ahihkeileh (Khazihmite upna-ah) Pasian piak pilna anei mite-in tua pilna tawphah ahihman-in ama siamsinna-tawh kituak thute bek-ah siam cihbang hilo-in, thukhualna leh huainopna lungsim-tawh hongkop ciang-in nasepzia leh mapanzia hong taangzaii thei-hi. Hih-pen Zomi taangpi-in tuabang mite neihsa pilna-pen atawphah-uh ahihlam theilo-in siamsinna pan-a pilna angah sakha-uh ahihi. Tua thu ahiauhau, aliim avaang kimu ahihman-in siamsinna saangpipi azote-in Pasian piak pilna nei takeileh mipihte-in pil acihding lunggulhzaw-uh ahihman-in siamsinna (education) nangawn pilsinna hongci tangial uhhi. Hihpen taangpi kheemna hi-a, tuabang kammal-tawh hongbum masate ulianpi ahihman-in khangno khenkhat-in umkha laai-hi. Siamsinna-ah pilna kisin lo-hi, zong kisin thei lo-hi, banghanghiam cihleh Pasian kihtaakna-in pilna guipi hi-a, tua Pasian-pen pilna ahihi, tua pilna-pen Kawlgam saanginn diakdiak-ah kinaak sinloh lua-hi. Siamsinna pan-a akingah thutheihna-tawh kizuui-a akilawm gamtatluheek cihte ciangbek kisin-a, Anungta Pasian Kihtaak ziading-peuhmah siamsinna-ah kisin lo-hi. Gammi hoih (good citizen) khat neihding gamtatluheek, paulehhaamzia, zialehtong cihte ahihleh saanginn kim-ah hongki pattahding angeina ahihi. Tua ahihman-in siamsinna saangpenpen zo napi-in apil vetlo, ami asa nangawn akhuallo, akhua atui adon vetlo, unau tanaute nangawn adonlo ulian mahmah, ahau mahmah, azalian mahmah tampitak kinei-hi. Siamsinna saangpipi azo khempeuh pil kim peuhmah lo-a, siamsinna-tawh akisawhkha ngeilo khempeuh mawlhaii kimlo-hi. Siamsinna saangpi zo-a apil mahmah khenkhat a-om mahbang-in, siamsin ngeilo-a apil mahmah, athukhual mahmah, acitak mahmah tampi om-a, ahizong-in amaute-in leitung luanna tuihual lak-ah tu-nuanua ciang-in mun ngah zolo uhhi, banghanghiam cihleh pil cih-pen khalam leh lungsimtawng lamsang vaangliatna leh thahaatna nam-khat ahihman-in amaute kizuak daidai ngeilo uh-in, siamsin-a apillote ahihleh kizuak-in kipulaakgawp, meeltheih tanauteng leh akaaikiik lametnei teng-in phatpah zuahzuah cihbang dinmun ahihman ahihi. Tua ahihman-in siamsinna-pen thusinna, thupaizia sinna, thu-omzia sinna, apiangsa thute sinna, apiang laaitak thute sinna, (akhangkhin gamliante-ah) abeisa leh tuhun-a thupiang-tawh zil-in maailam-ah banghong piangthei cihte upmawhsansaat-a cilgiltak-a sinna cihte ahihi. Cidamnalam ahihleh natna namte, natna apiangsak lungnote, tua lungnote thahtheihthahlah cihte, thahtheihte bang zatui-tawh bawlding, thahlahte bang zatui-tawh khalding cihte ataangpi ahihi. Thukhaam (law ဥပဒ) bangpeuhmah-pen Kawlgam diakdiak-ah sahkhua thutanna-tawh thukhending kipattah ngeitlohna ahihman-in amawh akhial pipi bangteng-tawh peipuang-a zosak theiding, bangci kawipilding cihte ahihi. Lambu siamna-zong lampi, innpi, leii cihte bawlzia, sumbeiding tuatkholhzia, nasepna-a kizanghding sang-a amau ngahding alimci theithei tuatsiamna cihte-mah sin uhhi. Siamsinna (education) lamzing khempeuh atung-a bang-a akisin ahihi. Hihteng adiak-in thukhaam, cidamna, leh lambu siamsinnate-pen Kawlgam tanzil-ah Pilna ahi Pasian-tawh akilemlo vive hizaw-hi. Pilna-pen Pasian Kihtaakna hi-a, Pasian akihta thukhaamsiampi khat-in thukinei nihte lak-ah akhialzaw zosak ngeilo dinghi. Pasian akihte zatuisiampi khat-in ama zatui khot naciang ding-in cinate tungpan sum lunggulh ngeilo dinghi. Pasian akihta lambu khat-in tungsiah pan-a masuan khat ading-a hongkia sum alangvaal ne-in mipi leh kumpi kheem ngeilo dinghi. Ahizong-in hihte pilna akisa khialkha zahdong ding-in hong kibumcip khinsa ahihman-in pilna-mah kisa-a, tute tate ading thunget sim-in hihte-mah kilo, kisam, kingen tangtang laai tazen-hi. Hihte pilna akisak khialhkhaak man-in pilna taktak kiphawkkha nawnlo-hi. Bangzah-in laainat-huai ahihiam! Unau Lii-te Kizopna: Pasian akihtalo mi-in pilna nei-thei veve-a, Pasian langpangpa pilna hipah-hi. Pilna-pen kivakna, siamna leh siamsinna-tawh akikop naaknaakleh Pasian kihta-in kihtalo himah taseleh naakpi-in muiibunh-in mipi-in lunggulh kim-hi. Neekzonna ciang ahihleh kivakna khat anei mi-in pilna, siamna leh siamsinna cihte khatbeek-tawh akopkei zong-in akivakna-in ankham sakthei veve-hi. Tua-mahbang-in pilna nei takeileh siamna anei mi-in siamsinna leh kivakna aneikei zong-in ankham thei-hi. Ahizong-in hihte-in ama gilpi longal gilpi adang tampi vahsak zolo-hi. Siamsinna tawphah-a siamna ahihkeileh kivakna anei mite-in ahihleh ama gilpi baan-ah gilpi adang ahoihkhom khatciang vahsak thei-hi. Pasian kihtaakna pan-a akingah Pilna tawphah-a kivakna leh siamna anei mite-in agil-bek hilo-in alungtaii uh-a, midangte gil avahsak zokei zong-in midangte lungtaii sak-hi. Pilna tawphah-a, siamsinna-tawh haat-hiam-in kivakna leh siamna anei mi-in ahihleh ama gilpi ading sang-in mite gilvah nading leh lungtaii nading, abit nading, akhantoh nading, agualbat nading mitsuanzaw uh-a, tuate alawhcin nading-in gilkial dangtaak thuakngam zawsop uhhi. Zomi khangthak khempeuh TOPA kihtaakna anei thei kimciat ding-in (2Corinth 5:17 mikim-in Khazih sung-ah a-omleh athak piansaksi new creature ahihi; aluui nate si-in, athak nate pianghongtung-hi.) I lungsim I pumpi bawlthak ciat-in, Pasian hongpiak kivaknate siamsinna-tawh phungvuh theikim leh I sin thulehlate hahkat-a siamna kician anei kimciat ding-in kithawi ciatni! Nupila papilate leh amau sang-a uzaw khempeuh ahihleh suunni mual-ah liam hak nawnlo ding-a, tuailaai momnote ahihleh Pasian leh Minam ading-in thuhaksa tampi phuut akipan phiingding, kham (gold) leh buhtú ahihkeh lopakung (straw) koizaw nahi-hiam cih khuahun-in hong ze-et (test) hun ahongtung hita-hi. A diakin Khristian leh muslim te adingin lauhuai mai uh hi. RSS cih ciang Rastriya Swayamsevak Sanghacihna hi in Hindu extremist pawlte cih ding hi pen mai hi. Dr. Keshav Baliram Hedgewar in kum 1925 September kha in Maharashtra ah na din hi. A tup leh ngiim uh India gam Hindu te vaihawmna gam Hindu Rastra suahsak ding ahi hi. A malakna uh leh nasepzia thangsak nuam khollo uh hi.Amau pawla lut ding khatpeuh India gam leh nam leh Hindu biakna gum dingin kiciamsak (Oath taking) masa zel uh hi. A tungin phatuam ngai pawl dana kidin himahleh politics lamah hong kigawlh pian ta uh hi. RSS makai Guruji a cih deep uh MS. Golwalkar in, India gama Hindu ahi lo khempeuh in zong Hindi culture zui in Hindi pau siam uh hen. Tua banah Hindu gam zah tak mah mah ding uh hi. Hih miten ki deihsakna te lunggulh lo ding uh hi.India gam pen Democracy gam dingin kilawm lo hi. Socialism zong gamdang pana mikhual hong lut hi lel in, India constitution zong phuahtawm hi. State Assembly leh kumpi phiat in kumpi khat bek om hen ci in gen hi. Kum zalom 19 na hun laia Hindu te nuntakzia thaksuahsak kik ding pen a tupna khat uh ahi hi.India cih pen Hindu Culture tawh kizawm hi cih biakna dang zui ten a theih ding deih uh hi.India cih ciang Hindu cihna dan in ngaihsut ding a deihna uh hi. A tup leh ngimna uh om bangin BJP in politics lamah ma la hi. Bajrang Dal zong a madawk khat ahi hi. VHP pen leitungbup a huam aki zopkhawmna uh ahi hi. Pawl tuam tuam Shiv Sena, BMS leh Hindu Munnani etc. ten Hindu ngeina kembit dingin RSS leh VHP te nuaiah nasem uh hi. Biakna dangte dawp sawm vetlo vial uh hi. Khristian leh Muslim te Hindu a suahnop kei ua leh melma bangin ki ngaihsun ding cimawk uh hi.Hitler in Nazi German nam gual tungtuang hi a cih zel mah bangin leh Jud ate a vatmai bangin malak zong kuul kha ding ci uh hi. A lungsim uh i gensa dan himah leh thakhat thu in gamtang pah buat buat sam lo uh hi. Siam tak leh pil takin kalsuan zaw uh hi. Phatuamngai pawl ahihna ah siat tuahna khawngah bel pahtaak huai vanglak uh hi. Andra Pradesh a tuikhanna hanga haksatna thuakte leh Gujarat a ziinling hanga haksatna thuakte bang naakpi takin huh uh hi. Laisinna school lam zong thupi ngaihsut mah mah uh hi. Kum 1977 in Vidhya Bharti hong uh a, school lamah nasem uh hi. India gam mun tuam tuam ah Shishu Mandir leh Bal Mandir lam uh hi.North East India nangawn ah school leh hospital bangzah hiam hong khin uh hi. Arunachal Pradesh-bangah Social Experiment in Inter-State Living (SEIL) hong ngiat uh hi. Naupang kum 4 gual mi genthei te tate state tuam tuamah kepsak uh hi. Amau thu zui dinga a lungsim a zawh khit ciangun ciahsak kik lel uh hi. Mizoram ah zong Central School hong nuam uh hi. Zika Virus akilawh pen mi tamsemsem, khangsemsem a, tuni ciangciang Zika Virus ngahpen mi 56 hita cin Straits Times ten tangkokhia uhhi. Aki muhcil in numei khattungpan aki mukhia hi a, tuapan in mi kibehlap toto ahih manin, thuneiten adangzong aki behlap toto khadiam cin lunghimawh mahmah uhhi. UNITED KINGDOM UK kumpi ten agammi te uh Singapore gamsung ah azindingleh adiakdiak in nupi naupaai laitak te, naupaai sawmte in amau ii zat Doctor tetawh hoihtak Travel Plan bawlkhawm in kikupding zaksakna nei uhhi. AUSTRALIA Australia Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade tenzong agammi te uh Singapore gamsung ah azinding aomleh thokang kipehsak hetlohding, hoihtak ki kepbitding amau ii zat Website tungtawn in tangkona nei uhhi. Naupaai tezong athupi mahmah ahihkeileh zinlohding banah, Singapore pan ciahkik khitzawh khanih sungbang naupaai lohding cihtezong theihsakna nei uhhi. TAIWAN Taiwan inzong agammi naupaai te Singapore ah zinlohding leh adang azinkhin tezong thokang kipehsakkhak hetlohding lim vaikhak mahmah hi. MALAYSIA Malaysia panin Singapore gamsung nisim alut apusuak te lakah Bus tawh apaite Johor panin Bus tawh apaite Thermal Screening bawlding uh cihi. Motorcycle, Taxi leh Car tawh apaite ahihleh cidamna tawh kisai theihsakna laihawm piading uh cihi. Hih Zika Virus pen thokang panin kilawh sawnthei ahih manin, eizong ih omna peuhah thokang ki petsakkhak hetlohding hanciamni. "url": " "depth": 0 --- zomi record: Thu ciapteh When the world of Zomi changed zomi record Thu ciapteh When the world of Zomi changed Rev. Dr. J. M. Ngul Khan Pau The Zomi are a group of tribes, who are living in three different countries, namely Bangladesh , India and in Myanmar . Due to their nomadic lifestyles, constant inter-tribe conflicts, and the divide and rule policy of the British colonialism, these tribes were separated from one another into different countries. Dr Laldena has rightly observed by saying, Zomi were perhaps one of the worst victims of the onslaught of British imperialism. They were divided and scattered throughout Southeast Asia (Neihsial 1984:1). To give a detailed description of the land, each of its distinct cultural practices and customs would be a great deal of work. Additionally contacting Zomis from Sylhet and Chittagong Hill Tracts of Bangladesh, to get enough information about them will be very difficult. Zo people are Mongoloid by race. One of the marks of the Mongolian race is a blue spot at the bottom of anew born baby. According to the anthropological term it is know as Blue Mongolian Spot. Their language belongs to the Tibeto-Burman group. The main focus of this paper will be Zo people from the chin state in Myanmar and from the two states of India namely Manipur and Mizoram. According to the record of Dr. Marrison, the then Linguistic Advisor Bible Society of India and Ceylon ( Sri Lanka ) Zomi regions cover parts of different political areas, as follows: 1. Assam: part of the north Cachar and Mikir Hills, part of the Khasi and Jaintia Hills and the Lushai Hills (Mizoram). 2. Nagaland: part of the extreme south 3. Manipur: state 4. Tripura: state 5. East Pakistan ( Bangladesh ): Sylhet District and the Chittagong Hill Tracts. 6. Burma: The Chin Hills 7. Special Division (Chin State), where large Chin groups including Tedim, Falam, and Hakas are to be found, and part of the Magwe Division (Pakokku and Thayetmyo) and Arakan Division (Arakan Hill Tracts, Akyab, Kyaukpyu and Sandoway), where various southern Chin tribes are located (Khup Za Go 1988:177). The Term Zomi or Mizo, Kuki and Chin (pp. 11-12:) The wind of national consciousness and ethnic resurgence did give insights and re-examination of their names. Zo tribes, who are recognized by the Indian government under the Scheduled tribes in India , would like to have a common nomenclature by which they should be known. Zomi being their name of origin, seven tribes from Manipur state adopted this name in June 26, 1993 at Pearsonmun, Churachandpur. The seven tribes are: Paite, Gangte, Hmar, Simte, Zou, Tedim Chin and Vaiphei. One of the important resolutions is about having Common Identity and their resolution goes like this: Common Identity In the continuation of Zomi movement, the members felt the necessity of having a common identity with which all tribes can identify themselves without any reservation or hesitation for unity, solidarity and safety. The leaders present, therefore, adopted the name ZOMI for common identity which will take immediate effect from today (Nehkhojang 1993:1). Manipur a Zomite genkhahna lah deu teng type-khiet Changes in Zomi Religion (pp. 95-97) The Zomi world has been changed dramatically as a result of the Gospel. One time spirit and demon-trodden people are now living in a new way as a result of Christianity and education as well. Today, they are aware that their Traditional religion did not satisfy them. They are tired offering series of sacrifices and living in constant fear. G K Nang has drawn a table of comparative elements of workshop from Christian and Animist perspectives that show the deplorable condition of Zomis Traditional religion: Christianity Mans response to God Prayer to God Confession Self-sacrifice (Spiritual service) Adoration Reverence Unity Love Thanksgiving Giving Trust Devotion Remembrance Fellowship Praise (1994:4) Animism Mans response to spirits Prayer to spirits Confession Animal (Sacrifice) Propitiation Fear Independence (sometimes corporate) Worry Ritualism Receiving Suspicion Alienation The Gospel has change the mountains and the valley of Zoland , and today there are churches where there was once worship of demons. Where traditional religious pillars were erected now stand Jubilee Stones which marked the coming of Christianity. In one of the newsletters of a missionary in North East India, this wonderful transformation of the tribes was recorded thus: The mountains that formerly echoed with blood-curdling war cries are now re-echoing the harmony of Christian hymns. Their forefathers were head-hunting animists and used to sing their head-hunting chants, but they have now exchanged for the hymns of fraternal love. The children of the head-hunting people have now become the children of God (Zaithanga 1981:48). The days of harvest still continues in Zomi inhabited areas, the rapid development both in the way of living and in the Christina life cannot be ignore. Even a Hindu writer wrote about the changes he saw among the Hill people of Manipur state: The missionaries have succeeded in modernizing the tribal people of Manipur. Indeed they have unlocked and opened up the closed doors of these primitive people in the light of modern education. There are now many scientists, professor of art, literature, history, sociology, commerce and economics, amongst the tribal Christian communities in Manipur. Tow of the chief ministers of Manipur had been tribal Christians (Gori 1984:114). Indeed there area changes still taking place. Zo people, who were once the children of darkness and living in fear, are the children of God. They have no fear of the evil forces, because in Christ they are victorious (Rom 8:37). Now they are the chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for Gods own possession (1 Pet 2:9). In the midst of evil forces, they are assured that the One who is in them is greater than he who is in the world (1 John 4:4). They are free from the penalty of sin, in Christ, from the power of the spirits in Christ, and they are no more primitive, pre-literate, filthy Zomi, but one with any other races in Gods big family. The Coming of Christianity to the World of Zomi (pp. 119) When we trace the history of Christianity to the Zo people, we cannot ignore the heroic attempts of dedicated men and women of God. Many of them gave their lives and the memorial stones of their lives still speak to us today. The earliest attempt at Protestant missionary work in Burma was at Rangoon , where Messrs. Chater and Mardon, of the Baptist Missionary Society of England, opened a mission in 1807. Felix Carey, son of William Carey, came soon after Chater and Mardon, remaining until 1814. The London Missionary Society sent two missionaries to Rangoon in 1808, but within a year one died and the other left (Warburton 1908:310). Adoniram Judson and his wife, who originally came in order to work in India , were not permitted by the East India Company. They sailed to Rangoon on the suggestion of William Carey, and arrived there on July 13, 1813 (Wa 1963:4), Judson was the outstanding Protestant missionary to Burma . While he was a student of Andover Theological Seminary, he and his friends brought a petition from the theological students of Andover Theological Seminary to the American Board of Commission in order to bring the Foreign Mission into being (Latourette, Vol 6:226). Later, he himself was the first missionary sent abroad by that society. The First Missionary Couple to Chin Hills (p.120) Arthur E. Carson reached Rangoon on December 13, 1886, and was married to Laura L. Hardin, just five days later. The marriage took place in Bassein at the Sgaw Karen mission compound. They were the first American Baptist missionary couple assigned to work among the Zomi. On February 2, 1899, they left Thayetmyo, their mission station and head quarters for eight years, for Chin Hills , where no mission work had ever been done. They arrived at Haka on March 15, 1899, six weeks after setting out from Thayetmyo. While in Thayetmyo they had several converts and, besides the Carsons, there were 18 unordained native preachers, one ordained native preachers, nine churches, 205 members and 47 baptized members (Johnson 1988:11). One night Arthur and Laura Carson arrived at Haka, Laura Carson wept bitterly, not more because of my disappointment in the place and the people than for my own ability to meet the situation bravely (Carson 1927:163). Arthur, I cant do it! I simply cant do it! How can I possibility stay here for a lifetime? she tearfully asked. Arthur told her, Dont talk that way. Thing will look brighter in the morning (Ibid 163). Then Laura remembered their motto: I can do all things through Christ who strengthened me (Phil 4:13). With that motto, they went to bed and rose the next morning, determined to give their lives for Christ to win the wild tribes. To the Zomis in Mizoram and Manipur (pp. 125-127) J H Lorrain and F W Savidge were the first missionaries to Mizoram (then called Lushai Hills) under the Arthingto Aborigine Mission. They both felt called of God toward the rising of the sun. When they arrived in North East India, they came to know that Mizoram was opened by the British government. They then begged the authorities to allow them to settle there. They were able to enter Mizoram on Boxing Day, 1893, with great joy to realize their dreams and hope had been fulfilled. They arrived at Aizawl on January 11, 1894. They trusted the Mizos implicitly, and soon won their confidence by simple kindness and by medical services. Because of their loving concern and services, the Mizos conferred upon them the title Zosap, which means Sahib for Mizos (Hminga 1987:49). Christianity caught on among the Mizos like a wild fire. In the 1940s, there were villages in which all people were Christian. There were even some villages founded where only Christians were allowed to dwell. In the 1951 census of India , 91 or 178,000 of 196,000 Mizos were Christians, and 56,000 or 29 of them could read and write. In 1980, a special census was carried out jointly by the three major churches the Presbyterian Church of Mizoram, the Baptist Church of Mizoram and the Independent Church of Maraland. According to that census, the Christian population of the state formed 92.52 of the total population. The non-Christian population which formed 7.48 of the total, was divide into Hindu, Muslim, Buddhist, Sikh and animistic groups (Ibid. 334). According to Johnstone, the Christian percentage in 1993 was 95 (Johnstone 1993:286). The North East India General Mission Churches (now renamed as Evangelical Congregational Churches of India) in Manipur are mostly in the sought district, mainly among the Zomi tribes. In 1897, a Vaiphei Zomi young man, Lungpau by name, went to Singzawl village and there he saw a man reading a book. He was very much attracted by this and had a strong desire to learn how to read and write. Accordingly, he went to Aizawl to study with his boyhood comrade, Thangkai. Dr. Frazer and Rev., Watkin Robert gave them admission and supported them. In 1909, a copy of St. Johns Gospel in Lushei dialect found its way into the hand of Kamkholun, the chief of Senvawn village. He was so much interested in the message of the Gospel that he extended an invitation to the white missionaries to Aizawl. Dr. Frazer and Rev. Robert felt the invitation from Kamkholun of Senvawn was a Macedonian Call. So, in March 1910, Rev. Robert set out toward Manipur, taking with him the two young Vaiphei men and some other as his porters. On March 17, 1910, on their way to Vervek village, the two young men accepted Christ as their Savior and Lord, and became the first converts among the Zomi tribes in Manipur (Vaiphei 1981:65). The North East India General Mission has been effective in its evangelistic works. Churches are established among the following Zomi sub-tribes: The Paite, the Vaiphei, the Kukis, the Hmars, the Gangtes, the Zous and the Simtes. ECCI (the then NEIGM) is not affiliated with any denomination in India ; they have a Presbyterian form of church structure and administration. The growth of Christianity among the Zomis in Manipur is remarkable. By 1931, there were 2,478 Christians, in 1935 it grew up to 4,856 members, by 1948 it had 15,000, and in 1960 the membership was 26,678. Today, they are the largest and most mission-oriented churches in the south district of Manipur. After seventy-five years, this church became not only a self-support church but a missionary sending church with more than 127 missionaries serving in different parts of India , as well as other countries such as Bhutan , Burma and Thailand (Khaizakham 1988:4-5). Courtesy: When the World of Zomi Changed (A product submitted to the faculty of Western Conservation Baptist Seminary, Portland, Oregon, USA in partial fulfillment of the requirement for the degree of Doctor of Missiology by J M Ngul Khan Pau. Pilna ki sam hi hang (Pilna a Pia theipa Pasian a hih lam I phawk ding kisam hi) Pasian zahtakna in pilna ki patna a hih lam phawk a, Pasian thu leh leitung thu tuamtuam te ah pilna sangpipi I neihzawh ding kisam hi. II. Cidamna kisam hi hang (Cidamna a pia theipa Pasian ahih lam I phawk ding kisam hi) Pasian zahtakna in khausau na leh cidamna a hih lam I theih gige ding kisam hi. Koikoi ah ih om a, bangbang I sem zong in I nuntakna ah I cidamna ding mah ngaihsut pipen in nei a, I nekding, I dawnding, I gamtatding, leh I sepding kisam hi. III. Hauhna kisam hi hang. (Hauhna a pia theipa Pasian a hihlam I phawk ding kisam hi) Pasian zahtakna in Hauhna kipatna a hih lam I theih gige ding kisam hi. Mi hing te pen, I khantoh na ding in, sum leh pai tha kisam mahmah a hih lam thei a, I neih sunsun zatsiam ban ah, a met a pung a I bawltheihna ding lamtuamtuam zong a, I hanciam ding in leh hong hausak den ding pa tung ah, citak a sawm ah khat ( sehsuah) I piak ding thupipen ding hi. IV. Kipum khat na kisam hi hang. (Ki kipumkhatna a pia theipa Pasian a hih lam I phawk ding kisam hi.) Pasian zahtakna in kipumkhat theihna lungsim hongpia a hih lam I phawk detding kisam hi. Mihing te Pasian in, khat leh khat ki huh leh ki panpih ban ah, ki pumkhatna tawh, nasem ding a hong bawl a hih mah bang in, I minam sung ah zong kipum khat na a om ma teng in I khantoh ding baih lo ding hi. Rev.Dr. Zam Khan Thang (Dr.Thangbawi) Note: zomidailygmail.com ah Dr. Thawngbawi in 2011 October kha in hongkhakdan lianin khatvei hongki suaksakkik ahihi. The official list stops at languages such as Mizo or Burmese. Yet, when you open modern AI systems like ChatGPT , Claude , or Gemini and type a simple greeting Na dam maw? the response often comes back fluent and contextually correct. This apparent contradiction is not accidental. It exists because Google Translate and modern AI systems are built on fundamentally different philosophies of language . 1. Translating vs. Understanding To see why AI knows Zomi, we must first separate two ideas that are often confused: translation and understanding . Google Translate: the dictionary approach Google Translate relies on Neural Machine Translation (NMT). For a language to be officially supported, Google requires massive amounts of parallel data : millions of carefully matched sentence pairs where the English sentence "A" aligns perfectly with Zomi sentence "B." The problem: Zomi is classified as a low-resource language . There are not yet enough large, clean, digitized EnglishZomi corpora that meet Googles strict quality and verification standards. Without this, Google will not ship the language as a public utility. Modern AI: the library approach Large Language Models (LLMs) are not trained primarily to translate. They are trained to predict patternsspecifically, what word is likely to come next given a context. To do this, they ingest enormous portions of the public internet: articles, PDFs, social media posts, blogs, forums, and more. The result: AI does not need a perfect dictionary. It learns Zomi the same way humans doby seeing it appear repeatedly in meaningful contexts alongside other languages. 2. The Bible Facebook Factor A natural question follows: Where did the AI encounter Zomi in the first place? Two sources are especially important. Religious texts The Bible is one of the most translated and digitized documents in human history. Zomi Bible translations and Christian literature are widely available online. Because AI has encountered the Bible in English, Burmese, and Zomi, it can internally map concepts across languages without ever being explicitly taught EnglishZomi translation rules. Social media Zomi speakers are highly active on platforms like Facebook and YouTube. These platforms contain vast amounts of informal, conversational Zomi comments, captions, testimonies, sermons, and discussions. Traditional translation engines largely ignore such messy data. AI, by contrast, learns directly from it. In short, AI learned Zomi by listening to how Zomi people actually speak online . - Zomi Language Resources Center 3. The Cousin Language Effect Zomi belongs to the Sino-Tibetan language family, specifically the Kuki-Chin branch. This matters enormously for AI learning. Even if an AI has limited direct exposure to Zomi, it has seen billions of sentences in related languages such as Mizo, Burmese, and Thadou. This enables transfer learning . The AI transfers grammatical structures, word roots, and syntactic patterns from related languages to Zomi. Google Translates NMT system is far more conservative: if it cannot guarantee accuracy, it simply withholds the language entirely. 4. Why Google Keeps Zomi Off the List If AI can already translate Zomi reasonably well, why doesnt Google just add it? The answer is reliability versus creativity . AI chat systems are designed to be helpful. An 85 accurate translation with minor grammatical issues is acceptable in conversation. Google Translate, however, is treated as critical infrastructure. Users depend on it for travel, medicine, education, and legal contexts. Google will not list a language until it reaches a high product-ready thresholdoften requiring extensive human validation and near-professional accuracy. From Googles perspective, withholding Zomi is safer than releasing an imperfect tool. 5. The Dialect Soup Problem AIs Zomi fluency comes with a serious caveat: dialect mixing . Zomi is an umbrella term that includes Tedim, Paite, Zou, Thadou, and other closely related varieties. Because AI learned from the open internet without strict linguistic labeling, these varieties sit very close together in its internal model. What happens: You may ask for formal Zomi (Tedim), but the AI might insert a Paite-specific word or a Mizo-style construction. Why: Without a prescriptive dictionary telling it that this word belongs only to this dialect , the AI chooses what statistically fits best, not what is dialect-pure. This is impressivebut also a reminder that AI fluency is not the same as linguistic standardization. 6. The Magic of Zero-Shot Translation One of the most remarkable aspects of modern AI is zero-shot translation . Traditional systems require a direct bridge: English Zomi must be explicitly trained. AI often skips this step. How it works: If the AI knows that love corresponds to it in Burmese, and that it corresponds to itna in Zomi, it can infer that love itna even if it never saw that exact pairing before. AI translates concepts , not just word pairs. 7. The Race: Meta vs. Google While Google Translate dominates public perception, the Zomi community should pay close attention to Meta . Meta has launched the No Language Left Behind (NLLB) initiative. Because Facebook is the primary digital gathering place for many Zomi speakers, Meta likely has access to far more real-world Zomi data than Google. The likely outcome: Official, high-quality Zomi translation support may appear on Meta platforms before it ever reaches Google Translatesimply because that is where the Zomi conversation already lives. 8. How the Community Can Teach Google AI learned Zomi accidentallythrough everyday use. For Google Translate, the process must become intentional . Key pathways include: Contributing verified translations through Google Translate Community tools Building clean parallel corpora (EnglishZomi sentence pairs) Participating in open projects like Mozilla Common Voice for text and speech data What Google needs is not proof that Zomi exists, but structured, verifiable linguistic labor . A Language Alive The fact that Zomi exists in the mind of AI before it exists in the official database of Google Translate is not a failure. It is evidence of vitality. A language does not need a corporation, a government, or a dropdown menu to be real. It only needs Zomi speakers who use it, share it, and refuse to let it disappear. AI did not learn Zomi because it was told to. It learned Zomi because the Zomi people refused to be silent. Agelh Pu Thang Lian Pau (President, Zomi Reunification Organisation) By: LAIBUSAAL Date: September 13, 2023 Zomi te koitan tungta ihiam? (Where Are We Now?) Agelh Pu Thang Lian Pau (President, Zomi Reunification Organisation) Minam I cih ciangin namnih in na kikhen a, tuate English in Nation leh Ethnic na kici hi. Ei Zo pau in anih in Minam kici ziau a, a tuam in zong na kingaihsun lo hi. Tua hi a, minam I cih ciangin tawndan leh ngeina kibang, pupa khangui kizom, pupate tung pan a aluahsuk uh gamlehleitang ah teng mite ahi hi. Tua ahih manin nation leh ethnic pen kibang mahmah na pi in kilamdangna khat nei kingaihsun hi, tua pen pupate luahna gam a tengin amaulehamau a kivaihawmte pen Nation kici se in, minam hi tase leh pupate luahna gam a tenglo hiam, ahih kei leh a tenna gam uh gamgi bangin a khente pen ethnic group ki ci hi. Ei Zomite zong pupa ngeina leh tawndan, khanggui kizom, paulehham kilamdanglo, pupate tung pan I luahsuk ngekngek gamah teng I hih manin minam kician mahmah khat ihi hi. Ahih hangin I Zogam pen tuizum Mangkangte hong khan laiin gam tuamtuam ah hong khen manin tudong gamkhat, ukna khat leh kivaihawmna khat ah kiom thei nailo a, minamkhatgamkhat suah ding lametna neiin hih theih zahzah hunkhat khithunkhat, khangkhatkhitkhangkhat in kihanciam toto hi. Tuin Zomite muntuamgamtuam ah hong kikhenzak in, min tuamtuam tawh minamdangte in hong ciamteh mah taseleh, Zosuante ihihna kihaihloin, ei laiguizom teng kivaihawmna khat a om ding lunggulhna tawh khangmasate na kalsuannate uh ciin muh theih hi. Mangkangte in kum 1777 AD pawlin I Zogam hong nawk pan uh a, ahi zongin kum 1890 in la zo bek uh hi. Tua hun a kipanin I Zogam ah hong ukin, hong vaihawmkhum uh hi. Amaute cihloh buang kuaman hong ukzou ngeilo, bekthamloin zong hong kisimzo ngeilo hi, tua hia ei Zomite pen eimahleheimah kivaihawmin, zaleentaka na nungta tawntung ihi hi. Zogam hong lak khit uh sotlou in, minam khat ihih lam hongtel semsem uh ahih manin, Zominamte tenna gam teng kivaipuakna khat sungah gawmding hong gel uh a, hih thu ngaihsun dingin ChinLushai Conference1892, Fort Willam, Calcutta ah na nei ngei uhi. Tua hunlai in Zomite politics lamah kikhanglou nailou hi. Ih gamah modern education sangmangte in hong pan uh a, Christian biakna zong hong khang hi. Hih hun apanin lam tuamtuam ah khanlohna hong om mahleh politics lamah Zomite pen kilamzang thei loin kiniam mahmah hong suak hi. Ei Zosuante kigawmkhop a, vaihawmna khat sunga om ding lunggulhna kinei tawntung ahihlam I khangthu uh I et ciangin muh ding na om totou a, tuate phok tawntung ding kisam hi (i) 1933 kimlakin, Pu Than Pet Mang Vum Thu Muang makaihin, Chin National Union na phuan uh a, tuazoh Japan gal hunlai in, Chin Leaders Freedom League, Sukte Indipendance Army, Free Chin, adgte. chih kipawlna toh zaleennasuahtakna nasual uhi. (ii) 1940s hun ciangin, Zomi Ukpiten Allied Forces toh pangkhawm in Japan gal nasat uhi. Burma leh India in suahtakna ngah ding dinmun a hong om ciangin, Mizo Union in Zosuante kigawm ding deih thu Mangkangte khut ah dolkhat na khia uhi. Hiai kum (1947) mahin, BritishBurma a om Zomite leh khamtungmi tuamtuamten Panglong Agreement1947 bawlin, kum 10 khitciang a Burma potsan theih ding na ci uhi. India a om Zosuan pawlkhat ten L.L.Peter, Suptd of Lushai Hills kimuhpih in, kum 10 khit ciang a India potsan theihna dingthu na kum uhi. Manipur a om Zosuante lakah Kuki National Assembly, Khul Union, adgte. hongpiang in, amauten zong Zosuante kigawm ding lungtup in nei uhi. (iii) 1960s hun in, phamsa Pu Gen. Tun Kho Pum Baite makaihna, Chin Liberation Army leh Pu Laldenga makaih, Mizo National Front ten Zosuante kigawmkikna ding thu limtakin na hanciam uhi. Hiai pawl nihte kitheisiamtaka kalsuan kimlai, heutu khenkhat hong kithah ciangin, minam sungah meima hong piang hi. (iv) MNF leh Government of India in kum 1986 a kilemna hong bawl ciangin, Mizoram State hong piang hi. Hiai Mizo Accord in Zosuan teng huapkhalou sakna hong piangin, Zomi National Congress (Manipur) leh Peoples Congress(Mizoram) ten movement dangkhat hong pankhia a, First World Zomi Convention1988 Champhai a kineihkhit ciangin, Zomi Reunification Organisation(ZoRO) hong phutkhia uhi (1991 in Zomi chihpen Zo cin khek uhi). Tuni chiang dong, ZoRO in Zosuante kigawmkikna ding deihna toh International forum tuamtuam ah, tua thute taangkoupihta uhi. (v) Zosuan teng kivaihawmna khat ah omkhawm naikei mahleng, Chin State (Burma), Mizoram state (India), banah CHT (Bangladesh), leh Tripura (India) a om Zosuanten Sixth Schedule cihbang I nei a, hucihlai in Manipur a omten kivaihawmna mumaltak tunitan neilou uh hi. (vi) 1990s ciangin Manipur a om Zosuante lakah minam a khanlawhna khat hong pianga, chibing(tribe) a kikhenna ten minam suahtakna tunlou ding ahihdan leh, eimah kicihna, Zomi min mah zanga politics saivet ding ahi cih ngaihsutna kiptak toh, khovel a Zosuante kigawmkikna ding tup pipen a a nei, Zomi Reunification Organisation(ZRO) hong pankhia uhi. Nam lianzaw pawlkhatin thagum zanga hong nengchip thei dinmun a om ciangin, Zomi Revolutionary Army (ZRA) hong pankhia uhi. Hiai hun lai in, Burma ah MP kitelna hong om a, Zomi National Congress pen Political Party khata nei in MP 2 (two) I telching uhi. (vii) 2000 ciang in, khovel politics paizia zong hong kikheng hiaihiai in, Zomite sungah zong civil organisations tuamtuam hong piang khia hi. Saptuam maikaite hanciamna toh Global Zomi Alliance cih bang, Manipur a tribe tuamtuamte kipawlkhopna ahi Zomi Council, banah khovel mun tuamtuam ah Zomi Innkuan, Zomi Fellowship, adgte. ipankhia theita uh hi. Hiai a tunga I taklat thute apan, Zomiten kigawmkhopna leh vaihawmnakiukna khat a omkhop ding lunggulhin nei gige uh hi cih teltakin kimu thei hi. Tunin midangte hong sapna min zanga political platform ineihna kum 80, revolutionary movement ipatna kum 54 vel leh Zomi min toh political party (ZNC formed at Daizang in 1972) ineihna kum 42, banah, Zomi min toh revolutionary movement I patna kum 21 bang phatheita ahihtak chiangin, minam nnasepnaah koitan tungta, koiteng in samlai hiam chihte kivelthakzel poimoh mahmah hi. Adiak kholin, ZRO I pat apan tuni chiang en leng, politics a lohcinna (political achievements) cih gen ding omlo phial bang mahleh, minam nnasepna ah naakpitakin makisawn hi: (a) Zomi cih miten hong pompih mahmahta a, koimunkoigam ah Zomi kicih angtanhuai kisa theita hi. Pasian huhna toh, Zosuan khangnoute felna leh kipiakzohnate namdangten hong muh ciangin, muantham leh belhtham cing hongsain, zong hong thupisim uh hi. Pasian in Isrealte kiangah, a mei hilou in, a lu dingin kongbawl ding hi acih pen ei Zomite adin zong dikpha diak kasa hi. (b) Kineu ngaihsutna apan a lianzo lam lungtup in kinei theita hi. Hun khatlai in Manipur a om Zosuante lakah, cibing ngaihsutna lian mahmah a, tua cibingte minam dana koih in, Simte National Council, Paite National Council, Vaiphei National Organisation, adgte., cih bangin na om tiltel uh hi. Tuni ciangin, ih minam diktak Zomi hi a, chibing a India in hong cheptehnate tribes ahi cih kiphokna toh, Simte Tribe Council, Paite Tribe Council, adgte., in honglaih in, tunin cibing tuamtuam 9(Nine) bang in Zomi Council sungah seemkhom theita hi. (c) Zomi chih a pomtheilianlou pawlkhat ten zong Zosuan ihihdan phawkin, tuabang nnasepnate ah hong kiheltheita uhi. Mizoram sung ah zong, ZosuanZohnahthlak cih hong thupi ngaihsut theita in, hun paisa a Duhlian pau a zangthei lianloute tuambawlna zong hong beipianta hi. (d) Khangthak siamsinten zong midangte hongsapna peuh thupi ngaihsut nawnlou in, Zomi chih min toh research tuamtuam hong panta in, khamtungmualtung a iteenziak a Zomi hizolo in, Zosuan ihihziaka Zomi ihihdan hong phoulaak semsem uhi. (e) Zosuanten I tawndan leh hunbi poimohte ngaih khawkna kineita a, Zomi Namni, Khodou Pawi, etc bang thupitakin izangkhawm theita uhi. Heutu masate zahna leh amaute phokkikna lungsim zong kineita hi. (f) Khovel gam tuamtuam 32 bangah kikhosa a, tuabanga khosa Zosuante in zong minam leh gam khantouhna ding lunggeelna kineitheita hi. (g) Manipur a om Zosuante adia political status khat neih ding deihna toh kipawlkhopna lianzaw kinei in, thautawi naupangten India toh hiamkhamna nei a, political talk neih ding lametna toh kingaklel hi. Hiai bang dinmun pen, namdang pawlkhat in kum 3040 bang a sual nunga leng a muhlouh uh hamphatna ahi. (h) Minam min toh kipawlkhopna tuamtuam ten eimah septheihna lamciat ah, gam leh nam khantouhna ding deihna toh, kihanciam theita hi. Chibing, khuabing a tuailaite kipawlkhopna tuamtuamte zong Zomi Youth Association cin a lianzawtaangzaizaw in kiseem theita hi. Tuamah bangin, Zomi Siamsin (Zomi Student Federation), Zomi Human Rights Foundation, Zomi Literatures and Languages Society, Zomi Artists Association, Zomi Innkuan, Global Zomi Alliance, Zomi Council, adgte kinei in, mabang panin, kihanciam theita hi. (i) Namdangte toh sepkhop, bawlkhop cihte kithupi ngaihsut a, Alliance tuamtuam ah member kihi koikoi hi. Thukhupna: Haksatna leh buaina tampi tuaksek mahleng, Pasian in hong nusialo in, minam adia isepnate zong a thawnaval ahihlohdan muhtheih om hi. Ahihhangin, Rabindranath Tagore in, miles to go before I sleep (ka ihmutma in ka kalsuan dingsep ding tam mahmah hi) acih bangin, eiten zong I lungtup tangtunna ding in sep le bawl ding tampi mahin samlai hi cih phokhuai kasa hi. Thupil in, tuimal neuneu kigawm in tuipi lianpi bawl hi acih bangin, ih omna leh kihelkhakna ciatah, minam adin haanciamtek leng, Pasian in hunkhat ni ciang in i lungtup hong kuitungsak ding hi. Khat Thang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW A lamdang Leitung, A kipeipei hizen veh! Khat Thang posted on 28 March 2015 at 2:08 pm Lomkholna: Article , Khatthang A lamdang Leitung, A kipeipei hizen veh! 1892 lai-a, Stanford University ah thu piang takpi ahi hi. Kum 18 apha tangvalno khat in, a Sang saap piak ding sum hong nei nawn lo hi. Tagah hi sawnsawn ahih manin sumlepaii a ngetna ding mel thei lo-in hong cimawh lua peuhmah hi. Ahi zongin, ngaihsutna hoih khat hong nei thei-in, a lawmpa khat tawh musical concert khat a sang huang sung vuah bawlin sum zong ding, tua tawh a pilna sin zom ding cih ahi hi. Concert a ding piano tumsiam minthang Ignacy Jan Paderewski cial theih dingin hong kiho thei uh hi. Ahi zongin, piano tumsiampa cial man dingin, a manager pa in 2000 piak dingin ngen hi. Tangvalno nihte zong thukimin concert limcitak khat bawl zawh ding hong kipan uh hi. Pawi bawl ni hong tung petmah hi. Paderewski zong piano tumin Stanford Sangah hong kihel takpi hi. Kamsiatna ci ding i hiam, tangval gel in, a concert ticket zuak uh a tup zah un khawng lo uh ahih manin 1600 bek hong ngah mawk uh hi. Lungkiat huaipi mahin, Paderewski kiangah hong pai uh a, a haksatnate hong gen tamai uh hi. A sum ngah sunsun uh 1600 pia-in, a kisam lai 400 pen check at sa-in pia uh hi. A manlang thei penin hih check na thoh theih dingin hong hanciam nung, ahi zongin, tawmvei bel hong ngak in ci-in kamciam pia-in hong thum uh hi. Paderewski in Hi thei lo ee, tua bang ngeina om lo hi a cih kawmin tua check balkekin, sum tang 1600 zong leh piakkik kawmin, pawi a ding na sum bat tenguh lohkik un la, na Sang saap piak ding kisamte na piak khit uh teh a val lai leh tua a val teng kei hong pia un ci-in gen hi. Tangval nihte zong um ngam lo phialin lamdang sa kawmin, lungdam thu hong ko uh hi. Paderewski a dingin a cihtak het lo huhna khat himah tase leh a picing mihing khat ii sep ding, a kilawm thu khat a sem khia kha na higige mawk hi. Bang dinga, cikmah a, meltheih ngei loh tangvalno nih huh kha ahizen tam maw? Eite in zong, hi bang dan thute tuak kha ngei ciat ding hi hang. Eite a tam zaw in, Hunna pia zenzen hi leng, kei bang ka sup lawh tam? cih lam bek i ngaihsun kha ding hi. A picing lungsim tawh kidim mite in ahih leh, Ken hun kei mawk leng hite bang suak mawk ding? cih lungsim nei uh hi. Ngahkik ding khat peuh lamen masa lo zawin, sep ding a kilawm thumaan khat a semin kingaihsun zaw uh hi. Piano tum siam, Paderewski a gam ahi, Poland ah ciahkikin Prime Minister hong suak hi. Makai picing khat hi sam napi, kamsiatna ci ding hiam, leitung galpi khatna in, Poland gam zong hong nawk kha citciat hi. Poland gammi 1.5 million bang a gam sungah dongtuakin, sum nei lo, an nek ding nei lo-in hong om uh hi. Paderewski huhna ngetna ding thei lo-in, hong cimawh lua peuhmah hi. US gam an le dongtuak huhna lam thu saipi (US Food and Relief Administration) kiangah huhna hong gal nget hi. Tua mun san ah a lian pen thusaipi pa Herbert Hoover (a sawt lo a US President a suak to pa) na hi hi. Hoover in zong Poland gam cimawh dongtuakte huhna piak ding thukim pahin, nek theih tampi puak pah lian hi. Huhna kicing takin hong tung ahih manin, Paderewski a van gikpi hong zang pah hi. Lungdam lua ahih manin, US Food and Relief Administration a makaipipa tawh kimuh ding, lungdam koh dingin vaihawm pah hi. Hong kimuh phet un Paderewski in zahtakna pia in, a mai ah kun phial a lungdam thu a gen sawm laitak, Hoover in nawh satakin, na nial aa, Kei tungah nang lungdam nong koh ding om lo hi, a zahtakhuai Prime Minister aw! Nang bel zong phawk kha nawn khol lo ding hi teh. Ahih hangin, tuma kum tamkhin sim lai-in, US gamah mi nih college sang kah a zop suak theih na dinguh, na huh ngei hi, tua mi nih lakah kei zong khat hing The world is a wonderful place. What goes around comes around! Agelh Thang Cin Lian By: LAIBUSAAL Date: March 29, 2023 THUCIIN HOIH (70) A pan Z Thang Cin Lian, MIT 1999 A nungta Pasian bia inla, um in muang tawntung in. A piangsa thute ah lungkim inla, mailam thu ding encian in. Asia leh apha khentel thei inla, thuciin hoihlote nusia in. Beh leh phung bulphuh lua kei inla, mimal hihna bulphuh zaw in. Biakna leh ngeina khentel thei inla, khua hun kikhel zia phawk in. Ciimna na ngah nadingin hanciam inla, gong tat ding ngaihsun ngei kei in. Cit leh siam ding hanciam tawntung inla, khansia ngei kei in. Deihteel theihte teelsiam inla,deihteel ahilo te ah lungkim in. Duhhap huaiham kei inla, aipeng lungsim nei ngei kei in. Eimite bek it kei inla, midangte zong it ding hanciam in. Encian masa inla, tua khit teh na muhna zia gen pan in. Gamtat hoih cimtak ngei kei inla, mawh nei mite engkha kei in. Geelkholhna tawh nasem inla, hun zatzia siam in. Guihtheih khamtheih pelh inla, siantho ding hanciam den in. Hangsan inla, hang den kei in. Hauh ding hanciam inla, kihau sak kei in. Hazatna lungsim nei kei inla, mi deidan kei in. Heh thei inla, hehpahpah kei in. I pau, I lai leh ngeina te kemcing inla, zumpih ngei kei in. Itna bulphuh in thu vaihawm inla, lampial sak kei in. Kamkhum zang inla, lungsim takpi tawh hopih in. Kampau kidawm inla, kidokkik thei nawnlo ahih lam phawk in. Kha Siangtho lamlahna ngak inla, cilehsa ngaihsutna ultung sak kha ken. Khansau ding hanciam inla, sih khit hun a sawtzawk lam phawk in. Kiphasak kei inla, kiniamkhiat den zaw in. Lai Siangtho sim den inla, nang deihdan zia in deihkaih kha kei in. Lawmte tung ah thuman in citak inla, gen sia ngei kei in. Lawmthak zonbeh inla, na lawmlui te mangngilh tuan kei in. Maitai den inla, kineih khem kei in. Maizum thei inla, maizum den kei in. Mawhna mai sak inla, ciamtehteh kei in. Mi hong muan dingin nungta inla, midang te zong muang in. Midang tawh kipawlkhop siam inla, tang pek ngei kei in. Midang te huhin panpih inla, amau hong thuh kik ding lamen se kei in. Midangte khasiatna dingin gamta kampau kei inla, pahtawi in tha pia zaw in. Min ut peuhpeuh phuak kei inla, khiatna nei ahih lam phawk in. Mite hong pahtawi ding bek ngaihsun kei inla, Pasian deih thu lungngai zaw in. Na khempeuh thungetna tawh apmasa inla, nang theihna suang kei in. Na kisap van bek lei inla, na deih mawkmawk te lei kei in. Na lungdamnate mangngilh kei inla, na lungsim sungah ciamteh khinkhian in. Na theihloh thu dong masa inla, na upmawh thu gen kei in. Nang bek a thupi in kingaihsun kei inla, midang te zong thupi sim in. Ngaihsuncian masa in nasep kipan inla, a nungzuih a hamsat lam phawk in. Ngim leh tup kician nei inla, nung kik ngei kei in. Nisim in Diary gelh den inla, thusia ciamteh kei in. Nu leh pate itin zahtak in vak inla, khasia sak ngei kei in. Nupa kikal ah thuman citak inla, zuau thu gen ngei kei in. Om mawkmawk kei inla, na hoih khat teitei sem in. Omna peuh siangtho sak inla, nuntak siantho ding hanciam in. Pasian nasem te huhin panpih inla, khasia sak se kei in. Piakkhiatna hanciam inla, ciamteh ngei kei in. Pilna na ngah nadingin hanciam in sin inla, kipil sak kei in. Sangkah nuamsa inla, pilna bucing ngah sawm in. Sepna peuhpeuh ah thuman citak in sem inla, lungkia ngei kei in. Sum leh paai tung ah thuman inla, sum zeeksiam in. Sum thupina thei inla, hong siasak thei ahih lam phawk in. Tangthu kan inla, kipumkhat nading hi sak in. Tawlngak hun nuam lazel inla, tawlngak hun tawh hun bei sak kei in. Thu khat peuhpeuh tom ngaihsut lua kei inla, a thu telcian masa zaw in. Thu manlo te ah lungdam kei inla, thuman thutak ah dingtang in. Thuakzawh hatna kisin inla, mite hong simmawh ding in om kei in. Thumanna leh cihtakna khah suah ngei kei inla, tua te kizepna in nei in. Thungen den inla, nakpi tak in sep ding a kisap lam zong phawk in. Thupha na bawl te gengen kei inla, thupha na sante pulak zaw in. Upna tawh kalsuan inla, sepna tawh lakkhia in. Vaihawm siam inla, angvaan luat nei tuan kei in. Vantung gam tun sawm inla, tunbaih ding sawm kei in. Zindo siam inla, zin tun zong siam in. Zomi min it inla, amite nakpi tak in itzaw in. Zuau thu gen ngei kei inla, ciampeel ngei kei in. Tags Rev. Russia te vanlengkhat kia, asungah atuang mi 71 avekin si ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Russia te vanlengkhat kia, asungah atuang mi 71 avekin si posted on 11 February 2018 at 10:13 pm Lomkholna: News , Russia , Sawltak , World Russia te vanlengkhat kia, asungah atuang mi 71 avekin si Russia gamsung ah vanlengkhat kia in mi 71 si cih Reuters pan kiza hi. Tua vanleng pen Russias Saratov Airlines te neihsa hi a, tuni Sunday (Feb 11) ni in Russia gam ii Capital khuapi ahi Moscow City geinai ah akia ahihi. Hih Russia vanleng sungah khualzin Passenger akigawm in 65 hi a, vanlengsung nasem Crew Member pen mi 6 hi in, akigawm in mi 71 atuangkhawm uh ahihi. TASS Report akizakna ah hih vanleng pen Moscows Domodedovo Airport panin alengkhia hi a, alenkhiatzawh Minute 10 ciangin Radar panin kimu nawnlo, mangcip cihi. Hih vanleng pen Russia gamsung kikawmna in akizang Short-haul Regional Antonov AN-148 ahihi. Russia gamsungmah ahi Orenburg Region aom Orsk City zuanin alengkhia ahihi. Russian state TV channel Rossiya-24 ten hih vanleng akiatkhit aki tamzan, athem nengneng in akithehzak pen TV sungah suaksak uhhi. TASS ten agenna ah hih vanlengpen vuuk lakah athemnengneng in kimu a, asungah atuang khempeuh asuakta kuamah kimulo hi cin genkhia uhhi. Hih vanleng kiatna ahangpen tulaitak bangmah genkhiattheih omlo ci a, ahi zongin Russian Transport Ministry ten khuahun Weather siatluat hangzong hithei, vanlenghawlpa ii khialhna Pilot Error zong hithei, aset siatna Technical Failure zong hithei ci uhhi. RT News te genna ah hih atuahsiat Russia te vanleng pen Saratov Airlines An-148 ci uhhi. Tua Saratov Airlines Jet akiatna munsan ah Rescue Teams tezong delhpah uh a, ahi zongin akiatna munsantak ah mawtaw tawh paitheilo uh ahih manin, khetawh paingiat in vadelh uh cihi. Emergency Services te genkhiatna ah hih vanleng akizia pen asungah atuangte asuakta khatzong omloding hi cin genkhia uhhi. Investigative Committee tenzong vanleng akiatna aphual ah Forensic Teams te paisak uh a, hoihtak in velcialna, Criminal Probe bawlna neiding uhhi. Russian Transportation Minister Maxim Sokolov ngiat inzong aphual ah delh cih Russian Media ten genkhia uhhi. Federal Air Transport Agency (Rosaviatsiya) te genna ah hih vanlengpen alenkhiatkhit asawtlo in Radio Contact ki ngahnawnlo in, Air Traffic Control te ii Radar Screen paninzong mancipziau cimawk hi. Tualaitak in Moscow Region, Ramenskoe District sungah alenlaitak hiding kici hi. Khedap bulhlo in lampai pen cidam nadingin hoih ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Khedap bulhlo in lampai pen cidam nadingin hoih posted on 28 April 2016 at 7:39 am Lomkholna: Article , Health , Sawltak Khedap bulhlo in lampai pen cidam nadingin hoih Khedap bulhlo in lampaina hangin lungkham sinkhamna (Stress) kiamsak cihi. Hihpen Germanys Federal Institute for Posture and Mobilisation Support pan amakai pipa ahi Dieter Breithecker in agenkhiat hi a, ih khetul leh khepek tawh leilak aki sukkhakna hangin lunggimna leh lungsim zawngkhalna te damsaktuam aci ahihi. Ih Zogam khuaneu khuata te ah khedap bulhzolo ki tamlai mahmah a, khedap bulhloh ahoihna om ahihleh lungdamhuai cihding ahihi. Khedap bulhloh hoih cihsam hangin ninbu lomlak, thawlkitam leh linglak cihte lakah khedap bulhlo in paipahding hilo hi. Tuabang lauhuaina tepan kidaltheih nadingmah in khedap akibawl masa hizaw hi. Ahi zongin tuhunciang adiakdiak numei te bulhding in khedap tawsang tulsang atuamtuam kibawl in kibulh a, khedap tawsanglua bulhzong hoihtuak hetlo hi. Adiakdiak in nupi naupaai te adingin khedap tulsang pen hoih hetlo hi. Khedap bulhlo in paileng ahoihna munpen sehnellak leh suanghumnel lak cihkhawng hiphadiak a, tua munte ah khedap bulhlo in paileng phattuamna tampi hongpiathei nahi gige hi. Tua ahih manin sumnei mihau te tuipigei Beach khawngah tawlnga dingin zintheizel uh a, tuipinawl sehnel lakah khedap bulhlo in pai hiathiat thei uhhi. A khangto gamte ah tuhun ciangin tuipigei pai akul tektek nawnloding in Apartment leh Condominium khawngah sehnel leh suanghum tawh lampai nading atuam in kibawlta hi. More: Khedap taih tawh sum a zong mizawng pa in kua a hihiam? Phalbi zingsangtung lopa leh kiaktung ah daitui akawt nilhnelh laitak khedap lotawh atungah paileng hoihphadiak cin Dieter Breithecker in genthuah hi. Khedap bulhlo in lampai hoih ahih mawkleh sumbei dinglah hisamlo ahihciang eizong khedap bulhlo in paimawkleng hoihlodia?
