"url": " comkhang-kilumlet-hau-za-cin", "depth": 1 --- Khang Kilumlet Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Khang Kilumlet Hau Za Cin posted on 10 April 2016 at 7:00 am Lomkholna: Article, Hauzacin Khang Kilumlet Hau Za Cin A diak in gam khangtote ah khang kilamdang hi. Numeite lapsangna pan numei leh pasal liangko kikimna cihte kiuanggen, kiuangbawl in kilamdanna tampi piangsak hi. Khangno sung diakdiak ah kilamdanna tam a, nasepna leh summuhna zong kilamdang hi. Tuate hangin innsung leh khuasung ah zong kilamdanna tampi piangsak hi. Numei tampi in pasal te mah bangin sum leh pai muta uh a, pawlkhat bangin pasal sangin khasum tam sangzaw hi. USA, Europe, Japan, Korea gamte ah nasia diak hi ciin Chicago khuapi pan thukizakna khat in gen hi. Tua bang mun ah pasal pen innsung vak hi nawnlo in numei pen innsung vak suak hi. Tua tawh kiton in innsungah thuneihna zong kilehbulh in, pasal pen inntekpa hinawnlo in numei in inntekpa suakta hi. Tua banga kilamdanna pen gam khangto masa peuhmah ah kimu hamtang hi ci uh hi. Numei pasal nei nailo te khasum a tam mahmah ciang a pasal deihdan uh zong tuam mahmah a, a lametna uh zong sang mahmah hi. Khuata pan himah leh khasum a tam ciangin khuapi ah pasal zong dingin vanleng tawh leng in va delh kawikawi uh hi. NY, Paris, London, Tokyo, etc cihte ah Nipini khawng va zang in kikholhna mun (club) peuh ah va tualbual uh a, pasal ding va zong uh hi. A mu a om hangin a tamzaw in a lamet uh bang mulo hi, kici hi. Tua bang mun ah kibual pasal tampi pen sum leh pai kisam hilo uh ahih manin khasum tam sang numei deih masalo in numei hoih bek mah a deih masa pawl na hi bilbel uh hi. Numeite pen pasal sangin pilna zonna ah a khuak uh manlangzaw ahih manin thei pahpah uh a, pasal tampi sangin siambaihzaw, thei baihzaw ahih manin pasalte in banlo uh hi. Tua banga amau a banlo te numeite in na mitsuan masalo in amau sanga degree niamzaw, amau sanga khasum niamzaw, amau sanga lungsim ziakaizaw cihte numeite in neu etnopna nei diak uh hi (pasalte sang). Tua manin nungak tampi in pasal neihloh lawh, pasal a kisapna uh zong om sa tuanlo cih bangin khatguak om paisuak uh hi. Khanglui hun a pasal in vak ding cih banga ngaihsutna om nawnlo ahih manin numei in pasal a kisapna omlo ci lel uh hi. Tua bang a paitoh zel leh pasal in lah ta nei theilo ahih manin leitung luah ding mihing khang kizopna tampi kilamdang ding hi, kici hi. Numeite in ta neilo in pasal nei nuam kei le uh pasal te bek in leitungah nopsa tuan ding ahi hiam ci uh hi. Pasal khasum kisam hetlo a numei a om theih ciangin, amau leh amau a kivak theih ciangin innsungah, khuasungah kua thuneizaw ding, kua tokhom tungah tu ding cih kinialna tam semsem hi ci uh hi. Numeite pilna, siamna, leh degree te hong sang deuhdeuh ciangin ama mipih sung sangin minam dang lak ah kibual nuamzaw hamtang hi ci uh hi. Ahang pen mipih sungah kibual sangin minam dang lak ah kibual le uh thupi kisa uh, mite in a pi muh ding sa uh hi kici hi. Tua manin minam dang tawh kitenna, kingaihna, kizopna cihte neizaw hamtang uh hi. Tua banga minam dang tawh a kikhawllo, minam lak ah a tualbawl zolo a numei pihte uh a teekkuan, a upat lam uh ciang eng mahmah uh hi ci hi. A hoihna, a thahatna teng a bei ciang amau a it taktak ding pen a mipihte bek mah na hita ahih manin nungkik nuam liang uh a, ahi zongin kikhel khinta ahih manin a hun nunung lam vuah lungzuang khuangai in hehpihhuai mahmah uh hi kici hi. Zomi sung bel tua bang i om nai diam ka thei kei hi. Minam khangto ihih ciang kiphu toto veve ding hihtuak hi. Articles Christian Hymn-te Tangthu Knowledge Kei Ading Tam Khang Suangpi (Rock of Ages) AgelhZam Khat Kham By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 23, 2021 Kei Ading Tam Khang Suangpi Rock of Ages (Isaiah 26:4) AgelhZam Khat Kham Augustus M. Toplady(1740-1778) Thomas Hastings (1784-1872) Christian hymn-te laka suangmanpha tawh a kibang hih la pen Mangkam-a kisa late lakah a kisa munpen, a koimapeuh-a , a kuamapeuh in a deihpen la khat ahi hi. Salvation Army-te hotkhiat lamdung lamvai a mi vakvaite-a kipan a kivuina ah hih la mah kisa-a Westminter Abbey innpi sung thawn ziahziah-a a kisak Prime Minister Gladstone dong, mi khempeuhte kha lam tangsapna khempeuh a cingsak la hi, ci-in kigen helzen hi. Hih la a phuakpa Augustus Montague Toplady pen England gam Farnham ah November 4, 1740 ni-in suak hi. A pa galkap sunga major khat ahi hi. Toplady a ngek lai-in a pa in sihsan hi. Kum 16 a phak-in, Ireland a hawh laitak piangthak hi. Dublin, Ireland-a Trinity College panin sang a zawh khit ciang, 1762 kumin Anglican pawlpi sungah ordination kipia hi. A pumpi mahmah hat lohna leh lungdamna thu a genna ah na a uangsep luatna hangin kum tawm mahmah lai, kum 38 a phak-in si hi. Tawlkhat sung John Wesley, Charles Wesley-te leh Mothodist nasepnate thupisa mahmah a, ahi zongin John Calvin election doctrine lam mah ah kipzaw a, Arminian upna nei Wesley-te unau tawh sermon, laihawm tuamtuam leh kiselna debate peuh-in khat le khat ki dodo uh hi. 1776 kumin in Toplady in The Gospel Magazine sunga a laigelhna hih lamalte-in khuma, A Living and Dying Prayer for the Holiest Believer in the World cih thulu pia hi. Sianthosakna tawh kisai thu ummi khat in mawhna kici peuhmah pelh-a mawhna kisikkikna leh mawhna nei lo-a siangtho kiuhkeuh-a om ding cih Arminian upna a langpanna-a a gelh ahi hi. Taang nihna ah hih bangin na gen hi: Ka khut in ka sepna tawh, Thukham deihna cin zo lo; Hahkat den zo mah leng zong, Tawp lo khitui luan hang zong; Mawhna kiphel zo sam lo, Nangmah bek in nong hon zo. Toplady in mi khat kum 80 nungta hi leh mawhna awn tul nih leh awn za nga ( 2.5 billion) bang bawl kha thei ding ci-in seh a, kuamah peuhmah amah leh amah a kihonkhia zo ngei ding hi lo a, Honpa kisam hi, cih thu nakpi-a a genna tungtawna hong piangkhia la ahi hi. Toplady in hih la a phuahna ah a nungthu nih peuhmah om hi, ci-in kiciamteh hi. A masa pen Dr. Daniel Brevints sermon a zakna pana piang ahi hi. Tua sermon sungah siapa in, O Israel Suangpi, Hotkhiatna Suangpi, kei adinga kisatkham a khaangtam Suangpi aw, Emmaus a na nungzuite tawh anlum na balkhap lai-a na nungzuite lungsim bangin hih anlum ka balkhap uh ciangin Nangma nasem dingin ka lungsim uh hong lawpsak in. Na pang pana hong zuikhawm sisan leh tuite Horeb vum tungah dinga a gamlapi pana lunggulh bangin hong omsak kei in ci-in lunggulhna lianpi tawh a genna a zak ciangin a lungsim nakpi-in sukha a, mangngilh thei mahmah lo hi. A nihna pen bel nikhat, Topladay lungnuam takin Barrington Coombs ah vak hiathiat hi. Thakhat thu-in huihpi guahpi hong kipeii-a, van-ging keekkia in lau huai lua mahmah hi. A biakinn lamah taikik ding ci leh lah gamla lua zek-a, tua Coombs a suangpi kitam sung khat ah bu hi. A kiim a paam ah huih le guah nasia mah mah a, ahih hangin tua suangtumpi kitam sung beel ahih manin bittak-in om hi. Tua banga huihpi le guah kithuah a tuah laitak, suangtumpi bela bitna a ngah laitak-in a lungsim-ah Dr. Brevint semon hong suak denden hi. Tua a tuah huihpi leh guahpi pan a suahtak nadinga suangpi kitam heenga a bukna pen Zeisu Khazih in Calvary singlamteh tunga a nasep tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam, ci-in ngaihsun hi. Huihpi dai ta hi. Pastor Toplady zong a biakinn zuan-in ciah vingvenga, tua ni-a thupiangte leh thupiangte tungtawna a ngaihsutnate a lungsim pan a man ma-in, Kei ading tam khang suangpi, Nangma sung hong beel sak aw ci-in la hong phuak hi. Pastor Toplady phuah lamalte tawh kituak ding la-aw American church musician minthang mahmah Thomas Hastings in 1830 kum-a a phuah ahi hi. Thomas Hastings pen ama pilna siamnate America gam buppi ah Pasian phatna late a khantoh nadinga a pumpiak masapen ahi hi. Amah mah in khatvei, The homage that we owe the Almighty God calls for the noblest and most reverential tribute that music can render ci-in gen ngiat hi. Amah October 15, 1784 ni-in Washington, Connecticut ah suak hi. Music taktak a sinna tam lo-in a mit mahmah a hat loh den hangin a khan sungin church music bu 50 sanga tawmzaw lo gelh a, la-aw dawng 1000 leh lamal dawng 600 phuak hi. Mi tuamtuamte phuahsa la bu 50 bangmah kaikhawm lai hi. 1858 kumin the University of the City of New York in ama nasepna thupite pahtawina-in Doctor of Music Degree pia hi. American church music a khangtosak taktak Thomas Hastings leh Lowell Mason hi, ci-a ciaptehna ngah hi. Ama la-aw phuahte lakah hih la, Kei Ading Ta m Khang Suangpi (Rock of Ages) banah, Hong Hon Topa Zeisu Tal-Ah (Majestic Sweetness Sits Enthroned ), A Dahte Hong Pai un (Come, Ye Disconsolate), From Every Storm Wind That Blows cih kihel hi. Kei aa-ding tam Khang Suangpi, Nangma sung kong beel ding hi. Na pangvang pan hong ki zui, Thakhat luang khia si leh tui Mawh kiphel thuapna hi heh, Hong sut hen la hong sawp hen. Kakhut in ka sepna tawh, Thukham deihna cin zolo Hahkat den zo mah leng zong, Tawp lo khitui luang hangzong Mawhna kiphel zo samlo, Nang mah bek in hong hon zo Khutsung bangmah keng lopi, Na sing lamteh kong beel hi. Puan neilo Nangmahn nong guan, Cimawh hehpihna kong zuan Kih huai tuinak kong delh hi. Nong sil keh ka si ding hi. Kak nuntak lai hi ta leh, Ka sih laitak hi ta leh Theih loh gam ka kah ciang zong, Thukhenna mai kong tun dong Kei taang kitam suangpi aw, Nang mah sung hong beel sak aw. Lailui khua ah ZCD MP te gualzawhna pawi kibawl ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Lailui khua ah ZCD MP te gualzawhna pawi kibawl posted on 21 April 2016 at 5:21 pm Lomkholna: News , ZCD , Zomi Lailui khua ah ZCD MP te gualzawhna pawi kibawl A zah tak huai kong it kong muang uh Zomidaily aw hih anuai aa kong lai puak uh Zomidaily Thu Thang tuam2 ah nong hel sak nading un zahtak na lianpi tawh LaiLui Khua ZCD in kong thum kong gen uh hi. Lai mal cing lo mun te ah nong beklam sak nading uh leh azak nop lo laimal te ah deihsak na tawh nong huh lai nading un zong kong thum nuam lai uh hi. April 20. 2016 ni in Lai Lui khua ah ZCD gualzawh picin Lungdam koh bawl na ah ZCD MP te ki sam in hong pai uh ahih man in khuami te ki lungdam pha mah2 hi. ZCD MP te vai dawn na khuami ten nei uh aa hih bang in na dawn uh hi Zosuan Zo Von Tawi Te Zua Pa Teng Aw Tang Bang Ong Dam Uh Maw ci in Zo ngei na te tawh ki dawn in nuam ki sa in ki lungdam thei mah2 hi. ZCD MP pan mailam kalsuan dan ding, sep leh bawl dan ding leh ZCD ii ngiim na te leh muh dan te Khua mi te tung hong gen khia uh ahih man in tha ki ngah in ki lawp mah2 hi. ZCD MP te Vok nih tawh muakna ki nei in khuami te tawh ZCD gualzawh lungdam koh na annkuang ki umkhawm in Zosuan Zo Von Tawi te Zua Pa teng aw khan kum khua sawn in tangbang hong dam un maw ci in annlum tawh ki valh suk in ankam lim mah2 hi. Gual zawh na hong pia ih biak Pasian min thang ta hen la ZCD MP te Khan Kum Khua Sawn hen la ZCD Khuam Bang Kho den ta hen. Agelh CSKhai By: LAIBUSAAL Date: May 31, 2020 A KI SIASATE A PUAH KIKTE HONG KI CI DING HI (Isaiah 58:12) Agelh CSKhai Thupatna 1939 September 3 ni in Germa n galkapte in Poland gam a simna uh hangin leitung galpi nihna hong kipa n khia hi. Hih galpisungah Ger man galkapte bek hilo in mipitampi in a nuntakna uh bei lawh uh hi. Mi h ing bek hilo in, inn le lote ki siacip hi. Galpi nihna hang in meigon g nupi tul 300 kiim om hi ki ci hi. Pasal tampi g alsung ah si a hih manin, pasal na sep, numei nasep cih omlo in, numeite in nasia takin na sem uh hi. Ger many gam hong lamkik numeit e a hi uh hi, ci uh hi. Galpi nihna hangin Germany khennih kisuah a East le West German y ki ci hi. East Germany Soviet Union in uka , West Germany a hih leh USA, French le Britain in hawm uh hi. Thudang khat in genleng East Germany ah Communism ukna tawh a kikalsuan laitak in West Germany ah Dem ocracy ukna tawh kalsuan cihna a hihi. E ast le West kikal ah kilangdona , ki elna lianpi hong om hi. Berlin khuapi sungah Berliner Mauer (Berlin Wall) ci in khuampi ki phuta , West le East ki kawmna haksa sak hi. East le West kideidanna, muhzi a le sanzia ki lamdangna om k awmkal ah, November 9 , 1989 ni in Berlin Kulhpi hong ki phukkhia a, West l eh East ki deidanna beita hi. 1990 kumciangin galpi nihna hang a ki khen East leh West G ermany Wiedervereinigung 1990 hong ki gawmkik ngeu uh a, Deutschlan d ki ci h i. East le West hong k i gawmkik ciangin hong th ahat mahmah uh a, European U nion sung thu neihna, thu vai hawmna lianpipite ah hong ki helzo pah uh hi. Tua banah Galpi nihna laia vutlevai suaksa a gamuh hong puahkik manun, tu hunciangin leitung gamhau le gamthupi te lak ah hong ki helkik zota uh hi. Galpi ni hna lai a, a kisiasa a inn a lo te bek uh puahlo in, a lungs im uh zong puah uh hi. Cik mahhuni n East le West Germany ki gawm kik zo ngei nawn loding hi, a ki ci sa na ngawn, a lungsim te uh hongpuah in, lungsimpicing le tangzaitak in thu ho ng vaihawmkhawm uh a, hong ki pumkhat kikzo lel mawk uh hi. Israelte Ki Makaihzia Lungngaihkikna Israelte ki maikaih zia in : 1. Nu le pate makaihna (Abramham, Isaak, Jacob), 2. Kamsangte le Siampite makaihna (Moses, Aron), 3. Thukhente makaihna (Othniel, Deborah), 4. Kumpite makaihna (Saul, David, Solomon) cih bangin ki khen thei hi. Israel te sungpan in kumpi a sem masa pen in Saul a hihi. Saul, David, Solomon te hunsung a kumpi gamuh khangin tha hat mahmah hi. BC 930 ciangin Solomon tap a Rehoboam in a pa kumpiza hong laihta hi. R ehoboam in kumpi hongsep a sawtlo in a pa Kumpi gam khennih hong kisuah hi. Saklamgam, Northern Kingdom or Israel ki ci a, Khanglamgam Southern Kingdom or Judah gam kici hi . Hunmasa laia, a thahat, a vanglian gam ki thutuahlohna le ki pumkhatlohna hangin Assyria le Babylonte khutnuai ah hong omta uh hi. BC 722 kumin Assy ria te in Northern Kingdom sim in, Northern Kindom khuapi Samaria suksiatsaka, Israel mitampi sila dingin ciahpih hi. Tuabang mahin BC 586 kum in Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar makaihna tawh Southern Kingdom hong do uh a, Southern Kingdom te khuapi Jerusalem susia in Judah mi tampite Babylon gamah ciahpi h in kum 70 sung sal in khawi uh hi. Saul, David le Solomon ten Kumpi a sepsungun Jewste kumpi gam kip hi. Ahi zongin, Nothern leh Southern ci in gamnih hong suah uhciangin a beisa hunlai bangin thahat zo nawnlo uh a, mite sila a suak uh ahihi. Ih minam sung, pawlpi sung, Innkuansungah kilemna, ki thutuakna, kipumkhatna a om kei leh mite sila kisuak thei cihna hi. Zomite paunak a hi,, Akta mangkuan ki tutu a cih tawh a ki banglel ding a hihi. Israel te khatvei leh Assyriate sila, khatvei leh Babylonte sila suak uhhi. Babylon saltanna panin a gamuh ah hongciah kik uh ciangin, Isaiah tungtawn in Pasian in Israel te hopih hi. Note pen a siasa a puah kikte, munsiate a ngei a bangsak kikte hong kici ding hi (Isaiah 58:12) ci hi. Pasian thu mangin Assyriate le Babylonte suksiatsa a gamte uh puah kikding hong kipan uh hi. Hi bang in gam le lei puahkikna sungah lauhuaina tampi tuakkha a hihmanun, na a sepkawm un, a khutlangkhat uhtawh a van puak uh lenin, a khut langkhat uh ah galhiam tawi uh hi (Nehemiah 4:17). Kumtampi sung a ki mangngilhsa, gamneilo tu in gamkip a nei minamte hongsuak kikta uh hi. Pasian tawh ih ki zopna, Zomi pih dangte tawh i h ki zopnate ki puahpha kik ni. Beh thupitsakluatna, pawlpi thupitsakluatna, kampau awsuah thupitsak luatnate in ih ki pumkhat ding hong dal thei tawntung a hihman in ki ngaihsun pha kikni. Tedim, Sihzang, Zo, Dim, Vaiphei, Paihte, Saizang, Teizang, Vangteh, Khuano, Dapzal , T hahdo cih bang a kipan ih ki zopna te khitciangin , ih unau, Falam, Khalkha, Matu, Mindat, Paletwa, Mizo cihte tawh ih ki zopnate zong ki puahpha kik ni. Lungsimpi cing le, thusau khual zote nase p nate mah hong tangzai zaw veve ding hi. Eite unau sanggam khat ih hi a, Zogam le Zomi te a zuunnuamte ih hi uh hi . Ih sanggamte in tonkhuang a kaihni un, zo in, a ki lungdampih di ngte ih hi uh hi. Vangik a puakni un a puakpih dingte i h hi uh hi. Pasian bawlsa mihingte bek hilo in singkung le lopa te tawh ih kizopna te puahph a kik in l obang a tuulsa Zogam New Eden hong suak kiknading in panla in mapang khawm ni. Tua bang lungtangpuak nei in, na ih sep khop ciang in ih gam ih lei hong no suak kik ding a, Pasian in Israelte tungah Note a kisiasa munte a puah kikte ho ng kici ding hi ( Isaiah 58: 12) a cih bangin l obang a tulsa Zogam a P uahkikte hong kici ding hi. Articles Christian Hymn-te Tangthu Knowledge Kei Ading Tam Khang Suangpi (Rock of Ages) AgelhZam Khat Kham By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 23, 2021 Kei Ading Tam Khang Suangpi Rock of Ages (Isaiah 26:4) AgelhZam Khat Kham Augustus M. Toplady(1740-1778) Thomas Hastings (1784-1872) Christian hymn-te laka suangmanpha tawh a kibang hih la pen Mangkam-a kisa late lakah a kisa munpen, a koimapeuh-a , a kuamapeuh in a deihpen la khat ahi hi. Salvation Army-te hotkhiat lamdung lamvai a mi vakvaite-a kipan a kivuina ah hih la mah kisa-a Westminter Abbey innpi sung thawn ziahziah-a a kisak Prime Minister Gladstone dong, mi khempeuhte kha lam tangsapna khempeuh a cingsak la hi, ci-in kigen helzen hi. Hih la a phuakpa Augustus Montague Toplady pen England gam Farnham ah November 4, 1740 ni-in suak hi. A pa galkap sunga major khat ahi hi. Toplady a ngek lai-in a pa in sihsan hi. Kum 16 a phak-in, Ireland a hawh laitak piangthak hi. Dublin, Ireland-a Trinity College panin sang a zawh khit ciang, 1762 kumin Anglican pawlpi sungah ordination kipia hi. A pumpi mahmah hat lohna leh lungdamna thu a genna ah na a uangsep luatna hangin kum tawm mahmah lai, kum 38 a phak-in si hi. Tawlkhat sung John Wesley, Charles Wesley-te leh Mothodist nasepnate thupisa mahmah a, ahi zongin John Calvin election doctrine lam mah ah kipzaw a, Arminian upna nei Wesley-te unau tawh sermon, laihawm tuamtuam leh kiselna debate peuh-in khat le khat ki dodo uh hi. 1776 kumin in Toplady in The Gospel Magazine sunga a laigelhna hih lamalte-in khuma, A Living and Dying Prayer for the Holiest Believer in the World cih thulu pia hi. Sianthosakna tawh kisai thu ummi khat in mawhna kici peuhmah pelh-a mawhna kisikkikna leh mawhna nei lo-a siangtho kiuhkeuh-a om ding cih Arminian upna a langpanna-a a gelh ahi hi. Taang nihna ah hih bangin na gen hi: Ka khut in ka sepna tawh, Thukham deihna cin zo lo; Hahkat den zo mah leng zong, Tawp lo khitui luan hang zong; Mawhna kiphel zo sam lo, Nangmah bek in nong hon zo. Toplady in mi khat kum 80 nungta hi leh mawhna awn tul nih leh awn za nga ( 2.5 billion) bang bawl kha thei ding ci-in seh a, kuamah peuhmah amah leh amah a kihonkhia zo ngei ding hi lo a, Honpa kisam hi, cih thu nakpi-a a genna tungtawna hong piangkhia la ahi hi. Toplady in hih la a phuahna ah a nungthu nih peuhmah om hi, ci-in kiciamteh hi. A masa pen Dr. Daniel Brevints sermon a zakna pana piang ahi hi. Tua sermon sungah siapa in, O Israel Suangpi, Hotkhiatna Suangpi, kei adinga kisatkham a khaangtam Suangpi aw, Emmaus a na nungzuite tawh anlum na balkhap lai-a na nungzuite lungsim bangin hih anlum ka balkhap uh ciangin Nangma nasem dingin ka lungsim uh hong lawpsak in. Na pang pana hong zuikhawm sisan leh tuite Horeb vum tungah dinga a gamlapi pana lunggulh bangin hong omsak kei in ci-in lunggulhna lianpi tawh a genna a zak ciangin a lungsim nakpi-in sukha a, mangngilh thei mahmah lo hi. A nihna pen bel nikhat, Topladay lungnuam takin Barrington Coombs ah vak hiathiat hi. Thakhat thu-in huihpi guahpi hong kipeii-a, van-ging keekkia in lau huai lua mahmah hi. A biakinn lamah taikik ding ci leh lah gamla lua zek-a, tua Coombs a suangpi kitam sung khat ah bu hi. A kiim a paam ah huih le guah nasia mah mah a, ahih hangin tua suangtumpi kitam sung beel ahih manin bittak-in om hi. Tua banga huihpi le guah kithuah a tuah laitak, suangtumpi bela bitna a ngah laitak-in a lungsim-ah Dr. Brevint semon hong suak denden hi. Tua a tuah huihpi leh guahpi pan a suahtak nadinga suangpi kitam heenga a bukna pen Zeisu Khazih in Calvary singlamteh tunga a nasep tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam, ci-in ngaihsun hi. Huihpi dai ta hi. Pastor Toplady zong a biakinn zuan-in ciah vingvenga, tua ni-a thupiangte leh thupiangte tungtawna a ngaihsutnate a lungsim pan a man ma-in, Kei ading tam khang suangpi, Nangma sung hong beel sak aw ci-in la hong phuak hi. Pastor Toplady phuah lamalte tawh kituak ding la-aw American church musician minthang mahmah Thomas Hastings in 1830 kum-a a phuah ahi hi. Thomas Hastings pen ama pilna siamnate America gam buppi ah Pasian phatna late a khantoh nadinga a pumpiak masapen ahi hi. Amah mah in khatvei, The homage that we owe the Almighty God calls for the noblest and most reverential tribute that music can render ci-in gen ngiat hi. Amah October 15, 1784 ni-in Washington, Connecticut ah suak hi. Music taktak a sinna tam lo-in a mit mahmah a hat loh den hangin a khan sungin church music bu 50 sanga tawmzaw lo gelh a, la-aw dawng 1000 leh lamal dawng 600 phuak hi. Mi tuamtuamte phuahsa la bu 50 bangmah kaikhawm lai hi. 1858 kumin the University of the City of New York in ama nasepna thupite pahtawina-in Doctor of Music Degree pia hi. American church music a khangtosak taktak Thomas Hastings leh Lowell Mason hi, ci-a ciaptehna ngah hi. Ama la-aw phuahte lakah hih la, Kei Ading Ta m Khang Suangpi (Rock of Ages) banah, Hong Hon Topa Zeisu Tal-Ah (Majestic Sweetness Sits Enthroned ), A Dahte Hong Pai un (Come, Ye Disconsolate), From Every Storm Wind That Blows cih kihel hi. Kei aa-ding tam Khang Suangpi, Nangma sung kong beel ding hi. Na pangvang pan hong ki zui, Thakhat luang khia si leh tui Mawh kiphel thuapna hi heh, Hong sut hen la hong sawp hen. Kakhut in ka sepna tawh, Thukham deihna cin zolo Hahkat den zo mah leng zong, Tawp lo khitui luang hangzong Mawhna kiphel zo samlo, Nang mah bek in hong hon zo Khutsung bangmah keng lopi, Na sing lamteh kong beel hi. Puan neilo Nangmahn nong guan, Cimawh hehpihna kong zuan Kih huai tuinak kong delh hi. Nong sil keh ka si ding hi. Kak nuntak lai hi ta leh, Ka sih laitak hi ta leh Theih loh gam ka kah ciang zong, Thukhenna mai kong tun dong Kei taang kitam suangpi aw, Nang mah sung hong beel sak aw. Pilna tua zah in khang hat, manlang mahmahta a, mihingte in tua khantohna pen kipuahphatna in zangin nuntakna a nopzawknang, nek leh dawn ah a ki ningcin zawknang leh sep leh bawl ah tawldamna a ngahna dingun zang ta uh hi. Hih bang pilna pen pawlpi (Church) leh taangmi (Society) adingin phattuamna tampi om hi. A taktak in ci leng science khantohna hangin Gospel puakkhiatna zong nakpi takin thahat tuam hi. Pasian pilna namkim hong piapa hi a, mihingte in Pasian thu thuk itheihtheihna tem ah zong Pasian hong piak mah ahi hi. I pilna te mihing te adingin siatna lauhuai pen hi mahleh Pasian kiang pan hong pai pilna ahi hi. Mi khat in pilna a sin leh tua pilna tungtawnin Pasian aw a za ahi hi. Mi khat in leitung pianzia a sin leh tua mah tungtawn in Pasian aw a za, a ngai, a thei leh a tel mi ahi hi. Banghang hiam cih leh science ahih kei leh pilna pen Pasian aw, Pasian kam, leitung ah a kizaktheihna lampi ahi hi. Ahi zongin science pilna pen a hoih lam leh a sia lam in piang thei a, kizang khial thei, hong puahpha thei hi. Mi khat in buangnai lam siamna nei hileh a hoih lamin zang thei a, a sia lamin zong bomb bawlna khawngin zang thei hi. A hoih lamin zang hileh mihingte nuntakna a nuam sak leh metna tampi a piangsak thei hinapi bomb banga a hong kizat ciangin mihing tampi nuntakna susia thei hong suak leuleu hi. Tua bang ahih manin science in bangci zat dinga, koi lam ah zang ding cih ciangtanna neilo hi. Ahih leh tua bang ciangtanna tua pilna in neilo hitamawk leh kuan ciangtan kula, kuan hong vaihawmsak kul ding hiam? Mihing pilna pen mihing thupina in a uk kul ding hi. Hih lai ah Lai Siangtho in na lamdangpi khat hong theisak hi. Mihingte pilna sangpen dong ahong hilh a, mihing sia leh pha theihna leh kha leh pumpi manphatna dong in Pasian vangliatna tawh a hong hilh hi. Tua hi a, Lai Siangtho pen a zang mite adingin, Khantawn nuntakna lamlak hong suak hi. Mipil misiamte adingin zong nuntakna leh pilna lamlak ahi hi. Science (mihingzontawm pilna) pen Pasian in leitung nate tungtawna hong hopihna leh hong kamgenna hita leh Lai Siangtho pen muh theih teekteek sim theih teekteek dinga laimal tawh hong hopihna hi leuleu ding hi. Pasian pen na khempeuh a gelpa kici hi. Scientist cingzo takatk lote in thukanmi te gensia ding uh a, tua mah bangin Lai Siangtho thu (theology) kan cian zo taktak lo mite in science pilna pen gensia thei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin science leh Theology pen kikhen thei hilo a, a kituaklo zong hilo in, a ki bucingsak tuah hizaw uh hi. Pasian thu kanna (theology) omlo in science a picin zawhloh mah bangin science lo in theology zong a picing zo kei hi. Thau bang hileh a vui leh a tang bang hi uh hi. Paih zawk ding omlo. Tua hi a, pilna a sang deudeuh ciangin, mi a pil deuhdeuh ciangin Pasian om hi cih tel deuhdeuh uh hi. Hau Za Cin Ni 21.2.1992 Laithaini PS: Ka khut tawh ka gelh tangtang article te computer tawh kong khenkhia kik hi. , myriad, various, or numerous Yue," which was an ancient Chinese name for the societies of the regions that are now southern China he Japanese common noun tōmorokoshi トウモロコシ 玉蜀黍 , which refers to maize appears to contain an element cognate with the proper noun formerly used in reference to China lthough tōmorokoshi is traditionally written with Chinese characters that literally mean "jade Shu millet ", the etymology of the Japanese word appears to go back to "Tang morokoshi ", in which morokoshi was the obsolete Japanese name for China as well as the Japanese word for sorghum which seems to have been introduced into Japan from China angi edit 1837 map of Mongol Empire, showing Mangi in southern China From Chinese Manzi 蠻子, southern barbarians he division of north and south China under the Jin dynasty and Song dynasty weakened the idea of a unified China, and it was common for non-Han peoples to refer to the politically disparate North and South by different names for some time hile Northern China was called Cathay Southern China was referred to as Mangi anzi often appears in documents of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty as a disparaging term for Southern China he Mongols also called Southern Chinese Nangkiyas or Nangkiyad and considered them ethnically distinct from North Chinese he word Manzi reached the Western world as Mangi as used by Marco Polo, which is a name commonly found on medieval maps he Chinese themselves considered Manzi to be derogatory and never used it as a self-appellation.

Minam Itna-in Namdang Huatna Hilo Pu Zokhai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Minam Itna-in Namdang Huatna Hilo Pu Zokhai posted on 18 October 2016 at 3:03 pm Lomkholna: News , Politics , Zokhai , Zomi Minam Itna-in Namdang Huatna Hilo Pu Zokhai Zomi Minam vaai I-suut ciang-in Zomi is Zomi, non-Zomi is not Zomi hilel-a, non-Zomite muhdah gaalbawl nading om laaizang lo-hi. Atung-a Zing Cung-tawh maaitai tak-in kam ka-kumkhawm thei lel uh-a, ahizong-in kote sung-a national or ethnical spirit kidang sitset-hi. Ama sung-ah bang om cih ka-thei kei-a, ka upmawh ahbel Chin State sung-ah Chin minpua Laimite khantoh nading vei mahmah ding-in ka-umhi. Kei lungsim ahzong Zomite-in Zomi-ah kihual-a masuan lianpi khat apangkhawm theiding lunggulhna lianpi om-hi. Tua akidang veina leh deihnate leh personal leh social interaction kisukha lo-hi, mihai khenkhat ahihleh kisukha sak-in ki pummuhdah maimaibel omthei-hi. Zomi kei mimal view-ah Laimi huamlo kahih man-in Zing Cung-tawh Zomi-tawh kisai thute kuppih lo-in Chin State development bekmah ka kuppih-hi. Nam-in gii nei-in huang nei lel-a, ki-gaalbawl loh man-a kipawlpah, sungthu tengkhawng genpah puahpuah zawzending hilo cih kei mimal muhna ahihi. Tuni saangkhaak kahih man-in groups member teng-in athuak nahita vevua hehehee. Tedim khuapi ah (03 February) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Tedim khuapi ah (03 February) posted on 4 February 2015 at 12:10 am Lomkholna: News , Tedim , Zomi Tedim khuapi ah (03 February) Lai at dan siamlo pipi aa, TEDIM KHUAPI AH cih thulu tawh ka theih sunsun lai ka at te hong simsak a, tha hong piate khempeuh tungah lungdam hong ko ing. TEDIM KHUAPI AH khua hun tawmtawm hong kikhel in, a vot pan zong damdamin hong lum pian hi. Nitak nai khat khit khawng hi leh tansawm laivuan huihkhi hong langin, tansawm laivuan dingte bang kiphawktuam peuhmah hi. TEDIM KHUAPI AH nung a ka helsa hita leh EBC khawmpi a dingin bawda tual ah, state kilam pen hoih mahmah dingin lam et huai hi. Ta ban ah, bawda tual dim in nidang in hileh takteh khawng kiphah pen tung mipi tutna ding tutna giat U Tunta khutsiamte in bawl in zo dekddek ta uh cih ding hi. A ni theilian keng, nai in um ing. TCBCte in zong biakinn tual dimin Mandat bawlsan uh a, hih zong nopci ding hi. Tualo Tuiphumte bel khuano lam ah, Association kumcinte sim dingin zing ah thai ah ding khia dingin lingling ta uh hi. TEDIM KHUAPI AH ka theihna in a batlah tam peuhmah a, mawtaw leh cycle hong kinawk khak khat in, lawmpen teng numei nih leh, palik puan silh nih in thupianna mun ah phone tawh man hong zaih tak teh TEDIM KHUAPI AH numei palik a om lam ka thei pan a, thupi sa mahmah ing. Tua ban ah, galkapte kiangah, zong mattawm, mattam kisam sese lo, tansawm ong numei te in galkap sung ah lai-at ding zong kisiau thei cih ka zak ciangin, Pasian thupha ih san lam hong telsak hi. TEDIM KHUAPI AH khuasung inn kilamte bang pen saimual pan ih suah lian teh nidang hi leh innte pen vom miatmuat a, innza hang hong hi hi. Tunb el maw guai tambawsii kizut hong tam zawta a hih manin, vaupak hong bang pianpian ta a, hong nopci mahmah ta hi. Inn kilamthak lah tam, a lui kipuah lam tam Pasian thupha ka na ci ci hi. Mundang om ten inn lam hong puah nop lam uh kimu thei pha mahmah cih ding hong hi ta hi. Nung aa, inn kilam ih gen ban ah, Sakollam veng, nidang Pu Thang Za Do te inn mun ah, Pa Hang Lam Thang lam inn bang pen, mun dangdang a ih muh TEDIM KHUAPI AH om leh ih cih dan te pawl hong hi pah ahih man kei bang bel hong zawh ding kaal ngaklah mahmah himai ingh. Zan ni in Chin State Governer hong pai in, khuakiim hausate leh khuasung ulian te tawh kimuh khopna nei uh hi. Athucing ken tel keng. Tua ban ah, April kha teh Zosuan tuailai khawmpi hong tung dinga, tua ding zong ZYA- Tedim te leh Hang khan Lian zong thu kikupna kinei khin hi. A thucing pen ZYA Secretary kidong thei hi, Ka theihsunsun hong at hing. Kapteel Khuasatna Thu Paakzang Khua Tangthu PU TUAL KHAW MANG Pu Mangtal TANGTHU Laaitui Khua Gam leh Mite Teizang Tangthu Tawmging Beh Tangthu LUNMUAL VANGKHUA: Vol.I, Issue No.1; December 2012 Peng Lam Tangthu ZOMITE' PIANKHIATNA THU January (12) 2015 (587) December (21) November (54) October (32) September (20) August (57) July (48) June (116) May (28) April (6) March (201) February (4) 2014 (42) December (2) November (1) October (5) September (11) August (4) July (6) June (6) May (1) April (3) March (2) January (1) 2013 (12) December (3) November (1) May (2) April (2) March (2) January (2) 2012 (165) December (2) November (9) October (6) September (11) August (18) July (10) June (23) May (25) April (54) March (4) February (3) 2011 (134) December (2) November (1) September (1) August (3) July (7) June (6) May (9) April (8) March (15) February (18) January (64) 2010 (38) December (36) June (1) April (1) 2009 (1) June (1) Travel Definition List Pages Home Free Myanmar Online Dictionaries Site Map Holung Kupkhopna History Friday, February 19, 2016 Kawl leh Zo KilamdannaDr Vum Son 9:31:00 PM Kawl leh Zo Kilamdanna Dr. Vum Son Mungpi tawh ka ki ho leh, "Kawlte pen Zote sangin kal suan khat a masawn zawkna pen bang hang hiam?" hong ci hi. Kawl leh Zo pen mipilte (Linguists, Anthropologists, Historians) in Tibeto-Burman minam-te sungah hong koih khawm uh hi. Tua pen thu dang hang hi lo, Kawl leh Zo pen a paute uh kinaai-in, a daan uh zong kinaai hi, ci hi. Tua bek tham lo-in hong paikhiatna pen kibang pian-a, tu laitak Sen (Chinese)-te ii uk Tibetan Plateau pan hong paikhiate hi, ci hi. Hun khat lai-in, Tibeto-Burman minamte pen mun khat-ah om khawm-in, pau namkhat zangh khawm dingin kingaih sun hi. Unau zong hi kha ngei ding hi, cih upna zong om hi. Tua ahih leh bang hangin Kawlte pen masawnin om hiam cih, en ni. Zomite pen Kawlgamah Zeisu suah zawh khum zakhat, kumzanih (First or second century AD) sungah tu-a Chindwin gun kiang hong tung suk hi-in mipilte in mu uh hi. Kawlte pen kum zasagihzagiat zawh ciang (seventh to eighth century AD)-ah Kawlgam hong tung suk ding-in mipilte in mu hi. Tua hun-in pen Kawlte in Kawlgam sunga kum tampi a omsa Pyu mihingte tawh Kyaukse a cihna khawngah hong kimu uh hi. Pyu te pen Kawlgam-ah sawtpi om ta ahih manin, Kawlgam zaangtamna-ah bangci lo kho cih na thei ta uh hi. (Wet cultivation buh ciinna cih bang.) Mual leh uuam gam Tibet leh Salween, Mekong, Irrawaddy, Chindwin, Brahmaputra gunpi-te kipatna pan hong tuakkhia a hih hang Kawlte in Pyu-te pilna teng luah thei pah ahih ciang in, amau te kal khat a suan-in hong makai ta hi. Tua bek hi lo-in, tu laitak-a Kawl galkapte gilo si e, i cih mah bangin, midang tawh a kipeh uh ciang gilo gawp-in Kawl te Kawlgam dry zone a tun khit sawt lo-in Pyu mihingte mangthang uh hi. Pawlkhat in tulaitak-a om Pao te pen Pyu-te hi-in, Kawlte a thuak lah hanga, mualtung-ah taito hi ci-in upna nei hi. Bangbangh hi leh Kawlte giitlohna hangin, Pyu-te bei manghi. Tua a hih kei leh Kawlte in zawhthawh thu tawh Kawlte suak hiam cih zong muanmawhna om hi. Tua hang-in zong Kawlmi hong tam toto hi kha ding hi. Tua pen a ma suanna bulpi khat hi. (Kawl te giitlohna pen Thailand-a Ayuthia kumpi khua a siat sakna, a bawlsiatna uh, Mon-te a khuapi Bago (Pegu) pan a mangthanna uh, Arakan (Rakhaing) kumpi te a bawlsiatna uh, Assamte bang in, bangci-a hih bang-a gilo lawmlawm hiam, a cihna uh, Meitei (Manipur) kum sagih Kawlte ii uk hun pen Meiteite in seven years of devastation (kum sagih sung mi monsak na ) ci-in ciamteh-in, Kawlte pen i kidop kei leh mi gilo lamdangte hi cih theih-in ciapteh ding thupi hi.) Zo mite pen tu laitak-a Monywa sak lam khawng teng-ah hong teeng to uh-a, tua-ah pen midang om lo ahih ciangin, mual sangpi Tibet plateau khawng, gun golpite kipat na mualsang tung-a a teen lai uh-a, lo khawhna teng zang gam hong tun uh ciang tua tengmah zangh uh ahih ciangin, khantohna na om khol lo uh hi. Zaanggam om zo hi napi, leisangna teng mah-ah lo kho nuam zaw-in Kawlgam sung hi ta leh Kawlgam sak lam mualtung (tu laitak-a i gam khawng-ah nuam na sa zaw mai uh ahihciangin, khangto lo-in i ngeina teng ngeina sak mawk uh hi. Kawl te zaanggam ah om-in, mitam ta uh ahih ciangin, migilo, zuauthugen, leh mikheem pen tampi hong nei ta uh hi. Tua banga mihoihlote pen a kitheih ciangin, khuadangah paikhia-in mangthang thei hi. Tua hangin Kawlte in mi a theih ngeilo khat pen um thei nawn lo ahih manin, bangci-in hih leng mi kheem thei ding ka hiam, mi na te bangci-in, ngah thei ding ka hiam cih hakkat -na hong nei ahih uh ciang, mikheemna pen pilna golpi khat suaksak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Kawlte in mikehem hong siam-a, a mikheem theih ding mite hong mu thei uh. Tua pen Mangkangte pau (English)-in ci leeng Urban society, mitamna khuasungthu hong suak hi. Zo mite pen khua neuneu sungah teengin, khua sungah kua teng teeng hiam, tua bek domlo in, beh leh phung vive ahih uh ciang, guta, zuauthu, mikheem cih te pen piangthei lo mai hi. Mun dangah taai ding ci leeng lah khua dangte zong a beh a phung vive na hi mai uh ahih ciangin, khuadang kibeel thei lo-in, mihoih lote mangthang thei lo-in, mihoihte bangin, a khua uh-ah a om kenkan uh kul mawk ahih ciang, Zo mite pen mikheem thei lo, thuman gente, i suak mawk. Tua pen English-in ci leeng Village Society ci-in, Zo mite village society hong suak hi. Europe khawng, America khawng-ah i om ciangin, amau zongh Village Society na hi nwn lo-in Urban society na hi uh hi. Kidawm kei leeng hih mipil i cihte gam-ah, mi bawlsiat na i thuak ding lauhuai mahmah hi. Tua hangin zong Kawl mite in British-te Kawlgam-ah hong pai ciangin, kiho thei lo-in British-te colony (British-te sal) hong suahna uh zong tua hang hi. Asia sung-ah mipil deuhte Thai-te bang ci leeng, British-te tawh thu kiho thei ahih ciangin, British leh Francete in uk nuam taleh zong, uk zo lo-in, Thaite in, hoih takin, thukimna bawl thei hi. Kawlte pen Zo mite sang kal khat masuan ahih uh hang Thaite sang kal khat nung khak zaw leeuleeu cihna hi. Tu laitak Kawlgam leh a kiangkap-a gamte en leeng, Kawlte pen mihai mahmah mihing ahih hun lam i mu hi. Kawl i cih pen Sing Kho Khai laibu sungah zangtam mi te cihna hi ci-in at a hih manin Zo History ka at lai-in, ama at ka zui hi. Tun Bangladesh-ah ka pai ciang, Bangladesh-a Zo mite in Bengali-te Korka ci uh hi, hong ci hi. Kor or Kawr cih pen zadang neu cihna hi. Mualtung mi pen a zadang uh gol-in Bengalite a zadang uh neu cihna hi. Tua hang zongin, ei zong in "Kawl" ci-in a min uh pia kha i hi tam, ka ci hi. Hih lai, 11 MAY 05 WED ni-in kingah hi. Interview: Lian (Li Anh) The Band Illuxion Of Death Sxf ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Interview: Lian (Li Anh) The Band Illuxion Of Death Sxf posted on 16 November 2017 at 7:14 pm Lomkholna: Article , Celebrity , Interview , Sawltak Interview: Lian (Li Anh) The Band Illuxion Of Death Sxf Tutung Zomi Daily Celebrity Column ah suahsakding in aki selsim khinkhian lasak leh laphuahsiam ei Zomi khattawh dotna leh dawnna kong neithei uhhi. Tuaban ah Zomi ten ih thapiakding khat hong kibehlap ahihna thuzong hong pulakkawm kahipah uhhi. Tukum 2017 September kha in England khuapi London ah lasa ding, leitung gambup ah a siamna lakkhiat theih nading lampi omin akisam himahleh, gambeel mikhat ahihna tawh gamdang zintheihna laibu (Passport) ngah theilo ahih manin, ahamphatna ataanlawh khatzong hi a, Zomi te supna lianpikhat ahih banah ama ading ih ngaihsut sakciang in hong khasiat huai phialmawk hi. Tutung Zomi Daily tawh hun hongpiathei ahih manin, amah kua hi a, atup angimna leh a lasak, laphuah tezong dotna tawm ihnei nuamhi. ZD: Hi Lian, Zomi Daily hun nongpiak manin lungdam eimaw. Lian: Keizong lungdamsem ingei. ZD: Na min hong koici sapding kaivua? Na behmin eleh? Lian: Lian inzong hongsamthei, Lianpu zong kingah. Tulaitak India gamah la kasak ciangbel Li Anh cin hongsam uh, kabeh minpen Naulak hi. ZD: Na innkuanpih te kua hi a, unau bangzah pha naivua? (Family Background) Lian: Kapa Lian Khan Suan, kanu Sian Kim hin, pianpih unau 4 pha ung. Keipen a ulampan a 2 na hi ing. ZD: Na pianna khua? Na sangkahna leh na teenna e leh? Lian: Kasuahna munpen India gamsung Phai hin, tulaitak ka innkuan un Delhi ah om ung. Ka sangkahna cileng St. Paul Institute (Siapi Hau Khen Pau) sangleh Blue State Academy (Dr. Dal Lian) sangah kah ing. ZD: Bangkum akipan lasak, laphuah kipan? Tuaciang banghang in hihdan in ukna nei nahitam? (cihnopna ah nanu, napa la uk, lasiam ahih keileh behleh phungsung ah la leh siamna kivakna cihdan) Lian: Atung a kagensa mahbangin kapa pen Suanno hin, amahpen la uk leh laphuak khatmah hi. Tulai khangthak tenbel theikholkei mai incin, kapa laphuah ei Zomi sungah aki theizawdeuh a ka upmawh pen Denciang cise ken zekai niteh acihla hi. Tuaciang kapa pen U Lengtong Pauno, U Lengtong Go Hau, U Lengtong Pau Thawng te lawm it khat hi. Ka neulai in kapa te lawmtateng ka innvuah lasin, lalem cihdan hidenpian in, tua tungtawn in la uk khat asuak hing. La kasak asawt hang, ka laphuahbel 2015 khawng pan hi. ZD: Na laphuah te bangla hi a, bang Style dan te ahia? Lian: Mangla (Mikangla) hin, ka la khempeuh pen zawlla (Love Song) pavetlo, Gospel la lah hilo, a Style cilengbel Rock leh Thrash Metal lam hi. ZD: Zola na phuah leh nasak aom limlimhia? Lian: Zola kaphuah zong ommah, Pasian la (Gospel) la vive hin, biakinn sungah kasak cihloh khui khawngah kasak omnailo. ZD: La naphuah, na gelh khempeuh dawng bangzah phata? Lian: La dawng 19 kiim hi. ZD: La naphuahciang nang ii lungsim sungpan hong piangkhia lamal ahia? Ahih keileh kiim leh paam pan a na ngah lamal te hizaw ahia? Lian: A tamzaw pen kei lungsim sungpan ahong piangkhia lamala te hin, pawlkhatbel cileng kiim leh paam a thupiang te awlmawhna khatneileng tua ka awlmawhna dan gelhziau cihdan hi. ZD: Tulaitak na Band min uhleh kuateng nahi uhhiam cihzong hong genve? Lian: Ka Band min uhpen Illuxion of Death hi in, kei minvawh ahih banah, a Owner Manager zong hipah ing. Vocal pen keimah, Lead Guitar pen Khupboih, Bass pen Alfred Zomi, Drummer pen Sangpi hi. Khatveivei bel alem bangbang, Band khatpeuhpeuh, Vaite, Nepali tetawh cihbang, Philippines sangnaupang Delhi ah sang hongkah te pawlkhattawh cihbang in la kasak hunzong om, ka Show tamzawbel Full Band sangin Solo maw, Duo in lazaw ing. ZD: Kua in na Show ding hong vaihawmsak in, munbangzah ah Show bawl ngeikhin? Lian: India gamsung muntuamtuam ah Show bel 20 veibang neikhin ung. Ka Show dinguh hong vaihawmsak cileng Event Company tuamtuam hi. Giglue, Gigstart, Starclinch, KS Event, Karyakrum, Skillboxes cihte hin, India Company tuamtuam hi uh. Adang munahzongbel Show neuneu neiden ing. Tuate pen Hotel, Bar, Cafe ah hin, tuadan lasaknading aomciang keibek hongsamzaw uh cihding hi. ZD: Show nabawl uhciang haksatna tuahkhak cibang aomhia? Lian: Haksakna lianbel tuakkha ngeilo, hong vaihawmsak tezong kician ahihman hikha ve. Ahihang kolampan lemtheilo in ka Cancel uh tamzawpian. ZD: Show nabawl uhciang hong guaihna uh bangdan in hongpia ahia? Lian: Hong guaihna uhbel India lasak te khatmah bangin hongpia uhin, atammah suakve. ZD: No Band pen London ah hongkisam ngei cihkhat? Bangkum hi a, bangcidan in hongsam uh? No Band pen bangcidan in hong theikha uh ahia? Lian: Ummm hongsam mah uh, tukum 2017 September khasung hi. Ka Facebook Friend tepen atamzaw mikang vive ahih banah Musician, Producer, Promoter, Event Company pan cihdan vive uhhi. Tuate in hong Contact in Ka Facebook lawmten na lasak te naza ungin, Asian Band Online Music Selection omding hi, tua ah na Submit sak nuam ung, alemdiam cih hongdot uhteh kenzong lungdamlua in Sure, Yes nacipah ziau. Tua Selection abawlna pan ko Band kiteelna lakah apakha suakve. ZD: Tua hongsam te bang Company pan hilimlim ahileh? Lian: London Events, Tour, Concert, Parties kici Event Company khat hi. Website, Source leh akicianzaw atheinuam ten ka Page pan unzong ki muthei inteh. ZD: London ah naki heltheih lohna atomkimcing in nong gentheidia? Lian: Passport leh Visa hang hi. India Identity Card neilo in, kibawl theilo hipah. Bawltheih nading lampi omsunpen Kawlgam paikul cihteng hi. Ka vekpi un Passport nei khatzong omlo. Selection ka ngahkhakding uh lamenlo kawmkal ah ka Photo uhpen Poster vuah hong suahkhiat ciangbel ahimah aive maw cin kalung uh dammahmah napi, paitheilo deuhse cihdan himai ei. ZD: Tulaitak hih nasiamna tawh kisai bang buaipih laitak nahia? Lian: Tulaitak bel lasa hongki sapciang sazel, tualo la mah gelh, phuak cihbangtawh hunbeipian. ZD: Mailam ah bang tupna nanei a? Lian: Ka laphuah khempeuh Video Album ahoih mahmah, Quality anei simkhat bawlnuamlua, ka hanciam mahmah laitak leh, tua hong Sponsor ding azongzong hing. ZD: Zomi leh Music nang muhdan? Lian: Ei Zomi tepen Music tawh asuakkhia ngiatdan in mumai ing. Pasian inzong Zomi leh Music atonkhawm, kizui totoding ahongsiam hinteh cing. Enpakleng tunai ih Idol te, i khangno te lasiam aki selsim tampi na ommawk hilomaw mate, tha apiading kisam cih kei muhna hi. ZD: Zomi lasa, tumging siamte leh a thapiading Zomi mipi te kikal nang muhdan? Lian: Atung a kagensa mahbangin ei Zomi lasa leh tumging siamtebel siamtheilua, tha piading ten tha piazolo hizaw. A thapiading Zomi milip aneu, alian ii mawhpuak ahihlam ki mangngilh hiam? Tha kipia nuamlo ihhiam? cihpen kei leh kei kakidot ngei zelkhat hi. Tuaban ah i theihsa bangin ei Zomi tebel khatsiamna (Talent) khat neita leh siam ei, hoih hi cihsangpeuh gensiatlam ki hatzawpian theizel mawkin, tuapen khasiat huai banah hoihsa hetkeng. ZD: A zenzen in leitung gambup Level aminthang khat hilecin, tua minthanna Title pen koicidan in kemcing in, nang leh nangzong koici kikepsawm nahia? Lian: Hahaha hih lianbel ki lamen ngamkeilua ingin, aihhang nongdot uh himawk ahihciang ka lungsim aom bangin hongdawng ningei. Leitung gambup Level in aminthang khat hi zezen lengzongpen Pasian tawh kinaina pen kibang veve ding hi, cihnopna ah ka Pasian mangngilh sawm limlim keng. Kikep cihciang tep leh muam, zu le sa lamsangah tunzong siangtho kik bilbel ing. Kei adingin zu le sa, khamtheih, guihtheih hihding kisam lolua mai. Tua leitung nopna tesang ka la gelh, ka la sak mite deihtheih honghihding buaipihzaw ing. Zudawnding cileng Show khatpeuh aom ciang a mawkna in ki ngah hi, ahihhang ken theitui nadawnzaw ing. Band Page: Commercial Video: Audio Original Music: London hong kisapna: Sweden pan Interview na: Online Radio pan hongna khahsak te: INDIE SCENE RADIO (Boston USA), Rock Rage Radio(AustraliaUSAUK ZD: Zomi khangthak lasiam, laphuak te ading na deihsak, thapiaknop? Lian: La i gelh, i sak ciang veinakhat neih mahmahna tawh gelh in sading, hongki gensia dikdek theihi. Ahihhang phamawh sase kei in, na la gelh athu hongki kosak in, hong nuihsan pawl omkhading hi. Phamawh savet kei in, a thupi penpen cileng laphuak tungah ka gennop mahmah thu pen i Zola lamal te zong thupi mahmah hi, tuasang a thupi zaw kasak khatah i la aw (Melody) mahmah ahoih ding kisampen sa ingei guai. ZD: Atawpna pen nagennop khatpeuhpeuh? Lian: Ka Zomi pih ten hong phawk khalo uh aitam maw kacih laitak, lamet lohpi in Zomi Daily in hihbang in nong thapiakna uhleh Interview nong neihtheih uhbel nakpitak ka lungdam hi. Mailam ahzong Zomi sungah Talent nei tampi ki om ahihna dungzui in, hihdan Interview te hong hanciam totolai un. Tua ahih manin Zomi bup lungkihual in adiakdiak in Malaysia om Zomi te ading ih biakinn ciat pan in thunget khop hun khat lak dingin ih kizasak nuam hi. Ei te kipum khat in ih thunget khopna ah Pasian in lungkim in nalamdang hong sem ding hi. Anuai a hun bangin kipumkhat in thungen khawm dingin ih kizasak phapha hi. Ani: April 21, 2019 (Sunday) Amun: Zomite Biakinn Khempeuh ah Ahun: Eima kikhop hun sung ciatah (Easter Sunday ni ih pawlpi hunsung ciat ah hun limcii khat la ding.) (Note: Sabbath ni biakpiakna a neite adingin April 20 ni hiding) Ngimna leh Thunget Dingte: 1. Zomite cidam khansau na ding (pilvang a i kikep siam nading) 2. Malaysia gamsungah Zomite i sihnotloh na ding, 3. Zomite Zumvai mabante ah mazan kim nading leh isepna ciatah lawh cin nading, 4. I maikaite panpihna leh amaute tawh pankhopna ah i kithutuah na ding! (A geelkhia-Zomi Genvai Tanute ZSM-2019) NA CONTACT NUMBER TE UH HONG UPDATE UN ZAM card tawi member te in ZAM zum ah na phone no. te uh update hong bawl hamtang un. Phone No. kilaih tam ahih manin ih phone No. te update ih bawl ham tang ding kisam hi. A zenzen in UNHCR lam pan vai khat om leh na contact No. aman lopi tawh bangmah hong kisam thei lo ding ahih manin update ih bawlna ding hong zasak ung. KAMLET SEM NUAM TE IN SAZIAN HONG PIA UN UNHCR zum leh zum dangte ah Zomi kamlet (Interpre -ter) ding mi kisam zelzel a, a hun zui in ih sap pah theih dingin Zomi sungah Kamlet (Interpreter) nasep a lunglut te in min sazian nong piak nang uh hong zasak ung. 2019 ZSM LAIBU TE HONG AP KIK TA UN 2019 ZSM laibu te I hawm khiat zawh kha 4 bang hong cingta ahih manin March kha bei ah ih laibu khempeuh Zum ah ih puak kikna dingin ih ki zasak hi. Hong ap kik khin zong tampi mah ki om a, hong ap man nailo zong zong ki om lai ahih manin in a manlang in nong ap kik nang uh zong hong zasak ung. Mapang khawm in ih sep khopna te hangin tuni ciang a kalsuan zo ih hihi. ZAM ZUM AH HONG HAWH Suangphei khuami Sia Enn Sian Khai Palm Tree and Cedor Project Ministry in Malaysia hong zin sungin Zomi te a it aveina tawh kizui in ZAM zum ah hong hawh in thapiak na leh thupha piakna hong nei ahihmanin kilungdam mah mah hi. Topan siapa nuntakna hong zang semsem tahen. WELCOME TO ZAM Kawlgam, Vaigam, tuipigal leh gam tuamtuam pan Malaysia ah hong zin Zomi makai ten Zomi zumpi ahi Zomi Association of Malaysia(ZAM) ah nong hawhphak hamtang nading un itna lianpi tawh kong zawn uh hi. ZAM ZUM AH KILEI THEI ZAM zumpi ah ih Zomi ngeina van tuamtuam te ahiZopuan Design tuamtuam, Zoniik Design tuamtuam, Puanten, Puandum, Zodial(Silk), Puanlaisan, Zokhi, Tanghciin, Khephiau, Zolukhu, Zothungkuah, Zodial cihte akipan naupang puan tuamtuam te deih zahzah kilei thei hi. Tua bek loin khui tuamtuam leh anuai a laibu te zong kilei thei hi. NA UN VAI NAKAN NUAM HIAM? Na UN vai lunghimawhin kannop dotnop khat peuh peuh nanei hiam? UN Department tuamtuam ah laigelh sak nopna neih leh ZAM Member te ading mangenloin ZAM zum pan lai kigelh sak theiden hi. ZAM member I cihpen ZAM Card bawl ngei cihbek hi loin UN card a neih khit hangin a renewhingsak den te pen member hiden cihna hi. Refugee na kicih sam hang UN Card naneih naikei leh UN ten kami hongci tuanlo hi. DAHPIH NA PULAKNA Mawngken Khuami, Kawlpi leipi veng ah teng Sukte beh Pa Lian Suan Kham (Kum-52) in 04 April 2019 ni-in upmawh lohpi in PJ University Zato pan in hong nusia hi. Pa Lian Suan Kham luanghawm tawh kisai in ZAMZSM pan in vaipuak kila hi. Hih sang gam pa hong nusiatna tawh kisai in ZAMZSM pan in zong dahpih na ih pulak khia hi. Topan a dah a kap khem peuh a lamdangin hong heh nem tahen. ZOMI TANGMI THUNGEN PAWL Zomi Tangmi thungen pawl te makaihna tawh Zomibup a ding thungetna om ding ahih manin, a gamla a nai cih omlo thungetna ah nong kihel kimciat na dingun zahtakna lianpi tawh kong zawn uh hi. A diakdiakin tulaitak Malaysia gambel te dinmun adingin nakpi takin thungetna kinei ding hi. Lungsim kipumkhat in ih thunget khopna in nalianpi hong piangsak ding cih ih lam en hi. Contact person: Siamah Ciin Ph. No.: 60182688752 INTERVIEW NA PAI CIANG Tulaitak a diakdiakin RSC leh DHS interview te kinawh sap mahmah ta hi. Tua ahihmanin interview napai ciang in pelloin na theih ding thu pawl khat hong om zel hamtang hi. Tulai tak pen ei ading hun nunung hong hi ta ahih manin interview ah kiginglopi a na paina pen nang leh nang a kibawlsia tawh akibang nahih lam phawk gige in. Ih mailam kalsuan nadingte ei mau mahmah in a hoihpen ding in hanciam tek ni. 1. Thu hong kidongte hoihtak tel lopi in dawng kik kei hamtangin. (upmawh dawn or mangsia khiat in khiain dawng kei in) Telmel lopi in upmawhin na dawnna in na zum vai hong kikhel sak thei cih phawk gige in. 2. Kamphen te in pau telcian lo ahih kei leh nang lam panin kamphen te pau telcian loh na khat a om khak leh zong kisuangtaklo tak mah in kitel kei ci-in gen lel in. Tua bangin na sianggen na hangin nang a ding buaina bang mah om tuanlo ding hi. 3. Pawl khat in ei khua awsuahawkaih tawh ih pau ciangin kamlet pawl khat in zong tello thei hi. Tua bang hun ciangin kamlet pawl khat in Tedim pau in pau in ci in tai cih zong kiza thei a, ahi zongin kamphen te mahmah in zong nang pau hong tel ding zong a thupi a hih lam phawk hamtangin. Kammal khat kitelkhial leh zong I vai pi khat ki pelh thei hi. 4. Zomi ahi lo namdangte in kamlet hong sep a, a pau na tel kei leh zong tello cih siangtakin gen pah zaw in. 5. Zum ah interview ding na pai limlim ciang zuu nam heha sa leh kamsan biabua sa khawng in pai kei zaw hamtang in. Articles Knowledge Ngeina Tuamtuamte Zomite Aading Muhtheih Kipumkhatna (Towards Visible Unity for Zo People). Agelh Suang Khen Pau By: LAIBUSAAL Date: November 15, 2020 Zomite Aading Muhtheih Kipumkhatna (Towards Visible Unity for Zo People) Agelh Suang Khen Pau Thupatna Mangte in, Kipumkhatna in thahatna hi, ci uh aa, Kawlte in ahih leh , Bawnghonte kikhenleh sahang in tuah hi, ci-in ei Zomiten bel, Nupa kilungtuak khua khat in zolo; khua khat kilungtuak khua kua in zolo, cih paunak ih nei hi.Singkung a tangpote tukbaih-aa: a khawlpote puk hak hi. Khauzang khat sangin a kihekkhawm namkhau botsat hak zaw hi.Tua bang mahin ih minam dinmunah Zomite ih kipumkhat ding kisamta bek hilo in, a kul hi ta hi. A kikulna thu Khristian biakna tung tawnin ih en ding hi. Amasa-in Zomite hong kikhenkhamsak thute ih suutphot dingaa, tua khit ciangin kipumkhat nading a kisapzia enin , a tawpna ah kipumkhatna ih neih theih nadingin sepkhop-bawlkhop theih ding thu pawlkhat ka hong sung ding hi. Zomite kipumkhat theih nading lampi a khunsawm ihi hi. I.Hong Kikhenkhamsak Thute(Factors Leading to Division) Zomite tu laitak ih kipumkhat theilohna ka et ciangin a hang pawlkhat a nuai-aa bangin ka mukhia hi. (1)Ih Tual Lungsim(Localism ) Thu tuamtuam hangin mun tuamtuam leh khuata tuamtuam ah kithehthangin ih teeng hi. Tua manin makai tuamtuam leh ngeina tuamtuam ih neiciat hi. Pau leh awsuah tuamtuam zong piangpah hi.Kizop-kivanna hamsa ahih manin khua khat leh khua khat mi tuampi ih suak hi. Kidemna tuamtuamte in zong mikhual hong tangsaklai hi. Tual lungsim neihna hong khang semsem aa, Khristian ih suahkhit ciang nangawnin tua in kikhenna piangsak hi.Tual lungsim, kual lungsim, leh huang lungsim neihnate in eite hong kikhenkhamsak takpi mawk hi. Tual lungsim a khauhpai nadingin zong khua khat leh khua khat a mual a guamin hong hal-in ih awsuahte tangkai mawk takpi hi.Tua manin tual kibatlohna munte-ah kihuh kipanpih nopna omlo pah hi.Pheisa-liangsa ci-in ih kikhenmawk hi.Simta-zota, sakmi-khangmi ci-in ih kilo hi.I hihna bangin ih kimu thei kei hi. Nang pa mei sang keipa mei sau zaw, ci-in ih kidemden aa, ih kipantahnuam kei hi. Kipantah cih thadah ih kipanpihnuam keilai hi. (2) Ih Beh Lungsim(Excessive Clan Spirit) Tual lungsim a behlap dingin beh lungsim na omlailai mawk hi.A behpa ahihleh nasep guan nuam deuh pawlkhat ki-om hi. A behpa ahih leh sum leitawi a piabek ki-om hi. A khialh hangin a behpa ahih nakleh panpih cih bangin beh lungsim khat pen Zomite sungah om gige lai mawk hi. Jesuh beh ih hihlam ih kimangngilh denkeeii laimawk hi.Deihsakdiak leh pahtawinopdiak kinei hi.Nung pan-in tawsawn nopdiak ih nei hi.Tua in ih pawlpi sungah ahi zongin, kipawlna khat peuhpeuh leh kumpi nasepna sungah nget bangin hong ne-in no pawl, ko pawl, cih hong khangpah lian hi.Tamlo na leiileii tua bangin kideidana kulhpi ih cian sawmlailai hi. (3) Ih Pawl Lungsim(Denominationalism) Tual lungsim leh beh lungsiam sangin a siahuai zaw khat in pawl lungsim neihna ahi hi. Pawl lungsim neihluat manin unau-pata, sungta-putu ih ki-innlamtanh lianlianlai mawk hi.Ih Khristian nuntakna sungah ih picing nailoh man hi zawkha dingin ka um hi. Hih pawl lungsim hong khauhlua ahih manin Tuitphum, RC, AG,EBC cih bangin kigim neihna om aa, tuiphumte in ko a innpite hi ung, cih lungsim hong neipah hi.Pawl dangte in zong miluite-piangluite ci-in thupisim deksuaituanlo hi.Tuiphum sung nangawnah ko TBC, ZBC no ZBCM cih bangin kilangmuhna lianlai mahmah mawk hi.Pawl lungsim neihna lianlua ahih manin unau sanggam khat hi gegu na pi, dongtuakna nagawnah kidon kilkello cihzah dongin Khrih hong itna ih pawlpi sungah ih neuseekseek hi.Pawl lungsim hong uangluat ciangin thupomziate nangawn dongah, Huate upna peengte, hiate limsangte, ko pen upna laingil neite, cih bangin ei aabek mah man ih sa liuleu mawk hi.A taktakin ei thupom pen ei adingin a dik pen ahi zah khatin mite thupomte zong amaute adingin a dik pen ahihlam ih muhsakkha kei hi. Hih pawl lungsim neihna in ih minam sungah unau-sanggam khat ih hih lam muh theih nading ih mit hong tawsak lailai hi. III.Kipumkhat Nading A Tawsawn Thute(Factors Leading to Unity) Kipumkhatna tawh kisai-in hong tawsawn thu pawlkhat om aa, tuate a nuai-bangin kong sungkhia hi. A. Pasian Thu Tungtawnin Etna (Theological Imperative) Khristiante biak Pasian in Tothum Pasian(triune God) ahi hi. Thumgawm Pasian khat ahi hi. Pa Pasian,Tapa Jesuh Khrih leh Kha Siangtho ahi hi. Pa Pasian pen vannuai-aa piang mihing, ganhing, sihkung-lopa, tuipi-mualmau, nuntakna nei leh nuntakna neilo na khempeuh a bawlpa(creator) in hong kilang hi.A bawlsa nate puahin kemin a zuun Pasian(sustainer) zong ahi hi. Tapa Jesus Khrih ahih leh Pasian bawlsa mihing leh nate a gumkhia(savior) dingin hong pai ahi hi.Kha Siangtho ahih leh mihingte tawh omkhawm aa, a siansuah( sanctifier) ding in hong kilang ahi hi.Tothum Pasian khat ahih hangun a nasep uh a tuamtek ahi hi. Tua hi-a Zomi Khristiante kipumkhat ding ih cih ciangin kipumbatna(uniformity) a cinuam ka hi kei aa, ii kibatlohna sungmah panin kipumkhatna(unity in diversity) a gennuam ih hi hi. Pa pen Tapa ahihloh mah bangin Tapa zong Kha Siangtho hilo hi.Ahi zongin amaute Pasian hihna sungah pumkhat ahih mah bangin Zomite zong ih kipumkhat theih nading a pulaaknuam ka hi hi. I biak Pasian zong kipumkhat-in Tothum Pasian ahih leh eite zong banghangin kipumkhat theilo ding i hi hiam?I pawlpi minte lobuang eite kilamdanna mahmah ka muzo het kei hi. B.Mihing Hihna Tungtawnin Etna (Anthropological Imperative) Leitung-a piang Zogam a kicihna mun-aa teng Zomite pen mihing mah ih hikhawmciat hi. Mihing ih hih zahkhatin mihing zia-le-tong, nuntak-khuasakzia, ngeina leh lai, kampau leh ham a nei minam mah ih hi hi. Lunggulhna(will), theih theihna(cognation) leh khentat tawn theihna(voliation) ih neiciat hi. Tua mah bangin nuntakna kha(soul) a neitek ih hi hi. Tua ahih manin kipumkhat theiloh nading thu a omkei hi.Mihing ih hih manin mihing neihding-a kilawm ki-itna, ki-lemna, thumanna leh suaktakna tawh ih kipawlkhop theih ding ahi hi. Mihing hikhawm bek thamlo-in minam khat Zosisan nei vive ih hih manin ih kithuhual theihloh nading thu mahmah om lo hi.Tu hun pen kikhenkhap hun hi nawnlo aa, kipumkhat hun hita hi. Kigensiatsiat hun hinawnlo-in kipahtawi hun hi ta hi. Kilangpan hun hi nawnlo aa, kipanpih hun hi ta hi. Kitelkhialh hun hi nawnlo-in, kitelsiam hun hita hi. C.Pawlpi Tungtawnin Etna(Ecclesiological Imperative) Zomite lakah Khristian 95 ih hita hi. A nungta Pasian um-a Khristian biakna a biate ih hi hi. Tu laitak-in pawl tuamtuam(denominations) ih hih hangin I biak Pasian kibangin, i up kibang-aa, ih laisiangtho a kibang ahi hi.A taktakin hih pawl tuamtuamte pen gamdang pan-aa hong pai sangmangte hong ken hilel hi.Judson sangmangpa pen America gamah a omlai-in Tuitheh(Congregationalist) mi hi aa, sangmang nasep sem dingin hong pai-in India a tun ciangin Tuiphum(Baptist) a suak ahi hi. Judson sangmangpa pen Tuiphum na suak keileh tulai tak-aa a kituiphum sak mahmah nang-le-kei zong tuiphum hi keek khalo ding hi hang.Tua hi aa, i pawl lungsimte pen sangmangte hong puak pawlpi tungtawn-aa hong piangkhia ahihna kiteel mahmah hi.Tua bang ka cih ciangin sangmangte a mawhsak nuam ka hi kei hi. Amau zong amau hunin a hoih pen ding ngimna mah tawh hong pantah uh ahi hi.Ahi zongin tu-in pawl kideidan-aa ih kilangbawlbawl leh sangmangte mawhna hang hi nawnlo dingaa, nanglekei mawhpuak hong hita ding hi. Pawl lungsim neihluatna in kipumkhat nadingin hong khaktan tawntung hi.A minin pawl tuamtuam ih hih hangin ih To khat, upna khat, tuiphumna khat leh laisiangtho khat a tawikhawm Khrih sungah innkuan khat ih hih manin ih kipawl theihloh nading bang thu om zenzen ding a hiam? D.Tual Nuntakna Tungtawnin Etna(Socialogical Imperative) Zomite pen minam khat ih hi khawm aa, lampuan zawngkhawmte ih hi hi. Zogam ah tengin, Zo sinsan, Zo lungsim nei-in Zo an ne aa, Zo ngeina tawh a khangkhiate ih hi hi.Zomi-in piangin Zomi mah aa a si dingte i hi hi.Tuinaak khat dawn khawmin lociingkhat khokhawm aa, pumbuuk khat zangkhawmin tulpi khat a neikhawmte ih hi hi.Nopna-dahnaah a ki-uapliailiate ih hi aa, a bawng nuntak (communal life) minamte ih hi hi.Zuhai-sakbak a tangkhawmte ih hi aa, zulim-salim a kisuah masakte ih hi hi.Tua ahih manin banghangin ma pangkhawm theilo mawk ding ih hi hiam? Biakna lam panin kipumkhat theih nadingin ka etpak ciangin a tungaa thute ka lungsim sungah hong suakpak thute hi aa, kipumkhat nopna lungsim ih neih ngelngel leh bel ih kipumkhat theih nadingin thulela tampi mah omlai ding hi.Lai simte in ih ngaihsut beh ding kong hanthawn nuam hi. III. Kipumkhat Nadingin Bang Sem Ding? (What should we do for Unity?) Kipumkhat theih nadingin a kibang ngimna(common vision) leh a kibang kungmui(common goal) ih neihkhop ding kisam pen ding hi.I minam bupin kungmui kibang ih neihkhop ciang bekin na ih semkhawm thei pan ding hi. Tua kungmuite lakah pawlkhat a nuai-aa bangin kong pulaaknuam hi. (1)Zomi Hihna Thupisakkhawmna Lamah (Towards New Identity) Ciimnuai masiah ih tangthu pen a kigenzelzul lai ahi hi. Ahi zongin ih pulepate khang-aa kipan tuni dong Zomi-in a kilo minam ih hi hi. Eile-ei ih kisap ciangin Zomi ih kici aa, miten hong sap ciangin Chin hong ci uh hi.Zogam sungaa om midangte in Tedim hong ci leuleu uh hi.Chin leh Tedim cih pen mite hong sapna hi aa, mite tawh ih kizopna-ah sangsiam-aa ih zatsiam ding thupi mahmah hi. Ahi zongin eilehei ih kisap ciangin Zomi ih kicitekthei hi. Tedim Kampau Zomite sungah awsuah zui-in Sihzang, Saizang. Teizang, Dim, Khuano, Losau, leh Zo etc., cih bangin a ke ki-omlai ahih manin tuate zong amau mun ciatciat-ah ih thupisak ding kisam hi.Zomi hihna sungah tua bang-aa a ke a ke-in, a bil a bilin, a khil a khilin ih omna in kimuhdah, ki-etsat, kipampaih nading hilo zawin ih hoihna honglak hi zaw gege hi.Sihzang mi, Zo cih bangin ahi zongin a kilonuam ih om dingaa, tua zong ih thupi sim ding hi. Tua bang aa omna in ih Zomi hihna a kiamsak zong hi tuanlo-in a hoihna a pulaak ahi zaw hi.Paak huan sungah singkung nam tampi a om ciangin a etlawm pan hi zaw hi.Bangbang ahi zongin tuni dongin Zomi mah ih sangkim theipen ding hi. Ahi zongin mite hong sapna zui-in Chin ahih keileh Tedim a kicinuam a omleh zong, Keng sa-a thalnialpah ding zong hi ka sa tuan kei hi.Tuate in Zomi bei nading hilo zawin a thupit nading ahih lam phawkhuai ka sa hi.Tua ahih manin mite hong sapna zong thupisa-in eile-ei ih kimuhna zong thupisa-aa Zomi ih hihna ih kilat sak ding kungmui-in ih neikhawm ding hi. (2) Pupa Ngeina Zo ngeina leh Zolai Thupisakna Lamah (Towards Promoting Culture and Literature) Zomiten a kibang kungmui ih neihkhop theih nadingin i ngeina, i pauleh i laite thupisak ding hi hang.In ngeina pawite ahi zongin ki-it kingaihna late ahi zongin kepcing ih sawm ding hi. Ih Zopuante aa kipan ih vanzatte dongin thupisak ding hi hang.A diakdiakin minam khat-aa picing takin ih din theih nading ih lai leh ih kampau mahmah ih zuun ding kisam ka sa hi. Gentehna in tu laitak-in ih minambup in ih lai ih thupitsak theih nadingin Zomi Christian Literature Society ah kigawmkhawmin puahkhawm leng hoih mahmah ding hi.ZCLS in pawl kideidan lo-in a kilut thei Zomite lailamah khantoh nading a vaihawmpi ahih manin tua kipawlna-ah kituahin mapang khawmleng ih kithutuak baih pen ding hi. (3) Zogam Khantoh Nadingin Pankhopna Lamah (Towards Sustainable Development) Thupha ngah minam ih kicihkeii sam hangin Leitugnah Kawlgam a zawng pen a hihna a khangsak pen Zogam-aa teng ei Zomite ih hi aa, 40 om hi, hong kici hi.I pianna Zogam khangto deknailo cihna hi.Mangkang kumpi in Zogam hong lak ciangin galkapbu khat in Pasian in leitung abawlin Zogam a hoihin lem manlo hi, ciliang hi. Tua hi aa, Zomite kipumkhat theih pen nadingin Zomi Khantohna Committee neih ding kisam ka sa hi. Kayinte in neikhin uh hi. Tua bangin nei theihleng, Zomi ahih keileh Tedim cih nengnengte tawh ih buai mannawn kei ding aa, Zogam khantoh nading ahi; khuakim motor lam tun nading, khuakim in tuitha tawh mei a ngahzawh nading,khuakimah pilna a kisin theih nading, cidamna lamah khantoh theih nading, khuakimah kihona phone a om nading cih bangin ih semkhawm theih ding hi. Zomite tomno sungin a khantoh theih pen nading ka lungngaih ciangin meitha (electricity) ngah ding kisam ka sa pen hi.Gentehna-in Meitei gun khakin meitha ngah lehang: anhuan nading sing kitom nawnlo ding aa ih gam hong nosuak kik ding hi. Huihlak kizopna hong khangto ding aa, phone leh internet-te deih bangin zang thei-in online tung pan leitungah ih zin kawikawi thei ding hi. Nisim ih nuntakna-ah tua meitha tawh na kisem ding a ahih manin ih living standard hong sangtuam mahmah ding hi. Meitha zang-aa sum bawlna private business kisem theih dingaa nasep manlang bek tham lo-in nasem ding zong hong tam mahmah ding hi. A khangto khinsa gamte bangin mualkhat leh mualkhat sikkhau zangin ih kikawm ziauziau thei ding hi. Zomite khantoh theih nadingin mei ginatak(electricity) ngah thei leng lam bann pen dingin ka um hi. (4) Khristian Mission Semkhopna Lamah (Towards Partnership in Mission) Zomite pen biakna mi, biakna uukte ih hi hi. Mission ih semkhawm ding hi.Mission Board khat ih phuankhawm dingaa tua panin sangmang ih puak ding hi.Kua pawl kua pawl cilo-in kideidan hetlo aa, tua mission board ah huhna sum ih puak lel ding hi. I pawlpi bulphuh lo-in Khrih leh lungdamna thu ih bulphuhzaw ding hi. Kha mangthang manin pawlpi ih phuh leh pawl min bulh sese lo-in Church of Christ(Khrih Pawlpi) ih cihsawm lel ding hi. A hih kei leh a kiang-aa a naii ompen pawlpi khat ih ap ngamlel ding hi.Tua bangin mission semkhawm lehang ih kipumkhat baih pen ding hi. Thukhupna Hih thului in Zomite kipumkhat theih nading biakna tungtawnin etpakna hi aa, a hampi petmah ahi hi. Hih bang danin ka et ciangin kipumkhatlah nading lampi peuhmah ka mu kei hi.A diakdiakin kungmui ih neihkhop ding thupi pen hi. Aituam (private)sep lo-in minam tangin(national movement) sep ding thupi ding hi. A toi lungsimte ih tanzausak ding hi.A kawite ih seektang ding hi. A phawkte ih tamkimsak ding hi. A diakdiakin minam huamin Zomi Development Network cih bang khat phuanin khantohna ih seppah ding kisam ka sa mahmah hi. Tu ni ciangciang ih minam bupin ih sepkhop bangmah omlo ahih manin ih veeikhop omlo aa, ih neihkhop kungmui omlo mawk hi. Neihkhop kungmui a om masiah kithuhual tak-aa nasep ding thubaihlo kha ding hi. Hih bangin minam bup kipumkhat theih nadingin kithusimna(recognition), kisansiamna(acceptance) leh lungsim kipiakna(openness) cihte ih neihloh phamawh ding hi. Amasa-in kipumkhat nopna lungsimah ih kituah masa dingaa, tua khit ciangin ih minam aading leh pawlpi aadingin ma ih pangkhawm ding hi.Tua ciang bekin ih teeng khawm thei dinga, sinkhawm thei-in leh khangto khawmin Pa Pasian leh Minam na ih semtheih ding hi. ### Input:

Articles Kammal Hoih Knowledge Pianna TuunNu Lungdam Sak In. Agelh Hen Khan Go By: LAIBUSAAL Date: May 11, 2018 Pianna TuunNu Lungdam Sak In. Paunak 23:25 Agelh Rev . Hen Khan Go Nu Ih cih kammal: Nu aki ci kammal pen athuk mahmah kammal khat hi a, ih haksat ciangin zong nuvei pavei ci-in, na ih sak mahmah ciangin zong nuaw, nuaw ci-in kap hi hang. Ih nulepa ih lawhna ah zong NU mah ki masak hi. Minam dangte in zong nute thupi sak lua uh ahih man in apianpih kampau pen Mother tongue ci-in kanu pau tua hi naci se uh hi. Tua bang mah in biakna khawng a gen uh ciangin zong mother church ka nu pawlpi ci uh hi. Tua ahih man in NU cih kammal pen akhum ngaungau khat ahi hi. Nuten tate mawhna maisak zo a, tate in nute mawhna ki maisak zolo thei hi. Nute in tate sawmbang hong vak zo thei uh a, tate sawm in nukhat pen vak zolo in baak vat bangin a om na mel ding thei lo in, nop asak na mel om lo in ki tai kawikawi sak kha thei a, atawpna ah aki vak zo lo, aki lungkim sak zolo na hi gige hi. Nute itna pen ih kanngno lai in ki telkim zo lo thei a, ei mahmah nudin mun, pa dinmun ah ih om ciangin ki tel san pan thei hi. Ih tel ihphawk ciangin ziakai thei hi. Tua ahih man in ahun lap a nute itna ih theih ding deihna tawh nute itna thu agelh ih hihi. Nute Itna aliatzia: Lai Siangtho sungah nuten tete ait zia: Nupi ten nawipia limtak kem (Is.60:16) Anawi atep nau mangngilh lo (IS. 49:15) Hagar in Ismael it mahmah (Pian. 21:16) Moses nu in si ngam in kem (Pai. 2:3) Hanah in Samuel it mahmah (2Sam. 2:19) Ta nei taktak zaw nu in a itzia asih sangin taan ngam(1Kum.2:26) Shunem numei nu in ata ait zia (2Kum .2:20) Cannan Numei nu maizum khual lo in ata itna lak in damna ngah(Matt.15:22) Mary in Zeisu a it lua in Cavary mual dong ah zui (John. 19:25) Mipil khat in alai gelhna ah nute itna gentehna zangin gen a: Nute itna leitung cia ahih leh tate itna guateh cia Nute itna agol mahmah Pacific cia aphak leh tate itna guah mal cia Nute itnaAsang mahmah Everest mual dawn tan ahih leh tate itna Bawngtal ki tan khawng bek hi na ci hi. Pianna tunnu din mun ah kua mahmah lut thei lo a, kua mahmah in laih theih lo hi. Neu tunga nute itna a ciam kha lo te in nute Itna kial mahmah uh hi. Ih nute mah in thu ong hilh in ong sat kha phial leh zong NU AW, NU AW mah ci in ong sat numin mah lo in ki kap hi. Nupi te itna thupi lua mahmah ahih man in amau pumpi tunga om a nawizu ngiat uh zong tate adingin manpha hi. Ta te mahmah zong ih mit na leh nawizu taak leng dam hi. Nawi zu tawh akhang khia leh nawi aki pia lo te mipil ten aki lamdan na zonguh a, nawi tawh akhang khia te in, khuak pil zaw, guhkhauh zaw, cidam zaw ci ngiat uh hi. Nute pahtawina tawh thupha dawh ni: Mipil tampi tak in anu te apah tawina un anuai abangin na gen uh hi. Bishop Thompson in Nu cih kammal sungah lungnopna nam cin om hi na ci hi. BeogeHerbert in Nu hoih khat pen sia 100 tawh ki kim hi naci hi. Abraham Lincoln in US president ka suah na ka nu ong pantah na hang hi naci hi. Rosa Wallace in Nauluai a vei khut in leitung buppi uk hi na ci hi. St. Augustine in Nute hong pia un; amau te zangin leitung hong ki lamdang sak ding hing na ci hi. R.A.Torry in Nu hoih sang a azah taak huaizaw kua mah dang om lo hinaci hi. D.L Moody in Nu khempeuh kei ma nu dan hi leh leitungah thonginn ki sam lo ding hi naci hi. Susanah Wesley in Tapa 19 pan tah a, avekpi un mi minthang vive suaksak hi (mipil tampi tak ii gelh te hih lai ah ih lai sau lua ding ahih man in gelh khin zo kei ni). Thukhupna: Na nu adam lai leh napianna nu kiangah thupha dawh hamtangin, na ki sik kei ding hi. Thu-um mahmah khat in thupha deih in zongin, dawh kawikawi a, Pasian kiangah zong thungen in bangci dan in thupha ngah ding ka hi hiam ci-in Topa dong hi. A zan ciangin amang sungah Topa in ki laak a, thupha na ngah nadingin gamla pipi ah zon kul kei, mi khempeuh kiangah zong dawhdawh kul kei, na kiang a a tu khiukheu na nu teek na pianna nu lungdamsak in cih kam mal amang sungah ki gen hi. Tua ahih man in anuai ateng ih ki dong nuam hi. Na nu anungta lai hiam? Anun taak lai leh thupha dawhna tawh lungkim sak in. Na Khasia sak ngei hiam?-A kha siat ngei a, adam lai leh mawh mai na ngen in. Na zi nata hangin akha sia ngei hiam?-Akha siat leh nazi na ta, na nu zak loh kal in hilh in, la na nu zahtaak na pia sak in. An lim ih neek ciang ih ne masa sak ngei hiam?-Ih masak ngei kei leh pia masa ham tangin , a lungsim tawng na lungkim mahmah ding a, thupha zawi hi. Na pai nading a om ciang nu aw tua lai pai ning ci-in na gen ngei hiam?-Tek lua ta bangmah gen kul kei ci-peuh mah ken la, nu aw tua lai, tua te inn ah va pai pak ning ci in. Na tun kal ngaklah mahmah ding hi. Gamla pi ah nutawh ki gamla in na om leh zong alung kim nadingin na hopih ngei hiam?-Atawm pen kha khat in khat vei na nu adam lai leh phone tawh ahi zong na aw ngiat azak theih nading nam khat peuhpeuh tawh ho pih in. Puansilh lui teng kholna hilo in athak sitset na leisak ngei hiam?-Ih leisak ngei mel kei leh tu kum NU NI ciangin athak khat beek hanciam in leisak ni. Na hih zawhding ahih leh adeih mahmah Khi bah, Suaikhi, Bilbah, khut bulh, cih ten a guan ngei hiam? Na guat zawh nai kei leh na tha lawhsa mah tawh neih zawh sak sawm in. Ih neu lai atawm penpen kum nihkum thum sungbang ih zun ih ek asiak ih nute ahih man in, zun leh ek siak kik akul ciang na siak sak hiam? Kih het lo in siak sak ding ki sam hi. Ama hong itna zah mah it thuk ding alung gulh ih nute ahi hi. Nu aw nong it nate hangin nuam ing NU AW ong it ing ci ci mai-in, nu dang lei tungah ih pianna nu sim loh adang om lo hi. Aw mim bang pianna tuun nutan bang tehpih ding om lo tunnu, singta gamlei ka heizongin, tun nu itna zah a itna koi mah ah mu zo keng nu aw ongit ngiat ing ei! Topan asim kha khempeuh nute itna thupha hong pia ta hen! Tags Rev. Hen Khan Go Previous article Deih napi Von A Tawizo Nailo Nupate Theihhuai Pawlkhat. Next article NU: MINAM THUPHA. Thang admin 4 years ago 4 years ago 0 3 mins Pu Hang Tual leh Pi Goih Nial te sung pan Tonzang khua ah 1.9.1922 ni-in suak hi. Nu Ning Za Niang tawh kiteeng a, tanu 4 leh tapa 2 nei uh hi. Sangkahna: Zolai Tan IV dong Tonzang ah kah hi. Manglai Tan IV pan VI dong Tedim ah kah hi. Falam ah Tan IX dong kah hi.1938 in Sagaing ah Tan X tawmvei sung sim a, Maymyo Govt. High School ah Tan X dong kah in, 1939 March ciangin zo hi. 1947 ciangin Yangon University ah kah a,1949 in Senior vuan-in 1950 kumin UDC ngah hi. Tua khit ciangin Senior Assistant ngah hi. Na sem kawmkawm in laivuan kawma Senior I.Sc zo hi. Tua ciangin Science la nawn loin Arts lam zui-a sang kah nading sum thalawh kawmkawm tawh thuah hi. Senior B.A asin kum ciangin Zo zumpi a, a nasepna pan tawp hi.1951 March ciangin Senior B.A vuan hi.1952 ciangin B.A zo hi.1960 pan 1961 dong USA ah kha guk sung lai vasin hi.1962 in Dip.Ed ngah hi. 1963 B.Ed ngah hi. Nasepna: 1939 pan 1940 dong Falam galkap zum ah lai-at sem kawmin Kala kamphen kawm hi. Japan gal sungin 1940 pan 1947 dong Falam Zatopi ah lai-at neu, lai-at pi sem hi. 1948 pan 1950 dong Zangkong Zo zumpi ah lai-atneu, lai-atpi sem hi. 1951 kumin Tedim ah Private sia sem hi. 5.11.1951 Tedim ah SAT sem hi.1955 pan 1957 dong SHS Hakha ah Siapi sem hi.1957 pan 1960 dong Tedim SHS ah Siapi sem hi. August 1960 pan March 1961 ding USA ah pai a, 1961 pan 1963 dong training vakah hi.1963 in Paletwa ah Siapi sem hi.1965 pan 1967 dong Thuklai ah Siapi sem hi.1967 pan 1969 in Mindat ah Siapi sem hi.1968 January in B.E.S (Senior Branch) in zaa khang hi.Kawlkam sinna Kawllai them nono (Burmese Self-taught) bawl hi. How to spell, pronounce, and leran Tedim-Chin Word leh Chin-English Dictionary bawl a J.Gin Za Twang in huh hi. Mindat ah Siapi sem Kimlai cina sa-in hong ciaha 29.6.1967 ni-in Kawlpi leh Tedim kikal Theizang khuataw ah mawtaw tunga tuang Kimlai si hi. Tua ciangin Tedim innpi ah Christian ngeina in kivui hi. Khutcin pen khecin sangin a zah li bangin khanghat zaw hi. A tangpi in nikhatah thumal 5000 bang kigenkhia hih tuak Mi khatbek ii vunah ganhingno(mocro organism) leitung mihing zah sanga tamzaw om ci. Mihing pen ann lo tawh kha khat vaal nungta zo mahleh tui lo tawh kaal khat vaal nungta zo lo hi. Nikhat sungin 23,000 vei ki naak man hi. Mi khat in a nuntak sungin tui 75,000 litres dawn gai man hi. Khutme lakah me lai khang hat pen in khutpi khanghat lo pen hi. Mihing lu ah guh 22 om hi. Na pumpi a tui om 1 bek in kiam leh zong na dangtaak pah ding hi. Mihing cell laka saw thing pen brain cell ahi hi. Na taksa veilam ii nasep pen na khuak taklam in uk a, taklam ii nasep pen na khuak veilam in uk kik hi. Tho pen ni 14 sung bek hing thei hi. Daidep nai 24 sung bek hing thei hi. Ganvulh laka space a zin masa pen Ui ahi hi. Leitunga ui neu pen nam chihuahua kici hi. Tuikep a nu leh a pa ah kiiikhel kawi kawi ziau thei. Thosi pa ten mi pet ngeilo. Starfish in khuak nei lo. Octopus in lungtang thum nei. Sound pen huih lak sangin tui lakah a zah thum bangin pai hat zaw hi. Email masa pen chu kum 1972 in Ray Tomlinson in khak hi. Sik nam laka a tui hak pen tungsten hi in a melting point 3410 degree Celcius hi. Periodic table ah J laimal bek kilanglo. Glass a tui suak sak theiacid pen Hydrofluoric acid kici. Kaikuang namkhat Shrimp kici a lu-ah a lungtang om se. Khuangbai ten a khuk nuai lian ah bil nei. Thokang ten ha 47 nei. Common Goldfish pen ganhing laka Infra-red leh ultra-violet light mukhawm thei omsun ahi hi. Leitunga Alarm clock masa pen Greek mipil Plato in kum BC 427 pek in na bawl khin hi. Ganesh Khoud,Agriculture Department(Assam) a seem kum 1967 in retired napi a zakhanna lai kum 1979 in ngah pan hi. Mihingten 45 degrees a za kimu thei a,mu in 110 degrees a za mu thei zen hi. Numei kum 45 a upa khat leh pasal kum 65 a upa khat pen a thagum hatna uh kikim hi. Leitunga Skycrapper masa pen William Lc Baronkum 1884 in Chicago ah na kilam hi. Tui taak khat bek ah atoms 100000000000 tak om zen hi. Sisan pen tui sangin a zah nga in tha hat hi.Sisan taak khat ah red Blood Cells 100000 leh platelets om hi. India numei Basketball Player te laka sang pen Tata Iron Steel Company,Jamshedpur a kimawl ,Pradeep Shrivatsava tanu Geethika Shrivatsava ahi hi,69 in sang zen hi. Mi a tamzaw in ni khat in mit 25000 vei phiasak man hi. Leitunga Postage Stamp lian pen Marshall Islands Pacific Ocean ah kibawl khia hi.A letter envelope sangin lianzaw ci zaw zen hi. Leitungbupa Meileeng lampi sang pen South American-Peru central railway ahi hi.Rail Station Ticlio kici pen 15.685ft in sang hi. Thang Lian Khup (kum 49) posted on 28 March 2015 at 10:14 pm Lomkholna: Dahpihna , News Dahpihna pulakna Rev. Thang Lian Khup (kum 49) Tedim khua aateng hong nusia sa, Pu Son Cin Lian Pi Niang Khen Don te tapa u pen, Nu Do Suan Vung pasal,Rev.Thang Lian Khup (Khupsan) kum (49) in 24-3-2015 ni-in van innpi hong ciahsan ahih manin anusiat azi atate,asanggam te, adiak in EBC.KL upa Cin Khan Lam (Cia lam) te innkuan tawh akibangin dahna i thuakkhawm hi cih kong pulaak hi. Rev.Thang Lian Khup in, Nu.Don Suan Vung tawh tapa nih nei-in, Florida.USA ah ateng uh ahihi.Unau pasal (5) leh numei (2) lakah pasal ah, u pen ahihi. 29-3-2015 Sunday 5:00 PM hun in EBC.KL.upa Cia Lam te innah, hehnep thungetna Pawlpi mintawh kinei ding hi. A dah akap lungleng khuangai khempeuh hehnempa Khasiangtho in hong hehnem kimciat ta hen!.
