The Golden Generation Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW The Golden Generation Hau Za Cin posted on 5 February 2016 at 10:25 am Lomkholna: Article , Hauzacin Football thu a gen sawm ka hi kei hi. English Football ah tuma deuh leh tulaitaka England Team te pen thukizakna saite (journalist) in, The Golden Generation ci uh hi. Tua lak ah a kihelte pawlkhat David Beckham, Paul Scholes, John Terry, Frank Lampard, Steven Gerard, etc leh a naupangpente Wayne Rooney leh Joe Cole te ahi uh hi. Hih khanghun sungah a kimawlte pen England in 1966 kuma WC Champions a ngah uh pan team hoih penpente hi in a kingaihsun ahi hi. Tua manin FIFA WC Germany 2006 ah zong lametna lianpi nei in Champions ahih kei leh Final tan tung teitei dingin (Zomi Comedy sungah Boxing champion ding a ki umpa mah bangin) amau zong a ki um kingkengte ahi uh hi. Ahi zongin tragedy struck and Rooney got sent off. and the rest is, as they often said, history. USA te in zong Greatest Generation cih bang na nei uh a, amau khangthu a sut uh ciang tua huna khangte tua bang matutna nei uh aci uh hi. Ko, India gam, tu laitak in Information Technology ah ka mabut laitak uh hi a, IT Generation kici thei mai ding hi. Gam tampi ah India pan IT skills tawh nasem tawmlo hi. IIT Kanpur ah ka lawmpa khat pen Hyderabad, India ah college a kah lai un amau batch pen tua college history ah laisiam penpen batch hi ciin kiciamteh hi. Ko zong, ci laizang leng, Hnahlan ah High School ka kah lai un Murlen khuate peuhmah in 1,2,3,. kigual suk diudeu den ka hih manun Hnahlan khua inn 500 in Murlen inn 80 pen hong simmawh thei hetlo uh hi. Tulaitak Lamka CBA pawlpi mi sung pan Ph.D. ngahsa khangno mi 3 in India gam University ah Professor sem uh hi. A pawlpi bup uh mihing tul 4 (4000) phalo maithei hi. Khangpha i cih Golden Generation i cih tua hilo hiam. Hong Kong ka zinlaia ka lungsim ah hong suak khat pen hih hi. Khatvei thu a Zomi hizah Lai Siangtho sangkah gamdangah ki om cih pen ka ngaihsutna a sau sak mahmah khat hi. Amau pen tuhun adingin, ei Zomi te adingin i Golden Generation te hilo uh hiam ka ci hi. Hong Kong ah Lasiam Sia Lianpi (Tang Lungtup), M.Th. sinlai hi a; Sia Mangno, M.Th. mah hi a, Sianu Man Hau Cing, Th.D. hi a, Sia Dal Mang, M.Th. mah hi a; Philipines ah Sia Thang Cin Lian, D.Min. hi a, Siamah Cingkok, Ph.D. hi a; Korea ah Sianu Zen Dot Mang, M.Th.? hi a, hi a, hi a. ka ci toto hi. Tua hun lai leh tua madeuh in Singapore ah Sia Khoi Lam Thang, Sia Tua Mung, etc cihna zong na om hi. Tua bek hilo, a gen uh ciang a pai nailo (tua hun in), Sia Nang Sawm Piang, Sia Go Van Mung, etc cihte hilai hi. Tua bek hilo lai, kawlpi ah ka muh Sia Cin Ngaih Thang, Sia Mun Thang, Sia Hen Khan Go, leh a dang tampi om hi. Hihte khempeuh ka ngaihsut ciang Topa Pasian in Zomi te zong Ama nasem dingin Golden Generation cih theih ding hong pia hilo hiam, ka ci hi. Golden Generation cih ciangin khangkhat hun ah a khangkhawm a muanhuai mahmah, amau sepna peuh ah a lawhcing khawm, a muanhuai khang cihna hi. Sia J.M. Ngul Khan Pau te Lai Siangtho sangkah laiin zong amau khangual pen a khauh pai mahmah hihtuak hi. Sia Dino Tothang pen EFICOR ah General Secretary hi a, India gambup leh gamdang tawh kizopna ah a lianpen (i theihsiam pakna dingin) hi a, Sia Kabi Gangmei pen Baptist World Aid ah a lianpen hi leuleu hi. A dang zong omlai. I gennop zawk pen in ah khangkhat hun ah a khangkhawm lawm leh gual kihual deuh om a, tua bang khangpha (good generation) pen tam mahmahlo hi. Tua bang khangpha hun ah a khang khate hampha mahmah uh hi. India gam hi in, Kawlgam hi in, gamdang ah hita leh i khantohna upate kammal kawm leng, muh theih in khang hi phial hi. Lamka khua sung bekbek pan India gam sungah kumpi u lian a sem tawmlo hi. Kawlgam pan Pasian mina kalsuanna lian pipi a nei tawmlo hi. Hihte khempeuh ka ngaihsut ciang a mawkna in a kingah hilo ding cih ka upna om hi. Pasian in hehpihhuai ciin hong pia phei pak zong hilo kha ding hi. Thumanna leh Cihtakna khahsuah ngei kei inla, cih kigelhna Lai Siangtho i neihma pek in thuman thutak tawh a gamta minam ihih manin tuni in a manpha mahmah leh a khangpha mahmah hun Golden Generation hun ah Topa in hong sangkhai hilo hiam ka ci hi. Hun pawlkhat ah kiim leh pam huihnung hangin luvaih hun leh mangsia man banga i mengmet hun om kha ding hi, ahi zongin tuate in i lungsim hong hencip lo in i neihsa, i go, i van manpha thumanna leh cihtakna hangin mailam ah zong Golden Generation tampi i neih toh zel ding ka lamen hi. Na ngawng ah awk in, na lungtang tungah gelh in, cih i laibu i neihma, tua laibu sung pan i sim teekteek ma pek in i neihsa, i awhsa, i lungtang ah i gelhsa thumanna leh cihtakna a khahsuahlo dingte ihi hi. Tua khempeuh pan hong pai thupha ahi Khangpha, Golden Generation, a kibansamlo dingin Topan hong pia thei hi. I phawk tawntung dinga hoih kasak bel hih bang Golden Generation hong pianna dingin a pattah mi om hi. Makai thupi i cih in amah a laih thei ding, makai a sem thei ding mi tampi a sek khiate hi a kicih mah bangin hih Golden Generation hun ah zong a piangsak makai om hamtang ding hi. King a om theihna dingin King Maker a om kul hi kici a (politics vai ah), tua banga King a pianna dinga a kimulo ah a gim, a tawl, a pantah khat na om hamtang takpi hi. King i hih khit ciang King Maker i sep kul hun hong om dinga, tua hun ciang khangthak khangpha hong pian kik den theihna dingin ei zong King Maker hihding lungsit kei ni. The earlier the better (Makai thei ding a khangno theithei sekzo leng hoih hi). Golden Generation omsak den ni. Ataktak in Malaysia gampen United Nations 1951 Refugee Convention ah thukimna letmat athuhlo gamkhat himahleh Myanmar Refugee tepen agamah aciahkik dingin thagumtawh kisawlloding cihi. Malaysia gampen aki thukhual sakmahmah gamkhat ahihi. 1951 Refugee Convention ah thukimna letmat kithuhlo Signatory Country kihilo himahleh letmat athuhte mahbangin ki thukhual in ki gamta hi cin genbeh hi. Hihvai pen Foreign Minister pan Wisma Putra ah Press Conference akibawl laitak in agenkhiat hi a, Myanmar Chin Refugee Community tepen 2019 kumbei ciangin Refugee in ki ciamteh nawnloding, UNHCR in hukbitna dalna Protection pianawnloding cihvaitawh kisai in thukidotna panin Foreign Minister in agenkhiat, adawnkikna ahihi. UNHCR in 2019 kumbei ciangin Chin Community sung aom Refugee te buaipih nawnloding cih tangko uhhi. Tuavai hangin alungkham, asinkham leh aki sihbawl zahdongin thusia tampi kizakhin hi. Abeisa kalsung in R.AGE ten Chin Community sungah UN vai hangin lungkiat natna Depression angah khanghanhan in, amauleh amau aki sihbawl Suicide zong tampi omkhin hi cin Exclusive Report kiciantak in pulakkhia uhhi. Foreign Minister in agenbehna ah Chin Refugee tepen kumsawmval hihgamsung ah ki omsak khinta hi. Malaysian Government pen thukhual in mi hehpihna anei ahih mahbangin Myanmar Chin Community te bitna leh lungmuanna aomnading in ki vaihawmsak hi. Malaysia gampen Refugee te omsuak nopna Final destination country ahihloh zenzen hangin hihgamsung ah aomtheih nadingin ki vaihawmsak hi. Myanmar Chin Community tepen hawlkhiatding geelna aomloh hangin, Refugee tampitak hih gamsung ah aomtheih nading kicingtaklo hi cihzong genkhia hi. Abeisa tukum June 13 ni in Community Lianson Unit (CLU) te makaihna tawh Malaysia UNHCR huangpisung aom New Building Conference Room ah Meeting kinei hi. Tua Meeting pen Chin Community Based Organizations (CBOs) cin Chin State huamsung aom kipawlna tuamtuam ahi ZAM, ZRC, CRC, ACR, FRO, DAI cihte leh Fellowship makai, Pawlpi makai, Khua makai cihtebek atuamngiat in akisam ahihi. Myanmar gampan in Refugee gambel in aom minamdang Myanmar Ethnic Group tuamtuamzong tampi om himahleh, Chin State huamsung aom kipawlna tengbek atuam vilvel in UNHCR ten Meeting asap uh ahih manin, bangthu om hidinghiam cin ki lunghimawh mahmah a, Chin State huamsung pan gambel Refugee khempeuh pen 31 December 2019 ciangbek UN Card tawikhuan kipiading a, tuakhitzawh UN Card tawikhuan omnawnloding, Renew ki bawlthei nawnloding cihthu kigenkhia takpimawk hi. Hihpen Chin State huamsungpan mikhempeuh 31 December 2019 ciangbek Refugee in ki ciamteh laiding, tuakhitzawh Refugee in kiciamteh nawnloding cihna ahihi. Hihpen Chin State Refugee khempeuh tawh kisai ci uh a, tuni akipan 2019 kumbeidong Myanmar gamsung ciahkiknading in ahun kha 18 sung hongki piahi cin pulakkhia uhhi. Abeisa in aki buaipih mahmah 2013 Card tawite, 2013 kumma Card tawite cihbang in kikhenna bangmah omtuam nawnloding a, ahi zongin Card Renew khempeuh anunung penpen 31 December 2019 ciangbek Card Renew kibawlsakding cihi. 31 December 2019 khitzawh UNHCR zumpi in Chin State pan Refugee tepen buaipih nawnloding, tavuan lanawn loding, amautawh kisaina omsak nawnloding citamawk hi. Tua ahih manin 31 December 2019 khitzawh UN Card tawikhuan aomnawnloh banah Chin State Refugee tetawh kisai in zato vai, sangvai, kimat kihenvai khempeuh UNHCR tawh kisaina bangmah omnawnlodingci uhhi. zomidaily PHONE NUMBER UPDATE BAWL HAMTANG IN Na phone mangsia ahih leh a manlang theithei in UNHCR zum ah update bawl hamtangin. Articles Knowledge Lai Nasepna Pasian maw Sesum (More Money Than GOD). AgelhKhansuan T. Guite By: LAIBUSAAL Date: August 1, 2021 Pasian maw Sesum (More Money Than GOD) Agelh Khansuan T. Guite Newspaper lui ka lemlem leh nimit 19 February,2007 ni a USA Today newspaper sungah USA gamsung Virginia gamke St. Jude Catholic biakinn a sem Roman Catholic (RC) Diecese Rodis in biak inn neihsa sum US 600,000 (tul za guk) a nek gukna hangin thu khenzum ah thu sitna a thuakna ka sim kha hi. Hih bang thu kasim lai in ka lungsim ngaihsutna ah mihing tampi ten Pasian sangin sum thupi sak zawkna leh midang ten hong mu kei, hong thei kei tah cin Pasian deih loh na hoihlo tampi a kisep ngamna hong phawk sak kik hi. Pasian ih mut kal cih bang a om sam loh hangin Pasian om lam i phawk khak loh hun tam pha mahmah hi. Newspaper a dang khat sung ka et kik leh Cartoon kigelhna column ah a hong tung ding 2008 kum, USA gamsung ah Presidential election a kidem ding (candidate) a kith aw i Democratic party a nominees te lak pan a hat pen Senator Hillary Cliton a kikona ka sim kha leuleu hi. Halary Cliton in a ma mee (vote) zonna ah a thupi sak pen hauhsakna ahih manin USA gamsung a Pasian um mi tampi in Pasian a mang ngilh khak ding lauhna tawh Hillary Cliton in Pasian sangin sum deih zaw hi (More money than God) cin a kona uh ahi hi. Hih Cartoon ka muh ciangin kammal li (4) bek tawh kigelh hi na pi USA gam sung mite ngaihsutna hong kilang sak mahmah zo a, mitampi tak zong sum deihna hang in Pasian kiang pan lam pial khin zo a hih na hong kilang sak hanhan hi. Hih a tunga thute ka muh ciangin tu lai tak Zomi te nuntakna zia zong ka mit kha sungah hong kilang siasua hi. Zomi te zong an nek tui dawn ding kisap manin nasep tuamtuam kisem sam napi haksatna tampi tawh leitung minam dangte nuntakna zia kipha zo nai lo hi. A beisa kum sawtnai lo hun (4-5 decade ago) lai in Zogam ah galkap piang ki ci a, tu hun tak teh Pasian nasem leh biakna na sem piang kici leuleu hi. Zong man takpi hi. Zomi te in nekzonna dingin a beisa hunsung a mi a tam zaw sep theih galkap na kisem ngeingai a, tu hun tak teh galkap na sep tawh innkuan nuntak kicing zo nawnlo ahih manin nuntakna zonna ding a om sun lampi a hi Pasian na leh biakna na kisem ngeingai leuleu hi. Pasian na sem ding a ki aap takpi leh sapna ngah takpi a kisap bangin, mi pawl khat zong om tak pi mah a, ahih hangin biakna na sem ding in sapna leh ki aap luat zong kullo in kisem thei hi. Mi pawlkhat te in biakna nasep leh Pasian nasep ki khenlo kha ahih manin biakna nasem pawlkhat te Pasian nasem kisa a pawlpi sung, khua sung leh gamsung ah buaina tampi om den hi. Biakna nasem te in a pualam ah a ut bangun gamta in nipi (Sunday) ni ciangin pulpit tungah kah in thu hilh zong zum huai sa lo uh hi. Thu hilhtu te man lo ahih manin a tawpna thu ngai mi te zong lampial gawp in siatna piang thei zaw hi. Zomi te pen a tamzaw Christian ki hi a, Pasian upna a thupi sak minam te i hi hi. Sep ding bawl ding om leh Pasian min tawh na sem leng a nuam mahmah ahih manin na khempeuh Pasian min paulam in na kisem hi. Tua hi a, i tualsung nuntakzia (civil society) zong i biakna in hong zeel a, i Christian biakna bulphuh na khempeuh kivai hawm ahi hi. Biakna makai Upa, Siate pen kizah tak a, a thugen te uh hoihin hoih ta kei leh Pasian zahtak manin nial ding in kituat lo hi. Tua ahih manin i minam hoihna ding leh siatna ding pen biakna makai (Upate leh siate) makaihna sungah om hi. Hoihna ding a hong makaih uh leh i minam bup in a zal ki zo dinga, hong pai khialh pih uh leh i minam bup in daan kituak ding hi. Tua bang in Pasian zahtakna tawh a thu mang Zomi te sungah na sem ding mi hong kibeh lap in nasep zong nuam mahmah hi. Ahi zongin Laisingtho tawh a Pasian thugen mi khempeuh pen Pasian nasem taktak ding a ki aap leh sapna ngah hi lo uh ahih manin a piang thak takpi hi lo in, a kipiang thak sak mite hi a Pasian nasep ding sangin Biakna nasep ding hong kin zaw uh hi. A maute in mun khempeuh ah Pasian om cih um na pi Pasian sangin mite lau zaw uh a, mite muh loh leh theih loh na mun te ah a hoihlo nate sem ngam mawhlo uh hi. Pawlpi sum zong ne gu ngam lah lo uh hi. Khialhna tuamtuam zong bawl ngam lah lo uh hi. Tua bang mite in Pasian a lungkim sak ding sang sik in Pasian min dai sak zaw uh ahih manin i minam tungah Pasian hehna hai hong kibua thei lai hi. Pasian a min dai sak khat leh nih hang tawh i minam bup tungah Pasian hehna i thuak kha thei hi. USA gam zong a kiphuh khiat cil lai hun in Pasian upna leh muanna tawh kiphu t khia gam ahih manin In God we Trust ci -i n a sum laidal tungah a kigelh ngiat gam ahi hi. Pasian upna leh muanna tawh a kal suan hun sung uh leh Pasian um taktak te in a makaih manin USA gam pen leitungah gam hoih leh a hau pen gam suak hi. Ahi zongin Pasian sangin sum a thupi sak luat uh ciangin a gam uh a hauhna zah in lungnopna omlo hi. Leitung bup ah kithahna leh khialhna (criminals) a tam pen na gam cileng kikhiallo ding hi. Abeisa April 16, 2007 ni a Virginia Technology sang ah South Korea gam pan a suak mi khat in sang inn sungah mi (23) kap lum a, USA tangthu sungah mi khat i khut lum tawh mi a tam sihna pen khat ahi hi. A gammi te leh gam sung makai te (biakna makai leh politik makai te khempeuh) pen thuman gamtat nawnlo in Pasian sangin mihing te mai en zaw in Pasian kiang pan lam pial lua mahmah ta uh ahih manin Pasian hehna a gammi te khempeuh in thuak uh hi. Makai te khialhna ahi zongin mi khat i khialhna ahi zongin ama h bek in thuak lo in, mipi leh minam bup in ki thuak thei hi. Tags Tual Khan Suan Previous article Kingaklah Lua Kha Zel. Agelh Pu Gin Pian Khup Zokhup By: LAIBUSAAL Date: May 29, 2023 Zogam Aksi 3 te Agelh Pu Gin Pian Khup Zokhup Zomi le Zogam tangthu ah thupi deuh Zogam Aksi ci-in min kipiathei ciat hi. Tua bangin i piakte sungah nasepna le panmun tawh kizui in I piak hikha ding ahih manin, kuamah kimawhsak theih omlo hi. Ahi zongin Minam le gamvai ah Zomite ading madawk bek tham loin abeisa le tuni dong i et kikkik ciangin, 1900 khit ciapteh thamcing mi 3 om hi. Tuate in; Pu Hau Za Lian (Sukte Independence Army-SIA) Pu Mang Tung Nung (Chin National Organisation-CNO) Pu Chin Sian Thang (HCSU, ZNCZCD) Pu Hau Za Lian pen Sukte Independence Army ah mangpi Commander-in-Chief hi a, Kawl ten Japan te a do ma Zomi te makaih a Japan do ahi hi. Anti Japanese movement ah leitung theih a ciapteh thamcing khat ahi hi. Tua banah Pu Kamhau leh Ukpi hun a Zogam galkapte British te i lelh nunga, Zomi tawh kisai galkap phutkik masa pen ahi hi. Japan lah do, British lah langpang ci in galpi nihna zawh ciangin British te nangawnin a matsawm liang ahi hi. Pu Mang Tung Nung pen Panglong tungtangah Federal Union deih ung ci a, mumal tak a dawng thei om sunsun ChinZomi mipilam palai khat ahi hi. Tuabanah 1947 constitution pen Federal Constitution tawh laih ding a, Taunggyi mualmi leh mualgam khawmpi ah Zomi palai teng makai ahi hi. Ni masa ni bekin thugen a, a kik ciangin Zomi lak a Law sin masa pen leh Hill Chin Student Union Chairman Tg. Chin Sian Thang tonpih in ama tangin thugen in pantah a, tuni dong Pu Chin Sian Thang Federal Politics ah a makai suak ahi hi. Zomi lak ah King Commission kici mangkang galkap bawk 3 za taktak angah masa pen ahih manin, Captain Mang Tung Nung ci in thanga Captain pa zong kici hi. A za taawpna taktak pen MajorBohmu ahi hi. Nasep teng akhawl ciangin makai leh ulian dangte bangin Kawlgam ah a sih dong vaitham loin, apianna khua Muizawl khua, Zogam ah ciahkik ngiat in tengkik hi. A sanggampa tate 2 Zomi milian leh makai sem ngei Pu Khen Za Mung leh adangdangte nangawn tuni dong Zogam ah tengkik tamlo hi. Pu Chin Sian Thang pen Sitnipa kici a Zomi lak ah LL. B zo masa pen ahih banah a degree lakna pen Amerian Constitution ahi hi. Zomi milui lak ah constitutional law thei omlo kikeuh a, khangthak ah zong tuni dong mah khutme kuaih theih lai phial ding ahi hi. Taunggyi Conference ah Pu Mang Tung Nung tawh a kithuah khit uh ciangin, 1974 Constitution vai ah zong Federal Constitution Zomi ten ka deih uh hi ci in Myanmar Army chief Ne Win kiangah Pu Lian Uk (Haka) te tawh makaih in lai pia uh ahih manin mat leh thuak lawh hi. 1988 zawh ZNC ah president dinmuun la in Federal Cause mah dingpih suak ahi hi. Gamsung gampua te deih Panglong Conference samkik ding tawh kisai Kalay Declaration makai in tangko ahih manin gambup cihmawh laitak tawh kituakin, Aung San Suu Kyi in zong thukimin amah ki-ap suak hi. 2016 kum ciangin kilemna khawmpi kibawl ding pen in min 3 aneih lak ah 2 ahi 2nd Panglong leh 21st Century Panglong pen Kalay Declaration huzap tawh kiloto suak ahi hi. Pu Hau Za Lian leh Pu Mang Tung Nung pen aKawl aZo cih omlo, leitungbup theih hita a, tangthu nei Zomi aksipi 2 hita in, Pu Chin Sian Thang bel bangmah theilo hai ciakciak teng, hong ki nung-leh -kaih saklo a, tutung Panglong ah mualmi mualgamte lunggulh tawn tung ahi Federal Constitution mah hong dinpih suak a leh Aksipi 3na in kiciamteh suak ding ahi hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Thupha Guntui Hau Suan Khai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Thupha Guntui Hau Suan Khai posted on 1 January 2013 at 6:40 pm Lomkholna: News Thupha Guntui Hau Suan Khai Abeisa 2013 sung Malaysia a om Zomi te ih ki makaihna, kalsuanna ah hamsatna, gentheihna, ze-etna omlo hilo in, tuate sungah ih biak Topan ih thuak lah ding hamsatna, gentheihna, ze-etna tuamtuam hong thuak saklo in hong ompih tawntung in gualzawhna hongpia ahih manin tua Topan minthanna, vangliatna leh ukzawhna te tang tawntung ta hen! Pilna, siamna leh theihna kicinglo pipi mahin minam itna, veina, lainatna leh hehpihna tawh Malaysia Zomi Kiphawlna (ZAM) a sem ka hi bek vua, nong hawmthawh hun uh zong om zel ding hi. Kicinglo pipi mahin 2013 sung sepkhiatna tampi omte lak ah pawl khat en leng: Minam kician ih hihna tawh kizui in ih minam Zomi Nam Ni nasia takin kibawl a, tua ni thungen dingin kawlgam panin Pu Cin Sian Thang (ZCD President) kisam a, Short speech gen dingin Dr. Hau Za Cin, Singapore pan kisam hi. Zomi Nam Ni pahtawina a kibawl den ahi Zomi Cup tukpeng kidemna Team 41, Khua 40 panin nasia takin kinei hi. Malaysia gam sung a om Zomi kampau biakpiakna nei pawlpi 32 te tawh khut kilen in tatsatlo thungetna kha khat sung kinei hi. Zomi ngeina khuado pawi kibawl in thungen dingin Pu Hang Khan Lian (President ZIS) kisam, Zolia Zotaang kiteelna zong nasia takin ki bawl hi. Dr. Do Kham in hong nusiat tak ciangin Malaysia om Zomi ten zong memorial service ZAM ah kibawl a, galna RM 4398.40 val kikhak hi. Malaysia a om Zomi ten ih lunggulh mahmah ahi UNHCR minsanna tul tampi hong ngah thei hi. A hunhun in khua makai te leh biakna makai te tawh kimuh khopna kinei den. Nisim zumvai ki vaipuakna tuamtuam kisem den hi. Gentehna in, innkuan lutpih ding leh kisam theilo te kisap theih nang laiten sakna, phone len khalo te kisap kik theih nang laiten sakna, damlo te ading huhna ngetsakna, Card bawlna etc Damlo te zato kipai pih a ki huh tawntung hi. Kimat, kihen tuak te huh theih zahin kihuh a suahtak theihna ding lampi kipan pih den hi. Rawng, Kota Damnasara, Setapak leh Klang veng tengah UNHCR-CDU tawh kithuah ngiat in zumvai dot nop peuh dotna kinei. Nasep neilo te nasep amau septheih tawh kituak kizon sak den hi. Zomi naupang te pilna, siamna tuamtuam ki hilh hi. Sihna tuakna ah luang kipham in vai khempeuh kivan pih. Zomi numei te khut siamna tuamtuam hilh na. NGO tuamtuam te kiangah Zomi ki pulak tawntung. Zomi numei te khut siamna tuamtuam hilh na. Mipi tawh thu le la zumvai ki zakna THUPUAK kal khat in copy 1500 manh nget lohin kihawm khia den hi. A tung a teng ih gen khiat theih pak Malaysia Zomi Kipawlna (ZAM) in sep khiat teng hi a, hi teng bek cihna hilo hi. Hi ci bang a Zomi mipih te phattuam theihna ding na lianpi ih sep theihna pen thu dang hi peuh mahlo in Pa Pasian hong hehpihna thupha hang hi. A beisa 2013 sung tawntung Zomi te hong ompih a hong kalsuan pih Topa in 2014 kumthak sungah zong hong ompih zaw kan lai ding a thupha namkim hong pia lai ding hi. Tua ahih manin tukum 2014 sungin mite a ding thupha a bawlzo nupa THUPHA GUNTUI ih hihna ding mimal kimin hamciam in a nuai a Pasian kammal tawh 2014 ading thala khawm ni. THUPHA GUNTUI Ezekiel 47:1-7 sungah guntui thu khat kigelh a, a beisa thu genna ahi phial zongin, mailam thu genna ahi phial zongin, tuni in Pasian thu um Zomi te adingin THUPHA GUNTUI ci-in ih gen nuam hi. Tua thupha guntui pen Pasian kiang panin hong luang hi ci-in ih gen nuam hi. Thupha guntui tawh kisai thu thum kisin thei a, tuate in A Nak, A Luana leh A Tha. 1. Thupha Guntui Ih Nak Hih thupha guntui hong kipat khiatna mun gunnak koi teng hiam? Tg. 1na ah biakinn kongkhak pan ci hi. Jerusalem khua a om biakna inn kongkhak panin pan hih thupha guntui hong kipan hi. Khuapi dangte bang lo in Jerusalem ah khua in a khua sungah tuinak khat bek neilo hi. Ahih hang tu in thupha guntui hong luangkhia hi. Tua ahih manin thupha guntui hong luankhiatna pen Pasian kiang Van Jerusalem pan ahi hi. Thupha khempeuh hong luanna Nak pen Pasian ahi hi. A beisa kum sung ih thupha san khempeuh sim kik le hang ih pil man, ih siam man, ih ginat man hi leh sang hetlo ding hi hang. Ahi zongin Pasian in tua te na enlo a thupha hong pia ahih manin Pasian pen ih thupha nak hi a, ih san thupha khempeuh Ama kiang pan ahi hi. Na thupha te khat khait khat sim kik in la thupha nak ahi Pasian kiangah lungdam koko in. 2. Thupha Guntui Ih Luanna Pasian kiangpan a hong luang hih thupha guntui koi lamah luangsuk hiam? Tg. 1na ah nisuahna lamah kici hi. Jerusalem khua panin nisuahna lamah bang om hiam? Tg. 8 na ah, gam keugaw sung nawkin Jordan kuamah luangsuk a, Si Tuipi sung tungin Si Tuipi a siangsak hi, kici hi. Gam keugaw a nelsak ding, a nosak ding hih thupha guntui ahi hi. Nuntakna a nelsak ding, a nosak ding thupha guntui ahi hi. A uih, a namsia Si Tuipi siangsak hi. Nuntakna uih, nuntakna namsia a siangsak ding hih thupha guntui ahi hi. Hong nosak, hong siansuah guntui ahi hi. Ei Zomi te zong Jerusalem pan hong luang khia Jordan gunin Si Tuipi a uih, a namsia sung a om ganhing te nuntakna apiak, a siansak mah bangin Zomi ahih lam uh thei gegu or mimal phattuam na ding bek a C Tuipi uih, namsia sung a ki daihdiah ih Zomi pihte a piangthak sak ding, a siansuah ding, a namtui sak ding nang kei leh mawhpuak ahi hi. 3. Thupha Guntui Ih Tha Hih thupha guntui hong luansuk khit ciangin khuah pai tektek hi. A tui tam tektek hi. Khuah tektek hi. Amasa in siakmit ciang bek thuk hi (tg. 3) khuk ciangah khang hi (tg. 4), kawng ciangah khang hi, khangkhang lai a kingaptan zo nawnlo hi (tg. 5). Van pan a hong luang thupha guntui in keugaw gam nosak a, a uihte siangsak in, nuntakna khem zel hi. Ih Pasian na sepna, ih minam na sepna ah ni khat khit ni khat, kha khat khit kha khat, kum khat khit kum khat a khang tektek ding, a khauh tektek ding, a thahat tektek ding ZOMI te ih hi hi. 2014 sung na innkuan pihte ading, na lawm na gual ading, na khua kipawlna ading, na pawlpi ading, na minam kipawlna ading THUPHA GUNTUI ahi dingin Zomi mimal kim Topan thupha hongpia ta hen! "url": " comgamvai-leh-biakna-vai-khenzia-pu-thangboi", "depth": 0 --- Gamvai leh Biakna vai khenzia Pu Thangboi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Gamvai leh Biakna vai khenzia Pu Thangboi posted on 28 September 2016 at 11:21 pm Lomkholna: News, Politics, Thangboi, Zomi Gamvai leh Biakna vai khenzia Pu Thangboi Tuhun teh Zomi ten Gamvai leh Biakna vai lumletkha pahpah ih hih man in ih minam sungah buaina tampi om hi. Tua ahih man in Gamvai leh Biakna vai khenzia ding tawm lungngai khawm leng hoih ding hi. Hih mun ah Gamvai kacih ciang in kawlpau in Naingnganyee, mikang pau in Politics akici pen hi. Biakna vai kacih ciang in Christian (tapidaw) Biakna bek ahi hi. Biakna dangte tawh kisailo hi. Gamvai ih cih pen leitung leinuai aa akimu thei (visible) khempeuh ahi hi. Biakna vai bel akimu theilo (invisible) khempeuh hi. Gamvai pen gam thukhun (constitution) tungtawn in ki vaihawm aa Biakna vai zong biakna thukhun ahi Laisiangtho tungtawn in ki vaihawm hi. Gam thukhunte pen mihing te bawl hi aa leitung aa gam thukhun a upa penpen USA te thukhun ahi hi. Tu kum 2016 kum September kha in kum 229 pha ta hi. A upapen nihna 1814 kum aa kibawl Norway ta hi aa athumna pen 1831 kum aa kibawl Belgium ta hi. Biakna thukhun (LST) bel kum 1500 val sung phial mi tuamtuam 40 kiim bang in agelh hi aa agelh khit zawh uh kum 2000 bang phata hi. Gam thukhun in gam khat sung aa akimu thei teng bek huam aa biakna thukhun in leitung leh vantung aa akimuthei leh akimu theilo khempeuh avek in huam hi. Gam thukhun pen adiak in mihingte zuihding aa kibawl hi aa biakna thukhun pen mihing, akimu thei akimu theilo na khempeuhte leh Pasian mahmah in azuih ding aa abawl ahi hi. Gam thukhun pen agam mite in adeih kei nak leh kilaih thei aa biakna thukhun pen leitung mihing khempeuh in adeih kei phial zong in kilaih thei tuanlo ding hi. Gam thukhun khatpeuh ih palsat hang in mi khat teiiteii in hong muh hong theihpih khak kei leh mawhna omlo in kisim hi. Biakna thukhun bel kua mah in hong theihpih khak sese loh hang in ih palsat nak leh akimawh hipah hi. Gam thukhun azuite bang mah kicih lo aa biakna thukhun azuiten hamphatna leh pahtawina tampi ngah hi. Gam thukhun in mawh hi hong cih nak leh thuum theih om nawnlo aa mawhna thaman thuak loh phamawh hi. Biakna thukhun in mawh hi hong cih hang mawhna thaman thuakloh theihna lampi om hi. Gamvai ah thukhun zui in gam-uk ding kilaih zel aa biakna vai ah bel a Ukpa kilaih ngeilo hi. Gamvai ah atungnung ding kituh kul aa biakna vai ah anuainung ding kituh kul hi. Biakna vai ah Zeisu theih bek tawh pianglo aa neih zong kul hi. Gamthu ah bel suahphet aa neihsa hizaw aa theih loh phamawh hi. Ih theih kei leh gamvai kisem theilo hi. Gamvai ah theihna tawh kikal suan. Biakna vai ah neihna tawh ki kalsuan. Gamvai ah mipite deihna zuih kul aa biakna vai ah Pasian deihna zuih kul hi. Gamvai in biakna vai tung ah thuneihna nei zolo hi. Gtn in leitungbup aa kumpi teng kikai khawm in Tukum guah zusak lo ding; huihnung sak lo ding; misi sak lo ding cih bang khen tat theih omlo hi. Ahih hang in biankna vai Ukpa khentatna khempeuh gamvai in azuih loh pha mawh vetse hi. Gamvai tung ah biakna vai in khupnelh hi. Gamvai pen akimu thei teng bek ahih man in tuaval bangmah kantan zolo hi. Biakna vai bel akimu theilo teng ahih man in akimu thei ten khaktan theilo hi. Gamvai in gamgi nei aa biakna vai pen tua gamgi ten khaktan theilo hi. Gamvai tawh akilam mihingte nuntak khuasakna sung ah biakna in na asep theihna ding in gamvai in kong hong leh hoihpen hi. Gamvaite gamvai zia leh tong tawh kituak in vaihawm ding hi aa biakna vai zong Ukpa zia leh tong zuih ding ahi hi. Gamvai tawh kisai kipawlna khatpeuh phuat ding ciang in mihingte gelsiamna leh ngaihsut siamna ahoih pente gawmkhawm aa phuat ding ahi hi. Biakna vai bel a Ukpa cih bangbang manh ding hilel hi. Biakna pawlpi khawng gamvai dan aa mihingte hoihsak thu tawh phuat ziauziau ding hilo aa a Ukpa dot phot ding ahi hi. Pasian thukim pihna omlo pi aa pawlpi khawng mawk phuat ziauziau ding hilo hi. Gamvai pen pilna siamna tawh deihtak kidemh ding hi aa biakna vai ah bel itna masuan in kiniam khiat tak in mi khempeuh tawh kiho theih kul hi. Biakna vai ah gal omlo hi. Gamvai ah angal hat tata, mitam aukzo tata gualzo in ki ngaihsun aa biakna vai ah akiniam khiat tata, mitam ahuhzo tata gualzo in ki ngaihsun hi. Gamvai ah ei mahmah in ihsep kul aa biakna vai ah Ukpa sepsa upna muanna tawh zuih hiathiat ding ahi hi. Gamvai ah gam khat luahna ding in khua-ul sisan tawh lei kul aa biakna vai ah bel tawntung gam luahtheihna ding in Zeisu in abuak khiat a khua-ul a sisan te tung ah upna muanna tawh kingak hithiat ding hilel hi. Gamvai ah thuneite vahuh in va panpih leng pahtawina kingah aa biakna vai ah bel Ukpa ihva huh kul sese lo hi. Gamvai ah uliante tawh kimuh khak ding hamsa mahmah aa biakna vai ah bel ut hunhun in Alianpen Pa kihopih thei ziauziau hi. Gamvai ah pilna, siamna, hauhna, cidamna leh hanciamna te thupi mahmah aa biakna vai ah bel Ukpa in akicing in aneihsa hi aa tuate khempeuh ih nuntakna ah hong luankhiat theihna ding in Ama zia leh tongte zui in amah tawh kikholh det kul hi. Gamvai khempeuh mihingte khutsung ah Pasian in a apsa hi aa biakna vai khempeuh Pasian in atawntung in len gige hi. Gamvai ah thuneihna Pasian in mihing tungah apiaksa ahi hi. Biakna vai pen vantung pan kivaihawm aa gamvai pen leitung pan kivaihawm hi. Gamvai ah gualzawhna leh lawhcinna pen akimutheite tawh kiteh aa biakna vai ah bel akimu theilote tawh kiteh zaw hi. Pasian a umte in Vantung ah na deihna akicin mah bangin leitungah kicingta hen a cih theih ding kisamh hi. Gamvai leh biakna vai pen kibangh hetlo napi kizom gige hi. Kawlgam bang ah gamvai hong kihon teh biakna vai nasepna zong nakpi in mazang pah hi. Zomi ten biakna leh gamvai helzau nawnlo in ama zia leh tong tek tawh kalsuan thei hile hang ih minam hong cidam mahmah pah ding hi. Gamvai nasem ten gam thukhunte hoihtak theih kul aa pilna siamna tawh kop akul mah bang in biakna nasem ten zong biakna thukhun ahi Lai Siangtho sung ah nakpi tak in kibual in Pasian tawh hoihtak kilawm tatna nei in Pasian zia leh tong zui in a kalsuan theih ding uh kisamh mahmah hi. Tu aa kipan gamvai leh biakna vai te ama zia leh tong tawh kituak in sem setset leng Zomite ih nahlawh hong pek ding aa mite mai leh Pasian maipha ngah ding ih hih man in minam lian khat manlang tak in ih suak ding hi. Hih lai nasim kawmkawm in Pasian Khasiangtho in hong lawng in athuthuukte hong hilh ngiatna ding in thu kangen hi. Amen. "url": " "depth": 0 --- Zomi Pau tuamtuam Paul Thangpi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zomi Pau tuamtuam Paul Thangpi posted on 15 September 2016 at 7:54 am Lomkholna: Article , PaulThangpi , Politics Zomi Pau tuamtuam (Tedim, Teizang, Saizang, Sihzang, Zo, etc.) a tom in Paul Thangpi Zomi sung ah Pau (language) tuamtuam hong piankhiatna i et ciang, nam (2) in kikhen thei hi. Tua te in: (1) Luahsuk Pau (Traditional Language), (2) Piangtawm Pau (Borning Language) ahi hi. Luahsuk Pau (Traditional Language) Zomi sung ah Luahsuk pau icihte in: Teizang pau, Sihzang pau, Saizang pau, Zo (puzo) pau, Paihte pau, Dim, Losau, Khuano, etc. te ahi uh hi. Hih Kampaute Zomi sung ah i kep lai Luahsuk pau te hi in, hong kipat hun zong kikan ban nawn lo ahih manin, upa mahmah ta uh hi. Piangtawm Pau (Borning Language) Piangtawm Pau (Borning Language) icih pen a mitamna leh a zang ding tamna tawh kisai loin piangtawm pau ahih manin, mi khempeuh in zat nuamsa in, khang baih in, mainawt den hi. Tu laitak leitung khempeuh ah akizang pha mahmah Mikang Pau (English) icih pen piangtawm pau ahi hi. Zomi sung ah Piangtawm pau icih pen Tedim Pau icih ahi hi. Luahsuk Pau (Teizang, Sihzang, Saizang, Zo, etc.) te sang in naupang zaw thamtham hi. Tedim Pau Hong Piankhiatna Hunkhatlai in Tedim khua ah minam tuamtuam, kampau le ngeina kibanglo tuamtuam a tenkhopna pan un hong piang khia ahi hi. A ten khop uh a sawt ciangin a tu, a tate uh hong kikhol in tua a kikholhna pan un, pau khat hong piang khia a, tua hong Piangtawm Pau pen Tedim Pau ki ci hi. Sangmang Cope topa te innkuan Tedim hong tun uh ciangin Ukpi Pu Hau Cin Khup kiang ah Na zat khop theih ding uh lai bawl nuam ihih manin, bang kam zang le hang hoih sa pen na hiam? ci-in a dot leh Pu Hau Cin Khup in Mipite deih bel khat hi lo ing hia ci-in na dawng hi. Tua tawh kizui in Tedim khuapi a kizang Tedim Tualsuak Pau tawh Cope topa in lai hong bawl sak hi. Tedim Pau Khantohna 1919 hunlai in Sukte in Zogam leilu lam (Tedim le Tonzang gam teng) na uk in siah na kai uh a, Teizang pau tawh uk uh hi. Tuciang dong mah Teizang pau pen Ukpi te pau kici lai hi. Tua ahih manin a diakin Teizang pau zangte in pau dang zuih ding haksa ki sa phadiak hi. Hun hong bei toto in 1979 ma siah ei pau ciat mah kizang tangtang hi napi, kikawmna, kithuahna tam zaw semsem ahih manin Tedim pau in mai hong nawt mahmah hi. 1990 khit lam ciangin gam sung haksatna hang ahi zongin kimuh khopna leh kithuah khopna hong tam semsem na hangin mai nawt semsem in, kum 2000 khit ciangin Tedim pau in Zomi te sung ah zattaang theih Pau hong suak ta hi. Thukhupna Tulaitak in Zomi sung ah i zattaang theih pen in Piangtawm pau ahi Tedim pau ahi hi. Hih Tedim pau hong piankhiat theihna ding in Luahsuk Pau tuamtuam ahi: Teizang, Saizang, Sihzang, Zo, Dim, Losau, Khuano, Paite, etc. etc. a om man in hong piang khia thei ahi hi. Tua ahih manin Piangtawm Pau ahi, tu laitak a Zomi sung ah i zat kim theih Tedim Pau hoihsa in, i zahtaak leh a piankhiatna ahi Luahsuk pau tuamtuam (Teizang, Saizang, Sihzang, Zo etc.) te zong i zahtak le i iit theih ding thupi mahmah hi. I pu i pa te in a dahna vuah dah khop nang, a nopna vuah nop khop nang, khat le khat kizop theih nang a Luahsuk Pau tuamtuam te na piang sak uh hi. Tu hun ciangin Ciamnuih bawlna peuh, ki ko na peuh in zang lo in i zahtaak bawl theih ding thupi mahmah hi. Note tawh, Paul Thangpi (Offenbach, Germany) Reader Interactions Previous: Democracy maw? Langh Sawm Kim Kimpu Kum (37) ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Dahna Pulakna: Mangpha Tg. Langh Sawm Kim Kimpu Kum (37) posted on 3 August 2016 at 9:14 am Lomkholna: Dahpihna, News, ZIUSA, Zomi USA gam, Oregon State, Portland khuapi a teng Tg. Langh Sawm Kim Kimpu, Thatmun beh, Kum (37) in abeisa August 1, 2016 ni-in Portland khuasunga Zato minthang khat ahi Adventist Hospital panin gilsunglam damlohna hangtawh mual ong liamsanta cihthu izakmanin Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in nakpitakin kidahpih, kilainatpih mahmah hi. Tg. Kimpu pen Zogam, Tedim uksung, Heilei khuami, kawlpi ateng Pa Zel Za Cin leh Nu Tel Ngo Cing ten Tapasal 4 tanumei 4 a neihnalakah a upen 4na hi-in Tg. Kimpu pen leitung nuntak khuasakna, sumzon paaizonna a nuamzawding lunggulhna tawh a beisa 2008 kumin USA gam ongtung ahihi. nasepna khempeuhah citak mahmah, mipawlnuam mahmah khat leh Zomi tangval melhoih mahmah khat ahihmanin hicibanga khangdawnglai pi a mual ong liamsanpen pammaihsa leh I phalnai het kei hi. ahizongin ei mihingte ongbawl ongnei i Pa Pasian gelnabanga na khempeuh apiang ahihmanin ithuaksiamtekdingzong I kideihsak hi. I sanggampa Tg. Kimpu pen USA leitang tunga ong nusia Zomi khat ahihna tawh kizui-in Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in Zomi sungah unausanggam khat, laizomkhat sikhat sakhat hihnahanga lainatpihna, dahpihna lahna in Paakkual khattawh Mangpha khakna kineiding hi. I sanggampa Tg. Kimpu tawh a nunungpen hunzatkhopding pen ongtungding August 03, 2016 (Wednesday) ni-in Omega Funeral Cremation Service Chapel Hall 223, SE 122nd Ave, Portland, OR 97233 ah zingsang nai 11:00am hun-in Zomi Bethel Church pawlpite makaihna tawh anunungpen hunzatkhopna, hehnephunbawlna kineidinga tuakhitciang 2:00pm hunin 400 SW Walters Dr, Gresham, OR 97080 ah vuina daitansakna kineiding hi. I sanggampa Tg. Kimpu ongnusiatna hanga adah akap Inn leh gam muntuamtuam pana alunglengkhuangai pianna nulehpa sanggam laizomteng leh khuapihtuipih tanaumeltheih behlehphung a kuamapeuh tungah ibiak Vanglian Pasianin amakiangpana ongpai a khasiangtho hehnepna bucing ongpiaksak henla aluang khituite ong nulsakin lungnoptawldamna ongguan kimciat tahen cih Zomi Innkuan USA kipawlna in thu kongngetpih uhhi. Dahpihna lianpitawh Executive Committee Zomi Innkuan USA, Inc. Rocky Ziipao download Download free PDF arrow_forward_ios View more papers keyboard_arrow_down Abstract The article is an attempt to study the history of the Tedim Road, a 265 km transborder road connecting Imphal (the capital of Manipur in India) with Tedim in the Chin Hills (Chin State) in western Burma (Myanmar). It was constructed by the British solely for the purpose of facilitating military movements along the IndiaBurma frontier during the Second World War. Although it is yet to receive adequate scholarly attention, the historical significance of the Tedim Road as part of the larger Allied plan for the reconquest of Burma after it was lost to the Japanese in the early 1940s cannot be overlooked. The article attempts to analyse encounters between the Allied and the Japanese on this road. It argues that the historical events that occurred on the Tedim Road and the participation of the indigenous tribes of the IndiaBurma frontier in the war made a significant contribution to ensuring the withdrawal of the Japanese from the Indian frontier. ... Key takeaways AI generated The Tedim Road, spanning 265 km, was pivotal for military logistics during WWII. Historical events on the Tedim Road contributed significantly to Japanese withdrawal from India. Indigenous tribes played crucial roles in labor and intelligence, aiding Allied forces. Seven decisive battles occurred on the Tedim Road, impacting the overall campaign. The article aims to highlight the strategic importance of the Tedim Road in historical context. FAQ's AI generated What strategic role did Tedim Road play during the Second World War? add The Tedim Road was essential in preventing the encirclement of the 17 Indian Division by Japanese forces. It allowed for crucial military operations and retreats, influencing the course of the campaign in 1944. How did the construction of the Tedim Road impact local populations during WWII? add Over 5,000 indigenous Zos participated in constructing the Tedim Road, earning resources amidst chaos. Their involvement provided vital labor support to the British, creating both resilience and dependency within local communities. What evidence indicates the Tedim Road's historical significance before British annexation? add The article notes that Tedim was a vital administrative center prior to British control, influencing over 130 villages. This underscores its role in pre-colonial interactions between Manipur and the Chin Hills. When did the Tedim Road begin to receive military attention during the war? add Military interest in the Tedim Road surged in September 1942 when plans were made for its construction to facilitate movement against advancing Japanese forces. This decision came amid early Japanese incursions into Indian territory. How did the fighting dynamics change due to battles on the Tedim Road? add Seven significant battles on the Tedim Road prevented the Japanese from effectively encircling British forces. These confrontations, characterized by intense combat, turned the road into a 'corridor of death' for Japanese troops. (Pre-print) jasnea sarma download Download free PDF Kanchanaburi and the Thai-Burma railway: disputed narratives in the interpretation of war John Lennon download Download free PDF References (30) Tedim is the largest village in northern Chin State. Before the advent of the British it was the seat of Kam Hau, a paramount ruler who was feared not only in his domain but also in the neigh- bouring areas, including Manipur and the Lushai Hills. Named after the ruler, the Kamhaus are today better known as Zomi. Apart from in Chin State, they are today predominantly found in Churachandpur district of Manipur and parts of Mizoram. The Tedim Road thus connected the separated Zo people (also known as Chin-Kuki-Mizo) who are settled on both sides of the international boundary. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Zolai gelhzia alunglutte tung ngaihsut piakna ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zolai gelhzia alunglutte tung ngaihsut piakna posted on 4 August 2014 at 1:37 pm Lomkholna: Article , Literature , Zamsiansum Zolai gelhzia alunglutte tung ngaihsut piakna Zolai pen hongpian zawh sawtnai hetlo nungdeuh in kum 100 cinpawi kibawl pan hi. Ataktak in Zolai simbu ci-in sanginn ah Formal takin isin hun 1924 kumkhawng hipan ahih manin kum 100 cing nailo hi cileng khiallua loding hi. Tuamah bangin Linguistics pan enleng, Zolai tawh kisai Philology, Syntactics, Discourse, Pragmatics, Semantics, Structuralism, Grammar, Phonetics, Phonology, etc. cih bangin sintheih ding, puahding maban tampi omlai hi. Tu tadih inbel Morphology, Lexicology, Morphophonemics ciang buaipih lunglung lai hihang. Taangpi taangta theih dingin tomkaih pakleng laimal gawmdan SpellingWord Structure ciangah buai lingling hihang. Tua kawmkal ah awsuahawkaih (Accent) kibanglo ihih manin lai igelh ciangin akihual kiim theiding hamsa sim hi. Gentehna in; gamngam, ginngin, gawmngawm cihbang dan tepawl. Pasian hehpihna tawh Zomite Laisiangtho sinna lamah mazangin Ph.D. tampi i om ta hi. Ahih hangin Secular lamah kitawm lai mahmah cihding hi. Tua kawmkal ah Lai lamah cileng Linguistics, Literature Majors te tawh DoctorD. Lit. ngah kikhaat mahmah a, M.A. ciangzong kitawm mahmah hi. Katheih khialh keileh D.Lit. ngahbang ki omzo nailo hi. Tua banah hong nusiakhin pawlkhat om in, anungta lai kitawm hi. Mailam ah khangthak sungah Zolai zuunding pilna sangnei tampi hong piankhiat dingzong lamen hang. Tuabang teng kawmkal ah nuntak khuasak haksatna hangin lai-uk, laideih, laisiamnuam, laitheinuam veuveu themcik khat lobuang atamzaw in sumngah nading, hauhpak nading, meetpak nading leh zalian pipi, makai pipi suahtheih nading bek buaipih in laigelhdan peuhmah awlmawh in neilo uh hi. Tua bektham lo-in tulai khangno tampite in Zolai zong ginatak in gelhthei nawnlo uh hi. Zolai siamlo in English zong siam tuanlo zelmah hi. Tua kacih ciangin pawlkhat bangin zahdah khamai dinguh a, ahi zongin tuciangciang online ah English tawh lai kigelh te ka-et ciangin hoihtakmaantak a gelhthei mi 10 zong a-om teiitam kaci hi. English abul abal a thei, endik (edit) semthei dingciang mi 34 bang ih omzo teii tam ci-ing. Cianlian keng (Not quite sure). Lamkhat pan tuazong ahiding mah hi. Mikangte mahmah zong amau lai English maantakhoihtak gelh theilo tampi omlel uh hi. Mangpau leuleu bel maanse takei leh dangnal zalzal, eusuk euto a pauthei tawh, uun-ham duadua a pauthei tawh ki-om nianua hi. Hibang teng kawmkal ah Zolai avei zawdeuh te in amau kivakna Specialization ahih zenzen loh hangin hong zuunsak toto in Tan 4 (Standard Four) ciang kisinthei a, laigelh thei liamliam dinmun tungta ihih manin amau tungah ilungdamna lian mahmah hi. Hih atung a igen bialbual teng kikumni cileng hongsau luading ahih manin tulaitak Zolai gelhzia hong lungmangsak dekdek awsau, awtom, aw-eu tawh kisai them eusuk ni. Amasa in Cope topan hong bawlsak Zolai pen Languages tampi te mah bangin awsuah zui-in laimal gawm hihang. Tuatawh kizui-in laimal cin bangpen Mikang awkaih in sin himawk ahih manin telkhialh loh nadingin chin tawh na malgawm sak hi. Tua huhau-in Zomi upa Cin minnei pawlkhat Chin in na malgawm uh a, pawlkhat bang lungmanlawh dektak uh hi. Tua banah nidang Zo laibute enleng zong awkhat malkhat Monotonic Syllables zui-in kigelh tamzaw hi. Gentehna in: Pau Hau in thau a nei hi. Ni a sa hi. Mi li a si hi. Sih ah sa a pang hi. Tuhun leuleu ciangin aw 45 bang malkhat asuah sukziau zong ki-om ta hi. Gentehna in; pheituamsungteenthak cihbang dan. Atung a igensa mah bangin awsuah zui-a malgawm pen kitamzat pen hi. Ahih hangin Zolai pen Manglai danin Phonetic Alphabets atuam in neilo ihih manin kammal pawlkhat awsuah banglian aleikiat zui-in malgawm haksa hi. Gentehna in: Hai 1) Kanau in huan ah hai gah alo hi. 2) Mihai tawh kikhawl kei in. 3) Hai ciakciak kei in. 4) Tutung mopawi ah tanute leh haitawite buaideuh uh hi. 5) Mi suangtum tawh kideng ziahziah namuh ciangin en heihai kei in. Atung a gentehna teng lakah 1 leh 5 na ah laimalgawm hai sangin haai zangleng awsuah tawh kinaizaw hi. Ahih hang laigual 1 na ah hai bangzong izatzatsa leh ikingeina sehnasa hi-in alaimal imuhphet in imitkha ah hai lim hongsuak pah hi. Laigual 5 na-a hai sang haai cileng zong khialh omlo, cikei lengzong telkhialh nading liang omsam lo hi. Tua hi-in laigual 1 leh 5 na ah haihaai laimalte pen awsuah kibang hinapi akhiatna atuamtuak hise hi. Mikang ten tuate pen Homophones naci uh hi. Tua banah 2 leh 3 na ah hai pen akhiatna akibat hang awsuah kibang lotuak hi. Laigual 2 na ah hai pen aw-eu leh awtom kigawm hi-in, 3 na-a hai leuleu pen aw-uunniam leh awtom hi citciat se hi. Tuamah bangin 3 leh 4 pen awsuah kinai huaipian napi akhiatna tuamtuak hivet sehi. Hih atung a hai teng bangzong Mikangpau in Homonyms cileng huamkiim hi. Tua ahih manin hibangdan kammalte igelh ciangin Kawllai danin awsuah khenkhiatnakilamdan sakna tuamtuam neilo, Manglai danin lah Phonetic Transcription tuam neihlo ihih manin asimte in laiguallaipai (Context) en a bangci awsuah ding cih ngahsut siamkul hi. Nidang ciang Phonetics atuam a ineih zawhleh thukhat ci ni. Anuai ah khat ensuk lai ni: Pai Sumkuang lampai ahat kei hi. Ninbung sung bekah ninpai in. Note pai kawikawi unla lungdamna thu vataang ko un. Hih atung a pai teng bang isim ciangin awsuah kibang lo hi. Double Vowels zattheih nading zong om tuanlo hi. Double Vowels zattheihna pen anuai a bang munte bek hi: Khat lah kateem, khat lah kapaai himawk in kagup zawkding thei keng. Naupaiite gilo thei hi. Zolai ah hibangdan awsuah banglian a ki-at theilo, akhiatna lah kitel veve laimalte deihtak kancian laileng tampitak omlai ding hi. Maban sah mahmah omlai cihna hi. Hun ingahciang zom toto ni. Tu tadih inbel awsau zatdan them telkheh nuam hang. Awsau pen Zolai in ih at ciangin atamzaw in Double Vowel zang hihang. Gentehna in; Ciim,Meii, Thaam (gulpi), Taanghaam, Taangmi, etc. Double Vowels zathuai laimal gawmdan pawlkhat Ciim, Ciin, Daan, Kiim, Leeng, Leii, Maang, Meii, Taang, Teel, Tuu, Zaan, Zuu, etc. CiimCim Sawm Piang pen sang akah ngeiloh hangin ciim (cim hilo) vilvel se hi. Langno lo huung pen cimlua (ciimluahilo) in ihmu cipkha hi. CiinCin, MeiiMei Tuni thapai meii (mei hilo) kaii in guah a ciin (cin hilo) hi. (meii awlai leh awsau kigawm; ciin awsangeu pian leh awsau kigawm) DaanDan Migam milei ah nuntak dan isiam keileh daan kituak thei hi. (Daantuakdaanpia cihbang munte lobuangah dan kizang lel hi.) KiimKim Mikiim (kim hilo) in haksatna kinei ciat hi. Simbeng zong kim (kiim hilo) ciitciat tangzangh kiguan. LeengLeng Vanleeng tual ah sakolleng tailo hi. Lehbulh khaleng akhiatna tuampi suak hiau hi: Vanleng tual ah sakolleeng tailo hi. LeiiLei Sai mai-ah vanlei nuam mi hongpai ciang naleii naphen khakei in. MaangMang Mingelh ciangin atamzaw in Mang limzat zaw uh a, awsuah bangin gelhleng Maang ding hizaw hi. Laigelh ciangin akitel khialthei munte ah zatsiam kul hi: Galkap Maangpa (Commander) in anautaangte thu apia hi. Galkap mangpa (lost soldier) kimukik ta hi. (Hidan munte lobuangah maang leh mang kizang taang kawikawi a, laisim te in zong kitelsiam lel hi.) TaangTang Thang Ho leh Lian Do inzong taangtang phelhawm kici hi. Kawlgam innpi ah Taangmi pawlkhat ihmut suakin lusu ngeingai uh hi. Ngalkhaat tetangtat (taangtat hilo) uh hi. (Taang pen mun tampi ah kizang thei a, tang tawh khenkhiat siam kul hi.) Teeltel Mipil kiteelna ah thutel meello mihai lomtangg vakihel hi. Laigual sungah teel leh tel lehbulh khaleng akhiatna tuampi suak hi: Mipil kitelna ah thuteel meello mihai lomtangg vakihel hi. TuuTu Hiah tu inla pau kei in. Jesuh in Tuucing (tucinghilo) hoih ahi hi. Kei nong it leh katuute (tutehilo) nakem in. (Laigual masapen bangah tu sangin tuu in malgawm leng awsuah tawh kinai zaw hi. Laigual nihna ah Tuu bangpen awtom hi-a, Tucinghoih cileng awsuah tawh kinaizaw hi. Theihding ah tuu, tuuno, tuupeek cihte pen Cope topan hong bawlsak laimalgawm lakah tudong zatngeina Convention zahphial a ineih laimal hoih hi-a, awtom, awsau koimun koimun ah Double Vowels tawh gelh hamtang kul hi. Tu-le-ta te (PosterityDescendants) munah tuu-le-ta te (Sheep and Children) ci-a gelhkhak lohding zong thupi zel hi.) ZaanZan Zaan ni zankim pawlin hong kimeng hi. Zaanzan in hong kimeng hi. (Mundang tampi ah zan tawh kicing lel hi.) Mangpu ihmut suaklua kizan deedaa hi. ZuuZu Zuudawnte in zuumi (zuu tawh mehkhoppih) dingin zusa (zuusa hilo) emkeu uh hi. Hih atung a teng lakah Ciin leh Tuu lobuang atamzaw awniam, awlai leh awsau munte ah double vowel kizang phadiak hi. Ciin pen aw-eu pian leh awsau kigawm hi. Aw-eu mun khempeuh ah double vowels zat pahpah lohding hoihzaw hi. Izatkhak leh ilaigelh ziate hong kitukalh mangding hi. Atung a teng banah honkhat omlai hi. Tua banah Double Vowels zang taleng, zang takeileng akitel laimal pawlkhat om leuleu hi. Gentehna in: KhaangKhang KhangnoteKhaangnote in minam nasep kinbawl uh hi. Zomi te in khangkhaang tangthu thupiseh uh hi. (Khang zatna atamzaw pen awlai leh awsau kigawm ahih manin Double Vowel tawh malgawm leng khiallo napi, Single Vowel tawhzong kitelcian mahmah hi. Atamzaw in Single Vowel tawh malgawm uh hi.) Ahih hang khang leh khaang akizat khawm theihlohna om ciitciat hi: Ihmu in Topan hongkem ahih manin ka khanglo (khaanglo hilo) hi. Guah tamlua-in leitang akhaang (khang hilo) hi. (Risen hilo Cracked cihnopna ah) IinIn Zopaulai ahin kici affix pen kitamzat mahmah a, atamzaw suffix in kizang hi. Awlai leh awsau kigawm ahih manin awsuah lianin gelhleng iin ding hi. Ahi zongin laimal dangtawh telkhialh nading om peuhmah lo ahih manin atamzaw in Single Vowels mahtawh kizang suak a, Norm khat bangin kingahsunta hi: Tuakhit cianginciangiin uiphuk mangpa tuisungah alutsuk hi. ZouZooZo Ataktak in tulai Zo, Zomi, Zolai, Zopau cihte ah Zo pen awlai leh awsau kigawm ahih manin Double Vowels tawh ZouZoo cih bangin gelhleng awsuah tawh kinaipen hi: Zo(awsuah Zoo) lakah sa ataa hi. Zomite gualneek zo kasakei hi. Zomi ka hi hi. Laigual 2 nasungah Zo laimal munnih ah om napi, amasa pen Zoo ci-in awsau tawh isim a, anunung pen zo, gualzo, galzo, cihdan awtom tawh isim se hi. Hipen Kawlten igelh ciang amaan, isimciang a-aw (ရတ အမန ဖတတ အသ) aneih mah bangun Zolai ah zong anei hihang. Double Vowels limzat mahmah honkhat bangin himun ah hongzang samlo uh ahih manun lungdam huai hi. KaawlgaamKawlgam Awsuah liantawh gelhding hileng awsau leh awlai tuak ahih manin Kaawlgaam cihding hi. Awsuah liantawh gelhsang Kawlgam cileng laimal ciiksuah zaw hi. Double Vowels pupite inzong Kawlgam mah hongzat pihlai uh hi. LaaiLai Muntampi ah kizang khel kawikawi hi. Ahi zongin khuamin Laaitui bangzong amau zatdan zatpih ding thuman ahi hi. Lai (Writing) leuleu pen awlai leh awsau kigawm hilo, aw-eu leh awsau kigawm zong hilo ahih manin lai, laimal, laigual, cihding hilel a, Double Vowels behlap kul peuhmah lo hi. Khatvei leh laimal khatvei leuleu leh laaimal cih thimthum kullo hi: Laaitui khua-ah laimal (laaimalhilo) gawmzia kisin hi. Tulaitulaai tak lai kagelh hi. LuungsiimLungsim Awsuah lian hileh Luungsiim ding hi-a, laigelh ciang Lungsim mah kizang kiim hi. Luungsiim ci-a malgawm kikhaat mahmah ding hi. SeemSem Thadah ten nasem (seem hilo) nuamlo hi. Zolai ah seem kizatna tawm mahmah ding hi. PeenPen Awsuah in peen ahih zenzen hang laigelh ciang pen kitam zatzaw hi. Bangmah dangtawh telkhialh nading omlo ahih ciang pen mah zangsuak leng hoihzaw hi. Tuanu pen mi gensiat hatlua kici ve aw. Double Vowel zatnop leh anuai a bang laigual te ah zathuai hi: Gol peenpeen mehneu tawi, neu peenpeen mehgol tawi. GaalgiingGalging Anih tuak in awlai leh awsau ahih manin awsuah lianin gelhleng gaalgiing ding hi. Zat ngeina ah galging, galkap, galhang, cih bangin Single Vowels kizang zaw hi. Ahih hang theihhuai thukhat ah, Zopau ah awsau pen tam simsim ahih manin laigelh ciang awsau omna khempeuh ah Double Vowel zangleng laisim dan alemloh naciang om banah, Conventional Writing tawh hong ki keelki thei hi. Mi pawlkhat te bangin lai malgawm ciangin Double Vowel tamzat lua-uh ahih manun amkham gawp in khat veivei awtom Single Vowel zangleng kitel siuseu zaw, maltu zawding hiphial taleh awsau Double Vowel zangkha vaivai zong om khelkhel hi. Awsuah lian zui-a laigelh sin dihni: Luun Maang peen Kaawlpi ah Zoo ngeina lam laam dingiin nuungkaal pek aa paaisuk hi aa phone lah hongseet lo diil deel mawk aa zaan haal ziing saang iin a paaipih te uun innlam hopih katheih ciang iin, keizong kadot leh, theikei uung hong cii luungkham lua iing. Koilaai koiteeng ah omcih hongkaan pih uun, hehpihna tawh. Luungdaam. Atung a laigualte enleng, awsuah liantawh ki-at hi-a, khialhna a-omloh hangin simhak simsim leh dausuah simsim hi. Tua manin S. T. Hau Go in Zolai pen awsuah lianlian in gelhleng lemtaang khinlo nacingei hi. Adiak in, awsau, aw-eu khempeuh Double Vowels bektawh zepthuah, behlap pahpah pen Zolai dausuahsak, peengsuahsak zawsop hi. Ahoih theipen a puahding, zuunding mawhpuak neiciat ihih mah bangin Double Vowels bektawh hilo-in akilawm zaw Phonetics tuamneih zo-in, laimalte ahih leh aciilgil theithei, aciik theithei in malgawm kisinleng ahoihzaw tam ci-ing. Zomi linguists te maban tampi omlai cihna hi. Mailam ah kikum toto ni. Articles Cidamna SIING (GINGER) THU THEIHHUAI. Agelh Dr. Nang Khan Lian By: LAIBUSAAL Date: October 25, 2020 SIING (GINGER) THU THEIHHUAI Agelh Dr. Nang Khan Lian Theih huai; Bang hunte ah Sing nek huailo? Sing pen tualsuak zatui khat in Pulepate in na zang uhi. Sing in lungnoneute thatzo in, gilpi um natna aading zong ahoih mahmah tualsuak innsung zatui khat ahi hi. Sing sungah an hing an hoihlote, gilpi um angawina le gu pawlkhatte a hemkhia zo enzyme tampi kihel ahih manin zong leitung ah akizang thei pen le ahoihpen tualsuak zatui hoihkhat ahi hi. Ahi zongin leitung thu khat ahi na khempeuh ah kicing cih omlo cih mah bangin a hoihna a liat mahmah hangin a siatna zong na om veve hi. A. Sing tamnek lua leng? Zatui lam kiva mipilte genna ah singpen nikhat 4g sangin a tamzaw nek ding hoihlo hi ci uhi. Tua sangin a tamzawk aa leh omdan hekdan noplo (malaise), awm sung gilsung sa (heartburn) le thazang natna (neuralgia) zong kivei thei hi ci uhi. B. Kuate in Sing zat huailo? (i.) Naupaai nupite, (ii.) Pongman pumpi gikna nuai ah a omte (BMI pan kithei thei hi) le (iii.) "url": " "depth": 1 --- Najib kimantading cih thuthang hangin Reporter ten a innmai ah ngakcippah ngeingai ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Najib kimantading cih thuthang hangin Reporter ten a innmai ah ngakcippah ngeingai posted on 27 June 2018 at 11:00 am Lomkholna: Malaysia , News , Sawltak , World Najib kimantading cih thuthang hangin Reporter ten a innmai ah ngakcippah ngeingai Abeisa in Malaysia gamsung ah Prime Minister asemlui ahi Datuk Seri Najib Razak pen zannitak in kimankhia tadinghi cih thuthang kiza ahih manin Reporters honkhat in delhpah ngeingai uh cih Bernama pan kiza hi. Najib kimanding cih thuthang akizak ciangin Taman Duta, Jalan Langgak Duta aom Najib ii innmai ah Reporter bekbek mi 30 bangin delhpah ngeingai uhhi. Ahi zongin hihvai tawh kisai in Bukit Aman Commercial Crime Investigation Department Director Datuk Seri Amar Singh Ishar Singh tungah akidot ciangin tua thuthangpen thumanlo hi, Rumour hi cin genkhia hi. Malaysia gamsung ah golhguk ane te apholakkhia leh amankhia kipawlna ahi Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) Commissioner Datuk Seri Mohd Shukri Abdull tungahzong akidot ciangin Najib innpen kibuluhna Raid omlo hi, kimatna zong omlo hi cin genkhia hi. Najib ii inngeiteng ah Police Personnel ten limtak in ngakcip, encik gigelai uh cihzong kiza hi. Abeisa in Prime Minister Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad in 1MDB (1Malaysia Development Berhad) vaitawh kisai in sum Billion tampitak supna om ahih manin, Najib pen thu kibawlding hi cin genkhia ngeihi. Tuavaiteng hangin Najib Razak leh azi Datin Seri Rosmah Mansor tepen gampualam ah azinkhiatheilo, ataisim theiloding inzong Immigration Department ten Blacklist sungah koihsak in, gampua apaikhiatding aki khakcip ahihi. Zanni in Najib kimantading cih akizak ciangin Reporter leh Media tuamtuam te lawpmahmah in delhpah ngeingai uh a, ahi zongin aki mantaktakding nahinailozel hi. Najib ii kimatkhiatding pen ki ngaklahtuak mahmahleh kilawm hi. 1MDB Scandal vai, sum neksimna vaitawh kisaipen 2015 kumpekpan akipankhia ahihi. Ahi zongin tualai in Najib Razak pen Prime Minister aseplaitak hi a, bangmah khialhna kaneikei hi cin Najib in nialcipden hi. Tuaban ah 1MDB vai akansawm Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) makaite pen Investigation abawl hangin khakcipsak pahpah kici hi. 1MDB sumvai tawh kisai in Najib in ama mimal Personal Bank Account sungah RM2.6 Billion (US681 Million) lutsak kici a, tuavai akikan ciangin Saudi Royal kumpi ten Donation apiak hi cihtawh khupcip sukziau hi. Tun Dr. Mahathir in Prime Minister hongngahkhiat, hongsep taktak ciangin tua 1MDB vai hoihtak in aki kankik theipanding ahihi. More: Najib innsungpan sum akimanteng kisimkhinta, RM114 Million pha Najib ii abeisa sumvai tawh kisai 1MDB gamtatna vaipen tulaitak hoihtak in aki kanciansan laitak hi a, tua Result tungtawn in Najib pen thong akiatleh akiatlohding ki khentatding hi cin Dr. Mahathir in genkhia hi. Abeisa in mattheih taktak nading mawhmat kician, Evidence kician taktak kimu nailo himahleh tuni akipan 1Malaysia Development Bhd (1MDB) Special Task Force cih kipawlna in mawhpuakla in Najib ii sumvai limkansawm mahmahlai uhhi. Nungak hel dan tuamtuam Hau Za Cin ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Nungak hel dan tuamtuam Hau Za Cin posted on 18 May 2020 at 9:51 am Lomkholna: Article , Hauzacin Nungak hel dan tuamtuam Hau Za Cin Ka pa tangval laiin meilah de in nungak hel uh hi. Kei tangval ciang leitung khangto zaw deuhta a dry cell battery kithuah datmei kici torch light zong akici tawh nungak kihel a, ka tangval lai mah in electric vak ah nungak mel kician taka kimu thei in nungak kihel thei a, .. (a ban pen ngaihsutna tawh zom ciat ni) Ka pa khangah khuakhat nungak bek kihel uh a, khuazin ciang zinna khua nungakte hel uh hi. Khualzinna pen khe tawh lampai vive hia, tua manin gim uh ahih manin ngeina danin mikhual tangval pen khuatual tangvalte sangin ciah baihzaw, lum baihzaw uh hi. Leitung hong khantoh zel tawh kituak in nungak helna pen khetawh pai bat, khetawh kitung zo hi mah leh ki style sakna leh noptalna zaw deuh tawh moto tawh a hel om ta a, Motor Bike leh Car tawh nungak hel om in, Jeep leh Truck tungah tuangin a vak zong om hi. Tua mah bangin Bicycle tung tuang leh Lawi tung tuang, sakawl tung tuang cih bangin om ding hi. Neih zawh dandan leh a kisap bangbang in kigamtang ciat ci pak ni. Tu hun ciangin leitung tawmkhat hong khangto zaw deuh a, nuntak hong nuam i cih hang nuntak a gimhuai hizaw ta a, nuntak nuam sangin sum leh pai tam kideihzaw ta hiam cih ding hi. Ahih kei leh a kilawm zaw deuh in gen leng i nekzonna hong kidang hi. Korea ah U Suanpi in la lui khat a gen zel mah bangin, Sunni lah tum ta, ngaih tawh lah khawllo hi den mai pawl om hi. Ngaih neite lah omkhawm lo, ngaih neilo te lah om khawm heelhawl cih zong om thei hi. Tua mah bangin ngaih neilote lah om khawmlo, ngaih neite lah om khawm cih zong hithei hi. Bangbang hi leh thu kizak tuah pen nuntak a nopna hi a, tua dingin laikhak kikhak thei in, telephone pan kiho in aw kiza thei in, kong ngai lua peuh kici pongpong sam in, internet tungtawn in laikikhak in, kiho on, online ah kizom in kiho lim cih bangin kizopna hong om hi. Meilah de a nungak helna pan internet tan kikhangto man cihna hi a, khangkhat khangthu dingin a thupi veve hi. Khe tawh nungak hel hun pan, Bicycle, Motor Bike, Car hun ban ah Vanleng na tawm tawh nungak a kihel ding hita tazen hi. Khantohna na sia mahmah hi. Bangbang tawh nungak na hel zongin itna kisam pen a, itna a kuitung ding thupi hi. Heina dang zong lailung kidang lo. Heina peuhah Zomi. Zogam Chin State thuneite leh Tedim gam leitang neite vai Pu Nang Lian Thang ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Zogam Chin State thuneite leh Tedim gam leitang neite vai Pu Nang Lian Thang posted on 8 February 2017 at 6:58 pm Lomkholna: News , Politics , Zomi Zogam Tedim ah Hotel lamtheih nadingin, Leilum apple-huangneite munteng laaksak sawm (confiscate) cih kiza hi. Chin State leh Tedim khantoh nadingin a ki vaihawm hi, lungdamhuai hi ci-in, Chin State vuangyi khat in Tedim upate leh Tedim thunei-te tungah gen hi. Hi banga kivaihawm ahih leh, Tedim MP-te leh Tedim pan-a Chin State MP-ten a thei kha uh hiam? Khuadang mihaute khut sungah ih Zogam, ih khua ih tui ong ki zuaksak ding ih phal diam? A beisa kumpi hun lai-in, Prime Minister Hung Ngai in a pianna gam Mindat leh Kanpetlet khua-te-ah Hotel Tourism khantoh nading ci-in, Hotel leh Tourism Business khuadang panin mihau tampi leitangh pia-in, semsak hi. Ih et kikkik teh, a khua a tui pen mi khutsungah leitung bei dong, a pia suak mawk hi. A mipite bel leitung bei dong hi leitangteah tua mihaute neihsa lamsa zah nei ngei lo ding in, nasem sila, khasum saang bek-in a om tawntung ding uh, khuangaih huai mahmah hi. Gentehna-in, a mipihte Hotel Tourism business pantah-in nuntak nading lampi honsak hi leh, ahih kei leh a leitang neite 50 or percent a kilawm zah khat neihtheihna vaihawmsak hi leh, a khuapihte in tu khang ta khang dongah, Business owner suak ding cih te ngaihsut huai mahmah hi. Zomi MP-te leh Tedim-gam khuanu khuapate ngaihsut ding 1. Kumpi lamding ahih leh Tedim khua te neihsa ahih manin phalhuai hi. Tua business nasepna khempeuh-ah nasemte pen kumpi khasum sang suak ding uh hi. 2. Kumpi min paulap napin, khuadang mihau khat ii business ding ahih leh, tua mihaupa nasem suak ding hi hanga, kumpi nasep zah-in, benefit om lo ding hi. Tua mihaupa in Tedim khua adingin, Kawlgam sum Teng tul val(US one million)official-in ong piakkhiat hang hawmthawh huai mahmah lai kha ding hi. 3. Zomi Tedim-gam sunga mihau tampitak hotel lam zo ding om hi. Personal-in midangten lam theih nading permit ngah thei ahih leh, ih MP-te leh Zomi thuneite in Zomi mihauten permit ngah theih nading vaihawm huai lo ding hiam? Tender kisam aa a kidemsak ahih leh zong, a hun lap-in mipi theih dingin, notice announcement a kibawl hiam? Tedim khuasungah hih notice-te khuanu khuapa theih dingin a ki zasak hiam? 4. Galkap kumpi hun lai-in, kumpi min paulap-in, lokho-mite leitangteng, mihaute tungah zuaksak hi. Tua tawh ki lamdang lo ding hi. 5. Mipite in Tedimkhua aa kumpilam thuneitetungah muhkhialh lohding kisam hi. Tungsiahte thu banga a tat uh kul hi aa, Tedim aa kumpi nasem makaiten vaipuak nei lo uh hi. Tua mah bangin, Leilum khua mipite deihna lungsim pulakna nasepnate-ah (movement) Tedimkhua kumpilam thuneite a galbawl uh ahih loh lam, Tedimkhua kumpilam thuneiten a telsiam ding uhzongh kisam hi. 6. Ih Tedim gamsungah pupa logam leitang khempeuh, kumpi akhang akhang-in gran kibawlsak cih bang om ngei lo hi. Thuduh manin, leitang lai, gran paulap aa thu bawlsawm cih te pen ngeina om lo hi. Mipi khempeuh ki thutuak aa ki panpihtek ding kisam mahmah hi. Mailam kalsuan zia ding 1. Leilumkhua mipite sungpanin hih vai a lunghimawhteng committee phuan-in, septohtoh huai hi. 2. Tua committee in Tedimkhua kumpilam thuneite tungah thuzaksakna lai piak ding kisam aa, a theihsak-huai munkhempeuh-ah copy piak ding kisam hi. 3. Tedimkhua, State Union level MP khempeuh leh CSO, CVO kipawlnate-ah theihsak ding leh huhnget ding kisam hi. 4. State Councilor Daw Aung San Suu Kyi, vice president Henry Van Thio, Chin State Prime Minister pu Salai Lian Luai-te tungah personal huhngetna lai piak kul hi. 5. Zomi sungah Zogam leitang vai a lunghimawhten ong panpih theih nadingin, Zomi Social Network Media khempeuh-ah suahsak huai hi. "url": " "depth": 1 --- Kidawm theileng DK Khup ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Kidawm theileng DK Khup posted on 4 September 2018 at 7:43 am Lomkholna: DKKhup , News , Zomi Kidawm theileng DK Khup Kawlgam UN Palai Pu HDSuan pen tu sungteng facebook pan athu (policy) hilo, a mimal hihna (personal attack) a koko om mawk hangin kidawm thei deuh leng mimal hoihsakna nei ingh. Muhdan tuamtuam bel a om thei ding mah hi in, ahi zong pawlkhat lai-at dan val deuh leh kilawmsa ingh. Pu Suan pen Palai (Ambassador-pi, Representative) hi in Kawl kumpi leh UN kipawlna kikal aa Kawlgam Palai hi. Palai nasep pen ama thu in vailiante ah zong thu khensat theihna nei panmun ( decision making) zong hilo in thei ingh. Tua ban ah Pu Suan pen career official (zum nasem ulian) hi a, NLD, ahih kei leh Galkap, political appointee (party mapanna hang in panmun ngah) zong hilo hi. Foreign Ministry ah kum tampi kumpi nam tuamtuam khat khit khat ah asem toto, za khang toto zum nasem khat hi. Pu Suan in amah leh amah zong Good Government Servant kumpi zum nasem hoihkhat hi ingh aki ci khat hi. Minam makai, minam nasem khat in zong ki gen ngeilo, zong ki ngaihsun ngeilo kha ding hi. Refugee vai ah ahih leh VP2, CNF, Chin state dinmun aki gengen hi in, Palai Pu Suan ki gen lo in thei ingh. Nung UNHCR-Malaysia Ulianpen in zong Pu Suan thei khalo a, ZomiChin Palai om cih in zong atheih loh lam 100 gen thei ingh. Tua hi in, refugee vai ah Pu Suan hel na ding, kisai sakna ding omlo kha dingin mimal muhna nei ingh. Lawmte ahih leh Kawlgam khuahun zui in kaaigawi kawikawi thei a, a ulian neihte uh gensia nuam hetlo in mu ingh. Rakhine buaina ahih leh athuman pen a lai khawng khat ah om leh kilawmsa ingh UN vs Myanmar military. Mimal muhna pan, UN te report zong sim leng huam at lua leh lang khat na ciang om veve in ki mu thei sa ingh. UN human right commissioner Hussein zong Trump in a deih hetlo hi. Trump in US zong UN human right council pan a pusuak pih liang hi.Pu Trump in muslim uangtat-te leh liberal mainstream media te dinmun tellua ahih man in Rakhine buaina tu ciang dong khatvei zong tweet nailo a, muslim pawlkhat te in Trump tungah a lungkim lohna pi khat zong hi in mu ingh. Photo te pen mipi lungsim la ding in a ki ziah hi thei a, athuman sang emotional appeal lam in ki zang thei in et dan siam kisam in mu ingh. 2005 kim pawl in Rakhine lawm khat in kum 3 sung khawng Rakhine gamsung a abuaipih te i siatna teng, Rakhine te a bawlsiatna teng uh thu tampi hong gengen ngei in, tu nai thupiang te tawh etkaak in ka hih teh alang, alang dinmun khat hong telsak tuam hi. Pu Suan report na te zong ka sim den phial zel aa, UN tawh kilehdo (confrontation) lam hilo in constructive engagementcooperation (semkhawm ahilam in kizopna) lam in mu ingh. Athu gen nunung dan mah in, NLD Kumpi in hong kah teh Kawlgam mite lametna, leitungbup in a hoih lam in hong muh kopat hunlian in ARSA pawl hong kipan in tu ciang mah Rakhine buaina vai tawh Kawlgammi khempeuh phial thutelcianlo atamzaw in hong mudah, Kawlgam zong hong vaan nuam nawnlo pawlkhat a om zah dong in dinmun anei ta ahih man in Kawlgam mite a ding a deih huai hetlo thu cihdan in a gen zel in tel ingh. Muslim gam teng leh liberal media pawlkhat ten hih vai uanggen, tawsawn den ban ah, Western gam pawlkhat ten NLD nusia om ta in Kawlgam leh Kawlgam mite a ding hunhoih ngah kipat ding a khaktan buaina cihlam in gen theih thu in zong mu ingh. Hih vai ah a thu omdan atel, asiam (expert) ka hi kei a, mimal kantawm, info simna tung in muhna bek hi. Thusau, vaitam khat ahih lam bel tel ingh. Tu nai mahmah in UN Human Right Commissioner Hussein in zong DASSK resign hen khawng cici ta hi. Kawlgam buai ding khawng a lungsim ah a koih kha hetlo, Rakhine buaina bek mah mitsuan hi leh kilawm sa ingh. Kawlgam deihsak leh DASSK dinmun thei US Senate majority leader Mr. Mitch McConnell muhdan tawh kilehbulh sa ingh. More: The Seven Myths about Zomi and Chin DK Khup Minam sungah ulian tam neihloh khawmkal ah i lapsan, pahtawi theih kei leh zong mimal in kobawl ding kilawmlo in mu ingh. Beh leh phung, u leh nau kinei ciat zong kihi in mimal kiko na te zat ding kilawmlo hi. Athu zui ahih leh muhdan tuamtuam akinei theih ding mah hi. Hih thusin na pen kha (9) sung sawt ding aa, a diakdiak in Community tuamtuam te ah cidamna lam a semte, Volunteer te leh Community sung pan in Community tawh khut kilen in nasem khawm nuamte kikah thei ding hi. Hih thusin na tungtawn in Lungsim damlohna lam (Mental) tawh kisai a hunlap takin lungsim lam damlohna tawh kisai panpih theih nading, a lauhuai dinmun te a tunloh na dingin lungsim damlo te tawh kisai bang ci kep ding, bang ci dal theih ding, bang ci pattah ding cih te a kipan kisin pih ding hi. Hih traning thusin na pen 30 October pan 2019 pan 01 July 2020 sung hiding hi. A lunglut te in a nunung pen in October 13, 2019 ni ma in form ki puak thei ding hi. PILVANG TAK IN OM SAWM NI Tuhun laitak in kimat kihen hong tam mahmah a, Malaysia kumpite in a gamsung ah phalna lo tawh om mitampi tak siangsak nuam ahih manin kimat kihenna hong tam to semsem ding hi ci gen khia khin uh hi. Mun tampi ah Oparasi lut kawikawi ahih manin I omna ciat ah kidawm tak, pilvang tak in om ding hanciam ni. A thukin lua mahmah ahih kei leh vakvak loin I om na ciat ah daitakin om ding hoih zaw tham hi. A zenzen in nasepna ah thuneite in sitna khat hong neih leh kei pen UNHCR ah gambel in hong san ding ngak in a om hi ingUNHCR card tawi gambelmi ka hi hi. Ka nuntak nading hih teng ah part time tawh na a sem pak hi ing ci-in I gen theih ding thupi ding hi. Tua bang mah in I boss te kiang ah zong limtak gen khol in. Amau mahmah in zong hihte pen khasum tawh ka sepsakte hi kei part time in hong kuan pak zel bek uh hi hong cih sak ding zong kisam hi. Malaysia om Zomipih a kuamaciat I omna gam huihnun zia tawh kizui in kidawm ciatni cih hong zasak phapha ung. Kiim leh pam a om mite in hong muh khialh loh dingin I om dan I khawldante kikem siam kawmsa in om ciatni. Azenzen in kimat kihenna khat natuak leh ZAM zum ah hong zasak pah in. Mi 2 kap khin Pu Thangboi ZOMI DAILY Skip to main content Skip to primary sidebar Skip to footer Additional menu ZOMI DAILY Online News Magazine HOME NEWS ZOMI WORLD MYANMAR MALAYSIA POLITICS BIAKNA HEALTH ARTICLE INTERVIEW Mi 2 kap khin Pu Thangboi posted on 25 September 2020 at 10:18 pm Lomkholna: News , Politics , Thangboi , Zomi Mi 2 kap khin Pu Thangboi Ih gam ih lei, ih khua ih tui maban ding tawh kisai thugenna leh thu kikupnate ah mi 2 kap khin ta hi. A nih un sangsia hi. Amasa Akap masa pen Saalzang khua a sangsia sem khat hi. September 18 ni a kap hi. Saalzang kuam ah phone kingah vetlo hi. Phone line adeih huaina thu kagen a, phone line hoihna mun ah ka omkhak man a zi angah lawh kahihna thu ciamnuih tawh thuah in kagen hi. Adang ih gam ih lei in akisap thu pawlkhat zong kagen uh hi. Sangsia khat hong dingto in thu agen kawm in hong kap hi. Pasal totang zukham ankham hetlo kimlai a akap ahi hi. Ih gam ah kideidanna tamlua ci hi. Akhasiatna thu tampi hong suut hi. Kei zong ka nehno gawp a Pasian in leitung abawl lai in abuan val teng tawh Saalzang hong phop hisamlo hi. Gual tawh tanbang kim ding a hong siam hi kaci hi. Anihna Anihna pen zan nitak (September 24) hi. Tonzang khuapi sungah amun 7 na BOC veng ah thugenna kanei uh hi. Ka thugenna mun uh pen Khuavong Zolai sang gei hi. Democracy gimnam ih zak zawh kum 10 phading hita hi. Hih Tonzang khuasung lam lianpi gei a sang nagawn akilaih nailoh pen lamdang kasa mahmah hi. Hih zah a sanginn hoihlo sung ah naupang ten bangci nopsak peuhmah ding uh ahiam. Bawng khum leng zong ut ken teh. Naupangte maban ih honsak kei leh ih gam maban abing hilel hi Sangpi gei a tualpi tungah vanleng tual kibawl mawk hi. Naupangte kimawl thei nawnlo hi. Naupang pen aki mawlmawl ding hizaw hi. Akimawl khak kei leh alungsim leh apumpi khangto lo ding hi. Amun dang awnglo hisamlo aih teh hih sangnaupangte kimawlna tualpi ah vanleng tual vabawl zawzen ding hisamlo hi kaci hi. Aden teh mipi hun atun teh mipi sungpan nupi khat hong dingto in Kei Khuavong Zolai sang a sangsiapinu hing ongcih teh ka patau man liang hi. Thu ong gen kawmkawm in ong kap hiau hi. Hih sang bel kawlgambup a sang teng pan hoih kei pen mah inteh ci hi. Sanginn akingah mah hiven ong kisut ci hi. Ki deidanna vai mah hi. A party in gen leng azadah om in cin biakna pawlpi tawh gen leng: Kei pen AG hing. Ko AG te pen agamlum nam kahi uh hi. Ka ut uhteh tawndian in akumangte kahi uh hi. Ko nuam kasak mahmah uh hang khat veivei kiim le paam in dongkholh ongsa in amit uh adon mahmah hun om ding hi. Party ih cih zong ih kibatpih teng tawh kikhawl in nuam ihsak hang ih kibatpih lohte muhna ah khat veivei dongkholh mahmah thei ding hi. Zogam ah party tam mahmah hi. Khat le khat ih kizahtak diamdiam ding thupi hi. Ih kibatpihlote ih gal hi pahpah samlo hi.
